mandarin_meaning: 一種芳香的草本植物（古籍常見），也常用作人名用字
english_meaning: a kind of aromatic herb (appears in classical texts); also used as a character in personal names
explanation_mandarin: 「芷」原指一種帶香氣的草本植物，常見於古文；現代也常用作人名中的字，帶有文雅、清新的意象。
explanation_english: Originally refers to an aromatic herb found in classical texts; nowadays it is also used as a character in personal names, conveying a sense of elegance and freshness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個名叫李芷，聽落好文靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ming4 giu3 lei5 zi2, teng1 lok6 hou2 man4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的名字叫李芷，聽起來很文靜。
examples.english_sentence: Her name is Li Zhi; it sounds very gentle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 芷係一種香草，古時有人用嚟做香料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 hai6 jat1 zung2 hoeng1 cou2, gu2 si4 jau5 jan4 jung6 lai4 zou6 hoeng1 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 芷是一種香草，古時有人用來當作香料。
examples.english_sentence: Zhi is a type of aromatic herb; in ancient times people used it as a fragrance or spice.

mandarin_meaning: yún；原指芳草、藥草；亦見於『芸芸』，表示眾多、一般大眾；常作人名用字
english_meaning: yún; originally an aromatic/herbaceous plant; appears in '芸芸' meaning numerous/the masses; also used as a personal name
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（常見於複合詞、成語或人名）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (used in compounds, idioms, and personal names)
explanation_mandarin: 漢字，古義指芳草或藥草；現多見於詞語或成語，如『芸芸眾生』表示眾多的生靈、世人；亦常作人名的一個字。廣東話日常較少單獨使用，通常出現在複合詞或名字中。
explanation_english: Chinese character originally referring to aromatic or herbaceous plants. Commonly appears in compounds and the idiom '芸芸眾生' (the myriad beings/the masses). Also frequently used as a character in personal names. Rarely used alone in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世界上有芸芸眾生，各有各的命運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 gaai3 soeng6 jau5 wan4 wan4 zung3 sang1, gok3 jau5 gok3 dik1 ming6 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 世上有芸芸众生，各有各的命运。
examples.english_sentence: There are myriad beings in the world; each has its own fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識個朋友叫王芸，佢喺設計公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 go3 pang4 jau5 giu3 wong4 wan4, keoi5 hai2 cit3 gai3 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我认识一个朋友叫王芸，她在设计公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: I know a friend named Wang Yun; she works at a design company.

mandarin_meaning: 众多；芸芸众生（指普罗大众、凡人）
english_meaning: numerous; myriad; the common people (ordinary masses)
explanation_mandarin: “芸芸”常用于“芸芸众生”，表示众多、平凡的众人或世间万物，带有泛指多数或凡俗之意。
explanation_english: “芸芸” is often used in the phrase “芸芸众生” to denote the many or the ordinary masses — innumerable beings or commonplace people; it conveys the idea of multitude or ordinariness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界芸芸眾生，各有各嘅命運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 wan4 wan4 zung3 sang1, gok3 jau5 gok3 ge3 ming6 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界芸芸众生，各有各的命运。
examples.english_sentence: In this world of countless beings, everyone has their own fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺芸芸人群入面，你要保持自己嘅獨特。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 wan4 wan4 jan4 kwan4 jap6 min6, nei5 jiu3 bou2 ci4 zi6 gei2 ge3 duk6 dak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在芸芸人群中，你要保持自己的独特。
examples.english_sentence: Among the many people, you should keep your uniqueness.

mandarin_meaning: 芹（通常指芹菜，如中國芹或西洋芹）
english_meaning: Celery (the edible vegetable; can refer to Chinese celery or Western celery)
explanation_mandarin: 指一種可食用的蔬菜，常指芹菜，莖葉帶香味，用於湯、炒菜或沙拉等料理中。
explanation_english: An edible vegetable (celery). Stalks and leaves are aromatic and used in soups, stir-fries, salads, and other dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚煲湯加啲芹菜會好味啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 bou1 tong1 gaa1 di1 kan4 coi3 wui5 hou2 mei6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚煲汤加点芹菜会更好吃。
examples.english_sentence: If you add some celery to the soup tonight, it will taste better.

mandarin_meaning: 芹菜 (qíncài)
english_meaning: celery
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的蔬菜，茎和叶可食，常用于炒菜、凉拌或汤品中。
explanation_english: A common vegetable whose stalks and leaves are eaten; commonly used in stir-fries, salads, and soups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚買咗啲芹菜，準備炒牛肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 di1 kan4 coi3, zeon2 bei6 caau2 ngau4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚買了些芹菜，準備炒牛肉。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some celery tonight and am going to stir-fry it with beef.

mandarin_meaning: 飼料；乾草（文言，也可作“割草”或“供給飼料”之意）
english_meaning: fodder; hay; (literary) to cut/supply fodder
explanation_mandarin: “芻”多指給牲畜吃的飼料或乾草，常見於文言文或書面語，有時也用作動詞，表示割草或提供飼料。
explanation_english: “芻” refers to fodder or hay for livestock. It is chiefly literary and can sometimes be used as a verb meaning to cut or supply fodder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農莊準備咗足夠嘅芻料畀牛羊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 zong1 zeon2 bei6 zo2 zuk1 gau3 ge3 ceoi1 liu6 bei2 ngau4 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農場準備了足夠的飼料給牛羊。
examples.english_sentence: The farm prepared enough fodder for the cattle and sheep.

mandarin_meaning: 初步的意見；暫時的討論或建議
english_meaning: a preliminary suggestion or tentative discussion; a rough proposal
explanation_mandarin: 文言或書面用語，指尚未定案的粗略意見或初步討論，常用於報告或會議中表示暫時性觀點。
explanation_english: A literary/formal term for a provisional or rough opinion — a tentative suggestion or preliminary discussion, often used in reports or meetings to indicate an interim point of view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告只係芻議，仲需要詳細研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 hai6 cau4 ji5, zung6 seoi1 jiu3 coeng4 sai3 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告只是初步意见，还需要详细研究。
examples.english_sentence: This report is only a preliminary suggestion; it still needs thorough study.

mandarin_meaning: 芽 (yá)：植物的嫩芽、芽苞；亦可指事物的萌芽、初期。
english_meaning: bud; sprout; the nascent or beginning stage of something.
explanation_mandarin: 指植物生長出的嫩芽或芽苞；引申可指事物的萌芽、初期階段。亦常見於食材名稱，如「豆芽」。
explanation_english: Refers to a plant's bud or sprout; figuratively can mean the beginning or nascent stage of something. Also commonly appears in food names like "bean sprout."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天到，樹上開始長出新芽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 dou3, syu6 soeng6 hoi1 ci2 zoeng2 ceot1 san1 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天到了，树上开始长出新芽。
examples.english_sentence: Spring has arrived; new buds are starting to grow on the trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意喺湯入面加啲豆芽，食落更清爽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 tong1 jap6 min6 gaa1 di1 dau6 ngaa4, sik6 lok6 gang1 cing1 song2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢在汤里加一些豆芽，吃起来更清爽。
examples.english_sentence: I like adding some bean sprouts to the soup; it tastes fresher.

mandarin_meaning: 芽菜（指蔬菜的嫩芽，常指豆芽；在粵語語境下有時也指醃製或調味的芥菜芽）
english_meaning: sprouts; bean sprouts; young shoots (in Cantonese sometimes refers to preserved/seasoned mustard sprouts used as a condiment)
explanation_mandarin: 指蔬菜的嫩芽，通常指豆芽或其他可食用的芽。在廣東話裡，有時也用來指經醃製或調味的芥菜芽，常用作配菜、拌料或炒菜的材料。
explanation_english: Refers to the young shoots of vegetables, commonly bean sprouts. In Cantonese usage it can also mean preserved or seasoned mustard sprouts used as a side dish or ingredient in cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚炒菜我買咗啲芽菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 caau2 coi3 ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 ngaa4 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚炒菜我買了些芽菜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some sprouts to stir-fry tonight.

mandarin_meaning: （1）豆芽、芽菜；（2）俚語：形容瘦小的人或對年輕、新手的愛稱（帶戲謔或親暱意味）
english_meaning: (1) Bean sprouts; (2) slang/affectionate term: someone skinny or a young/novice person (playful or teasing)
explanation_mandarin: 「芽菜仔」原指可食用的豆芽菜；在口語中也可作俚語或暱稱，用來形容人瘦小、年輕或是新手，常帶玩笑或親暱意味。
explanation_english: Literally refers to bean sprouts (edible). Colloquially it can be used as a slang or nickname to describe someone very skinny, young, or a newcomer—often used playfully or teasingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚食炒牛河，入面有芽菜仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 sik6 caau2 ngau4 ho4, jap6 min6 jau5 ngaa4 coi3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚吃炒牛河，里面有芽菜。
examples.english_sentence: We're having beef ho fun tonight with bean sprouts in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瘦到好似芽菜仔咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sou3 dou3 hou2 ci5 ngaa4 coi3 zai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他瘦得像豆芽一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's as skinny as a bean sprout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱返工嘅阿明，大家叫佢芽菜仔，因為佢好年輕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aam1 aam1 faan1 gung1 ge3 aa3 ming4, daai6 gaa1 giu3 keoi5 ngaa4 coi3 zai2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hou2 nin4 hing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚上班的阿明，大家叫他芽菜仔，因为他很年轻。
examples.english_sentence: The new guy Ah Ming is nicknamed '芽菜仔' because he's very young.

mandarin_meaning: 園、園林；文學或藝術的聚集、活動場所或範圍
english_meaning: garden; park; a literary or artistic circle/venue
explanation_mandarin: 「苑」常指園林、花園或供人遊賞的場所；引申也可指文學、藝術等的聚集或活動領域（如「文苑」）。
explanation_english: «苑» usually refers to a garden, park, or landscaped area for enjoyment; by extension it can mean a literary or artistic circle/field (e.g. "文苑").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個花苑好靚，啱我哋影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faa1 jyun2 hou2 leng3, aam1 ngo5 dei6 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個花苑很漂亮，適合我們拍照。
examples.english_sentence: This garden is beautiful; it's suitable for us to take photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺文苑出咗本詩集，幾受好評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 man4 jyun2 ceot1 zo2 bun2 si1 zaap6, gei2 sau6 hou2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在文苑出版了一本詩集，頗受好評。
examples.english_sentence: He published a poetry collection in the literary circle and it received quite good reviews.

mandarin_meaning: 茯苓（中药名），一种药用菌核（Poria cocos），用于利水渗湿、健脾安神。
english_meaning: Poria (Poria cocos), a medicinal fungus commonly called 'fu ling' in Chinese medicine, used to promote urination, drain dampness, strengthen the spleen, and calm the mind.
explanation_mandarin: 「苓」多見於藥名或藥材名中，如「茯苓」。指一種可入藥的菌核，常用於中醫處方以利水滲濕、健脾及安神。
explanation_english: The character '苓' appears in names of medicinal materials (e.g., 'fu ling'). It denotes the sclerotium of a fungus (Poria cocos) used in TCM for draining dampness, promoting urination, strengthening the spleen, and calming the spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中藥方入面有苓，主要用嚟利水化濕同健脾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 joek6 fong1 jap6 min6 jau5 ling4, zyu2 jiu3 jung6 lai4 lei6 seoi2 faa3 sat1 tung4 gin6 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中药方剂里有苓，主要用于利水化湿和健脾。
examples.english_sentence: The herbal prescription contains 'ling' (fu ling); it is mainly used to promote urination, drain dampness, and strengthen the spleen.

mandarin_meaning: 苔藓（如青苔），常見於潮濕表面
english_meaning: moss; moss-like plants (e.g., green moss)
explanation_mandarin: 指生長在潮濕表面的苔蘚類植物，常見於石頭、牆壁、樹幹等，顏色多為綠色或暗綠色。
explanation_english: Refers to moss or moss-like plants that grow on damp surfaces; commonly found on stones, walls, and tree trunks, usually green or dark green in color.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 石牆上長滿咗青苔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sek6 coeng4 soeng6 zoeng2 mun5 zo2 ceng1 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 石墙上长满了青苔。
examples.english_sentence: The stone wall is covered with moss.

mandarin_meaning: 秧苗；幼苗；（用於複合詞）疫苗；（如“苗頭”）端倪、跡象
english_meaning: seedling; young plant; (in compounds) vaccine; a sign or indication (as in '苗頭')
explanation_mandarin: 指植物的幼苗，也常見於複合詞中（如疫苗、苗頭），可表示實物的幼苗或抽象的跡象、端倪。
explanation_english: Refers to a young plant or seedling. Also appears in compounds (e.g., '疫苗' vaccine, '苗頭' sign) to mean either the physical seedling or an indication/hint of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我種咗啲菜苗喺陽台上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 zo2 di1 coi3 miu4 hai2 joeng4 toi4 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把菜苗种在阳台上。
examples.english_sentence: I planted the vegetable seedlings on the balcony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經打咗疫苗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 daa2 zo2 jik6 miu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经打了疫苗。
examples.english_sentence: I've already been vaccinated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司見到訂單增多，覺得有啲苗頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gin3 dou3 ding6 daan1 zang1 do1, gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 miu4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司看到订单增多，觉得有些苗头（有起色）。
examples.english_sentence: The company saw orders increase and felt there were signs of improvement.

mandarin_meaning: 苗圃 (miáopǔ)，培育幼苗的場地或機構
english_meaning: plant nursery; a place where seedlings, saplings, and ornamental plants are grown
explanation_mandarin: 專門培育、管理及出售幼苗、樹木或觀賞植物的場所或機構，常用於園藝、造林或復育計劃。
explanation_english: A facility or site where young plants, saplings, and ornamental plants are cultivated, managed, and often sold; used for horticulture, reforestation, or restoration projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個苗圃專門種植花草同樹苗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 miu4 pou2 zyun1 mun4 zung3 zik6 faa1 cou2 tung4 syu6 miu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个苗圃专门种植花草和树苗。
examples.english_sentence: This nursery specializes in growing flowers, plants, and saplings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市政府會喺沿海地區建立一個苗圃去復育本地植物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zing3 fu2 wui5 hai2 jin4 hoi2 dei6 keoi1 gin3 lap6 jat1 go3 miu4 pou2 heoi3 fuk6 juk6 bun2 dei6 zik6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市政府会在沿海地区建立一个苗圃去复育本地植物。
examples.english_sentence: The city government will establish a nursery in the coastal area to restore native plants.

mandarin_meaning: 苗头（表示事情开始出现的迹象、征兆）
english_meaning: sign; indication; hint (that something is beginning or likely to happen)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情開始顯露出來的跡象或端倪，常用來指可能發展成某種情況的初期徵兆。
explanation_english: Refers to an early sign or indication that something is beginning or may develop in a particular way; used to point out initial hints or tendencies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入面有裁員嘅苗頭，大家要準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jap6 min6 jau5 coi3 jyun4 ge3 miu4 tau4, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司內部有裁員的苗頭，大家要做好準備。
examples.english_sentence: There are signs of layoffs in the company; everyone should prepare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣開始轉變，好似有風暴嘅苗頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 bin3, hou2 ci5 jau5 fung1 bou6 ge3 miu4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣開始轉變，好像有風暴的苗頭。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is starting to change; it looks like there are signs of a storm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事有出事嘅苗頭，應該盡快處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 ceot1 si6 ge3 miu4 tau4, jing1 goi1 zeon6 faai3 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事有出事的苗頭，應該盡快處理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter shows signs that something might go wrong; it should be dealt with quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 苛（苛刻、苛求）
english_meaning: harsh; severe; exacting; to demand excessively
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示對人或要求非常嚴苛、苛刻；在某些詞（如「苛求」、「苛刻」）中常見，用於形容標準高或苛責他人的態度。
explanation_english: Indicates being harsh or severe toward others or demanding excessively. Commonly appears in compounds like "苛求" (to demand unreasonably) and "苛刻" (harsh, severe).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆對員工好苛刻，成日無緣無故責罵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 deoi3 jyun4 gung1 hou2 fo1 hak1, sing4 jat6 mou4 jyun4 mou4 gu3 zaak3 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板对员工很苛刻，经常无缘无故责备。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is very harsh with employees and often scolds them for no reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁苛求自己，做到就已經好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 fo1 kau4 zi6 gei2, zou6 dou3 zau6 ji5 ging1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要对自己要求太苛刻，做到就已经很好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be too hard on yourself; it's already good if you can do it.

mandarin_meaning: 苛刻 (kēkè)：對要求或標準非常嚴苛、嚴苛苛求
english_meaning: harsh; severe; stringent; overly demanding
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容對要求、標準、待遇等非常嚴格、苛嚴，通常帶有負面評價，表示過於挑剔或不寬容。
explanation_english: Describes demands, standards, or treatment that are very strict or severe; often has a negative connotation, implying excessive harshness or nitpicking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅要求好苛刻，令到大家壓力好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jiu1 kau4 hou2 ho1 hak1, ling6 dou3 daai6 gaa1 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的要求很苛刻，讓大家壓力很大。
examples.english_sentence: His demands are very harsh, which puts a lot of pressure on everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 苛政猛于虎（指苛刻暴虐的统治比猛虎更可怕）
english_meaning: Tyrannical or oppressive government is fiercer than tigers; oppressive rule is more terrifying than wild beasts.
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容统治者施行的苛刻政策比猛虎还要可怕，强调苛政对百姓的伤害与恐惧。
explanation_english: Describes harsh or oppressive governance as more terrifying or harmful than tigers, emphasizing the severe damage and fear that oppressive rule brings to the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嗰啲獨裁者實施嘅苛政真係猛於虎，人人都好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 go2 di1 duk6 coi4 ze2 sat6 si1 ge3 ho1 zing3 zan1 hai6 maang5 jyu1 fu2, jan4 jan4 dou1 hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前那些独裁者实行的苛政确实比老虎还可怕，人人都很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: The oppressive policies carried out by those past dictators were truly more terrifying than tigers; everyone was frightened.

mandarin_meaning: 苛求 (kēqiú) — 对别人或事物提出过分严格的要求
english_meaning: to be excessively demanding; to make harsh or unreasonable demands
explanation_mandarin: 指對人或事物要求苛刻、過分嚴格，通常帶有不合理或過度挑剔的含義。
explanation_english: To impose overly strict or unreasonable demands on someone or something; to be excessively picky or exacting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆唔好咁苛求員工，佢哋已經盡力喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 m4 hou2 gam2 fo1 kau4 jyun4 gung1, keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 zeon6 lik6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不要这么苛求员工，他们已经尽力了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss shouldn't be so demanding of the staff; they've already done their best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對小朋友太苛求可能會打擊佢哋嘅自信心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 siu2 pang4 jau5 taai3 fo1 kau4 ho2 nang4 wui5 daa2 gik1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zi6 seon3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对小朋友太苛求可能会打击他们的自信心。
examples.english_sentence: Being too demanding of children may hurt their self-confidence.

mandarin_meaning: 苛责（严厉责备、批评）
english_meaning: to harshly criticize or severely blame; to censure
explanation_mandarin: 苛責（kēzé）指嚴厲地責備或批評某人，帶有苛刻、不寬容的語氣或態度。
explanation_english: To criticize or reprimand someone harshly; implies a severe, harsh, or unforgiving attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁苛責佢，佢已經好努力喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 ho1zaak3 keoi5, keoi5 ji5 ging1 hou2 nou5 lik6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要這麼苛責他，他已經很努力了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so harsh on him; he's already trying very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母唔好過份苛責小朋友，應該鼓勵多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 m4 hou2 gwo3 fan6 ho1zaak3 siu2 pang4 jau5, jing1 goi1 gu2 lik6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母不要過分苛責小朋友，應該多些鼓勵。
examples.english_sentence: Parents shouldn't be overly harsh with children; they should offer more encouragement.

mandarin_meaning: 花苞；包裹、包葉（多用於複合詞）
english_meaning: bud (flower bud); a wrapping or husk (often in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 「苞」常用來指植物的花苞，也出現在複合詞中表示包裹或包葉的部分，例如「花苞」、「苞葉」。單字本身多用作名詞。
explanation_english: “苞” commonly refers to a plant's bud (especially a flower bud). It also appears in compounds to indicate a wrapping or husk (e.g., in words like 花苞). The character is primarily used as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰朵花個苞仲未開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 do2 faa1 go3 baau1 zung6 mei6 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那朵花的花苞還沒開。
examples.english_sentence: The flower's bud hasn't opened yet.

mandarin_meaning: 苟 (gǒu)：馬虎、敷衍；文言可作「如果、暫且」
english_meaning: careless, perfunctory; (literary) if/for the time being
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞 / 形容詞 / 連詞（文言）
explanation_mandarin: 「苟」常見於複合詞如「苟且」，表示做事草率、敷衍；在文言文中也可表示假設或暫且的意思。
explanation_english: Often found in compounds such as "苟且" meaning doing things carelessly or perfunctorily; in Classical Chinese it can also function as 'if' or indicate a provisional state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好苟且，從來唔用心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 gau2 ce2, cung4 loi4 m4 jung6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很苟且，從來不用心。
examples.english_sentence: He does things very carelessly and never puts his heart into them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好苟且偷安，要有長遠打算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gau2 ce2 tau1 on1, jiu3 jau5 coeng4 jyun5 daa2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要苟且偷安，要有長遠打算。
examples.english_sentence: Don't settle for temporary comfort; plan for the long term.

mandarin_meaning: 敷衍、草率、暫且將就；也有苟且偷生之意
english_meaning: careless; perfunctory; provisional; to do something in a makeshift or compromising way; as in 'to muddle along' or 'to merely get by'
explanation_mandarin: 表示做事敷衍、馬虎或暫且將就，有時含有放棄原則、僅求苟且過活的意思（如“苟且偷生”）。
explanation_english: Indicates doing things in a careless, perfunctory, or makeshift manner; can also imply compromising principles to get by (as in '苟且偷生' — merely surviving without dignity).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好苟且，唔可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 gau2 ce2, m4 ho2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很苟且，不可靠。
examples.english_sentence: He does his work very carelessly and is unreliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想苟且偷生，我想追求更好嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gau2 ce2 tau1 saang1, ngo5 soeng2 zeoi1 kau4 gang3 hou2 ge3 saang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想苟且偷生，我想追求更好的生活。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to merely muddle along; I want to pursue a better life.

mandarin_meaning: 苟且偷生（gǒu qiě tōu shēng）：苟且地活著，僅僅為了維持生命或勉強過日子，含有不顧原則、敷衍應付的意味。
english_meaning: To live in a makeshift or perfunctory way; to merely scrape by or survive without principles or dignity.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容為了苟且保全性命或暫時過日子而採取敷衍、不顧原則的做法或態度。
explanation_english: Describes the attitude or behavior of merely getting by to survive, often by compromise or neglecting principles — a makeshift, short-term way of living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家淨係想苟且偷生，根本唔理未來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zing6 hai6 soeng2 gau2 ce2 tau1 saang1, gan1 bun2 m4 lei5 mei6 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在只想苟且偷生，根本不管未來。
examples.english_sentence: He's just trying to get by for now and doesn't care about the future.

mandarin_meaning: 勉強維持殘存的狀態，苟且延續、勉強支撐
english_meaning: to cling to a precarious existence; to eke out a miserable prolongation of life/situation; to hang on in a dying or failing state
explanation_mandarin: 形容在困境或衰敗中勉強維持，僅剩微弱的存續或氣息，常帶有消極、無可挽回的意味。
explanation_english: Describes barely maintaining existence or operation in a dire or declining situation; to continue in a weakened, scarcely surviving state, often with a sense of inevitability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司已經冇乜生意，淨係苟延殘喘，隨時可能收檔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 mou5 mat1 saang1 ji3, zing6 hai6 gau2 jin4 caan4 cyun2, ceoi4 si4 ho2 nang4 sau1 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司已經沒有什麼生意，只是在苟延殘喘，隨時可能倒閉。
examples.english_sentence: The company hardly has any business left; it's merely lingering on and could close down at any time.

mandarin_meaning: 如果；若是（文言）
english_meaning: if; in case; as if (literary)
explanation_mandarin: 「若」為文言或書面用法，表示假設或比喻，相當於現代漢語的「如果」「若是」「好像」。在粵語書面或較正式語境亦可見用法。
explanation_english: A literary/written Chinese word used to express a conditional ('if') or a comparative ('as if'). Equivalent to modern 'if' (e.g. '如果') and mainly appears in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若你唔嚟，我就自己去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 nei5 m4 loi4, ngo5 zau6 zi6 gei2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不來，我就自己去。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't come, I'll go by myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若果天氣落雨，我哋就取消行程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 gwo2 tin1 hei3 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 ceoi2 siu1 hang4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果天氣下雨，我們就取消行程。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains, we'll cancel the trip.

mandarin_meaning: 若即若离（ruò jí ruò lí）：亲近又疏远，关系暧昧不清。
english_meaning: An ambivalent relationship or attitude — being alternately close and distant; ambiguous or on-and-off intimacy.
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系或态度若亲近又若疏远，暧昧不清，让人难以把握对方的真实意图。
explanation_english: Describes a relationship or attitude that is neither clearly close nor clearly distant — ambiguous, on-and-off, or deliberately keeping someone at arm's length.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間一直若即若離，大家都唔肯表白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 jat1 zik6 joek6 zik1 joek6 lei4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 hang2 biu2 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间一直若即若离，大家都不肯表白。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship has been ambiguous and on-and-off; neither of them is willing to confess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上司對佢嘅態度若即若離，令佢好困惑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 si1 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6 joek6 zik1 joek6 lei4, ling6 keoi5 hou2 kwan3 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上司对他的态度若即若离，让他很困惑。
examples.english_sentence: The boss's attitude toward him is ambivalent, which leaves him very confused.

mandarin_meaning: 若干 (ruògān)
english_meaning: some; several; a certain number/amount
explanation_mandarin: 表示不確定的數量或程度，相當於「一些」、「若干數量」。語氣較正式，常見於書面語或正式場合。
explanation_english: Indicates an indeterminate number or amount — 'some' or 'several'. It is relatively formal and commonly used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仲有若干時間可以準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 joek6 gon1 si4 gaan1 ho2 ji5 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們還有若干時間可以準備。
examples.english_sentence: We still have some time to prepare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲項目需要若干資金先可以開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hong6 muk6 seoi1 jiu3 joek6 gon1 zi1 gam1 sin1 ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些項目需要若干資金才能開始。
examples.english_sentence: These projects require some funding before they can start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司有若干年經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jau5 joek6 gon1 nin4 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司有若干年經驗。
examples.english_sentence: He has several years of experience at the company.

mandarin_meaning: 如果；假如
english_meaning: if; in case that
explanation_mandarin: 「若是」用作連接詞，表示假設或條件。語氣較書面或文言，與「如果」、「若果」意思相近。
explanation_english: "若是" is a conjunction used to introduce a conditional or hypothetical clause. It is relatively formal/literary and is similar in meaning to "if" or "in case".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若是你唔嚟，我哋就開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 si6 nei5 m4 lei4, ngo5 dei6 zau6 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不來，我們就開始。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't come, we'll start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若是畀人發現，後果唔堪設想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 si6 bei2 jan4 faat3 jin6, hau6 gwo2 m4 ham1 cit3 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果被人發現，後果不堪設想。
examples.english_sentence: If we're found out, the consequences would be unimaginable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若是咁，你可以同我講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 si6 gam2, nei5 ho2 ji5 tung4 ngo5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 若是這樣，你可以跟我說。
examples.english_sentence: If that's the case, you can tell me.

mandarin_meaning: 似乎有所失落；感到惆悵或失落
english_meaning: to seem to have lost something; to feel a sense of loss or dejection
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人看起來好像失去某種東西或機會，因而感到失落、惆悵或若有所失的神情。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who appears to have lost something or a chance, showing a feeling or expression of loss, dejection, or slight bewilderment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到老細講公司要重組，佢聽完之後面露若有所失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 lou5 sai3 gong2 gung1 si1 jiu3 cung4 zou2, keoi5 teng1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 min6 lou6 joek6 jau5 so2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到老闆說公司要重組，他聽完之後面露若有所失。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the boss say the company will be reorganized, he looked somewhat lost.

mandarin_meaning: 若有所思 (形容似乎在沉思或仔細思考)
english_meaning: to look pensive; to seem lost in thought; appearing thoughtful
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人看起來在沈思、若有所想，臉上或神情顯得若有所思。
explanation_english: An idiom describing someone who appears to be deep in thought or contemplative, showing a pensive expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢望住窗外，若有所思，好似喺諗緊啲咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong6 zyu6 coeng1 ngoi6, joek6 jau5 so2 si1, hou2 ci5 hai6 nam2 gan2 di1 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他望着窗外，若有所思，好像在想着什么。
examples.english_sentence: He was staring out the window, appearing pensive, as if thinking about something.

mandarin_meaning: 如果 (rúguǒ)
english_meaning: if; in case
explanation_mandarin: 表示假設或條件的連詞，相當於口語中的「如果」或「假如」。
explanation_english: A conjunction used to introduce a condition or hypothetical situation, equivalent to 'if' or 'in case'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若果你唔嚟，我哋就開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 gwo2 nei5 m4 lai4, ngo5 dei6 zau6 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不来，我们就开始。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't come, we'll start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若果天氣好，我哋去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 gwo2 tin1 hei3 hou2, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 hang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果天气好，我们去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: If the weather is good, we'll go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若果你有問題，可以問我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 gwo2 nei5 jau5 man6 tai4, ho2 ji5 man6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有问题，可以问我。
examples.english_sentence: If you have any questions, you can ask me.

mandarin_meaning: 若无其事 (ruò wú qí shì) — 裝作好像什麼事都沒發生過
english_meaning: to act as if nothing happened; to appear unconcerned or nonchalant
explanation_mandarin: 形容對已發生的事毫不在意或裝作沒事發生，表現得冷靜或若無其事。
explanation_english: Describes behaving or responding as though an event never happened; showing no visible concern or reaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到我跌倒，竟然若無其事咁行開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 ngo5 dit3 dou2, ging2 jin4 joek6 mou4 kei4 si6 gam2 haang4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到我跌倒，竟然若无其事地走开。
examples.english_sentence: He saw me fall and actually walked away as if nothing had happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發生咁大件事，你點可以若無其事？
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 sang1 gam2 daai6 gin6 si6, nei5 dim2 ho2 ji5 joek6 mou4 kei4 si6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发生这么大的一件事，你怎么可以若无其事？
examples.english_sentence: Such a big thing happened — how can you act as if nothing's wrong?

mandarin_meaning: 如果、若是（正式、書面語）
english_meaning: if; in that case; if so (formal/written conjunction)
explanation_mandarin: 「若然」用來引出假設條件或表示「若是如此」，語氣偏正式或書面。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a hypothetical condition or to indicate 'if so'/'in that case'. It is more formal or written in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若然你唔肯幫手，我哋要自己做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 jin4 nei5 m4 hang2 bong1 sau2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zi6 gei2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不肯帮忙，我们要自己做。
examples.english_sentence: If you are unwilling to help, we'll have to do it ourselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若然情況繼續惡化，政府會採取行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 jin4 cing4 fong3 gai3 zuk6 ok3 faa3, zing3 fu2 wui5 coi2 ceoi2 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果情况继续恶化，政府会采取行动。
examples.english_sentence: If the situation continues to worsen, the government will take action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若然係咁，我都冇辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 jin4 hai6 gam2, ngo5 dou1 mou5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 若然是这样，我也没办法。
examples.english_sentence: If that's the case, there's nothing I can do.

mandarin_meaning: 若是這樣／倘若如此
english_meaning: if so; in that case
explanation_mandarin: 一個偏書面或文言色彩的廣東話詞組，表示「如果是這樣／在那種情況下」。常見於書面或較正式的語境中。
explanation_english: A literary/archaic Cantonese phrase meaning "if so" or "in that case." Primarily used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若然之，咁我哋就改變計劃啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 jin4 zi1, gam2 ngo5 dei6 zau6 goi2 bin3 gai3 waak6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果是這樣，我們就改變計畫吧。
examples.english_sentence: If that's the case, we'll change our plan.

mandarin_meaning: 若隐若现（模糊地显现或隐去，时隐时现）
english_meaning: to appear faintly or indistinctly; half-seen, looming in and out of view
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物不完全清楚，時而顯現時而隱沒，帶有朦朧、模糊的感覺。
explanation_english: Describes something that is not clearly visible, alternately appearing and disappearing; conveys a hazy or indistinct impression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 霧中那座山若隱若現，好似一幅水墨畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou6 zung1 naa5 zo6 saan1 joek6 wan2 joek6 jin6, hou2 ci5 jat1 fuk1 seoi2 mak6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雾中的那座山若隐若现，好像一幅水墨画。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain in the fog appears and disappears faintly, like an ink painting.

mandarin_meaning: 如果不是；倘若不是
english_meaning: if not; were it not for
explanation_mandarin: 表示假設或條件，常用於書面或正式語境，相當於「如果不是」。用來引出例外或虧欠的原因。
explanation_english: A formal/written subordinating conjunction meaning "if not" or "were it not for," used to introduce a hypothetical contrary-to-fact condition or to indicate an exception or reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若非你幫手，我做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 fei1 nei5 bong1 sau2, ngo5 zou6 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不是你帮忙，我做不到。
examples.english_sentence: If it weren't for your help, I couldn't have done it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我若非聽到佢講，就唔知發生咗咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 joek6 fei1 teng1 dou3 keoi5 gong2, zau6 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 zo2 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我如果没有听到他说，就不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: If I hadn't heard him speak, I wouldn't know what happened.

mandarin_meaning: 苦 (kǔ) — 苦、痛苦、辛苦
english_meaning: bitter; suffering; hard/tough
explanation_mandarin: 表示味道上的「苦」或形容生活、處境艱難、痛苦的狀態。
explanation_english: Refers to the taste 'bitter' or describes hardship, suffering, or a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢杯咖啡好苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 hou2 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這杯咖啡很苦。
examples.english_sentence: This cup of coffee is very bitter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話生活好苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 saang1 wut6 hou2 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說生活很苦。
examples.english_sentence: He says life is hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰份工真係好苦，朝早到晚都做唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 fu2, ziu1 zou2 dou3 maan5 dou1 zou6 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那份工作真的很苦，從早到晚都做不停。
examples.english_sentence: That job is really tough; you're working nonstop from morning till night.

mandarin_meaning: 苦不堪言 (kǔ bù kān yán)：形容痛苦或困難到了難以用言語表達的地步。
english_meaning: So bitter or miserable that it is hard to put into words; unbearable to describe.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容遭遇極大的痛苦、困難或悲慘情況，難以用語言來表達其程度。
explanation_english: An idiom describing suffering, hardship, or miserable conditions so severe they are difficult to express in words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近工作壓力好大，生活苦不堪言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 gung1 zok3 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6, saang1 wut6 fu2 bat1 ham1 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近工作壓力很大，生活苦不堪言。
examples.english_sentence: He's been under so much pressure at work recently that life has become unbearable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲老人家冇錢睇醫生，生活苦不堪言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 mou5 cin2 tai2 ji1 saang1, saang1 wut6 fu2 bat1 ham1 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些老人家沒錢看病，生活苦不堪言。
examples.english_sentence: Those elderly people can't afford medical care; their lives are unbearable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢開嘅餐廳生意失敗，依家苦不堪言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoi1 ge3 caan1 teng1 sang1 ji3 sat1 baai6, ji4 gaa1 fu2 bat1 ham1 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他開的餐廳生意失敗，現在苦不堪言。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant he opened failed; now he is in dire straits.

mandarin_meaning: 在苦難中尋找快樂；於困境中自得其樂（苦中作樂）
english_meaning: to find joy amid hardship; to make the best of a bad situation; to take pleasure despite difficulties
explanation_mandarin: 形容在困境或艱難環境中仍然尋找或製造快樂，自我安慰以減輕痛苦。
explanation_english: Describes the act of finding or creating enjoyment while enduring hardship, using small pleasures to alleviate suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然生活好辛苦，但佢都苦中作樂，搵啲小事開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 sang1 wut6 hou2 san1 fu2, daan6 keoi5 dou1 fu2 zung1 zok3 lok6, wan2 di1 siu2 si6 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然生活很辛苦，但他仍然苦中作樂，從小事中找到快樂。
examples.english_sentence: Although life is hard, he still finds joy in small things and makes the best of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺實習期間，雖然工時長又辛苦，我哋都要學識苦中作樂，互相打氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 sat6 zaap6 kei4 gaan1, seoi1 jin4 gung1 si4 coeng4 jau6 san1 fu2, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 hok6 sik1 fu2 zung1 zok3 lok6, wu6 soeng1 daa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在實習期間，雖然工時長又辛苦，我們也要學會苦中作樂，互相打氣。
examples.english_sentence: During the internship, although the hours are long and it's tough, we learn to make the best of it and encourage each other.

mandarin_meaning: 受害者；受苦的人
english_meaning: victim; sufferer; the person who suffers
explanation_mandarin: 「苦主」是香港粵語俗語，指遭受損失、欺騙、麻煩或不便的一方。可正式使用，也常用作半開玩笑的說法。
explanation_english: “苦主” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang referring to the person who suffers harm, loss, inconvenience, or trouble — essentially the victim or sufferer. It can be used seriously or jokingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個網上投資騙局騙咗好多苦主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mong5 soeng6 tau4 zi1 pin3 guk6 pin3 zo2 hou2 do1 fu2 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個網上投資騙局騙了很多受害者。
examples.english_sentence: This online investment scam deceived many victims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你小心啲，唔好做苦主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 zou6 fu2 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你小心點，別讓自己成為受苦的人。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't make yourself the one who suffers.

mandarin_meaning: 愁眉苦臉；鬱悶、耍脾氣
english_meaning: to look sullen/sulky; appearing miserable or pouty
explanation_mandarin: 「苦刁刁」是廣東話口語，通常用來形容人表情苦悶、悶悶不樂或耍脾氣、耍嬲的樣子。多用於描述小孩或因不如意而鬧情緒的情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term used to describe someone who looks sullen, sulky, or miserable — often used when a person (frequently a child) is sulking or showing displeasure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩咁苦刁刁？講下有乜嘢唔開心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 gam2 fu2 diu1 diu1? gong2 haa5 jau5 mat1 je5 m4 hoi1 sam1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你為什麼這麼愁眉苦臉？說說看有什麼不開心吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why are you looking so miserable? Tell me what's wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路食唔到雪糕就苦刁刁，喊住唔肯停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 sik6 m4 dou2 syut3 gou1 zau6 fu2 diu1 diu1, haam3 zyu6 m4 hang2 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩吃不到冰淇淋就鬧起脾氣、哭個不停。
examples.english_sentence: The kid sulks and cries when he can't get ice cream.

mandarin_meaning: 苦力（kǔlì）：從事粗重體力勞動的工人，常指過去被雇用或被迫做苦力的勞工（如「苦工」或「苦力」的意思）。
english_meaning: coolie; manual laborer — a worker who does hard physical work (historically also refers to hired/unfree laborers).
explanation_mandarin: 「苦力」原指以體力為主、辛苦勞動的工人。歷史上常用來指受僱或被強迫從事粗重工作的勞工（例如海外移民時期的華工）。現代也可泛指做粗重體力活的人，用法在不同語境可帶有貶義或描述性。
explanation_english: “苦力” (fu2 lik6) refers to manual labourers who perform hard physical work. Historically it described hired or coerced labourers (e.g., Chinese coolies abroad). In modern usage it can generally mean someone who does heavy manual work; context may make it descriptive or pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做苦力，日日都好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 fu2 lik6, jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做苦力，天天都很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a laborer and is exhausted every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前好多華人被迫做苦力，生活好艱苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 hou2 do1 waa4 jan4 bei6 bik1 zou6 fu2 lik6, sang1 wut6 hou2 gaan1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前很多华人被迫做苦力，生活很艰苦。
examples.english_sentence: In the past many Chinese were forced to work as coolies and lived in hardship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想淨係做苦力，我想學多啲技能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zing6 hai6 zou6 fu2 lik6, ngo5 soeng2 hok6 do1 di1 gei6 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想只做苦力，我想學多一點技能。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to only do manual labor; I want to learn more skills.

mandarin_meaning: 苦功（kūgōng）：刻苦練習、艱苦付出以提升技藝或完成任務
english_meaning: hard, painstaking effort; diligent practice
explanation_mandarin: 指為了提高技能或達成目標而付出艱苦的練習或努力，常用於學習、技藝或工作上。
explanation_english: Refers to putting in arduous practice or effort to improve a skill or achieve a goal; commonly used for study, craft, or work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗準備考試下咗好多苦功，最後考到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zeon2 bei6 haau2 si3 haa6 zo2 hou2 do1 fu2 gung1, zeoi3 hau6 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了準備考試下了很多苦功，最後考到好成績。
examples.english_sentence: He put in a lot of hard practice to prepare for the exam and finally got good results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 彈琴要靠苦功，唔可以淨係靠天份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taan4 kam4 jiu3 kaau3 fu2 gung1, m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 kaau3 tin1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 彈琴要靠苦功，不能只靠天賦。
examples.english_sentence: Playing an instrument requires hard practice; you can't rely solely on talent.

mandarin_meaning: 苦口婆心（kǔ kǒu pó xīn）：好心但語氣可能嚴厲，反覆耐心地勸導或提醒
english_meaning: To admonish or advise repeatedly and earnestly (may sound harsh) out of genuine concern
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作副詞或動詞短語）
explanation_mandarin: 形容以苦口的語氣、出於關心而反覆耐心勸告別人，通常強調好意和耐心。
explanation_english: Describes giving repeated, earnest advice or admonition that may sound harsh but is motivated by sincere concern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢父母苦口婆心咁勸佢，叫佢唔好放棄學業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 mou5 fu2 hau2 po4 sam1 gam2 hyun3 keoi5, giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 fong3 hei3 hok6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的父母苦口婆心地勸他，不要放棄學業。
examples.english_sentence: His parents earnestly and repeatedly advised him not to give up on his studies.

mandarin_meaning: （成語）形容語氣或面容嚴厲、苦澀，常用來表示嚴厲地勸告或責備
english_meaning: An idiom describing a bitter or stern expression/tone; used for harsh admonition or reproach
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: “苦口苦面”字面意為嘴苦臉苦，形容說話的語氣或面容帶有嚴厲、苦澀或不悅，常用於表示對人嚴詞勸告或責備。
explanation_english: Literally “bitter mouth, bitter face.” Describes a stern or bitter look and tone; often used when someone is reprimanding or giving a harsh but earnest admonition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師苦口苦面咁同佢講，唔好再遲到，否則會有後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 fu2 hau2 fu2 min6 gam2 tung4 keoi5 gong2, m4 hou2 zoi6 ci4 dou3, fau2 zak1 wui5 jau5 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師苦口苦面地對他說，不要再遲到，否則會有後果。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher admonished him sternly, saying not to be late again or there would be consequences.

mandarin_meaning: 命運多舛；生活悲苦、不幸
english_meaning: having a hard life; ill-fated; born to suffer
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人命運辛苦、生活不順或遭遇不幸。常見於口語，可帶同情或自嘲意味。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose life is full of hardship, bad luck, or misfortune. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese and can convey sympathy or self-deprecation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係苦命，成日做嘢都唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 fu2 ming6, seng4 jat6 zou6 je5 dou1 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是苦命，做事總是不順。
examples.english_sentence: He really has a hard life; things he does never go smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我哋好窮，真係苦命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 hou2 kung4, zan1 hai6 fu2 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候我們很窮，真是苦命。
examples.english_sentence: We were very poor when we were young; we really had a hard life.

mandarin_meaning: 苦命的鴛鴦／不幸的一對夫妻或情侶
english_meaning: an ill‑fated couple; unfortunate lovers; a pair with a tragic or unlucky fate
explanation_mandarin: 指一對運氣不好、生活或感情遭遇不幸、命運多舛的夫妻或情侶，語氣可帶憐憫或帶點嘲諷。
explanation_english: Refers to a couple who are unlucky or ill‑fated—partners who suffer misfortune in life or in their relationship. The term can convey pity or a mildly sardonic tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋真係一對苦命鴛鴦，自從工廠收咗佢哋之後，日子愈嚟愈艱難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zan1 hai6 jat1 deoi3 fu2 ming6 jyun1 joeng1, zi6 cung4 gung1 cong2 sau1 zo2 keoi5 dei6 zi1 hau6, jat6 zi2 jyu6 loi4 jyu6 gaan1 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們真是一對苦命的鴛鴦，自從工廠把他們裁員後，日子越來越艱難。
examples.english_sentence: They really are an ill‑fated couple; ever since the factory laid them off, life has become harder and harder.

mandarin_meaning: 处于困苦、贫穷或艰难的状态 (kǔkùn)
english_meaning: to be in hardship; in dire straits; impoverished
explanation_mandarin: 表示處於生活困難、貧窮或艱苦的狀態，可用來形容個人或家庭的經濟和生活困境。
explanation_english: Describes being in a state of hardship, poverty, or severe difficulty; can refer to a person's or family's economic and living distress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為生意失敗，而家好苦困，連屋租都交唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 saang1ji3 sat1baai6, ji4gaa1 hou2 fu2 kwan3, lin4 uk1zou1 dou1 gaau1 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為生意失敗，現在陷入苦困，連房租都付不起。
examples.english_sentence: He failed in business and is now in dire straits; he can't even pay the rent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個時家境苦困，但佢一直努力讀書，最終考上咗大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 si4 gaa1 ging2 fu2 kwan3, daan6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, zeoi3 zung1 haau2 soeng5 zo2 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候家境苦困，但他一直努力讀書，最終考上了大學。
examples.english_sentence: He grew up poor, but he studied hard and eventually got into university.

mandarin_meaning: 苦大仇深（遭受很多痛苦，積怨深重）
english_meaning: Having suffered greatly and bearing deep hatred or resentment; deeply embittered and vengeful.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人曾經受過很多苦，心中積怨極深，對仇人或不公平的事懷有強烈仇恨或報復心。
explanation_english: An idiom describing someone who has endured great suffering and harbors deep-seated resentment or hatred; often used to depict vengeful, embittered feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個畀人欺負咗咁耐，長大之後對嗰班人真係苦大仇深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 bei2 jan4 hei1 fu6 zo2 gam2 noi6, coeng4 daai6 zi1 hau6 deoi3 go2 baan1 jan4 zan1 hai6 fu2 daai6 cau4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候被人欺負了那麼久，長大之後對那些人真是苦大仇深。
examples.english_sentence: He was bullied for so long as a child that, after growing up, he harbors deep hatred toward those people.

mandarin_meaning: 刻苦學習
english_meaning: to study diligently; to work hard at one's studies
explanation_mandarin: 指刻苦努力地學習，通常強調在困難或長時間的情況下仍然用功。
explanation_english: Refers to studying with perseverance and hard work, often emphasizing effort over a long period or under difficult conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好苦學，終於考上咗大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 fu2 hok6, zung1 jyu1 haau2 soeng5 zo2 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很刻苦學習，終於考上了大學。
examples.english_sentence: He studied diligently and finally got into university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗搵到一份好工，我苦學英文同電腦技能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wan2 dou3 jat1 fan6 hou2 gung1, ngo5 fu2 hok6 jing1 man4 tung4 din6 nou5 gei6 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了找到一份好工作，我刻苦學習英文和電腦技能。
examples.english_sentence: To get a good job, I studied English and computer skills diligently.

mandarin_meaning: 苦心 (kǔxīn)：費盡心思、用心良苦，表示為達成某事付出很多努力；有時也可指用心安排或策劃。
english_meaning: to take great pains; painstaking; done with great care and effort
explanation_mandarin: 表示為了某個目標或事情而費心費力、用盡心思，常用於稱讚或感謝別人的用心安排或經營。
explanation_english: Describes actions done with great care and effort. Often used to praise or thank someone for their careful arrangements or painstaking work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你嘅苦心安排，大家都好滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 fu2 sam1 on1 paai4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝你的苦心安排，大家都很滿意。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your painstaking arrangements; everyone is very satisfied.

mandarin_meaning: 苦思（苦苦思索，絞盡腦汁）
english_meaning: to rack one's brain; to ponder deeply
explanation_mandarin: 指費力思考、冥思苦想以尋找答案或解決辦法，常用於遇到難題時的深思過程。
explanation_english: To think very hard or ponder intensely in order to find an answer or solution, often used when facing a difficult problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為呢條數學題苦思咗好耐，終於解到喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai6 ni1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 fu2 si1 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 gaai2 dou3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我為這道數學題苦思了很久，終於解出來了。
examples.english_sentence: I racked my brain over this math problem for a long time and finally solved it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司老細為咗新計劃苦思良策，希望可以增加盈利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 lou5 sai3 wai6 zo2 san1 gai3 waak6 fu2 si1 loeng4 caak3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zeng1 gaa1 jing4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司老闆為了新計劃苦思良策，希望能增加盈利。
examples.english_sentence: The company boss pondered hard over the new plan, hoping to increase profits.

mandarin_meaning: 苦闷（感到郁闷、压抑、不快）
english_meaning: feeling distressed, depressed, bored, or sullen; a sense of gloom or stagnation
explanation_mandarin: 形容心情沉重、郁闷、不舒畅，可能由無聊、烦恼或压抑引起。
explanation_english: Describes a heavy, gloomy, or stifled mood — feeling unhappy, bored, or emotionally constrained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近成日覺得好苦悶，唔知點解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 hou2 fu2 mun6, m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近老是感到很苦闷，不知道为什么。
examples.english_sentence: I've been feeling very down lately and don't know why.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗幾個鐘頭嘢之後，我覺得好苦悶，想出去散心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 gei2 go3 zung1 tau4 je5 zi1 hau6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 fu2 mun6, soeng2 ceot1 heoi3 saan3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作了好幾個小時後，我感到很苦悶，想出去散心。
examples.english_sentence: After working for several hours I felt really fed up and wanted to go out to clear my head.

mandarin_meaning: 感到痛苦和煩惱；心裡難受、為難
english_meaning: distressed; anguished; troubled; feeling worried or upset
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容因為事情而感到心煩、痛苦或為難的不舒服情緒狀態。
explanation_english: Describes an emotional state of being upset, troubled, or anguished because of a problem or difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日為工作嘅事感到好苦惱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 wai6 gung1 zok3 ge3 si6 gam2 dou3 hou2 fu2 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近總是為工作的事情感到很苦惱。
examples.english_sentence: He has been feeling very distressed about work lately.

mandarin_meaning: 苦恋 (kǔliàn)：痛苦、折磨式的爱情，常指单相思或无法圆满的爱情。
english_meaning: bitter love; a painful or unrequited love; to pine for someone in sorrow
explanation_mandarin: 指因愛情而感到痛苦、煎熬的情感狀態，或指對某人長期無法忘懷、苦苦思念的情形。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of painful, anguished love — often unrequited or long-lasting longing for someone that causes suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢苦戀緊舊愛，好多年都放唔低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu2 lyun6 gan2 gau6 oi3, hou2 do1 nin4 dou1 fong3 m4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他苦恋着旧爱，好多年都放不下。
examples.english_sentence: He has been bitterly in love with his ex for many years and can't let go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫歌講苦戀嘅歌詞，往往會打動到唔少人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 go1 gong2 fu2 lyun6 ge3 go1 ci4, wong5 wong5 wui5 daa2 dung6 dou3 m4 siu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写歌讲述苦恋的歌词，往往能打动很多人。
examples.english_sentence: Lyrics about bitter love in songs often move many people.

mandarin_meaning: 苦战 (kǔzhàn)
english_meaning: fight a hard battle; struggle bitterly; hard-fought contest
explanation_mandarin: 指在战斗或竞赛中付出艰苦努力，与对手苦苦搏斗；也可引申为为完成某事付出艰苦努力。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in a gruelling fight or contest, struggling bitterly against an opponent or difficulty; can be used literally or metaphorically for striving with great difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊今場同對手苦戰到加時先勝出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi6 gam1 coeng4 tung4 deoi3 sau2 fu2 zin3 dou3 gaa1 si4 sin1 sing3 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队这场与对手苦战到加时才赢。
examples.english_sentence: The team fought a hard battle with the opponent and only won in overtime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試期間佢苦戰到深夜先瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 kei4 gaan1 keoi5 fu2 zin3 dou3 sam1 je6 sin1 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试期间他苦战到深夜才睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: He struggled (studied/worked) through the exam period until late at night before sleeping.

mandarin_meaning: 痛苦；苦难
english_meaning: suffering; pain; distress
explanation_mandarin: 表示痛苦、难受或苦难，常用作名词，指精神或身体上的折磨与痛楚。
explanation_english: Refers to suffering or distress; a noun describing physical or mental pain, hardship, or affliction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗嗰場意外，一直承受住好多身心上嘅苦楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 go2 coeng4 ji3 ngoi6, jat1 zik6 sing4 sau6 zyu6 hou2 do1 san1 sam1 soeng6 ge3 fu2 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為那場意外一直承受著很多身心上的痛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He has been suffering a lot of physical and mental pain since that accident.

mandarin_meaning: 抱怨、訴苦、委屈（常用於「吐苦水/講苦水」）
english_meaning: complaint(s), grievances; (informal) to vent one's hardships or complaints
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（口语；亦可作为动词短语，例如「吐苦水」）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (informal); can be used in verb phrase 'to vent/complain'
explanation_mandarin: 「苦水」字面為苦的水，引申指個人遭遇的不快、委屈或不滿，常用於表達向他人訴說抱怨或苦衷，如「吐苦水／講苦水」。
explanation_english: Literally 'bitter water', it figuratively means grievances or complaints. Commonly used to describe telling others about one's hardships or venting (e.g., 'to vent/complain').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺我面前講苦水，話份工好辛苦，做唔完啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 gong2 fu2 seoi2, waa6 fan6 gung1 hou2 san1 fu2, zou6 m4 jyun4 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常在我面前诉苦，说工作很辛苦，做不完事情。
examples.english_sentence: He often complains to me, saying his job is very hard and the work never gets finished.

mandarin_meaning: 苦境、困境、艱難的處境
english_meaning: a state of hardship or distress; difficult plight
explanation_mandarin: 表示艱苦、困苦的狀況或處境，通常用來形容生活、經濟或生存方面的困難。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation of hardship or suffering, often describing difficulties related to life, finances, or living conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年嚟，佢哋一家人面對住好嚴重嘅經濟苦況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 lai4, keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 min6 deoi3 zyu6 hou2 jim4 zung6 ge3 ging1 zai3 fu2 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年來，他們一家人面臨著嚴重的經濟困境。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, their family has been facing a severe economic hardship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔及時救助，呢啲苦況會越嚟越嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gap3 si4 gau3 zo6, ni1 di1 fu2 fong3 wui5 joek6 lai4 joek6 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不及時救助，這些困境會越來越嚴重。
examples.english_sentence: If they aren't helped in time, these hardships will get worse and worse.

mandarin_meaning: 苦海（比喻充滿苦難的境況）
english_meaning: a sea of suffering; a life or situation full of misery and hardship
explanation_mandarin: 原字面為「痛苦的海洋」，常用作比喻，形容生活或處境充滿苦難、煎熬。常見於成語「苦海無邊，回頭是岸」。
explanation_english: Literally 'sea of bitterness.' Used figuratively to describe a life or situation full of suffering and hardship. Often appears in the proverb 'the sea of suffering is boundless; turn back and you'll reach the shore.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話生活變咗苦海，日日都好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 sang1 wut6 bin3 zo2 fu2 hoi2, jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說生活變成了苦海，每天都很不開心。
examples.english_sentence: He said his life had become a sea of suffering; he was unhappy every day.

mandarin_meaning: 苦涩 (kǔsè)：指味道苦且带涩；也比喻心情或经历令人痛苦、难以接受。
english_meaning: bitter and astringent; bitter, painful, or poignant (describing taste or feelings).
explanation_mandarin: 形容味道帶有苦和澀，令人不舒服；也可用來形容心情、回憶或經歷讓人感到痛苦、難以吞嚥或接受。
explanation_english: Describes a taste that is bitter and astringent; can also describe emotions, memories, or experiences that are painful, poignant, or hard to accept.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第一口咖啡有啲苦澀，但慢慢就接受咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 jat1 hau2 gaa3 fe1 jau5 di1 fu2 sik1, daan6 maan6 maan6 zau6 zip3 sau6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第一口咖啡有點苦澀，但慢慢就習慣了。
examples.english_sentence: The first sip of coffee was a bit bitter/astringent, but I slowly got used to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢離開嘅消息，我心裏感到一陣苦澀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 lei4 hoi1 ge3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 sam1 leoi5 gam2 dou6 jat1 zan6 fu2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到他離開的消息，我心裡感到一陣苦澀。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing that he left, I felt a pang of bitterness.

mandarin_meaning: 苦瓜 (kǔguā)
english_meaning: bitter melon; bitter gourd
explanation_mandarin: 苦瓜是一種苦味的蔬菜（又稱涼瓜），常用來烹調。口語中也可作比喻，形容人表情苦澀或愁容，例如「苦瓜臉」。
explanation_english: Bitter melon (bitter gourd), a bitter-tasting vegetable used in cooking. Colloquially it can be used metaphorically to describe a sullen or unhappy facial expression (e.g. "bitter-melon face").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想整苦瓜炒蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 zing2 fu2 gwaa1 caau2 daan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想做苦瓜炒蛋。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of making bitter melon with scrambled eggs tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都擺苦瓜樣，睇落好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 baai2 fu2 gwaa1 joeng6, tai2 lok6 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天擺出一副苦瓜樣，看起來很不開心。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on a sullen look; he seems really unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 苦瓜干（晒乾或風乾的苦瓜），口語中亦可指面容苦澀的人
english_meaning: dried bitter gourd; (slang) a sour/bitter-looking person (sourpuss)
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指把苦瓜晒乾或風乾後的食品，可作小吃或烹調材料。廣東話口語中也會用來比喻一個人面色或表情苦兮兮、悶悶不樂，帶有戲謔或輕微貶義。
explanation_english: Literally the dried form of bitter gourd used as a snack or cooking ingredient. In Cantonese slang it can describe someone who looks sour, bitter, or sullen (a 'sourpuss'); the slang use is informal and can be mildly derogatory or teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲苦瓜乾，今晚用嚟煲湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 fu2 gwaa1 gon1, gam1 maan5 jung6 lai4 bou1 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了些苦瓜干，今晚用来煲汤。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some dried bitter gourd; I'll use it to make soup tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日面色好似苦瓜乾，睇落唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 min6 sik1 hou2 ci5 fu2 gwaa1 gon1, tai2 lok6 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天的脸色像苦瓜干，看来不太开心。
examples.english_sentence: He looked like a 'dried bitter gourd' today — seemed unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 一副愁苦、不高興或悶悶不樂的樣子（像苦瓜乾那樣）
english_meaning: to look sullen, glum, or bitter-faced (literally 'like a dried bitter gourd')
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話的口語說法，用來形容一個人面黃、愁苦或很不開心，表情很悶悶不樂，像乾苦瓜一樣的樣子。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase describing someone who looks sullen, miserable, or sulky — literally comparing their expression to a dried bitter gourd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試之後，佢一路返屋企一路都苦瓜乾噉樣，冇同我講點解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si3 zi1 hau6, keoi5 jat1 lou6 faan1 uk1 kei2 jat1 lou6 dou1 fu2 gwaa1 gon1 gam2 joeng6, mou5 tung4 ngo5 gong2 dim2 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完試後，他回家的路上一直愁眉苦臉，沒跟我說為什麼。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam he went home looking glum the whole way and didn't tell me why.

mandarin_meaning: 苦瓜臉 / 一副苦瓜臉（形容人愁眉苦臉、悶悶不樂或不高興的表情）
english_meaning: a sullen/sulky/upset look; 'bitter-gourd face' — to have an unhappy or sour expression
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，字面是「苦瓜那樣的臉」，用來形容一個人面容不開心、悶悶不樂或不高興，帶有抱怨或沉悶的神情。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally 'bitter-gourd-like face.' It describes someone who looks sullen, sulky, or visibly unhappy — a sour or gloomy expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都擺住苦瓜噉嘅面，發生咗咩事？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5-sing4-jat6-dou1-baai2-zyu6-fu2-gwaa1-gam2-ge3-min6, faat3-sang1-zo2-me1-si6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你總是板着一副苦瓜臉，發生了什麼事？
examples.english_sentence: You always have a sullen look — what happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試考得唔好，佢返到屋企就擺苦瓜噉嘅面，唔想同人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2-si3-haau2-dak1-m4-hou2, keoi5-faan1-dou3-uk1-kei2-zau6-baai2-fu2-gwaa1-gam2-ge3-min6, m4-seong2-tung4-jan4-gong2-je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試沒考好，他回到家就擺苦瓜臉，不想跟人說話。
examples.english_sentence: He did poorly on the exam; when he got home he put on a sulky face and didn't want to talk to anyone.

mandarin_meaning: 痛苦；疼痛
english_meaning: pain; suffering; ache
explanation_mandarin: 指身體上的疼痛或心理上的痛苦、折磨，通常作名詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to physical pain or emotional suffering; commonly used as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 手指被刀割到，好苦痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 zi2 bei6 dou1 got3 dou3, hou2 fu2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手指被刀割到，非常痛苦。
examples.english_sentence: My finger was cut by a knife; it hurts a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後覺得好苦痛，需要時間抒解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6 gok3 dak1 hou2 fu2 tung3, seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 syu1 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失戀之後覺得很痛苦，需要時間疏解。
examples.english_sentence: He felt deep pain after the breakup and needs time to recover.

mandarin_meaning: 苦尽甘来：经历痛苦和艰难之后，迎来幸福或好转。
english_meaning: After suffering comes happiness; a pleasant or favorable outcome follows hardship.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人在經歷了艱苦、困難或磨難之後，終於迎來順利、幸福或好運的情況。
explanation_english: Used to describe when someone endures hardship or difficulties and finally experiences improvement, relief, or good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾年嘅努力，依家生意好咗，真係苦盡甘來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 nin4 ge3 nou5 lik6, ji4 gaa1 saang1 ji3 hou2 zo2, zan1 hai6 fu2 zeon6 gam1 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過幾年的努力，現在生意好轉，真是苦盡甘來。
examples.english_sentence: After years of hard work the business has improved — it's truly a case of 'sweetness follows bitterness'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經歷咗好多困難，依家先考上大學，苦盡甘來啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 lik6 zo2 hou2 do1 kwan3 naan4, ji4 gaa1 sin1 haau2 soeng5 daai6 hok6, fu2 zeon6 gam1 loi4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經歷了很多困難，現在才考上大學，苦盡甘來啊！
examples.english_sentence: He went through many hardships and finally got into university — suffering followed by reward!

mandarin_meaning: 苦笑 (kǔxiào)
english_meaning: bitter smile; wry or forced smile; to smile bitterly
explanation_mandarin: 表示因無奈、尷尬或無可奈何而露出的勉強或苦澀的笑容，既可作動詞也可作名詞。
explanation_english: A smile that expresses helplessness, embarrassment, resignation, or bitterness; can be used as a verb (to smile wryly) or as a noun (a bitter/wry smile).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到投訴之後，只係苦笑咗一下，冇再解釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou3 tau4 sou3 zi1 hau6, zi2 hai6 fu2 siu3 zo2 jat1 haa6, mou5 zoi3 gaai2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收到投訴後，只是苦笑了一下，沒有再解釋。
examples.english_sentence: After receiving the complaint, he only gave a bitter smile and didn't explain further.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁大嘅麻煩，我只可以苦笑，無計可施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam2 daai6 ge3 maa4 faan4, ngo5 zi2 ho2 ji5 fu2 siu3, mou5 gai3 ho2 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對這麼大的麻煩，我只能苦笑，無能為力。
examples.english_sentence: Facing such a big problem, I could only smile wryly; there was nothing I could do.

mandarin_meaning: 苦练（刻苦训练）
english_meaning: to practice hard; to train diligently
explanation_mandarin: 指刻苦地反覆練習或訓練，以提高技藝或為比賽、演出等做準備。
explanation_english: To practice or train intensively and diligently, often repeatedly, to improve a skill or prepare for a competition/performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗比賽，佢苦練咗幾個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bei2 coi3, keoi5 fu2 lin6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了比赛，他苦练了几个月。
examples.english_sentence: He practiced hard for several months for the competition.

mandarin_meaning: 苦肉计 (kǔròujì)：以自我受傷或偽裝受害來博取同情或欺騙對方的計謀
english_meaning: A ruse of feigning or inflicting injury on oneself to gain sympathy or deceive others
explanation_mandarin: 指為了達到某種目的，故意傷害自己或裝作受傷受害，以博取同情、掩護真相或欺騙對方的策略或計謀。
explanation_english: Refers to a tactic in which someone deliberately injures or pretends to be injured to gain sympathy, cover the truth, or deceive others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用苦肉計，故意弄傷自己嚟博取同情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 fu2 juk6 gai3, gu3 ji3 nung6 soeng1 zi6 gei2 lai4 bok3 ceoi2 tung4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了苦肉计，故意弄伤自己来博取同情。
examples.english_sentence: He used the 'ku rou ji' trick, deliberately injuring himself to gain sympathy.

mandarin_meaning: 苦艾酒（以苦艾等藥草釀成的烈性酒，英文為 absinthe）
english_meaning: Absinthe (a strong distilled spirit made from wormwood and other botanicals)
explanation_mandarin: 一種以苦艾（艾蒿）和其他草本植物釀製的高度酒，常帶茴香味與草本香氣，歷史上曾被誤傳具有致幻作用，但主要是高度酒精與特定成分如蒿酮所致的副作用。
explanation_english: A strong distilled spirit made from wormwood (Artemisia absinthium) and other botanicals, typically anise-flavored. Historically linked to alleged hallucinogenic effects (largely attributed to thujone and high alcohol content), it is commonly known as absinthe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢樽苦艾酒好香，但好烈，要小心飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zeon1 fu2 ngoi6 zau2 hou2 hoeng1, daan6 hou2 lit6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这瓶苦艾酒很香，但很烈，喝的时候要小心。
examples.english_sentence: This bottle of absinthe smells strong and is very potent; be careful when drinking it.

mandarin_meaning: 苦茶 (kǔ chá)
english_meaning: bitter (herbal) tea
explanation_mandarin: 指味道較苦的草本茶，常指用中草藥煎煮的涼茶，用於清熱解毒；也可泛指味道苦的茶飲。
explanation_english: Refers to a bitter herbal tea, often made from Chinese medicinal herbs (a type of 'liangcha') used to clear heat and detoxify; can also generally mean any tea with a bitter taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔舒服嘅話，可以飲杯苦茶清熱解毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 syu1 fuk6 ge3 waa6, ho2 ji5 jam2 bui1 fu2 caa4 cing1 jit6 gaai2 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不舒服的話，可以喝杯苦茶清熱解毒。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't feel well, you can drink a cup of bitter tea to clear heat and detoxify.

mandarin_meaning: 苦行 (kǔxíng) — 為了宗教或精神上的修煉而刻意忍受艱苦、過簡樸生活的行為或狀態
english_meaning: asceticism; the practice of deliberately living in hardship or austerity (often for religious or spiritual reasons); to practice asceticism
explanation_mandarin: 指個人為追求宗教、精神上的淨化或修為，而刻意過簡樸或忍受艱苦的生活方式或修行行為。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately practicing a harsh or austere lifestyle (often for religious or spiritual purification), enduring hardship as a form of spiritual discipline or practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去印度做苦行，住喺寺廟度，好多年冇返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 jan3 dou6 zou6 fu2 haang4, zyu6 hai2 si6 miu6 dou6, hou2 do1 nin4 mou5 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去印度做苦行，住在寺庙里，很多年沒回家。
examples.english_sentence: He went to India to do ascetic practices, lived in a temple, and didn't return home for many years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想試下苦行，就唔買新衫，食得樸素啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 si3 haa5 fu2 haang4, zau6 m4 maai5 san1 saam1, sik6 dak1 pok3 sou3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說想試試苦行，就不買新衣，吃得樸素一些。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted to try asceticism, so he stopped buying new clothes and ate more plainly.

mandarin_meaning: 苦行僧（kǔxíngsēng）：過著苦行生活的僧人；比喻生活刻苦、節儉或自我克制的人。
english_meaning: an ascetic monk; someone who practices severe self-discipline and austerity; used metaphorically for a very frugal or self-denying person.
explanation_mandarin: 原指佛教中以苦行、克己為修行方式的僧人；引申為生活極為簡樸或自我約束的人，有時帶比喻或戲謔語氣。
explanation_english: Originally refers to Buddhist monks who practice asceticism; figuratively used for people who live very simply, practice strict self-discipline, or are extremely frugal. Can be used literally or metaphorically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢近排節儉到好似苦行僧咁，連買杯咖啡都唔肯買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan6 paai4 zit3 gim2 dou3 hou2 ci5 fu2 haang4 sang1 gam2, lin4 maai5 bui1 gaa3 fe1 dou1 m4 hang2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近節儉得像個苦行僧，連買杯咖啡都不肯買。
examples.english_sentence: He's been so frugal lately, like an ascetic monk — he won't even buy a cup of coffee.

mandarin_meaning: 苦衷 (kǔzhōng)：心中隱藏的難處或苦惱，常指因特殊原因而難以說明的理由或困難。
english_meaning: private difficulties; inner troubles or reasons for reluctance; hardships one finds hard to disclose
explanation_mandarin: 指個人心中隱藏的苦處或難處，多用來表示有無法公開或不便說明的原因與苦悶。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's hidden difficulties, troubles, or grievances—often reasons someone cannot or does not wish to disclose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我明白佢有佢嘅苦衷，唔好再逼佢講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ming4 baak6 keoi5 jau5 keoi5 ge3 fu2 zung1, m4 hou2 zoi3 bik1 keoi5 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明白他有他的苦衷，別再逼他说了。
examples.english_sentence: I understand he has his reasons; don't force him to talk about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔出席會議，其實係因為家庭有啲苦衷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 ceot1 zik6 wui6 ji5, kei4 sat6 hai6 jan1 wai6 gaa1 ting4 jau5 di1 fu2 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不出席會議，其實是因為家庭有些苦衷。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't attend the meeting because he actually has some family difficulties.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）比別人稍微更辛苦／遭受更多苦楚
english_meaning: colloquial expression meaning to have suffered a bit more / been worse off
explanation_mandarin: 「苦過dee dee」是粵語口語用法，帶有輕微戲謔或誇張成分，表示某人比別人多受一點苦。句中「dee dee」是非正式的拉丁字母音譯，對應粵語「啲啲」（di1 di1），表示「一點、稍微」。
explanation_english: “苦過 dee dee” is a colloquial Cantonese expression, often lighthearted or slightly sarcastic, meaning someone has suffered a little more than others. The “dee dee” part is an informal romanisation of the Cantonese 啲啲 (di1 di1), meaning “a bit/slightly.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話自己辛苦？我苦過dee dee啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 zi6 gei2 san1 fu2? ngo5 fu2 gwo3 di1 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說自己辛苦？我苦得更多啦！
examples.english_sentence: You say you're having it hard? I've had it even worse!

mandarin_meaning: 比別人更辛苦 / 吃盡苦頭
english_meaning: to have suffered a lot; to have had it especially rough
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語/俚語，用來形容某人經歷了很多辛苦或吃了很多苦，常帶誇張或自嘲意味，用於抱怨或強調自己過得比別人辛苦。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase used to say someone has endured a lot of hardship. It is often used hyperbolically or jokingly for complaint or self-deprecation, emphasizing that one has had it worse than others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我真係苦過弟弟，工作時間長到冇得休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 fu2 gwo3 dai6 dai2, gung1 zok3 si4 gaan3 coeng4 dou3 mou5 dak1 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我真的是吃尽了苦头，工作时间长到没有休息。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I've really had it rough — the working hours are so long I don't get any rest.

mandarin_meaning: 苦难 (kǔnàn)，指痛苦和困苦、磨难
english_meaning: suffering; hardship; adversity
explanation_mandarin: 指人在生活或歷程中遭遇的痛苦、困苦或磨難，強調經歷的艱辛與不幸。
explanation_english: Refers to the pain, hardships, or adversities a person endures in life; emphasizes difficult and unhappy experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一生經歷咗好多苦難，但仍然好堅強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 saang1 ging1 lik6 zo2 hou2 do1 fu2 naan6, daan6 jing4 jin4 hou2 gin1 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生经历了许多苦难，但仍然很坚强。
examples.english_sentence: He has endured many hardships in his life, but remains very strong.

mandarin_meaning: 吃苦、遭受痛苦或困苦的經歷
english_meaning: suffering; hardship; to endure hardship
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞／動詞（口語，表示遭受苦楚或受苦）
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人經歷的苦楚或困難，常用來說某人吃了很多苦或遭遇不愉快的經歷。
explanation_english: Refers to experiencing hardship or suffering; commonly used to say someone has gone through a lot of difficulties or unpleasant experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前食過好多苦頭，所以而家好堅強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 sik6 gwo3 hou2 do1 fu2 tau4, so2 ji5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 gin1 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前吃過很多苦頭，所以現在很堅強。
examples.english_sentence: He went through a lot of hardships before, so he's strong now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想再食苦頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi6 sik6 fu2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想再吃苦了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to suffer hardship again.

mandarin_meaning: 苦命的人；生活艱辛、吃苦的人（口語、俗稱）
english_meaning: a hard-luck person; someone who endures hardship (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話的口語用法，俗稱生活困苦或命運多舛、常要吃苦的人，語氣可帶自嘲或同情，常見於非正式場合。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term for a person who has a hard life or frequently endures hardship. Can be used jokingly or sympathetically in informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企冇錢，成日要做兩份工，真係個苦麥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 mou5 cin2, sing4 jat6 jiu3 zou6 loeng5 fan6 gung1, zan1 hai6 go3 fu2 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家裡沒錢，經常要做兩份工作，真是個吃苦的人。
examples.english_sentence: His family has no money; he often has to work two jobs — he's really a hard-luck person.

mandarin_meaning: 形容生活困苦、命運不順或經常倒楣的人（廣東話俚語）
english_meaning: Cantonese slang for a person who has a hard life, is unlucky, or often has bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 「苦麥菜」是粵語俗語，用來形容生活辛苦、運氣差或經常遇到不順利事情的人，常帶有自嘲或戲謔意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who endures hardship, has bad luck, or frequently encounters misfortune. It often carries a self-deprecating or teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己係苦麥菜，做咩都唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 fu2 mak6 coi3, zou6 me1 dou1 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总说自己是苦麦菜，做什么都不顺利。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's a '苦麥菜' — nothing he does goes well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好當佢係苦麥菜，佢其實好努力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dong3 keoi5 hai6 fu2 mak6 coi3, keoi5 kei4 sat6 hou2 nou5 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把他看作苦麦菜，他其實很努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat him like a '苦麥菜' — he's actually working very hard.

mandarin_meaning: 苫（shān）：用草、茅或布等覆蓋、遮蓋（如屋頂）
english_meaning: to thatch; to cover or shelter (e.g., a roof) with straw, mats, or cloth
explanation_mandarin: 表示用茅草、草席或布等物覆蓋、遮擋，常見於描述蓋屋頂或臨時遮蔽，屬書面或方言用法。
explanation_english: Means to cover or thatch something (typically a roof) with straw, mats, or cloth. Common in literary or dialectal usage to describe making a shelter or covering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲工人用茅草苫咗屋頂，避雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gung1 jan4 jung6 mou4 cou2 saam1 zo2 uk1 ding2, bei6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人用茅草蓋了屋頂，避雨。
examples.english_sentence: The workers thatched the roof with straw to keep out the rain.

mandarin_meaning: 1) 苯（化学名，běn，苯，溶剂类芳香烃）2) 口语中常用作“笨”（bèn，愚蠢）的变体写法
english_meaning: 1) benzene (chemical) 2) colloquial variant of 'stupid' or 'silly' (Cantonese slang)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（化学物质）/ 形容词（口语，表示愚蠢）
explanation_mandarin: “苯”在正式语境多指化学物质苯（芳香烃）；在香港粤语口语或网络用字中，常用作“笨”的变体，表示愚蠢或傻。
explanation_english: In formal contexts, 苯 refers to the chemical benzene. In Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial or internet usage, it is often used as a variant of 笨 to mean 'stupid' or 'silly'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係好苯，點會唔記得帶錢包？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ban6, dim2 wui5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 cin2 baau1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真的很笨，怎麼會忘了帶錢包？
examples.english_sentence: You're really silly/stupid — how could you forget to bring your wallet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 實驗室入面有苯，要小心處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat6 jim6 sat1 jap6 min6 jau5 ban2, jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 实验室里有苯，要小心处理。
examples.english_sentence: There is benzene in the lab; handle it carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 英（可作「英國」的縮寫；亦可表示英勇、優秀或作人名）
english_meaning: Ying / Brit(ish) (abbr.); brave, heroic, outstanding; used as a name
explanation_mandarin: 「英」常見於複合詞如「英國」、「英勇」、「英俊」，可表示國名（常在新聞標題中做縮寫），亦可表示英勇或優秀的性質，還可用作人名或字。
explanation_english: The character '英' appears in compounds such as '英國' (Britain), '英勇' (brave), '英俊' (handsome). It can be used as an abbreviation for the UK in headlines, to mean brave/outstanding, or as a personal name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 英首相下星期嚟香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 sau2 soeng2 haa6 sing1 kei4 lai4 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 英国首相下星期来香港。
examples.english_sentence: The British Prime Minister is coming to Hong Kong next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表現得好英勇，救咗好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 jin2 dak1 hou2 jing1 jung5, gau3 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表现得很英勇，救了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: He acted very bravely and saved many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有個朋友叫英，佢係一位老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 go3 pang4 jau5 giu3 jing1, keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai6 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有個朋友叫英，他是一位老师。
examples.english_sentence: I have a friend named Ying; they are a teacher.

mandarin_meaning: 英國與中國（常指兩國之間的關係）；在教育或語言語境中亦可指英語與中文（英中雙語）
english_meaning: Abbreviation for 'the United Kingdom and China' (often referring to bilateral relations); in educational/linguistic contexts can mean 'English and Chinese' (bilingual).
explanation_mandarin: 「英中」常用作「英國與中國」的簡稱，用於討論兩國之間的政治、經濟或文化關係；在教育或語言討論中，也會用來表示「英語與中文」的雙語體系或課程。具體含義依上下文而定。
explanation_english: Commonly used as an abbreviation for 'the United Kingdom and China', referring to political, economic, or cultural relations between the two countries. In education or language contexts it can mean 'English and Chinese' (bilingual). The exact meaning depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 英中關係最近有啲緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 zung1 gwaan1 hai6 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 di1 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 英中关系最近有点紧张。
examples.english_sentence: UK–China relations have been a bit tense recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校有英中雙語課程，學生可以用英語或中文上堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 jau5 jing1 zung1 soeng1 jyu5 fo3 cing4, hok6 saang1 ho2 ji5 jung6 jing1 jyu5 waak6 zung1 man4 soeng5 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校有英中双语课程，学生可以用英语或中文上课。
examples.english_sentence: This school has English–Chinese bilingual programs; students can attend classes in English or Chinese.

mandarin_meaning: 英俊（形容男子外表俊美）
english_meaning: handsome; good-looking (usually describing a man)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容外表俊美、有英氣的人（通常指男性），強調相貌端正、帥氣。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone (typically a man) who is attractive and distinguished in appearance, emphasizing a neat, handsome look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好英俊，啲女仔成日圍住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jing1 zeon3, di1 neoi5 zai2 seng4 jat6 wai4 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很英俊，很多女孩經常圍著他。
examples.english_sentence: He is really handsome; many girls often gather around him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔止聰明，仲好英俊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zi2 cung1 ming4, zung6 hou2 jing1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不僅聰明，而且很英俊。
examples.english_sentence: He's not only smart but also very handsome.

mandarin_meaning: 英俊潇洒（形容人長相俊朗、氣質瀟灑）
english_meaning: handsome and suave; dashing and debonair
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人長相英俊、氣質瀟灑、舉止自然不做作，通常用於男性的外貌與風度。
explanation_english: Describes someone (often a man) who is handsome and has a relaxed, stylish manner — attractive in both looks and bearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好英俊瀟灑，行入嚟嗰陣全部人都望住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jing1 zeon3 siu1 saa2, hang4 jap6 lei4 go2 zan6 cyun4 bou6 jan4 dou1 mong6 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很英俊瀟灑，走進來的時候所有人都看著他。
examples.english_sentence: He's really handsome and suave; when he walked in, everyone was looking at him.

mandarin_meaning: 英國；英式（與英國有關的）
english_meaning: Britain; British; English (relating to the UK or British style)
explanation_mandarin: 「英倫」常用來指英國或與英國有關的事物，例如英倫風（英式風格）。
explanation_english: Refers to Britain or things related to Britain; often used to describe British style (e.g., "英倫風" = British style).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近搬咗去英倫讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 bun1 zo2 heoi3 jing1 leon4 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近搬到英國去讀書。
examples.english_sentence: He recently moved to Britain to study.

mandarin_meaning: 英制（指英國或傳統的英制計量制度與單位）
english_meaning: Imperial system (the British system of measurement; often refers to units like inch, foot, pound)
explanation_mandarin: 指英國傳統使用的計量制度和單位，如吋（英寸）、英尺、磅等；在實際用語中有時也泛指美制/英制類似的非公制單位。
explanation_english: Refers to the British (Imperial) system of measurements and units (e.g., inch, foot, pound). In everyday usage it can also loosely refer to similar non-metric units such as those used in the US.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲工程師仍然會用英制單位，例如吋同磅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 gung1 cing4 si1 jing4 jin4 wui5 jung6 jing1 zai3 daan1 wai6, lai6 jyu4 ceon3 tung4 bong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些工程师仍然会使用英制单位，例如英寸和磅。
examples.english_sentence: Some engineers still use imperial units, such as inches and pounds.

mandarin_meaning: 英勇 (yīngyǒng) — 勇敢、有膽識
english_meaning: brave; courageous; valiant
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人有勇氣，敢於面對危險或困難，行為果敢、無畏。
