explanation_english: Originally denotes a herb or aromatic plant that can be used medicinally; also commonly appears in personal and place names (for example, Tsuen Wan in Hong Kong).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去荃灣買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 cyun4 waan1 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去荃灣買東西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Tsuen Wan tomorrow to buy some things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種荃好似可以做中藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 cyun4 hou2 ci5 ho2 ji5 zou6 zung1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種荃好像可以做中藥。
examples.english_sentence: This type of '荃' seems like it can be used as traditional Chinese medicine.

mandarin_meaning: 荃湾 (Quánwān)，香港新界西部的一個地名
english_meaning: Tsuen Wan, a district and town in the western New Territories of Hong Kong
explanation_mandarin: 荃灣是香港新界西部的市鎮及地區名稱，屬於新市鎮發展區，包含商業、住宅及交通樞紐，如荃灣港鐵站和多個巴士線。
explanation_english: Tsuen Wan is a town and district in the western New Territories of Hong Kong. It is a New Town with residential and commercial areas and key transport links such as the MTR Tsuen Wan station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去荃灣買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1jat6 jiu3 heoi3 cyun4 waan1 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去荃湾买东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Tsuen Wan to buy some things today.

mandarin_meaning: 荃灣西（香港新界荃灣的西部地區，亦指港鐵荃灣西站）
english_meaning: Tsuen Wan West (an area in Tsuen Wan, New Territories, Hong Kong; also the Tsuen Wan West MTR station)
explanation_mandarin: 荃灣西是香港新界荃灣的地區名稱，亦指位於該處的港鐵車站（現時屬於屯馬綫）。常用於指集合地點或交通樞紐。
explanation_english: Tsuen Wan West is a place name in Tsuen Wan, New Territories, Hong Kong, and also refers to the local MTR station (now on the Tuen Ma Line). Commonly used as a meeting place or transport hub.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺荃灣西見面啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 cyun4 waan1 sai1 gin3 min6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在荃灣西見面吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's meet at Tsuen Wan West.

mandarin_meaning: 草 (cǎo)：植物的草；在粗口用法上相當於「操/肏」(cào)，表示咒罵或不滿（粗俗用語）
english_meaning: grass; (slang, vulgar) fuck / damn (expletive)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞；口語粗口（感嘆詞/動詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「草」本義為植物的草，常用於複合詞如「草地」「草稿」。在廣東話口語中也常作粗口使用，相當於罵人的髒話（類似普通話的「操/肏」），屬於粗俗語場，應注意語境。
explanation_english: Literally 'grass' (a plant). In Cantonese it also appears as vulgar slang used as an expletive (equivalent to 'fuck' / 'damn'), corresponding to Mandarin's obscene term '操/肏'. Usage is coarse and context-sensitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 草地上有好多草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou2 dei6 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 草地上有很多草。
examples.english_sentence: There is a lot of grass on the lawn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 草，我唔記得帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou2, ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 操，我忘記帶鑰匙了。
examples.english_sentence: Fuck, I forgot to bring my keys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文件係草稿，仲未完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 man4 gin2 hai6 cou2 gou2, zung6 mei6 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份文件是草稿，還未完成。
examples.english_sentence: This document is a draft and is not finished yet.

mandarin_meaning: 初創、剛成立或處於創業初期；也可指草率創作
english_meaning: newly established; in the early/startup stage; tentative or makeshift
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容公司、組織或計劃剛剛成立或處於起步階段，尚未成熟或穩定；有時也指粗糙、匆促完成的創作或安排。
explanation_english: Describes an organization, project, or initiative that has just been established or is in its early/startup stage and is not yet mature or stable; can also refer to something done hastily or roughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家仲處於草創階段，資金好緊絀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 zung6 cyu5 jyu1 cou2 cong3 gaai1 dyun6, zi1 gam1 hou2 gan2 seot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司現在仍處於草創階段，資金很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: The company is still in its early/startup stage and short on funds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅計劃係一個草創嘅嘗試，可能會有好多問題要解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 hai6 jat1 go3 cou2 cong3 ge3 soeng4 si3, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 hou2 do1 man6 tai4 jiu3 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的計劃是一個草創性的嘗試，可能會有很多問題需要解決。
examples.english_sentence: Their plan is a tentative/early-stage attempt and may have many issues to resolve.

mandarin_meaning: 草原 (cǎoyuán)
english_meaning: grassland; prairie; steppe
explanation_mandarin: 指長滿草的廣闊地帶，通常為天然生態系統或放牧地，如大草原、草場等。
explanation_english: A wide area covered with grass, such as a prairie or steppe; typically a natural ecosystem or grazing land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天去草原野餐好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 heoi3 cou2 jyun4 je5 caan1 hou2 syu1 fuk6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天到草原野餐很舒適。
examples.english_sentence: Having a picnic on the grassland in summer is very pleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大草原上有好多羊同馬，景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 cou2 jyun4 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 joeng4 tung4 maa5，ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大草原上有很多羊和馬，景色很美。
examples.english_sentence: There are many sheep and horses on the great grassland; the scenery is beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 草丛 (cǎocóng) — 指长满草的丛生处或草丛，常作掩蔽物或植被的一部分。
english_meaning: A clump or thicket of grass; a patch of dense grass often used as cover or vegetation.
explanation_mandarin: 「草叢」指由许多青草或低矮植被聚集成的区域，常见於公园、路旁或荒地，可能成为小动物的栖息或藏身处。
explanation_english: Refers to an area where grasses or low vegetation grow densely together; commonly found in parks, roadside areas, or wasteland and may serve as shelter or hiding spots for small animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園有大片草叢，小朋友鍾意喺度玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jau5 daai6 pin3 cou2 cung4, siu2 pang4 jau5 zung1 ji3 hai2 dou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园有大片草丛，小朋友喜欢在那裡玩。
examples.english_sentence: There are large patches of grass in the park; children like to play there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老鼠躲喺草叢入面，唔容易搵到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 syu2 do2 hai2 cou2 cung4 jap6 min6, m4 jung4 ji6 wan2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老鼠躲在草丛里面，不容易找到。
examples.english_sentence: The mouse is hiding in the grass; it's not easy to find.

mandarin_meaning: 草图
english_meaning: sketch; rough draft; preliminary drawing
explanation_mandarin: 指設計或畫作的初步草稿，用來表達基本構思或構圖，尚未完成或定稿。
explanation_english: A preliminary sketch or rough draft used to convey basic ideas or layout; not a finished or final version.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 設計師先畫咗個草圖畀客戶睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sit3 gai3 si1 sin1 waa6 zo2 go3 cou2 tou4 bei2 haak3 wu6 tai2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 設計師先畫了一個草圖給客戶看。
examples.english_sentence: The designer first drew a rough sketch for the client to see.

mandarin_meaning: 草地（cǎodì）
english_meaning: lawn; grassland; grassy area
explanation_mandarin: 指長有草的地面，如公園、田野等覆蓋著草的區域，常供行走、休憩或遊玩。
explanation_english: An area covered with grass, such as a lawn or grassland found in parks or fields; often used for walking, resting, or play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個公園有好大嘅草地，啲小朋友喺度跑嚟跑去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gung1 jyun4 jau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 cou2 dei6, di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 dou6 paau2 lai4 paau2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个公园有很大的草地，孩子们在那儿跑来跑去。
examples.english_sentence: The park has a large lawn; the children are running around there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 草地濕咗，唔好喺度坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou2 dei6 sap1 zo2, m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 草地湿了，不要在上面坐。
examples.english_sentence: The grass is wet; don't sit on it.

mandarin_meaning: 草坪（cǎopíng）
english_meaning: lawn; grass lawn; turf
explanation_mandarin: 指公園、庭院等地方由草組成的平坦區域，常用作休憩、玩耍或舉辦活動的場所。
explanation_english: A flat area covered with grass, typically found in parks or yards, used for recreation, play, or events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園啲草坪有好多人喺度野餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun2 di1 cou2 ping4 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 hai2 dou6 je5 can1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公園的草坪有很多人在那裡野餐。
examples.english_sentence: There are many people picnicking on the park lawn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新屋企後面有一小片細細嘅草坪，好啱小朋友玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 uk1 kei2 hau6 min6 jau5 jat1 siu2 pin3 sai3 sai3 ge3 cou2 ping4, hou2 aam1 siu2 pang4 jau5 waan2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新家的後面有一小片草坪，很適合小朋友玩。
examples.english_sentence: There's a small lawn behind the new house, perfect for children to play.

mandarin_meaning: 草帽 (cǎomào)
english_meaning: straw hat; sun hat
explanation_mandarin: 用草或禾秆編成的帽子，通常用來遮陽或在戶外工作時防護。
explanation_english: A hat woven from straw or plant fibers, typically used for sun protection or worn outdoors while working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農夫戴住草帽喺田裡面做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 fu1 daai3 zyu6 cou2 mou6 hai2 tin4 leoi5 min6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农夫戴着草帽在田里工作。
examples.english_sentence: The farmer is wearing a straw hat while working in the field.

mandarin_meaning: 草蓑／蓑衣（用草或蘆葦等製成的披風或防雨衣）
english_meaning: grass cloak / straw raincoat (a cloak made of grass or reeds used for rain protection)
explanation_mandarin: 一種用草、蘆葦等材料編製的披風或蓑衣，舊時農漁民常用以擋雨或擋風。此詞用法較少見，常以「草蓑」「蓑衣」表達相同意思。
explanation_english: A cloak or raincoat made from grass, reeds or similar materials. Historically used by farmers and fishermen to shield from rain or wind. The term is relatively rare; similar terms include 'grass cloak' or 'straw raincoat.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時啲農民會用草披嚟擋雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 di1 nung4 man4 wui5 jung6 cou2 pei1 lai4 dong2 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古时候农民会用草披来挡雨。
examples.english_sentence: In old times, farmers used grass cloaks to shield themselves from the rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲漁夫會用草披做簡單嘅防水衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jyu4 fu1 wui5 jung6 cou2 pei1 zou6 gaan2 daan1 ge3 fong4 seoi2 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 渔夫会用草披做简易的防水衣。
examples.english_sentence: Fishermen would use grass cloaks as simple waterproof garments.

mandarin_meaning: 草拟；起草（文件、方案等）
english_meaning: to draft (a document/plan); to make a rough draft
explanation_mandarin: 指初步拟定文件或方案，属于草稿性质，通常还需要修改和完善。
explanation_english: To create an initial or provisional draft of a document or plan; implies the result is a rough version that will be revised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家先草擬一份合約，之後再慢慢修改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 sin1 cou2 ji5 jat1 fan6 hap6 joek3, zi1 hau6 zoi3 maan6 maan6 sau1 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在先草拟一份合约，之后再慢慢修改。
examples.english_sentence: We'll first draft a contract now, and then revise it gradually.

mandarin_meaning: 草书（cǎoshū）——汉字的一种书法体，笔画连绵、简化、快捷。
english_meaning: cursive script (Chinese calligraphy); cursive handwriting
explanation_mandarin: 草书是一种汉字书法字体，书写时常将笔画连成一体或大幅简化，以求快速书写与艺术表现，但有时难以辨认。
explanation_english: Cursive script is a style of Chinese calligraphy where strokes are often joined or greatly simplified for faster writing and expressive effect; it can be difficult to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意寫草書，字寫得好有個性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 se2 cou2 syu1, zi6 se2 dak1 hou2 jau5 go3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢写草书，字写得很有个性。
examples.english_sentence: He likes writing cursive script; his handwriting is very distinctive.

mandarin_meaning: 草木 (植物，指草和树木的总称)
english_meaning: plants; vegetation (collective term for grasses and trees)
explanation_mandarin: 指草和树木等植物的总称。亦常出现在成语中，如“草木皆兵”（形容惊慌到处疑神疑鬼）。
explanation_english: A collective term for grasses and trees—plants or vegetation. Also appears in idioms such as '草木皆兵', which describes being so panicked that one mistakes harmless things for threats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有好多草木，行山要小心蛇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 cou2 muk6, haang4 saan1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 se4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有很多草木，爬山要小心蛇。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of plants here; be careful of snakes when hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚到草木皆兵，見到風吹都以為有人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng1 dou3 cou2 muk6 gaai1 bing1, gin3 dou3 fung1 ceoi1 dou1 ji5 wai4 jau5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他惊慌到草木皆兵，看到风吹都以为有人。
examples.english_sentence: He was so panicked that he saw enemies in every bush and tree; even the wind made him think someone was there.

mandarin_meaning: 草木皆兵（形容因恐慌或疑懼而把無害的事物誤認為敵人）
english_meaning: To be so fearful or paranoid that even grass and trees look like soldiers/ threats; to be extremely jumpy and see danger everywhere.
explanation_mandarin: 形容因為驚慌或疑心過重，對周圍事物過度敏感，看到無害的東西也當成敵情或威脅。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a state of extreme nervousness or paranoia, where one misinterprets harmless things as threats and is overly suspicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從公司裁員之後，阿偉成日草木皆兵，見到有人敲門都驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 zi1 hau6, aa3 wai5 sing4 jat6 cou2 muk6 gaai1 bing1, gin3 dou2 jau5 jan4 haau1 mun4 dou1 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從公司裁員之後，阿偉整天草木皆兵，看到有人敲門都害怕。
examples.english_sentence: Since the company layoffs, Ah Wai is constantly on edge — he's so jumpy that he's afraid even when someone knocks on the door.

mandarin_meaning: 草本植物（指無木質莖、茎葉柔軟的植物，如一年生或多年生草本）
english_meaning: herbaceous plants (plants with non-woody stems; includes annuals and perennials)
explanation_mandarin: 草本植物指那些莖部不木質化、質地柔軟的植物。很多草本植物的地上部分會在不利季節枯萎，但可靠根、根莖或種子越冬再生。範圍包括一年生和多年生的草本類植物。
explanation_english: Herbaceous plants are plants with non-woody, soft stems. Many herbaceous species die back above ground during unfavorable seasons and survive via roots, rhizomes, or seeds to regrow. This includes annual and perennial herbaceous plants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係常見嘅草本植物，冬天會枯死，春天再生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 soeng4 gin3 ge3 cou2 bun2 zik6 mat6, dung1 tin1 wui5 fu1 sei2, ceon1 tin1 zoi3 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些是常見的草本植物，冬天會枯死，春天再生。
examples.english_sentence: These are common herbaceous plants; they die back in winter and regrow in spring.

mandarin_meaning: 草根（指社會基層或普通大眾）
english_meaning: grassroots; the common people; people at the base level of society
explanation_mandarin: 原指植物的根，延伸指社會最基層或普通大眾，也常用來形容來自基層的文化、運動或身份背景。
explanation_english: Literally 'grass root'; refers to the grassroots or ordinary people. Often used to describe people, movements, or culture that come from the base level of society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出身草根，但靠努力做到老闆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 san1 cou2 gan1, daan6 kaau3 nou5 lik6 zou6 dou3 lou5 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出身草根，但靠努力做到老闆。
examples.english_sentence: He came from a grassroots background but became a boss through hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 草根運動喺香港越嚟越多人參與。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou2 gan1 wan6 dung6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 jyut6 lei4 jyut6 do1 jan4 caam1 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 草根運動在香港越來越多人參與。
examples.english_sentence: Grassroots movements in Hong Kong are seeing increasing participation.

mandarin_meaning: 草根阶层（社会底层、普通百姓）
english_meaning: the grassroots; common people; the lower social strata
explanation_mandarin: 指社會底層、普通百姓或缺乏政治經濟資源的群體，常用以強調其地位較低或影響力有限。
explanation_english: Refers to the lower social strata or ordinary people who lack political or economic resources; often used to emphasize their lower status or limited influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個社區運動主要由草根階層發起嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 wan6 dung6 zyu2 ji3 jau4 cou2 gan1 gaai1 cang4 faat3 hei2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个社区运动主要由草根阶层发起的。
examples.english_sentence: This community movement was mainly initiated by the grassroots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該多啲關心草根階層嘅生活困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 do1 di1 gwaan1 sam1 cou2 gan1 gaai1 cang4 ge3 sang1 wut6 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该多关心草根阶层的生活困难。
examples.english_sentence: The government should pay more attention to the living hardships of the grassroots.

mandarin_meaning: 草案（初步擬定的文件、方案或法案）
english_meaning: draft (a preliminary document, proposal, or bill)
explanation_mandarin: 指初步制訂的文件或方案，通常用於法律、政策或計劃，供討論、修改或審議之用。
explanation_english: A preliminary document or proposal (such as a bill, plan, or report) prepared for discussion, revision, or review.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府提出了一份新的草案，會喺下個月交立法會審議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tai4 ceot1 liu5 jat1 fan6 san1 ge3 cou2 on3, wui5 hai2 haa6 go3 jyut6 gaau1 lap6 faat3 wui6 sam2 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府提出了一份新的草案，會在下個月提交立法會審議。
examples.english_sentence: The government has put forward a new draft, which will be submitted to the Legislative Council for review next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋先草擬咗一個草案，等大家畀意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sin1 cou2 ji5 zo2 jat1 go3 cou2 on3, dang2 daai6 gaa1 bei2 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們先草擬了一個草案，讓大家提出意見。
examples.english_sentence: We first drafted a proposal so everyone can give feedback.

mandarin_meaning: 草率 (cǎoshuài)：粗心、匆忙、不認真
english_meaning: careless; hasty; perfunctory
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不謹慎、匆忙或不夠認真，常帶有負面評價。
explanation_english: Describes actions done without sufficient care or thought — hurried, careless, or perfunctory; usually negative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做未免太草率啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 mei6 min5 taai3 cou2 seot6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做未免太草率了。
examples.english_sentence: You're being too hasty/careless doing that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢簽合約好草率，冇睇清楚條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cim1 hap6 joek3 hou2 cou2 seot6, mou5 tai2 cing1 co2 tiu4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他簽合約很草率，沒看清條款。
examples.english_sentence: He signed the contract carelessly and didn't read the terms carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試官話你答問題太草率，要準備多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 gung1 waa6 nei5 daap3 man6 tai4 taai3 cou2 seot6, jiu3 zeon2 bei6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試官說你回答問題太草率，要多準備。
examples.english_sentence: The interviewer said your answers were too cursory; you need to prepare more.

mandarin_meaning: 草皮 / 草坪（草覆蓋的表面，常指草地或鋪好的草皮）
english_meaning: turf; sod; grass surface
explanation_mandarin: 指覆蓋地面的草層或鋪設的草皮，常見於公園、球場或庭園的草地表面。
explanation_english: Refers to the layer of grass covering the ground or installed turf, commonly found on parks, sports fields, or lawns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園嘅草皮好靚，大家可以坐喺上面曬太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 ge3 cou2 pei4 hou2 leng3, daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 co5 hai2 soeng6 min6 saai3 taai3 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园的草皮很漂亮，大家可以坐在上面晒太阳。
examples.english_sentence: The park's turf is very nice; everyone can sit on it to sunbathe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球場啲草皮要定期更換，確保球員安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 coeng4 di1 cou2 pei4 jiu3 ding6 kei4 gang1 wun6, kok3 bou2 kau4 jyun4 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球场的草皮要定期更换，以确保球员安全。
examples.english_sentence: The turf on the field needs to be replaced regularly to ensure players' safety.

mandarin_meaning: 草稿 (cǎogǎo)，未經修訂的初步版本
english_meaning: draft; rough draft; preliminary version
explanation_mandarin: 指未經整理或修訂的初步版本，通常用來草擬內容或結構，之後會再修改完善。
explanation_english: An initial, unpolished version of a document or piece of writing, created to sketch out content or structure and intended to be revised later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章我仲係寫緊草稿，未可以交比老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ngo5 zung6 hai6 se2 gan2 cou2 gou2, mei6 ho2 ji5 gaau1 bei2 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇文章我還在寫草稿，還不能交給老師。
examples.english_sentence: I'm still writing a draft of this article; I can't submit it to the teacher yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做企劃嘅時候，最好先擬個草稿，等大家睇過先再改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 kei5 waak6 ge3 si4 hau6, zeoi3 hou2 sin1 ji5 go3 cou2 gou2, dang2 daai6 gaa1 tai2 gwo3 sin1 zoi6 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做企劃的時候，最好先擬個草稿，讓大家看過再修改。
examples.english_sentence: When planning a project it's best to draft a preliminary version first so everyone can review it before making revisions.

mandarin_meaning: 草约；暂定协议（口头或非正式的协议）
english_meaning: provisional agreement; rough/draft agreement; informal or verbal arrangement
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語中指非正式、暫定或草擬的協議或約定，通常是口頭或初步的承諾，不一定具有法律效力。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, refers to an informal, tentative, or draft agreement—often a verbal or provisional commitment that is not necessarily legally binding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋先訂個草約，等正式合約搞掂先至再簽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sin1 deng6 go3 cou2 joek3, dang2 zing3 sik1 hap6 joek3 gaau2 dim6 sin1 zi3 zoi3 cim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们先订一个草约，等正式合约搞定之后再签。
examples.english_sentence: Let's agree to a provisional agreement first; we'll sign the formal contract after it's finalized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰啲只係草約，唔可以當真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 zi2 hai6 cou2 joek3, m4 ho2 ji5 dong3 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的那些只是草约，不能当真。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is only a rough agreement; don't take it seriously.

mandarin_meaning: 草紙（可以指廢紙、草稿用紙；在粵語俚語中亦可貶稱某人無用、沒用的人）
english_meaning: grass paper / scrap paper; (slang) a useless person, loser (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，「草紙」字面可指廢紙、用來寫草稿的紙；作為俚語時，常用來貶低人，表示某人沒用、不可靠或可鄙（帶貶義）。用法視語境可中性或貶義。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '草紙' literally refers to scrap paper or paper for drafts. Colloquially it can be used as a derogatory slang term to call someone useless or unreliable. The meaning depends on context — literal (neutral) or slang (pejorative).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你擺低啲草紙畀我，我要寫低個電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baai2 dai1 di1 cou2 zi2 bei2 ngo5, ngo5 jiu3 se2 dai1 go3 din6 waa6 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把一些草紙放給我，我要寫下電話號碼。
examples.english_sentence: Put some scrap paper down for me — I need to write down the phone number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢根本係條草紙，叫佢做嘢一定做唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan1 bun2 hai6 tiu4 cou2 zi2, giu3 keoi5 zou6 je5 jat1 ding6 zou6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他根本是一個草紙，叫他做事一定做不好。
examples.english_sentence: He's basically useless — if you ask him to do something he definitely won't do it well.

mandarin_meaning: 草羊（cǎoyáng）：以天然牧草為食、放養在草地上的羊；常用來指草飼／放養的羊肉
english_meaning: grass-fed sheep; pasture-raised mutton (sheep raised on natural grassland, often used to describe a type of mutton)
explanation_mandarin: 指以天然牧草為主食、在草地放養的羊種或其肉品，常用以區分於圈養或飼料飼養的羊，強調肉質較清淡自然。
explanation_english: Refers to sheep raised on natural pasture/grass (grass-fed or pasture-raised sheep) or the meat from such sheep; often used to distinguish from barn- or feed‑raised animals and to indicate a cleaner, more natural flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間店賣嘅係草羊肉，味道比較清甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 dim3 maai6 ge3 hai6 cou2 joeng4 juk6, mei6 dou6 bei2 gaau3 cing1 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间店卖的是草羊肉，味道比较清甜。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells grass‑fed mutton; the flavor is relatively mild and slightly sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 俗氣、愛出風頭的人或事物；花哨但廉價、浮誇的裝飾或打扮
english_meaning: tacky/flashy (derogatory) — a person, outfit, or item that is gaudy, showy, and often cheap-looking or attention-seeking
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容人、服飾或物件過分花哨、俗氣或愛炫耀，含貶義，暗示廉價或不實用。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang describing a person, outfit, or object that is gaudy, flashy, or attention-seeking — usually derogatory, implying cheapness or lack of taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著啲衫好草花頭，成日想吸引別人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 di1 saam1 hou2 cou2 faa1 tau4, sing4 jat6 soeng2 kap1 bit6 jan4 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是穿得很草花頭，總想吸引別人注意。
examples.english_sentence: He always dresses in a tacky, flashy way — always trying to attract attention.

mandarin_meaning: 草草了事 / 草率地完成，敷衍了事
english_meaning: to do something hastily and perfunctorily; to just get it over with
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 動詞短語（表示方式）
explanation_mandarin: 表示做事很匆忙、敷衍，沒有用心或認真地完成任務，只為了應付了事。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something hastily and superficially without proper care or attention — merely getting it over with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做報告草草了事，連參考資料都冇寫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 bou3 gou3 cou2 cou2 liu5 si6, lin4 caam1 haau2 zi1 liu6 dou1 mou5 se2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做报告草草了事，连参考资料都没写。
examples.english_sentence: He did the report sloppily; he didn't even write the references.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好草草了事，呢份工要認真完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cou2 cou2 liu5 si6, ni1 fan6 gung1 jiu3 jing6 zan1 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要敷衍了事，这份工作要认真完成。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do it perfunctorily; this job needs to be done properly.

mandarin_meaning: 草莓 (cǎoméi)
english_meaning: strawberry
explanation_mandarin: 一種小型、多汁、通常為紅色且表面有小籽的水果。在粵語日常用語中，亦常用英語音譯「士多啤梨」。
explanation_english: A small, juicy red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface. In Cantonese speech the English loanword '士多啤梨' is also commonly used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食草莓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 cou2 mui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢吃草莓。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating strawberries.

mandarin_meaning: 草菅人命（形容粗暴地漠視或糟蹋人的生命，任意剝奪或犧牲人命）
english_meaning: To treat human life like grass — to utterly disregard or trample on human life; to wantonly sacrifice or kill people.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容當權者或某些人對人的生命極其輕視，任意迫害或殺害，沒有任何人道考量。
explanation_english: An idiom describing extreme contempt for human life — when those in power or others treat people's lives as worthless and arbitrarily harm or kill them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲官員為咗利益，竟然草菅人命，真係令人髮指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 gung1 jyun4 wai6 zo2 lei6 jik1, ging2 jin4 cou2 gaan1 jan4 ming6, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 faat3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些官員為了利益竟然草菅人命，真令人髮指。
examples.english_sentence: Those officials put profit over life and wantonly disregarded people's lives — truly outrageous.

mandarin_meaning: 草菇（稻草菇），学名 Volvariella volvacea，一种可食用的蕈类
english_meaning: straw mushroom (paddy straw mushroom, Volvariella volvacea)
explanation_mandarin: 草菇是一种常见的可食用蘑菇，常生长在稻草或腐殖质上，质地爽脆，常用于汤、炒菜或火锅等亚洲料理中。
explanation_english: An edible mushroom (Volvariella volvacea) commonly called the straw or paddy straw mushroom. It grows on straw or decaying plant matter, has a crisp texture, and is frequently used in soups, stir-fries, and hot pots in Asian cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚煮湯，我買咗啲草菇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 zyu2 tong1, ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 cou2 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚煮汤，我买了些草菇。
examples.english_sentence: I'm making soup tonight; I bought some straw mushrooms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 草菇通常同青菜一齊炒，口感爽脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou2 gu1 tung1 soeng4 tung4 cing1 coi3 jat1 cai4 caau2, hau2 gam2 song2 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 草菇通常和青菜一起炒，口感爽脆。
examples.english_sentence: Straw mushrooms are usually stir-fried with leafy greens; they have a crisp texture.

mandarin_meaning: 草药
english_meaning: herbal medicine; medicinal herb
explanation_mandarin: 指用作药用的植物或其制品，常用于中医和民間療法，泛指草本藥材或草藥配方。
explanation_english: Refers to plants or plant-based products used as medicine, commonly used in traditional Chinese medicine and folk remedies; generally denotes medicinal herbs or herbal remedies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個成日飲草藥，宜家身體好咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 jam2 cou2 joek6, ji4 gaa1 san1 tai2 hou2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候常常吃草药，现在身体好了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to take herbal medicine often when he was little; now his health is better.

mandarin_meaning: 草席（用草或稻草編成的席子）
english_meaning: straw mat; grass mat (a mat woven from straw or reeds used for sitting or sleeping)
explanation_mandarin: 用草、稻草或葦子等編成的席子，常用作睡覺、坐或野餐時的墊子，夏天摸上去較涼爽。
explanation_english: A mat woven from straw, reeds, or similar plant material, commonly used for sleeping, sitting, or picnicking; feels cooler in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企有一張草蓆，夏天瞓覺涼快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei5 jau5 jat1 zoeng1 cou2 sik1, haa6 tin1 fan3 gaau3 loeng4 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家有一張草蓆，夏天睡覺比較涼快。
examples.english_sentence: There's a straw mat at home; sleeping on it is cooler in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去郊外野餐，記得帶草蓆，坐喺地下舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 je5 caan1, gei3 dak1 daai3 cou2 sik1, co5 hai2 dei6 haa6 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們去郊外野餐，記得帶草蓆，坐在地上比較舒服。
examples.english_sentence: We're going on a picnic; remember to bring a straw mat — it's more comfortable to sit on the ground.

mandarin_meaning: 草药 (cǎoyào) — 药用植物或用于治疗、保健的草本制品
english_meaning: herbal medicine; medicinal herbs
explanation_mandarin: 指用于治疗疾病或保健的植物，通常指中医或民间使用的药用植物或由其制成的草本药物。
explanation_english: Refers to plants used for treating illnesses or maintaining health; commonly denotes herbs used in traditional Chinese medicine or herbal remedies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲草藥要按醫生指示服用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cou2 joek6 jiu3 on3 ji1 sang1 zi2 si6 fuk6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些草药要按照医生的指示服用。
examples.english_sentence: These medicinal herbs should be taken according to the doctor's instructions.

mandarin_meaning: 草蜢 / 蚱蜢（昆虫）；亦指香港流行乐队「草蜢」
english_meaning: grasshopper (insect); also the name of a Hong Kong pop band (Grasshopper)
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指一种常见的跳跃昆虫，属于直翅目；2) 同时是香港的一支知名流行乐队（草蜢），常用于指乐队本身或其歌曲。
explanation_english: 1) A common jumping insect (grasshopper); 2) The name of a well-known Hong Kong pop trio (Grasshopper), used to refer to the band or their music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面見到好多草蜢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 cou2 maang5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公园里看到很多蚱蜢。
examples.english_sentence: I saw many grasshoppers in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個好鍾意聽草蜢嘅歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1 cou2 maang5 ge3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢听草蜢（乐队）的歌。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I liked listening to Grasshopper's songs.

mandarin_meaning: 草做的被褥；稻草或草编成的毯子/被子
english_meaning: straw blanket; quilt or mat made of straw/grass
explanation_mandarin: 指用稻草、乾草等材料編織或壓成的被褥或毯子，傳統農村常見，用作簡易床褥或蓋被。
explanation_english: Refers to a blanket or bedding made from straw or grass; a traditional, makeshift quilt or mat commonly used in rural areas as bedding or cover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前農村嘅人多數用草被做被褥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 nung4 cyun1 ge3 jan4 do1 sou3 jung6 cou2 bei6 zou6 bei6 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前农村的人多数用草被当被褥。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people in rural areas often used straw blankets as bedding.

mandarin_meaning: 草鞋（稻草或草編成的鞋）
english_meaning: straw sandals; straw shoes
explanation_mandarin: 用稻草或其他植物纖維編成的鞋，傳統農村常見，質地粗糙且價格便宜，有時也用作比喻表示簡陋或寒酸。
explanation_english: Shoes made from straw or woven plant fibers, traditionally worn in rural areas. They are coarse and inexpensive; the term can also be used figuratively to describe something shabby or humble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農夫著住草鞋落田做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 fu1 zoek3 zyu6 cou2 haai4 lok6 tin4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农夫穿着草鞋下田干活。
examples.english_sentence: The farmer wore straw sandals into the field to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對舊草鞋已經散晒，要換一對新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 gau6 cou2 haai4 ji5 ging1 saan3 saai3, jiu3 wun6 jat1 deoi3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双旧草鞋已经散了，要换一双新的。
examples.english_sentence: These old straw sandals are falling apart; they need a new pair.

mandarin_meaning: 草食；草食族（指在感情或性方面較被動、不主動追求戀愛的人）
english_meaning: herbivore (literal); 'herbivore' as slang — a person who is passive or not actively pursuing romantic/sexual relationships
explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面意思：以植物為食的動物（草食動物）。2) 流行語／網絡用法：形容在感情或性方面較被動、不主動追求戀愛的人，常見片語有「草食男」「草食女」。
explanation_english: 1) Literal: animals that eat plants (herbivores). 2) Slang/popular usage: describes a person who is passive in romance or sexuality and does not actively pursue relationships (commonly used in phrases like 'herbivore man' or 'herbivore woman').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係草食男，唔主動追女仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 cou2 sik6 naam4, m4 zyu2 dung6 zeoi1 neoi5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是草食男，不會主動追女生。
examples.english_sentence: He's a 'herbivore' guy — he doesn't actively pursue girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兔仔係草食動物，成日食菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 zai2 hai6 cou2 sik6 dung6 mat6, sing4 jat6 sik6 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兔子是草食动物，经常吃菜。
examples.english_sentence: Rabbits are herbivores and often eat plants.

mandarin_meaning: 草食男（cǎoshí nán）：指性格較溫和、在戀愛或追求上比較被動、不太積極追求異性或對兩性關係興趣較低的男性。
english_meaning: A 'herbivore man' — a man who is passive or non-assertive in romantic pursuits, often gentle, reserved, and not actively seeking relationships or sexual encounters.
explanation_mandarin: 來源受日語「草食系男子」影響，用來描述那些對戀愛不主動、生活態度較平和、不追求傳統男性強勢形象的男性群體。
explanation_english: Originally from the Japanese term 'herbivore men', used to describe men who are uninterested or passive about dating and romance, preferring a gentle, non-competitive lifestyle rather than pursuing partners aggressively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個典型嘅草食男，平時好安靜，唔會主動追女仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 din2 jing4 ge3 cou2 sik6 naam4, ping4 si4 hou2 on1 zing6, m4 wui5 zyu2 dung6 zeoi1 neoi5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個典型的草食男，平時很安靜，不會主動追女生。
examples.english_sentence: He's a typical 'herbivore man' — quiet in daily life and won't actively pursue women.

mandarin_meaning: 草制的龍；用稻草、草茅或竹篾等編成的龍形物，常見於民間節慶、巡遊或祭祀活動中
english_meaning: straw (or grass) dragon — a dragon figure made from straw/grass or similar materials, used in folk festivals, parades or rituals
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東、香港及華南部分地區的民間習俗中，草龍指用稻草、草或竹片等編成的龍形道具或裝飾，常用於節慶巡遊、村落祭祀或表演。有時也可用來指臨時、簡陋製作的龍形物。
explanation_english: In Guangdong, Hong Kong and parts of southern China folk practice, a 'grass/straw dragon' is a dragon-shaped object made from straw, grass or bamboo strips, used as a prop or decoration in festival parades, village rituals or performances. It can also be used to describe a makeshift or roughly made dragon figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨日村入面有條草龍巡遊，大家去睇熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok6 jat6 cyun1 jap6 min6 jau5 tiu4 cou2 lung4 ceon4 jau4, daai6 gaa1 heoi3 tai2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天村里有一條草龍巡遊，大家去看熱鬧。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday the village had a straw-dragon parade, and everyone went to watch the festivities.

mandarin_meaning: （粗口）对人的辱骂，意为“混蛋”、“可鄙的人”。字面上是“草（操）龟”，带强烈脏话性质。
english_meaning: (vulgar) an insulting term meaning 'bastard', 'motherfucker', or 'jerk'; literally 'fuck turtle', used as a strong curse in Cantonese.
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話粗俗用語，用来骂人，带有强烈冒犯性。源自“草/操”作动词的粗口用法，后接“龜”作贬称，通常在非正式或愤怒情境出现，应避免在正式场合使用。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese vulgar insult combining 'cou' (to f**k) and 'gwai' (turtle) — used to call someone a bastard or to express strong anger. Highly offensive; avoid in polite or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你條草龜，做嘢點可以咁衰？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tiu4 cou2 gwai1, zou6 je5 dim2 ho2 ji5 gam2 seoi1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个混蛋，做事怎么能这么差？
examples.english_sentence: You bastard, how could you do such a lousy job?

mandarin_meaning: 荊、荆棘；多指帶刺的灌木，也可指地名或姓氏
english_meaning: bramble; thorny shrub; figuratively, difficulties or obstacles; also a place name or surname
explanation_mandarin: 本字常用於「荊棘」，表示帶刺的灌木或叢生的荊棘，引申指艱難、障礙；亦可作地名或姓氏使用。
explanation_english: The character commonly appears in compounds like "荊棘" to mean brambles or thorny shrubs. It is also used figuratively for hardships or obstacles, and can be a place name or surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路滿佈荊棘，行起上嚟真係好困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 mun5 bou3 ging1 gik1, hang4 hei2 soeng5 lai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路满是荆棘，走起来真的很困难。
examples.english_sentence: This path is full of brambles; it's really difficult to walk.

mandarin_meaning: 荊棘；比喻艱難、障礙
english_meaning: brambles/thorny shrubs; figuratively, hardships or obstacles
explanation_mandarin: 本義為帶刺的灌木、荊棘植物；引申用來比喻人生或事業道路上的困難、障礙與艱辛。
explanation_english: Originally refers to thorny shrubs (brambles); metaphorically used to mean difficulties, obstacles, or hardships encountered in life or endeavors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業之路充滿荊棘，但我哋要堅持落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 zi1 lou6 cung1 mun5 ging1 gik6, daan6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin1 ci4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 創業之路充滿荊棘，但我們要堅持下去。
examples.english_sentence: The road of starting a business is full of thorns (difficulties), but we must persevere.

mandarin_meaning: 荆棘满途（前路充满艰难险阻）
english_meaning: the path is strewn with thorns; facing many difficulties and obstacles
explanation_mandarin: 比喻前進的道路充滿艱難和阻礙，形容處境艱難、困難重重。
explanation_english: A figurative expression meaning that the road ahead is full of difficulties and obstacles; used to describe a situation that is fraught with hardship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢創業嗰陣遇到好多困難，真係荊棘滿途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cong3 jip6 go2 zan6 jyu6 dou3 hou2 do1 kwan3 naan4, zan1 hai6 ging1 gik1 mun5 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他创业那时遇到很多困难，真是荆棘满途。
examples.english_sentence: When he started his business he ran into many difficulties; it was truly a road full of thorns.

mandarin_meaning: （文言）软弱、柔弱；在词语“荏苒”中表示光阴流逝
english_meaning: soft, weak (literary); in the compound 荏苒 (rěnrǎn) meaning the passage of time/time slips away
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词（文言用法）/词素（用于合成词如“荏苒”）
explanation_mandarin: “荏”为古汉语字，常见于书面或文言中，可表示软弱、柔弱；在成语“荏苒”中与“苒”合用，表示时光流逝、光阴易逝。
explanation_english: “荏” is an archaic/literary character meaning soft or weak. It commonly appears in classical phrases such as 荏苒, which describes the fleeting passage of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時光荏苒，轉眼已經十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gwong1 jam6 jin5, zyun2 ngaan5 ji5 ging1 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时光荏苒，转眼已经十年。
examples.english_sentence: Time slips away; in the blink of an eye it's already been ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格有啲荏弱，唔係好堅定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gaak3 jau5 di1 jam6 joek6, m4 hai6 hou2 gin1 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他性格有点荏弱，不太坚定。
examples.english_sentence: He is somewhat weak/soft in character and not very resolute.

mandarin_meaning: 荐 / 薦 (jiàn)：推荐、荐举、呈献
english_meaning: to recommend; to endorse; to present (as a recommendation)
explanation_mandarin: 表示推荐或荐举某人或某事，常见于复合词如“推荐”“自荐”“荐举”。
explanation_english: Used to indicate recommending or endorsing someone or something; commonly appears in compounds like "recommend" (推荐) or "self-recommend" (自荐).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會推薦佢去申請嗰個職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 teoi1 zin3 keoi5 heoi3 san1 cing2 go2 go3 zik1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會推薦他去申请那个职位。
examples.english_sentence: I'll recommend him to apply for that position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自薦做隊長，但未被選上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 zin3 zou6 deoi6 zoeng2, daan6 mei6 bei6 syun2 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自荐做队长，但未被选上。
examples.english_sentence: He volunteered himself to be team leader, but wasn't chosen.

mandarin_meaning: 荒 (huāng)：荒蕪、荒涼、荒廢；也有荒唐、荒謬之意
english_meaning: desolate, barren, neglected; also absurd or ridiculous
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 動詞（視詞語而定，如「荒涼」「荒廢」）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / verb (depends on compound, e.g. 'desolate', 'to fall into disrepair')
explanation_mandarin: 表示土地或地方無人、荒蕪荒涼，也可表示事情荒唐、荒謬；在複合詞中可作動詞（如「荒廢」）或形容詞（如「荒涼」）。
explanation_english: Refers to land or places that are deserted, barren, or neglected; can also describe something as absurd. In compounds it can act as an adjective (e.g. 'desolate') or a verb (e.g. 'to fall into disrepair').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方好荒涼，冇人住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 hou2 wong4 loeng4, mou5 jan4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個地方很荒涼，沒有人住。
examples.english_sentence: This place is very desolate; no one lives here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰個理由真係好荒謬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 go3 lei5 jau6 zan1 hai6 hou2 wong4 mau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說的那個理由真是很荒謬。
examples.english_sentence: The reason you gave is really absurd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為懶，屋企嘅花園全部荒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 laan5, uk1 kei2 ge3 faa1 jyun4 cyun4 bou6 wong4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為懶，家裡的花園全部荒廢了。
examples.english_sentence: Because he's lazy, the garden at home has all fallen into disrepair.

mandarin_meaning: 荒僻 (偏遠、僻靜、荒涼)
english_meaning: remote; secluded; desolate
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容地方偏遠、少有人到、環境孤立或荒涼。
explanation_english: Describes a place that is remote, seldom visited, isolated, or desolate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個村好荒僻，去到好難搵到人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 cyun1 hou2 wong4 pik1, heoi3 dou3 hou2 naan4 wan2 dou3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个村子很荒僻，去那里很难找到人。
examples.english_sentence: That village is very remote; it's hard to find people there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 度假村嘅位置比較荒僻，但景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou6 gaa3 cyun1 ge3 wai6 zi6 bei2 gaau3 wong4 pik1, daan6 ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 度假村的位置比較偏僻，但景色很美。
examples.english_sentence: The resort is located in a relatively secluded spot, but the scenery is beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 荒唐（huāngtáng）— 荒诞、不合常理、荒谬
english_meaning: absurd; ridiculous; preposterous; outrageous
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容言行或事情荒诞、不合常理、没有道理或令人不能接受。
explanation_english: Describes behavior or situations that are absurd, unreasonable, or outrageous — something that defies common sense or is shockingly inappropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢真係好荒唐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 wong4 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的話真荒唐。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is really absurd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃太荒唐，根本冇可行性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 taai3 wong4 tong4, gan1 bun2 mou5 ho2 hang4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個計劃太荒唐，根本沒有可行性。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is too absurd; it has no feasibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做真係好荒唐，會害到其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 wong4 tong4, wui5 hoi6 dou3 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做真的很荒唐，會害到其他人。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is really ridiculous and will harm others.

mandarin_meaning: 荒地（未被耕作或開發的土地，荒蕪或廢置的地塊）
english_meaning: wasteland; uncultivated land; barren land
explanation_mandarin: 指未被耕作或開發、長滿雜草或被荒廢的土地。可指天然荒野或因人為原因而未利用的地塊。
explanation_english: Refers to land that is uncultivated or undeveloped, often overgrown or abandoned. Can denote naturally barren areas or plots left unused or neglected by people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊荒地已經好耐冇人管理，長滿咗雜草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 wong4 dei6 ji5 ging1 hou2 noi6 mou5 jan4 gun2 lei5, zoeng2 mun5 zo2 zaap6 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这片荒地已经很久没有人管理，长满了杂草。
examples.english_sentence: This patch of wasteland hasn't been maintained for a long time and is overgrown with weeds.

mandarin_meaning: 荒山；荒废或荒凉的山地
english_meaning: barren mountain; desolate hill; uncultivated/wasteland mountain
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有植被、少人居住或未開墾的山地，常用來形容景色荒涼的山丘或山脈。
explanation_english: Refers to a mountain or hill that is barren, uncultivated, sparsely vegetated, or rarely inhabited; used to describe a desolate, wasteland-like hill or mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條村後面有座荒山，好少人上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 cyun1 hau6 min6 jau5 zo6 wong4 saan1, hou2 siu2 jan4 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 村子後面有座荒山，很少人上去。
examples.english_sentence: There is a barren mountain behind the village; very few people go up there.

mandarin_meaning: 荒山野岭；偏远、荒凉的山区或野外
english_meaning: desolate, remote mountains/wilderness; a remote and sparsely populated place
explanation_mandarin: 指荒涼、偏遠且人煙稀少的山地或野外，常用來形容交通不便、無人居住的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to desolate, remote mountainous or wilderness areas; commonly used to describe places that are sparsely populated and hard to reach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間小屋喺荒山野嶺，平時好少有人嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 siu2 nguk1 hai6 wong1 saan1 je5 ling5, ping4 si4 hou2 siu2 jau5 jan4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間小屋在荒山野岭，平時很少有人來。
examples.english_sentence: That small cabin is in the remote mountains; very few people usually come there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今次去荒山野嶺露營，記得帶足夠糧食同水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 heoi3 wong1 saan1 je5 ling5 lou6 jing4, gei3 dak1 daai3 zuk1 gau3 loeng4 sik6 tung4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們這次去荒山野岭露營，記得帶足夠的糧食和水。
examples.english_sentence: We're going camping in the remote mountains this time; remember to bring enough food and water.

mandarin_meaning: 荒島（無人居住或荒涼的島嶼）
english_meaning: deserted island; uninhabited, desolate island
explanation_mandarin: 指無人居住或荒涼的島嶼，也可用來形容與世隔絕、孤立的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to an uninhabited or desolate island; can also be used metaphorically for a place isolated from the outside world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我被困喺荒島，我要做啲咩先？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 bei6 kwan3 hai2 wong4 dou2, ngo5 jiu3 zou6 di1 me1 sin1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我被困在荒島上，我要做什麼？
examples.english_sentence: If I were stranded on a deserted island, what should I do?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個小島好似荒島，冇人住，亦冇電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 siu2 dou2 hou2 ci5 wong4 dou2, mou5 jan4 zyu6, jik6 mou5 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個小島看起來像荒島，沒有人住，也沒有電力。
examples.english_sentence: That small island looks deserted — nobody lives there and there's no electricity.

mandarin_meaning: 荒废 (huāngfèi)：被忽略、未被妥善使用或管理，變得荒涼或廢棄
english_meaning: to be abandoned/neglected; to fall into disuse; derelict
explanation_mandarin: 指事物（如建築、土地、學業等）因缺乏照顧或使用而變得破敗、荒涼或無人管理。
explanation_english: Refers to something (e.g., a building, land, studies) that has become neglected, unused, or run-down due to lack of care or maintenance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間廠多年無人管理，已經荒廢晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 cong2 do1 nin4 mou5 jan4 gun2 lei5, ji5 ging1 wong4 fai3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家工廠多年無人管理，已經荒廢了。
examples.english_sentence: This factory has been unmaintained for years and has fallen into disrepair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗之後，學業荒廢咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6, hok6 jip6 wong4 fai3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病之後，學業荒廢了。
examples.english_sentence: After he got sick, his studies fell by the wayside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰塊田已經荒廢咗，長滿雜草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 faai3 tin4 ji5 ging1 wong4 fai3 zo2, coeng4 mun5 zaap6 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那塊田已經荒廢了，長滿雜草。
examples.english_sentence: That field has been abandoned and is overgrown with weeds.

mandarin_meaning: 荒凉 (huāngliáng) — 形容荒芜、冷清、无人或缺乏生气的景象
english_meaning: desolate; bleak; barren; deserted; forlorn
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容地方或景象荒芜、冷清、缺乏人迹或生气，常带有凄凉、孤寂的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes a place or scene that is barren, bleak, empty, or lacking activity or people; often conveys a sense of loneliness or forlornness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條山路好荒涼，夜晚行要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 hou2 wong4 loeng4, je6 maan5 haang4 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条山路很荒凉，晚上走要小心。
examples.english_sentence: This mountain path is very desolate; be careful when walking at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 離開城市後，四周變得一片荒涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei4 hoi1 sing4 si5 hau6, sei3 zau1 bin3 dak1 jat1 pin3 wong4 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 离开城市后，四周变得一片荒凉。
examples.english_sentence: After leaving the city, the surroundings became desolate.

mandarin_meaning: 荒淫（指在性行為或情慾方面放縱、無節制；亦可泛指行為放蕩、墮落）
english_meaning: licentious; dissolute; debauched; indulging in uncontrolled sexual pleasures or immoral behavior
explanation_mandarin: 指在性或情慾方面放縱、無節制，或行為放蕩、不檢點，常用於批評道德敗壞的人或行為。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is sexually licentious or indulgent, behaving in an unrestrained, immoral, or dissolute way; often used to criticize moral corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢生活荒淫無度，成日尋花問柳，屋企都散晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saang1 wut6 wong4 jam4 mou4 dou6, sing4 jat6 cam4 faa1 man6 lau4, uk1 kei2 dou1 saan3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生活荒淫無度，成天尋花問柳，家庭都散了。
examples.english_sentence: He lives a licentious, unrestrained life, always chasing women; his family has fallen apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時啲文獻常常話有啲皇帝荒淫，搞到國家衰落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 di1 man4 hin3 soeng4 soeng4 waa6 jau5 di1 wong4 dai3 wong4 jam4, gaau2 dou3 gwok3 gaa1 seoi1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代文獻常說有些皇帝荒淫，導致國家衰亡。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient records often say certain emperors were licentious, causing the decline of the state.

mandarin_meaning: 荒漠；干旱、荒涼的土地（如沙漠）
english_meaning: desert; barren wasteland; arid, desolate land
explanation_mandarin: 指廣闊乾旱、荒涼的土地，通常指沙漠或無人居住的荒原，也可用作比喻形容冷漠或貧瘠的處境。
explanation_english: Refers to vast arid and desolate land, typically a desert or uninhabited wasteland; can also be used metaphorically to describe emotional barrenness or a bleak situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度係一片荒漠，幾乎冇生命存在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 hai6 jat1 pin3 wong1 mok6, gei2 fu1 mou5 sang1 ming6 cyun4 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那裡是一片荒漠，幾乎沒有生命存在。
examples.english_sentence: It's a desert there, with almost no life present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個心好似荒漠咁，冇人可以入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sam1 hou2 ci5 wong1 mok6 gam2, mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的心像荒漠一樣，沒有人可以進入。
examples.english_sentence: His heart is like a desert; no one can enter.

mandarin_meaning: 荒芜；荒废、无人耕种或无人打理
english_meaning: barren; overgrown; neglected; uncultivated
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容土地、地方或事物荒廢、雜草叢生或無人管理，亦可比喻技能、事業等因久未使用而退化。
explanation_english: Used to describe land, places, or things that are abandoned, overgrown with weeds, or unmaintained; can also be used metaphorically for skills or affairs that have fallen into disuse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢片田已經荒蕪咗好耐，長滿咗雜草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin3 tin4 ji5 ging1 wong4 mou4 zo2 hou2 noi6, coeng4 mun5 zo2 zaap6 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这片田已经荒芜了很久，长满了杂草。
examples.english_sentence: This field has been overgrown for a long time and is covered with weeds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔繼續練習，技術會荒蕪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gai3 zuk6 lin6 zaap6, gei6 seot6 wui5 wong4 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不继续练习，技能会荒芜。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't keep practicing, your skills will deteriorate/become neglected.

mandarin_meaning: 荒诞（huāngdàn）：荒唐、不合常理或不真實，帶有誇張和荒謬的意味。
english_meaning: absurd; preposterous; bizarre; wildly unrealistic
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事情或說法極不合理、誇張或荒謬，通常帶有否定或批評意味。
explanation_english: Describes something extremely unreasonable, exaggerated, or ridiculous; often used to criticize or express disbelief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故事好荒誕，根本唔可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 hou2 wong1 daan6, gan1 bun2 m4 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事太荒诞，根本不可信。
examples.english_sentence: This story is too absurd to be believable.

mandarin_meaning: 荒谬
english_meaning: absurd; ridiculous; preposterous
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容言論、行為或情況非常不合理、荒唐或荒诞可笑。
explanation_english: Used to describe a statement, action, or situation that is unreasonable, ridiculous, or absurd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅理由完全係荒謬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 lei5 jau4 jyun4 cyun4 hai6 wong4 mau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的理由完全是荒谬的。
examples.english_sentence: The reason you gave is completely absurd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅指控冇證據，好荒謬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zi2 hung3 mou5 zing3 geoi3, hou2 wong4 mau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的指控没有证据，非常荒谬。
examples.english_sentence: His accusation has no evidence; it's very absurd.

mandarin_meaning: 荒郊野岭（远离市区的荒凉郊外或山岭）
english_meaning: desolate outskirts; remote wild hills; a lonely, deserted place
explanation_mandarin: 指遠離市區、荒涼的郊外或山嶺。可作為字面意思描述地點，也可比喻偏僻或無人問津的地方或情況。
explanation_english: Refers to remote, desolate outskirts or wild hills far from urban areas. Used literally for places and figuratively to describe isolated or neglected situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚一個人去荒郊野嶺好危險，唔好去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 wong1 gaau1 je5 ling5 hou2 ngai4 him2, m4 hou2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上一个人去荒郊野岭很危险，别去。
examples.english_sentence: It's dangerous to go to the desolate outskirts alone at night — don't go.

mandarin_meaning: 荒野；荒地；無人居住的廣闊野外
english_meaning: wilderness; wilds; uncultivated land
explanation_mandarin: 指未開墾或無人居住的廣闊自然地帶，常用來形容荒涼的野外地區或沒有建築物的空曠地面。
explanation_english: Refers to wide, uncultivated natural areas where people don't usually live; used to describe desolate outdoor regions or open land without buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度係一片荒野，夜晚行路好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 hai6 jat1 pin3 wong4 je5, je6 maan5 haang4 lou6 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那裡是一片荒野，晚上走路很危險。
examples.english_sentence: That's a wilderness; it's dangerous to walk there at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開發商準備喺嗰片荒野興建住宅區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 faat3 soeng1 zeon2 bei6 hai2 go2 pin3 wong4 je5 hing1 gin3 zyu6 zaak6 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开发商准备在那片荒野兴建住宅区。
examples.english_sentence: The developer plans to build a housing estate on that wilderness area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想去荒野求生，學下野外生存技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 heoi3 wong4 je5 kau4 saang1, hok6 haa5 je5 ngoi6 saang1 cyun4 gei6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想去荒野求生，學習野外生存技巧。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to try wilderness survival to learn outdoor survival skills.

mandarin_meaning: 荔枝（lìzhī）
english_meaning: lychee (a tropical fruit)
explanation_mandarin: 荔为荔枝的简称，指一种外皮粗糙、果肉多汁、味道香甜的热带水果。
explanation_english: Short form for lychee, a tropical fruit with rough red skin, juicy flesh, and a sweet fragrant taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一箱荔，啲荔好香好甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 soeng1 lai6, di1 lai6 hou2 hoeng1 hou2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一箱荔枝，这些荔枝很香很甜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a box of lychees; they are very fragrant and sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 荔景（地名）
english_meaning: Lai King (place name in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 荔景是香港的一個地名，位於葵青區，附近有荔景邨及港鐵荔景站，是以住宅區與交通樞紐聞名的地區。
explanation_english: Lai King is a place name in Hong Kong (Kwai Tsing District). It includes residential developments such as Lai King Estate and Lai King MTR station, and is known as a residential area and transport interchange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺荔景長大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 lai6 ging2 coeng4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在荔景長大。
examples.english_sentence: I grew up in Lai King.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 荔景站係荃灣線同東涌線嘅轉車站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai6 ging2 zaam6 hai6 cyun4 waan1 sin3 tung4 dung1 chung1 sin3 ge3 zyun2 ce1 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 荔景站是荃灣線和東涌線的轉乘站。
examples.english_sentence: Lai King station is an interchange between the Tsuen Wan Line and the Tung Chung Line.

mandarin_meaning: 荔枝 (lìzhī)
english_meaning: lychee (a tropical fruit)
explanation_mandarin: 荔枝是一種原產於華南的熱帶水果，外殼紅色有突起，果肉白色半透明，味道甜多汁，常見於廣東、香港等地的夏季時令水果。
explanation_english: Lychee is a tropical fruit native to southern China. It has a rough red shell, translucent white juicy flesh, and a sweet flavor. Commonly eaten in summer, especially in Guangdong and Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買荔枝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 lai6 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买荔枝。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy lychees.

mandarin_meaning: 荔枝干 (lìzhīgān)
english_meaning: dried lychee
explanation_mandarin: 荔枝干是将新鲜荔枝去核并经晒干或烘干制成的干果，常作为零食或用于煲汤、甜品等。在粤菜和民间食疗中亦常见。
explanation_english: Dried lychee—lychee fruit pitted and dried (sun-dried or oven-dried). It is commonly eaten as a snack or used in soups and desserts, and appears in Cantonese cuisine and traditional remedies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食荔枝乾，細個成日食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 lai6 zi1 gon1, sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢吃荔枝干，小时候经常吃。
examples.english_sentence: I really like dried lychees; I used to eat them a lot as a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽用荔枝乾煲湯，湯好甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jung6 lai6 zi1 gon1 bou1 tong1, tong1 hou2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈用荔枝干煲汤，汤很甜。
examples.english_sentence: My mom uses dried lychees to make soup; the soup is very sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 荔枝角（地名，香港九龍西的一個地區）
english_meaning: Lai Chi Kok (a neighbourhood in Kowloon West, Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 荔枝角是香港九龍西的一個地區，名稱來源於昔日該處有荔枝樹，區內有荔枝角公園、住宅和交通設施，亦有港鐵荔枝角站（屬荔枝角站範圍）。
explanation_english: Lai Chi Kok is an area in Kowloon West, Hong Kong. The name originally referred to a place with lychee trees. The neighbourhood includes parks, residential areas and transport facilities, and is served by Lai Chi Kok MTR station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日喺荔枝角見面，幾點好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 hai2 lai6 zi1 gok3 gin3 min6, gei2 dim2 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們明天在荔枝角見面，幾點方便？
examples.english_sentence: Let's meet at Lai Chi Kok tomorrow — what time is good?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常坐地鐵去荔枝角，車程唔耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 co5 dei6 tit3 heoi3 lai6 zi1 gok3, ce1 cing4 m4 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常坐地鐵去荔枝角，車程不久。
examples.english_sentence: I usually take the MTR to Lai Chi Kok; the ride isn't long.

mandarin_meaning: 荔浦芋（荔浦出產的一種芋頭品種）
english_meaning: Lipu taro (a variety of taro produced in Lipu, Guangxi)
explanation_mandarin: 指廣西荔浦縣出產的一種芋頭（芋），以質地綿密、香軟、風味佳著稱，常用於甜品或烹調中。
explanation_english: Refers to a variety of taro grown in Lipu County, Guangxi. Known for its smooth, dense texture and pleasant flavor; commonly used in desserts and savory dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個甜品用咗荔浦芋，口感好綿密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tim4 ban2 jung6 zo2 lai6 pou2 wu6, hau2 gam2 hou2 min4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個甜品用了荔浦芋，口感很綿密。
examples.english_sentence: This dessert uses Lipu taro and has a very smooth, dense texture.

mandarin_meaning: 荔湾（地名，廣州市下轄區）
english_meaning: Liwan (a district/area; Liwan District in Guangzhou)
explanation_mandarin: 荔灣是廣州市的一個歷史區名（荔灣區），名稱源於舊時此地盛產荔枝及臨水灣地帶，常用以指稱該地區及其文化、飲食特色。
explanation_english: Liwan is a place name referring to Liwan District in Guangzhou. The name historically refers to lychee-producing areas and a bay; it's commonly used to denote the district and its cultural and culinary characteristics (e.g., dim sum).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 周末我哋去廣州荔灣食早茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau1 mut6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gwong2 zau1 lai6 waan1 sik6 zou2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 周末我们去广州荔湾吃早茶。
examples.english_sentence: This weekend we're going to Liwan in Guangzhou to have morning tea (dim sum).

mandarin_meaning: 芋头（粤语地区对芋头的称呼）
english_meaning: taro (regional Cantonese name for the tuber)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种常见的块茎作物，即芋头。『荔芋』为粤语地区常用的称呼，常用于甜品、糕点或煮食中。
explanation_english: Refers to a starchy tuber known as taro. '荔芋' is a Cantonese regional name for taro, commonly used in desserts, cakes, and cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個市場啲荔芋好新鮮，我買咗嚟整芋頭糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si5 coeng4 di1 lai6 wu6 hou2 san1 sin1, ngo5 maai5 zo2 lai4 zing2 wu6 tau4 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個市場的荔芋很新鮮，我買來做芋頭糕。
examples.english_sentence: The taro at this market is very fresh; I bought some to make taro cake.

mandarin_meaning: 摆动、摇晃；在某些词中可表示放荡或来回晃荡
english_meaning: to swing, to sway, to rock; in some compounds can mean licentious or to loiter/rove
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“荡”常用来表示物体来回摆动或摇晃（如“荡秋千”）；在部分词语中亦可表示放荡、不检点或闲荡、晃来晃去的意思。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '蕩' is commonly used to mean swinging or swaying (e.g. 'to swing on a swing'). In some compounds it can carry senses of licentiousness or of loafing/roving about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路最鍾意蕩秋千。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 dong6 cau1 cin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子最喜欢荡秋千。
examples.english_sentence: Kids love swinging on swings.

mandarin_meaning: 荣 (róng)：荣耀、光荣、兴盛；可作名词、形容词或动词，表示受到尊荣或使显得光荣。
english_meaning: rong (róng): honor, glory, prosperity; can function as noun, adjective, or verb indicating honor or flourishing.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞/形容詞/動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: “荣”常用來表示光榮、榮譽或興旺，例如“光荣”“荣幸”“荣耀”。在不同詞語中可作不同詞性。
explanation_english: “荣” (rong) commonly denotes honor, glory, or flourishing (e.g., 光荣, 荣幸, 荣耀). It appears in various parts of speech depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好榮幸可以參加今次比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 wing4 hang6 ho2 ji5 caam1 gaa1 gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很榮幸能參加這次比賽。
examples.english_sentence: I'm honored to be able to participate in this competition.

mandarin_meaning: 豆（dòu），表示豆类、豆子
english_meaning: bean; beans (legume)
explanation_mandarin: 「荳」是「豆」的異體字，粤語讀作 dau6（普通话讀作 dòu）。主要用來表示各種豆類（如豆腐、豆漿、紅豆等）。在現代漢語中常用「豆」字，但在一些古文、名字或方言書寫中會見到「荳」。
explanation_english: “荳” is a variant form of the character 豆, pronounced dau6 in Cantonese (dòu in Mandarin). It refers to beans or legumes (appearing in words like tofu, soy milk, red bean). The standard modern character is 豆, but 荳 appears in historical texts, names, or dialectal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食荳腐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 dau6 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃豆腐。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating tofu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 早晨飲杯荳漿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 san4 jam2 bui1 dau6 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早晨喝杯豆浆。
examples.english_sentence: Have a cup of soy milk in the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 沙律入面有紅荳同青豆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saa1 leot6 jap6 min6 jau5 hung4 dau6 tung4 ceng1 dau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沙拉里有红豆和青豆。
examples.english_sentence: There are red beans and green peas in the salad.

mandarin_meaning: 豆腐；（俚語）「吃／食豆腐」：指對異性做出輕佻或猥褻的舉動（調戲、摸索）
english_meaning: tofu; (slang) to grope or make sexual advances (as in 'to take liberties')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（食物）；動詞／俚語（性騷擾、調戲）
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指以大豆製成的豆腐，是一種食物。在口語中常見短語「食／吃豆腐」，用來形容對別人做出輕佻或猥褻的舉動（例如摸索或調戲）。
explanation_english: Literally 'tofu', a soybean product. Colloquially, in phrases like 'sik6 dau6fu6'/'eat tofu' it means to make sexual advances or grope someone (to take liberties).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去食荳腐火鍋，啲湯好鮮味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 dau6 fu6 fo2 wo1, di1 tong1 hou2 sin1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們去吃豆腐火鍋，湯很鮮美。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go have tofu hotpot tonight; the broth is really tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀佢食你嘅荳腐！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 sik6 nei5 ge3 dau6 fu6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要讓他／她摸你或調戲你！
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him/her grope you!

mandarin_meaning: 豆蔻；一種香料（如豆蔻）；另指“豆蔻年華”，比喻少女青澀年華（早期青春期，傳統指13歲）
english_meaning: cardamom (a spice); also used figuratively in the phrase '豆蔻年華' to mean the age of early adolescence (traditionally thirteen)
explanation_mandarin: 荳蔻原指一種香料（如小荳蔻／豆蔻），在文學用法中常見於「豆蔻年華」，用來形容少女的青春年齡（傳統指十三歲或早期青少年時期）。
explanation_english: Originally a spice (cardamom), the term is also used in literary/idiomatic contexts in '豆蔻年華' to describe a girl's early adolescent years (traditionally the age of thirteen).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面有啲荳蔻，可以用嚟煮咖哩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 dau6 kau3, ho2 ji5 jung6 lai4 zyu2 gaa3 lei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房裡有一些豆蔻，可以用來煮咖哩。
examples.english_sentence: There are some cardamom in the kitchen; they can be used to cook curry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家正值荳蔻年華，咩都想試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zing3 zik1 dau6 kau3 nin4 waa4, me1 dou1 soeng2 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她現在正值豆蔻年華，什麼都想試一試。
examples.english_sentence: She's in her early teens and wants to try everything.

mandarin_meaning: 豆蔻年華（指少女的青春時期，尤指十三四歲左右；泛指青春年華）
english_meaning: the age of youth; the prime of adolescence (especially a girl's early teens)
explanation_mandarin: 指少女的青春年華，傳統上多指十三、四歲左右，也可泛指青春時期或年輕人的美好歲月，常用於書面或詩意的表達。
explanation_english: Refers to the youthful years, traditionally a girl's early teens (around 13–14), and more generally the prime of youth. Often used in literary or poetic contexts to describe a young person's bloom of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家正值荳蔻年華，值得多啲關心同保護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zing3 zi6 dou6 kau3 nin4 waa4, zik1 dak1 do1 di1 gwaan1 sam1 tung4 bou2 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她現在正值豆蔻年華，值得更多的關心和保護。
examples.english_sentence: She is now in her teenage years and deserves more care and protection.

mandarin_meaning: 荷（hé）— 常指荷花、莲花，也用于复合词如荷包、荷叶；古义有承担、负荷之意。
english_meaning: Lotus (flower); also appears in compounds (e.g. lotus leaf, wallet/purse). Historically can mean to bear or carry (archaic).
explanation_mandarin: 「荷」作名詞時多指荷花或蓮花，並常見於複合詞（如荷花、荷葉、荷包）。作動詞為古用法，表示承擔或負荷，現代漢語中較少單獨使用，主要出現在詞語裡。
explanation_english: As a noun, 荷 usually refers to the lotus (flower) and appears in compounds such as lotus leaf or purse. As a verb it is an archaic term meaning to bear or carry; in modern usage it mainly occurs inside compounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去公園睇荷花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 tai2 ho4 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去公园看荷花。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the park to see the lotus flowers.

mandarin_meaning: 錢包、口袋；也指財力
english_meaning: purse; wallet; one's funds
explanation_mandarin: 指用來放錢或小物件的小包、錢包；在口語中也可泛指個人的財力或可支配的錢。
explanation_english: A small pouch or wallet used to carry money or small items; colloquially can refer to a person's financial resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近開支多，我個荷包好扁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 hoi1 zi1 do1, ngo5 go3 ho4 baau1 hou2 bin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近開銷多，我的錢包很扁。
examples.english_sentence: I've had a lot of expenses lately; my wallet is pretty thin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年，媽媽會將利是放喺荷包入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4, maa4 maa1 wui5 zoeng1 lei6 si6 fong3 hai2 ho4 baau1 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農曆新年，媽媽會把利是放在荷包裡。
examples.english_sentence: During Lunar New Year, mom puts the red packets into the purse.

mandarin_meaning: 小錢包；小皮夾（口語）
english_meaning: small coin purse; small wallet (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，指用來放零錢的小錢包或小皮夾。主要在香港粵語中使用，有時也可泛指零用錢，但通常指實物。
explanation_english: An informal Cantonese term for a small coin purse or wallet used to hold loose change. Commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese; occasionally used loosely to refer to pocket money but usually denotes the physical item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗個新荷包仔，用嚟放零錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 mai5 zo2 go3 san1 ho4 baau1 zai2, jung6 lei4 fong3 ling4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛買了一個新的荷包仔，用來放零錢。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a new coin purse to hold loose change.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）形容非常缺錢、囊中羞澀（相當於「身無分文」「口袋空空」）
english_meaning: To be penniless; to be broke (literally: the purse is hung upside down)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 口語詞語（形容詞性）
explanation_mandarin: 「荷包倒吊」原指錢包翻轉懸掛，喻指沒有錢或財務緊張，常用作口語化的形容。
explanation_english: Literally 'the purse is hung upside down.' A colloquial Cantonese idiom meaning to be out of money or financially strapped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個月買咗好多嘢，我而家荷包倒吊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyut6 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ho4 baau1 dou2 diu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月买了很多东西，我现在身无分文。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a lot of stuff this month; I'm broke now.

mandarin_meaning: 常替朋友付錢的人 / 被朋友當成錢包的人（俚語）
english_meaning: a friend who frequently pays for others / a friend who is treated as the group's wallet (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「荷包友」是廣東話俚語，字面意思是「錢包的朋友」。可指經常請客、替朋友付錢的那個人（帶有稱讚或戲稱意味），亦可用來指被朋友經常索取、當成錢源的人（帶有被利用的負面意味）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term literally meaning "wallet friend." It can refer to someone who often treats or covers expenses for friends (either praised or teased), or to a person who is frequently treated as the group's source of money (negative, implying being taken advantage of).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去食飯，阿明又係我哋嘅荷包友，佢請晒我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 sik6 faan6, aa3 ming4 jau6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 ho4 baau1 jau5, keoi5 ceng2 saai3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去吃飯，阿明又當我們的荷包友，他請客了。
examples.english_sentence: We went to dinner tonight and Ah Ming was our 'wallet friend' again—he treated all of us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日當朋友係你嘅荷包友，大家應該AA制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 dong3 pang4 jau5 hai6 nei5 ge3 ho4 baau1 jau5, daai6 gaa1 jing1 goi1 AA zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要總把朋友當成你的荷包友，大家應該各付各的（AA制）。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always treat friends as your personal wallet; we should split the bill.

jyutping: ho4 baau1 daa2 dou2 deng6 (疑似拼寫或用法不明，請確認)
mandarin_meaning: （疑似口語/俚語）錢包被掏空、花光錢、變得身無分文
english_meaning: Likely slang: one's wallet is emptied; to be broke after spending a lot
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語/俚語，動詞短語（疑似）
explanation_mandarin: 此短語並非常見書面用語；字面含義與「荷包」(錢包) 有關，推測用來形容花費過多導致錢包空了或變窮。由於詞形不太常見，可能是地區性俚語或拼寫/輸入錯誤，建議確認原始來源。
explanation_english: This expression is not a widely attested written phrase. Literally involves 'wallet' (荷包); likely a colloquial/slang way to say one has emptied their wallet or become broke after spending. Because the exact form is uncommon, it may be regional slang or a spelling/typing variant — please confirm the original form or context for a precise analysis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日去買嘢，最後荷包打倒掟，連半個錢都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 maai5 je5, zeoi3 hau6 ho4 baau1 daa2 dou2 deng6, lin4 bun3 go3 cin2 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是去买东西，结果钱包被掏空，连一分钱都没有。
examples.english_sentence: I keep shopping and in the end my wallet got emptied; I don't have a single cent left.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）形容钱包空了或破产，没钱可用
english_meaning: Cantonese slang meaning 'to be extremely broke' (literally 'wallet cirrhosis')
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俚语，字面上把“荷包”（钱包）比作“肝硬化”，夸张地形容因花钱太多或遭遇花费而导致没有钱、口袋空的状态。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression that literally says 'wallet cirrhosis.' It humorously exaggerates that one's wallet has been so damaged by spending that it is 'cirrhotic' — i.e., one is very broke or financially drained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買咗咁多嘢，依家我真係荷包肝硬化，今晚要煮剩飯食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 zo2 gam2 do1 je5, ji1 gaa1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ho4 baau1 gon1 ngaang6 faa3, gam1 maan5 jiu3 zyu2 sing4 faan6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买了这么多东西，现在我真的是钱包空了（俗称“荷包肝硬化”），今晚得吃剩饭。
examples.english_sentence: I bought so many things, now I'm really broke (literally 'wallet cirrhosis'); I'll have to eat leftovers tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 荷包蛋
english_meaning: fried egg (sunny-side up)
explanation_mandarin: 将鸡蛋打入锅中煎，蛋白凝固而蛋黄通常保持完整或半熟，外形像小荷包，常指“sunny-side up”式的煎蛋。
explanation_english: An egg fried on one side so the white sets while the yolk remains whole and often runny; commonly called a sunny-side up egg.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日朝早想食荷包蛋配多士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 ziu1zou2 soeng2 sik6 ho4 baau1 daan6 pui3 do1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天早上想吃荷包蛋配吐司。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a fried egg with toast for breakfast tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 荷塘（hé táng）：种有荷花或长有荷叶的池塘或水域
english_meaning: lotus pond; a pond or pool where lotuses grow
explanation_mandarin: 指种植或生长有荷花、荷叶的池塘或水域，常用于描写自然景物或园林景观。
explanation_english: A pond or pool in which lotuses (and their leaves) grow; commonly used to describe a scenic or garden feature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天我哋去荷塘睇荷花，景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 ho4 tong4 tai2 ho4 faa1, ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天我们去荷塘看荷花，景色很美。
examples.english_sentence: In summer we go to the lotus pond to see the lotus flowers; the scenery is very beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 荷官（賭場發牌員、莊面工作人員）
english_meaning: croupier; casino dealer
explanation_mandarin: 指在賭場負責發牌、管理賭桌、處理投注和維持賭檯秩序的工作人員，即 croupier 或 dealer。
explanation_english: Refers to the casino staff who deal cards, manage table games, handle bets, and maintain order at the table — a croupier or dealer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲荷官態度好專業，發牌又快又準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ho4 gun1 taai3 dou6 hou2 zyun1 jip6, faat3 paai4 jau6 faai3 jau6 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些荷官態度很專業，發牌又快又準。
examples.english_sentence: The croupiers were very professional; they dealt quickly and accurately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賭場入面嘅荷官要接受嚴格嘅培訓先可以上崗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou2 coeng4 jap6 min6 ge3 ho4 gun1 jiu3 zip3 sau6 jim4 gaak3 ge3 pui4 fan3 sin1 ho2 ji5 soeng5 gong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 賭場裡面的荷官必須接受嚴格的培訓才能上崗。
examples.english_sentence: Croupiers in casinos must undergo rigorous training before they can start working.

mandarin_meaning: （可能作）人名或非標準用語；普通話讀作hé huì
english_meaning: Likely a personal name or non-standard term; pronounced roughly 'Hehui' in Mandarin
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 专有名词（人名）/ 非标准词
explanation_mandarin: 「荷惠」並非一個通行的廣東話詞彙，常見情況是作為人名或書面拼寫；字面上兩字分別為「荷」（粵：ho4，普通話：hé）和「惠」（粵：wai6，普通話：huì）。如果在語境中出現，通常要視為姓名或需要向說話者確認其含義。
explanation_english: “荷惠” is not a common Cantonese lexical item. It is most likely used as a personal name or a non-standard/erroneous written form. The characters read in Cantonese as ho4 wai6 (Mandarin hé huì). In context it should be treated as a name or its meaning should be confirmed with the speaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 荷惠係我阿姨嘅名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho4 wai6 hai6 ngo5 aa3 ji4 ge3 ming4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 荷惠是我阿姨的名字。
examples.english_sentence: Hehui is my aunt's name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰個「荷惠」係咪人名？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 go3 "ho4 wai6" hai6 mai6 jan4 ming4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的那个“荷惠”是人名吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is the 'Hehui' you mentioned a person's name?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我未聽過'荷惠'作爲常用詞，可能係個名或者寫錯字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mei6 teng1 gwo3 'ho4 wai6' zok3 wai4 soeng4 jung6 ci4, ho2 nang4 hai6 go3 ming4 waak6 ze2 se2 co3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没听过'荷惠'作为常用词，可能是个人名或者写错字。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't heard 'Hehui' used as a common word; it might be a personal name or a misspelling.

mandarin_meaning: 好莱坞（指美国洛杉矶的电影区及电影工业）
english_meaning: Hollywood (the district in Los Angeles and the U.S. film industry)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语对英语“Hollywood”的音译，通常指美国洛杉矶的好莱坞地区及由此衍生的电影工业，有时也用来泛指美国商业大片或电影界。
explanation_english: A Cantonese transliteration of 'Hollywood'. It refers to the Hollywood district in Los Angeles and, by extension, the U.S. film industry or big commercial films.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜會去荷李活拍戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 ho4 lei5 wut6 paak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个礼拜我要去好莱坞拍电影。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Hollywood to shoot a film next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 荷李活出產好多大製作嘅電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho4 lei5 wut6 ceot1 caan2 hou2 do1 daai6 zai3 zok3 ge3 din6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好莱坞出产很多大制作的电影。
examples.english_sentence: Hollywood produces many big-budget films.

mandarin_meaning: 荷枪实弹（帶著武器和實彈；比喻準備充足、裝備齊全或戒備嚴密）
english_meaning: Literally 'carrying guns with live ammunition'; describes being armed with real weapons and bullets. Figuratively: well-armed, fully equipped, heavily armed, or on high alert/fully prepared.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作動詞或形容詞）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (can be used as a verb or adjective)
explanation_mandarin: 原指持槍並帶實彈，表示實際武裝；引申為某人或某組織準備充足、裝備齊全或戒備嚴密。
explanation_english: Originally refers to carrying firearms with live ammunition. Extended use describes someone or a group that is thoroughly equipped, heavily armed, or fully prepared/alert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方話嫌疑人荷槍實彈，好危險，叫附近居民疏散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waa6 jim4 ji4 jan4 ho4 coeng1 sat6 daan6, hou2 ngai4 him2, giu3 fu6 gan6 geoi1 man4 so1 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方說嫌疑人荷槍實彈，很危險，要求附近居民疏散。
examples.english_sentence: The police said the suspect was armed with live ammunition; it was very dangerous and nearby residents were asked to evacuate.

mandarin_meaning: 荷尔蒙（激素）
english_meaning: hormone; chemical messenger produced by glands that regulates physiology and behavior
explanation_mandarin: 由腺体分泌的化学物质，调节生理功能和行为，例如性激素、甲状腺激素等。常用于描述影响情绪或性欲的生理因素。
explanation_english: Chemical substances secreted by glands that regulate physiological functions and behavior (e.g., sex hormones, thyroid hormones). Often used to refer to biological factors that affect mood or libido.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 青春期嘅時候，荷爾蒙會變得好活躍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ceon1 kei4 ge3 si4 hau6, ho4 ji5 mung4 wui5 bin3 dak1 hou2 wut6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 青春期的时候，荷尔蒙会变得很活跃。
examples.english_sentence: During puberty, hormones become very active.

mandarin_meaning: 荷花 / 莲花 (héhuā / liánhuā)
english_meaning: lotus (flower); lotus blossom
explanation_mandarin: 荷花是多年生的水生植物的花朵，常见于池塘、湖泊和淤泥中，花瓣美丽，常被用来象征纯洁、高洁和出淤泥而不染。
explanation_english: The lotus is the flower of an aquatic perennial plant, commonly found in ponds and lakes. It has showy petals and is often used as a symbol of purity and nobility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有好靚嘅荷花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 leng3 ge3 ho4 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有很漂亮的荷花。
examples.english_sentence: There are beautiful lotus flowers in the park.

mandarin_meaning: 荷叶 (hé yè) — 莲花的叶子，常用于烹饪（如荷叶饭、糯米鸡）或作为中药材。
english_meaning: lotus leaf — the leaf of the lotus plant, used in cooking (e.g., lotus-leaf-wrapped dishes) and in traditional medicine.
explanation_mandarin: 荷葉是蓮花的葉子，可以指植物的葉片，也常被用來包裹食物或入藥。
explanation_english: The leaf of the lotus plant. Refers to the plant part and is commonly used to wrap food or in traditional medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 荷葉可以用嚟包飯，或者用喺中藥入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho4 jip6 ho2 ji5 jung6 lai4 baau1 faan6, waak6 ze2 jung6 hai2 zung1 joek6 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 荷叶可以用来包饭，或者用于中药里。
examples.english_sentence: Lotus leaves can be used to wrap food, or used in traditional medicine.

mandarin_meaning: 荷兰（Hélán，歐洲國家）
english_meaning: The Netherlands (Holland)
explanation_mandarin: 指位於西歐的國家荷蘭（全名荷蘭王國）。日常語境中常用「荷蘭」或「Holland」互換，但嚴格來說「Holland」僅指荷蘭的兩個省份。
explanation_english: Refers to the country the Netherlands (Kingdom of the Netherlands) in Western Europe. Commonly called Holland, though strictly speaking Holland denotes only two provinces within the Netherlands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去荷蘭旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 ho4 laan4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去荷兰旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the Netherlands next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 荷蘭係世界上著名嘅鬱金香產地之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho4 laan4 hai6 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 zoek3 ming4 ge3 wat1 gam1 hoeng1 caan2 dei6 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 荷兰是世界上著名的郁金香产地之一。
examples.english_sentence: The Netherlands is one of the world's famous tulip-producing regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嚴格嚟講，荷蘭同Holland唔完全一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jim4 gaak3 lai4 gong2, ho4 laan4 tung4 Holland m4 jyun4 cyun4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 严格来说，‘荷兰’和‘Holland’并不完全相同。
examples.english_sentence: Strictly speaking, 'the Netherlands' and 'Holland' are not exactly the same.

mandarin_meaning: 荷兰挞（西式的一种烘焙甜点／西式撻类糕点）
english_meaning: Dutch tart (a Western-style baked tart/pastry)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粤语中，『荷蘭撻』通常指西式的撻類烘焙甜點，外殼為酥皮或脆皮，內餡可為卡士達、果餡或其他甜餡，類似西式蛋撻或水果撻。常見於麵包店或西餅店。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '荷蘭撻' refers to a Western-style tart/pastry commonly sold in bakeries — a crust (shortcrust or puff) filled with custard, fruit, or other sweet fillings. It is similar to other Western tarts and sold in Hong Kong bakeries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餅店啲荷蘭撻好好味，買一個嚟試下。
