explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，用來形容技術差或經驗不足、做事沒效率或沒用的人，類似「菜鳥」或「新手」。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang for someone inexperienced, incompetent, or useless—similar to "noob" or "rookie."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一個菜腳，咩都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 coi3 goek3, me1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的是個菜鳥，什麼都不會做。
examples.english_sentence: He really is a noob; he can't do anything.

mandarin_meaning: 沒膽量 / 膽小 / 懦弱的人
english_meaning: coward; timid; lacking courage
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，用來形容一個人膽量小、懦弱或不敢面對困難和挑戰。
explanation_english: Colloquial slang used to describe someone who lacks courage, is timid, or unwilling to face difficulties or challenges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁菜膽，連上台講嘢都唔敢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 coi3 daam2, lin4 soeng5 toi4 gong2 je5 dou1 m4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這麼沒膽量，連上台講話都不敢。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a coward; he doesn't even dare to speak on stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊同事話我菜膽，但其實我只係唔鍾意冒險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 tung4 si6 waa6 ngo5 coi3 daam2, daan6 kei4 sat6 ngo5 zi2 hai6 m4 zung1 ji3 mou6 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前同事說我沒膽量，但其實我只是沒喜歡冒險。
examples.english_sentence: My former colleague called me a coward, but actually I just don't like taking risks.

mandarin_meaning: 菜心（càixīn），一种常见的叶用蔬菜，尤指可食用的嫩茎和叶
english_meaning: Choy sum (Chinese flowering cabbage) — the tender stems and leaves of a leafy Chinese vegetable commonly used in Cantonese cooking
explanation_mandarin: 菜芯是粤式烹饪中常见的一种绿叶蔬菜，通常指菜心的嫩茎和叶，常用于清炒或蒜蓉等做法。'菜芯'与'菜心'写法上可互换。
explanation_english: A common leafy vegetable in Cantonese cuisine (choy sum). It refers to the tender stems and leaves and is often stir-fried or cooked with garlic. The characters 菜芯 and 菜心 are often used interchangeably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚買咗啲菜芯返嚟炒蒜蓉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 di1 coi3 sam1 faan1 lei4 caau2 syun3 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚买了一些菜心回来炒蒜蓉。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some choy sum tonight to stir-fry with garlic.

mandarin_meaning: 1) 花椰菜（蔬菜）；2) 俚语，指生殖器疣（尖锐湿疣）
english_meaning: 1) Cauliflower (the vegetable); 2) Slang for genital warts (condyloma acuminatum)
explanation_mandarin: （1）一种常见蔬菜，即花椰菜。 （2）口语或俚语用法，指生长在生殖器部位的疣，医学上为“尖锐湿疣”。
explanation_english: 1) A common vegetable, cauliflower. 2) Colloquial/slang usage referring to genital warts (medically: condyloma acuminatum).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我煮菜花炒牛肉，幫手切菜啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 zyu2 coi3 faa1 caau2 ngau4 juk6, bong1 sau2 cit3 coi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我煮花椰菜炒牛肉，你幫忙切菜吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm cooking cauliflower stir-fried with beef tonight — help me chop the vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢生咗菜花，要去檢查同治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 saang1 zo2 coi3 faa1, jiu3 heoi3 gim2 caa4 tung4 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他长了菜花，需要去检查和治疗。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he developed 'cauliflower' (genital warts) and needs to be examined and treated.

mandarin_meaning: 菜苗；（口語）菜鳥、新手
english_meaning: vegetable seedling; (colloquial) newbie, novice
explanation_mandarin: 本义指蔬菜的幼苗、幼芽；在口语中也可引申为对新手、經驗不足者的俗称，类似“菜鸟”。
explanation_english: Originally refers to young vegetable seedlings or shoots. Colloquially it can be used metaphorically to mean a newbie or inexperienced person (similar to "noob").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲菜苗生得好靚，要小心澆水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 coi3 miu4 saang1 dak1 hou2 leng3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 gaau1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菜苗长得很好，要小心浇水。
examples.english_sentence: The vegetable seedlings are growing nicely; be careful when watering them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係菜苗，做嘢唔熟，要有人教佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 coi3 miu4, zou6 je5 m4 suk6, jiu3 jau5 jan4 gaau3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个菜鸟，做事不熟练，需要有人教他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a newbie; he's not skilled yet and needs someone to teach him.

mandarin_meaning: 蔬菜的莢果（如豆莢、豌豆莢）
english_meaning: vegetable pod (e.g., pea pod or bean pod)
explanation_mandarin: 指蔬菜上包住種子的莢，常用來指豆類或豌豆等的莢。
explanation_english: Refers to the pod of a vegetable that contains seeds, commonly used for pods of beans, peas, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗啲菜莢，準備同肉片一齊炒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 di1 coi3 gaap3, zeon2 bei6 tung4 juk6 pin3 jat1 cai4 caau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天買了些菜莢，準備和肉片一起炒。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some vegetable pods today and plan to stir-fry them with slices of meat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲菜莢係豌豆嘅，嫩到好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 coi3 gaap3 hai6 wun1 dau6 ge3, non6 dou3 hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些菜莢是豌豆的，嫩得很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: These pods are pea pods — they're so tender and very tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 一种蔬菜（方言或罕见用法）
english_meaning: a (rare/archaic) term for a leafy vegetable; a regional/rare name for certain greens
explanation_mandarin: 「菜薳」為廣東話中較罕見或地方性的詞彙，用來指稱某種葉類蔬菜。現代口語中不常使用，通常可視為「蔬菜」或「菜心、青菜」的泛稱或方言名稱。
explanation_english: “菜薳” is a rare or regional Cantonese term referring to a leafy vegetable. It is not commonly used in modern everyday speech and can be considered a dialectal or archaic name broadly meaning greens or leafy vegetables (similar to general terms like 'vegetable' or specific greens such as choy sum).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度買到新鮮嘅菜薳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 maai5 dou3 san1 sin1 ge3 coi3 wun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里可以买到新鲜的菜薳。
examples.english_sentence: You can buy fresh caiwan (leafy greens) here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講呢個名係舊時村裡對某種青菜嘅叫法，好少人用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ni1 go3 ming4 hai6 gau6 si4 cyun1 leoi5 deoi3 mau5 zung2 ceng1 coi3 ge3 giu3 faat3, hou2 siu2 jan4 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这个名字是旧时村里对某种青菜的叫法，很少人用。
examples.english_sentence: He said this name was an old village term for a kind of green; few people use it today.

mandarin_meaning: 菜譜／菜谱（càipǔ）——菜單或記載菜餚做法的書或清單
english_meaning: menu; cookbook; recipe book; a list of dishes or recipes
explanation_mandarin: 「菜譜」可指餐廳的菜單，也可指記錄菜餚材料與做法的食譜或菜譜集。
explanation_english: Refers to a menu at a restaurant or a cookbook/recipe list that records dishes, ingredients, and cooking methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下呢本菜譜，有冇啲啱你口味嘅菜？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 ni1 bun2 coi3 pou2, jau5 mou5 di1 aam1 nei5 hau2 mei6 ge3 coi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看這本菜譜，有沒有合你口味的菜？
examples.english_sentence: Look through this menu/cookbook — are there any dishes that suit your taste?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想整新菜，要參考下菜譜上嘅做法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 zing2 san1 coi3, jiu3 caam1 haau2 haa5 coi3 pou2 soeng6 ge3 zou6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想做新菜，要參考菜譜上的做法。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to cook a new dish, refer to the recipes in the cookbook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 餐廳有電子菜譜，可以喺枱上掃QR碼睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caan1 teng1 jau5 din6 zi2 coi3 pou2, ho2 ji5 hai2 toi2 soeng6 sou3 QR maa5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐廳有電子菜譜，可以在桌上掃描 QR 碼查看。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant has a digital menu — you can scan the QR code on the table to view it.

mandarin_meaning: 很菜／非常不擅長（俚語）
english_meaning: extremely bad/incompetent (slang); a total noob
explanation_mandarin: 「菜遠」是香港粵語俚語，用來形容一個人在某方面非常差、很沒有經驗或能力，類似「很菜」「菜到不行」。
explanation_english: “菜遠” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used to describe someone who is extremely bad or inexperienced at something — essentially a strong way to call someone a noob or incompetent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打機咁差，真係菜遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 gei1 gam2 caa1, zan1 hai6 coi3 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打遊戲這麼差，真是菜到不行。
examples.english_sentence: You're so bad at gaming — such a noob.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係新手，打機成日輸，真係菜遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 san1 sau2, daa2 gei1 seng4 jat6 syu1, zan1 hai6 coi3 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是新手，打遊戲總是輸，真是太菜了。
examples.english_sentence: He's a newbie and always loses at games — really hopeless.

mandarin_meaning: 白蘿蔔 / 蘿蔔
english_meaning: daikon; white radish
explanation_mandarin: 「菜頭」是廣東話裡常用來指白蘿蔔的詞，也可在日常烹飪語境中使用（如煲菜頭湯）。在香港口語中屬於常見的食材稱呼。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "菜頭" commonly refers to the white radish (daikon). It is used in everyday cooking contexts (e.g. making radish soup) and is a common, colloquial name for this vegetable in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚買咗啲菜頭，打算煲菜頭湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 di1 coi3 tau4, daa2 syun3 bou1 coi3 tau4 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚买了一些白萝卜，打算煲萝卜汤。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some daikon tonight and plan to make radish soup.

mandarin_meaning: 瑣碎的事；無關緊要的小事（類似「雞毛蒜皮」）
english_meaning: trivial matters; petty things; small, insignificant details
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來形容一些瑣碎、微不足道的事情或小事，通常含有不值得重視或不想理會的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression referring to trivial or petty matters — small, insignificant issues not worth much attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲菜頭菜尾唔使理佢，唔值得為呢啲小事爭吵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 coi3 tau4 coi3 mei5 m4 sai2 lei5 keoi5, m4 zik1 dak1 wai6 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 zang1 cau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別理那些瑣碎的事，不值得為這些小事爭吵。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother with those trivial things; they're not worth arguing over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做家務嗰啲菜頭菜尾最令人煩厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 gaa1 mou6 go2 di1 coi3 tau4 coi3 mei5 zeoi3 ling6 jan4 faan4 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做家務那些瑣碎的事最令人厭煩。
examples.english_sentence: Those trivial chores around the house are the most annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 剩菜；菜餚的殘渣（廣東話口語／書面偏古）
english_meaning: leftover dishes; food scraps (colloquial/archaic Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「菜餔」在廣東話中通常指剩下的菜或食物殘渣。此詞帶有口語或古舊色彩，有時在口語中也可引申為貶義地形容無用的人或物，視語境而定。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '菜餔' typically denotes leftover vegetables or food scraps. The term has a colloquial or somewhat archaic tone. In some contexts it can be used figuratively and pejoratively to describe a useless person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟菜係咪菜餔？我唔想食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 coi3 hai6 mai6 coi3 buk6? ngo5 m4 soeng2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盤菜是剩菜嗎？我不想吃。
examples.english_sentence: Is this plate of vegetables leftover? I don't want to eat it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日食菜餔，唔會自己煮嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sik6 coi3 buk6, m4 wui5 zi6 gei2 zyu2 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常吃剩菜，不會自己煮東西吃。
examples.english_sentence: He often eats leftovers and doesn't cook for himself.

mandarin_meaning: 菜肴 (càiyáo)
english_meaning: dishes; prepared dishes served in a meal
explanation_mandarin: 指在一頓飯中烹調、擺盤並供人食用的各種菜品，通常用於書面或較正式的語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the various cooked dishes prepared and served in a meal; a somewhat formal term for dishes or culinary preparations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢整咗好多精緻嘅菜餚畀我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing2 zo2 hou2 do1 zing1 zi3 ge3 coi3 jiu4 bei2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了很多精緻的菜肴給我們。
examples.english_sentence: He made many delicate dishes for us.

mandarin_meaning: 菜馆 (小饭馆、餐厅)
english_meaning: eatery; small restaurant
explanation_mandarin: 供人吃饭的地方，通常指规模较小的饭馆或餐厅，多以家常菜为主。
explanation_english: A place where people eat; typically refers to a small restaurant or eatery, often serving home-style dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去嗰間新開嘅菜館食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 go2 gaan1 san1 hoi1 ge3 coi3 gun2 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去那家新开的菜馆吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat at that newly opened restaurant tonight.

jyutping: coi3 hoeng1 bat1 cau4 hong6 zai2 sam1
mandarin_meaning: 好貨不怕巷子深（好東西不怕放在深巷，只要品質好，自會有人發現或購買）
english_meaning: Good products (or talents) will attract people even if they are in an obscure place; quality speaks for itself.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻品質好或有實力的東西、人才，不用過度宣傳或擔心沒人知道，最終會被發現和接受。
explanation_english: A proverb meaning that good goods or talents don't need heavy promotion — their quality will attract attention or customers even if they're hidden away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅手工咁好，唔洗擔心，菜香不愁巷仔深，遲啲自然會有人嚟買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 sau2 gung1 gam2 hou2, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, coi3 hoeng1 bat1 cau4 hong6 zai2 sam1, ci4 di1 zi6 jin4 wui5 jau5 jan4 lai4 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的手工这么好，不用担心，好货不怕巷子深，迟早会有人来买。
examples.english_sentence: Your craftsmanship is so good, don't worry — good products don't fear being in a deep alley; sooner or later someone will come to buy them.

mandarin_meaning: 菠，常见于合成词“菠萝”，表示凤梨（pineapple）；单字较少单独使用，也常作音译用字。
english_meaning: A character used mainly in compounds such as '菠蘿' (pineapple). Rarely used alone; also used as a transliteration character.
explanation_mandarin: 漢字，多用于合成詞（如菠蘿/菠萝），表示鳳梨；在粤語中讀作 bo1，單字獨立使用不多，常見於食品名稱或音譯詞中。
explanation_english: A Chinese character most commonly seen in words like '菠蘿' (pineapple). Pronounced bo1 in Cantonese. It is rarely used alone and often appears in food names or as part of transliterations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個菠蘿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 bo1 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个菠萝。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a pineapple.

mandarin_meaning: 菠菜（绿叶蔬菜）；在网络语境中常被用作“博彩/赌博”的委婉说法
english_meaning: spinach (a leafy green vegetable); colloquially used online as a euphemism for gambling
explanation_mandarin: 菠菜是一種常見的綠葉蔬菜，富含鐵和維生素。在部分網路語境中，因與“博彩”發音接近，菠菜也被用作指代賭博的委婉語（俚語用法）。
explanation_english: Spinach is a common leafy green vegetable rich in iron and vitamins. In some internet/colloquial contexts it is also used as a euphemism for gambling due to phonetic similarity with words meaning betting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚買咗菠菜，準備煮湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 bo1 coi3, zeon2 bei6 zyu2 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚买了菠菜，准备煮汤。
examples.english_sentence: I bought spinach tonight and am going to make soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度玩菠菜，輸晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 waan2 bo1 coi3, syu1 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那裡賭博，輸光了錢。
examples.english_sentence: He's always gambling there and has lost all his money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟炒菠菜好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 caau2 bo1 coi3 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盤炒菠菜很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This plate of stir-fried spinach is delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 菠萝 / 凤梨（熱帶水果）
english_meaning: pineapple
explanation_mandarin: 指一種熱帶水果，果肉多汁且甜；在香港常稱為「菠蘿」。另外「菠蘿包」是以其外形命名的麵包，但不一定含菠蘿。
explanation_english: Refers to the tropical fruit pineapple, with juicy and sweet flesh; commonly called "菠蘿" in Cantonese. Note: "pineapple bun" (菠蘿包) is named for its appearance and does not necessarily contain pineapple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一個菠蘿返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 bo1 lo4 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一個菠蘿回家。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a pineapple home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個菠蘿好甜，好多汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bo1 lo4 hou2 tim4, hou2 do1 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個菠蘿很甜，很多汁。
examples.english_sentence: This pineapple is very sweet and juicy.

mandarin_meaning: 菠蘿包夾冰（如冷牛油或雪糕）
english_meaning: pineapple bun filled with something cold (e.g. a slab of chilled butter or ice cream)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俗稱，用於指將菠蘿包夾入冷的餡料，例如一塊冷牛油（類似「冰火菠蘿包」）或夾雪糕的吃法。屬於茶餐廳或街頭小吃的做法，有時用法可涵蓋不同冷餡變體。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese term for a pineapple bun served with a cold filling — typically a slab of chilled butter (as in the 'ice-fire' variant) or sometimes ice cream. It's a common cha chaan teng/street snack and the term can refer to these different cold-filled versions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 茶餐廳有賣菠蘿冰，入面夾咗一塊凍牛油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 caan1 teng1 jau5 maai6 bo1 lo4 bing1, jap6 min6 gaap3 zo2 jat1 faai3 dung3 ngau4 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 茶餐廳有賣菠蘿冰，裡面夾了一塊冷牛油。
examples.english_sentence: The cha chaan teng sells 菠蘿冰 — a pineapple bun with a slab of cold butter inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天我鍾意食菠蘿冰，菠蘿包夾雪糕好消暑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 bo1 lo4 bing1, bo1 lo4 baau1 gaap3 syut3 gou1 hou2 siu1 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天我喜歡吃菠蘿冰，菠蘿包夾著雪糕很消暑。
examples.english_sentence: In summer I like 菠蘿冰 — a pineapple bun filled with ice cream; it's very refreshing.

mandarin_meaning: 菠萝包（香港/廣東常見的甜麵包，表面有脆甜的餅皮，形狀像菠蘿）
english_meaning: pineapple bun (a sweet Hong Kong/Guangdong-style bun with a crunchy, sugary crust that resembles a pineapple)
explanation_mandarin: 一種源自廣東/香港的甜麵包，表面有一層酥脆且略帶甜味的餅皮（看起來像菠蘿），常在茶餐廳或麵包店販售。夾牛油時俗稱「菠蘿油」。
explanation_english: A sweet bun popular in Hong Kong and Guangdong featuring a crunchy, sweet crust on top that resembles a pineapple. Commonly sold in cha chaan tengs and bakeries. When served with a slab of butter it's often called 'pineapple bun with butter' (菠蘿油).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早喺茶餐廳食咗個熱辣辣嘅菠蘿包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 sik6 zo2 go3 jit6 laat6 laat6 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早上在茶餐廳吃了一個熱騰騰的菠蘿包。
examples.english_sentence: I ate a piping-hot pineapple bun at the cha chaan teng this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要一個菠蘿包，加牛油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 jat1 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1, gaa1 ngau4 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要一個菠蘿包，加牛油。
examples.english_sentence: I want a pineapple bun with butter.

mandarin_meaning: 手榴弹（俗稱，因外形像菠萝而得名）
english_meaning: a hand grenade (colloquially called a "pineapple grenade" because of its segmented exterior)
explanation_mandarin: 俚語/俗稱，用來指外型像菠蘿的手榴彈，通常指破片手榴彈。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for a type of fragmentation hand grenade whose segmented casing resembles a pineapple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方發現有人身上帶住一枚菠蘿彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 fat3 jin6 jau5 jan4 san1 soeng6 daai3 zyu6 jat1 mui4 bo1 lo4 daan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方發現有人身上攜帶一枚菠蘿彈。
examples.english_sentence: The police discovered someone was carrying a pineapple grenade on their person.

mandarin_meaning: 菠萝包夹牛油（菠萝包加奶油）
english_meaning: pineapple bun with a slab of butter (bolo yau)
explanation_mandarin: 菠蘿油是香港常見的小吃，指在菠蘿包中夾上一大塊牛油（奶油）後食用。菠蘿包的名稱來自包頂酥皮的紋理像菠蘿表皮，實際並不含菠蘿。通常在茶餐廳或麵包店作早餐或下午茶。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong snack consisting of a pineapple bun (bolo bao) with a thick slice of butter inside. The bun is called 'pineapple' for its crust pattern, not because it contains pineapple. Commonly eaten for breakfast or as a snack at cha chaan tengs and bakeries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早喺茶餐廳食咗個菠蘿油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1zou2 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 sik6 zo2 go3 bo1 lo4 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上在茶餐廳吃了一個菠蘿油。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I had a pineapple bun with butter at a cha chaan teng.

mandarin_meaning: 菠蘿包上面那層酥脆的糖皮或外層
english_meaning: The crunchy, sweet crust/topping on a Hong Kong-style pineapple bun (bolo bao).
explanation_mandarin: 指香港菠蘿包表面那層呈龜裂狀、帶甜味且酥脆的蓋狀糖皮，常用於描述麵包的外層口感或外觀。
explanation_english: Refers to the cracked, sweet, crunchy topping on the surface of a Hong Kong-style pineapple bun (bolo bao). Used to describe the bun's crust in bakeries or casual conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗個菠蘿包，最鍾意嗰層菠蘿蓋，好脆！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1, zeoi3 zung1 ji3 go2 cang4 bo1 lo4 goi3, hou2 ceoi3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天買了個菠蘿包，最喜歡那層菠蘿蓋，非常酥脆！
examples.english_sentence: I bought a pineapple bun today; I love the top crust — it's so crunchy!

mandarin_meaning: 菠萝蜜（波罗蜜），热带水果
english_meaning: jackfruit
explanation_mandarin: 菠萝蜜（學名 Artocarpus heterophyllus）是一種熱帶大型水果，果肉多、香甜，常見於東南亞及熱帶地區，可鮮食或入菜。
explanation_english: Jackfruit (Artocarpus heterophyllus) is a large tropical fruit with many sweet, fragrant fleshy bulbs; commonly found in Southeast Asia, eaten fresh or used in cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食菠蘿蜜，果肉好香又甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 bo1 lo4 mat6, gwo2 juk6 hou2 hoeng1 jau6 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡吃菠蘿蜜，果肉很香又甜。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating jackfruit; the flesh is very fragrant and sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢檔街市嘅菠蘿蜜好新鮮，買一個返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dong3 gaai1 si5 ge3 bo1 lo4 mat6 hou2 san1 sin1, maai5 jat1 go3 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這攤街市的菠蘿蜜很新鮮，買一個回家。
examples.english_sentence: The jackfruit at this market stall is very fresh; I'll buy one to take home.

mandarin_meaning: 菠萝钉（字面意思：釘子的釘頭或外觀帶有類似菠蘿紋路的花紋；多為五金/裝飾用途的釘子，作為俗稱時較少見）
english_meaning: pineapple nail (literally): a nail whose head has a textured/patterned surface resembling a pineapple; typically a hardware or decorative nail. The term is chiefly literal and not a common idiom.
explanation_mandarin: 「菠蘿釘」主要是對某類釘子（釘頭表面有花紋或紋理）的稱呼，用於五金或裝飾用途。此詞作為俚語或成語的用法並不常見，通常按字面理解。
explanation_english: “菠蘿釘” is primarily a literal name for a type of nail whose head bears a textured or patterned surface (resembling a pineapple). It is used in hardware or decorative contexts. The term is not a common idiom or slang and is generally taken literally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅，用嗰啲菠蘿釘把木板釘實啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2, jung6 go2 di1 bo1 lo4 ding1 baa2 muk6 baan2 ding1 sat6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 師傅，用那些菠蘿釘把木板釘牢。
examples.english_sentence: Boss, use those pineapple nails to secure the wooden boards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 五金舖有賣菠蘿釘，一包十支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng5 gam1 pou3 jau5 maai6 bo1 lo4 ding1, jat1 baau1 sap6 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 五金店有賣菠萝钉，一包十支。
examples.english_sentence: The hardware store sells pineapple nails — ten in a pack.

mandarin_meaning: 菠萝鸡 / 凤梨鸡（以菠萝与鸡肉同煮或同炒的菜肴，常带酸甜口味）
english_meaning: pineapple chicken (a dish of chicken cooked with pineapple, often sweet-and-sour)
explanation_mandarin: 一道中式菜餚，通常指以菠蘿（鳳梨）與雞肉同炒或同燴，常帶酸甜口味；有時也指將雞肉放入掏空的菠蘿中烹調的擺盤做法。
explanation_english: A Chinese dish where chicken is cooked with pineapple (often in a sweet-and-sour style); it can also refer to a presentation where chicken is served inside a hollowed pineapple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚叫一份菠蘿雞啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 giu3 jat1 fan6 bo1 lo4 gai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚叫一份菠蘿雞吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's order a pineapple chicken tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菠蘿雞好好味，酸酸甜甜幾開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 bo1 lo4 gai1 hou2 hou2 mei6, syun1 syun1 tim4 tim4 gei2 hoi1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的菠蘿雞很美味，酸酸甜甜很開胃。
examples.english_sentence: The pineapple chicken at this restaurant is delicious — the sweet-and-sour flavor is very appetizing.

mandarin_meaning: 菠萝鸡（以菠萝和鸡肉为主的菜肴，通常带有酸甜或咕噜类酱汁）
english_meaning: pineapple chicken (a dish of chicken cooked with pineapple, often in a sweet-and-sour or sweet sauce)
explanation_mandarin: 一道常見的中式/粤菜菜肴，通常以雞肉為主，配菠蘿並以酸甜或咕嚕式醬汁烹調，口味偏甜酸，餐廳和家常菜均常見。
explanation_english: A common Chinese/Cantonese dish made with chicken and pineapple, typically cooked in a sweet-and-sour or similar sauce. It is found in restaurants and home cooking and has a sweet-tangy flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚返屋企食唔食菠蘿雞呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 faan1 uk1 kei2 sik6 m4 sik6 bo1 lo4 gai1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚回家吃菠萝鸡吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are we having pineapple chicken at home tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲菠蘿雞好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 bo1 lo4 gai1 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菠萝鸡很出名。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's pineapple chicken is famous.

mandarin_meaning: 麻子；凹凸不平的痘疤（臉上的痘坑）
english_meaning: pockmarks; pitted acne scars (pitted skin on the face)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容臉部或皮膚表面凹陷、像菠蘿表面一樣的痘疤或麻點，可作名詞或形容詞使用。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe pitted scars or bumps on the skin that resemble the surface of a pineapple. Used as a noun or adjective to refer to pockmarked skin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個面有啲菠蘿麻，好難化妝掩飾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 min6 jau5 di1 bo1 lo4 maa4, hou2 naan4 faa3 zong1 jim2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的臉上有些麻子，很難用化妝掩飾。
examples.english_sentence: They have some pockmarks on their face; it's hard to cover with makeup.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見字，現代漢語中無固定常用義，常見於古籍、譯注或人名，具體含義視上下文而定。
english_meaning: A rare/obscure character with no standardized modern meaning; appears mainly in classical texts, transcriptions, or personal names; meaning depends on context.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 罕用，視上下文而定（可作名詞或動詞）
partOfSpeech_english: rare/varies — typically noun or verb depending on context
explanation_mandarin: 菢為不常用字，現代廣東話與普通話中均少見。多用於古籍、刻本、譯名或人名中，單靠字形難以給出統一義項，需參考具體語境或史料。
explanation_english: 菢 is an uncommon character seldom used in modern Cantonese or Mandarin. It mainly occurs in classical texts, editions, transcriptions, or personal names. Its sense is not standardized and must be determined from context or historical sources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「菢」喺而家好少見，多數淨係喺古書或人名入面見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'bok3' hai6 ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 gin3, do1 sou3 zing6 hai6 hai2 gu2 syu1 waak6 jan4 ming4 jap6 min6 gin3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字“菢”在现在很少见，多数只在古书或人名中看到。
examples.english_sentence: The character '菢' is rarely seen today; it's mostly found in classical texts or personal names.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見的粵語方言或俚語，具貶義的可能性（具體含義不詳）
english_meaning: An obscure Cantonese dialect/slang term, likely derogatory; exact meaning uncertain
explanation_mandarin: 「菢竇」在可查資料中非常罕見，缺乏權威詞典記載。根據使用情境，它可能是地區性的俚語或罵人用語，但讀音與具體含義會因地區而異，尚無定論。
explanation_english: “菢竇” is an extremely rare Cantonese regional or slang term with little authoritative documentation. From context it appears to be colloquial and possibly derogatory, but pronunciation and exact meaning vary regionally and are not well established.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知道「菢竇」係乜嘢意思，呢個字好少見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 dou3 "bok6 dau6" hai6 mat1 je5 ji3 si1, ni1 go3 zi6 hou2 siu2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道「菢竇」是什麼意思，這個詞很少見。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what "菢竇" means; this term is very rare.

mandarin_meaning: 笨蛋；傻瓜（口語、罵人）
english_meaning: an idiot; a fool (colloquial insult)
explanation_mandarin: 「菢竇雞」是廣東話的粗俗俚語，用來罵人愚蠢或沒用。詞語來源與字面意義不一定相關，主要是音譯或諧音，用於口語、非正式場合，常見於香港粵語圈，但屬侮辱性用語，需謹慎使用。
explanation_english: "菢竇雞" is a Cantonese coarse slang term used to call someone stupid or useless. The characters are mainly used for phonetic/colloquial effect rather than literal meaning. It appears in informal speech (especially in Hong Kong Cantonese) and is an insulting term—use with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做菢竇雞，快啲幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 bok3 dau6 gai1, faai3 di1 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當個菢竇雞，快點幫忙啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be an idiot—hurry up and help.

mandarin_meaning: 未知（可能為錯字、方言俚語或被打碼的粗口）
english_meaning: Unknown (possibly a misspelling, nonstandard slang, or a censored profanity)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 未知 / 可能為俚語或感嘆詞
explanation_mandarin: 該詞條不可考。包含的字形或許為罕見字、打錯字，或原詞為粗口而被部分字符替換/打碼，故無法確定正確讀音與意思。建議確認原始來源或提供更多上下文。
explanation_english: The entry cannot be verified. The characters may be rare, a typo, or part of an obscured profanity (some characters censored), so the exact pronunciation and meaning are uncertain. Please provide original context or check the source for clarification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個詞「菢竇鷄*」我唔識，可能係打錯字或者係罵人被打碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ci4 '菢竇鷄*' ngo5 m4 sik1, ho2 nang4 hai6 daa2 co3 zi6 waak6 ze2 hai6 maa6 jan4 bei6 daa2 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個詞「菢竇鷄*」我不認識，可能是打錯字或被加了馬賽克的罵人話。
examples.english_sentence: I don't recognize the term '菢竇鷄*'; it might be a typo or an insult with censored characters.

mandarin_meaning: 菩 (pú) — 常見於佛教語彙，如“菩薩”“菩提”，為梵語音譯，與覺悟、慈悲等概念相關。
english_meaning: 菩 (pou4) — a character used mainly in Buddhist terms (e.g. 'Bodhisattva', 'bodhi'); a transliteration from Sanskrit associated with enlightenment and compassion.
explanation_mandarin: 漢字，主要出現在佛教術語中，為梵語音譯，常見於“菩薩”“菩提”等詞，通常與覺悟、慈悲或菩薩行相關。
explanation_english: A Chinese character used primarily in Buddhist contexts. It appears in compounds like '菩薩' (Bodhisattva) and '菩提' (bodhi) and is a transliteration from Sanskrit, associated with enlightenment and compassion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間寺廟入面供奉住一尊菩薩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 zi6 miu6 jap6 min6 gung1 fung6 zyu6 jat1 zyun1 pou4 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间寺庙里供奉着一尊菩萨。
examples.english_sentence: That temple houses a statue of a bodhisattva.

mandarin_meaning: 菩提（觉悟、开悟；亦指菩提树）
english_meaning: Bodhi (awakening/enlightenment); also the Bodhi tree
explanation_mandarin: 佛教術語，源自梵語 bodhi，意指覺悟、開悟或覺性；有時也用於指菩提樹。
explanation_english: A Buddhist term from Sanskrit 'bodhi', meaning awakening or enlightenment (bodhicitta); can also refer to the Bodhi tree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想修行，追求菩提。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 sau1 hang4 zeoi1 kau4 pou4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说想修行，追求菩提。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wants to cultivate himself and pursue Bodhi (enlightenment).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺佛教入面，菩提代表覺悟同智慧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 fat6 gaau3 jap6 min6, pou4 tai4 doi6 biu2 gok3 ng6 tung4 zi3 wai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在佛教中，菩提代表觉悟与智慧。
examples.english_sentence: In Buddhism, 'bodhi' represents awakening and wisdom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寺院門口有棵古老嘅菩提樹，信徒會喺樹下靜坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 jyun6 mun4 hau2 jau5 fo1 gu2 lou5 ge3 pou4 tai4 syu6, seon3 tou4 wui5 hai2 syu6 haa6 zing6 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寺院门口有一棵古老的菩提树，信徒会在树下静坐。
examples.english_sentence: There is an ancient Bodhi tree at the temple entrance, and devotees sit quietly under it.

mandarin_meaning: 菩提子（菩提树的种子），常用于制作佛教念珠或手串，也泛指佛珠。
english_meaning: Bodhi seed (seeds of the Bodhi tree) used as Buddhist prayer beads; a string of bodhi seeds (Bodhi beads).
explanation_mandarin: 菩提子原指菩提樹的種子，常被穿成念珠或手串，供佛教信徒誦經、持咒或作裝飾，也可泛指各類佛珠。
explanation_english: The seeds of the Bodhi tree, commonly strung into prayer beads or wrist malas used by Buddhists for chanting, meditation, or as ornamentation; often used broadly to mean Buddhist beads.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 菩提子係佛教常見嘅念珠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou4 tai4 zi2 hai6 fat6 gaau3 soeng4 gin3 ge3 nim6 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菩提子是佛教常见的念珠。
examples.english_sentence: Bodhi seeds are a common type of Buddhist prayer beads.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見詞，無標準釋義；可能為人名、地名或誤寫（需視語境而定）
english_meaning: An obscure/rare term with no standard definition; possibly a personal name, place name, or a misspelling (meaning depends on context).
explanation_mandarin: 「菩薘」在現代粵語與普通話辭典中均屬罕見字詞，查無統一意義。單字「菩」常見於佛教用語（如菩薩），而「薘」為較少見的草字頭字形，可能為「蘭」的異體或罕用字。遇到此詞時應結合原文語境判斷，或確認是否為人名、地名或印刷/錄入錯誤。
explanation_english: The term "菩薘" is highly obscure and not attested with a standard meaning in modern Cantonese or Mandarin dictionaries. The character 菩 appears in Buddhist contexts (e.g. 菩薩), while 薘 is a rare grass‑radical character that may be an unusual variant of 蘭 or simply a seldom‑used character. Interpretations should rely on context; it may be a personal/place name or a typo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺本書入面見到「菩薘」，但查唔到意思，可能係人名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 bun2 syu1 jap6 min6 gin3 dou2 "pou4 laan4", daan6 caa4 m4 dou2 ji3 si1, ho2 nang4 hai6 jan4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在書裡看到「菩薘」，但查不到意思，可能是人名。
examples.english_sentence: I saw "菩薘" in a book but couldn't find its meaning; it might be a person's name.

mandarin_meaning: 菩薩（佛教中指發菩提心、願救度眾生的覺悟者；也用來稱讚慈悲人士）
english_meaning: Bodhisattva (in Buddhism, an enlightened being who seeks awakening for the sake of all sentient beings); used figuratively to describe a compassionate, merciful person
explanation_mandarin: 菩薩是佛教術語，指立志成佛以救度眾生的人；日常亦會用來形容非常慈悲、樂於助人的人。
explanation_english: A Buddhist term for a being who aspires to attain Buddhahood for the benefit of all beings; commonly used figuratively to praise someone very kind or helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好似菩薩咁，成日幫人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 pou4 saat3 gam2, sing4 jat6 bong1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真像菩萨一样，总是帮助别人。
examples.english_sentence: He really is like a Bodhisattva, always helping others.

mandarin_meaning: 菩薩心腸 / 心地善良、富有慈悲心
english_meaning: having the heart of a bodhisattva; very kind-hearted and compassionate
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人非常慈悲、心地善良，樂於幫助別人。常用來稱讚某人的慈悲或善良性格。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely compassionate and kind-hearted, always willing to help others. Commonly used to praise a person's merciful or benevolent nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係有菩薩心腸，成日幫手照顧有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 pou4 saat3 sam1 coeng4, seng4 jat6 bong1 sau2 ziu3 gu3 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的是菩薩心腸，常常幫忙照顧有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: They really have the heart of a bodhisattva — always helping to care for people in need.

mandarin_meaning: （網路／口語）對「菩薩／佛陀」的戲稱或引申用法，用來形容人非常包容、寬厚，或帶有諷刺意味地稱某人自以為慈悲
english_meaning: (slang) a playful/sarcastic reference to a Buddha/bodhisattva; used to call someone extremely tolerant/forbearing or to mock someone who acts self-righteously
explanation_mandarin: 「菩達」為粵語網路與口語中的俚語，取自「菩薩／佛陀」的字形或音近轉化。常用來稱讚某人非常包容、寬厚，或帶有調侃、諷刺意味，指對方像聖人般寬容或擺出一副慈悲的姿態。
explanation_english: “菩達” is a Cantonese slang term derived from the characters for bodhisattva/Buddha. It appears in online and spoken Cantonese. It can praise someone for being extremely tolerant and forgiving, or it can be used sarcastically to mock someone who behaves as if they are saintly or morally superior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係做菩達，好多時都要講下自己嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 zou6 pou4 daat6, hou2 do1 si4 dou1 jiu3 gong2 haa5 zi6 gei2 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只當自己是菩薩，有時候也要表達自己的意見。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just act like a 'Buddha' (saint); sometimes you should express your own opinion.

mandarin_meaning: 华（huá/huà）－ 华美、光彩；也指中国或与中国有关的人或事（如“中华”“华人”），亦为姓氏
english_meaning: Hua — splendid, magnificent; also used to refer to China or things/people Chinese (e.g., 'Zhonghua', 'Hua people'); a surname
explanation_mandarin: “華”可表示華麗、光彩、繁華等概念；在複合詞中常指中國或與中國有關（如“中華”、“華人”），也可作姓氏。
explanation_english: “華” can mean splendid or resplendent. In compounds it often refers to China or things/people related to China (e.g., 'Zhonghua', 'Hua people'). It can also be a surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中華文化好有歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 waa4 man4 faa3 hou2 jau5 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中华文化有悠久的历史。
examples.english_sentence: Chinese culture has a long history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個設計好華麗，吸引晒大家注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 cit3 gai3 hou2 waa4 lai6, kap1 jan5 saai1 daai6 gaa1 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的设计很华丽，吸引了大家注意。
examples.english_sentence: His design is very splendid and attracted everyone's attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多華人社區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 waa4 jan4 se5 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多华人社区。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many Chinese communities.

mandarin_meaning: 华人（huárén）——指有中国血统或文化背景的人，通常泛指居住在中国或海外的华裔。
english_meaning: Chinese people; people of Chinese descent (ethnic Chinese), often used to refer to both residents of China and overseas Chinese.
explanation_mandarin: 「華人」用來表示具有漢族或中國文化背景的人，強調血統或文化認同，範圍可包括中國大陸、香港、台灣及海外的華裔人士。
explanation_english: “華人” refers to people of Chinese ethnicity or cultural background. It emphasizes ethnic or cultural identity and can include people living in China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, or overseas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個喺美國生活嘅華人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hai2 mei5 gwok3 sang1 wut6 ge3 waa4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位在美国生活的华人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a Chinese person living in the United States.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺東南亞，有好大嘅華人社區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dung1 naam4 aa3, jau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 waa4 jan4 se5 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在东南亚，有很大的华人社区。
examples.english_sentence: In Southeast Asia, there are large Chinese communities.

mandarin_meaning: 華佗（Huà Tuó），東漢時期著名醫生與外科醫學家，常被用來稱讚醫術高超的人
english_meaning: Hua Tuo, a famous physician of the Eastern Han dynasty; used to refer to an exceptionally skilled doctor
explanation_mandarin: 華佗是東漢時期的名醫，傳說擅長外科手術並創製麻沸散，後世常以「華佗再世」或直接用其名來稱讚醫術高超的人或神醫。
explanation_english: Hua Tuo was a renowned physician of the Eastern Han dynasty, famed in tradition for surgical skills and an anesthetic (mafeisan). His name is often used to praise extraordinarily skilled doctors or to call someone a 'miracle healer.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢醫術好高超，真係華佗再世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 seot6 hou2 gou1 ciu1, zan1 hai6 Waa4 To4 zoi3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他醫術很高超，真是華佗再世。
examples.english_sentence: His medical skills are superb — he really is like Hua Tuo reborn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代有個名醫叫華佗，佢係漢朝好出名嘅醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 jau5 go3 ming4 ji1 giu3 Waa4 To4, keoi5 hai6 hon3 ciu4 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代有個名醫叫華佗，他在漢朝非常有名的醫生。
examples.english_sentence: There was a famous ancient physician named Hua Tuo; he was a well-known doctor in the Han dynasty.

mandarin_meaning: 华侨（居住在海外的中国人，通常保留中国国籍）
english_meaning: overseas Chinese (Chinese people living abroad, often retaining Chinese nationality)
explanation_mandarin: 指居住在国外的中国人，通常保留中國國籍；與「華裔」（可能擁有外國國籍的華人後裔）有區別。
explanation_english: Refers to Chinese people who live abroad, often retaining Chinese nationality; distinct from 'huayi' (ethnic Chinese who may hold foreign citizenship).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係華僑，已經喺加拿大住咗二十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 waa4 kiu4, ji5 ging1 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 zyu6 zo2 ji6 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是華僑，已經在加拿大住了二十年。
examples.english_sentence: He is an overseas Chinese; he has already lived in Canada for twenty years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多華僑會返嚟過新年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 waa4 kiu4 wui5 faan1 lai4 gwo3 san1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多華僑會回來過新年。
examples.english_sentence: There are many overseas Chinese who come back to Hong Kong to celebrate the Lunar New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 華僑同華裔唔一樣，華僑通常保留中國籍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa4 kiu4 tung4 waa4 jeoi6 m4 jat1 joeng6, waa4 kiu4 tung1 soeng4 bou2 lau4 zung1 gwok3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 華僑和華裔不一樣，華僑通常保留中國籍。
examples.english_sentence: Huáqiáo and huáyì are not the same; huáqiáo usually retain Chinese nationality.

mandarin_meaning: 华南（中国南部地区）
english_meaning: South China; the southern region of China
explanation_mandarin: 指中国南部的地理区域，通常包括广东、广西、海南等省区，气候以亚热带至热带为主。
explanation_english: Refers to the southern region of China, typically including provinces/areas such as Guangdong, Guangxi, and Hainan; climate is generally subtropical to tropical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 華南今年夏天特別潮濕，雨水好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa4 naam4 gam1 nin4 haa6 tin1 dak6 bit6 ciu4 sap1, jyu5 seoi2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 华南今年夏天特别潮湿，雨水很多。
examples.english_sentence: South China is especially humid this summer, with a lot of rainfall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司喺華南開咗一間分公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai2 waa4 naam4 hoi1 zo2 jat1 gaan1 fan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司在华南开设了一家分公司。
examples.english_sentence: Our company opened a branch in South China.

mandarin_meaning: 華埠 / 唐人街
english_meaning: Chinatown; Chinese quarter
explanation_mandarin: 指海外城市中華人集中活動、經商或居住的街區，常用「唐人街」或「華人街」來表示。
explanation_english: Refers to an area in a foreign city where Chinese people concentrate in residence, business, and cultural activities — commonly called Chinatown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去華埠搵食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 waa4 fau6 wan2 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去華埠（唐人街）吃飯吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Chinatown to eat tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 华夏（古代对中国的称呼，泛指中华民族或中华文明）
english_meaning: Huaxia — an ancient name for China; the Chinese nation/civilization
explanation_mandarin: “华夏”原为古代对中原诸夏部落及其文化的称呼，后泛指中华民族或中华文明，常用于历史、文化语境。
explanation_english: “Huaxia” originally referred to the ancient Zhou-era peoples and culture of central China and later came to denote the Chinese nation or civilization; used chiefly in historical and cultural contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個展覽展示咗華夏文明嘅歷史同文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zin2 laam5 zin2 si6 zo2 waa4 haa6 man4 ming4 ge3 lik6 si2 tung4 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个展览展示了华夏文明的历史和文化。
examples.english_sentence: This exhibition displayed the history and culture of the Huaxia civilization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 華夏文化對亞洲好多國家都有深遠嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa4 haa6 man4 faa3 deoi3 aa3 zau1 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 jau5 sam1 jyun5 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 华夏文化对亚洲许多国家都有深远的影响。
examples.english_sentence: Huaxia culture has had a profound influence on many Asian countries.

mandarin_meaning: 華山（山名）
english_meaning: Mount Hua (a mountain in China)
explanation_mandarin: 華山位於中國陝西省，是中國著名的五嶽之一，以險峻的山勢和道教聖地聞名，常作為登山、朝聖和旅遊的目的地。
explanation_english: Mount Hua is a famous mountain in Shaanxi Province, China. It is one of the Five Great Mountains, known for its steep cliffs, Taoist sites, and popular hiking routes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜去華山行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 waa4 saan1 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下個禮拜去華山爬山。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to hike Mount Hua next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 華山係中國五嶽之一，以險峻著名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa4 saan1 hai6 zung1 gwok3 ng5 ngok6 zi1 jat1, ji5 him2 zeon3 zoek3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 華山是中國五嶽之一，以險峻著稱。
examples.english_sentence: Mount Hua is one of China's Five Great Mountains, known for its steepness.

mandarin_meaning: 華盛頓（美國首都）；有時泛指美國聯邦政府
english_meaning: Washington (D.C.), the capital of the United States; sometimes used to refer to the U.S. federal government
explanation_mandarin: 「華府」在中文裡通常指美國首都華盛頓（華盛頓特區），有時也用作美國聯邦政府的代稱（轉喻）。
explanation_english: Refers to Washington, D.C., the U.S. capital. It is also used metonymically to mean the U.S. federal government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺華府做緊政府顧問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 waa4 fu2 zou6 gan2 zing3 fu2 gu3 man6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在華府擔任政府顧問。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently working in Washington (D.C.) as a government advisor.

mandarin_meaning: 華文（中文、中文書面語或華人的語文教育）
english_meaning: Chinese (language), especially written Chinese or Chinese language education
explanation_mandarin: 「華文」通常指中文（多指書面語）或與華人語文相關的教育科目，例如學校裡的華文課、華文教材等。有時可與「中文」互換使用，但在某些語境下強調華人的語文文化或教學體系。
explanation_english: Refers to the Chinese language, especially written Chinese, or Chinese language education (e.g. school Chinese classes, materials). It can often be used interchangeably with "Chinese" but sometimes emphasizes Chinese-language cultural/educational contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺學校有華文課，想加強寫作同閱讀能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 hok6 haau6 jau5 waa4 man4 fo3, soeng2 gaa1 goeng3 se2 zok3 tung4 jyut6 duk6 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在學校有華文課，想加強寫作和閱讀能力。
examples.english_sentence: I have Chinese classes at school and want to improve my writing and reading skills.

mandarin_meaning: 华氏（温度计量单位，华氏温标）
english_meaning: Fahrenheit (temperature scale/unit)
explanation_mandarin: 指華氏溫標或華氏度，是一種測量溫度的單位，常見於美國等使用華氏的地區。
explanation_english: Refers to the Fahrenheit temperature scale or degrees Fahrenheit, a unit for measuring temperature commonly used in the United States.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美國啲天氣報告通常用華氏度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 gwok3 di1 tin1 hei3 bou3 gou3 tung1 soeng4 jung6 waa4 si6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美国的天气预报通常使用华氏度。
examples.english_sentence: Weather reports in the U.S. typically use degrees Fahrenheit.

mandarin_meaning: 华沙（波兰首都）
english_meaning: Warsaw (capital city of Poland)
explanation_mandarin: 波兰的首都华沙，是该国的政治、经济和文化中心。
explanation_english: The capital and largest city of Poland; the country's political, economic, and cultural center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜會去華沙旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 waa4 saa1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个礼拜会去华沙旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Warsaw next week.

mandarin_meaning: 華人與外國人之間的爭執、摩擦或糾紛
english_meaning: Disputes, friction, or quarrels between Chinese and foreigners (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，指華人與洋人（外國人）之間因文化、習俗或利益不同而產生的爭執或摩擦。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression referring to disputes, friction, or entanglements between Chinese and foreigners, often arising from cultural differences or misunderstandings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為文化差異發生華洋轇轕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 man4 faa3 caa1 ji6 faat3 saang1 waa4 joeng4 giu1 gap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們因為文化差異與外國人發生爭執。
examples.english_sentence: They had disputes with foreigners because of cultural differences.

mandarin_meaning: 华尔兹
english_meaning: waltz (a ballroom dance and the music for it)
explanation_mandarin: 一種源自歐洲的三拍子舞蹈和相應的音樂形式，常見於社交舞會與舞蹈表演。
explanation_english: A ballroom dance in triple time (3/4) originating in Europe, and the musical form for that dance; commonly seen at social dances and performances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚要去學華爾茲，老師話好多步要記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jiu3 heoi3 hok6 waa4 ji5 zi1, lou5 si1 waa6 hou2 do1 bou6 jiu3 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚要去学华尔兹，老师说有很多步要记。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to learn the waltz tonight; the teacher said there are many steps to remember.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺舞會上跳華爾茲，旋律聽落好浪漫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 mou5 wui2 seong6 tiu3 waa4 ji5 zi1, syun4 leot6 teng1 lok6 hou2 long6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在舞会上跳华尔兹，旋律听起来很浪漫。
examples.english_sentence: They danced the waltz at the ball; the melody sounded very romantic.

mandarin_meaning: 華田（專有名詞，常作人名、公司或地名）
english_meaning: Hua Tian (proper noun — a personal name, company name, or place name)
explanation_mandarin: 「華田」通常不是普通詞彙，而是用作人名、企業名或地名的專有名稱。具體含義視上下文而定。
explanation_english: “Hua Tian” is typically a proper name rather than a common lexical item. It is used as a personal name, company name, or place name; exact meaning depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 華田今日會嚟公司開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa4 tin4 gam1 jat6 wui5 lei4 gung1 si1 hoi1 wui6 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 華田今天會來公司開會。
examples.english_sentence: Hua Tian will come to the office for a meeting today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺華田度做設計師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 waa4 tin4 dou6 zou6 cit3 gai3 si1 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在華田做設計師。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a designer at Hua Tian.

mandarin_meaning: 华人社群；与华人相关的社会、文化圈子
english_meaning: the Chinese community/circle; the social or cultural sphere of Chinese people
explanation_mandarin: 指華人社群、華人圈子或與華人相關的社會、文化領域，常用以描述在華人社會內流傳或關注的事務。
explanation_english: Refers to the Chinese community or circle — the social and cultural sphere related to Chinese people; used to describe matters circulated within or relevant to the Chinese community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺華界好有名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 waa4 gaai3 hou2 jau5 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在华界很有名。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very famous in the Chinese community.

mandarin_meaning: 华盛顿（Huáshèngdùn）
english_meaning: Washington (e.g., Washington, D.C. or the U.S. state of Washington)
explanation_mandarin: 指美國的地名，通常指美國首都華盛頓哥倫比亞特區（Washington, D.C.），有時也指美國西北部的華盛頓州（Washington State）。
explanation_english: The place name Washington — commonly refers to Washington, D.C., the capital of the United States, and can also refer to the U.S. state of Washington.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去華盛頓出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 waa4 sing4 deon6 ceot1 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去华盛顿出差。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Washington on a business trip next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 華盛頓係美國嘅首都。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa4 sing4 deon6 hai6 mei5 gwok3 ge3 sau2 dou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 华盛顿是美国的首都。
examples.english_sentence: Washington is the capital of the United States.

mandarin_meaning: 華沙條約（華約），即華沙條約組織（華沙公約）的簡稱
english_meaning: Warsaw Pact (abbreviation for the Warsaw Treaty Organization)
explanation_mandarin: 「華約」是「華沙條約組織」的簡稱，指冷戰期間由蘇聯與東歐社會主義國家組成的軍事與政治同盟（1955–1991）。
explanation_english: Short for the Warsaw Pact (Warsaw Treaty Organization), the military-political alliance led by the Soviet Union made up of Eastern Bloc socialist states during the Cold War (1955–1991).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冷戰期間，東歐好多國家都加入咗華約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laang5 zin3 kei4 gaan1, dung1 au1 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 gaa1 jap6 zo2 waa4 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冷战期间，东欧很多国家加入了华约。
examples.english_sentence: During the Cold War, many Eastern European countries joined the Warsaw Pact.

mandarin_meaning: 華而不實 (huá ér bù shí)：外表華麗但缺乏實質內容或實際效果。
english_meaning: Showy but lacking substance; all flash and no substance.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物外表華麗、誇張或裝飾很多，但實際上缺乏實質內容、效用或真實價值。
explanation_english: Describes something that appears grand or flashy on the surface but lacks real substance, practical value, or genuine effectiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個廣告華而不實，講得好靚，但冇任何實際內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gwong2 gou3 waa4 ji4 bat1 sat6, gong2 dak1 hou2 leng3, daan6 mou5 jam6 ho4 sat6 zai3 noi6 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个广告华而不实，说得很漂亮，但没有任何实际内容。
examples.english_sentence: That advertisement is all show and no substance — it sounds great but has no real content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅新政策表面好宏偉，但實際上華而不實，執行好困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 san1 zing3 caak3 biu2 min6 hou2 hung4 wai5, daan6 sat6 zai3 soeng6 waa4 ji4 bat1 sat6, zap1 hang4 hou2 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的新政策表面宏伟，但实际上华而不实，执行起来很困难。
examples.english_sentence: The company's new policy looks grand on the surface, but in reality it's all show and no substance and hard to implement.

mandarin_meaning: 華裔（指具有中國血統，在海外出生或長大的個人）
english_meaning: Person of Chinese descent; of Chinese ancestry (often born or living outside China)
explanation_mandarin: 指具有中華（中國）血統、但在外國出生或長大的個人，常用於描述在海外的華人血統者（例如華裔美國人、華裔加拿大人）。
explanation_english: Refers to people of Chinese ancestry who are often born or residing abroad; used to describe individuals of Chinese descent (e.g., Chinese Americans, Chinese Canadians).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係華裔美國人，但佢嘅中文幾流利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 waa4 jeoi6 mei5 gwok3 jan4, daan6 keoi5 ge3 zung1 man4 gei2 lau4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是華裔美國人，但他的中文很流利。
examples.english_sentence: He is a Chinese American, but his Chinese is quite fluent.

mandarin_meaning: 华语（指汉语中的普通话或汉语语言）
english_meaning: Mandarin (the Chinese language), Chinese (Mandarin)
explanation_mandarin: 「華語」常用來指華人社會中使用的中文語言，尤其在台灣及東南亞語境中指普通話／標準漢語。有時也泛指漢語。
explanation_english: Refers to the Chinese language, commonly used to mean Mandarin (Standard Chinese). In Taiwan and parts of Southeast Asia it specifically denotes Mandarin; sometimes used broadly for Chinese language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識講華語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 gong2 waa4 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会说华语。
examples.english_sentence: I can't speak Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校有華語課程，啱啲外國學生修讀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 jau5 waa4 jyu5 fo3 cing4, aam1 di1 ngoi6 gwok3 hok6 saang1 sau1 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校有华语课程，适合外國学生修读。
examples.english_sentence: The school offers Mandarin courses, suitable for foreign students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去台灣學華語，語言進步好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 toi4 waan1 hok6 waa4 jyu5, jyu5 jin4 zeon3 bou6 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去台湾学华语，语言进步很快。
examples.english_sentence: He went to Taiwan to study Mandarin, and his language improved quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 华丽（huálì）：华美、富丽堂皇，外表或装饰十分豪华、显眼。
english_meaning: gorgeous; magnificent; ornate
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容外觀、衣著、建築或裝飾等看起來很華美、豪華、引人注目。
explanation_english: Used to describe appearance, clothing, architecture, or decoration that is ornate, splendid, and eye-catching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫好華麗，好適合舞台表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 hou2 waa4 lai6, hou2 sik1 hap6 mou5 toi4 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她的衣服很華麗，很適合舞台表演。
examples.english_sentence: His/her outfit is very gorgeous and well suited for stage performances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間酒店裝修得好華麗，但價錢好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 zau2 dim3 zong1 sau1 dak1 hou2 waa4 lai6, daan6 gaa3 cin2 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家酒店裝修得很華麗，但價格很貴。
examples.english_sentence: That hotel is decorated very gorgeously, but the prices are quite high.

mandarin_meaning: 一種水生植物，常指菰草或野生稻等沼澤、池塘生長的植物，部分地區用於編蓆或作為食材。
english_meaning: An aquatic plant (a reed or wild-rice type) found in ponds and marshes; sometimes used for weaving mats or as food in some regions.
explanation_mandarin: 菰一般指生長於水邊或沼澤的植物，屬於禾本科或芦苇類的通稱。傳統中常以其莖葉編織蓆子或局部食用其種子／鱗莖。
explanation_english: Refers to plants growing at the water's edge or in marshes, broadly a reed/wild-rice type. Traditionally stems and leaves are used for mat-weaving and in some areas parts may be eaten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆用菰草編蓆，夏天瞓覺會舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 jung6 gu1 cou2 bin1 sik1, haa6 tin1 fan3 gaau3 wui5 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶用菰草編蓆，夏天睡覺會比較舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma weaves mats from gu grass, which makes sleeping in summer more comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 菱（可指菱角，一种水生坚果；也指菱形，即菱形/菱状）
english_meaning: ling (refers to the water caltrop, an aquatic nut; also a rhombus/diamond shape)
explanation_mandarin: 「菱」可用于表示菱角（一种生长在水中的坚果/可食用种子），也常见于复合词如「菱形」，表示一种四边形的几何形状。
explanation_english: The character 菱 can denote the water caltrop (an aquatic nut) and appears in compounds like 菱形 to mean a rhombus or diamond-shaped figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個塘入面有好多菱角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 tong4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 ling4 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 池塘里有很多菱角。
examples.english_sentence: There are many water caltrops in the pond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個圖案係菱形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tou4 on3 hai6 ling4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个图案是菱形。
examples.english_sentence: This pattern is a rhombus.

mandarin_meaning: 菱形（几何图形，四边相等的平行四边形）
english_meaning: rhombus; diamond shape (a quadrilateral with all sides equal)
explanation_mandarin: 菱形是一種幾何圖形，通常指四邊相等、對角相等或為平行四邊形的一種，常稱為「菱形」或「鑽石形」。
explanation_english: A rhombus (diamond shape): a geometric quadrilateral with all four sides equal in length; often called a diamond-shaped figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個圖案係一個菱形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 tou4 on3 hai6 jat1 go3 ling4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个图案是一个菱形。
examples.english_sentence: That pattern is a rhombus (diamond shape).

mandarin_meaning: （口語簡稱）菲律賓；（口語）菲律賓籍家庭傭工（即「菲傭」）
english_meaning: Philippines (abbr.); Filipino domestic helper (informal abbreviation)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語中，「菲」常用作「菲律賓」或「菲律賓籍家庭傭工（菲傭）」的簡稱。屬口語或俗稱，使用時要注意場合，可能帶有簡化或不禮貌的語感。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, '菲' is commonly used as an abbreviation for 'Philippines' or for a Filipino domestic helper (菲傭). It is informal and can sound colloquial or impolite in some contexts; use with care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企請咗個菲做工，佢好細心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 cing2 zo2 go3 fei1 zou6 gung1, keoi5 hou2 sai3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家請了個菲律賓幫傭，她很細心。
examples.english_sentence: My family hired a Filipino domestic helper; she's very attentive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個月我會去菲度假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 jyut6 ngo5 wui5 heoi3 fei1 dou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下個月我會去菲律賓度假。
examples.english_sentence: Next month I'm going to the Philippines for vacation.

mandarin_meaning: 菲佣；菲律賓家庭傭工
english_meaning: Filipino domestic helper (domestic worker from the Philippines)
explanation_mandarin: 指受僱於家庭、來自菲律賓的家庭傭工，常見於香港等地，屬於外傭的一種稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to a domestic helper from the Philippines employed in households, commonly in Hong Kong and other places; a type of foreign domestic worker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企請咗一個菲傭，幫手煮飯同埋照顧小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 cing2 zo2 jat1 go3 fei1 jung4, bong1 sau2 zyu2 faan6 tung4 maai4 ziu3 gu3 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家請了一個菲佣，幫忙做飯和照顧小孩。
examples.english_sentence: My family hired a Filipino domestic helper who helps with cooking and looking after the kids.

mandarin_meaning: 菲律賓
english_meaning: the Philippines
explanation_mandarin: 指位於東南亞的國家，官方名稱為菲律賓共和國。
explanation_english: Refers to the country in Southeast Asia, officially the Republic of the Philippines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個暑假會去菲律賓旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 syu1 gaa3 wui5 heoi3 fei1 leot6 ban1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個暑假會去菲律賓旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the Philippines for a trip next summer vacation.

mandarin_meaning: 菲律宾话；（通常指）他加禄语/菲律宾语
english_meaning: Filipino language (Philippine language, often refers to Tagalog/Filipino)
explanation_mandarin: 指菲律宾的语言。粵語語境下「菲律賓話」通常用來指他加祿語／菲律賓語，或泛指來自菲律賓的人所說的語言。
explanation_english: Refers to languages of the Philippines. In Cantonese usage, it commonly denotes Tagalog/Filipino, or more generally the language spoken by people from the Philippines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講菲律賓話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 fei1 leot6 ban1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说菲律宾话。
examples.english_sentence: He/She can speak Filipino.

mandarin_meaning: 膠卷；底片（拍照用的傳統光學底片）
english_meaning: photographic film; film roll; photo negative
explanation_mandarin: 指用作拍照的傳統感光膠片，一般以一卷形式存在，用來拍攝底片及沖洗成相片。在香港粵語中常用「菲林」稱呼膠卷或底片。
explanation_english: Refers to photographic film — the traditional light-sensitive material used in cameras, typically in rolls, producing negatives that are developed into photos. In Hong Kong Cantonese, '菲林' is commonly used to mean film or negatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲有一卷菲林未沖相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 jau5 jat1 gyun2 fei1 lam4 mei6 cung1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我還有一卷菲林還沒沖洗。
examples.english_sentence: I still have a roll of film that hasn't been developed.

mandarin_meaning: 菸、香菸（yān），指煙草製品
english_meaning: cigarette; tobacco (product); smoke (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來吸食的煙草製品，通常指香菸，也可泛指煙。
explanation_english: Refers to tobacco products for smoking, typically a cigarette; can also be used more generally for smoke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇菸？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 jin1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有菸？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have a cigarette?

mandarin_meaning: cuì（聚集、集中；傑出，書面用法）
english_meaning: to gather; to concentrate; concentrated; eminent (literary)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 形容詞（書面/文言）
explanation_mandarin: 「萃」本義為聚集、集中，常見於書面語或與其他字構成詞語如「薈萃」，表示匯聚精華或傑出匯聚之意。亦可用於科學術語如「萃取」。
explanation_english: The character originally means to gather or concentrate. It often appears in literary compounds such as "薈萃" (huìcuì), meaning a convergence of the best, and in technical terms like "萃取" (extraction).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個藝術節薈萃咗來自全港嘅創作人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ngai6 seot6 zit3 wui6 seoi3 zo2 loi4 zi6 cyun4 gong2 ge3 cong3 zok3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個藝術節匯聚了來自全港的創作者。
examples.english_sentence: This arts festival has gathered creators from across Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 實驗室進行嘅萃取程序要好小心，避免污染。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat6 jim6 sat1 zeon3 hang4 ge3 seoi3 ceot1 cing4 coeng4 jiu3 hou2 siu2 sam1, bei6 min5 wu1 jim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 實驗室進行的萃取程序要很小心，避免污染。
examples.english_sentence: The extraction procedures carried out in the lab must be handled carefully to avoid contamination.

mandarin_meaning: 萃取（提取、抽取）
english_meaning: to extract (separate a substance from a mixture)
explanation_mandarin: 在化學或分析中，指用溶劑或其他方法，將混合物中某種成分分離、提取出來的過程。
explanation_english: In chemistry or analysis, the process of separating and taking a specific component from a mixture using a solvent or other method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 實驗室會用溶劑將樣本入面嘅目標化合物萃取出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat6 jim6 sat1 wui5 jung6 jung4 zai3 zoeng1 joeng6 bun2 jap6 min6 ge3 muk6 biu1 faa3 hap6 mat6 seoi3 ceoi2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 實驗室會用溶劑將樣本裡的目標化合物萃取出來。
examples.english_sentence: The lab will use a solvent to extract the target compound from the sample.

mandarin_meaning: 葡萄（见于“葡萄”一词）
english_meaning: grape (component character, as in "葡萄")
explanation_mandarin: 單字「萄」常見於詞語「葡萄」，表示葡萄這種水果，本字單獨使用較少。
explanation_english: The character "萄" commonly appears in the word "葡萄" (grape). It denotes the fruit grape and is rarely used by itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一盒葡萄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 hap6 pou4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一盒葡萄。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a box of grapes.

mandarin_meaning: 萊/莱（lái）——野草、野菜；常用於專有名詞或音譯（如莱姆、莱茵）
english_meaning: Lái (a type of weed or wild vegetable); also used in proper names and transliterations (e.g. 'lime' as 萊姆, 'Rhine' as 萊茵)
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「萊」本義指野生的草或菜，現代漢語多出現在地名、人名或外來詞的音譯中，如「萊姆」（lime）、「萊茵」（Rhine）。
explanation_english: The character 萊 originally denotes wild plants or weeds. In modern usage it often appears in proper nouns or transliterations, for example 萊姆 (lime) and 萊茵 (Rhine).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲萊姆去整雞尾酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 loi4 mou5 heoi3 zing2 gai1 mei5 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了些莱姆去调鸡尾酒。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some limes to make cocktails.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去萊茵河旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 loi4 jan1 ho4 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去莱茵河旅行吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go travel to the Rhine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 田頭啲萊好難除。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin4 tau4 di1 loi4 hou2 naan4 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 田边的野草很难清除。
examples.english_sentence: The weeds at the edge of the field are hard to remove.

mandarin_meaning: 萊姆病（萊姆氏病），由蜱叮咬傳播的細菌性疾病
english_meaning: Lyme disease — a tick-borne bacterial infection (Borrelia)
explanation_mandarin: 由攜帶伯氏疏螺旋體（Borrelia） 的蜱叮咬傳播，早期可出現紅斑（游走性紅斑）、發燒、頭痛、關節痛，若未及時治療可能影響神經或心臟。
explanation_english: An infection transmitted by ticks carrying Borrelia bacteria. Early signs include erythema migrans (a spreading rash), fever, headache, and joint pain; untreated cases can lead to neurological or cardiac complications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾蜱叮咗，檢查先話係萊姆病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 pei4 ding1 zo2, gim2 caa4 sin1 waa6 hai6 loi4 mou5 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被蜱叮咬，檢查後才發現是萊姆病。
examples.english_sentence: He was bitten by a tick; after tests they discovered it was Lyme disease.

mandarin_meaning: 莱索托（非洲国家）
english_meaning: Lesotho (country)
explanation_mandarin: 萊索托是位於非洲南部的一個內陸國家，為被南非包圍的君主立憲國，首都是馬塞魯。
explanation_english: Lesotho is a landlocked country in southern Africa, an independent kingdom entirely surrounded by South Africa; its capital is Maseru.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月會去萊索托旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 loi4 sok3 tok3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月会去莱索托旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to travel to Lesotho next month.

mandarin_meaning: 莱茵河
english_meaning: Rhine River
explanation_mandarin: 萊茵河是歐洲的一條主要河流，源於瑞士阿爾卑斯山，流經德國和荷蘭，最後注入北海，是歐洲重要的航運和文化地標。
explanation_english: The Rhine River is a major European river that originates in the Swiss Alps, flows through countries including Germany and the Netherlands, and empties into the North Sea. It is an important waterway and cultural landmark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去歐洲，睇下萊茵河嘅風景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 au1 zau1, tai2 haa5 loi4 jan1 ho4 ge3 fung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去欧洲，看看莱茵河的风景。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to Europe to see the scenery of the Rhine River.

mandarin_meaning: （本義）萌芽、發生；（網路/口語）可愛、萌化（受日語「萌え」影響）
english_meaning: (literal) to sprout, bud; (slang) cute, adorable (influenced by Japanese 'moe')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞（本義）、形容詞（網路/口語）
explanation_mandarin: 「萌」原指植物發芽、事物開始產生。近年受日語「萌え」影響，在網絡與口語中常用作形容詞，表示可愛、令人心動的感覺。
explanation_english: Originally means to sprout or begin to grow. In recent usage (influenced by Japanese 'moe'), it is commonly used as slang to describe something as cute or endearing and to express an affectionate feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻貓好萌呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 maau1 hou2 mung4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只猫好萌啊！
examples.english_sentence: This cat is so cute!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天啲草開始萌芽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 di1 cou2 hoi1 ci2 mung4 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天的草开始萌芽。
examples.english_sentence: In spring the grass begins to sprout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢冇萌感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 mou5 mung4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他/她没有萌感。
examples.english_sentence: I don't feel the 'moe' (cute/affectionate) feeling for them.

mandarin_meaning: 被可愛弄得說不出話／被萌到
english_meaning: to be overwhelmed or rendered speechless by cuteness; to be 'cute-struck'
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語／俚語；動詞或形容詞
explanation_mandarin: 「萌塞」為廣東話口語俚語，用來形容被某人或事物的可愛程度震懾、呆住或說不出話，類似「被萌到」或「萌到說不出話」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe being so overwhelmed by someone/something's cuteness that one is stunned, speechless, or otherwise 'cute-struck'. Similar to saying 'smitten' or 'overwhelmed by cuteness'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到隻小狗咁可愛，我真係萌塞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 zek3 siu2 gau2 gam2 ho2 oi3, ngo5 zan1 hai6 mung4 sak1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到那只小狗這麼可愛，我真的被萌到了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that puppy so cute, I was really overwhelmed by the cuteness.

mandarin_meaning: 产生；开始出现（念头、情感或事物）
english_meaning: to arise; to spring up; to begin to occur (an idea, feeling, or phenomenon)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種想法、情感或事物開始出現或產生。
explanation_english: Indicates that an idea, feeling, or thing begins to appear or come into being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個計劃萌生咗興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 mung4 saang1 zo2 hing3 ceoi3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對这个计划萌生了兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: I have developed an interest in this project.

mandarin_meaning: 萌芽（开始发芽；事物开始出现或初步发展）
english_meaning: to sprout; bud; the beginning or nascent stage of something
explanation_mandarin: 原指植物開始長出芽，也常用來比喻事物或想法剛開始出現或處於初期發展階段。
explanation_english: Literally means plant buds appearing; figuratively describes something beginning to emerge or enter an early stage of development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天到，樹上開始萌芽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 dou3, syu6 soeng6 hoi1 ci2 mung4 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天到了，树开始萌芽。
examples.english_sentence: When spring arrives, the trees begin to bud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃仲處於萌芽階段，未成型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zung6 cyu3 jyu1 mung4 ngaa4 gaai1 dyun6, mei6 sing4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划还处于萌芽阶段，还没成型。
examples.english_sentence: This project is still in its infancy and hasn't taken shape yet.

mandarin_meaning: 萍（浮萍）；引申為漂泊、無定所
english_meaning: duckweed (floating water plant); metaphorically: drifting, transient
explanation_mandarin: 「萍」原指水面上漂浮的植物（浮萍）。在比喻用法中常用來形容漂泊無定或偶然相遇，見於成語如「萍水相逢」。
explanation_english: Literally 'duckweed', a small plant that floats on water. Figuratively it denotes drifting, transience, or a chance encounter (as in the idiom '萍水相逢').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋只係萍水相逢，無需要成日保持聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi2 hai6 ping4 seoi2 soeng1 fung4, mou5 seoi1 jiu3 sing4 jat6 bou2 ci4 lyun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們只是萍水相逢，不需要經常保持聯絡。
examples.english_sentence: We're just people who met by chance; there's no need to keep in touch all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生好似浮萍，一陣風就飄走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 saang1 hou2 ci5 fau4 ping4, jat1 zan6 fung1 zau6 piu1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生像浮萍，一陣風就會飄走。
examples.english_sentence: Life is like floating duckweed; a gust of wind and it drifts away.

mandarin_meaning: 指素不相識的人偶然相遇（常用來形容短暫或偶然的相遇）
english_meaning: a chance encounter; to meet by accident — strangers meeting briefly and incidentally
explanation_mandarin: 形容彼此並無交情或未曾相識的人偶然相遇，帶有短暫、偶然的意味。
explanation_english: Describes people who are unacquainted meeting by chance; implies a brief or incidental meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺街市萍水相逢，傾咗幾句就各自走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 si5 ping4 seoi2 soeng1 fung4, king1 zo2 gei2 geoi3 zau6 gok3 zi6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在街市萍水相逢，聊了幾句就各自離開了。
examples.english_sentence: We met by chance at the market, chatted for a few minutes, then went our separate ways.

mandarin_meaning: 枯萎、萎縮；（口語）沒精神、萎靡
english_meaning: to wither/wilt, to shrink or weaken; (colloquial) to feel demotivated or listless
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can be used adjectivally); informal adjective
explanation_mandarin: 指植物失去生機、枯萎或收縮；口語中也用來形容人沒有精神、氣餒或意志消沉。
explanation_english: Refers to plants losing vitality and wilting or shrinking; colloquially used to describe a person feeling dispirited, demotivated, or listless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲花因為冇水澆，全部都萎咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 faa1 jan1wai6 mou5 seoi2 gaau1, cyun4bou6 dou1 wai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些花因为没人浇水，都枯萎了。
examples.english_sentence: The flowers withered because nobody watered them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲事搞到我好萎，唔想再做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 si6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 wai1, m4 soeng2 zoi3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事把我搞得很没劲，不想再做了。
examples.english_sentence: This situation has left me feeling demotivated; I don't want to do it anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 枯萎、凋謝；比喻衰退或萎縮
english_meaning: to wilt; to wither; to droop; (figuratively) to decline or shrink
explanation_mandarin: 通常指植物因缺水、受損或年老而變得枯萎、凋謝，也可用來比喻事物或情況逐漸衰落或萎縮。
explanation_english: Usually refers to plants losing vitality and drying up or drooping due to lack of water, damage, or age; can also be used figuratively for decline or shrinkage of things or situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲菜因為冇澆水，已經開始萎凋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 coi3 jan1 wai6 mou5 giu1 seoi2, ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 wai2 diu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些菜因為沒澆水，已經開始枯萎凋謝。
examples.english_sentence: The vegetables have begun to wilt because they weren't watered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟蕭條令小店生意萎凋，好多舖都要結業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 siu1 tiu4 ling6 siu2 dim3 sang1 ji3 wai2 diu1, hou2 do1 pou3 dou1 jiu3 git3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經濟蕭條使小店生意萎縮，很多店都要結業。
examples.english_sentence: The economic downturn caused small shops' businesses to wither; many stores had to close.

mandarin_meaning: 萎缩（wěisuō）：指组织、器官、力量等变小或变弱；也可用于比喻，表示精神、气势、经济等衰退或收缩。
english_meaning: to wither; to atrophy; to shrink or contract in size, strength, or vigor (literal or figurative).
explanation_mandarin: 指生物組織或器官因缺乏營養、運動或疾病而變小變弱；在比喻用法上，也指氣勢、經濟、影響力等逐漸減弱或收縮。
explanation_english: Describes physical shrinking or weakening (e.g., muscle atrophy) and figurative decline (e.g., morale, economy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期缺乏運動，肌肉會萎縮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 kyut3 fat6 wan6 dung6, gei1 juk6 wui5 wai2 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期缺乏运动，肌肉会萎缩。
examples.english_sentence: If you lack exercise for a long time, your muscles will atrophy.

mandarin_meaning: 精神萎靡、沒有活力或幹勁，士氣低落
english_meaning: listless and dispirited; lacking energy or morale; unable to recover one's spirit
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或團體精神萎靡、提不起勁，缺乏動力或鬥志，難以振作。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a person or group that is listless and lacks energy or morale, having difficulty recovering or becoming motivated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近公司業績差，員工士氣萎靡不振，管理層要想辦法刺激一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gung1 si1 jip6 zik1 caa1, jyun4 gung1 si6 hei3 wai2 mai5 bat1 zan3, gun2 lei5 cang4 jiu3 soeng2 baan6 faat3 ci3 gik1 jat1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近公司业绩差，员工士气萎靡不振，管理层要想办法刺激一下。
examples.english_sentence: The company's recent poor performance has left employees listless and dispirited; management needs to find ways to boost morale.

mandarin_meaning: 万（wàn），表示一万，也可表示很多、无数或用于固定词语中
english_meaning: ten thousand; myriad; many; used in set phrases
explanation_mandarin: “萬”本义为数字一万，在口语和书面语中也常用于表示大量、无数或出现在成语与固定搭配中（如“萬事如意”、“萬一”）。
explanation_english: “萬” primarily denotes the number ten thousand. It is also used figuratively to mean a great number or myriad and appears in many set phrases (e.g. "萬事如意", "萬一").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書賣咗成萬本，真係好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 maai6 zo2 seng4 maan6 bun2, zan1 hai6 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书卖了上万本，真厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This book sold more than ten thousand copies, really impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件褸要成萬蚊，你真係考慮清楚先買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 lau1 jiu3 seng4 maan6 man1, nei5 zan1 hai6 haau2 leoi6 cing1 co2 sin1 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件夹克要一万元，你真的要考虑清楚再买。
examples.english_sentence: This jacket costs around ten thousand dollars; you should think carefully before buying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你萬事如意，新年快樂！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 maan6 si6 jyu4 ji3, san1 nin4 faai3 lok6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你万事如意，新年快乐！
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you all the best and a happy new year!

mandarin_meaning: 万一（表示假設或以防萬一）
english_meaning: in case; if by any chance; should (something happen)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 連詞 / 副詞（表示假設）
explanation_mandarin: 用來引入一種假設或不太可能但需預防的情況，相當於「如果」「要是」或「以防萬一」。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a hypothetical or unlikely but possible situation to be prepared for; equivalent to 'if', 'in case', or 'should (something happen)'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 萬一我遲到，你先幫我留位啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan6 jat1 ngo5 ci4 dou3, nei5 sin1 bong1 ngo5 lau4 wai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 万一我迟到，你先帮我留位。
examples.english_sentence: If I’m late, please save a seat for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要帶把傘，萬一落雨就可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 daai3 baa2 saan3, maan6 jat1 lok6 jyu5 zau6 ho2 ji5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要带把伞，万一下雨就可以用。
examples.english_sentence: Bring an umbrella in case it rains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 萬一出事點算？
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan6 jat1 ceot1 si6 dim2 syun3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 万一出事怎么办？
examples.english_sentence: What if something goes wrong?

mandarin_meaning: 万丈深渊：形容极深的深渊，也比喻处境极为危险或绝望。
english_meaning: An abyss; a very deep chasm; figuratively, an extremely dangerous or desperate situation.
explanation_mandarin: “萬丈深淵”原指極深的深坑或深谷，常用來比喻形勢險惡、陷入絕境或難以回復的狀況。
explanation_english: Literally refers to an extremely deep abyss; commonly used metaphorically to describe a perilous, desperate, or seemingly hopeless situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個山谷係萬丈深淵，行山要好小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 saan1 guk1 hai6 maan6 zoeng6 sam1 jyun1, hang4 saan1 jiu3 hou2 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個山谷是萬丈深淵，爬山要很小心。
examples.english_sentence: That valley is an abyss; be very careful when hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司欠咗太多債，生意已經陷入萬丈深淵，想翻身都好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 him3 zo2 taai3 do1 zai3, saang1 ji3 ji5 ging1 ham6 jap6 maan6 zoeng6 sam1 jyun1, soeng2 faan1 san1 dou1 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司欠了太多債，生意已經陷入萬丈深淵，翻身無望。
examples.english_sentence: The company is heavily in debt; the business has fallen into an abyss with no hope of recovery.

jyutping: maan6 zoeng6 gou1 lau4 ping4 dei6 hei2
mandarin_meaning: 從無到有、由基礎開始建立龐大事業或建築（比喻由小開始發展成大）
english_meaning: Literally 'a towering building rises from level ground' — figuratively, to build something great from humble beginnings; to grow from nothing into something substantial.
explanation_mandarin: 形容從零開始，經過努力建立起龐大的事業或建築；常用來稱讚由基礎發展成大的成就。
explanation_english: Describes starting from nothing and, through effort or development, building up a great enterprise or structure. Often used to praise achievements that grew from humble beginnings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司由一間細鋪開始，靠住員工嘅努力，終於做到萬丈高樓平地起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jau4 jat1 gaan1 sai3 pou3 hoi1 ci2, kaau3 zyu6 jyun4 gung1 ge3 nou5 lik6, zung1 jyu1 zou6 dou3 maan6 zoeng6 gou1 lau4 ping4 dei6 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司从一家小店开始，靠员工的努力，终于做到万丈高楼平地起。
examples.english_sentence: The company started as a small shop; thanks to the employees' hard work, it has risen from nothing to great heights.

jyutping: maan6 zoeng6 gou1 lau4 cung4 dei6 hei2
mandarin_meaning: 万丈高楼从地起（wàn zhàng gāo lóu cóng dì qǐ）——伟大的事业或建筑都是从基础一步一步开始的。
english_meaning: A towering building starts from the ground — great achievements begin from humble beginnings and are built step by step.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻任何宏大的事業或成就都必須從基礎做起、逐步累積，不可貪圖速成。
explanation_english: Used to express that large accomplishments must be built from the ground up, step by step; don't expect instant success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做大嘢要有耐性，萬丈高樓從地起，唔好急於求成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zo6 daai6 je5 jiu3 jau5 noi6 sing3, maan6 zoeng6 gou1 lau4 cung4 dei6 hei2, m4 hou2 gap1 jyu1 kau4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做大事要有耐心，万丈高楼从地起，不要急于求成。
examples.english_sentence: To do something big you need patience — a towering building starts from the ground; don't rush to achieve success.

mandarin_meaning: 萬世景仰的師表、楷模（wàn shì shī biǎo）
english_meaning: an exemplar or model teacher for all generations; a paragon admired by posterity
explanation_mandarin: 用來稱讚某人是世代景仰的師表或典範，通常指在品德或學問上具有深遠影響的人。
explanation_english: Used to praise someone as a model or exemplar admired by generations, usually referring to a person with far-reaching influence in morality or scholarship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孔子一向被尊稱為萬世師表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung2 zi2 jat1 hoeng3 bei6 zyun1 cing1 wai4 maan6 sai3 si1 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孔子一直被尊稱為萬世師表。
examples.english_sentence: Confucius has long been revered as an exemplar for all generations.

mandarin_meaning: 万事俱备
english_meaning: everything is ready; all preparations are complete
explanation_mandarin: 表示所有準備工作都已完成，一切就緒，沒有遺漏。
explanation_english: Indicates that all preparations have been completed and everything is in readiness; nothing is left undone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婚禮快到，場地、菜單、賓客都安排晒，真係萬事俱備，可以開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 lai5 faai3 dou3, coeng4 dei6, coi3 daan1, ban1 haak3 dou1 on1 paai4 saai3, zan1 hai6 maan6 si6 geoi6 bei6, ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婚礼快到了，场地、菜单、宾客都安排好了，真是万事俱备，可以开始了。
examples.english_sentence: The wedding is almost here; the venue, menu, and guests are all arranged — everything is ready, we can start.

mandarin_meaning: 万事胜意
english_meaning: May everything go better than you wish; may all things exceed your expectations (a well-wishing phrase)
explanation_mandarin: 常用的祝福語，意思是願所有事情比心意更好，常在新年或慶祝場合用來祝福別人。
explanation_english: A common well-wishing expression meaning 'may everything turn out better than you expect.' Often used in New Year greetings or congratulatory situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，萬事勝意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, maan6 si6 sing3 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，万事胜意！
