examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year — may everything go better than you wish!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭喜升職，祝你萬事勝意，事事順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hei2 sing1 zik1, zuk1 nei5 maan6 si6 sing3 ji3, si6 si6 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭喜升职，祝你万事胜意，事事顺利。
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on the promotion — wishing you that everything exceeds your expectations and that all goes smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 万事大吉（wàn shì dà jí），表示一切顺利、吉祥
english_meaning: Everything turns out well; may all be auspicious
explanation_mandarin: 表示一切顺利、平安吉祥，常用于祝贺（如新年、庆祝）或道别时的祝福语。
explanation_english: A fixed idiomatic expression used to wish that everything will be auspicious and go well; commonly used in greetings, congratulations (e.g., New Year), or farewells.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，萬事大吉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, maan6 si6 daai6 gat1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，万事大吉！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year — may everything go well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 合同簽咗，希望萬事大吉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hap6 tung4 cim1 zo2, hei1 mong6 maan6 si6 daai6 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 合同签好了，希望万事大吉。
examples.english_sentence: The contract is signed — hope everything goes well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搬新屋？恭喜晒，萬事大吉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bun1 san1 nguk1? gung1 hei2 saai3, maan6 si6 daai6 gat1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你搬新家？恭喜，万事大吉！
examples.english_sentence: You're moving into a new home? Congratulations — may everything go smoothly!

mandarin_meaning: 万事如意（祝愿一切顺利、心想事成）
english_meaning: May everything go as you wish; may all your wishes come true.
explanation_mandarin: 用來祝福他人的固定詞語，表示希望對方事事順利、心想事成，常見於農曆新年或慶祝場合。
explanation_english: A fixed phrase used to wish someone that everything goes smoothly and their wishes come true; commonly used during Lunar New Year and other celebratory occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，萬事如意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, maan6 si6 jyu4 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，万事如意！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year — may everything go as you wish!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你考試成功，萬事如意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 haau2 si3 sing4 gung1, maan6 si6 jyu4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你考试成功，万事如意。
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you success in your exams and may everything go as you wish.

mandarin_meaning: 一切沒問題 / 万事大吉（口語）
english_meaning: Everything's fine; no problem (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「萬事得」是香港粵語口語用法，表示一切順利、沒有問題，相當於「萬事大吉」或「一切沒問題」。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial expression meaning everything is fine or no problem — similar to "all good" or "everything's OK."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心，萬事得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, maan6 si6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，万事没问题。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, everything's fine.

mandarin_meaning: 凡事都可以商量 / 萬事可以商量
english_meaning: Everything is negotiable; matters can be discussed; nothing is set in stone
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情可以商討、協商，沒有絕對不可改變的決定，常用於表示願意溝通或妥協。
explanation_english: Indicates that matters can be discussed or negotiated; used to show willingness to communicate or compromise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有咩問題，大家坐低傾下，萬事有商量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 me1 man6 tai4, daai6 gaa1 co5 dai1 king1 haa5, maan6 si6 jau5 soeng1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有什麼問題，大家坐下談談，萬事都可以商量。
examples.english_sentence: If there are any issues, let's sit down and talk — everything's negotiable.

mandarin_meaning: 万事发（即万事兴旺、万事发达），用作祝福语，祝愿对方事事发财、兴旺
english_meaning: A Cantonese blessing meaning "may everything prosper" or "may you be prosperous in all matters."
explanation_mandarin: 一個廣東話的祝賀或口語用語，表示祝願對方在事業、財運或生活各方面興旺、順利。常在新年或慶祝場合使用。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial blessing used to wish someone prosperity and success in all matters. Commonly used during Lunar New Year or other celebratory occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，萬事發！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, maan6 si6 faat3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，祝你万事发达！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year — may everything bring you prosperity!

mandarin_meaning: 万事开头难
english_meaning: All beginnings are hard; the start of something is often the most difficult.
explanation_mandarin: 表示做任何事情在开始阶段最困难，强调起步时要有耐心和毅力。
explanation_english: A proverb meaning that the beginning of any task is usually the hardest part; it emphasizes patience and persistence when starting something new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開始做生意時好辛苦，真係萬事起頭難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 ci2 zou6 saang1 ji3 si4 hou2 san1 fu2, zan1 hai6 maan6 si6 hei2 tau4 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚开始做生意的时候很辛苦，的确万事开头难。
examples.english_sentence: It was tough when I started the business; indeed, all beginnings are hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好灰心，萬事起頭難，慢慢嚟就會習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fui1 sam1, maan6 si6 hei2 tau4 naan4, maan6 maan6 lai4 zau6 wui5 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要灰心，万事开头难，慢慢来就会习惯。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be discouraged—it's always hard in the beginning; take it slow and you'll get used to it.

mandarin_meaning: 非常有把握；絕對、百分之百
english_meaning: extremely; absolutely sure (colloquial, like "120% sure")
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，用來強調程度或把握非常高，類似「百分之百」、「絕對」或「非常有把握」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to emphasize a very high degree of certainty or intensity, similar to "absolutely" or "100% sure" (often hyperbolically expressed as "120% sure").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢有萬二分嘅信心，佢一定做得到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 jau5 maan6 ji6 fan1 ge3 seon3 sam1, keoi5 jat1 ding6 zou6 dak1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對他／她非常有信心，他／她一定能做到。
examples.english_sentence: I'm extremely confident in him/her; he/she will definitely be able to do it.

mandarin_meaning: 万人空巷
english_meaning: streets emptied because everyone went out; huge turnout
explanation_mandarin: 形容某個活動吸引大量民眾參加，街道因此顯得空蕩，表達出席人數眾多或全民關注的情況。
explanation_english: An idiom describing that a huge number of people have gone out to attend an event, leaving streets seemingly empty; used to indicate massive turnout or widespread public interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚全城萬人空巷，大家都去睇個大型演唱會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zo6 maan5 cyun4 sing4 maan6 jan4 hung1 hong6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 heoi3 tai2 go3 daai6 jing4 jin2 coeng3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚全城万人空巷，大家都去看那場大型演唱會。
examples.english_sentence: Last night the whole city emptied out — everyone went to see that big concert.

mandarin_meaning: 万人迷（非常受異性或眾人喜愛、迷戀的人）
english_meaning: heartthrob; charmer; someone who attracts many admirers
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容非常受異性或眾人喜愛、迷戀的人，通常指有很大魅力或吸引力的人。
explanation_english: Describes a person who attracts admiration or infatuation from many people; a heartthrob or very popular charmer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺學校成日都好受歡迎，簡直係萬人迷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hok6 haau6 sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4, gaan2 zik6 hai6 maan6 jan4 mai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她在學校總是很受歡迎，簡直是萬人迷。
examples.english_sentence: They are always very popular at school — practically a heartthrob.

mandarin_meaning: 万分 / 非常
english_meaning: extremely; very much
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常高，用來修飾形容詞或動詞，相當於「非常」、「極其」。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high degree; used to modify adjectives or verbs, equivalent to "extremely" or "very".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫手，我萬分感激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 sau2, ngo5 maan6 fan1 gam2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮忙，我万分感激。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your help; I am extremely grateful.

mandarin_meaning: 万劫不复（形容处于极难挽回的境地，永无回头之路）
english_meaning: An idiom meaning irretrievable ruin or catastrophe; beyond redemption; no way to recover.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（作形容詞或謂語使用）
explanation_mandarin: 形容遭受極大災難、損失或墮入絕境，無法挽回或回復原狀，常用於比喻情況極其嚴重。
explanation_english: Describes a situation of extreme disaster or ruin from which there is no recovery; often used metaphorically to indicate something is irrevocably ruined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲罪行，可能會令佢萬劫不復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 zeoi6 hang4, ho2 nang4 wui5 ling6 keoi5 maan6 gip3 bat1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的那些罪行可能會使他萬劫不復。
examples.english_sentence: His crimes could condemn him to irredeemable ruin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你喺今次投資輸晒所有錢，可能真係萬劫不復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai2 gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 syu1 saai3 so2 jau5 cin2, ho2 nang4 zan1 hai6 maan6 gip3 bat1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你在這次投資把所有錢都輸光，可能真的會萬劫不復。
examples.english_sentence: If you lose all your money in this investment, you might truly be beyond recovery.

mandarin_meaning: 成千上萬；無數；各式各樣
english_meaning: many; countless; myriad; a great number of
explanation_mandarin: 表示數量很多或種類繁多，常用來形容數目龐大或多樣性。
explanation_english: Indicates a very large number or great variety; used to describe countless quantities or numerous kinds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間古董店有萬千珍寶，令我目不暇給。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gu2 dung2 dim3 jau5 maan6 cin1 zan1 bou2, ling6 ngo5 muk6 bat1 haai4 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間古董店有數不清的珍寶，使我目不暇給。
examples.english_sentence: This antique shop has countless treasures, leaving me dazzled.

mandarin_meaning: （受到）万千宠爱；被大量的爱护与溺爱
english_meaning: to be showered with love and favor; to be lavishly doted on
explanation_mandarin: 形容受到極多的寵愛與關顧，常用於表示某人被家人、愛人或群眾特別溺愛。常見用法如「受到萬千寵愛」「萬千寵愛於一身」。
explanation_english: Describes receiving a great deal of affection, favor, or pampering—often implying someone is excessively doted on by parents, a partner, or fans. Common usages include 'be showered with love' or 'to be the object of lavish affection.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自細就受父母萬千寵愛，乜嘢都有家人包辦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 sai3 zau6 sau6 fu6 mou5 maan6 cin1 cung2 oi3, mat1 je5 dou1 jau5 gaa1 jan4 baau1 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他從小就受到父母萬千寵愛，什麼都有家人包辦。
examples.english_sentence: He has been showered with his parents' love since childhood; his family takes care of everything for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成個女明星被粉絲萬千寵愛，場場演唱會都爆滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 go3 neoi5 ming4 sing1 bei6 fan2 si1 maan6 cin1 cung2 oi3, coeng4 coeng4 jin2 coeng3 wui2 dou1 baau3 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整個女明星被粉絲萬千寵愛，場場演唱會都座無虛席。
examples.english_sentence: The pop star is adored by countless fans; every concert is sold out.

mandarin_meaning: 萬國旗 / 彩旗（裝飾用的一串小旗子）
english_meaning: bunting; strings of small decorative flags
explanation_mandarin: 指慶典或活動中懸掛的一串小國旗或彩色三角旗，用作裝飾，營造節日氣氛。
explanation_english: Refers to strings of small national flags or colorful triangular flags used as decoration in celebrations or events to create a festive atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街道上掛滿咗萬國旗，個市集好有節日氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 dou6 soeng6 gwaa3 mun5 zo2 maan6 gwok3 kei4, go3 si5 zaap6 hou2 jau5 zit3 jat6 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街道上掛滿了萬國旗，市集很有節日氣氛。
examples.english_sentence: The streets were hung with bunting, and the market felt very festive.

mandarin_meaning: 木瓜（又稱番木瓜）
english_meaning: papaya (Carica papaya)
explanation_mandarin: 萬壽果指木瓜，一種熱帶水果，可生吃或入菜、打成果汁或奶昔。部分地區以「萬壽果」稱呼木瓜。
explanation_english: Refers to papaya (Carica papaya), a tropical fruit eaten raw or used in cooking, juices, and smoothies. In some regions the papaya is called '萬壽果'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個萬壽果好甜，可以用嚟整沙律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 maan6 sau6 gwo2 hou2 tim4, ho2 ji5 jung6 lai4 zing2 saa1 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个万寿果很甜，可以用来做沙拉。
examples.english_sentence: This papaya is very sweet and can be used to make a salad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 萬壽果仲未熟，等幾日先食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan6 sau6 gwo2 zung6 mei6 suk6, dang2 gei2 jat6 sin1 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 万寿果还没熟，等几天再吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: The papaya isn't ripe yet; wait a few days before eating it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我媽每日都飲一杯萬壽果奶，話對消化好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maa4 mui5 jat6 dou1 jam2 jat1 bui1 maan6 sau6 gwo2 naai5, waa6 deoi3 siu1 faa3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈每天都喝一杯木瓜牛奶，说对消化有好处。
examples.english_sentence: My mom drinks a glass of papaya milk every day; she says it's good for digestion.

mandarin_meaning: 万寿无疆（wàn shòu wú jiāng）：祝愿寿命极长、没有边际的祝寿用语
english_meaning: An idiomatic blessing meaning 'may you live for ten thousand years' or 'long life without bounds'; used to wish someone great longevity
explanation_mandarin: 漢語成語，字面為「萬年壽命無邊」，古時常用於祝賀皇帝或長者的壽辰，現多用作對長者的祝壽或戲謔式祝福。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese idiom literally meaning 'ten thousand years of life without limit.' Historically used to praise or bless emperors' longevity; today used to wish elders long life or sometimes used jokingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係阿婆八十大壽，大家一齊向佢高呼「萬壽無疆」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 aa3 po4 baat3 sap6 daai6 sau3, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 hoeng3 keoi5 gou1 fu1 "maan6 sau3 mou4 goeng1".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是奶奶八十大壽，大家一起向她高呼「萬壽無疆」。
examples.english_sentence: Today is Grandma's 80th birthday; everyone shouted 'Wan shou wu jiang' to her (wishing her boundless longevity).

mandarin_meaning: 把重要的事情交給我處理；有我在，不用擔心。
english_meaning: Leave the important/big matters to me; I've got this.
explanation_mandarin: 一種香港廣東話的口語表達，用來安慰或表明自己會負責處理重要或棘手的事情。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial expression used to reassure others or assert that the speaker will take responsibility for handling important or difficult matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心，萬大事有我，呢啲交畀我處理就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, maan6 daai6 si6 jau5 ngo5, ni1 di1 gaau1 bei2 ngo5 cyu3 lei5 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用擔心，重要的事情交給我處理就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry — leave the important matters to me, I'll handle them.

mandarin_meaning: 交給我/有我在，放心吧
english_meaning: Leave it to me; I've got this
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示有自信能應付重大或棘手的事，請他人放心把事交給自己處理。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to show confidence in handling an important or difficult task; tells others to trust and leave the matter to the speaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，萬大有我，一定整得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, maan6 daai6 jau5 ngo5, jat1 ding6 zing2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用怕，交給我，一定能處理好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, leave it to me — I'll definitely handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽好重要，萬大有我，大家放心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 hou2 zung6 jiu3, maan6 daai6 jau5 ngo5, daai6 gaa1 fong3 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛很重要，交給我，大家放心吧。
examples.english_sentence: This competition is important; leave it to me — everyone can relax.

mandarin_meaning: 万子（麻将牌的一种花色，刻有“萬”字的1到9点牌）
english_meaning: wan (the 'characters' suit in mahjong; tiles marked with the character 萬, numbered 1–9)
explanation_mandarin: 在麻将中，萬子指刻有「萬」字的一类花色牌（從一萬到九萬），常与筒子、条子并列。
explanation_english: In mahjong, 萬子 (wan/‘characters’) is the suit of tiles stamped with the character 萬, numbered 1 through 9; one of the three numbered suits alongside dots and bamboos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打麻將嗰陣，我冇萬子，輸咗幾局。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 maa4zoeng1 go2 zan6, ngo5 mou5 maan6 zi2, syu1 zo2 gei2 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打麻将的时候，我没有万子，输了好几局。
examples.english_sentence: When playing mahjong, I didn't have any wan tiles and lost several rounds.

mandarin_meaning: 万字夹（发夹/夹具），也可引申为“多功能夹/万能夹”
english_meaning: wan-zi clip (a type of clip/hairpin); by extension, an all-purpose clip
explanation_mandarin: 指一種外形或結構像“萬”字的夾子，常用作髮夾或固定物件的夾具；口語中也可比喻為能處理多種事務的“萬能夾”（較少見的引申用法）。
explanation_english: Refers to a clip whose shape or structure resembles the character '萬', commonly used as a hair clip or a fastener; colloquially it can be used figuratively to mean an all-purpose clip or someone/something versatile (less common).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家搵唔到個萬字夾，頭髮成日散晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wan2 m4 dou2 go3 maan6 zi6 gaap3, tau4 faat3 seng4 jat6 saan3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在找不到万字夹，頭髮總是散開。
examples.english_sentence: I can't find my wan-zi clip right now; my hair keeps falling apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個同事乜都識做，幾乎係萬字夾咁，邊樣都幫得手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 tung4 si6 mat1 dou1 sik1 zou6, gei2 fu1 hai6 maan6 zi6 gaap3 gam2, bin1 joeng6 dou1 bong1 dak1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個同事什麼都會做，幾乎像個萬字夾，什麼事情都能幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: That colleague can do almost anything — like an all-purpose clip; he helps with everything.

mandarin_meaning: 字底部形狀像「萬」字的部件
english_meaning: the bottom component of a Chinese character shaped like the character '萬' (wan)
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述漢字構件的術語，指字形下方類似「萬」字形的部分。常見於教學、書法或拆字時對部首、偏旁的說法。
explanation_english: A term used to describe a component in Chinese characters — specifically the bottom part that resembles the character '萬'. Commonly used in handwriting instruction, calligraphy, or when analyzing character composition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字有個萬字底，寫嘅時候要留意底部嘅筆畫方向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 jau5 go3 maan6 zi6 dai2, se2 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 lau4 ji3 dai2 bou6 ge3 bat1 waa2 fong1 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字有个万字底，写的时候要注意底部的笔画方向。
examples.english_sentence: This character has a '萬'‑shaped bottom component; when writing it you should pay attention to the direction of the bottom strokes.

mandarin_meaning: 万家灯火
english_meaning: the lights of thousands of homes; the scene of countless household lights (often describing a beautiful or bustling nightscape)
explanation_mandarin: 用于描绘夜晚许多家庭点亮灯火的景象，常用来形容城市或村落在夜间灯火通明、温馨或繁华的氛围，也可作比喻全民或众多家庭的生活状态。
explanation_english: Describes the scene of countless households with lights on at night, often used to evoke a beautiful, warm, or bustling nocturnal scene; can also metaphorically refer to the lives of many families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚喺山頂望落去，成個城市嘅萬家燈火好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 hai2 saan1 deng2 mong6 lok6 heoi3, sing4 go3 sing4 si5 ge3 maan6 gaa1 dang1 fo2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上在山顶向下望去，整个城市的万家灯火很美。
examples.english_sentence: At night, looking down from the hilltop, the city's thousands of lights are beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 万宝路（香烟品牌，Marlboro）
english_meaning: Marlboro (cigarette brand)
explanation_mandarin: 萬寶路是著名的香烟品牌（Marlboro）的中文譯名，在港澳及華語圈常用來指該品牌的香烟，有時泛指該類香烟。
explanation_english: "萬寶路" is the Chinese name for the Marlboro cigarette brand. It refers to that specific brand of cigarettes and is commonly used in Cantonese- and Mandarin-speaking areas; occasionally used generically for that type of cigarette.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買包萬寶路，有冇邊度賣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 baau1 maan6 bou2 lou6, jau5 mou5 bin1 dou6 maai6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买包万宝路，有没有哪里卖？
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a pack of Marlboros — do you know where they sell them?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意抽煙，通常都抽萬寶路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 cau1 jin1, tung1 soeng4 dou1 cau1 maan6 bou2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢抽烟，通常都抽万宝路。
examples.english_sentence: He likes smoking; he usually smokes Marlboros.

mandarin_meaning: 万年历 (指可查询/换算长时间范围内日期、农历与公历等的历表或工具)
english_meaning: perpetual calendar; a calendar/tool that lets you check dates across many years and convert between calendars
explanation_mandarin: 指能查詢或換算多年日期、星期、節氣、農曆與公曆對照等資料的曆表或工具（如書籍、網站或應用程式）。
explanation_english: A calendar or tool that covers many years (a perpetual calendar), used to look up dates, weekdays, lunar/solar conversions, and related calendrical information over long periods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用萬年曆查返今年農曆新年係幾時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 maan6 nin4 lik6 caa4 faan1 gam1 nin4 nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 hai6 gei2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用万年历查今年农历新年是哪一天。
examples.english_sentence: I used a perpetual calendar to check when the Lunar New Year falls this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個網站有個萬年曆，可以查公曆同農曆之間嘅轉換。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 jau5 go3 maan6 nin4 lik6, ho2 ji5 caa4 gung1 lik6 tung4 nung4 lik6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 zyun2 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个网站有个万年历，可以查询公历和农历之间的转换。
examples.english_sentence: This website has a perpetual calendar that can convert between the Gregorian calendar and the lunar calendar.

mandarin_meaning: 长期处于替补或固定不变位置的人；长期没被提升或替换的人（口语、贬义或戏谑）
english_meaning: A perennial fixture/benchwarmer — someone who stays in the same (often secondary) role for a very long time, implying stagnation; slang (often joking or disparaging).
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俗語，形容某人長期處於替補、固定或無升遷機會的位置，帶有玩笑或輕視意味。常用於工作、隊伍或團體中。
explanation_english: Hong Kong Cantonese slang describing a person who remains in a backup/unchanging position for a long time, suggesting no promotion or change; often used jokingly or pejoratively. Commonly applied in workplaces, teams, or groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺隊入面做咗萬年油，成日只係替補，無機會上場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 deoi6 jap6 min6 zou6 zo2 maan6 nin4 jau4, sing4 jat6 zi2 hai6 tai3 bou2, mou5 gei1 wui6 soeng5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在队里当了万年油，总是替补，没有上场的机会。
examples.english_sentence: He’s been a perennial benchwarmer on the team, always a substitute with no chance to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人喺公司做咗幾十年都冇升職，真係萬年油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 hai2 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 dou1 mou5 sing1 zik1, zan1 hai6 maan6 nin4 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人在公司做了几十年都没有升职，真是万年油。
examples.english_sentence: Some people have worked at the company for decades without promotion — they’re real perennial fixtures.

mandarin_meaning: 万念俱灰（彻底绝望、丧失所有希望）
english_meaning: to be utterly despondent; to lose all hope; completely disheartened
explanation_mandarin: 形容人因遭遇打击或挫折而彻底失去信心、希望，感到非常绝望。
explanation_english: Describes a state of complete despair after setbacks or misfortunes, when someone loses all hope and confidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試失敗之後，佢萬念俱灰，唔想再試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 sat1 baai6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 maan6 nim6 geoi6 fui1, m4 soeng2 zoi3 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试失败之后，他万念俱灰，不想再试。
examples.english_sentence: After failing the exam, he was utterly despondent and didn't want to try again.

mandarin_meaning: 万恶（wàn'è）
english_meaning: extremely evil; heinous
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常邪惡、可憎，常用來形容人或行為極其惡劣，有時出現在成語或強烈評斷的語境中。
explanation_english: Denotes extreme wickedness or heinousness; used to describe people or actions that are morally very bad. Often appears in emphatic expressions or idioms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲行為真係萬惡，害咗咁多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 hang4 wai6 zan1 hai6 maan6 ngok3, hoi6 zo2 gam2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行為真是萬惡，害了這麼多人。
examples.english_sentence: His actions are truly wicked; they harmed so many people.

mandarin_meaning: 在眾多罪惡中，淫欲為首
english_meaning: Of all evils, lust (sexual desire) is foremost
explanation_mandarin: 一句傳統倫理道德說法，表示在各種惡行中，淫欲（性放縱）是最應受譴責或最危害的。
explanation_english: A traditional moral proverb stating that among all evils, sexual lust or indulgence is the chief one and should be condemned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都話「萬惡淫為首」，叫我哋唔好沉迷色慾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 'maan6 ngok3 jam4 wai4 sau2', giu3 ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 cam4 mai4 sik1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈常说“万恶淫为首”，叫我们不要沉迷色欲。
examples.english_sentence: My mother often says 'Of all evils, lust is foremost,' telling us not to be consumed by sexual desire.

mandarin_meaning: 万恶以淫为首（意指淫欲是諸惡之首）
english_meaning: Among all evils, lust/sexual immorality is the foremost
explanation_mandarin: 一句傳統格言或道德說法，強調淫欲（性放縱）是諸多惡行中的首要根源，常見於宗教或倫理勸誡的語境中。
explanation_english: A traditional proverb warning that lust or sexual immorality is the chief of all evils; commonly used in religious or moral contexts to caution against uncontrolled sexual desire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教會長老成日引用「萬惡淫爲首」嚟提醒信徒戒除淫慾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 wui6 zoeng2 lou5 seng4 jat6 jan5 jung6 「maan6 ok3 jam4 wai4 sau2」lai4 tai4 sing2 seon3 tou4 gaai3 ceoi4 jam4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教會長老經常引用「萬惡淫為首」來提醒信徒戒除淫慾。
examples.english_sentence: Church elders often cite 'among all evils, lust is foremost' to remind believers to curb sexual desire.

mandarin_meaning: 万有引力
english_meaning: universal gravitation; gravity (the attractive force between masses)
explanation_mandarin: 指牛頓提出的萬有引力，即任何有質量的物體之間相互吸引的力。也可用作比喻，指強烈的吸引力。
explanation_english: Refers to Newton's universal gravitation — the attractive force between masses. Can also be used metaphorically to mean a powerful attraction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牛頓提出咗萬有引力定律，解釋咗天體之間嘅引力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngau4 deon6 tai4 ceot1 zo2 maan6 jau5 jan5 lik6 ding6 leot6, gaai2 sik1 zo2 tin1 tai2 zi1 gaan1 ge3 jan5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牛顿提出了万有引力定律，解释了天体之间的引力。
examples.english_sentence: Newton proposed the law of universal gravitation, explaining the attractive force between celestial bodies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰兩個人好似受咗萬有引力影響，成日黐埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 loeng5 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 sau6 zo2 maan6 jau5 jan5 lik6 jing2 hoeng2, sing4 jat6 ci1 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那兩個人好像受了万有引力的影響，整天黏在一起。
examples.english_sentence: Those two seem affected by a universal attraction, always sticking together.

mandarin_meaning: 万岁（祝願長壽或表示歡呼）
english_meaning: long live; hurrah; an exclamation wishing long life
explanation_mandarin: 用作祝願某人或事物長壽或作為歡呼、慶祝的喊聲，字面意為「一萬年」，常用於祝賀或呼喊（如「皇上萬歲」或群眾歡呼）。
explanation_english: An exclamation used to wish someone or something long life or to express cheering/celebration. Literally means "ten thousand years," commonly used in phrases like "Long live the..." or as a jubilant shout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家一齊喊：萬歲！萬歲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 haam3: maan6 seoi3! maan6 seoi3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家一起喊：万岁！万岁！
examples.english_sentence: Everyone shouts: "Long live! Long live!"

examples.cantonese_sentence: 皇上萬歲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong4 soeng6 maan6 seoi3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 皇上万岁！
examples.english_sentence: Long live the Emperor!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋終於完成咗，萬歲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 jyun4 sing4 zo2, maan6 seoi3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们终于完成了，万岁！
examples.english_sentence: We finally finished — hooray!

mandarin_meaning: 万水千山 (历经许多艰难险阻/路途遥远)
english_meaning: literally 'ten thousand waters and a thousand mountains' — used to describe long, arduous journeys or many hardships one has endured
explanation_mandarin: “萬水千山”字面指眾多的河流和山嶺，常用來形容路途遙遠或經歷了許多困難與艱辛，強調經歷的不易或距離的遙遠。
explanation_english: Literally refers to countless rivers and mountains; commonly used to emphasize long, difficult journeys or many hardships and obstacles someone has gone through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗見你，我穿過萬水千山嚟到呢度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gin3 nei5, ngo5 cyun1 gwo3 maan6 seoi2 cin1 saan1 lai4 dou3 ni1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了见你，我穿过千山万水来到这里。
examples.english_sentence: I crossed countless mountains and rivers to come here to see you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷經萬水千山，我哋終於重逢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 ging1 maan6 seoi2 cin1 saan1, ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 cung4 fung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历经千山万水，我们终于重逢。
examples.english_sentence: After going through so much, we finally reunited.

mandarin_meaning: 万无一失（完全不会出错；绝对可靠）
english_meaning: absolutely foolproof; fail-safe; certain to succeed; no chance of error
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事情非常可靠或安全，沒有任何失誤或失敗的可能。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe something as completely reliable or safe, with no possibility of error or failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次比賽我哋做足準備，應該萬無一失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 zuk1 zeon2 bei6, jing1 goi1 maan6 mou4 jat1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们准备充分，应该万无一失。
examples.english_sentence: We have prepared thoroughly for this competition; it should be absolutely foolproof.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好太相信佢講嘅保證，世事冇嘢真係可以萬無一失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 taai3 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 bou2 zing3, sai3 si6 mou5 je5 zan1 hai6 ho2 ji5 maan6 mou4 jat1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别太相信他/她的保证，世事没有什么真的可以万无一失。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put too much faith in their guarantee; nothing in life is truly foolproof.

mandarin_meaning: 万物
english_meaning: all things; everything
explanation_mandarin: 指世間的一切事物，泛指所有存在的東西，常用於哲學或文學語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to all things or everything in existence; used collectively to denote all creatures/objects, often in philosophical or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宇宙萬物都有佢嘅規律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 zau6 maan6 mat6 dou1 jau5 keoi5 ge3 gwai1 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宇宙万物都有它的规律。
examples.english_sentence: All things in the universe follow their own laws.

mandarin_meaning: 万物之灵（指人类，是万物中最有灵性或最聪明的存在）
english_meaning: the spirit/intelligent being of all creation; used to describe humans as the most sentient/intelligent of all creatures
explanation_mandarin: 成语/短语，常用来指人类是万物中最有灵性的存在，强调人的智慧或统御地位，有时用于讨论人类与自然的关系时带有价值判断。
explanation_english: An idiomatic phrase used to refer to humans as the most sentient or intelligent beings among all creatures; often emphasizes human intelligence or dominion and can carry evaluative meaning when discussing humans' relationship with nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人話人類係萬物之靈，但係我覺得我哋應該對大自然更尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 jan4 leoi6 hai6 maan6 mat6 zi1 ling4, daan6 hai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 deoi3 daai6 zi6 jin4 gang3 zeon1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人说人类是万物之灵，但我觉得我们应该更尊重大自然。
examples.english_sentence: Some people say humans are the spirit of all creation, but I think we should show more respect to nature.

mandarin_meaning: 万用（表示可用于多种用途或多种场合）
english_meaning: multipurpose; versatile; all-purpose
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物或某事具有廣泛用途，可用於多種情況或目的。
explanation_english: Indicates something that can be used for many purposes or in many situations; multipurpose or versatile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個萬用插頭可以喺唔同國家用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 maan6 jung6 caat3 tau4 ho2 ji5 hai2 m4 tung4 gwok3 gaa1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个万用插头可以在不同国家使用。
examples.english_sentence: This universal plug can be used in different countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件萬用工具好實用，無論維修定手作都用到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 maan6 jung6 gung1 geoi6 hou2 sat6 jung6, mou4 leon6 wai4 sau1 ding6 sau2 zok3 dou1 jung6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件万用工具很实用，无论维修还是手工都能用到。
examples.english_sentence: This multipurpose tool is very practical; it can be used for repairs or crafts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗支萬用膠，黐得好實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zi1 maan6 jung6 gaau1, ci1 dak1 hou2 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一支万用胶，黏得很好。
examples.english_sentence: I bought an all-purpose glue; it holds very well.

mandarin_meaning: 多功能刀；萬能小刀（可指折疊刀或工用刀）
english_meaning: utility knife; multipurpose knife
explanation_mandarin: 指一種多用途的小刀或工具刀，用於切割、開箱或作為多功能隨身工具，有時也指瑞士軍刀類型的折疊多功能刀具。
explanation_english: Refers to a multipurpose small knife or utility blade used for cutting, opening boxes, or general everyday tasks; can also mean a folding multi-tool like a Swiss Army knife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房有把萬用刀，可以幫手切蘋果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 jau5 baa2 maan6 jung6 dou1, ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 cit3 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房裡有把萬用刀，可以幫忙切蘋果。
examples.english_sentence: There's a utility knife in the kitchen; it can help cut apples.

mandarin_meaning: 万用表（万用电表），用于测量电压、电流、电阻等电气参数的仪器。
english_meaning: Multimeter — an instrument used to measure electrical quantities such as voltage, current, and resistance.
explanation_mandarin: 一種可以測量電壓、電流、電阻、通斷等多種電氣參數的便攜式儀器，常用於電工與電子維修檢測。
explanation_english: A portable instrument that measures electrical quantities (voltage, current, resistance, continuity, etc.), commonly used in electrical and electronic testing and repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部萬用表壞咗，量唔到電壓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 maan6 jung6 biu2 waai6 zo2, loeng4 m4 dou3 din6 aat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的万用表坏了，量不了电压。
examples.english_sentence: My multimeter is broken; it can't measure the voltage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用萬用表測下電路有冇短路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 maan6 jung6 biu2 cak1 haa5 din6 lou6 jau5 mou5 dyun2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用万用表测试电路有没有短路。
examples.english_sentence: Use the multimeter to check whether the circuit has a short.

mandarin_meaning: 萬用表（用來測量電壓、電流和電阻等的儀器）
english_meaning: multimeter (a handheld instrument for measuring voltage, current, resistance, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 一種手持電子測量儀器，用於測量電壓（V）、電流（A）、電阻（Ω）等參數，廣泛用於電子和電氣維修與測試。
explanation_english: A handheld electronic measuring instrument used to measure electrical quantities such as voltage (V), current (A), and resistance (Ω). Commonly used in electronics and electrical troubleshooting and testing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部萬用錶壞咗，量唔到電壓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 maan6 jung6 biu1 waai6 zo2, loeng4 m4 dou3 din6 ngaat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的萬用表壞了，量不到電壓。
examples.english_sentence: My multimeter is broken; it can't measure the voltage.

mandarin_meaning: 万众一心；大家团结一致
english_meaning: All the people united as one; united in purpose; to band together
explanation_mandarin: 表示广大人民或一群人团结一致、齐心协力，常用于鼓舞士气或强调团结的重要性。
explanation_english: Indicates that the people or a group are united as one and work together; often used to rally morale or emphasize the importance of unity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，大家要萬眾一心，齊心抗疫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 cing4 kei4 gaan1, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 maan6 zung3 jat1 sam1, cai4 sam1 kong3 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期间，大家要万众一心，齐心抗疫。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic, everyone must unite as one to fight the epidemic.

mandarin_meaning: 萬箭穿心（wàn jiàn chuān xīn）：形容極度悲痛，好像心被萬箭穿透。
english_meaning: To feel as if ten thousand arrows pierce one's heart; to be extremely heartbroken or agonized.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（比喻性形容詞/動詞短語）
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容極度悲傷或痛苦，心如被無數箭矢刺穿，常表示遭受重大情感打擊。
explanation_english: A figurative expression describing extreme grief or emotional pain, as if the heart were pierced by countless arrows; often used when someone suffers a severe emotional blow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到嗰個消息，感到萬箭穿心，忍唔住喊咗出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go2 go3 siu1 sik1, gam2 dou6 maan6 zin3 cyun1 sam1, jan2 m4 zyu6 haam3 zo2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到那個消息，感到萬箭穿心，忍不住哭了出來。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard the news, he felt as if ten thousand arrows had pierced his heart and couldn't stop crying.

mandarin_meaning: 万紫千红（形容繁花盛开、色彩绚烂的景象）
english_meaning: A riot of colour; resplendent with many colours — often used to describe flowers in full bloom or a vividly coloured scene.
explanation_mandarin: 形容繁花盛开、色彩絢爛的景象，常用來描寫春天、花園或一片多彩的景致。
explanation_english: Describes a scene rich in varied and brilliant colours, especially of flowers in full bloom; literally 'ten thousand purples, thousand reds', meaning a magnificent profusion of colours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天個公園入面啲花開得萬紫千紅，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 go3 gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 di1 faa1 hoi1 dak1 maan6 zi2 cin1 hung4, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天公园里的花开得万紫千红，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: In spring, the flowers in the park are blooming in a riot of colors — very beautiful.

jyutping: maan6 luk6 cung4 zung1 jat1 dim2 hung4
mandarin_meaning: 萬綠叢中一點紅（万绿丛中一点红）
english_meaning: A lone spot of red in a sea of green — someone or something that stands out conspicuously from its surroundings.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在一片相同或平凡的事物中，只有一個人或物格外顯眼、突出。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing that is strikingly noticeable or outstanding among many similar or monotonous others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺一班人全部着黑衫嘅時候，佢着嗰件紅色外套真係萬綠叢中一點紅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jat1 baan1 jan4 cyun4 bou6 zoek3 hak1 saam1 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 zoek3 go2 gin6 hung4 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 zan1 hai6 maan6 luk6 cung4 zung1 jat1 dim2 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在一群人都穿黑色衬衫的时候，他穿的那件红色外套真是万绿丛中一点红。
examples.english_sentence: When everyone in the group was wearing black shirts, the red jacket he wore really stood out.

mandarin_meaning: 万圣节 (Wànshèngjié)
english_meaning: Halloween
explanation_mandarin: 西方的節日，通常在每年10月31日，習俗包括化妝、要糖和舉辦化妝派對等。
explanation_english: A Western holiday on October 31st, commonly celebrated with costumes, trick-or-treating, and costume parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今年萬聖節有冇打算扮鬼呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 nin4 maan6 sing3 zit3 jau5 mou5 daa2 syun3 baan6 gwai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今年万圣节有没有打算扮鬼？
examples.english_sentence: Are you planning to dress up as a ghost this Halloween?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校喺萬聖節會舉辦化妝舞會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 hai2 maan6 sing3 zit3 wui5 geoi2 baan6 faa3 zong1 mou5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校在万圣节会举办化妆舞会。
examples.english_sentence: The school will hold a costume party on Halloween.

mandarin_meaning: 万能 (wànnéng)：能做很多事或适用于多种用途，常用来表示非常灵活或几乎无所不能（有时夸张）。
english_meaning: omnipotent; all-purpose; versatile — able to do many things or suitable for many uses (sometimes used hyperbolically).
explanation_mandarin: 「萬能」用來形容人或物能做很多不同的事情或適用於多種情況，有時為誇張用法，例如說某物『萬能』表示用途廣泛、功能齊全。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing that can do many different tasks or is suitable for many situations. It can be hyperbolic — saying something is "万能" often means it is very versatile or multi-purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢係萬能，但其實都唔係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 hai6 maan6 nang4, daan6 kei4 sat6 dou1 m4 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己是萬能，但其實並非如此。
examples.english_sentence: He claims he can do everything, but actually he's not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機萬能到可以做晒好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 maan6 nang4 dou3 ho2 ji5 zou6 saai3 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機萬能到可以做很多事。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is so versatile that it can do many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽好萬能，煮得又識縫衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 hou2 maan6 nang4, zyu2 dak1 jau6 sik1 fung4 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我媽媽很萬能，會煮飯也會縫衣服。
examples.english_sentence: My mom is very capable — she can cook and also sew clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 萬能鑰匙（引申為能解決各種問題的人或方法）
english_meaning: master key; a '万能 key' — literally a key that opens many locks; figuratively someone or something that can solve many problems
explanation_mandarin: 「萬能key」是香港粵語俚語，來自英文 key，字面意思是能打開多把鎖的鑰匙；引申用法指能解決各種問題的人、方法或工具，有時也用來指萬用密碼或通用工具。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term borrowed from English 'key'. Literally 'master key' that opens many locks; figuratively someone or something that can handle or solve many kinds of problems. It can also refer to a universal passcode or multi-purpose tool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋隊嘅萬能key，乜嘢問題佢都可以幫手解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 deoi6 ge3 maan6 nang4 kei4, mat1 je5 man6 tai4 keoi5 dou1 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們隊的萬能鑰匙，什麼問題他都能幫忙解決。
examples.english_sentence: He's our team's 'master key' — he can help solve any problem.

mandarin_meaning: 萬能插座／多功能插座（可接受多種插頭或有多個插孔的延長插座或轉接器）
english_meaning: universal power strip / multi-socket adapter (a power strip or adapter that accepts multiple plug types or provides multiple outlets)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指能夠接納不同國家插頭或提供多個插位的插座或轉接器，常用於家居或旅行時為多個電子設備供電或充電。
explanation_english: Colloquial term referring to a power strip or adapter that accepts different plug types or provides multiple outlets; commonly used at home or when traveling to power or charge several electronic devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買個萬能插蘇放喺客廳，咁啲電子產品就可以一齊充電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 go3 maan6 nang4 caap3 sou1 fong3 hai2 haak3 teng1, gam2 di1 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2 zau6 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 cung1 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買一個萬能插座放在客廳，這樣電子產品就可以一起充電。
examples.english_sentence: Buy a universal power strip for the living room so electronic devices can all be charged together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去旅行記得帶個萬能插蘇，先可以插埋唔同國家嘅插頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 gei3 dak1 daai3 go3 maan6 nang4 caap3 sou1, sin1 ho2 ji5 caap3 maai4 m4 tung4 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 caap3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去旅行記得帶萬能插座，這樣才能接上不同國家的插頭。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring a universal adapter when traveling so you can plug in plugs from different countries.

mandarin_meaning: 萬能老倌（萬事通、萬能老手）
english_meaning: jack-of-all-trades; handy person; someone who seems able to do anything
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指樣樣都懂、能處理各種工作或問題的人，常用於口語或戲謔語境，有時帶有誇張或自誇的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who can do many different tasks — a jack-of-all-trades or handy person. Used colloquially and often jocularly; can imply boastful competence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿華係個萬能老倌，屋企啲水電、電腦問題佢都整得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 waa4 hai6 go3 maan6 nang4 lou5 gwan1, uk1 kei5 di1 seoi2 din6, din6 nou5 man6 tai4 keoi5 dou1 zing2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿華是個萬能老倌，家裡的水電、電腦問題他都能處理。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Wah is a jack-of-all-trades — he can handle the plumbing, electrical and computer problems at home.

mandarin_meaning: 万能胶；强力粘合剂
english_meaning: super glue; multi-purpose adhesive
explanation_mandarin: 一种强力、多用途的黏合剂，用于粘接各类材料。有时也用作比喻，表示难以修补或难以挽回的事物无法用简单的方法解决。
explanation_english: A strong, multi-purpose adhesive used to bond various materials. Sometimes used figuratively to indicate that something cannot be easily fixed or salvaged with a simple solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用萬能膠黐返個杯柄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 maan6 nang4 gaau1 ci1 faan1 go3 bui1 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用万能胶把杯柄粘回来了。
examples.english_sentence: I used super glue to reattach the cup handle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連萬能膠都救唔到呢樣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 maan6 nang4 gaau1 dou1 gau3 m4 dou2 ni1 joeng6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 连万能胶也救不了这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Even super glue can't fix this.

mandarin_meaning: 指稱某個姓蘇的人，戲稱他無所不能或樣樣都會（俗稱、俚語用法）。
english_meaning: A joking/affectionate label for someone with the surname So who seems able to do everything; a 'jack-of-all-trades' (slang).
explanation_mandarin: 「萬能蘇」多用作粵語口語或網絡用語，稱讚或戲稱姓蘇的人很能幹、甚麼都識做，但通常帶有輕鬆或幽默的語氣。
explanation_english: Used in Cantonese speech or online as a humorous or admiring nickname for someone surnamed So who appears very capable and can handle many tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係萬能蘇，咩都識整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 maan6 nang4 sou1, me1 dou1 sik1 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是「萬能蘇」，什麼都會修／做。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a '萬能蘇' — he can fix or do anything.

mandarin_meaning: 万般（各种、所有种类）
english_meaning: all kinds; every sort; all possible
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 数量词（表示各种、所有类别）
explanation_mandarin: 表示各種、所有類別或程度的總稱，常用於「萬般⋯⋯」或固定短語如「萬般無奈」中，屬於修飾語，用來強調範圍或程度。
explanation_english: Indicates all kinds or every sort; a modifier/quantifier used to refer to the full range of types or degrees. Often appears in phrases like "萬般無奈."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生有萬般困難，都要堅持落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 jau5 maan6 baan1 kwan3 naan6, dou1 jiu3 gin1 ci4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生有万般困难，都要坚持下去。
examples.english_sentence: Life has all kinds of difficulties; you must keep going.

mandarin_meaning: 萬花筒（光學玩具）；比喻多彩多變的事物或景象
english_meaning: kaleidoscope (optical toy); metaphorically, a colorful, ever-changing scene or mixture
explanation_mandarin: 指一種由鏡子和彩色碎片組成的光學玩具，透過旋轉可產生不斷變化的對稱圖案；引申為形容事物色彩豐富或變化多端。
explanation_english: An optical toy made of mirrors and colored pieces that creates constantly changing symmetrical patterns when rotated; used figuratively to describe something colorful or ever-changing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚嘅城市燈光，好似一個萬花筒，變幻無窮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 ge3 sing4 si5 dang1 gwong1, hou2 ci5 jat1 go3 maan6 faa1 tung2, bin3 waan6 mou4 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上的城市燈光像一個萬花筒，變化無窮。
examples.english_sentence: The city's lights at night are like a kaleidoscope, ever-changing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人生就係一個萬花筒，充滿咗唔同嘅經歷同色彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 saang1 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 maan6 faa1 tung2, cung1 mun5 zo2 m4 tung4 ge3 ging1 lik6 tung4 sik1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人生就像一個萬花筒，充滿了不同的經歷和色彩。
examples.english_sentence: His life is like a kaleidoscope, full of varied experiences and colors.

mandarin_meaning: （用於否定或強調）千萬、絕對不要、萬萬不可
english_meaning: absolutely/ by no means; used to strongly emphasize prohibition or impossibility
explanation_mandarin: 用來強調否定或可能性極小，常與“不/唔/不要/不可”等詞連用，表示“絕對不要”或“萬萬不能”。
explanation_english: An emphatic adverb used to stress prohibition or impossibility; often used with negatives to mean 'must never' or 'by no means'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日萬萬唔好遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 maan6 maan6 m4 hou2 ci4 dou3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天千万别迟到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be late today under any circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事萬萬唔可以畀人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 maan6 maan6 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 jan4 zi1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事千万不能让别人知道。
examples.english_sentence: You must never let anyone know about this.

mandarin_meaning: 万众一心（大家团结一致）
english_meaning: to unite as one; all people of one mind; united effort
explanation_mandarin: 表示所有人團結一致，齊心協力去完成某個目標或應付某種情況。
explanation_english: Expresses that many people unite with one mind and work together to achieve a goal or face a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對疫情，市民要萬衆一心，一齊抗疫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 jik6 cing4, si5 man4 jiu3 maan6 zung3 jat1 sam1, jat1 cai4 kong3 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对疫情，市民要万众一心，齐心抗疫。
examples.english_sentence: Facing the epidemic, citizens must unite as one to fight the virus.

mandarin_meaning: 万众一心
english_meaning: to unite as one; the masses united with one heart
explanation_mandarin: 形容很多人团结一致，齐心协力为同一目标努力，常用于强调集体合作与一致的意志。
explanation_english: Describes many people united as one, working together toward the same goal; often used to emphasize collective cooperation and shared determination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺今次嘅抗疫期間，大家都萬衆一心，齊心抗疫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam1 ci3 ge3 kong3 jik6 kei4 gaan1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 maan6 zung3 jat1 sam1, cai4 sam1 kong3 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这次抗疫期间，大家都万众一心，齐心抗疫。
examples.english_sentence: During this epidemic, everyone united as one to fight the outbreak.

mandarin_meaning: 万试万灵（意指某种方法、偏方或东西屡试不爽、非常灵验）
english_meaning: foolproof; works every time; highly effective (used for a method, remedy, or trick that never seems to fail)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某種做法或偏方非常靈驗、多次嘗試都有效，常用於口語或俗語語境。
explanation_english: Used to describe a method, remedy, or trick that is extremely effective and consistently works; commonly used in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法真係萬試萬靈，我試過幾次都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1faat3 zan1 hai6 maan6 si3 maan6 ling4, ngo5 si3 gwo3 gei2 ci3 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法真是万试万灵，我试过好几次都有效。
examples.english_sentence: This method is really foolproof; I've tried it several times and it worked every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話呢隻藥膏萬試萬靈，但我覺得未必咁準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ni1 zek3 joek6 gou1 maan6 si3 maan6 ling4, daan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 mei6 bit1 gam2 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这款药膏万试万灵，但我觉得未必那么准。
examples.english_sentence: He says this ointment always works, but I don't think it's necessarily that reliable.

jyutping: maan6 bin3 bat1 lei4 kei4 zung1
mandarin_meaning: 无论如何变化，都不脱离根本或本质（万变不离其宗）
english_meaning: No matter how many changes occur, the fundamental principle or essence remains unchanged.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物表面或形式可能千变万化，但不脱离其根本、本质或宗旨。
explanation_english: Indicates that despite many apparent changes in form or appearance, the core principle, essence, or purpose remains the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然公司嘅營銷手法日日變，但萬變不離其宗，始終係以客為本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1jin4 gung1si1 ge3 jing4siu1 sau2faat3 jat6 jat6 bin3, daan6 maan6 bin3 bat1 lei4 kei4 zung1, ci2zung1 hai6 ji5 haak3 wai4 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然公司的營銷手法天天變，但萬變不離其宗，始終以顧客為本。
examples.english_sentence: Although the company's marketing tactics change every day, fundamentally things don't change — it's always customer-oriented.

mandarin_meaning: 万象（指世間萬物或各種現象）
english_meaning: the myriad phenomena; all things; everything
explanation_mandarin: 「萬象」指世間各種事物或現象的總稱，常用於成語如「萬象更新」，表示事物煥然一新或世事萬變。
explanation_english: Refers to all things or the myriad phenomena of the world. Often used in expressions like "万象更新" to denote a general renewal or the variety of things in the universe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天來到，山野間萬象更新，百花齊放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 loi4 dou3, saan1 je5 gaan1 maan6 zoeng6 gung1 san1, baak3 faa1 cai4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天來了，山野間萬象更新，百花齊放。
examples.english_sentence: With spring's arrival, everything in the hills and fields is renewed and flowers bloom everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 書展展示咗世界文化嘅萬象，吸引唔少人嚟參觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 zin2 zin2 si6 zo2 sai3 gaai3 man4 faa3 ge3 maan6 zoeng6, kap1 jan5 m4 siu2 jan4 lai4 caam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 書展展示了世界文化的萬象，吸引了不少人來參觀。
examples.english_sentence: The book fair displayed the myriad aspects of world cultures, attracting many visitors.

mandarin_meaning: 万象更新 (wàn xiàng gēng xīn) — 表示事物焕然一新，常用于新年或重大变革后
english_meaning: Everything takes on a new look; renewal; a fresh start
explanation_mandarin: 形容萬物煥然一新，常用於新年或重大變動後，表示新的氣象與希望。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everything appears renewed or refreshed; often used for the New Year or after major changes to express a sense of renewal and hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年到，萬象更新，大家都有新希望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 dou3, maan6 zoeng6 gang1 san1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 san1 hei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年到了，万象更新，大家都有新的希望。
examples.english_sentence: With the New Year here, everything is renewed; everyone has new hopes.

mandarin_meaning: 万里长城（中國的長城）
english_meaning: The Great Wall (of China)
explanation_mandarin: 指中國古代的長城防禦工程，橫貫北方多個省份，歷史悠久且具有重要的文化象徵意義。
explanation_english: Refers to the Great Wall of China, the ancient defensive fortifications stretching across northern China; historically significant and a cultural symbol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上個暑假去咗萬里長城，景色好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 go3 syu1 gaa3 heoi3 zo2 maan6 lei5 coeng4 sing4, ging2 sik1 hou2 zong6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上个暑假去了万里长城，风景很壮观。
examples.english_sentence: I went to the Great Wall last summer; the scenery was magnificent.

mandarin_meaning: 万金油；万能的东西或万能的人，有时指万灵药（万能药）
english_meaning: a jack-of-all-trades; a cure-all or something/someone seen as万能 (万能的东西/人)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容能做很多不同事情的人或被視為能解決多種問題的東西（有時指萬靈藥）。根據上下文可指人的多才多藝或物品/藥物的廣泛適用性。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person who can do many different tasks or something considered capable of solving many problems (sometimes meaning a cure-all). Depending on context it can mean versatile person or broadly useful item/medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅萬金油，乜嘢都識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1si1 ge3 maan6 gam1 jau4, mat1 je5 dou1 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司的万金油，什么都能做。
examples.english_sentence: He's the company's jack-of-all-trades — he can do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種藥唔係萬金油，唔可以亂用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 joek6 m4 hai6 maan6 gam1 jau4, m4 ho2 ji5 lyun6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种药不是万金油，不能乱用。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine isn't a cure-all; it shouldn't be used indiscriminately.

mandarin_meaning: 万隆（印度尼西亚城市，西爪哇省省会）
english_meaning: Bandung (city in Indonesia, capital of West Java)
explanation_mandarin: 萬隆是印度尼西亞西爪哇省的省會城市，為重要的文化與教育中心，歷史上亦因1955年的萬隆會議而知名。
explanation_english: Bandung is the capital city of West Java, Indonesia. It's an important cultural and educational center and is historically notable for the 1955 Bandung Conference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去印尼萬隆旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 jan3 nei4 maan6 lung4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去印度尼西亚的万隆旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Bandung, Indonesia next month.

mandarin_meaning: 形容人很多，擠在一起；與「人山人海」、「熙熙攘攘」意思相近
english_meaning: Describes a scene swarming with people; literally 'ten thousand heads gathered together' — very crowded and bustling
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (descriptive phrase; used adjectivally or verbally)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人很多、擠在一起的熱鬧或擁擠場面，常用於描述市集、節慶或公共場所的人潮。
explanation_english: Used to describe a bustling, tightly packed crowd; commonly applied to markets, festivals, or public places filled with people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個新年市集真係萬頭攢動，人多到行都行唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 san1 nin4 si5 zaap6 zan1 hai6 maan6 tau4 zyun2 dung6, jan4 do1 dou3 haang4 dou1 haang4 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年市集真是萬頭攢動，人太多走不動。
examples.english_sentence: The Lunar New Year market was absolutely packed — there were so many people you couldn't move.

mandarin_meaning: 萬馬奔騰 (wàn mǎ bēn téng)：原指成千上萬的馬兒奔騰，形容場面壯觀或氣勢浩大。
english_meaning: Literally 'ten thousand horses galloping'; used figuratively to describe a spectacular scene, overwhelming momentum, or a surging, vigorous force.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻氣勢雄偉、聲勢浩大或場面熱鬧、洶湧澎湃，常用來形容大規模的場面或強勁的氣勢。
explanation_english: Used metaphorically to describe great momentum, a spectacular or tumultuous scene, or an overwhelming display of energy or force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽最後嗰圈，衝線嗰陣真係好似萬馬奔騰，觀眾全部起哄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 zeoi3 hau6 go2 hyun1, cung1 sin3 go2 zan6 zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 maan6 maa5 ban1 tang4, gun1 zung3 cyun4 bou6 hei2 hung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽最後一圈，衝線時真的像萬馬奔騰，觀眾全都起哄。
examples.english_sentence: In the final lap of the race, crossing the finish line felt like ten thousand horses galloping; the crowd was roaring.

mandarin_meaning: 萱（萱草），一種多年生草本植物；古代常以萱草象徵忘憂，也常見於人名
english_meaning: Daylily (Hemerocallis); in classical usage a symbol for 'forgetting worries' and used as a feminine given name
explanation_mandarin: 萱（xuān）通常指萱草（又稱忘憂草），是一種日間開花的多年生草本植物。古代詩文常用萱草象徵忘憂或思母，亦常用作人名或名字的一部分。
explanation_english: The character refers to the daylily (Hemerocallis), a perennial herbaceous plant that blooms during the day. In classical Chinese literature it is often associated with 'forgetting worries' and filial or maternal themes; it is also used as a feminine given name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽喺屋企後園種咗啲萱草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 hai2 uk1 kei5 hau6 jyun4 zung3 zo2 di1 hyun1 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈在屋后花园种了些萱草。
examples.english_sentence: My mother planted some daylilies in the backyard garden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古詩經常用萱草象徵忘憂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si1 ging1 soeng4 jung6 hyun1 cou2 zoeng6 zing1 mong4 jau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古诗经常用萱草象征忘忧。
examples.english_sentence: Classical poems often use the daylily to symbolize forgetting worries.

mandarin_meaning: 萵（常見於「萵苣」），指生菜類的綠葉蔬菜
english_meaning: lettuce (as in the compound 萵苣), a leafy vegetable
explanation_mandarin: 「萵」字通常出現在合成詞如「萵苣」，用來表示生菜或一類可食用的綠葉蔬菜。單獨使用較少，常見於菜名或食品描述中。
explanation_english: The character 萵 usually appears in compounds such as 萵苣 (lettuce) and denotes a leafy vegetable. It is rarely used alone and commonly appears in names of vegetables or food descriptions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市有新鮮嘅萵苣，買一棵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jau5 san1 sin1 ge3 wo1 geoi1, maai5 jat1 fo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有新鮮的萵苣，買一棵吧。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket has fresh lettuce; buy one.

mandarin_meaning: 莴笋
english_meaning: celtuce; stem lettuce (asparagus lettuce)
explanation_mandarin: 一种以肥厚的莖部食用的蔬菜（莴笋），莖脆嫩，可炒、拌或做沙拉，常見於中式菜肴。
explanation_english: A vegetable known as celtuce or stem/asparagus lettuce; the thickened stem is eaten. It is crunchy and commonly stir-fried, mixed in salads, or used in Chinese cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市啱啱入咗啲新鮮嘅萵筍，買兩條返屋企炒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 ngaam1 ngaam1 jap6 zo2 di1 san1 sin1 ge3 wo1 seon2, maai5 loeng5 tiu4 faan1 uk1 kei5 caau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市剛進了一些新鮮的莴笋，買兩根回家炒吧。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket just got some fresh celtuce; buy two and stir-fry them at home.

mandarin_meaning: 山茱萸（Cornus officinalis），一種木本植物，其果實可入藥，為中藥材
english_meaning: Cornus officinalis (Japanese cornel/dogwood), a woody plant whose fruit is used in traditional Chinese medicine
explanation_mandarin: 萸常見於詞語「山茱萸」，為中藥材，果實用於補腎、固精等方劑。
explanation_english: Often seen in the term 'shan zhuyu' (Cornus officinalis). It is a medicinal plant whose fruit is used in formulas to tonify the kidneys and preserve essence in traditional Chinese medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個中藥處方入面有山茱萸，主要用嚟補腎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zung1 joek6 cyu5 fong1 jap6 min6 jau5 saan1 zyu1 jyu4, zyu2 jiu3 jung6 lei4 bou2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個中藥處方裡有山茱萸，主要用來補腎。
examples.english_sentence: This herbal prescription contains Cornus officinalis (shan zhuyu), mainly used to tonify the kidneys.

mandarin_meaning: 落 / 漏 / 下（如落下、下车、下雨、放置等）
english_meaning: to fall / to go down / to get off (a vehicle) / to put/place / to rain / to start (an action)
explanation_mandarin: 「落」在廣東話中是多義字，常作動詞，表示向下移動或掉落（如葉子落下）、下車或下來（如落車、落嚟）、下雨（落雨）、放置（放落枱）或開始做某事（落手/落手做）等多種用法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '落' is a multifunctional verb meaning to move down or fall (e.g. leaves falling), to get off or come down (e.g. get off a vehicle, come down here), to rain, to place/put (put on a surface), or to begin an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲葉落咗落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jip6 lok6 zo2 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树叶掉到地上了。
examples.english_sentence: The leaves have fallen to the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺下一站落車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 haa6 jat1 zaam6 lok6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在下一站下车。
examples.english_sentence: We'll get off at the next stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日可能會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天可能会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: It might rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你將部電話放落枱上啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 bou6 din6 waa2 fong3 lok6 toi4 soeng6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把手机放到桌子上吧。
examples.english_sentence: Put your phone on the table.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）放一些 / 加一點；把……降低一點；稍微
english_meaning: informal: add a bit; lower/reduce a bit; a little (bit)
explanation_mandarin: 「落啲」（書寫常見為「落啲」或「落D」）是香港粵語口語用法。可用於表示把某物放入（如「落啲鹽」＝加一些鹽），也可表示把某事物降低或減少（如「將音量落啲」＝把音量調低一點），有時作程度副詞表示「稍微、一點」。
explanation_english: “落啲” (written colloquially as 落D) is Hong Kong Cantonese slang. It can mean to add a small amount (e.g. “落啲鹽” = add some salt), to lower/reduce something a bit (e.g. “將音量落啲” = turn the volume down a bit), or function as a degree word meaning “a little.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你落啲鹽啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lok6 di1 jim4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你加一些鹽吧。
examples.english_sentence: Add some salt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將音量落啲啦，太嘈喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 jam1 loeng6 lok6 di1 laa1, taai3 cou4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把音量調低一點，太吵了。
examples.english_sentence: Turn the volume down a bit; it's too loud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以將個價落啲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 go3 gaa3 lok6 di1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能不能把價格降一點？
examples.english_sentence: Could you lower the price a bit?

mandarin_meaning: 登上（報紙/媒體/版面）
english_meaning: to appear on/ be featured in (a newspaper, media, or a page/section)
explanation_mandarin: 「落⋯面」是廣東話的口語用法，表示某件事或某人出現在報紙、媒體或某一版面、節目等上面（被報道或曝光）。⋯處可替換為具體的媒體或版面，如「報紙面」、「頭版面」、「媒體面」等。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "落⋯面" is a colloquial pattern meaning that something or someone appears in or is featured by a media outlet or a specific page/section (e.g., in a newspaper, on TV). The ellipsis can be replaced by a concrete medium or page, such as "報紙面" (newspaper page) or "頭版面" (front page).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件事最後落咗報紙面，大家都知道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 si6 zeoi3 hau6 lok6 zo2 bou3 zi2 min6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件事最後登上了報紙版面，大家都知道了。
examples.english_sentence: That incident ended up appearing in the newspaper, so everyone knew about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條新聞最後落咗頭版面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 san1 man4 zeoi3 hau6 lok6 zo2 tau4 baan2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條新聞最後登上了頭版。
examples.english_sentence: This news story eventually made the front page.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想私人嘅事落媒體面畀人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 si1 jan4 ge3 si6 lok6 mui4 tai2 min6 bei2 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想私人事情登上媒體版面被人談論。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want his private matters to be covered by the media.

mandarin_meaning: 落井下石（成語），比喻乘人有難，再去打擊或陷害。
english_meaning: To attack, criticize, or take advantage of someone when they are already in trouble; to kick someone when they're down.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在別人遭遇不幸或困難時，趁機攻擊、嘲笑或加以陷害，表示刻薄或不應有的行為。
explanation_english: An idiom describing the act of making things worse for someone already suffering misfortune — attacking, criticizing, or taking advantage of them instead of helping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經遇到好多麻煩，仲有人落井下石，真係過分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 jyu6 dou3 hou2 do1 maa4 faan4, zung6 jau5 jan4 lok6 zeng2 haa6 sek6, zan1 hai6 gwo3 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經遇到很多麻煩，還有人落井下石，真是過分。
examples.english_sentence: He's already in a lot of trouble, and people are still kicking him when he's down — it's really too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司裁員嗰陣，有啲同事唔但唔幫，仲落井下石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 coi2 jyun4 go2 zan6, jau5 di1 tung4 si6 m4 daan6 m4 bong1, zung6 lok6 zeng2 haa6 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司裁員的時候，有些同事不但不幫忙，反而落井下石。
examples.english_sentence: When the company was laying people off, some colleagues not only didn't help but made things worse for them.

mandarin_meaning: 被免職／被降職／被撤換（口語）
english_meaning: to be demoted, dismissed, or dropped (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「落仔」是香港粵語口語用法，常用來表示某人被撤換、降職或從某個名單／崗位中被除去。語氣偏口語、非正式，常見於工作、團隊或選拔情境。
explanation_english: “落仔” is a colloquial Cantonese expression (Hong Kong) used to say someone has been removed, demoted, dismissed, or dropped from a roster/position. It is informal and typically used in contexts like work, teams, or selections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司重組，阿明可能會畀人落仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 cung4 zou2, aa3 ming4 ho2 nang4 wui5 bei2 jan4 lok6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司重組，阿明可能會被人免職／撤換。
examples.english_sentence: With the company reorganization, Ah Ming might be dismissed/dropped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊成績差，教練差唔多要俾人落仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi6 sing4 zik1 caa1, gaau3 lin6 caa1 m4 do1 jiu3 bei2 jan4 lok6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球隊成績差，教練差不多要被撤換了。
examples.english_sentence: The team's results are poor; the coach will likely be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 落伍（luòwǔ）：跟不上时代或潮流，落在别人或集体的后面
english_meaning: to be outdated; to fall behind; behind the times
explanation_mandarin: 表示跟不上時代、潮流或他人發展，可作動詞（落在別人後面）或形容詞（過時、不合潮流）。
explanation_english: Indicates being out of date or falling behind others or current trends. Can be used as a verb (to fall behind) or an adjective (outdated).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你仲用一部好舊嘅電話，真係幾落伍喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zung6 jung6 jat1 bou6 hou2 gau6 ge3 din6 waa2, zan1 hai6 gei2 lok6 ng5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你還在用一部很舊的手機，真的有點落伍了。
examples.english_sentence: If you're still using a very old phone, it's kind of outdated.

mandarin_meaning: 落入 / (luòrù) 掉进、进入（某个地方或状态）
english_meaning: to fall into; to enter (a place or state); to be caught in
explanation_mandarin: 表示掉進或進入某個場所或狀態，可作為物理上的落入（例如掉進坑、掉進水中）或比喻性的陷入（例如陷入困境、落入圈套）。
explanation_english: Indicates falling into or entering a place or state. Can be used literally (e.g., fall into a hole or water) or figuratively (e.g., fall into difficulties or a trap).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個波跌落入水渠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 dit3 lok6 jap6 seoi2 keoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球掉进了水沟。
examples.english_sentence: The ball fell into the gutter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家落入困境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 lok6 jap6 kwan3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司现在陷入困境。
examples.english_sentence: The company has fallen into difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢落入咗個圈套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lok6 jap6 zo2 go3 hyun1 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他落入了圈套。
examples.english_sentence: He fell into a trap.

mandarin_meaning: 剩下；留下
english_meaning: to be left (over); leftover
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示某物在使用或分配之後剩下或留存下來的部分，相當於普通話的「剩下」或「留下」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning something remains or is left over after use, distribution, or consumption — equivalent to Mandarin '剩下' or English 'leftover / remain'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯，碟上仲落剩啲菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6, dip6 soeng6 zung6 lok6 zing6 di1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完飯，碟子上還剩下一些菜。
examples.english_sentence: After the meal, there were still some dishes left on the plate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買咗一打麵包，返到屋企只係落剩兩個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 zo2 jat1 daat3 min6 baau1, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 zi2 hai6 lok6 zing6 loeng5 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買了一打麵包，回到家只剩下兩個。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a dozen buns, but when I got home only two were left.

mandarin_meaning: 努力／用力
english_meaning: to work hard; to put in effort; energetically
explanation_mandarin: 表示付出努力或用力去做某事，常用於口語，可作動詞或副詞。
explanation_english: Indicates putting in effort or doing something vigorously. Commonly used colloquially; can function as a verb or an adverb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你落力啲做啦，唔好懶惰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lok6 lik6 di1 zou6 laa1, m4 hou2 laan5 do6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要努力一點，別懶惰。
examples.english_sentence: Work harder, don't be lazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢落力練習，終於考上大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lok6 lik6 lin6 zaap6, zung1 jyu1 haau2 soeng5 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他努力練習，終於考上大學。
examples.english_sentence: He practiced hard and finally got into university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚落力搵客，生意先會好轉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 lok6 lik6 wan2 haak3, saang1 ji3 sin1 wui5 hou2 zyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚多努力招攬顧客，生意才會好轉。
examples.english_sentence: Work hard to attract customers tonight and the business will improve.

mandarin_meaning: 下區（到社區／到現場巡訪或做外展）
english_meaning: to go into a district/neighborhood (to patrol, do outreach, visit the community)
explanation_mandarin: 「落區」是廣東話口語，指前往某個地區或社區進行巡訪、外展、接觸居民或到現場處理事務，常見於警方、社工或義工等語境。
explanation_english: ‘Lok6 keoi1’ is a Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to go into a district or neighborhood, often used for patrols, outreach, home/community visits, or on-site work by police, social workers, volunteers, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社工下個星期會落區探訪長者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 gung1 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 wui5 lok6 keoi1 taam3 fong2 zoeng2 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社工下個星期會下區探訪長者。
examples.english_sentence: The social worker will go into the neighborhood next week to visit elderly residents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方今晚會落區巡邏，大家注意安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gam1 maan5 wui5 lok6 keoi1 ceon4 lo4, daai6 gaa1 zyu3 ji3 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方今晚會下區巡邏，大家注意安全。
examples.english_sentence: The police will patrol the neighborhood tonight; everyone please be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期六落區派問卷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 lok6 keoi1 paai3 man6 gyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期六下區派發問卷。
examples.english_sentence: We're going into the community on Saturday to distribute questionnaires.

mandarin_meaning: 下去；往下走/往下（或表示接下來）
english_meaning: to go down; to descend; to go down to (somewhere); also used to mean 'from now on' or 'after this' in colloquial use
explanation_mandarin: 表示向下移動或前往較低的位置（如「落去樓下」），亦可用於口語表示接下來/以後的動作或情形（如「以後落去」）。
explanation_english: Indicates movement downward or going to a lower place (e.g. 'go downstairs'); in colloquial use it can also indicate continuation or 'from now on'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家落去樓下拎嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 lok6 heoi3 lau4 haa6 ling1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在下去楼下拿东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going downstairs now to get something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家落去地鐵站等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 lok6 heoi3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在下去地铁站等你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going down to the MTR station to wait for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以後落去，你遲到就要承擔後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 hau6 lok6 heoi3, nei5 ci4 dou3 zau6 jiu3 sing4 daam1 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以后你再迟到就要承担后果。
examples.english_sentence: From now on, if you're late again you'll have to bear the consequences.

mandarin_meaning: （口頭）供詞；招供；作口供
english_meaning: to give an oral statement or confession (often to police); to confess verbally
explanation_mandarin: 指向警方或調查人員口頭陳述事實或承認罪行，類似「作口供」或「招供」。在口語中常用於描述被問話時的供詞。
explanation_english: Refers to giving an oral account or confession to police or investigators. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese to mean making a statement or admitting guilt verbally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀警方拘捕之後落咗口供，承認偷咗啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 ging2 fong1 keoi1 bou6 zi1 hau6 lok6 zo2 hau2 gung1, sing4 jing6 tou1 zo2 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被警方拘捕之後作了口供，承認偷了錢。
examples.english_sentence: He gave an oral statement after being arrested by the police and admitted stealing the money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀人逼你落口供，如果唔肯講，就搵律師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 bik1 nei5 lok6 hau2 gung1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hang2 gong2, zau6 wan2 leot6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要讓人逼你做口供，如果不願意說話，就找律師。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let anyone force you to make an oral statement; if you refuse to talk, get a lawyer.

mandarin_meaning: 下台（走下舞台）；辭職或被迫離職、下台受責任
english_meaning: to step down / leave the stage; to resign or be forced to resign; to be removed from office; to leave a performance stage
explanation_mandarin: 「落台」可作字面意思，指從舞台或台上走下來；亦常作口語或政治語境下的比喻，表示辭職、下野或被迫離職，含有失勢或被要求負責的意味。
explanation_english: Literally means to leave the stage. Idiomatically (especially in political or public contexts) it means to step down, resign, or be forced out of a position — often implying loss of power or being held accountable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯咗咁多嘢，終於要落台啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 zo2 gam2 do1 je5, zung1 jyu1 jiu3 lok6 toi4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯了這麼多事，終於要下台了。
examples.english_sentence: He made so many mistakes; finally he has to step down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演員表演完就落台換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 jyun4 biu2 jin2 jyun4 zau6 lok6 toi4 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演員表演完就下台換衣服。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing their performance, the actors go offstage to change clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個政客一出事，就被媒體逼到落台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 zing3 haak3 jat1 ceot1 si6, zau6 bei6 mui4 tai2 bik1 dou3 lok6 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個政客一出事，就被媒體逼得下台。
examples.english_sentence: That politician got into trouble and was pressured by the media to step down.

mandarin_meaning: 下樓梯；讓步、給對方一個體面的退路或（人）下台／辭職
english_meaning: literally 'go down the stairs'; idiomatically 'step down/resign' or 'give someone a way to save face/allow a graceful exit'
explanation_mandarin: 可作字面意思，指從台階或樓梯走下；口語上常用作比喻，表示讓步、給對方一個體面的退路，或指人下台、辭職。
explanation_english: Can be used literally to mean going down stairs. Idiomatically it means to step down (from a position) or to give someone a way to save face — a graceful exit or retreat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲落台階，唔好跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1 lok6 toi4 gaai1, m4 hou2 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心下台階，別摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful going down the stairs; don't fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單醜聞爆出嚟之後，佢唯有落台階。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 cau2 man4 baau3 ceot1 lai4 zi1 hau6, keoi5 wai6 jau5 lok6 toi4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這起醜聞爆發後，他只好下台。
examples.english_sentence: After the scandal broke, he had no choice but to step down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咪咁死撐啦，畀佢有個台階落啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mai6 gam3 sei2 caang1 laa1, bei2 keoi5 jau5 go3 toi4 gaai1 lok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別那麼硬撐，給他一個下台階吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn; give him a way to save face.

mandarin_meaning: 下去吧 / 下车吧 / 下来吧
english_meaning: Get down / Get off / Come down (imperative, colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口语用法，用于请求或命令别人从高处下来或从车上/站台上落下（下车、下来），常见于日常对话和到站提醒。
explanation_english: A colloquial imperative used to tell someone to get down, come down, or get off (e.g., from a vehicle or from a height). Common in everyday spoken Cantonese when asking someone to disembark or descend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋到站啦，落吧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou3 zaam6 laa1, lok6 baa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们到站了，下车吧。
examples.english_sentence: We've arrived at the stop — get off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺梯上面，快啲落吧，小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 tai1 soeng6 min6, faai3 di1 lok6 baa6, siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在梯子上面，快点下来，小心点。
examples.english_sentence: You're on the ladder — come down quickly and be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 挖苦、讥讽（用言语使人难堪）
english_meaning: to make a cutting remark; to taunt or verbally mock someone
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用詞，指用言語挖苦、諷刺或羞辱別人，使對方感到難堪或尷尬。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to make a cutting remark, taunt, or verbally humiliate someone, causing embarrassment or discomfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都鍾意落我咀頭，搞到我好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zung1 ji3 lok6 ngo5 zeoi2 tau4, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常喜欢挖苦我，弄得我很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He often likes to make cutting remarks about me, which makes me very unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）假牙掉了；（引申）出洋相、丢脸
english_meaning: literally: (a) a denture fell out; figuratively: to make a fool of oneself / lose face
explanation_mandarin: 「落咗棚牙」字面上指假牙鬆脫或掉落，常見於長者描述假牙的情況；在口語中也可引申為在公眾場合出醜、感到丟臉或尷尬。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a denture coming loose or falling out (often said by/for elderly people). Figuratively it can mean having an embarrassing mishap in public — making a fool of oneself or losing face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆今日落咗棚牙，佢覺得好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 gam1 jat6 lok6 zo2 paang4 ngaa4, keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶今天假牙掉了，她覺得很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma's denture came out today; she feels very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺會議上講錯資料，我真係落咗棚牙，尷尬到唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 gong2 co3 zi1 liu2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 lok6 zo2 paang4 ngaa4, gaan1 gaai3 dou3 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在會議上說錯資料，我真的出糗了，尷尬到不知道怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: I gave wrong information in the meeting — I really embarrassed myself and didn't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 下單；（口語）被留下、孤單一個
english_meaning: to place an order; (colloquial) to be left alone / left behind
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語中常用，主要指在餐廳或網店等處「下單／訂購」。口語上亦可表示某人被留下、獨自一人（被落單）。
explanation_english: Common in Hong Kong Cantonese. Primarily means to place an order (e.g., for food or online). Colloquially it can also mean someone is left alone or left behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想食咩？我幫你落單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 sik6 me1? ngo5 bong1 nei5 lok6 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想吃什麼？我幫你下單。
examples.english_sentence: What do you want to eat? I'll place the order for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成班人去旅行，佢唔見咗，結果落單咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 baan1 jan4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, keoi5 m4 gin3 zo2, git3 gwo2 lok6 daan1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們一群人去旅行，他不見了，結果被留下了一個人。
examples.english_sentence: We went on a trip as a group; he disappeared and ended up being left alone.

mandarin_meaning: 開口說話；隨口說（常指抱怨或批評）
english_meaning: to speak up / say something (often casually or blurted out; frequently used for a critical or complaining remark)
explanation_mandarin: 「落嘴頭」為廣東話口語表達，指開始開口說話或隨口說出某句話，語氣上常帶隨意或略帶批評、抱怨的成分。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to open one's mouth and say something or to blurt something out. It often implies a casual, offhand remark and can carry a critical or complaining tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日落嘴頭話人懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 lok6 zeoi2 tau4 waa6 jan4 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是隨口說別人懶惰。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep blurting out that people are lazy.

mandarin_meaning: 下来 / 过来 / 随后
english_meaning: to come down; to come over; then/afterwards (discourse marker)
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can function as a discourse marker)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语常用口语，表示从高处或某处移动到说话者一方（下来/过来），也可用作叙述时表示随后发生的动作（随后、接着）。
explanation_english: A common Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to move down or come over to the speaker (come down/come over). It can also be used as a discourse marker to indicate what happens next or afterwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓由屋頂落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 jau4 nguk1 ding2 lok6 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只猫从屋顶下来。
examples.english_sentence: The cat came down from the roof.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你落嚟坐吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lok6 lei4 co5 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你过来坐一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Come over and have a seat for a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講完落嚟，我再補充。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 jyun4 lok6 lei4, ngo5 zoi3 bou2 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说完之后我再补充。
examples.english_sentence: After you finish speaking, I'll add more.

mandarin_meaning: 落地（着陆；到达；实施、落實）
english_meaning: to land; to arrive; to be implemented or rolled out; to take effect
explanation_mandarin: 「落地」可指飛機或人到達並落在地面（着陆/到达），也可用來表示政策、方案或產品開始實施或投入使用（落實、實施）。
explanation_english: “落地” can mean for an aircraft or person to land/arrive, or for a policy, plan, or product to be implemented, rolled out, or put into effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飛機就快落地喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei1 gei1 zau6 faai3 lok6 dei6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机就快落地了。
examples.english_sentence: The plane is about to land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新政策下個月就會落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 zing3 caak3 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 wui5 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新政策下个月就会落地。
examples.english_sentence: The new policy will be implemented next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱落地香港，仲未拎到行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 lok6 dei6 hoeng1 gong2, zung6 mei6 ling1 dou3 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚到达香港，行李还没拿到。
examples.english_sentence: He just arrived in Hong Kong and hasn't collected his luggage yet.

cantonese: 落地喊三聲，好醜命生成
jyutping: lok6 dei6 haam3 saam1 seng1, hou2 cau2 ming6 saang1 sing4
mandarin_meaning: 一出生就很醜，注定長相難看（用作罵人或戲謔）
english_meaning: Born ugly / born to be ugly (colloquial insult indicating someone's ugliness is innate and 'doomed')
