explanation_mandarin: 這是一句香港粵語的口語俚語，用來形容某人天生長得醜或嘲諷對方長相，帶有強烈的貶義和人身攻擊意味，通常不禮貌。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase used to describe or mock someone as being ugly from birth and therefore 'doomed' to an ugly life. It's an insulting, colloquial expression and can be offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人好衰，一見到佢張相就話：落地喊三聲，好醜命生成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 hou2 seoi1, jat1 gin3 dou3 keoi5 zoeng1 soeng2 zau6 waa6: lok6 dei6 haam3 saam1 seng1, hou2 cau2 ming6 saang1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人真壞，一看到他的照片就說：一出生就很醜，命苦。
examples.english_sentence: Those people are mean; as soon as they saw his photo they said, 'Born ugly, doomed life.'

mandarin_meaning: 在新的地方安定下来，开始扎根、稳定发展（落地生根）
english_meaning: To settle down in a new place, put down roots; to become firmly established
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“落到地上生出根来”，比喻在新的环境中安定下来、紮根或开始稳定发展。
explanation_english: Literally 'fall to the ground and grow roots'. Figuratively used to say someone or something has settled in a new place and become established.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢移民嚟香港之後，好快就落地生根，仲買咗間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4man4 lai4 hoeng1gong2 zi1hau6, hou2 faai3 zau6 lok6 dei6 saang1 gan1, zung6 maai5 zo2 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他移民来香港之后，很快就落地生根，还买了房子。
examples.english_sentence: After he immigrated to Hong Kong, he quickly settled down and even bought a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司喺嗰度開咗辦事處，好快就落地生根，當地員工越嚟越多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 hai2 go2 dou6 hoi1 zo2 baan6si6cyu3, hou2 faai3 zau6 lok6 dei6 saang1 gan1, dong1dei6 jyun4 gung1 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司在那边设了办事处，很快就落地生根，当地员工越来越多。
examples.english_sentence: The company opened an office there and soon put down roots; the number of local employees kept growing.

mandarin_meaning: 落地簽證 (luòdì qiānzhèng)
english_meaning: visa on arrival
explanation_mandarin: 指旅客抵達入境口岸時現場申辦並取得的短期入境許可或簽證，通常由入境國在機場或口岸發放。
explanation_english: A visa issued upon arrival at the border or airport, allowing travelers to obtain short-term permission to enter the country without applying in advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去泰國可以落地簽証，唔使預先申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 taai3 gwok3 ho2 ji5 lok6 dei6 cim1 zing3, m4 sai2 jyu6 sin1 san1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去泰國可以辦落地簽證，不需要事先申請。
examples.english_sentence: You can get a visa on arrival in Thailand; you don't need to apply in advance.

mandarin_meaning: 落地签证（抵达后在入境口岸现场办理并获发的签证）
english_meaning: visa on arrival (a visa issued at the port of entry upon arrival)
explanation_mandarin: 指旅客在抵達目的地的入境口岸時，可於現場申請並獲發的簽證，俗稱「落地簽」。適用國家和條件各有不同，通常有停留期限和可否延長等規定。
explanation_english: Refers to a visa granted to travelers at the port of entry upon arrival, commonly called a 'visa on arrival'. Eligibility, duration and rules vary by country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去緬甸旅遊，入境時可以辦落地簽證，唔使預先申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 min5 din1 leoi5 jau4, jap6 ging2 si4 ho2 ji5 baan6 lok6 dei6 cim1 zing3, m4 sai2 jyu6 sin1 san1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去缅甸旅游，入境时可以办理落地签证，不用提前申请。
examples.english_sentence: When traveling to Myanmar, you can get a visa on arrival at the border; you don't need to apply in advance.

cantonese: 落地蟹殼 - 富能窮不能
jyutping: lok6 dei6 haai5 hok3 fu3 nang4 kung4 bat1 nang4
mandarin_meaning: 有錢人能做到、能掌控事情，窮人則無能力或無資源去做到。
english_meaning: The rich can do what the poor cannot; wealth grants ability and access that poverty restricts.
explanation_mandarin: 一句俗語，用來形容財力決定可做的事與享有的權力，強調有錢人的優勢與窮人的受限。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb expressing that wealth enables action and influence while poverty limits capability and opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔係淨係靠理念，落地蟹殼——富能窮不能，資金同關係好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 haau1 lei6 nim6, lok6 dei6 haai5 hok3 fu3 nang4 kung4 bat1 nang4, zi1 gam1 tung4 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 cung4 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不只是靠理念，落地蟹殼——有錢能做到，窮人做不到，資金和人脈很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Running a business isn't just about ideas — as the proverb says, the rich can do what the poor cannot; capital and connections matter.

jyutping: lok6 dei6 hoi1 faa1 fu3 gwai3 wing4 waa4
mandarin_meaning: 落地开花，富贵荣华（祝愿到处兴旺、迅速获得富贵荣耀）
english_meaning: May things bloom as soon as they arrive and bring wealth and honor — an auspicious blessing wishing immediate prosperity and glory.
explanation_mandarin: 把「落地開花」與「富貴榮華」連用，多用作祝福語，表示希望事業、家庭或子孫到達新環境後馬上興旺，獲得富貴與榮華。
explanation_english: A compound auspicious phrase combining 'to bloom upon landing' and 'wealth and honor.' Used as a blessing to wish that a person, business, or family will prosper immediately and enjoy wealth and prestige.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新屋入伙，祝你落地開花，富貴榮華。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 uk1 jap6 fo2, zuk1 nei5 lok6 dei6 hoi1 faa1, fu3 gwai3 wing4 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乔迁新居，祝你落地开花，富贵荣华。
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on your new home — may you prosper immediately and enjoy wealth and honor.

mandarin_meaning: 出去、下街、到市區逛
english_meaning: to go out; to go down to town; to hang out in the neighbourhood
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，通常指到街上或市區外出、逛街或社交。屬口語/區域性表達，語感較隨意。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to go out into town or the neighbourhood — typically to hang out, shop, or socialize. Informal and regionally used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋落坊食飯、睇戲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 lok6 fong1 sik6 faan6, tai2 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們出去吃飯、看電影吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go out to eat and watch a movie tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 落入陷阱 / 被騙 / （口語）陷入某種困境或上癮
english_meaning: literally 'fall into a pit'; figuratively 'fall into a trap', 'be deceived', or 'get hooked/addicted to something'
explanation_mandarin: 「落坑」原指掉進坑裡；口語用法常表示落入別人的陷阱、被騙或比喻上癮、被某事吸引而無法自拔。
explanation_english: Literally means to fall into a pit. Colloquially used to say someone has fallen into a trap or been deceived; can also be used metaphorically to mean becoming hooked or addicted to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心行過去就跌落個坑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 haang4 gwo3 heoi3 zau6 dit3 lok6 go3 haang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心走过去就掉进了坑里。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally walked over and fell into the pit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好俾人呃到落坑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 ngaa6 dou3 lok6 haang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，不要被人骗上当。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful; don't be deceived or fall into someone's trap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我本來只係試下睇，點知而家完全落坑，成日追緊呢套劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun2 loi4 zi2 hai6 si3 haa5 tai2, dim2 zi1 ji4 gaa1 jyun4 cyun4 lok6 haang1, sing4 jat6 zeoi1 gan2 ni1 tou3 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本来只是试着看，没想到现在完全入坑了，天天都在追这部剧。
examples.english_sentence: I only tried watching it at first, but now I'm totally hooked — I watch this series every day.

mandarin_meaning: 下课
english_meaning: class is over; class dismissed
explanation_mandarin: 表示課堂結束，學生可以離開教室。
explanation_english: Indicates that a class has ended and students may leave the classroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上課差唔多完，老師話可以落堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 fo3 caa1 m4 do1 jyun4, lou5 si1 waa6 ho2 ji5 lok6 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上课快要结束了，老师说可以下课。
examples.english_sentence: Class is almost over; the teacher said we can dismiss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下午兩點有堂，四點先落堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 ng5 loeng5 dim2 jau5 tong4, sei3 dim2 sin1 lok6 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下午两点有课，四点才下课。
examples.english_sentence: We have class at 2 PM and won't finish until 4 PM.

mandarin_meaning: 上场 / 出场 / 出面
english_meaning: to go on stage; to take the field; to come out in public
explanation_mandarin: 表示演出或比賽時進入舞台或場地表演／上場，也可用來指公開出面回應或出現。
explanation_english: Used to indicate entering a stage or playing field to perform or participate; can also mean coming out publicly to respond or appear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚佢會落場表演新歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 keoi5 wui5 lok6 coeng4 biu2 jin2 san1 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚他會上台表演新歌。
examples.english_sentence: He will perform his new song on stage tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練話下週有兩個球員會落場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 waa6 haa6 zau1 jau5 loeng5 go3 kau4 jyun4 wui5 lok6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教練說下週有兩名球員會上场。
examples.english_sentence: The coach said two players will take the field next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一出事就要落場回應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ceot1 si6 zau6 jiu3 lok6 coeng4 wui4 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一出事就要出面回應。
examples.english_sentence: Whenever there's trouble, he has to come out and respond.

mandarin_meaning: 脫妝／卸妝（化妝脫落或把妝卸掉）
english_meaning: makeup coming off; to remove makeup
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，『落妝』可指化妝因流汗、哭泣等而脫落（脫妝），也可口語地用作把妝卸掉（卸妝）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '落妝' can mean makeup coming off (e.g. from sweating or crying) or, colloquially, to take off/remove one's makeup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喊到落咗妝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haam3 dou3 lok6 zo2 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她哭到妝都掉了。
examples.english_sentence: She cried until her makeup came off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天咁熱成日出汗，底妝好易溶會落妝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 gam2 jit6 sing4 jat6 ceot1 hon4, dai2 zong1 hou2 ji6 jung4 wui5 lok6 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天那麼熱又經常出汗，底妝很容易脫妝。
examples.english_sentence: In summer it's so hot and you sweat a lot; foundation easily melts and your makeup comes off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我返到屋企就落妝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 lok6 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我回到家就卸妝。
examples.english_sentence: I'll take off my makeup as soon as I get home.

mandarin_meaning: 确定；敲定；落实
english_meaning: to be settled; to be finalized; to confirm
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，表示某件事、日期、訂單或安排已經確定下來或敲定好了。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning that something (a decision, date, order, arrangement) has been confirmed or finalized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次旅行嘅日期已經落定喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 ge3 jat6 kei4 ji5 ging1 lok6 ding6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次旅行的日期已经确定了。
examples.english_sentence: The dates for this trip have been finalized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我落定呢幾份訂單？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 lok6 ding6 ni1 gei2 fan6 ding6 daan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我把这几份订单确认/下定吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me finalize/place these orders?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再傾啦，已經落定喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 king1 laa1, ji5 ging1 lok6 ding6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再讨论了，已经确定了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't discuss it further; it's already settled.

mandarin_meaning: 让乘客下车；把乘客放下车（多用于的士/司机）
english_meaning: to drop off a passenger; to let a passenger alight (commonly used by taxi drivers)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语动词，通常由司机（尤其是的士司機）使用，表示让乘客在某处下车或把乘客放下车。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb phrase, typically used by drivers (especially taxi drivers), meaning to let a passenger get off or to drop someone off at a location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅，你可唔可以喺呢度落客？
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 ni1 dou6 lok6 haak3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅，您可以在这里让我下车吗？
examples.english_sentence: Driver, can you drop me off here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次個的士司機唔肯落客，搞到我遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 go3 dik1 si6 si1 gei1 m4 hang2 lok6 haak3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ci4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次的士司机不肯让我下车，导致我迟到。
examples.english_sentence: Last time the taxi driver refused to drop me off and I ended up late.

mandarin_meaning: 落寞 / 孤寂
english_meaning: lonely; forlorn; desolate
explanation_mandarin: 「落寞」用來形容人感到孤單、寂寞，或形容場所／氣氛顯得冷清、孤寂。
explanation_english: Describes a person who feels lonely or forlorn, or an atmosphere/place that seems desolate and quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都覺得好落寞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 lok6 mok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我經常覺得很落寞。
examples.english_sentence: I often feel very lonely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搬咗去外國之後，成日都覺得好落寞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun1 zo2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 zi1 hau6, sing4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 lok6 mok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搬到國外之後，常常覺得很落寞。
examples.english_sentence: After he moved abroad, he often felt very lonely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司冇咗佢之後，嗰陣氣氛睇落好落寞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mou5 zo2 keoi5 zi1 hau6, go2 zan6 hei3 fan1 tai2 lok6 hou2 lok6 mok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司沒有他之後，那段時間的氣氛看起來很落寞。
examples.english_sentence: After the company lost him, the atmosphere there felt very forlorn.

mandarin_meaning: 落实（把政策、计划或措施付诸实施，使之生效）
english_meaning: to implement; to put into practice; to carry out
explanation_mandarin: 表示把政策、計劃或措施真正執行、付諸實行，使其落到實處並生效。
explanation_english: Indicates carrying out or executing a policy, plan, or measure so that it is actually implemented and takes effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃要盡快落實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 lok6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划要尽快落实。
examples.english_sentence: This plan needs to be implemented as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話會落實新政策，但仲未有時間表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 lok6 sat6 san1 zing3 caak3, daan6 zung6 mei6 jau5 si4 gaan1 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府说会落实新政策，但还没有时间表。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it would implement the new policy, but there's still no timeline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要把計劃落實，大家要分工合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 baa2 gai3 waak6 lok6 sat6, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 fan1 gung1 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要把计划落实，大家要分工合作。
examples.english_sentence: To put the plan into practice, everyone needs to divide tasks and cooperate.

mandarin_meaning: 下山；（引申）下台、失勢或被撤職
english_meaning: to descend a mountain; (figurative) to step down, fall from power or be removed from office
explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面意思：從山上往下走。2) 引申/口語：指下台、失勢或被罷免、撤職等。
explanation_english: 1) Literal: to go down a mountain. 2) Figurative/slang: to step down, lose power, or be removed from a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要落山先，天快黑喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lok6 saan1 sin1, tin1 faai3 hak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要下山了，天快黑了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to go down the mountain; it's getting dark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯咁多嘢，終於要落山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 gam2 do1 je5, zung1 jyu1 jiu3 lok6 saan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯這麼多事，終於要下台了。
examples.english_sentence: He made so many mistakes; he's finally going to step down.

mandarin_meaning: 落幕 (luòmù)：落下幕布，比喻演出或事情結束
english_meaning: to draw the curtain; the end (of a performance, event, era)
explanation_mandarin: 原指舞台上落下幕布，表示演出結束；引申為事情、時代或活動的結束或落幕。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the curtain falling on stage to signal the end of a performance; metaphorically used for the conclusion of an event, era, or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅演出已經落幕，台上冇人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 jin2 ceot1 ji5 ging1 lok6 mok6, toi4 soeng6 mou5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的演出已经落幕，台上没人。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's performance has already ended; there's no one on stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隨住企業嘅倒閉，呢個時代終於落幕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 zyu6 kei4 jip6 ge3 dou3 bai6, ni1 go3 si4 doi6 zung1 jyu1 lok6 mok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 随着公司的倒闭，这个时代终于落幕。
examples.english_sentence: With the company's closure, this era has finally come to an end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影落幕時，全場掌聲響起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 lok6 mok6 si4, cyun4 coeng4 zoeng2 sing1 hoeng2 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影落幕时，全场掌声响起。
examples.english_sentence: When the movie ended, the whole audience burst into applause.

mandarin_meaning: 下厨
english_meaning: to cook; to go into the kitchen to prepare food
explanation_mandarin: 口语用语，指进入厨房做菜或准备食物。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to go into the kitchen to cook or prepare food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚你落廚定出去食？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 nei5 lok6 cyu4 ding6 ceot1 heoi3 sik6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚你下厨还是出去吃？
examples.english_sentence: Are you going to cook tonight or go out to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意落廚，成日試新菜式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 lok6 cyu4, seng4 jat6 si3 san1 coi3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢下厨，经常尝试新菜式。
examples.english_sentence: He/She loves cooking and often tries new recipes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝落廚整咗一個蛋撻比你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 lok6 cyu4 zeng2 zo2 jat1 go3 daan6 taat1 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上下厨房做了一个蛋挞给你。
examples.english_sentence: I went into the kitchen this morning and made an egg tart for you.

mandarin_meaning: 落后（luòhòu）
english_meaning: behind; backward; lagging behind; outdated
explanation_mandarin: 表示在发展、进步或时间上比别人慢，或在技术、观念上陈旧、落伍。
explanation_english: Indicates being behind in development, progress, or time; also used to describe something outdated or lagging behind in technology or ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅技術有啲落後，要加快升級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 ge3 gei6seot6 jau5 di1 lok6 hau6, jiu3 gaa1 faai3 sing1 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间公司的技术有点落后，需要加快升级。
examples.english_sentence: This company's technology is somewhat behind; it needs to upgrade faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果學校嘅教學方法太落後，學生會冇競爭力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 hok6 haau6 ge3 gaau3 hok6 fong1 faat3 taai3 lok6 hau6, hok6 saang1 wui5 mou5 ging6 zaang1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果学校的教学方法太落后，学生会没有竞争力。
examples.english_sentence: If a school's teaching methods are too outdated, students will lack competitiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽入面落後咗兩分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 sai3 jap6 min6 lok6 hau6 zo2 loeng5 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中落后了两分。
examples.english_sentence: He was two points behind in the match.

mandarin_meaning: 落成 (工程或建築完成；並可指舉行落成典禮)
english_meaning: to be completed; completion (of a building/project); inauguration/opening (ceremony)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 指建築、工程或項目完成，常用於描述竣工或舉行落成儀式的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the completion of a building, project, or similar work; often used to describe the finished state or the inauguration/opening ceremony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大樓終於落成，我哋可以搬入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 lau4 zung1 jyu1 lok6 sing4, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 bun1 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大樓終於落成了，我們可以搬進去了。
examples.english_sentence: The building is finally completed; we can move in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新圖書館下星期會有落成典禮，大家都受邀出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 tou4 syu1 gun2 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 jau5 lok6 sing4 din2 lai5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 sau6 jiu1 ceot1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新圖書館下週會有落成典禮，大家都受邀出席。
examples.english_sentence: The new library will have an opening ceremony next week; everyone has been invited to attend.

mandarin_meaning: 落户（在某地登记为户籍居民/取得户口）
english_meaning: to obtain household registration / to register residency (hukou)
explanation_mandarin: 指在某城市或地區將戶籍登記轉入或取得戶口，常用於申請在當地居住、買房或享受公共服務的法律手續。
explanation_english: Refers to registering household residency in a city/area or obtaining a hukou; commonly used about the legal procedures to become a local resident to buy property or access public services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想去深圳落戶，咁就可以喺嗰度買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 heoi3 sam1 zan3 lok6 wu6, gam2 zau6 ho2 ji5 hai2 go2 dou6 maai5 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说想去深圳落户，这样就可以在那边买房。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wants to get household registration in Shenzhen, so he can buy a house there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司幫我辦落戶手續，唔使自己跑來跑去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bong1 ngo5 baan6 lok6 wu6 sau2 zuk6, m4 sai2 zi6 gei2 paau2 loi4 paau2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司帮我办理落户手续，不用自己跑来跑去。
examples.english_sentence: The company is helping me process the household registration, so I don't have to run around myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新政策會放寬落戶限制，吸引更多人才過來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 zing3 caak3 wui5 fong3 fun1 lok6 wu6 haan6 zai3, kap1 gang1 do1 jan4 coi4 gwo3 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新政策会放宽落户限制，吸引更多人才过来。
examples.english_sentence: The new policy will relax household registration restrictions to attract more talent.

mandarin_meaning: 落户（落戶，luòhù）——办理户口登记，成为某地的常住户口或在某地登记为居民。
english_meaning: to register one's household; to obtain household registration; to settle in as a resident (register legally at a place).
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个地方办理户口登记或取得常住居民身份。也可指把户口迁入某地以便享受当地的公共服务或福利。
explanation_english: Refers to registering household status in a place or obtaining official resident registration there. Often involves formal procedures to gain access to local services and benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱喺廣州落戶，終於可以同家人一齊住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 gwong2 zau1 lok6 wu6, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 tung4 gaa1 jan4 jat1 cai4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚在广州落户，终于可以和家人一起住。
examples.english_sentence: He just registered his household in Guangzhou; he can finally live together with his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想喺上海落戶，要準備好多證件同資歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 hai2 soeng5 hoi2 lok6 wu6, jiu3 zeon2 bei6 hou2 do1 zing3 gin6 tung4 zi1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想在上海落户，要准备很多证件和资历。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to register residency in Shanghai, you need to prepare many documents and qualifications.

mandarin_meaning: 动手 / 出手
english_meaning: to lay hands on; to hit; to take action; to get to work
explanation_mandarin: 「落手」是粤语口语，常有两种用法：一是指动手打人或对人施暴（相当于“动手”“出手”）；二是指开始实际去做某事、付诸行动（相当于“开始着手”）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 落手 (lok6 sau2) is colloquial and has two common senses: (1) to lay hands on someone or to hit/assault; (2) to start doing something, i.e. to take action or get to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一見到對方就落手打人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gin3 dou3 deoi3fong1 zau6 lok6 sau2 daa2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一看到对方就动手打人。
examples.english_sentence: He starts hitting people as soon as he sees them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係講，你要落手做嘢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 gong2, nei5 jiu3 lok6 sau2 zou6 je5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只说，你要动手做事才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just talk; you need to get to work.

mandarin_meaning: 在深夜出手/在夜深時下手偷襲或突襲
english_meaning: to strike/act in the dead of night; to launch a surprise or sneaky attack late at night
explanation_mandarin: 指在深夜或別人不注意的時候出手攻擊或採取行動，常帶有突襲、偷偷摸摸的含義。也可引申為在關鍵時刻突然發力或採取行動。
explanation_english: Refers to making a move or attacking in the dead of night or when others are unprepared; often implies a surprise or stealthy action. Can also be used metaphorically for taking decisive action at a critical moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋趁夜黑落手打三更，偷咗啲嘢走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 can3 je6 hak1 lok6 sau2 daa2 saam1 geng1, tau1 zo2 di1 je5 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们趁夜深下手，偷了东西逃走了。
examples.english_sentence: They took advantage of the darkness to strike at night, stole some things and ran off.

mandarin_meaning: 親自動手、勤快幫忙；（口語）動手動腳（有時含猥褻之意）
english_meaning: to get hands-on; to pitch in and work energetically; (colloquial) to get physically hands-on (can imply groping in some contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 「落手落腳」常用來形容親自動手做事、積極幫忙或麻利地處理工作；在某些情況下也可指對人動手動腳，帶有不禮貌或猥褻的含義，需視語境而定。
explanation_english: Commonly used to describe someone who personally gets stuck in and helps or works briskly; in some contexts it can mean touching someone inappropriately (being handsy), so the meaning depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你落手落腳幫我搬屋，真係幫咗大忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 lok6 sau2 lok6 goek3 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1, zan1 hai6 bong1 zo2 daai6 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝你親自幫我搬家，真的幫了大忙。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks for pitching in to help me move — you were a big help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細今朝落手落腳教我做新嘢，學咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam1 ziu1 lok6 sau2 lok6 goek3 gaau3 ngo5 zou6 san1 je5, hok6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆今天親自教我做新工作，我學到了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The boss personally showed me the new task this morning; I learned a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺派對上對女仔落手落腳，令大家好反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 paai3 deoi3 soeng6 deoi3 neoi5 zai2 lok6 sau2 lok6 goek3, ling6 daai6 ga1 hou2 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在派對上對女生動手動腳，讓大家很反感。
examples.english_sentence: He was getting handsy with the women at the party, which made everyone uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）搭乘或上下交通工具（視語境可指上車或下車）
english_meaning: Colloquial verb for boarding or alighting a vehicle (context-dependent; can mean getting on or getting off)
explanation_mandarin: 「落搭」是廣東話的口語用法，常在香港地區出現，用來描述與交通工具有關的上下車動作。此詞具地方性與口語色彩，具體是上車或下車需依語境判斷。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb commonly used in Hong Kong to describe boarding or alighting a vehicle. It is regional and informal; whether it means getting on or getting off depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺中環站落搭咗，喺出口等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 zung1 waan4 zaam6 lok6 daap3 zo2, hai2 ceot1 hau2 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在中環站下車了，在出口等你。
examples.english_sentence: I got off at Central station — I'll wait for you at the exit.

mandarin_meaning: 落败 / 失败
english_meaning: to be defeated; to lose; to fail
explanation_mandarin: 表示在比賽、競爭或衝突中被打敗或失利，亦可用作形容詞表示處於失敗狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates being defeated or losing in a contest, competition, or struggle; can also describe a state of failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我哋落敗咗，大家唔好灰心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 lok6 baai6 zo2, daai6 gaa1 m4 hou2 fui1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们输了，大家不要灰心。
examples.english_sentence: We lost this match; don't be discouraged, everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於資金問題，公司最終落敗，被同行收購。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 zi1 gam1 man6 tai4, gung1 si1 zeoi3 zung1 lok6 baai6, bei6 tung4 hong4 sau1 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由于资金问题，公司最终失败，被同行收购。
examples.english_sentence: Due to funding problems, the company ultimately failed and was acquired by a competitor.

mandarin_meaning: 下滑 / 走下坡（事物變差或走向衰落）
english_meaning: to decline; to go downhill; (literally) to slope down
explanation_mandarin: 原指向下傾斜，引申為事情、狀況或表現開始變差、走下坡或失控。口語中常用於描述生意、成績、情況等變壞。
explanation_english: Literally 'to slope down.' Used figuratively to say something is declining or going downhill — e.g., business performance, grades, or a situation getting worse. Common Cantonese colloquial usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近佢公司嘅生意開始落斜，客人越嚟越少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 keoi5 gung1 si1 ge3 saang1 ji3 hoi1 ci2 lok6 ce4, haak3 jan4 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近他公司的生意開始下滑，顧客越來越少。
examples.english_sentence: Recently his company's business started to decline; customers are getting fewer and fewer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近沉迷賭博，生活開始落斜，朋友都擔心佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 cam4 mai4 dou2 bok3, sang1 wut6 hoi1 ci2 lok6 ce4, pang4 jau5 dou1 daam1 sam1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近沉迷賭博，生活開始走下坡，朋友們都很擔心他。
examples.english_sentence: He's been addicted to gambling lately; his life is going downhill and his friends are worried about him.

mandarin_meaning: 降旗、收起旗幟；引申為停止營業、撤退或放棄
english_meaning: to lower/take down a flag or banner; figuratively, to close down, withdraw, give up, or end an activity
explanation_mandarin: 原義為把旗幟降下或收起，口語中常用來表示結束活動、停止營業、撤退或放棄某項行動。
explanation_english: Literally means to lower or take down a flag. Colloquially used to mean ending an activity, closing down a business, withdrawing, or giving up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舖生意差，老闆決定落旗收舖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 saang1 ji3 caa1, lou5 baan2 kyut3 ding6 lok6 kei4 sau1 pou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間店生意不好，老闆決定結業關店。
examples.english_sentence: The shop's business is poor; the owner decided to close down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方要求示威者落旗，收起橫額。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 jiu1 kau4 si6 wai1 ze2 lok6 kei4, sau1 hei2 waang4 ngaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方要求示威者降下旗幟，收起橫幅。
examples.english_sentence: The police demanded protesters lower their flags and take down the banners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 玩捉旗嘅時候，隊長話要落旗交畀裁判。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waan2 zuk1 kei4 ge3 si4 hau6, deoi6 zoeng2 waa6 jiu3 lok6 kei4 gaau1 bei2 coi4 pun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玩奪旗遊戲時，隊長說要把旗交給裁判。
examples.english_sentence: During the capture-the-flag game, the captain said to hand the flag to the referee.

mandarin_meaning: 落日；日落，夕陽；亦可比喻衰落或接近結束
english_meaning: sunset; sundown; figuratively, decline or approaching the end
explanation_mandarin: 指太陽下山、天色變暗的現象（即日落、夕陽）；在比喻用法上，常用來形容事物、產業或時代的衰落或接近終結。
explanation_english: Refers to the sun setting (sunset/sundown). Figuratively, it can describe the decline or approaching end of something (e.g., an industry, era, or institution).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落日好靚，我哋去海邊睇下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 jat6 hou2 leng3, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 tai2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天落日很美，我們去海邊看看吧。
examples.english_sentence: The sunset is beautiful today; let's go to the beach to watch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司而家係落日產業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 hai6 lok6 jat6 caan2 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司現在是落日產業。
examples.english_sentence: This company is now a sunset industry (in decline).

mandarin_meaning: 日落條款（指法律、條例或合約中規定在特定日期後自動失效的條款）
english_meaning: Sunset clause — a provision that causes a law, regulation, or contractual term to expire automatically at a specified date unless renewed.
explanation_mandarin: 指法律、條例或合約中規定某條款在指定時間或日期後自動失效，除非經明確延長或重新通過。常用於限制臨時措施或要求定期檢討。
explanation_english: A legal or contractual provision that sets an expiration date for a law, regulation, or clause so it automatically lapses unless actively renewed or extended. Often used for temporary measures or to require periodic review.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條落日條款到期就會失效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lok6 jat6 tiu4 fun2 dou3 kei4 zau6 wui5 sat1 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條日落條款到期就會失效。
examples.english_sentence: This sunset clause will expire when the deadline arrives.

mandarin_meaning: 丟臉、出醜、非常尷尬或被羞辱
english_meaning: to be thoroughly embarrassed or humiliated; to make a fool of oneself; to lose face completely
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，形容因為失誤、出錯或被揭短而感到非常丟臉或被人看扁。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase used to describe being extremely embarrassed, humiliated, or losing face because of a mistake or awkward incident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上跌咗，真係落晒形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 seong6 dit3 zo2, zan1 hai6 lok6 saai3 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上摔倒了，真是太丟臉了。
examples.english_sentence: He fell on stage and was completely humiliated.

mandarin_meaning: 值班／上班（尤指輪班或夜班）
english_meaning: to go on duty / start a shift (often a night or rotating shift)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指開始值班或接替他人的班次，常用於夜間或輪班工作場合。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to begin a work shift or take over a shift, commonly used for night duty or rotating shifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要落更，唔可以出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 lok6 gang1, m4 ho2 ji5 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要值班，不能出去。
examples.english_sentence: I have to be on duty tonight; I can't go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保安話你聽日要落更，記得帶證件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 on1 waa6 nei5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 lok6 gang1, gei3 dak1 daai3 zing3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保安說你明天要值班，記得帶證件。
examples.english_sentence: Security said you have to be on shift tomorrow; remember to bring your ID.

mandarin_meaning: 投入本金；下重注（口語）
english_meaning: to invest/stake capital; to put serious money or resources into something; to go all-in
explanation_mandarin: 「落本」為廣東話口語，指把本金或大量資源投入某件事、下重注或冒較大風險；可用於投資、創業或賭博等情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to put in capital or large resources, to place a heavy bet, or to commit seriously to something (used for investments, startups, gambling, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好將啲錢落本喺嗰啲高風險股票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoeng1 di1 cin2 lok6 bun2 hai2 go2 di1 gou1 fung1 him2 gu2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别把钱投入那些高风险的股票。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put your money into those high-risk stocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你真係諗住創業，就要落本投入資金先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zan1 hai6 lam2 zyu6 cong3 jip6, zau6 jiu3 lok6 bun2 tau1 jap6 zi1 gam1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你真的打算创业，就要先投入本金。
examples.english_sentence: If you really plan to start a business, you need to invest capital first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺賭場一晚就落本輸晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou2 coeng4 jat1 maan5 zau6 lok6 bun2 syu1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在赌场一晚就把本钱输光了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost all his stake at the casino in one night.

mandarin_meaning: （物件）掉落/倒塌/散架；（商品）下架；（人）下台/退位（口語）
english_meaning: to fall off/collapse; to fall apart or be dismantled; to be taken off the shelves; (figuratively) to step down or be removed
explanation_mandarin: 「落架」在粤语中主要作动词使用，字面可指物件從架上掉下或拆散、倒塌；也常用來表示商品被下架，或引申為人下台、被撤職等口語用法。口語場合亦可形容東西壞到散掉或突然失去作用。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '落架' (lok6 gaa3) is a verb meaning literally 'to fall off the frame' or 'to collapse/dismantle'. It can describe objects falling apart or collapsing, products being taken off shelves, or figuratively someone stepping down or being removed. Colloquially it can also describe something breaking down completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張椅仔唔穩，突然間落架啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 ji2 zai2 m4 wan5, dat6 jin4 gaan1 lok6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那張椅子不穩，突然就倒塌了。
examples.english_sentence: The chair was unstable and suddenly collapsed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰款玩具因為安全問題已經落架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fun2 waan6 geoi6 jan1 wai6 on1 cyun4 man6 tai4 ji5 ging1 lok6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那款玩具因為安全問題已經下架了。
examples.english_sentence: That toy model has been taken off the shelves due to safety issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯事，要落架負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 si6, jiu3 lok6 gaa3 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯事，要下台負責。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake and has to step down to take responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 被捕；被拘留
english_meaning: to be arrested; to be taken into police custody
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語俚語，指被警察逮捕或帶走拘留，常用於非正式語境。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning to be arrested or taken into police custody. Used in informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢昨晚喺街度俾差人落柯打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok6 maan5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 bei2 caai1 jan4 lok6 o1 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚在街上被警察逮捕。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested by the police on the street last night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你再搞事，可能會落柯打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zoi3 gaau2 si6, ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 o1 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你再闹事，可能會被捕。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep causing trouble, you might get arrested.

mandarin_meaning: 过时；落伍
english_meaning: to go out of fashion; to become outdated
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，指某種風格、款式或潮流不再流行、變得過時或不合潮流。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning that a style, item, or trend is no longer popular or has become outdated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種髮型而家咁多人，會唔會好快落格？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 faat3 jing4 ji4 gaa1 gam2 do1 jan4, wui5 m4 wui5 hou2 faai3 lok6 gaak3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種髮型現在那麼多人，會不會很快就過時？
examples.english_sentence: This hairstyle is so common now — will it go out of fashion soon?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嗰款牛仔褲已經落格，宜家冇人著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 go2 fun2 ngau4 zai2 fu3 ji5 ging1 lok6 gaak3, ji4 gaa1 mou5 jan4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前那款牛仔褲已經過時了，現在沒人穿。
examples.english_sentence: That style of jeans is already out of fashion; nobody wears them now.

mandarin_meaning: 立案；登记案件并开始调查或起诉
english_meaning: to file/register a case; to formally open an investigation or bring charges
explanation_mandarin: 在法律或警方語境中，表示正式立案、將案件記錄在案並開始調查或提起訴訟。
explanation_english: Used in legal or police contexts to mean officially filing or registering a case and beginning investigation or prosecution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方已經落案調查呢宗案件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 ji5 ging1 lok6 on3 diu6 caa4 ni1 zung1 on3 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方已经立案调查这起案件。
examples.english_sentence: The police have already filed a case to investigate this incident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果證據齊全，法院會落案起訴佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 geoi3 cai4 cyun4, faat3 jyun2 wui5 lok6 on3 hei2 sou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果证据齐全，法院会立案起诉他/她。
examples.english_sentence: If the evidence is sufficient, the court will file charges against him/her.

mandarin_meaning: 下樓
english_meaning: go downstairs; go down from a building or floor
explanation_mandarin: 表示從樓上往下走到樓下，或從屋內前往樓下/大堂離開建築物。
explanation_english: Means to go down from an upper floor to a lower floor (go downstairs), or to leave one’s flat/building by going downstairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家落樓買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 lok6 lau4 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在下樓買東西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going downstairs to buy something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得鎖門先至落樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 so2 mun4 sin1 zi3 lok6 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記得先把門鎖好再下樓。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to lock the door before going downstairs.

mandarin_meaning: 下飛機
english_meaning: to get off a plane; to disembark
explanation_mandarin: 表示從飛機上下來、離開飛機。屬於口語用法，常見於香港廣東話。
explanation_english: Refers to getting off a plane or disembarking. A colloquial Cantonese expression commonly used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仲有十分鐘就要落機喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung6 jau5 sap6 fan1 zung1 zau6 jiu3 lok6 gei1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 還有十分鐘就要下飛機了。
examples.english_sentence: There are ten minutes left before we get off the plane.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落機之後要去拎行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 gei1 zi1 hau6 jiu3 heoi3 ling1 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下飛機之後要去取行李。
examples.english_sentence: After getting off the plane, I need to collect my luggage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你到時落機嘅時候記得打畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou3 si4 lok6 gei1 ge3 si4 hau6 gei3 dak1 daa2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到時你下飛機的時候記得打給我。
examples.english_sentence: When you get off the plane, remember to call me.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）散布惡意謠言、詆毀或陷害某人；比喻性地「毒害」某人的名譽或心情，也可指詛咒
english_meaning: (colloquial) to spread malicious rumors, bad-mouth or slander someone; figuratively to 'poison' someone's reputation or mood; can also mean to curse someone
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，通常指在背後說別人壞話、散布惡意謠言或設計陷害，使對方名譽或處境受損；有時也用來形容用言語詛咒或傷害他人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb usually meaning to badmouth someone, spread malicious rumors, or set someone up so their reputation or situation is harmed; sometimes used to mean verbally cursing or hurting someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度落毒啦，佢都冇做錯嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 lok6 duk6 laa1, keoi5 dou1 mou5 zou6 co3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在這裡說壞話，他也沒有做錯事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't badmouth him here; he hasn't done anything wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺背後落毒，點解大家仲會信佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 bui3 hau6 lok6 duk6, dim2 gaai2 daai6 gaa1 zung6 wui5 seon3 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在背後中傷別人，為什麼大家還會相信他？
examples.english_sentence: He keeps badmouthing people behind their backs; why do people still believe him?

mandarin_meaning: 掉進水裡；（引申）陷入麻煩、被牽連
english_meaning: literally 'fall into the water'; figuratively 'to get into trouble' or 'to be implicated/dragged into something'
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指掉進水裡。口語或慣用表達中也常用作比喻，表示陷入困境或被牽連／被拖下水（例如「拉人落水」）。
explanation_english: Literally means to fall into water. Figuratively used to mean getting into trouble, being implicated, or being dragged into someone else's mess (e.g. 'to be dragged into it').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心跌咗落水，要救佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 dit3 zo2 lok6 seoi2, jiu3 gau3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心掉進水裡了，要救他。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally fell into the water; we need to save him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好拉我落水！我同件事無關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 laai1 ngo5 lok6 seoi2! ngo5 tung4 gin6 si6 mou4 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別把我拖下水！我和這件事無關。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drag me into this! I'm not involved in this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 被踢出、被淘汰；（口語）被拒絕、被甩
english_meaning: to be dropped (from a team/lineup/project); colloquially, to be rejected or dumped
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語。原本常用於運動或隊伍語境，指被教練或負責人從名單或陣容中剔除、不能上場；引申為在工作、社交或感情關係中被放棄、淘汰或拒絕。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial/slang verb. Originally used in sports context to mean being dropped from a team or lineup by a coach/manager; extended usage means being removed, sidelined, rejected, or dumped in work, social, or romantic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練決定將佢落波，今場無得上陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 leon6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 keoi5 lok6 bo1, gam1 coeng4 mou5 dak1 soeng5 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练决定把他剔出名单，这场不能上场。
examples.english_sentence: The coach decided to drop him; he won't play in this match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目交唔到，佢畀公司落波咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hoeng6 muk6 gaau1 m4 dou3, keoi5 bei2 gung1 si1 lok6 bo1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目交不出来，公司把他除名了。
examples.english_sentence: The project couldn't be delivered; the company dropped him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 識咗幾個月，佢俾女朋友落波咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik1 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6, keoi5 bei2 neoi5 pang4 jau5 lok6 bo1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 认识了几个月，他被女朋友甩了。
examples.english_sentence: They'd been seeing each other for a few months; he got dumped by his girlfriend.

mandarin_meaning: 下注 / 投注
english_meaning: to place a bet; to stake (money)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指在賭博、彩票或比賽中把錢押在某個選項或號碼上。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to place a wager or stake money on a selection in gambling, lottery, or a contest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去賭場落注，輸贏無定數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 dou2 coeng4 lok6 zyu3, sou1 jing4 mou4 ding6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常去賭場下注，輸贏沒有一定。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the casino to place bets; wins and losses are uncertain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識點樣落注，教下我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 dim2 joeng6 lok6 zyu3, gaau3 haa5 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道怎麼下注，教教我吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to place a bet — teach me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚賽馬我落咗注喺第三號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 coi3 maa5 ngo5 lok6 zo2 zyu3 hai2 dai6 saam1 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚賽馬我下注押在第三號。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight for the horse race I placed a bet on number three.

mandarin_meaning: 落泪；流下眼泪，哭泣
english_meaning: to shed tears; to cry; to be moved to tears
explanation_mandarin: 表示眼泪从眼睛流出，通常因悲伤、感动或疼痛而哭泣。
explanation_english: To have tears fall from the eyes — to cry or be moved to tears, often because of sadness, strong emotion, or pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇到啲相就落淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 dou3 di1 soeng2 zau6 lok6 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到那些照片就落泪。
examples.english_sentence: He/she shed tears when seeing those photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到學生畢業嗰刻，老師忍唔住落淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 hok6 saang1 bat1 jip6 go2 hak1, lou5 si1 jan2 m4 zyu6 lok6 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到学生毕业的那一刻，老师忍不住落泪。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the students graduate, the teacher couldn't help but shed tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為感動而落淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 gam2 dung6 ji4 lok6 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为感动而落泪。
examples.english_sentence: He/she was moved to tears.

mandarin_meaning: 落汤鸡
english_meaning: soaking wet; drenched
explanation_mandarin: 口語慣用語，用來形容被雨或水淋得全身濕透，像掉進湯裡的雞一樣。
explanation_english: A colloquial idiom describing someone who is drenched—so wet as if they had fallen into soup (literally, a chicken fallen into soup).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱落完一場大雨，我成個人都濕透，真係落湯雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaam1 ngaam1 lok6 jyun4 jat1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5, ngo5 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 sap1 tau3, zan1 hai6 lok6 tong1 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 剛才下了一場大雨，我整個人都濕透了，真像落湯雞。
examples.english_sentence: It just poured and I was soaked through — I'm truly drenched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨冇帶遮，返到屋企成個人係落湯雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 mou5 daai3 ze1, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 seng4 go3 jan4 hai6 lok6 tong1 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨沒帶傘，回到家全身都濕透了，像落湯雞一樣。
examples.english_sentence: It rained and I didn't bring an umbrella; when I got home I was soaking wet.

mandarin_meaning: （像）落汤鸡，浑身湿透
english_meaning: soaking wet; drenched
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，形容被雨水或水淋得全身濕透，像落入湯裡的雞一樣。通常用來形容人被雨淋濕的情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone who is thoroughly soaked (as if a chicken dropped into hot water). Commonly used to describe a person drenched by rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落好大雨，佢返到屋企已經濕到似隻落湯鷄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 hou2 daai6 jyu5, keoi5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 ji5 ging1 sap1 dou3 ci5 zek3 lok6 tong4 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下大雨，他到家時已經濕得像落湯雞。
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily today; he arrived home already soaked like a drenched chicken.

mandarin_meaning: 嚇到腿軟、牙齒發顫（口語）
english_meaning: to be so frightened that one's legs go weak and teeth chatter (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「落牙骹」是香港粵語的口語說法，形容被嚇得很厲害，出現腿軟、牙齒發抖等生理反應。屬於俗語／俚語，用於非正式語境。
explanation_english: “落牙骹” is Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial slang describing being so frightened that one’s legs go weak and teeth chatter. It’s informal and typically used in spoken contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻大蜘蛛爬上枱面，佢即刻嚇到落牙骹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 daai6 zi1 zuk1 paa4 soeng5 toi2 min6, keoi5 zik1 hak1 haak3 dou3 lok6 ngaa4 gwaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻大蜘蛛爬到桌面，他立刻被嚇得腿軟、牙齒發抖。
examples.english_sentence: When the big spider crawled onto the table, he was immediately so scared his legs went weak and his teeth chattered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到深夜屋企樓下有拆嘈聲，佢一個人嚇到落牙骹，唔敢出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 sam1 je6 uk1 kei5 lau4 haa6 jau5 caak3 cou4 sing1, keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 haak3 dou3 lok6 ngaa4 gwaa1, m4 gam2 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 深夜聽到家樓下有吵鬧聲，他一個人嚇得腿軟，沒敢出去。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing noises downstairs late at night, he was alone and so frightened he didn't dare go out.

mandarin_meaning: 倒霉；運氣很差
english_meaning: to be unlucky; to have bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面是「踩到狗屎」，引申為遇到不順利或很衰的事情，表示倒霉或碰上麻煩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'step in dog poo.' It is used figuratively to say someone is unlucky or has run into misfortune/trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝出門就落狗屎，唔見咗錢包，仲遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ceot1 mun4 zau6 lok6 gau2 si2, m4 gin3 zo2 cin2 baau1, zung6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天一出門就倒霉，丟了錢包，還遲到。
examples.english_sentence: I was unlucky this morning: I lost my wallet as soon as I left and I was late.

mandarin_meaning: 下班；收工
english_meaning: to get off work; to finish one's shift
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，表示結束工作或從工作地點離開回家（即下班、收工）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to finish work or leave the workplace to go home (i.e., get off work).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日六點先落班，今晚唔得閒陪你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 luk6 dim2 sin1 lok6 baan1, gam1 maan5 m4 dak1 haan4 pui4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天六點才下班，今晚沒空陪你。
examples.english_sentence: I don't finish work until 6 today, so I can't hang out with you tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你落班記住買餸返屋企煮飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lok6 baan1 gei3 zyu6 maai5 sung3 faan1 faan1 uk1 kei2 zyu2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你下班記得買菜回家做飯。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to buy groceries on your way home after work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落大雨，仲要落班真係唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, zung6 jiu3 lok6 baan1 zan1 hai6 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下大雨，還要下班真的不方便。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining heavily today; having to get off work is really inconvenient.

mandarin_meaning: 被剔除／被取消／被排除在外
english_meaning: to be dropped (from a lineup/plan/cast); to be sidelined; to fall out of favor
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語口語用詞，表示某人或某事被從名單、節目、計劃中剔除或不再被用或重用，常見於娛樂圈、宣傳或工作安排上。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning someone or something has been removed from a list, programme, or plan — no longer included or has been sidelined. Commonly used for celebrities dropped from projects or people taken off schedules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次俾公司落畫，唔使出席晚會喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 bei2 gung1 si1 lok6 waa6, m4 sai2 ceot1 zik6 maan5 wui6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次被公司除名，不用出席晚會了。
examples.english_sentence: He was dropped by the company this time and doesn't have to attend the gala.

mandarin_meaning: 跌倒；倒下；（口語）崩潰、垮掉
english_meaning: to fall down; to collapse; (colloquial) to break down or fall apart
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語口語用詞。可用來形容人或物理上跌倒，也可引申為情緒或狀況崩潰、瓦解。視語境可為字面或比喻用法。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese term. It can describe a person or object physically falling, and can also be used figuratively for emotional collapse or a situation breaking down. Usage depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路唔小心落疊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 m4 siu2 sam1 lok6 daap6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路不小心摔倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally fell down while walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試失敗，佢整個人都落疊晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 sat1 baai6, keoi5 zing2 go3 jan4 dou1 lok6 daap6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試失敗，他整個人都崩潰了。
examples.english_sentence: After failing the exam, he completely broke down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司經營方式咁唔理想，遲早會落疊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ging1 jing4 fong1 sik1 gam2 m4 lei5 soeng2, ci4 zou2 wui5 lok6 daap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的經營方式這麼不理想，遲早會倒閉/瓦解。
examples.english_sentence: With such poor management, the company will collapse sooner or later.

mandarin_meaning: 落空；未能實現；失敗
english_meaning: to fail; to come to nothing; to fall through; to be unfulfilled
explanation_mandarin: 表示計劃、約定、希望或安排未能達成、沒有實現。為口語常用表達，常見用法有「落空咗／落空了」。
explanation_english: Indicates that a plan, appointment, hope, or arrangement did not succeed or was not realized. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese to mean that something 'fell through' or 'came to nothing.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來以為可以見到佢，但最後落空咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 loi4 ji5 wai6 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou3 keoi5, daan6 zeoi3 hau6 lok6 hung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本來以為可以見到他，但最後落空了。
examples.english_sentence: We thought we'd be able to see him, but in the end it fell through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅計劃全部落空咗，冇一樣做成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 cyun4 bou6 lok6 hung1 zo2, mou5 jat1 joeng6 zou6 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的计划全部落空了，沒有一项成功。
examples.english_sentence: Their plans all fell through; none of them worked out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試成績未達標，升學嘅希望都落空咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 sing4 zik1 mei6 daat6 biu1, sing1 hok6 ge3 hei1 mong6 dou1 lok6 hung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试成绩未達到標準，升学的希望都落空了。
examples.english_sentence: The exam results didn't meet the standard, so the hopes of advancing to a higher school were dashed.

mandarin_meaning: 落笔；开始写作；签字
english_meaning: to put pen to paper; to begin writing; to sign
explanation_mandarin: 指把筆放下開始寫字或開始動筆創作，有時也用於簽署文件或合約。
explanation_english: Refers to putting pen to paper — beginning to write or start composing; can also be used for signing documents or contracts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗咗半個鐘先至落筆，唔想寫得匆忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 sin1 zi3 lok6 bat1, m4 soeng2 se2 dak1 cung1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想了半個小時才落筆，不想寫得匆忙。
examples.english_sentence: I thought for half an hour before putting pen to paper; I don't want to write hastily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約到時要你落筆簽名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 dou3 si4 jiu3 nei5 lok6 bat1 cim1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份合約到時需要你落筆簽名。
examples.english_sentence: You'll need to sign this contract when the time comes.

mandarin_meaning: （像）挑燈夜戰／熬夜寫作
english_meaning: to burn the midnight oil (to write/work late into the night)
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，形容一開始寫作或做事後就寫到很晚（甚至通宵），沉迷於寫作或工作，熬夜不睡。
explanation_english: A Cantonese idiom describing starting to write or work and continuing late into the night (or all night); being so absorbed in writing/work that one burns the midnight oil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做報告果陣，我一落筆就打三更，寫到凌晨先瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 bou3 gou3 gwo2 zan6, ngo5 jat1 lok6 bat1 zau6 daa2 saam1 geng1, se2 dou3 ling4 san4 sin1 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做报告的时候，我一开始动笔就写到深夜，写到凌晨才睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: When I was writing the report, once I started I ended up working into the late night and didn't sleep until the early morning.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）把東西放入箱子；（俚語，香港）收檔、結束營業、離職或被解僱
english_meaning: (literal) to put into a box; (slang, Hong Kong) to close up/pack up (a business), quit, or be let go (to be sacked)
explanation_mandarin: 「落箱」可以是字面意思，把東西放入箱子；在香港口語裡常作俚語，表示收檔、結束營業、打包離開、辭職或被解僱等結束性的行為。
explanation_english: Literally 'put into a box'. In Hong Kong colloquial usage, it is a slang verb meaning to pack up/close shop, to quit, or to be let go (i.e., an end/closure of business or position).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲衫已經落咗箱，準備搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 saam1 ji5 ging1 lok6 zo2 soeng1, zeon2 bei6 bun1 uk1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的衣服已經放進箱子，準備搬家。
examples.english_sentence: My clothes have already been packed into boxes, ready to move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖生意差，估唔到會落箱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 sang1 ji3 caa1, gu2 m4 dou3 wui5 lok6 soeng1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店生意不好，沒想到會收檔/關門。
examples.english_sentence: This shop's business is poor; I didn't expect it would close down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話公司要裁員，有啲同事已經落箱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 gung1 si1 jiu3 coi4 jyun4, jau5 di1 tung4 si6 ji5 ging1 lok6 soeng1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆說公司要裁員，有些同事已經被裁掉/離職。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said the company will lay off staff; some colleagues have already been let go.

mandarin_meaning: 阴道出血（常指妊娠初期或可能导致流产的出血）
english_meaning: Vaginal bleeding; spotting, especially during early pregnancy or as a sign of threatened miscarriage
explanation_mandarin: 指陰道出血，常用來描述妊娠早期的少量出血或可能是先兆流產的出血情況。
explanation_english: Refers to vaginal bleeding or spotting, commonly used to describe bleeding in early pregnancy or bleeding that may indicate a threatened miscarriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我早兩日有啲落紅，已經約咗醫生檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou2 loeng5 jat6 jau5 di1 lok6 hung4, ji5 ging1 joek3 zo2 ji1 sang1 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我前两天有些阴道出血，已经约了医生检查。
examples.english_sentence: I had some vaginal bleeding a couple of days ago and already made an appointment to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孕婦出現落紅要小心，可能係流產前嘅徵兆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan6 fu5 ceot1 jin6 lok6 hung4 jiu3 siu2 sam1, ho2 nang4 hai6 lau4 caan2 cin4 ge3 zing1 ziu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孕妇出现阴道出血要小心，可能是流产前的征兆。
examples.english_sentence: If a pregnant woman has vaginal bleeding, be cautious — it may be a sign of impending miscarriage.

mandarin_meaning: 落网（被捕、被抓获）
english_meaning: to be caught; to be arrested; to be nabbed (by police); figuratively, to be exposed or trapped
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語/俗語，指被警方或當局逮捕、抓獲，也可比喻被揭發或陷入圈套。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to be caught or arrested (usually by police). It can also be used metaphorically for being exposed or trapped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於落網喇，警方拘捕咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 lok6 mong5 laa3, ging2 fong1 gu1 bou3 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于落网了，警方已经把他逮捕。
examples.english_sentence: He was finally caught; the police arrested him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班詐騙集團終於落網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 zaa3 pin3 zaap6 tyun4 zung1 jyu1 lok6 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这帮诈骗集团终于落网了。
examples.english_sentence: The fraud ring was finally caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺機場將佢落網，帶返警署問話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 gei1 coeng4 zoeng1 keoi5 lok6 mong5, daai3 faan1 ging2 syu2 man6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在机场把他逮捕，带回警署问话。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested him at the airport and took him back to the station for questioning.

mandarin_meaning: 嚴厲責罵、訓斥
english_meaning: to harshly scold or give someone a tongue-lashing
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指對人嚴厲地責罵或發脾氣罵人，常用於日常會話中描述訓斥行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to scold someone harshly or lose one's temper at them; used in informal speech to describe giving a reprimand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細一錯就會落老蘭，好多人唔敢問問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 jat1 co3 zau6 wui5 lok6 lou5 laan4, hou2 do1 jan4 m4 gam2 man6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆一犯錯就會嚴厲責罵，很多人不敢問問題。
examples.english_sentence: The boss scolds harshly at the slightest mistake, so many people dare not ask questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再咁樣，我會落老蘭㗎喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gam2 joeng6, ngo5 wui5 lok6 lou5 laan4 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再這樣了，我會罵你的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't do that again — I'll give you a good scolding!

mandarin_meaning: 落脚；落脚处（暂住、借宿、安顿）
english_meaning: to stay (temporarily); to take lodging; to settle (in a place)
explanation_mandarin: 「落腳」在廣東話中常用來表示在某處暫時或永久安頓、借宿或居住下來，常見用法有「喺某處落腳／落腳點」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "落腳" commonly means to take lodging or settle down (temporarily or permanently) at a place. Frequently used as "to stay at" or "a place to stay" (e.g., "落腳點").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我可唔可以喺你屋企落腳？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 nei5 uk1 kei2 lok6 goek3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我可以在你家落脚吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I stay at your place tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家暫時喺朋友屋企落腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zam6 si4 hai2 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2 lok6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在暫時在朋友家落腳。
examples.english_sentence: I'm temporarily staying at a friend's place.

mandarin_meaning: 惹人生气、使人烦躁或不舒服（粤语俚语）
english_meaning: to annoy, irritate, or make someone feel uncomfortable (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语/俚语，通常作动词，表示使人感到不舒服、烦躁或被惹恼。可用于描述人、行为或言语令人讨厌或恼火。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb used to describe causing someone to feel irritated, annoyed, or uncomfortable. It can refer to a person, action, or remark that gets on someone's nerves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，真係好落膈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 lok6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，真让人烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢咁樣講，我真係有啲落膈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou3 keoi5 gam2 joeng6 gong2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 jau5 di1 lok6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他那样说，我真的有点生气/不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that actually made me a bit irritated.

mandarin_meaning: 下船；（比喻）退出、放棄
english_meaning: to disembark (from a boat); figuratively, to quit/abandon a project or withdraw support
explanation_mandarin: 「落船」字面意思是從船上下來；在口語或俚語用法中，常用來比喻在事情、計畫或投資過程中途退出或放棄（類似「退出」、「下車」）。
explanation_english: Literally means to get off a boat. Colloquially it is used figuratively to mean withdrawing from or abandoning a project, plan, investment, or group (similar to 'bowing out' or 'abandoning ship').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 船到碼頭，我哋可以落船啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun4 dou3 maa5 tau4, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 lok6 syun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 船到码头，我们可以下船了。
examples.english_sentence: The boat's at the dock; we can get off now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個項目中途落船，冇堅持到最後。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 zung1 tou4 lok6 syun4, mou5 gin1 ci4 dou3 zeoi3 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这个项目中途退出了，没坚持到最后。
examples.english_sentence: He dropped out of the project halfway and didn't stick it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資者發現風險，開始陸續落船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 ze2 faat3 jin6 fung1 him2, hoi1 ci2 luk6 zuk6 lok6 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资者发现风险，开始陆续退出（抛售）。
examples.english_sentence: Investors detected risks and began to abandon ship one after another (sell off).

mandarin_meaning: 落花（luòhuā）：1. 凋落的花瓣；2. 引申為事物凋零、失落或用於描寫感情上的無奈（見成語如「落花流水」、「落花有意，流水無情」）。
english_meaning: fallen flowers / fallen petals; figuratively decay, fading beauty, or used in expressions about unrequited love or defeat.
explanation_mandarin: 可指實際掉落的花瓣，也常在詩詞和成語中作比喻，表達凋零、失落或感情上的無奈。
explanation_english: Can mean actual fallen petals, and is often used poetically or in idioms to express decline, loss, or romantic disappointment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天啲落花好靚，鋪滿條路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 dik1 lok6 faa1 hou2 leng3, pou1 mun5 tiu4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天的落花很漂亮，鋪滿了整條路。
examples.english_sentence: The fallen flowers in spring are beautiful, covering the whole path.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽入面表現得落花流水，完全冇機會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 biu2 jin2 dak1 lok6 faa1 lau4 seoi2, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 gei1 wui6 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中表现得落花流水，完全没有机会赢。
examples.english_sentence: He performed disastrously in the match and had no chance to win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有句古話講：落花有意，流水無情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 geoi3 gu2 waa6 gong2: lok6 faa1 jau5 ji3, lau4 seoi2 mou4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有句古話說：落花有意，流水無情。
examples.english_sentence: There is an old saying: 'The fallen flowers may have affection, but the flowing water is heartless.'

mandarin_meaning: 落花流水（成語），比喻遭到慘敗或境遇凄慘、狼狽不堪
english_meaning: An idiom meaning 'utterly defeated' or 'in complete rout'; literally 'fallen flowers and flowing water', used to describe a crushing defeat or a sorry state
explanation_mandarin: 原指落花被流水沖散，後用來比喻遭受慘敗或處境非常淒涼、狼狽不堪，也可形容事物破敗不成樣。
explanation_english: Originally describes fallen flowers swept away by flowing water; metaphorically used for suffering a crushing defeat or being in a pitiable, disordered state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場比賽佢哋畀對手打到落花流水，連一個入球都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 keoi5 dei6 bei2 deoi3 sau2 daa2 dou3 lok6 faa1 lau4 seoi2, lin4 jat1 go3 jap6 kau4 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛他们被对手打得落花流水，连一个进球都没有。
examples.english_sentence: In this match they were routed by their opponents, not even scoring a single goal.

mandarin_meaning: 落草為寇（成語），意為棄農從盜／投身為盜，常指因走投無路而成為盜匪或反叛者。
english_meaning: to take to the hills and become a bandit; to turn to outlawry or rebellion (idiom).
explanation_mandarin: 原指放棄耕作，投奔山林成為盜賊；現多用來形容因走投無路或反抗而走上成為盜匪、造反等道路。
explanation_english: Originally referred to abandoning farming and taking to the hills to become bandits; now often used to describe turning to outlawry or rebellion when driven to desperation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲窮苦嘅人走投無路，唯有落草為寇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 kung4 fu2 ge3 jan4 zau2 tau4 mou4 lou6, wai4 jau5 lok6 cou2 wai4 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些窮苦的人走投無路，只好落草為寇。
examples.english_sentence: Those impoverished people had nowhere to turn and had to take to the hills and become bandits.

mandarin_meaning: 落草為寇（成為強盜或起義者）
english_meaning: To take to the hills and become a bandit; to turn into an outlaw or rebel (often out of desperation)
explanation_mandarin: 古代成語，原指離家上山聚眾為盜，後泛指因困窮或被逼無奈而走上成為盜匪或造反的道路。
explanation_english: A classical idiom meaning to take to the hills and become a bandit. Figuratively it describes someone who becomes an outlaw or rebel, often out of desperation or forced circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅窮困逼到佢落草為寇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 kung4 kwan3 bik1 dou3 keoi5 lok6 cou2 wai4 kau3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的窮困逼得他落草為寇。
examples.english_sentence: His poverty forced him to take to the hills and become an outlaw.

mandarin_meaning: 落荒而逃（因驚慌或恐懼而慌忙逃走）
english_meaning: To flee in panic; to run away hurriedly out of fear or alarm.
explanation_mandarin: 成語，形容因為驚慌或恐懼而匆忙逃跑，帶有慌亂、狼狽的意味。
explanation_english: An idiom describing fleeing in a panic — running away hurriedly because of fear or alarm, often in a disorderly or embarrassed manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到後面有人追佢，佢即刻落荒而逃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 hau6 min6 jau5 jan4 zeoi1 keoi5, keoi5 zik1 hak1 lok6 fong1 ji4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到後面有人追他，他立刻落荒而逃。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing someone chasing him from behind, he immediately fled in panic.

mandarin_meaning: 下庄（在牌局或赌博中不再担任庄家或离开赌桌）
english_meaning: to step down as the dealer/banker; to leave the table or quit playing (in gambling/game context)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，常見於麻將、賭博或牌局情境，表示不再當莊家、退出牌局或離開賭桌；也可引申指停止參與或退出某個輪次或活動。
explanation_english: A colloquial term used in mahjong, gambling, or game contexts meaning to stop being the dealer/banker or to leave the table; can also be used more broadly to mean withdrawing or bowing out of a round or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 贏咗之後佢即刻落莊，唔想再玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing4 zo2 zi1 hau6 keoi5 zik1 hak1 lok6 zong1, m4 soeng2 zoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一赢就立刻下庄，不想再玩了。
examples.english_sentence: He cashed out and left the table right after winning; he didn't want to play anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做莊做得好累，佢話下輪要落莊畀其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zong1 zou6 dak1 hou2 leoi6, keoi5 waa6 haa6 leon4 jiu3 lok6 zong1 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当庄当得很累，他說下一輪要下庄讓別人來。
examples.english_sentence: Being the dealer is tiring; he said he'll step down next round and let someone else take over.

mandarin_meaning: 落叶 (luò yè)
english_meaning: fallen leaves; leaves that have fallen from trees
explanation_mandarin: 指從樹上掉下來的葉子，常用來描述秋季或凋零的景象，也可用作比喻凋零、離散或孤寂的意象。
explanation_english: Refers to leaves that have fallen from trees. Often used to describe autumn or imagery of decay, dispersal, or loneliness; can be used literally or figuratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋天公園入面到處都係落葉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 tin1 gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 dou3 cyu3 dou1 hai6 lok6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋天公園裡到處都是落葉。
examples.english_sentence: In autumn the park is full of fallen leaves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講起舊日嘅事，眼神好似落葉咁孤獨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hei2 gau6 jat6 ge3 si6, ngaan5 san4 hou2 ci5 lok6 jip6 gam2 gu1 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說起往事時，眼神像落葉般孤獨。
examples.english_sentence: When he talked about the past, his eyes looked lonely like fallen leaves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人喺馬路邊掃落葉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 hai2 maa5 lou6 bin1 sou3 lok6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人在馬路邊掃落葉。
examples.english_sentence: Workers are sweeping fallen leaves by the roadside.

mandarin_meaning: 落葉歸根 (luò yè guī gēn) — 回到故鄉或原本的地方，常指人在晚年或臨終時回歸故里。
english_meaning: Literal: 'fallen leaves return to the roots.' Figurative: to return to one's hometown or place of origin, especially at the end of life or when retiring.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人晚年或將近人生終點時，回到故鄉定居或安葬；也泛指回歸原來的地方或團聚。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to return to one's native place or roots, often used when someone goes back home in old age or at the end of life; can also mean returning to where one belongs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢年紀大咗，想落葉歸根，返老家同家人團聚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nin4 gei2 daai6 zo2, soeng2 lok6 jip6 gwai1 gan1, faan1 lou5 gaa1 tung4 gaa1 jan4 tyun4 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年紀大了，想落葉歸根，回老家和家人團聚。
examples.english_sentence: He's getting old and wants to return home to be with his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗幾十年喺海外，佢打算退休後落葉歸根。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 hai2 hoi2 ngoi6, keoi5 daa2 syun3 teoi3 jau1 hau6 lok6 jip6 gwai1 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在外工作幾十年，他打算退休後落葉歸根。
examples.english_sentence: After working abroad for decades, he plans to retire and return to his hometown.

mandarin_meaning: 下药（在他人食物或饮料中放入药物或迷药，使其失去意识或抵抗力）
english_meaning: to drug someone; to spike someone's food or drink (to secretly put drugs or sedatives into someone's food or drink to incapacitate them)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，常指在別人的食物或飲料中偷偷加入藥物或迷藥，使對方昏迷或喪失抵抗力，常見於搶劫或性侵犯等犯罪情況；在醫療語境中亦可指給藥，但較少見。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning to secretly put drugs or sedatives into someone's food or drink to incapacitate them. It usually refers to criminal acts such as spiking drinks for robbery or assault. Less commonly used to mean administering medication in a medical context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去酒吧要小心，唔好畀人落藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 zau2 baa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 lok6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去酒吧要小心，不要让人下药。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when going to bars; don't let anyone drug you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢懷疑杯裡被落藥，所以即刻報警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waai4 ji4 bui1 leoi5 bei6 lok6 joek6, so2 ji5 zik1 haak1 bou3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他怀疑杯里被下药，所以立刻报警。
examples.english_sentence: He suspected his drink had been spiked, so he immediately called the police.

mandarin_meaning: 出門 / 上街 / 出去（到街上或去買東西）
english_meaning: to go out (to the street/shops); to go out shopping; go outside
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來表示離開家或室內空間到街上或去逛街、買東西等活動；有時也可單純表示「出門」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to leave home or an indoor place to go out to the street — often to go shopping, hang out, or simply go outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家落街買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 lok6 gaai1 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在要出門去買東西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going out now to buy something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚落街食飯呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 lok6 gaai1 sik6 faan6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚出去吃飯嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go out for dinner tonight?

mandarin_meaning: 到手；收入囊中
english_meaning: to secure; to be 'in the bag'; to pocket (money or a guaranteed gain)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，字面意思是把東西放入袋中，常用來表示某物已經到手或已確定獲得，例如錢、獎金或訂單等。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase literally meaning 'put into the bag.' Commonly used to indicate that something has been secured or obtained (e.g., money, a bonus, an order).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 獎金已經落袋喇，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng2 gam1 ji5 ging1 lok6 doi6 laa3, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奖金已经收入囊中，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: The bonus is already secured, no need to worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賣咗之後啲錢已經落袋喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai6 zo2 zi1 hau6 di1 cin2 ji5 ging1 lok6 doi6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 卖了之后的钱已经到手了。
examples.english_sentence: The payment has come in after the sale.

mandarin_meaning: 去世；死亡（委婉說法）
english_meaning: to pass away; to die (euphemism)
explanation_mandarin: 「落西」是廣東話口語的委婉說法，字面上為「往西去」，常用來表示某人去世或死亡，屬非正式或口語用法。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial euphemism literally meaning "go west," commonly used to indicate that someone has died or passed away. It is informal and used in conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺病咗好耐，今朝終於落西。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, gam1 ziu1 zung1 jyu1 lok6 sai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爺爺病了很久，今天早上終於去世了。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather had been ill for a long time; he finally passed away this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢上個月落西咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 keoi5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 lok6 sai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說他上個月去世了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he passed away last month.

mandarin_meaning: 付訂、下訂（支付訂金以保留或確認訂單）
english_meaning: to place an order / to pay a deposit (to reserve or confirm a purchase or booking)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，「落訂」指為保留商品或服務而支付訂金或正式下訂，常用於買樓、買車、預訂貨品或訂位等場景，表示以金錢或書面形式確認訂單或保留資格。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 'lok6 ding6' means to place an order or pay a deposit to reserve goods or services. It's commonly used for confirming purchases or bookings (e.g., property, goods, reservations) by paying a deposit or making a formal commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經落咗訂，下星期去拎貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 lok6 zo2 ding6, haa6 sing1 kei4 heoi3 ling1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們已經付了訂金，下星期去取貨。
examples.english_sentence: We already paid the deposit; we'll pick up the goods next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果想買呢間樓，你要先落訂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 maai5 ni1 gaan1 lau4, nei5 jiu3 sin1 lok6 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果想買這間房子，你要先付訂金。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to buy this flat, you have to pay a deposit first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經落訂喺餐廳，今晚七點有位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 lok6 ding6 hai2 caan1 teng1, gam1 maan5 cat1 dim2 jau5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經在餐廳訂了位，今晚七點有位置。
examples.english_sentence: I've already reserved a table at the restaurant; there's a table for 7pm tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 到貨 / 卸貨 / 進貨
english_meaning: to receive/unload goods; to take delivery of stock; to get new stock for sale
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中指货物抵达并进行卸载或收货，也可指新貨上架、進貨準備出售。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, it means goods have arrived and are being unloaded/received; it can also refer to new stock arriving and being prepared for sale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新貨今朝已經落咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 fo3 gam1 ziu1 ji5 ging1 lok6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新货今天已经到了。
examples.english_sentence: The new stock arrived this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋禮拜五會落貨，準備開賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lai5 baai3 ng5 wui5 lok6 fo3, zeon2 bei6 hoi1 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期五會進貨，準備開賣。
examples.english_sentence: We will receive the stock on Friday and prepare to start selling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貨車到埗，可以開始落貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo3 ce1 dou3 bou6, ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 lok6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 货车到达，可以开始卸货。
examples.english_sentence: The truck has arrived; we can start unloading the goods.

mandarin_meaning: 黏著、依附（某人）；黏人
english_meaning: to cling to someone; to stick close (physically or emotionally); clingy
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，形容一個人緊貼或黏著別人，可以指身體上的依附或情感上的依賴／黏人。
explanation_english: An informal Cantonese expression meaning to stick close to or cling to someone. Can refer to physical closeness or emotional dependence — i.e., being 'clingy.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路成日落貼阿媽，唔肯自己瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 lok6 tip3 aa3 maa1, m4 hang2 zi6 gei2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子總是黏著媽媽，不肯自己睡覺。
examples.english_sentence: The child always clings to his/her mother and won't sleep on their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日落貼朋友，會令佢哋覺得好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 lok6 tip3 pang4 jau5, wui5 ling6 keoi5 dei6 gok3 dak1 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要總是黏著朋友，會讓他們覺得很煩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cling to your friends all the time — it'll make them feel annoyed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好落貼，成日黐住佢個女朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lok6 tip3, sing4 jat6 ci1 zyu6 keoi5 go3 neoi5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很黏人，總是黏著他的女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He's very clingy and is always attached to his girlfriend.

mandarin_meaning: 下足功夫；付出很多努力
english_meaning: to put in a lot of effort; to work hard; to do something thoroughly
explanation_mandarin: 「落足功夫」是廣東話常用的動詞短語，意指在某件事上投入大量時間和努力，做得很認真或徹底。
explanation_english: A Cantonese verb phrase meaning to invest a great deal of time and effort into something — to work hard or do something thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋呢個項目要落足功夫先至做得成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jiu3 lok6 zuk1 gung1 fu1 sin1 zi3 zou6 dak1 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这个项目要下足功夫才能成功。
examples.english_sentence: We need to put in a lot of effort on this project to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師話寫論文要落足功夫，唔好趕工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 waa6 se2 leon6 man4 jiu3 lok6 zuk1 gung1 fu1, m4 hou2 gon2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师说写论文要下足功夫，不要赶工。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher said you need to put a lot of effort into writing your thesis; don't rush it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗比賽落足功夫，每日都練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bei2 coi3 lok6 zuk1 gung1 fu1, mui5 jat6 dou1 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了比赛下足功夫，每天都练习。
examples.english_sentence: He put in a lot of effort for the competition, practicing every day.

mandarin_meaning: 跺脚；踩踏；重重地踏
english_meaning: to stomp; to stamp (one's feet); to tread heavily
explanation_mandarin: 口语用法，形容用力跺脚或重重地踏步，步伐沉重，常用来表示生气、不满或急躁的情绪。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb describing stamping or walking with heavy, forceful steps. Often used to convey anger, frustration, or agitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢走路好沉重，一路落踏咁行返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau2 lou6 hou2 cam4 zung6, jat1 lou6 lok6 taap3 gam2 haang4 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路很沉重，一路跺著脚走回家。
examples.english_sentence: He was walking heavily, stomping his feet all the way home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔玩到好興奮，不停落踏地下跑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 waan2 dou3 hou2 hing1 fan5, bat1 ting4 lok6 taap3 dei6 haa6 paau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子玩得很兴奋，不停地跺着地跑。
examples.english_sentence: The kids were so excited they kept stomping and running on the ground.

mandarin_meaning: 親身到場；親自前往
english_meaning: to go/come in person; to attend or handle something personally
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示親自到場或親自處理，不是透過電話或他人代辦。
explanation_english: Colloquial expression meaning to attend or handle something personally rather than by phone or through someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話會落身幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wui5 lok6 san1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說會親身幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'll come in person to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細要我今日落身見客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 jiu3 ngo5 gam1 jat6 lok6 san1 gin3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆要我今天親自見客戶。
examples.english_sentence: The boss wants me to meet the client in person today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有問題，最好落身睇一睇先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 man6 tai4, zeoi3 hou2 lok6 san1 tai2 jat1 tai2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有問題，最好親自去看看先。
examples.english_sentence: If there's a problem, it's best to go and check it yourself first.

mandarin_meaning: 下车 / 退出（比喻用法）
english_meaning: to get off (a vehicle); to quit/withdraw (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 「落車」原指從車上走下來，即下車。口語中亦常引申為在某個計劃、項目或行動中退出、不再參與。
