explanation_english: Originally means to get off a vehicle (to alight). Colloquially it can also mean to quit or withdraw from a plan, project, or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺下一站要落車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 haa6 jat1 zaam6 jiu3 lok6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要在下一站下车。
examples.english_sentence: I'm getting off at the next stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你到咗目的地先落車啦，唔好急住落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou3 zo2 muk6 dik1 dei6 sin1 lok6 ce1 laa1, m4 hou2 gap1 zyu6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你到达目的地再下车吧，别着急下车。
examples.english_sentence: Wait until we reach the destination before getting off—don't get off yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想繼續做呢個計劃，決定落車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gai3 zuk6 zou6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6, kyut3 ding6 lok6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想继续做这个计划，决定退出。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to continue with this plan; I've decided to quit.

mandarin_meaning: 落选 (luòxuǎn)
english_meaning: to lose (an election); to not be selected
explanation_mandarin: 表示在選舉或遴選中未被選上、失去當選或被錄取的資格。
explanation_english: Indicates failing to be elected or selected in an election or selection process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次落選咗，唔會再做議員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 lok6 syun2 zo2, m4 wui5 zoi3 zou6 ji5 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她這次落選了，不會再當議員。
examples.english_sentence: He/She lost the election this time and won't be a councillor again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我申請嗰份工落選，真係失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 san1 cing2 go2 fan6 gung1 lok6 syun2, zan1 hai6 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我申請那份工作落選了，真的很失望。
examples.english_sentence: My application for that job wasn't selected; I'm really disappointed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 票數太少，佢落選無得翻身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: piu3 sou3 taai3 siu2, keoi5 lok6 syun2 mou5 dak1 faan1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 票數太少，他/她落選無法翻身。
examples.english_sentence: With too few votes, he/she lost and can't make a comeback.

mandarin_meaning: 落錯格 / 放错类别、放错格子、放错位置
english_meaning: to put something or someone in the wrong category/box; to be out of place or misclassified; to appear inappropriate for the context
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，字面上是「放進錯的格子」，引申指把人或事物歸類錯誤、放錯位置，或在不合適的場合出現，使人感到不合時宜或被誤解。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "put into the wrong box." It is used to say someone or something has been misclassified or placed in the wrong spot, or that a remark/behaviour is out of place for the situation — often implying misunderstanding or inappropriateness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我填表嘅時候唔小心落錯格，結果資料畀錯咗部門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tin4 biu2 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 siu2 sam1 lok6 co3 gaak3, git3 gwo2 zi1 liu2 bei2 co3 zo2 bou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我填表的时候不小心落错格子，结果资料给错了部门。
examples.english_sentence: When I filled out the form I accidentally put it in the wrong box, and the information went to the wrong department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講，喺呢個場合好似落錯格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 gong2, hai2 ni1 go3 coeng4 hap6 hou2 ci5 lok6 co3 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样说，在这个场合显得有点不合时宜/格格不入。
examples.english_sentence: Saying that here seems out of place for this occasion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺交友網站落錯格，結果俾人誤會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaau1 jau5 mong5 zaam6 lok6 co3 gaak3, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 ng6 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在交友网站上选错类别，结果被人误会。
examples.english_sentence: He chose the wrong category on the dating site and was misunderstood.

mandarin_meaning: 被放錯類別／走錯地方（口語）
english_meaning: to be put in the wrong category / to end up in the wrong place (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「落錯隔」是廣東話口語，字面意思是放到錯誤的格子或隔間。常用來表示某人或某物被歸類到不正確的類別、被安排到不合適的群組或身處錯誤的地方，亦可指由於分類或安排錯誤而引起的誤會或不便。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, literally 'placed in the wrong partition/slot.' It is used to say someone or something was put into the wrong category, assigned to an inappropriate group, or ended up in the wrong place. It can also refer to misunderstandings or problems caused by such misplacement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲文件落錯隔，應該放喺人事部，唔係放喺財務部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 man4 gin2 lok6 co3 gaak3, jing1 goi1 fong3 hai2 jan4 si6 bou6, m4 hai6 fong3 hai2 coi4 mou6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 文件被放錯了分類，應該放在人事部，不是放在財務部。
examples.english_sentence: The documents were placed in the wrong section; they belong in HR, not Finance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇做錯嘢，只係落錯隔咗，結果被誤會咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 zou6 co3 je5, zi2 hai6 lok6 co3 gaak3 zo2, git3 gwo2 bei6 ng6 wui6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他沒有做錯事，只是被歸錯類了，結果被誤會了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do anything wrong; he was just put in the wrong category and got misunderstood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去到會場先發覺自己落錯隔，原來呢場係其他部門嘅聚會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 dou3 wui6 coeng4 sin1 faat3 gok3 zi6 gei2 lok6 co3 gaak3, jyun4 loi4 ni1 coeng4 hai6 kei4 taa1 bou6 mun4 ge3 zeoi6 wui5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到會場才發現自己走錯了地方，原來這是其他部門的聚會。
examples.english_sentence: I only realized at the venue that I was in the wrong group—the meeting was for another department.

mandarin_meaning: 惹上麻煩；被責備或被當替罪羊（類似「背黑鍋」）
english_meaning: to get into trouble, be blamed, or be made a scapegoat (literally 'fall into the wok')
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，字面是「落入鑊中」，引申為陷入麻煩、被人責備或替人頂罪。常用於描述被推卸責任或承擔不該有的責任。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'fall into the wok'. It describes getting into trouble, being blamed, or being made to take the fall for someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔想落鑊，就唔好同佢扯上關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 soeng2 lok6 wok6, zau6 m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 ce2 soeng5 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不想惹上麻煩，就不要跟他扯上關係。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to get into trouble, don't get involved with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話係我犯嘅錯，但實際上係佢搞，點解要我落鑊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 hai6 ngo5 faan6 ge3 co3, daan6 sat6 zai3 soeng6 hai6 keoi5 gaau2, dim2 gaai2 jiu3 ngo5 lok6 wok6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說是我犯的錯，但實際上是他弄的，為什麼要我背黑鍋？
examples.english_sentence: He says it was my mistake, but it was actually him — why should I take the blame?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出事，啲高層想搵個人落鑊，留意啲消息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceot1 si6, di1 gou1 cang4 soeng2 wan2 go3 jan4 lok6 wok6, lau4 ji3 di1 siu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出了問題，上層想找個人頂罪，要留意消息。
examples.english_sentence: There's trouble at the company; the executives want someone to take the fall — watch for news.

mandarin_meaning: 关门/停业；（字面）放下闸门、关闸
english_meaning: Literally 'lower the gate'; colloquially 'to close up' (a shop), to shut down, to cut off access or contact
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指把閘門放下（關閘）；口語上常用來表示店鋪關門歇業、暫停服務或切斷聯繫、停止交易。
explanation_english: Literally means to lower a gate. Colloquially used to mean closing a shop, ceasing operations, shutting down a service, or cutting off contact/ending a deal. Common in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舖頭喺夜晚十一點就落閘喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou3 tau4 hai2 je6 maan5 sap6 jat1 dim2 zau6 lok6 zaap6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 店舖在晚上十一點就關門了。
examples.english_sentence: The shop closes at 11 PM.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 談判搞唔掂之後，對方即刻落閘，冇再聯絡我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam4 pun3 gaau2 m4 dim6 zi1 hau6, deoi3 fong1 zik1 hak1 lok6 zaap6, mou5 zoi6 lyun4 lok3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 談判失敗後，對方立刻斷絕聯絡，不再回應我們。
examples.english_sentence: After the negotiations failed, the other side immediately shut off contact and stopped responding to us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝銀行系統臨時落閘，網上轉帳暫停咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ngan4 hong4 hai6 tung2 lam4 si4 lok6 zaap6, mong5 soeng6 zyun2 zoeng3 zaam6 ting4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上銀行系統臨時關閉，網上轉帳暫停了。
examples.english_sentence: This morning the bank's system temporarily shut down, and online transfers were suspended.

mandarin_meaning: 派人（或力量）去恐嚇、打壓或追捕某人；放出手下攻擊或鎮壓（口語、比喻用法）。
english_meaning: To 'let the dogs loose' — send people or forces to intimidate, attack, suppress, or go after someone; a colloquial/slang way to describe unleashing punitive or coercive measures.
explanation_mandarin: 常用於粵語口語與俚語，指上級或當事人下令放人去威嚇、查辦或打壓對方，帶有強硬或報復的意味，亦可比喻放開限制讓情況惡化。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang Cantonese expression meaning an authority or person unleashes others (literal or figurative 'dogs') to intimidate, attack, or suppress someone. It often carries a harsh or retaliatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋揭發咗內部醜聞，老闆即刻落閘放狗，派人去恐嚇嗰啲員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gik1faat3 zo2 noi6bou6 cau2man4, lou5baan2 zik1hak1 lok6 zaap6 fong3 gau2, paai3 jan4 heoi3 hung2haak3 go2 di1 jyun4gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们揭发了内部丑闻，老板立刻放出手下去恐吓那些员工。
examples.english_sentence: After they exposed the internal scandal, the boss immediately unleashed his people to intimidate those employees.

mandarin_meaning: 降職；被降級
english_meaning: to be demoted (in rank or position)
explanation_mandarin: 口語或行內用法，指因表現或過失而被公司、部門等降級或降職。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to be demoted or downgraded in rank/position, often used in workplace contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為犯錯被公司落降咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 faan6 co3 bei6 gung1 si1 lok6 gong3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為犯錯被公司降職了。
examples.english_sentence: He was demoted by the company because he made a mistake.

mandarin_meaning: 下降头；施巫术、下咒（用巫术或咒语诅咒或害人）
english_meaning: to cast a curse/hex on someone; to use black magic or sorcery to harm or jinx someone
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話和南方民間信仰中，『落降頭』指施行降頭術或被人用咒語、符咒或其他巫術手段害人，使其遭遇不幸、病痛或霉運。
explanation_english: In Cantonese and southern folk belief, '落降頭' refers to performing or being afflicted by 'jiangtou' sorcery — using spells, charms, or other occult means to curse or harm someone, causing illness, bad luck, or misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話有人落降頭，呢排成日病不停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jau5 jan4 lok6 gong3 tau4, ni1 paai4 sing4 jat6 beng6 bat1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说有人给他下了降头，最近总是病个不停。
examples.english_sentence: He says someone put a curse on him; he's been sick nonstop lately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信呢啲迷信，冇人會真係落降頭你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 ni1 di1 mai4 seon3, mou5 jan4 wui5 zan1 hai6 lok6 gong3 tau4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别信这些迷信，没人真的会给你下降头。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe in these superstitions; no one will really cast a curse on you.

mandarin_meaning: 被隔離／被排除在外
english_meaning: to be isolated; to be quarantined; to be sidelined/left out
explanation_mandarin: 口語（香港廣東話）用語，通常指被隔離（如檢疫）或在社交、工作場合被排除在外、被冷落或邊緣化。屬非正式用法，根據語境可指身體上的隔離或社會／職場上的排擠。
explanation_english: Informal Hong Kong Cantonese slang meaning to be isolated — physically (e.g., quarantined) or socially/at work (sidelined, left out). It is colloquial and the exact sense depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為接觸過病人，要落隔幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 zip3 zuk6 gwo3 beng6 jan4, jiu3 lok6 gaak3 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為接觸了病人，要被隔離幾天。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed to a patient and has to be quarantined for a few days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好落隔人，佢都係新嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lok6 gaak3 jan4, keoi5 dou1 hai6 san1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把他排除在外，他也是新來的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave him out; he's new here too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司將佢落隔，唔畀佢參與個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zoeng1 keoi5 lok6 gaak3, m4 bei2 keoi5 caam1 jyu5 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司把他排擠在外，不讓他參與那個項目。
examples.english_sentence: The company sidelined him and didn't let him participate in the project.

mandarin_meaning: 遭遇不幸、遇難或陷入困境（落難）
english_meaning: to fall into misfortune; to be stricken by disaster; to be in trouble or dire straits
explanation_mandarin: 表示遭遇災難、不幸或陷入經濟／生活上的困境，可用來形容個人或群體遇到嚴重困難。
explanation_english: Indicates experiencing misfortune, disaster, or falling into hardship or serious trouble. Can describe an individual or a group facing severe difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰日漁船遇到大風暴，船員全部落難咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 jat6 jyu4 syun4 jyu6 dou3 daai6 fung1 bou6, syun4 jyun4 cyun4 bou6 lok6 naan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那天漁船遇到大風暴，船員全部遇難了。
examples.english_sentence: That day the fishing boat hit a big storm; the crew were all stricken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢生意失敗，依家真係落難緊，無錢還債。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saang1 ji3 sat1 baai6, ji1 gaa1 zan1 hai6 lok6 naan6 gan2, mou5 cin2 waan4 zaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的生意失敗了，現在真的很落難，沒錢還債。
examples.english_sentence: His business failed; he's truly down on his luck now and can't pay his debts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫人唔成反而自己落難，真衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 jan4 m4 sing4 faan2 ji4 zi6 gei2 lok6 naan6, zan1 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幫人不成反而自己遭殃，真倒楣。
examples.english_sentence: Helping someone backfired and he ended up in trouble himself — really unlucky.

mandarin_meaning: 下雨
english_meaning: to rain
explanation_mandarin: 表示天空降雨，為廣東話的口語說法，等同普通話的「下雨」。
explanation_english: Indicates that rain is falling; the colloquial Cantonese way to say 'it's raining'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨喇，記得攞傘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 laa3, gei3 dak1 lo2 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨了，記得拿傘。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining; remember to bring an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日可能會落雨，要唔要改期？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 jyu5, jiu3 m4 jiu3 goi2 kei4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天可能會下雨，要不要改期？
examples.english_sentence: It might rain tomorrow; do you want to reschedule?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣預報話下晝會落大雨，記得帶雨具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 haa6 zau3 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5, gei3 dak1 daai3 jyu5 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣預報說下午會下大雨，記得帶雨具。
examples.english_sentence: The weather forecast says it'll pour this afternoon; remember to bring rain gear.

jyutping: lok6 jyu5 daam1 ze1 sei2 dong2
mandarin_meaning: 比喻固執、不讓步（口語俚語）
english_meaning: An idiom/slang describing someone stubborn or adamant, refusing to yield
explanation_mandarin: 「落雨擔遮——死擋」是廣東話俗語，用來形容人非常固執或死硬，不肯接受別人意見或讓步。字面上是「下雨就打傘——死不放手」，帶有嘲諷或調侃意味。
explanation_english: This Cantonese colloquialism describes someone who is extremely stubborn or obstinate and refuses to give in. Literally it evokes "taking an umbrella when it rains — refusing to budge," often used with a teasing or critical tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日係落雨擔遮——死擋，唔聽人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai6 lok6 jyu5 daam1 ze1 sei2 dong2, m4 teng1 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是很固執，像俗語「落雨擔遮——死擋」一樣，不聽別人說話。
examples.english_sentence: He's always stubborn — like the saying '落雨擔遮——死擋' — and won't listen to others.

cantonese: 落雨擔遮 - 顧前唔顧後
jyutping: lok6 jyu5 daam1 ze1 — gu3 cin4 m4 gu3 hau6
mandarin_meaning: 只顾眼前，不顾后果/长远（俗语、比喻短视）
english_meaning: Only cares about the immediate present and neglects the future/consequences (idiom for short-sightedness)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只顧眼前利益或眼前狀況，沒有長遠打算或不考慮後果，即短視近利的行為或態度。
explanation_english: A proverb describing someone who only focuses on the immediate situation or short-term gains and fails to consider long-term consequences — i.e., short-sighted behavior or attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司淨係追求短期利潤，根本係落雨擔遮——顧前唔顧後。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 zing6hai6 zeoi1kau4 dyun2kei4 lei6jeon6, gan1bun2 hai6 lok6 jyu5 daam1 ze1 — gu3 cin4 m4 gu3 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司只追求短期利润，根本就是只顾眼前，不顾后果。
examples.english_sentence: The company only chases short-term profits; it's being short-sighted — only thinking of the present and ignoring future consequences.

mandarin_meaning: 下雨就把柴火收起來（字面）。引申為遇到不利或突發情況時，應及時停止某些行為、收手或採取防範措施。
english_meaning: Literal: put away the firewood when it rains. Figurative: stop or pause actions and be cautious when adverse conditions arise; cut your losses or back off when the situation turns unfavorable.
explanation_mandarin: 這是一句廣東話俗語。字面意思是下雨時要收起柴火；引申指遇到不利、變化或突發情況時，要及早收手或調整行動以避免更大損失。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial saying. Literally it advises putting away firewood when it rains; figuratively it means to stop, pause, or take precautions when conditions become unfavorable to avoid greater losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家生意唔好，老闆話落雨收柴，暫停投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, lou5 baan2 waa6 lok6 jyu5 sau1 caai4, zaam6 ting4 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在生意不好，老闆說遇到不利情況就要收手，暫停投資。
examples.english_sentence: Business is poor now; the boss said 'when it rains, gather the firewood' — meaning stop and be cautious — and has paused investments.

mandarin_meaning: 做事時機錯誤／等到出事才行動（本末倒置、臨時抱佛腳）
english_meaning: to act at the wrong time or only after a problem has appeared; doing things too late or in the wrong order
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是「下雨時反而收摺傘」，用來形容做事本末倒置或只在危機發生後才採取行動，含批評或諷刺意味。
explanation_english: Literally “closing the umbrella when it rains.” Used figuratively to criticize someone who acts at the wrong time, reacts too late, or does things in the wrong order — often implying poor judgment or procrastination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都落雨收遮，總係要等到出事先做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 lok6 jyu5 sau1 ze1, zung2 hai6 jiu3 dang2 dou3 ceot1 si6 sin1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是等到出事才采取行动。
examples.english_sentence: He always waits until something goes wrong before taking action.

mandarin_meaning: 下著濕濕的雨 / 毛毛雨、陰雨綿綿
english_meaning: raining and damp; drizzly/wet and humid weather
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 片語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，形容天氣在下雨且潮濕、綿綿不斷或毛毛雨的狀態。重複「溼溼」有持續潮濕、黏膩的語感。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing weather that is raining and damp—often drizzly or persistently wet. The repeated 'sap sap' emphasizes ongoing dampness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落雨溼溼，出門記得帶把遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 sap1 sap1, ceot1 mun4 gei3 dak1 daai3 baa2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下著濛濛細雨，出門記得帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: It's drizzling and damp today; remember to bring an umbrella when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 下雨，潮濕
english_meaning: raining and damp; damp/rainy weather
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，形容天氣在下雨且潮濕，也可用來抱怨出行不便或帶有沉悶的氛圍。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing that it is raining and damp. It is used to comment on wet, uncomfortable weather and can carry a mildly gloomy or inconvenient connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝落雨濕濕，出街要帶把遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 lok6 jyu5 sap1 sap1, ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 daai3 baa2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上下雨又潮濕，出門要帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: It's rainy and damp this morning; bring an umbrella when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 被小雨／毛毛雨弄得微微潮濕
english_meaning: slightly damp from a light drizzle; a little wet because of light rain
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話表達，指被毛毛雨或細雨弄得有點濕潤，但不是完全淋透。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to be slightly damp from light drizzle — wet but not soaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街記得帶把遮，唔係會畀落雨絲溼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 baa2 ze1, m4 hai6 wui5 bei2 lok6 jyu5 si1 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門記得帶把傘，不然會被小雨打濕。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring an umbrella when you go out, otherwise you'll get slightly wet from the drizzle.

mandarin_meaning: 下毛毛雨 / 下小雨，使物体微微湿润
english_meaning: to drizzle; light misty rain that lightly wets things
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词短语（口语、天气用语）
explanation_mandarin: 表示下很细、很轻的雨，通常只是把人或物弄得微微湿润，属于口语用法，类似“下小雨”或“下毛毛雨”。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning a very light, mist-like rain — a drizzle or sprinkle that only lightly wets people or objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家落雨絲濕，記得攞埋把遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 lok6 jyu5 si1 sap1, gei3 dak1 lo2 maai4 baa2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在下着毛毛雨，记得带把伞。
examples.english_sentence: It's drizzling right now — remember to take an umbrella.

jyutping: lok6 jyu5 gin3 sing1, naan4 dak1 tin1 cing4
mandarin_meaning: 形容非常罕見、難得一遇的好事或異常現象
english_meaning: Describes something extremely rare or an unusually fortunate/rare occurrence
explanation_mandarin: 「落雨見星，難得天晴」用來形容某件事極為罕見或難得出現，通常帶有驚喜或慶幸的意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe an event that is very rare or unlikely to happen, often carrying a sense of surprise or fortunate luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日竟然請到假，又啱啱遇到老闆唔記得叫我返工，真係落雨見星，難得天晴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ging2 jin4 ceng2 dou3 gaa3, jau6 aap3 aap3 jyu6 dou3 lou5 baan2 m4 gei3 dak1 giu3 ngo5 faan1 gung1, zan1 hai6 lok6 jyu5 gin3 sing1, naan4 dak1 tin1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天竟然請到了假，而且老闆剛好忘記叫我上班，真是難得一見的好事。
examples.english_sentence: I actually got the day off today, and the boss also forgot to ask me to come in — it's a rare stroke of luck.

mandarin_meaning: 下雪
english_meaning: to snow; snow is falling
explanation_mandarin: 表示天空降下雪花的現象或動作，常用來描述下雪的天氣情況。
explanation_english: Indicates the phenomenon of snow falling from the sky; used to describe the weather condition when it is snowing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚可能會落雪，記得著多件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 syut3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚可能会下雪，记得多穿一件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: It might snow tonight — remember to wear an extra layer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山頂開始落雪，好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 deng2 hoi1 ci2 lok6 syut3, hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山顶开始下雪，很漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: It started snowing on the summit — it's beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好耐都冇落雪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 lok6 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很久都没下雪。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong hasn't had snow for a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 把面条放入（汤或锅中）；下（面条）
english_meaning: to add/put noodles into a pot or soup (to start cooking the noodles)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语用法，指把面条放入滚水或汤里煮，常用于厨房或餐饮场景。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to put noodles into boiling water or soup to cook; commonly used in kitchen/restaurant contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅，落碗雲吞麵，唔該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu1, lok6 wun2 wan4 tan1 min6, m4 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅，请放一碗云吞面，谢谢。
examples.english_sentence: Chef, please add a bowl of wonton noodles, thanks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煲滾咗，依家可以落面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou1 gwan2 zo2, ji1 gaa1 ho2 ji5 lok6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 锅煮开了，现在可以下面条了。
examples.english_sentence: The pot is boiling now; you can add the noodles.

mandarin_meaning: 擦鞋／上鞋油
english_meaning: to apply shoe polish; to polish shoes
explanation_mandarin: 指把鞋子涂上鞋油並擦拭使其光亮，為日常護理鞋子的動作，屬字面用法。
explanation_english: Refers to applying shoe polish and buffing shoes to make them shiny; a literal, everyday action of shoe care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲皮鞋甩色，我幫你落鞋油先，等佢睇落新啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 pei4 haai4 lat1 sik1, ngo5 bong1 nei5 lok6 haai4 jau4 sin1, dang2 keoi5 tai2 lok6 san1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的皮鞋掉色了，我先幫你擦鞋油，讓它看起來更新一些。
examples.english_sentence: Your leather shoes have faded; I'll polish them for you so they look newer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好注重儀容，每日都會落鞋油，保持鞋子光亮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyu3 zung6 ji4 jung4, mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 lok6 haai4 jau4, bou2 ci4 haai4 zi2 gwong1 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很注重儀表，每天都會擦鞋油，保持鞋子光亮。
examples.english_sentence: He pays attention to his appearance; he polishes his shoes every day to keep them shiny.

mandarin_meaning: 被開罰單；被罰款（口語）
english_meaning: to get a ticket / to be fined (colloquial, esp. parking/traffic)
explanation_mandarin: 「落飛」是香港廣東話口語，指被交警或有關部門開罰單、收到罰款，常用於停車或交通違例的情況。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to receive a ticket or fine (commonly for parking or traffic violations).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋日喺街邊泊車俾交警落飛，罰咗幾百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 paak3 ce1 bei2 gaau1 ging2 lok6 fei1, fat6 zo2 gei2 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在路邊停車被交警開了罰單，罰了幾百塊錢。
examples.english_sentence: I parked on the street yesterday and got a ticket from a traffic officer; I was fined a few hundred dollars.

mandarin_meaning: 落马（被免职、下台、失势）
english_meaning: to be disgraced/removed from office; to fall from power (literally: fall off a horse)
explanation_mandarin: 原指从马上掉下，现常用来比喻官员或有权势者因丑闻、错误等而被免职、失势或身败名裂。
explanation_english: Originally meant falling off a horse; now commonly used metaphorically for an official or powerful person being removed from office, losing power, or being disgraced due to scandal or wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺貪污案入面被揭發，最後落馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 taam1 wu1 on3 jap6 min6 bei6 kit3 faat3, zeoi3 hau6 lok6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在贪污案中被揭发，最终落马。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed in a corruption case and ultimately fell from power (was removed from office).

mandarin_meaning: 落马洲（香港北部的一個地名，毗鄰深圳，設有口岸與港鐵站）
english_meaning: Lok Ma Chau (a place in northern New Territories, Hong Kong, adjacent to Shenzhen; has a border control point and an MTR station)
explanation_mandarin: 落马洲是香港新界北部靠近深圳的一個地名，設有落馬洲口岸和落馬洲港鐵站，是常見的港深陸路過境點，也有部分自然保育與科技發展規劃。
explanation_english: Lok Ma Chau is a place in the northern New Territories of Hong Kong, next to Shenzhen. It contains the Lok Ma Chau control point and MTR station, serving as a common land border crossing between Hong Kong and mainland China; the area also includes ecological zones and development projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日返內地要經落馬洲口岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 faan1 noi6 dei6 jiu3 ging1 lok6 maa5 zau1 hau2 ngon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们去内地要经过落马洲口岸。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow we're going to the mainland via the Lok Ma Chau control point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋坐港鐵去落馬洲站，方便過關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 co5 gong2 tit3 heoi3 lok6 maa5 zau1 zaam6, fong1 bin6 gwo3 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐港铁去落马洲站，过关很方便。
examples.english_sentence: We take the MTR to Lok Ma Chau station; it's convenient for crossing the border.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落馬洲邊境檢查比較嚴格，記得帶埋身份證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 maa5 zau1 bin1 ging2 gim2 caa4 bei2 gaau3 jim4 gaak3, gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 san1 fan6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 落马洲边境检查比较严格，记得带上身份证。
examples.english_sentence: Border checks at Lok Ma Chau are fairly strict; remember to bring your ID.

mandarin_meaning: 說重點／切入重點
english_meaning: to get to the point; be specific
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，要求對方說出重點或講得具體、直接。常用於催促別人不要贅述、快說要點。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb used to urge someone to state the main point or be specific/direct. Often used to tell someone not to ramble and to get to the point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好周圍講，講落點啦，我哋要快啲決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 gong2, gong2 lok6 dim2 laa1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別東拉西扯，說重點吧，我們要快點決定。
examples.english_sentence: Stop rambling; get to the point — we need to decide quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 保存；保持；維持（多用於書面語或成語，如「永葆」）
english_meaning: to preserve; to maintain; to keep (literary, often used in compounds like '永葆')
explanation_mandarin: 「葆」是一個書面用字，表示保存、保持或維持的意思，常見於詞語如「永葆青春」。
explanation_english: A literary verb meaning to preserve, maintain, or keep something; commonly appears in compounds such as '永葆' (to remain forever...).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望永葆青春。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1 mong6 wing5 bou2 cing1 ceon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望永葆青春。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes to remain youthful forever.

mandarin_meaning: 叶（葉子）；也可作姓氏
english_meaning: leaf; (also a surname, Ye/Yip)
explanation_mandarin: 指植物的叶子，也常見於人名或姓氏（如葉先生）。在複合詞中可出現為葉子、葉片等。
explanation_english: Refers to the leaf of a plant; also used as a surname (Ye/Yip). Appears in compounds such as 'leaf' (葉子) or 'leaf blade' (葉片).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樹上有好多葉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu6 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树上有很多叶子。
examples.english_sentence: There are many leaves on the tree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姓葉，叫葉先生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 jip6, giu3 jip6 sin1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓叶，叫叶先生。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is Ye; he's Mr. Ye.

mandarin_meaning: 叶公好龙
english_meaning: To profess admiration for something but be frightened or unable to accept the real thing; hypocritical affection
explanation_mandarin: 出自《莊子·秋水》的寓言，形容表面上喜歡或讚美某物，實際上遇到真實情況時卻害怕或不能接受；亦用以譏諷虛有其表或口是心非的人。
explanation_english: From a fable in Zhuangzi; describes someone who outwardly professes love or admiration for something but, when faced with the real thing, is frightened or cannot accept it. Used to mock hypocrisy or superficial affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己好鍾意挑戰，但真係要落場嘅時候就縮埋，真係葉公好龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 zung1 ji3 tiu1 zin3, daan6 zan1 hai6 jiu3 lok6 coeng4 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 suk1 maai4, zan1 hai6 jip6 gung1 hou2 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己很喜欢挑战，但真的要上场的时候就退缩，真是叶公好龙。
examples.english_sentence: He says he loves challenges, but when it's time to actually step in he backs out — truly 'Ye Gong hao long.'

mandarin_meaning: 叶子（植物的叶片）
english_meaning: leaf; leaves (plant foliage)
explanation_mandarin: 指植物的叶片，通常生长在枝干上，进行光合作用并帮助蒸腾和气体交换。
explanation_english: Refers to the leaf or leaves of a plant, typically growing on branches and involved in photosynthesis, transpiration, and gas exchange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樹上啲葉子開始變黃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu6 soeng6 di1 jip6 zi2 hoi1 ci2 bin3 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树上的叶子开始变黄。
examples.english_sentence: The leaves on the tree are starting to turn yellow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落咗好多葉子，行路要小心，地面好滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 zo2 hou2 do1 jip6 zi2, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, dei6 min6 hou2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 落了很多叶子，走路要小心，地面很滑。
examples.english_sentence: Many leaves have fallen; be careful walking, the ground is slippery.

mandarin_meaning: 叶片
english_meaning: leaf blade; blade (e.g., fan or turbine blade)
explanation_mandarin: 指植物的葉子的扁平部分（葉片）；在技術語境下亦可指機械上的刀片或葉片狀部件，如風扇葉片、渦輪葉片等。
explanation_english: Refers to the flat part of a plant leaf (leaf blade). In technical contexts it can also mean blade-like parts on machines, such as fan blades or turbine blades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵植物嘅葉片好闊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 zik6 mat6 ge3 jip6 pin3 hou2 fut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這株植物的葉片很寬。
examples.english_sentence: The plant's leaves are very broad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風扇嘅葉片壞咗，風就冇咁勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 sin3 ge3 jip6 pin3 waai6 zo2, fung1 zau6 mou5 gam2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 風扇的葉片壞了，風就沒那麼強。
examples.english_sentence: The fan's blade is broken, so the airflow is weaker.

mandarin_meaning: 叶绿素 (yèlǜsù)
english_meaning: chlorophyll
explanation_mandarin: 葉綠素是一種存在於植物、藻類和某些細菌中的綠色色素，能吸收光能並在光合作用中將光能轉化為化學能。
explanation_english: Chlorophyll is the green pigment found in plants, algae, and some bacteria that absorbs light energy and converts it into chemical energy during photosynthesis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 植物靠葉綠素做光合作用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik6 mat6 kaau3 jip6 luk6 sou3 zou6 gwong1 hap6 zok3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 植物靠葉綠素進行光合作用。
examples.english_sentence: Plants rely on chlorophyll to perform photosynthesis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 葉綠素令葉片呈現綠色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jip6 luk6 sou3 ling6 jip6 pin3 cing4 jin6 luk6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 葉綠素讓葉片呈現綠色。
examples.english_sentence: Chlorophyll makes leaves appear green.

mandarin_meaning: 叶酸（维生素B9）
english_meaning: Folic acid (vitamin B9)
explanation_mandarin: 葉酸，又稱維生素B9，是一種水溶性維生素，對胎兒神經管發育非常重要，常建議孕婦在懷孕前及懷孕初期補充。
explanation_english: Folic acid, also called vitamin B9, is a water-soluble vitamin important for fetal neural tube development; it is commonly recommended that women take it before and during early pregnancy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 懷孕嘅時候，醫生會叫你補充葉酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waai4 jan6 ge3 si4 hau6, ji1 sang1 wui5 giu3 nei5 bou2 cung1 jip6 syun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 怀孕的时候，医生会叫你补充叶酸。
examples.english_sentence: During pregnancy, doctors will advise you to take folic acid.

mandarin_meaning: 穿；穿著；着火（引申）
english_meaning: to wear; to put on; (also) to catch fire / ignite
explanation_mandarin: 常用作動詞，表示穿上衣物或戴上物件；在某些語境也可表示着火（例如「著火」）。
explanation_english: A verb commonly used to mean wearing or putting on clothing or accessories. In some contexts it can also mean to catch fire (e.g., "著火").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我著咗件新衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 san1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我穿了件新衣。
examples.english_sentence: I put on a new shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔識著高跟鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sik1 zoek3 gou1 gan1 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她不會穿高跟鞋。
examples.english_sentence: She doesn't know how to wear high heels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房著火，快啲滅火！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 zoek3 fo2, faai3 di1 mit6 fo2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房着火，快點滅火！
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen is on fire — put it out quickly!

mandarin_meaning: 著作（指作者所寫的書籍、文章或其他作品）
english_meaning: work; literary or scholarly composition; written work
explanation_mandarin: 指作者創作的書籍、文章、學術或文學作品，泛指可出版或發表的書面作品。
explanation_english: Refers to a written work produced by an author — books, articles, scholarly or literary pieces; generally denotes publishable or presentable written compositions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰本著作好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 bun2 zoek3 zok3 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的著作很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: His work is very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位作家發表咗好多著作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 zok3 gaa1 faat3 biu2 zo2 hou2 do1 zoek3 zok3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位作家发表了许多著作。
examples.english_sentence: This author has published many works.

mandarin_meaning: 着力 (zhuó lì)：努力投入、着重于（某事）
english_meaning: to make an effort; to put energy/effort into; to focus on
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某個方面投入力量或精力，著重推進或改善某事。
explanation_english: Indicates putting effort or energy into something; to focus on progressing or improving a particular matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺呢個項目上著力，爭取好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 soeng6 zoek3 lik6, zang1 ceoi2 hou2 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在这个项目上着力，争取好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: We need to focus our efforts on this project to strive for good results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該著力改善基層醫療服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 zoek3 lik6 goi2 sin6 gei1 cang4 ji1 liu4 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该着力改善基层医疗服务。
examples.english_sentence: The government should put effort into improving primary healthcare services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近喺學習方面好著力，成績有明顯進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 hok6 zaap6 fong1 min6 hou2 zoek3 lik6, sing4 zik1 jau5 ming4 hin2 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近在学习方面很着力，成绩有明显进步。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working hard on his studies recently and his grades have shown clear improvement.

mandarin_meaning: 著名；有名；知名
english_meaning: famous; well-known; renowned
explanation_mandarin: 表示在社會上或某個領域中廣為人知、具有名氣或聲譽。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something is widely known or has a notable reputation in society or a particular field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位著名嘅歌手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 zyu6 ming4 ge3 go1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位著名的歌手。
examples.english_sentence: He is a famous singer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多著名嘅景點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 zyu6 ming4 ge3 ging2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多著名的景点。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many famous attractions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司喺業界好著名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 jip6 gaai3 hou2 zyu6 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司在業界很著名。
examples.english_sentence: This company is very well-known in the industry.

mandarin_meaning: 一起承擔責任或命運；共同被牽連（口語）
english_meaning: To be in the same boat; to share the same fate, responsibility, or be implicated together (colloquial/slang).
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語說法，表示兩人或多人一同陷入麻煩、共同承擔後果或互相牽連。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning two or more people end up sharing the same trouble, responsibility, or being implicated together—similar to 'in the same boat.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司冇錢，投資者同員工都會著埋一條褲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 mou5 cin2, tau4 zi1 ze2 tung4 jyun4 gung1 dou1 wui5 zoek3 maai4 jat1 tiu4 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司沒錢，投資者和員工都會一起受影響/承擔後果。
examples.english_sentence: If the company runs out of money, investors and employees will be in the same boat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你如果將真相公佈出嚟，老闆同你可能都會著埋一條褲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jyu4 gwo2 zoeng1 zan1 soeng1 gung1 bou3 ceot1 lai4, lou5 baan2 tung4 nei5 ho2 nang4 dou1 wui5 zoek3 maai4 jat1 tiu4 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你把真相公布出來，老闆和你可能都會被牽連。
examples.english_sentence: If you make the truth public, the boss and you might both get implicated.

mandarin_meaning: 着急 (zháo jí)
english_meaning: to be anxious, worried, or impatient; to be in a hurry
explanation_mandarin: 表示感到着急、焦虑或急于做某事，心里不安或急切希望事情快些发生或解决。
explanation_english: Expresses feeling anxious, worried, or impatient — a sense of urgency or eagerness for something to happen or be resolved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁著急做咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zoek3 gap1 zou6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么着急做什么？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you in such a hurry?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試快到，佢好著急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 faai3 dou3, keoi5 hou2 zoek3 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试快到了，他很着急。
examples.english_sentence: The exam is coming up; he's very anxious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好著急，慢慢嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoek3 gap1, maan6 maan2 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别着急，慢慢来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be anxious; take your time.

mandarin_meaning: 為他人著想；考慮別人的處境或感受
english_meaning: to consider others; to be considerate
explanation_mandarin: 表示在做決定或行動時，替別人考慮、體諒別人的需要或感受。
explanation_english: To take other people's needs or feelings into account when making decisions or acting; to be considerate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要為人著想，唔好淨係諗自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 wai6 jan4 zoek3 soeng2, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 nam2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要為別人著想，不要只想著自己。
examples.english_sentence: You should consider others; don't only think about yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 注意；留意；關注
english_meaning: to pay attention to; to take care of; to be mindful of
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事物加以注意或留心、照顧細節，語氣偏正式或書面用法。
explanation_english: Indicates paying attention to or taking care of something; often used in more formal or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行路要著意，唔好分心睇電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 lou6 jiu3 zoek3 ji3, m4 hou2 fan1 sam1 tai2 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走路要注意，不要分心看手機。
examples.english_sentence: Pay attention when walking; don't be distracted by your phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對工作好著意，做嘢一絲不苟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 zok3 hou2 zoek3 ji3, zou6 je5 jat1 si1 bat1 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對工作很注意，做事一絲不苟。
examples.english_sentence: He pays great attention to his work and is very meticulous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生交代咗食藥方法，要著意遵守指示。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gaau1 doi6 zo2 sik6 joek6 fong1 faat3, jiu3 zoek3 ji3 zeon1 sau2 zi2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生交代了用藥方法，要注意遵守指示。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor explained how to take the medicine; you should carefully follow the instructions.

mandarin_meaning: 着手（开始着手、着手处理）
english_meaning: to start; to set about; to begin working on
explanation_mandarin: 表示開始著手處理某件事或開始進行某項工作，常用於正式或書面語境中。
explanation_english: Indicates beginning to undertake or handle a task; commonly used in formal or written contexts to mean starting to work on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 項目已經批咗，我哋可以著手做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hong6 muk6 ji5 ging1 pai1 zo2, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zoek3 sau2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 项目已经批准了，我们可以着手做。
examples.english_sentence: The project has been approved; we can start working on it.

mandarin_meaning: 占便宜；划算
english_meaning: to be a good deal; advantageous; to get a bargain
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，表示某事物或交易對人有利、划算或能佔便宜。有時也可當動詞，表示讓人佔便宜或吃虧。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning something is advantageous, a good deal, or profitable. It can be used adjectivally to describe a favorable situation or as a verb meaning someone gets an advantage or bargain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買一送一，真係著數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 jat1 sung3 jat1, zan1 hai6 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買一送一，真的很划算。
examples.english_sentence: Buy one get one free — that's a great deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間餐廳嘅午餐好著數，價錢又平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ng5 caan1 hou2 zoek3 sou3, gaa3 cin2 jau6 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間餐廳的午餐很划算，價格也便宜。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant's lunch is a good deal and the price is cheap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀人著數，自己要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 zoek3 sou3, zi6 gei2 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要讓別人佔你的便宜，要自己小心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let others take advantage of you; be careful yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 適時 / 及時
english_meaning: timely; at the right time; in good time
explanation_mandarin: 表示在合適或恰當的時間或時機，常用來形容做某事的時機恰當或發生得及時。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens at a suitable or opportune time; used to describe actions or events that occur timely or appropriately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你著時嚟，我哋仲未走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoek3 si4 lai4, ngo5 dei6 zung6 mei6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你來得正好，我們還沒走。
examples.english_sentence: You came at the right time; we haven't left yet.

mandarin_meaning: 着凉
english_meaning: to catch a cold; to get chilled
explanation_mandarin: 因受寒、淋雨或吹冷气等导致身体不适或出现感冒症状（如流鼻涕、发烧、喉咙痛等）。
explanation_english: To become ill or develop cold-like symptoms because of being chilled, getting wet, or exposure to cold air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚唔好開冷氣，唔想著涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 m4 hou2 hoi1 laang5 hei3, m4 soeng2 zoek3 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚不要开空调，我不想着凉。
examples.english_sentence: Don't turn on the air conditioner tonight; I don't want to catch a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為淋咗雨而著涼，發燒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 lam4 zo2 jyu5 ji4 zoek3 loeng4, faat3 siu1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为淋雨而着凉，发烧了。
examples.english_sentence: He caught a cold because he got rained on and developed a fever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友如果著涼就要盡快睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 jyu4 gwo2 zoek3 loeng4 zau6 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友如果着凉就要尽快去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: If a child catches a cold, they should see a doctor as soon as possible.

mandarin_meaning: 着火 (zháohuǒ)
english_meaning: to catch fire; to be on fire
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体开始燃烧、发生火灾；口语中有时也可比喻情绪突然激动或发怒（较少用）。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has begun to burn or caught fire; colloquially it can sometimes be used figuratively to mean someone becomes very angry or excited (less common).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋著火喇，快啲走！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 zoek3 fo2 laa3, faai3 di1 zau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子着火了，快走！
examples.english_sentence: The house is on fire — get out quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂拋煙頭，會著火㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 paau1 jin1 tau4, wui5 zoek3 fo2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要乱扔烟头，会着火的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw cigarette butts around — it could start a fire!

mandarin_meaning: 着眼（于），注重、关注
english_meaning: to focus on; to pay attention to; to set one's sights on
explanation_mandarin: 表示把注意力或考量放在某個方面或目標上，常用於分析、規劃或評估時。
explanation_english: To place attention or consideration on a particular aspect or objective; often used when analyzing, planning, or evaluating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該著眼長遠發展，而唔係淨係追求短期利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 zoek3 ngaan5 coeng4 jyun5 faat3 zin2, ji4 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 zeoi1 kau4 dyun2 kei4 lei6 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该着眼长远发展，而不是只追求短期利益。
examples.english_sentence: The government should focus on long-term development instead of only pursuing short-term gains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資者著眼於企業嘅成長潛力，而唔係短期盈利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 ze2 zoek3 ngaan5 jyu1 kei5 jip6 ge3 sing4 zoeng2 cim4 lik6, ji4 m4 hai6 dyun2 kei4 jing4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资者着眼于企业的成长潜力，而不是短期盈利。
examples.english_sentence: Investors focus on a company's growth potential rather than short-term profits.

mandarin_meaning: 着眼点 (关注或考虑的重点)
english_meaning: focus; focal point; point of emphasis
explanation_mandarin: 指在考慮、分析或討論時所關注的重點或著力處，強調需要注意或放在心上的方面。
explanation_english: Refers to the point of focus or emphasis when considering, analysing, or discussing something — the aspect that one pays particular attention to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅著眼點係成本控制，同時要兼顧品質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zoek3 ngaan5 dim2 hai6 sing4 bun2 hung3 zai3, tung4 si4 jiu3 gim1 gu3 ban2 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的着眼点是成本控制，同时要兼顾质量。
examples.english_sentence: The focus of this report is cost control, while also taking quality into account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫計劃嘅時候，著眼點要放喺用戶嘅需要上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 gai3 waak6 ge3 si4 hau6, zoek3 ngaan5 dim2 jiu3 fong3 hai2 jung6 wu6 ge3 seoi1 jiu3 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写计划的时候，着眼点要放在用户的需求上。
examples.english_sentence: When drafting the plan, the focus should be placed on the users' needs.

mandarin_meaning: 以……著稱 / 著稱（動詞）
english_meaning: to be renowned for; to be known as
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事物因為某種特點、身份或事蹟而聞名、出名，常用結構為“以……著稱”。
explanation_english: Indicates that a person or thing is famous or well-known for a particular trait, role, or achievement; commonly used in the pattern 'known for ...'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳以海鮮新鮮著稱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ji5 hoi2 sin1 san1 sin1 zoek3 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳以海鮮新鮮著稱。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is known for its fresh seafood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺業界以誠實可靠著稱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jip6 gaai3 ji5 sing4 sat6 ho2 kaau3 zoek3 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在業界以誠實可靠著稱。
examples.english_sentence: He is known in the industry for being honest and reliable.

mandarin_meaning: 穿紅鞋（字面意思）；在特定語境可指新娘穿紅色鞋子（結婚習俗）或作比喻使用
english_meaning: to wear red shoes (literal); in some contexts can refer to a bride wearing red shoes at a wedding or be used figuratively
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是穿紅色的鞋子。廣東話裡通常為字面用法；在一些文化或婚俗語境中，會特指新娘穿紅鞋，也可根據語境作比喻性使用。
explanation_english: Literally means to wear red shoes. Usually used literally in Cantonese; in cultural or wedding contexts it may specifically refer to a bride wearing red shoes, and it can be used figuratively depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著紅鞋去婚禮，大家都話佢好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 hung4 haai4 heoi3 fan1 lai5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿紅鞋去婚禮，大家都說她很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She wore red shoes to the wedding today; everyone said she looked beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 正在穿著 / 開著
english_meaning: be wearing; be (switched) on — continuous/progressive state
explanation_mandarin: 「著緊」由動詞「著」（表示穿、戴或某些情況下的“開著”）加上進行體標記「緊」，用來表示正在進行或處於持續狀態。根據語境可解作正在穿著某物或某裝置/燈等處於開啟狀態。
explanation_english: '著緊' combines the verb 著 (zoek3: to wear/put on, or in some contexts 'be on') with the progressive marker 緊 (gan2) to indicate a continuous state. Depending on context it usually means 'be wearing' or 'be turned on.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著緊件紅色外套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 gan2 gin6 hung4 sik1 ngoi6 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在穿那件紅色外套。
examples.english_sentence: He is wearing that red coat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電燈著緊，唔使開手電筒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 dang1 zoek3 gan2, m4 sai2 hoi1 sau2 din6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 燈是開著的，不需要開手電筒。
examples.english_sentence: The light is on, no need to turn on the flashlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家著緊衫，唔好入嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zoek3 gan2 saam1, m4 hou2 jap6 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在正在穿衣服，別進來。
examples.english_sentence: I'm putting on clothes right now, don't come in.

mandarin_meaning: 溜走；逃走；（突然）消失
english_meaning: to run away; to slip away; to abscond; to bail out
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，表示突然離開、溜走或逃避責任或麻煩，人際或事件中常用。
explanation_english: Colloquial slang meaning to suddenly leave, slip away, or abscond — often used when someone bails out to avoid trouble or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢約好今晚見面，但佢最後著草冇嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joek3 hou2 gam1 maan5 gin3 min6, daan6 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 zoek3 cou2 mou5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們約好今晚見面，但他最後溜走沒來。
examples.english_sentence: We agreed to meet tonight, but he bailed and didn't show up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賣家收完錢就著草，買家當場發現被騙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai6 gaa1 sau1 jyun4 cin2 zau6 zoek3 cou2, maai5 gaa1 dong1 coeng4 faat3 jin6 bei6 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 賣家收了錢就溜走，買家當場發現被騙。
examples.english_sentence: The seller took the money and ran off, and the buyer realized on the spot they'd been scammed.

mandarin_meaning: 溜走；逃走；跑路
english_meaning: to run away; to make off; to decamp (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 表示迅速离开或逃走，常用于口语或俚语，往往含有为了躲避责任或麻烦而悄悄离开的意思。
explanation_english: Used to indicate leaving quickly or running away. A colloquial/slang expression often implying quietly escaping to avoid responsibility or trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到警察，我哋快啲著草鞋啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 ging2 caat3, ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 zoek3 cou2 haai4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到警察，我们快点溜走吧！
examples.english_sentence: If we see the police, let's run off quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出事，佢喺呢個時候竟然著草鞋，唔見晒人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceot1 si6, keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 si4 hau6 ging2 jin4 zoek3 cou2 haai4, m4 gin3 saat3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出事，他在这个时候竟然跑掉了，完全不见人影。
examples.english_sentence: When the company ran into trouble, he actually ran off at that time and completely disappeared.

mandarin_meaning: 着落 / 去向；安排、去處或結果
english_meaning: whereabouts; outcome; a settled arrangement or place to go; prospect that something will be resolved
explanation_mandarin: 「著落」常用於口語，指某事、某人或某物的去向、安排或最後的結果。常見用法有「有著落」、「沒著落」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning the whereabouts, outcome, or a secure arrangement for something or someone. Often used in phrases like "have a place/arrangement" (有著落) or "no prospect yet" (冇著落).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工作終於有著落喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 zung1 jyu1 jau5 zoek3 lok6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作终于有着落了。
examples.english_sentence: This job finally has a placement / it's finally settled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家有著落，可以安心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 jau5 zoek3 lok6, ho2 ji5 on1 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在有着落，可以放心一些。
examples.english_sentence: He now has somewhere to go / a plan, so he can be more at ease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單生意暫時未有著落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 saang1 ji3 zam6 si4 mei6 jau5 zoek3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔生意暂时还没有着落。
examples.english_sentence: This deal doesn't have an outcome/settlement yet.

jyutping: zoek3 hei2 lung4 pou4 m4 ci5 taai3 zi2
mandarin_meaning: 穿上龍袍不像太子（形容人雖打扮得很華麗或擺出高貴姿態，但看起來不合適、不像應有的氣度）
english_meaning: Dressed up but doesn't look the part — wearing grand clothes or acting pretentiously yet appearing awkward, incongruous, or ridiculous; all show and no substance.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人雖然穿得很華麗或裝作有氣派，但樣子、氣度或行為與所扮演的角色不相稱，顯得滑稽或不自然。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who, despite dressing extravagantly or putting on airs, doesn't carry the look or bearing of the role they are trying to assume — the result is awkward, mismatched, or laughable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己好有氣質，但著起龍袍唔似太子，仲俾人笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 zi6 gei2 hou2 jau5 hei3 zat1, daan6 zoek3 hei2 lung4 pou4 m4 ci5 taai3 zi2, zung6 bei2 jan4 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老說自己很有氣質，可是穿上華服卻不像太子，還被人嘲笑。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's very classy, but when he dresses up he doesn't look the part and people laugh.

mandarin_meaning: 著述（寫作、著作）
english_meaning: writings; literary works; to author or compose written works
explanation_mandarin: 指撰寫或已完成的著作、文獻或論述，常用於學術或文學範疇。
explanation_english: Refers to writing or written works (books, articles, scholarly works); used for authoring or the resulting publications, often in academic or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出咗本關於古典文學嘅著述，喺學界有好大影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 zo2 bun2 gwaan1 jyu1 gu2 din2 man4 hok6 ge3 zoek3 seot6, hai2 hok6 gaai3 jau5 hou2 daai6 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出版了一本關於古典文學的著述，在學界有很大影響。
examples.english_sentence: He published a work on classical literature that has had a great influence in academic circles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生應該參考前人的著述，作為研究的基礎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 saang1 jing1 goi1 caam1 haau2 cin4 jan4 dik1 zoek3 seot6, zok3 wai6 jin4 gau3 dik1 gei1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學生應該參考前人的著述，作為研究的基礎。
examples.english_sentence: Students should consult previous scholars' writings as a foundation for their research.

mandarin_meaning: 着迷 / 入迷（对某事非常着迷）
english_meaning: to be fascinated with; to be obsessed; to be enthralled
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事物非常感興趣或沉迷，難以自拔。
explanation_english: Indicates being very interested in or obsessed with someone or something, often to the point of being unable to pull oneself away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對魔術好著迷，成日睇片學新把戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 mo1 seot6 hou2 zoek3 mai4, sing4 jat6 tai2 pin2 hok6 san1 baa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對魔術很著迷，經常看影片學新把戲。
examples.english_sentence: He is very fascinated by magic; he often watches videos to learn new tricks.

mandarin_meaning: 注重 / 重视
english_meaning: to emphasize; to attach importance to; to value
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事物給予重視或強調，把它看得重要。
explanation_english: To give importance or emphasis to something; to regard something as important or to focus on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司好著重員工嘅培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hou2 zoek3 zung6 jyun4 gung1 ge3 pui4 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司很注重员工的培训。
examples.english_sentence: Our company places a lot of emphasis on employee training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師好著重學生嘅實踐能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hou2 zoek3 zung6 hok6 saang1 ge3 sat6 zin3 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师很重视学生的实践能力。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher emphasizes students' practical skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好只著重成績，要兼顧品格同態度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zi2 zoek3 zung6 sing4 zik1, jiu3 gim1 gu3 ban2 gaak3 tung4 taai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只注重成绩，要兼顾品格和态度。
examples.english_sentence: Don't focus only on grades; you should also consider character and attitude.

mandarin_meaning: 着陆（飛機等降落到地面）；也可引申為到達、落腳或獲得職位
english_meaning: to land; to touch down (usually of an aircraft); figuratively, to arrive, settle, or secure a position
explanation_mandarin: 指飛機或其他航行器降落到地面。口語或比喻用法中，也可表示某人或某物到達、落腳或成功獲得某個職位／工作。
explanation_english: Refers to an aircraft or other flying object landing on the ground. In colloquial or figurative use, it can mean someone or something arriving, settling, or successfully getting a position/job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班飛機已經著陸喺香港國際機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 fei1 gei1 ji5 ging1 zoek3 luk6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 gwok3 zai3 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飛機已經在香港國際機場著陸。
examples.english_sentence: The plane has already landed at Hong Kong International Airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於喺間大公司著陸，開始做正職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 hai2 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 zoek3 luk6, hoi1 ci2 zou6 zing3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於在大公司入職，開始做正式職位。
examples.english_sentence: He finally landed a job at a big company and started a full-time position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飛機預計十點二十分著陸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei1 gei1 jyu6 gai3 sap6 dim2 ji6 sap6 fan1 zoek3 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飛機預計在十點二十分著陸。
examples.english_sentence: The plane is scheduled to land at 10:20.

jyutping: zoek3 lung4 pou4 m4 ci5 taai3 zi2
mandarin_meaning: 穿龍袍不像太子；形容外表華麗但不相稱或不配身份，裝扮誇張卻不合格調或能力
english_meaning: Literally 'wearing the dragon robe but not looking like the crown prince' — describes someone who dresses or behaves ostentatiously but lacks the status, bearing, or ability to match it; putting on airs or being pretentious
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人外表或打扮很誇張、顯眼，但與其身份、氣質或能力不相稱，帶有嘲諷或批評意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone whose outward appearance or dress is flashy or grandiose but does not match their status, demeanor, or ability; often used mockingly to point out pretentiousness or mismatch between appearance and reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著啲好浮誇嘅衫，真係著龍袍唔似太子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 di1 hou2 fau4 kwaa1 ge3 saam1, zan1 hai6 zoek3 lung4 pou4 m4 ci5 taai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是穿得很浮誇，真是穿龍袍不像太子。
examples.english_sentence: He always dresses so ostentatiously — it's a clear case of 'wearing the dragon robe but not looking like the crown prince'.

mandarin_meaning: 葛（gé）：指葛藤或其根（葛根、葛粉），常用作中藥或食材；亦為姓氏。
english_meaning: Kudzu (a vine) or its root/starch (used in Chinese medicine and cooking); also a Chinese surname (Ge).
explanation_mandarin: 「葛」通常指一種攀緣植物（葛藤）及其根（葛根），可製成葛粉，用於烹飪或中藥；同時也是中文姓氏。
explanation_english: The character refers to the kudzu plant (a vine) and its root (used to make kudzu starch), commonly used in cooking and traditional Chinese medicine. It is also a Chinese surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包葛粉可以整糖水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 got3 fan2 ho2 ji5 zeng2 tong4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這包葛粉可以煮糖水。
examples.english_sentence: This packet of kudzu starch can be used to make sweet soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 葛根係中藥，對頭痛有幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: got3 gan1 hai6 zung1 joek6, deoi3 tau4 tung3 jau5 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 葛根是中藥，對頭痛有幫助。
examples.english_sentence: Kudzu root is a traditional Chinese medicine and can help with headaches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姓葛，叫葛先生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 got3, giu3 got3 sin1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓葛，叫葛先生。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is Ge; he's called Mr. Ge.

mandarin_meaning: （常見於）葡萄；葡萄牙（用作構詞成分）
english_meaning: used in compounds such as 'grape' (葡萄) and 'Portugal' (葡萄牙); a morpheme/character
explanation_mandarin: 漢字，單獨較少單用，常見於詞語如「葡萄」（grape）和「葡萄牙」（Portugal），作為構詞成分表示與葡萄或來源地相關。
explanation_english: A Chinese character rarely used alone; commonly appears in compounds such as 葡萄 (grape) and 葡萄牙 (Portugal). Functions as a morpheme in words related to grapes or the proper name Portugal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食葡萄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1ji3 sik6 pou4tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡吃葡萄。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat grapes.

mandarin_meaning: 葡萄牙（國家）
english_meaning: Portugal
explanation_mandarin: 「葡國」為粵語常用的簡稱，指葡萄牙（葡萄牙共和國），多用於口語或書面簡稱。
explanation_english: '葡國' is a Cantonese colloquial abbreviation referring to Portugal (the Portuguese Republic). Commonly used in speech and informal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月會去葡國旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 pou4 gwok3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月会去葡萄牙旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to Portugal next month.

mandarin_meaning: 口語指澳門的貨幣（澳門元 / Pataca），也可泛指葡萄牙的貨幣（多見於歷史或口語中）
english_meaning: Colloquial term usually for Macanese currency (Macanese pataca, MOP); can also loosely refer to Portuguese currency (historically)
explanation_mandarin: 「葡幣」是粵語口語用法，常用來指澳門通用的貨幣──澳門元（Pataca）。在某些語境下也會被用來指葡萄牙的貨幣，尤其是涉及歷史或非正式談話時。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquialism typically referring to the currency used in Macau — the Macanese pataca (MOP). In some contexts it may be used to refer to Portuguese currency, especially in historical or informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去澳門記得換啲葡幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 ou3 mun4 gei3 dak1 wun6 di1 pou4 bai6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去澳門記得換一些澳門幣。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to exchange some Macanese patacas before going to Macau.

mandarin_meaning: 葡萄干（常用於香港廣東話，指乾葡萄，即葡萄乾）
english_meaning: raisin (dried grape)
explanation_mandarin: 「葡提子」是香港廣東話常用的稱呼，指乾的葡萄（葡萄干／葡萄乾）。有時「提子」單獨也可指無籽的葡萄，但加上「葡」字時多指葡萄乾（葡萄干）。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "葡提子" commonly refers to raisins (dried grapes). "提子" alone can mean certain table grapes, but with "葡" it typically denotes dried grapes (raisins).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 蛋糕入面有葡提子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan6 gou1 jap6 min6 jau5 pou4 tai4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蛋糕里面有葡萄干。
examples.english_sentence: There are raisins in the cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鐘意食葡提子，覺得太甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 pou4 tai4 zi2, gok3 dak1 taai3 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢吃葡萄干，覺得太甜。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like eating raisins; I find them too sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 葡式蛋撻（葡萄牙蛋撻）
english_meaning: Portuguese egg tart (pastel de nata); Portuguese-style custard tart
explanation_mandarin: 「葡撻」是粵語中對葡式蛋撻的口語簡稱，指源自葡萄牙的酥皮奶黃蛋撻，香港和澳門的餅店常見且受歡迎。
explanation_english: "葡撻" is a Cantonese colloquial abbreviation for Portuguese egg tart (pastel de nata) — a flaky pastry filled with creamy custard. It's commonly sold and popular in Hong Kong and Macau bakeries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買個葡撻嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 go3 pou4 tat1 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想買個葡撻來吃。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a Portuguese egg tart to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 葡萄牙文 / 葡萄牙語
english_meaning: Portuguese (language); Portuguese text
explanation_mandarin: 「葡文」是粵語中對「葡萄牙文／葡萄牙語」的簡稱，通常指葡萄牙語或以葡萄牙語書寫的文字。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese abbreviation for Portuguese (language or Portuguese text), referring to the Portuguese language or materials written in Portuguese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大學修咗兩年葡文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 daai6 hok6 sau1 zo2 loeng5 nin4 pou4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大學學了兩年葡萄牙語。
examples.english_sentence: I studied Portuguese for two years at university.

mandarin_meaning: 葡萄汁
english_meaning: grape juice
explanation_mandarin: 「葡汁」通常是口語或餐牌上的簡稱，指葡萄榨成的飲料，即葡萄汁。
explanation_english: A colloquial or menu abbreviation for grape juice (juice made from grapes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯葡汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 pou4 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一杯葡萄汁。
examples.english_sentence: I want a glass of grape juice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友鍾意飲葡汁，唔鍾意飲牛奶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 zung1 ji3 jam2 pou4 zap1, m4 zung1 ji3 jam2 ngau4 naai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友喜欢喝葡萄汁，不喜欢喝牛奶。
examples.english_sentence: Kids like drinking grape juice and don't like milk.

mandarin_meaning: （罕見俗語）字面為「葡萄/葡國的紙」，在粵語口語中極為少見，可能被用來指與葡萄牙或澳門有關的紙張、文件或紙幣，也可能是地方性或年代久遠的用語，具體含義視語境而定。
english_meaning: (rare slang) Literally "Portuguese/grape paper". Very rare in Cantonese speech; may refer to paper, documents, or banknotes related to Portugal or Macau, or be a regional/old-fashioned term. Exact meaning depends on context.
explanation_mandarin: 『葡紙』並非常見粵語詞彙。字面可解作與「葡萄」或「葡國（葡萄牙）」相關的「紙」，在實際使用中很少見，若遇到需參照上下文判斷是否指文件、紙幣或其他紙製物。
explanation_english: Not a common Cantonese term. Literally suggests paper related to "grape" or "Portugal." Usage is rare; when encountered, context should determine whether it refers to documents, banknotes, or other paper items tied to Portugal/Macau or is simply an old/regional expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅「葡紙」我未聽過，可能係舊時用語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 「pou4 zi2」 ngo5 mei6 teng1 gwo3, ho2 nang4 hai6 gau6 si4 jung6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的「葡紙」我沒聽過，可能是舊時用語。
examples.english_sentence: I've never heard the term "葡紙" he mentioned; it might be an old-fashioned expression.

mandarin_meaning: 葡萄（pútao）
english_meaning: grape; grapes
explanation_mandarin: 葡萄是一种常见的水果，成串生长，可鲜食、榨汁或酿酒。也可晒制成葡萄干。
explanation_english: Grapes are a common fruit that grow in clusters; they can be eaten fresh, juiced, or used to make wine. They can also be dried into raisins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一串葡萄，味道好甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 cyun4 pou4 tou4, mei6 dou6 hou2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一串葡萄，味道很甜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bunch of grapes; they're very sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 葡萄可以用嚟釀酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou4 tou4 ho2 ji5 jung6 lai4 joeng6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 葡萄可以用来酿酒。
examples.english_sentence: Grapes can be used to make wine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鐘意食提子，夏天特別消暑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 tai4 zi2, haa6 tin1 dak6 bit6 siu1 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃提子，夏天特别解暑。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating grapes; they are especially refreshing in summer.

mandarin_meaning: 葡萄牙 (國家名，也可指該國的語言或事物)
english_meaning: Portugal (the country); can also refer to the Portuguese language or things related to Portugal
explanation_mandarin: 指位於歐洲西南部的國家葡萄牙；在語境中也可指葡萄牙語或與葡萄牙有關的人、文化、事物。
explanation_english: Refers to the country Portugal in southwestern Europe; in context it can also mean the Portuguese language or things/people related to Portugal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去過葡萄牙，覺得里斯本好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 gwo3 pou4 tou4 ngaa4, gok3 dak1 lei5 si1 bun2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去過葡萄牙，覺得里斯本很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: I've been to Portugal; I think Lisbon is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 葡萄牙語同西班牙語有啲相似，但又有自己特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou4 tou4 ngaa4 jyu5 tung4 sai1 baan1 jyu5 jau5 di1 soeng1 ci4, daan6 jau6 zi6 gei2 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 葡萄牙语和西班牙语有些相似，但又有自己的特色。
examples.english_sentence: Portuguese and Spanish are somewhat similar, but each has its own characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 澳門曾經係葡萄牙嘅殖民地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ou3 mun4 cang4 ging1 hai6 pou4 tou4 ngaa4 ge3 zik6 man4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 澳门曾经是葡萄牙的殖民地。
examples.english_sentence: Macau was once a Portuguese colony.

mandarin_meaning: 葡萄糖（pútáotáng），一種單糖，常用作能量來源或醫療輸注液
english_meaning: glucose; a simple sugar (monosaccharide) used as an energy source and in medical infusions
explanation_mandarin: 葡萄糖是一種單糖，存在於水果和血液中，人體主要能量來源之一。臨床上常以葡萄糖溶液作為補液或能量補充。
explanation_english: Glucose is a monosaccharide found in fruits and blood and is a primary energy source for the body. Clinically, glucose solutions are used for hydration and energy supplementation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫護話佢要輸葡萄糖，好快就會好返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 wu6 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 syu1 pou4 tou4 tong4, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 hou2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫護說他需要輸注葡萄糖，很快就會好轉。
examples.english_sentence: The medical staff said he needs a glucose drip; he'll get better soon.

mandarin_meaning: 葡萄酒 (pútáojiǔ)
english_meaning: wine (grape wine)
explanation_mandarin: 用葡萄發酵釀製的酒，常見有紅葡萄酒和白葡萄酒等。
explanation_english: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grapes; commonly refers to red or white wine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想飲杯紅葡萄酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 hung4 pou4 tou4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想喝一杯红葡萄酒。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I want to drink a glass of red wine.

mandarin_meaning: （動詞）管理、監督；（名詞）姓氏（董）
english_meaning: to manage; to supervise; (also a surname: Dong)
explanation_mandarin: 「董」作動詞時有管理、督導的意思；亦是常見姓氏，常見於「董事」等詞彙中。
explanation_english: As a verb, 董 means to manage or supervise. It is also a common Chinese surname (Dong) and appears in compounds like 董事 (director).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅董事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 dung2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司的董事。
examples.english_sentence: He is a director of the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋老闆姓董。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lou5 baan2 sing3 dung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们老板姓董。
examples.english_sentence: Our boss's surname is Dong.

mandarin_meaning: 董事 (dǒngshì)，公司或機構中負責決策與監督的成員
english_meaning: director (a member of a company's board of directors); a person responsible for governance and oversight
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或機構中負責重大決策、監督管理層和保障股東利益的成員，通常為董事會的成員。
explanation_english: A member of a company's or organization's board of directors who takes part in major decisions, governance, and oversight of management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係間上市公司嘅董事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gaan1 seong5 si5 gung1 si1 ge3 dung2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是那家上市公司的董事。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a director of that listed company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 董事會下星期會討論新策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung2 si6 wui6 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 tou2 leon6 san1 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 董事會下週會討論新策略。
examples.english_sentence: The board will discuss the new strategy next week.

mandarin_meaning: 董事会（企業的决策和監督機構）
english_meaning: board of directors
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或機構內由多位董事組成、負責重大決策、監督管理層與制訂策略的正式機構。
explanation_english: The governing body of a company or organization composed of directors responsible for major decisions, oversight of management, and setting strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅董事局今晚會開會，討論合併事宜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 dung2 si6 guk6 gam1 maan5 wui5 hoi1 wui6, tou2 leon6 hap6 bing3 si6 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的董事局今晚會開會，討論合併事宜。
examples.english_sentence: The company's board of directors will meet tonight to discuss the merger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 董事局已經委任咗新嘅行政總裁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung2 si6 guk6 ji5 ging1 wai2 jam6 zo2 san1 ge3 hang4 zing3 zung2 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 董事局已經委任了新的行政總裁。
examples.english_sentence: The board of directors has appointed a new CEO.

mandarin_meaning: 董事豪宅；富豪或公司董事所擁有的豪宅/大屋（俚語）
english_meaning: director's house; a slang term for a luxurious house or mansion owned by a director/tycoon
explanation_mandarin: 香港俚語，用來指稱富豪、公司董事等人擁有的豪宅或大屋，語氣可帶有羨慕或諷刺意味。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong slang term referring to a luxurious house or mansion owned by a director or tycoon; can carry tones of admiration or sarcasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺董事屋，成日喺度擺酒請客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 dung2 si6 uk1, sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 baai2 zau2 ceng2 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在董事豪宅，經常在那裡擺酒請客。
examples.english_sentence: He lives in a director's house and often hosts banquets to entertain guests.

mandarin_meaning: 董事会 (公司或组织的决策与监督机构)
english_meaning: board of directors
explanation_mandarin: 公司或组织中负责重大决策、监督管理层并代表股东利益的机构，由若干董事组成，负责制定政策、批准预算、任命高层管理人员等。
explanation_english: The governing body of a company or organization composed of directors responsible for major decision-making and oversight — setting policy, approving budgets, and appointing senior executives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 董事會下星期會討論新嘅預算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung2 si6 wui6 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 tou2 leon6 san1 ge3 jyu6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 董事会下星期会讨论新的预算。
examples.english_sentence: The board of directors will discuss the new budget next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 董事會已經任命咗新嘅執行長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung2 si6 wui6 ji5 ging1 jam6 ming6 zo2 san1 ge3 zap1 hang4 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 董事会已经任命了新的执行长（或首席执行官）。
examples.english_sentence: The board of directors has appointed a new CEO.

mandarin_meaning: 董事長 (dǒngshìzhǎng) — 公司或組織董事會的主席
english_meaning: chairman (chairperson) of the board; the head of a company's board of directors
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或組織中擔任董事會主席、主持董事會會議並參與重大決策和監督管理層的人，通常由董事會選舉或委任產生。
explanation_english: The person who chairs a company's or organization's board of directors; responsible for leading board meetings, overseeing management, and participating in major strategic decisions. Usually elected or appointed by the board.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅董事長今日會出席股東大會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 dung2 si6 zoeng2 gam1 jat6 wui5 ceot1 zik6 gu2 dung1 daai6 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的董事長今天會出席股東大會。
examples.english_sentence: The company's chairman will attend the shareholders' meeting today.

mandarin_meaning: 芦苇（wěi）——一种生长在湿地或河边的多年生草本植物
english_meaning: reed (Phragmites) — a perennial grass-like plant that grows in wetlands and along riverbanks
explanation_mandarin: 指生长在河边、沼泽等湿地的芦苇，常见于河岸与湿地植被；在文学中也可用作比喻。
explanation_english: Refers to reeds (Phragmites) that grow along riverbanks and in wetlands; commonly part of riparian vegetation and sometimes used figuratively in literature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 河邊到處都有葦，風一吹就沙沙作響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho4 bin1 dou3 cyu3 dou1 jau5 wai5, fung1 jat1 ceoi1 zau6 saa1 saa1 zok3 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 河边到处都有芦苇，风一吹就沙沙作响。
examples.english_sentence: Reeds grow everywhere along the riverbank; they rustle when the wind blows.

mandarin_meaning: 花瓣；花朵；（引申）奇怪的人或事（見「奇葩」）
english_meaning: petal; blossom; (figuratively) an odd or bizarre person/thing (as in '奇葩')
explanation_mandarin: 葩原指花瓣或花朵，常見於古文和成語（如「花中之葩」）。在口語中常見於複合詞「奇葩」，用來比喻奇怪或離奇的人或事。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a flower petal or blossom and appears in classical expressions (e.g. '花中之葩'). In colloquial usage it commonly appears in the compound '奇葩' to describe someone or something bizarre or extraordinary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢朵花嘅葩好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 do2 faa1 ge3 paa1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这朵花的花瓣很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The petals of this flower are very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係個奇葩，成日做啲奇怪嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 kei4 paa1, seng4 jat6 zou6 di1 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个奇葩，总是做一些奇怪的事。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a weirdo, always doing strange things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古書成日用「花中之葩」嚟形容最靚嘅花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 syu1 sing4 jat6 jung6 'faa1 zung1 zi1 paa1' lai4 jing4 jung4 zeoi3 leng3 ge3 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古书常用「花中之葩」来形容最美的花。
examples.english_sentence: Classical texts often use '花中之葩' to describe the most beautiful flowers.

mandarin_meaning: 葫芦（hú），葫芦類植物的通稱；在複合詞或成語中常見，如“葫蘆”。
english_meaning: Gourd (the bottle gourd); name for gourd plants; appears in compounds and idioms.
explanation_mandarin: “葫”字常用於“葫芦”一詞，指葫芦或葫芦屬植物。也出現在成語裡（例如“葫芦裡賣什麼藥”），用來比喻心懷秘密或不可捉摸的意圖。
explanation_english: The character '葫' appears in words like '葫芦' referring to gourds (bottle gourds) and gourd plants. It is also used in idioms (e.g. 'what's the deal in the gourd') to suggest hidden intentions or tricks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆喺屋企種咗幾條葫蘆藤，結果長咗幾個大葫蘆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hai2 uk1 kei2 zung6 zo2 gei2 tiu4 wu4 lou4 tang4, git3 gwo2 coeng4 zo2 gei2 go3 daai6 wu4 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶在家裡種了幾株葫蘆藤，結果長出好幾個大葫蘆。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma planted some gourd vines at home and ended up with several large gourds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日諗住葫蘆裡面賣乜嘢藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 wu4 lou4 leoi5 min6 maai6 mat1 je5 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是想葫芦里在卖什么药。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always wonder what trick someone is hiding (don't always suspect there's a hidden motive).

mandarin_meaning: 葫芦；一种植物的果实（瓜类），干制后可作为器皿或乐器；在俗语中常用于“葫芦里卖什么药”，意指某人心里有什么打算或隐情。
english_meaning: gourd (bottle gourd); the fruit of a vine used as a container or instrument when dried; used idiomatically in expressions like "what's in the gourd" to ask about someone's hidden intentions.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞；（作俗語時）片語/成語
explanation_mandarin: 葫蘆本是植物葫蘆科的果實，乾燥後常被用作容器、瓢或樂器。口語中常見成語或俗語“葫蘆裡賣什麼藥”，用來懷疑或探問別人有何圖謀或隱情。
explanation_english: Literally a gourd (the fruit of a vine) often used as a container or instrument when dried. Idiomatically appears in expressions like "what's in the gourd?" to question someone's motives or hidden plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個葫蘆係用嚟盛水嘅，可以做花瓶或者裝飾品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wu4 lou4 hai6 jung6 lai4 sing4 seoi2 ge3, ho2 ji5 zou6 faa1 ping4 waak6 ze2 zong1 sik1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个葫芦用来盛水，可以做花瓶或装饰品。
examples.english_sentence: This gourd is used to hold water; it can serve as a vase or a decorative item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要投資嗰個項目，但係我唔信，唔知佢葫蘆裡賣咩藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 tau4 zi1 go2 go3 hoeng6 muk6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 seon3, m4 zi1 keoi5 wu4 lou4 leoi5 maai6 me1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要投资那个项目，但我不信，不知道他葫芦里卖什么药。
examples.english_sentence: He says he wants to invest in that project, but I don't trust him — I don't know what his hidden motives are.

mandarin_meaning: 葫蘆（瓠瓜）
english_meaning: bottle gourd / calabash (a type of gourd used as a vegetable)
explanation_mandarin: 指一種葫蘆科植物的果實（即瓠瓜、葫蘆），果實呈瓶狀或長形，常作蔬菜或煲湯材料。在粵語口語中，某些地區或情況下也會把「葫蘆瓜」用作戲稱，指傻瓜或笨人（屬口語、地區性用法）。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of gourd (bottle gourd / calabash) whose fruit is bottle-shaped or elongated and is commonly used as a vegetable or in soups. In some Cantonese colloquial usage it can occasionally be used jokingly to call someone a fool (informal/regional).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽買咗個葫蘆瓜，今晚用嚟煲湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 maai5 zo2 go3 wu4 lou4 gwaa1, gam1 maan5 jung6 lai4 bou1 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽買了一個葫蘆瓜，今晚用來煲湯。
examples.english_sentence: Mom bought a bottle gourd; she'll use it to make soup tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做個葫蘆瓜啦，應該要諗辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 go3 wu4 lou4 gwaa1 laa1, jing1 goi1 jiu3 lam2 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當個傻瓜了，應該想辦法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a fool; you should think of a solution.

mandarin_meaning: 埋葬；舉行葬禮
english_meaning: to bury; to inter; to hold a funeral (burial)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把遺體埋入土中或舉行葬禮使其入土安葬的行為。
explanation_english: Indicates the act of burying a body in the ground or holding a funeral to inter someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺上個禮拜已經葬咗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 soeng6 go3 lai5 baai3 ji5 ging1 zong3 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爺爺上個禮拜已經下葬了。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather was buried last week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家人已經安排好葬禮，同埋下星期會正式葬佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 jan4 ji5 ging1 on1 paai4 hou2 zong3 lai5, tung4 maai4 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 zing3 sik1 zong3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家人已經安排好葬禮，並且下星期會正式為他下葬。
examples.english_sentence: The family has already arranged the funeral and will formally bury him next week.

mandarin_meaning: 葬禮 (zànglǐ)
english_meaning: funeral; funeral ceremony
explanation_mandarin: 指為逝者舉行的儀式或送葬活動，包含告別、追悼和下葬等程序。
explanation_english: A ceremony or set of rites held for a deceased person, including the funeral service, memorial activities, and burial proceedings.
