explanation_english: Refers to the clear part of an egg that turns white when cooked (egg white/albumen). Broadly it can mean protein (especially in dietary contexts) or albumen in biology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做蛋白霜要將蛋白打到企身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 daan6 baak6 soeng1 jiu3 zoeng1 daan6 baak6 daa2 dou3 kei5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做蛋白霜要把蛋白打到硬性發泡（企身）。
examples.english_sentence: To make meringue you need to beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 健身要食多啲蛋白，幫手增肌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 san1 jiu3 sik6 do1 di1 daan6 baak6, bong1 sau2 zang1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 健身要多吃蛋白（質），有助增加肌肉。
examples.english_sentence: If you work out you should eat more protein to help build muscle.

mandarin_meaning: 蛋白质 (dànbáizhì)
english_meaning: protein
explanation_mandarin: 蛋白質由氨基酸組成，是重要的營養素，參與構建和修復組織、製造酵素與激素、以及支持免疫功能等生理過程。
explanation_english: Proteins are macronutrients made of amino acids; they are essential for building and repairing tissues, producing enzymes and hormones, and supporting immune function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該食多啲含有蛋白質嘅食物，好似魚、肉同豆類。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 sik6 do1 di1 ham4 jau5 daan6 baak6 zat1 ge3 sik6 mat6, hou2 ci5 jyu4, juk6 tung4 dau6 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该多吃含有蛋白质的食物，比如鱼、肉和豆类。
examples.english_sentence: We should eat more foods that contain protein, such as fish, meat, and legumes.

mandarin_meaning: 冰淇淋蛋筒；甜筒
english_meaning: ice cream cone (waffle or sugar cone)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來盛放冰淇淋的可食用脆皮筒（如華夫筒或糖筒）。
explanation_english: An edible cone-shaped container (e.g., waffle or sugar cone) used to hold ice cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食一個蛋筒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 jat1 go3 daan6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃一个冰淇淋蛋筒。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat an ice cream cone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋筒好脆，食落好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 tung2 hou2 ceoi3, sik6 lok6 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋筒很脆，吃起来很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This cone is crispy and tastes great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食蛋筒要小心，唔好俾雪糕滴到衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 daan6 tung2 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 bei2 syut3 gou1 dik1 dou3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃蛋筒要小心，不要让冰淇淋滴到衣服上。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when eating an ice cream cone so the ice cream doesn't drip on your clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 蛋糕
english_meaning: cake
explanation_mandarin: 用麵粉、雞蛋、糖等原料烘焙而成的甜點，常用於慶祝活動如生日、聚會。
explanation_english: A sweet baked dessert made from ingredients like flour, eggs, and sugar; commonly used for celebrations such as birthdays and parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個蛋糕畀你，生日快樂！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 daan6 gou1 bei2 nei5, sang1 jat6 faai3 lok6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了個蛋糕給你，生日快樂！
examples.english_sentence: I bought a cake for you — happy birthday!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我留兩塊生日蛋糕啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 lau4 loeng5 faai3 sang1 jat6 daan6 gou1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你幫我留兩塊生日蛋糕吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please save me two pieces of the birthday cake.

mandarin_meaning: 蛋茶（将鸡蛋加入茶中制成的饮品）
english_meaning: egg tea (a beverage made by adding egg to tea)
explanation_mandarin: 把打散或整只鸡蛋加入热茶或奶茶中的饮品，地方性或家庭自制的传统/家常饮料，在粤语语境中较少见，常见于茶餐厅或家常做法。
explanation_english: A drink made by adding beaten or whole egg to hot tea or milk tea. It is a regional or homemade beverage sometimes served in cha chaan tengs or made at home; relatively uncommon in standard Cantonese vocabulary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳有賣蛋茶，想試下嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 jau5 maai6 daan6 caa4, soeng2 si3 haa5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间茶餐厅有卖蛋茶，想试一下吗？
examples.english_sentence: This cha chaan teng sells egg tea — want to try it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，阿媽成日整蛋茶俾我飲，話可以暖身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 zing2 daan6 caa4 bei2 ngo5 jam2, waa6 ho2 ji5 nyun5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，妈妈经常给我做蛋茶喝，说可以暖身。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mom often made me egg tea to drink, saying it would warm me up.

mandarin_meaning: 蛋店；賣雞蛋的攤／店
english_meaning: egg shop; a stall or shop that sells eggs
explanation_mandarin: 「蛋莊」是廣東話的口語用法，指專門賣雞蛋的攤位或小店。用於日常生活中稱呼賣蛋的地方，地區性較強且非正式。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to a stall or small shop that sells eggs. It's an informal, regionally used word for a place where eggs are sold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話我去蛋莊買一打雞蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 ngo5 heoi3 daan6 zong1 maai5 jat1 daa2 gai1 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽叫我去蛋庄買一打雞蛋。
examples.english_sentence: My mom asked me to go to the egg shop to buy a dozen eggs.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/小孩子說法）雞蛋；（俚語）睪丸（俗稱「蛋」）
english_meaning: eggs (childish term); testicles (slang/vulgar)
explanation_mandarin: 「蛋蛋」在粵語中常見兩種用法：一是小孩子或口語稱呼雞蛋（等同於普通話的「雞蛋」）；二是俚語或粗俗說法，指人的睪丸。使用時要注意語境和場合。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "蛋蛋" has two common uses: a childish/colloquial word for eggs, and a slang/vulgar term for testicles. Be mindful of context and register when using it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路成日叫雞蛋做「蛋蛋」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 giu3 gai1 daan6 zou6 「daan6 daan6」。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子常常把雞蛋叫作「蛋蛋」。
examples.english_sentence: Children often call eggs "daan-daan" (蛋蛋).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人踢親蛋蛋，痛到喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 tek3 can1 daan6 daan6, tung3 dou3 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人踢到蛋蛋，疼得哭了。
examples.english_sentence: He got kicked in the balls and cried from the pain.

mandarin_meaning: 蛋散（一種油炸酥脆的零食）
english_meaning: egg crisps / deep-fried egg-based crispy snack
explanation_mandarin: 「蛋饊」為粵語俗稱，指用蛋、麵粉等材料油炸而成的酥脆小點心，與「蛋散」或「蛋酥」同類。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "蛋饊" refers to a crispy deep-fried snack made from egg and flour (similar to "蛋散"/egg crisps). It is a crunchy pastry/snack often sold as a treat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽買咗包蛋饊返嚟，啱啱炸好，熱辣辣，好脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 maai5 zo2 baau1 daan6 saan2 faan1 lai4, aam1 aam1 zaa3 hou2, jit6 laat6 laat6, hou2 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽買了一包蛋饊回來，剛炸好，熱呼呼的，很酥脆。
examples.english_sentence: Mom bought a pack of egg crisps back; they were just fried, piping hot and very crispy.

mandarin_meaning: 蛋黄
english_meaning: egg yolk
explanation_mandarin: 蛋的黃色部分，常用於烹飪和烘焙，含有較多脂肪和膽固醇。
explanation_english: The yellow part of an egg (egg yolk), commonly used in cooking and baking; contains relatively high fat and cholesterol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我煎蛋嗰陣鍾意食蛋黃流心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zin1 daan6 go2 zan6 zung1 ji3 sik6 daan6 wong4 lau4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我煎蛋的時候喜歡吃蛋黃流心。
examples.english_sentence: I like my fried eggs with runny yolks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 焗蛋糕要分開蛋白同蛋黃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: guk6 daan6 gou1 jiu3 fan1 hoi1 daan6 baak6 tung4 daan6 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 烘焙蛋糕要分開蛋白和蛋黃。
examples.english_sentence: When baking a cake you need to separate the egg whites and yolks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 蛋黃含有較高嘅膽固醇，食嘅時候要留意份量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan6 wong4 ham4 jau5 gaau3 gou1 ge3 daam2 gu3 seon4, sik6 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 lau4 ji3 fan6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蛋黃含有較高的膽固醇，吃的時候要注意份量。
examples.english_sentence: Egg yolks contain relatively high cholesterol, so be mindful of how much you eat.

mandarin_meaning: 蛋黃醬 / 美乃滋（調味醬）
english_meaning: Mayonnaise (egg-yolk based condiment)
explanation_mandarin: 一種以蛋黃和植物油等為主要原料的調味醬，常用於三明治、沙拉、炸物等料理上增添風味與綿密口感。
explanation_english: A condiment made mainly from egg yolks and oil (mayonnaise), used to add creamy flavor and texture to sandwiches, salads, fried foods, and more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個三文治入面要唔要抹啲蛋黃醬？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saam1 man4 zi6 jap6 min6 jiu3 m4 jiu3 mut6 di1 daan6 wong4 zoeng3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個三明治要不要抹些蛋黃醬？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want some mayonnaise on this sandwich?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意蛋黃醬，有冇其他沙律醬？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 daan6 wong4 zoeng3, jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 saa1 leot6 zoeng3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜歡蛋黃醬，有沒有其他沙拉醬？
examples.english_sentence: I don't like mayonnaise; is there any other salad dressing?

mandarin_meaning: 青蛙
english_meaning: frog
explanation_mandarin: 指一種兩棲動物，常見於池塘、濕地，會發出呱呱或蛙鳴的叫聲。
explanation_english: An amphibian commonly found in ponds and wetlands, known for its croaking sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有隻蛙喺池塘度跳來跳去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 zek3 waa1 hai2 ci4 tong4 dou6 tiu3 loi4 tiu3 heoi3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一只蛙在池塘里跳来跳去。
examples.english_sentence: There is a frog in the park jumping back and forth in the pond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚可以喺郊外聽到好多蛙聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 ho2 ji5 hai2 gaau1 ngoi6 teng1 dou3 hou2 do1 waa1 sing1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上在郊外可以听到很多蛙声。
examples.english_sentence: At night in the countryside you can hear many frogs croaking.

mandarin_meaning: 蛙人（wārén），指受過訓練在水中執行任務的潛水員，常指海軍作戰潛水員
english_meaning: frogman; a combat or operational diver trained to perform duties underwater (e.g., navy combat diver, rescue diver)
explanation_mandarin: 指受過專門訓練，在水中執行偵察、滲透、救援或作戰任務的潛水員或士兵；在軍事語境下常指海軍蛙人（作戰潛水員）。
explanation_english: A person trained to perform underwater operations such as reconnaissance, infiltration, rescue, or combat. In military contexts it typically refers to a navy combat diver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係海軍蛙人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 hoi2 gwan1 waa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是海軍蛙人。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be a navy frogman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救難隊派咗兩個蛙人落水搜救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 naan6 deoi6 paai3 zo2 loeng5 go3 waa1 jan4 lok6 seoi2 sau1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救難隊派了兩個蛙人下水搜救。
examples.english_sentence: The rescue team sent two frogmen into the water to search for survivors.

mandarin_meaning: 蛙泳；像青蛙的姿勢（例如瑜伽中的蛙式）
english_meaning: breaststroke (swimming); frog-like posture (e.g., frog pose in yoga)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指游泳的一種姿勢──蛙泳（雙臂與雙腿像青蛙般協調動作）。在運動或瑜伽語境下，也可指模仿青蛙形態的姿勢或動作（如瑜伽蛙式）。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a swimming stroke — the breaststroke — where the arms and legs move in a frog-like pattern. In exercise or yoga contexts, it can also denote a frog-like posture or movement (e.g., frog pose).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢蛙式游得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa1 sik1 jau4 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他蛙式游得很快。
examples.english_sentence: He swims the breaststroke very fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家喺游泳池練蛙式，想改善踢腿動作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4gaa1 hai2 jau4wing6ci4 lin6 waa1 sik1, soeng2 goi2sin6 tek3 teoi2 dung6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在在游泳池練蛙式，希望可以改善踢腿動作。
examples.english_sentence: I'm practicing the breaststroke at the pool now, hoping to improve my kick technique.

mandarin_meaning: 蛙泳（游泳的一種泳姿）
english_meaning: breaststroke (a swimming stroke)
explanation_mandarin: 蛙泳是一種游泳姿勢，特徵為雙臂對稱划水並配合類似青蛙的打腿動作，節奏分明，常見於休閒及競賽游泳。
explanation_english: Breaststroke is a swimming stroke characterized by symmetrical arm pulls and a frog-like kick. It has a distinct rhythm and is commonly used in recreational and competitive swimming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺學校游泳隊主打蛙泳，贏咗幾場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hok6 haau6 jau4 wing6 deoi6 zyu2 daa2 waa1 wing6, jing4 zo2 gei2 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她在学校游泳队主打蛙泳，赢了几场比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He/she specializes in the breaststroke on the school swim team and has won several competitions.

mandarin_meaning: 蛙鞋；腳蹼（用於游泳、浮潛或潛水的蹼狀鞋）
english_meaning: fins; swim fins or flippers used for swimming, snorkeling, or diving
explanation_mandarin: 指裝在腳上的蹼狀裝備，能增大划水面積，幫助游泳、浮潛或潛水時推進。
explanation_english: A fin-like piece of equipment worn on the feet to increase surface area for propulsion, used in swimming, snorkeling, or diving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一對蛙鞋，準備去潛水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 deoi3 waa1 haai4, zeon2 bei6 heoi3 cim4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一雙蛙鞋，準備去潛水。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a pair of fins and am getting ready to go diving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 帶咗蛙鞋之後，我游得快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai3 zo2 waa1 haai4 zi1 hau6, ngo5 jau4 dak1 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戴了蛙鞋之後，我游得更快。
examples.english_sentence: After putting on fins, I can swim faster.

mandarin_meaning: 蜘蛛
english_meaning: spider
explanation_mandarin: 表示蜘蛛（蛛形綱動物）的字，常見於複合詞如「蜘蛛」，指會織網捕食的小型節肢動物。
explanation_english: The character for 'spider' (an arachnid). Commonly appears in compounds such as '蜘蛛' and refers to small arachnids that often spin webs to catch prey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企角落有隻蛛，記得唔好亂摸佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 gok3 lok6 jau5 zek3 zyu1, gei3 dak1 m4 hou2 lyun6 mo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡角落有一隻蜘蛛，記得不要亂摸它。
examples.english_sentence: There's a spider in the corner of the house; remember not to touch it.

mandarin_meaning: 蛛絲馬跡 (zhūsī mǎjì)：微小的線索或跡象
english_meaning: traces or clues; slight signs from which one can infer something
explanation_mandarin: 比喻微小的線索或跡象，能夠提示或推斷出事情的真相或情況。
explanation_english: A metaphorical idiom referring to small clues or traces that indicate the existence or nature of something and from which one can infer the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺現場搵到一啲蛛絲馬跡，慢慢揪出真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 wan2 dou3 jat1 di1 zyu1 si1 maa5 zek3, maan6 maan6 zau1 ceot1 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在現場發現了一些蛛絲馬跡，慢慢查出真相。
examples.english_sentence: The police found some clues at the scene and gradually uncovered the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 蛞蝓（无壳的腹足纲软体动物），常见于潮湿环境
english_meaning: slug (a shell-less land gastropod)
explanation_mandarin: 单字“蛞”本身较少单独使用，常见于词语“蛞蝓”，指一种无壳的腹足纲软体动物，常在潮湿处出现。
explanation_english: The character '蛞' is rarely used alone and commonly appears in the compound '蛞蝓' meaning slug — a shell-less land gastropod often found in damp environments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝落雨，花園有好幾隻蛞蝓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 lok6 jyu5, faa1 jyun4 jau5 hou2 gei2 zek3 kut3 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上下雨，花园有好几只蛞蝓。
examples.english_sentence: It rained this morning; there are several slugs in the garden.

mandarin_meaning: 蛞蝓 (kuò yú) — 一種沒有外殼的腹足綱軟體動物，俗稱「蛞蝓」或「無殼蝸牛」。
english_meaning: slug — a shell-less terrestrial gastropod mollusk (similar to a snail but without a visible shell).
explanation_mandarin: 蛞蝓是指沒有外殼的腹足類軟體動物，常見於潮濕環境，會在植物上留下黏液軌跡，對農作物或花園植物有時會造成危害。
explanation_english: A slug is a shell-less gastropod mollusk commonly found in damp environments. It leaves a trail of mucus and can sometimes damage garden plants or crops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨之後，花園入面見到好多蛞蝓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 zi1 hau6, faa1 jyun4 jap6 min6 gin3 dou3 hou2 do1 kwok3 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨之後，在花園裡看到很多蛞蝓。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, I saw many slugs in the garden.

mandarin_meaning: 蛟（jiāo）：傳說中的水龍或凶猛的龍類，有時也泛指凶猛的人或怪物。
english_meaning: jiaolong; a mythical flood/water dragon; a fierce or monstrous dragon (sometimes used figuratively for a fierce person).
explanation_mandarin: 「蛟」常指中國傳說中的水中龍類，如「蛟龍」，也可用來形容凶猛或可怕的事物或人。
explanation_english: Refers to a mythical water/flood dragon (as in 'jiaolong'). Also used figuratively to describe someone or something fierce or monstrous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳說中有一條蛟龍住喺江底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 syut3 zung1 jau5 jat1 tiu4 gaau1 lung4 zyu6 hai2 gong1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传说中有一条蛟龙住在江底。
examples.english_sentence: Legend says there's a jiaolong living at the bottom of the river.

mandarin_meaning: 蛟龙 (jiāolóng)：中國神話中的一種水中龍類，亦用以比喻隱藏的英雄或有才能而未被發掘的人。
english_meaning: Jiaolong (mythical flood/river dragon); figuratively, a hidden talent or outstanding person not yet revealed.
explanation_mandarin: 蛟龍是中國傳統神話裡的龍類，常與水、洪水、呼風喚雨有關。文學和口語中也常用來比喻潛藏的英雄或尚未露面的才俊。
explanation_english: A jiaolong is a dragon-like creature from Chinese mythology associated with water and floods. In literature and speech it is often used metaphorically for a hidden hero or a talented person who has not yet emerged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家仍然默默無聞，但我相信係一條蛟龍，遲早會出頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 jing4 jin4 mak6 mak6 mou4 man4, daan6 ngo5 soeng1 seon3 hai6 jat1 tiu4 gaau1 lung4, ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在仍然默默無聞，但我相信他是隱藏的蛟龍，遲早會出頭。
examples.english_sentence: He's still unknown now, but I believe he's a hidden jiaolong — he'll emerge sooner or later.

mandarin_meaning: 蛤：原指貝類（如蛤蜊）；也見於詞語如蛤蟆。另在網路用法中，單字「蛤？」作為疑問或不解的語氣詞（相當於「蛤？」/「什麼？」）。
english_meaning: 蛤: a kind of shellfish (clam); appears in compounds like '蛤蜊' or '蛤蟆'. In internet slang, '蛤?' is used as an interjection meaning 'huh?' or 'what?' expressing surprise or disbelief.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 叹詞（网络用法）
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指一種貝類，常見於蛤蜊、蛤蟆等詞彙中。近年在網路語境裡，單獨使用「蛤？」作為疑問或不解的語氣詞，類似「什麼？」或「哈？」。在廣東口語中，單字作叹詞的用法較少，主要見於文字/網路交流。
explanation_english: Literally a shellfish (clam), found in words like 蛤蜊 or 蛤蟆. Recently, written/internet usage has adopted the single character '蛤?' as an interjection to show confusion, disbelief, or to ask 'what?'. This slang usage is more common online than in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟炒蛤好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 caau2 hap6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盤炒蛤蜊很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This plate of stir-fried clams is delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 蛤？你講咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hap6? nei5 gong2 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蛤？你說什麼？
examples.english_sentence: Huh? What did you say?

mandarin_meaning: 丑陋的女人；老巫婆（粗俗、侮辱性的稱呼）
english_meaning: Derogatory Cantonese slang for an ugly or nasty woman; 'hag' or 'old witch' (offensive)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語、貶義用詞，用來侮辱或嘲笑女性，暗指像蟾蜍或巫婆。語氣粗俗，通常被視為不禮貌或冒犯。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang insult for a woman, likening her to a toad or hag. Vulgar and offensive; sometimes used jokingly among close friends but generally rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好叫人做蛤乸，咁講好無禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 giu3 jan4 zou6 gaap3 naa5, gam2 gong2 hou2 mou4 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要叫人蛤乸，這樣說很沒禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call someone a '蛤乸' — that's very impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬧人，啲同事笑佢係個蛤乸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 naau6 jan4, di1 tung4 si6 siu3 keoi5 hai6 go3 gaap3 naa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她常常罵人，同事笑她是個蛤乸。
examples.english_sentence: She often yells at people; colleagues tease that she's a '蛤乸'.

mandarin_meaning: 难看的衣服；丑陋、不合潮流的打扮（俚语）
english_meaning: an ugly or unfashionable piece of clothing; a shabby/unflattering outfit (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容衣服或打扮很難看、寒酸、不合潮流，有貶義，可用來嘲諷別人的穿著。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe clothing or an outfit that is ugly, shabby, or unfashionable. It is derogatory and often used to mock someone's dress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好著嗰件蛤乸衣出街啦，好難睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoek3 go2 gin6 hap6 naa5 ji1 ceot1 gaai1 laa1, hou2 naan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別穿那件蛤乸衣出門了，很難看。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wear that '蛤乸衣' out — it's really ugly.

mandarin_meaning: 蛤蚧（géjiè）：一种大型壁虎类蜥蜴（如蛤蚧/虎纹壁虎），在中药中常作为补品使用，也指其干制品。
english_meaning: Tokay gecko (Gekko gecko) or similar large gecko; in traditional Chinese medicine the dried gecko is used as a tonic.
explanation_mandarin: 蛤蚧是一种壁虎科的蜥蜴，个体较大，常见于东南亚与南中国。干制蛤蚧常入中药方，认为有补肾壮阳、强身等功效（属于传统用法）。
explanation_english: A large gecko species (commonly the Tokay gecko) found in Southeast Asia and southern China. Dried geckos are used in traditional Chinese medicine as tonics believed to support kidney yang and general vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗隻蛤蚧嚟煲湯，話可以補身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 zek3 haap6 gaai3 lai4 bou1 tong1, waa6 ho2 ji5 bou2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一只蛤蚧来煲汤，说可以补身。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a Tokay gecko to make soup, saying it can boost health.

mandarin_meaning: 蛤蜊（gélí），一種雙殼類軟體動物，常作食材
english_meaning: clam (a bivalve mollusk), commonly used as food
explanation_mandarin: 蛤蜊是一種雙殼的軟體動物，可食用，常用於湯、炒菜或海鮮料理中，肉質鮮美。
explanation_english: A bivalve mollusk (clam). Edible and commonly used in soups, stir-fries, and seafood dishes; valued for its fresh, savory flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋煮蛤蜊湯，好鮮甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 zyu2 haap6 lei4 tong1, hou2 sin1 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们煮蛤蜊汤，很鲜甜。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight we're making clam soup; it's very fresh and tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 蛤蟆（háma）——蟾蜍，一种两栖动物；口语中有时用作贬称
english_meaning: toad (amphibian); colloquially used as an insult
explanation_mandarin: 蛤蟆是一种两栖动物，通常指蟾蜍。在口语中也可用来贬称丑陋或粗鲁的人，或出现在民间故事如“蛤蟆精”中。
explanation_english: A toad (an amphibian). Colloquially it can be used as an insulting term for someone considered ugly or rude; also appears in folklore (e.g., 'toad spirit').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺池塘見到隻蛤蟆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ci4 tong4 gin3 dou2 zek3 haap6 maa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在池塘看到一只蛤蟆。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a toad in the pond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話人係蛤蟆，真係好冇禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 jan4 hai6 haap6 maa4, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常说别人是蛤蟆，真的很没有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: He always calls people toads; it's really disrespectful.

jyutping: unknown (first character 蛤 通常讀 hap6；𧊅 為罕用字，粵語讀音無可靠記錄)
mandarin_meaning: 罕見詞／字，含義不確定（第一字「蛤」可作 hap6，第二字𧊅為罕用字，無可靠資料）
english_meaning: Rare/obscure term; meaning uncertain (the first character 蛤 is usually read hap6 in Cantonese; the second character 𧊅 is a rare character with no reliable attested reading or meaning)
explanation_mandarin: 「蛤𧊅」為罕見或非標準的字詞組合。根據可得資料，第一個字「蛤」在粵語通常讀作 hap6（如蛤蜊、蛤蟆的用字變體），但第二個字𧊅屬罕用字，現有字典和語料缺乏可靠記錄，因此整個詞的意思和讀音無法確定。若有上下文（口語、標語、網路用語等），有助於釐清其意義。
explanation_english: “蛤𧊅” appears to be a rare or nonstandard character combination. The first character 蛤 normally reads hap6 in Cantonese, but the second character 𧊅 is an uncommon/unattested character with no reliable readings or meanings in available references. Therefore the overall meaning and pronunciation are uncertain. Providing context (spoken usage, sentence, or source) can help identify its intended sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「蛤𧊅」我唔識，有冇人知佢係乜嘢意思？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei1 go3 zi6 '??' ngo5 m4 sik1, jau5 mou5 jan4 zi1 keoi5 hai6 mat1 je5 ji3 si1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個字「蛤𧊅」我不認識，有沒有人知道它是什麼意思？
examples.english_sentence: I don't know the character '蛤𧊅'. Does anyone know what it means?

mandarin_meaning: 蛭（如水蛭），一种吸血的环节动物
english_meaning: leech (a blood-sucking annelid, e.g., a freshwater leech)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种常见于淡水或潮湿环境、以吸取血液为生的环节动物，常见词如“水蛭”。
explanation_english: Refers to a blood-sucking annelid commonly found in freshwater or damp environments; often seen in the compound term “water leech”.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面見到一條水蛭，唔好摸佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 gin3 dou3 jat1 tiu4 seoi2 zat6, m4 hou2 mo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公园看到一条水蛭，别摸它。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a leech in the park — don't touch it.

mandarin_meaning: 蛹；（昆虫的）蛹阶段
english_meaning: pupa; chrysalis (the insect stage between larva and adult)
explanation_mandarin: 指昆虫从幼虫到成虫之间的阶段，个体在此阶段通常不活动，体内发生重组以发育成成虫；也指处于该阶段的个体。
explanation_english: Refers to the stage between larva and adult in insects when the organism is typically inactive and undergoes metamorphosis; also denotes an individual in that stage (pupa or chrysalis).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毛蟲變成蛹，之後會化做蝴蝶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 cung4 bin3 sing4 jung5, zi1 hau6 wui5 faa3 zou6 wu4 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毛毛虫变成蛹，之后会化成蝴蝶。
examples.english_sentence: The caterpillar turns into a pupa, and then it will develop into a butterfly.

mandarin_meaning: 蛻 (tuì)：脫落、脫皮、蛻變；也可比喻改變或轉化。
english_meaning: to shed (skin); to molt; to undergo a transformation; to cast off
explanation_mandarin: 表示動物脫去外皮或外殼（如昆蟲、爬蟲類等的蛻皮行為）；引申指事物或人經歷變化而產生轉變或重塑。
explanation_english: Refers to animals shedding their skin or exoskeleton (e.g., insects molting); metaphorically used for a transformation or significant change in form, status, or character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毛毛蟲蛻變做蝴蝶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 mou4 cung4 teoi3 bin3 zou6 wu4 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毛毛虫蜕变成蝴蝶。
examples.english_sentence: The caterpillar transforms into a butterfly.

mandarin_meaning: （動詞）蛻變、轉變、變化；（可作名詞）重大轉變或變態
english_meaning: to undergo a transformation or metamorphosis; a dramatic change (can be used literally for biological molting/metamorphosis or figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 指從一種狀態轉換成另一種狀態，既可指生物的蛻皮、變態，也常用來比喻事物或性格等發生重大的改變。
explanation_english: Refers to changing from one state to another; can describe biological molting/metamorphosis or be used metaphorically for major changes in people, organizations, or situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司經歷咗大幅蛻變，管理層完全重組。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ging1 lik6 zo2 daai6 fuk1 teoi3 bin3, gun2 lei5 cang4 jyun4 cyun4 cung4 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司經歷了大幅蛻變，管理層完全重組。
examples.english_sentence: The company has undergone a major transformation; the management was completely reorganized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅性格經過多年蛻變，變得更加成熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing3 gaak3 ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 teoi3 bin3, bin3 dak1 gang1 gaa1 sing4 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格經過多年蛻變，變得更加成熟。
examples.english_sentence: His personality has transformed over many years and become more mature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 蝴蝶由毛毛蟲蛻變成成蟲嘅過程好神奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu4 dip6 jau4 mou4 mou4 cung4 teoi3 bin3 sing4 sing4 cung4 ge3 gwo3 cing4 hou2 san4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蝴蝶由毛毛蟲蛻變成成蟲的過程很神奇。
examples.english_sentence: The process of a caterpillar transforming into a butterfly is amazing.

mandarin_meaning: 蜕变 (tuìbiàn)：指事物或人的重大的變化或轉變
english_meaning: metamorphosis; transformation; a marked change in form, appearance, or character
explanation_mandarin: 「蛻變」既可指生物脫殼或蛻皮的生理現象，也常用於比喻，指經歷重大變化或轉型（例如性格、外貌、社會地位或環境的改變）。
explanation_english: “蛻變” can mean the biological process of molting/metamorphosis, and is frequently used figuratively to describe a significant change or transformation in character, appearance, status, or environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經歷咗人生嘅蛻變，變得更加成熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 lik6 zo2 jan4 sang1 ge3 teoi3 bin3, bin3 dak1 gaam1 gaa1 sing4 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經歷了人生的蛻變，變得更加成熟。
examples.english_sentence: He underwent a transformation in life and became more mature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市經過多年規劃，面貌有明顯嘅蛻變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 kwai1 waak6, min6 maau6 jau5 ming4 hin2 ge3 teoi3 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個城市經過多年規劃，面貌有明顯的蛻變。
examples.english_sentence: The city has undergone a noticeable transformation after years of planning.

mandarin_meaning: 蛾（é），一种鳞翅目昆虫
english_meaning: moth
explanation_mandarin: 蛾是鳞翅目的一类昆虫，多数夜间活动，翅膀有鳞粉，常被光源吸引。
explanation_english: A moth — an insect of the order Lepidoptera. Many species are nocturnal, have scaly wings, and are attracted to light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲燈光吸引咗好多蛾飛嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 dang1 gwong1 kap1jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 ngo4 fei1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灯光吸引了很多蛾飞过来。
examples.english_sentence: The lights attracted many moths flying over.

mandarin_meaning: 嗓子沙哑 / 喉咙不适
english_meaning: hoarse voice; sore or raspy throat
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，指喉嚨聲音變沙啞或喉嚨不舒服，常因感冒、大聲說話或唱歌過度而引起。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to a hoarse, raspy, or uncomfortable throat—usually caused by a cold, overusing the voice (shouting/singing), or throat irritation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝起身就覺得蛾喉，講唔出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 hei2 san1 zau6 gok3 dak1 ngo4 hau4, gong2 m4 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上起來就覺得嗓子沙啞，說不出聲音。
examples.english_sentence: I woke up this morning with a hoarse throat and couldn't make a sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁喊會唔會蛾喉呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 haam3 wui5 m4 wui5 ngo4 hau4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣哭會不會嗓子沙哑？
examples.english_sentence: If you keep crying like that, won't you get hoarse?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱到蛾喉，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 dou3 ngo4 hau4, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱到嗓子沙哑，要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He sang until his voice was hoarse and needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 蜀 / 古代蜀国；四川的简称
english_meaning: Shu (ancient state); abbreviation for Sichuan
explanation_mandarin: “蜀”指古代的蜀国，也常作四川的簡稱，用於地名或歷史語境（如蜀漢、蜀地）。
explanation_english: “Shu” refers to the ancient state of Shu and is commonly used as an abbreviation for Sichuan; appears in historical and geographic contexts (e.g. Shu Han, Shu region).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 四川又叫蜀，嗰度嘅菜好辣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sei3 cyun1 jau6 giu3 suk6, go2 dou6 ge3 coi3 hou2 laat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 四川又叫蜀，那里菜很辣。
examples.english_sentence: Sichuan is also called Shu; the food there is very spicy.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：蜀國中沒有大將。引申：缺乏有才能的領導或人才，無人可堪大任。
english_meaning: Literal: 'There are no great generals in Shu.' Idiomatic: a place or organization lacks capable people or leaders; no one competent to take charge.
explanation_mandarin: 出自三國典故，用來形容一方缺少能人或傑出人才，因此只能任用平庸者或無人可用。
explanation_english: From a Three Kingdoms story; used to describe a situation where capable people are lacking, forcing the appointment of mediocre or unfit persons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家真係冇啲可以帶領團隊嘅人，成日出事，真係蜀中無大將。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 mou4 di1 ho2 ji5 daai3 ling5 tyun4 deoi2 ge3 jan4, sing4 jat6 ceot1 si6, zan1 hai6 suk6 zung1 mou4 daai6 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司現在真的沒有能帶領團隊的人，經常出問題，真是蜀中無大將。
examples.english_sentence: The company really has no one who can lead the team; problems keep happening — it's a case of 'no great generals in Shu'.

mandarin_meaning: 蜀汉（三国时期的一个政权）
english_meaning: Shu Han (the state of Shu during the Three Kingdoms period)
explanation_mandarin: 蜀漢（221–263年）是三國時期由劉備建立的政權，治所主要在成都，與曹魏、東吳三分天下。
explanation_english: Shu Han (221–263 CE) was the state founded by Liu Bei during the Three Kingdoms era, based around Chengdu and one of the three contending states.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺三國嗰陣，蜀漢係由劉備建立嘅政權，首都係成都。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 saam1 gwok3 go2 zan6, suk6 hon3 hai6 jau4 lau4 bei6 gin3 laap6 ge3 zing3 kyun4, sau2 dou1 hai6 sing4 dou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在三国时期，蜀汉是由刘备建立的政权，首都是成都。
examples.english_sentence: During the Three Kingdoms period, Shu Han was the regime founded by Liu Bei, with its capital at Chengdu.

mandarin_meaning: （通常指）蜜蜂；亦見於複合詞（如蜂群、蜂巢）
english_meaning: bee; (also used in compounds like 'bee colony', 'beehive')
explanation_mandarin: 「蜂」指蜜蜂，常用於組合詞中表示成群的飛行昆蟲或與蜜蜂相關的事物，如蜂巢、蜂群。在口語或書面語中多作名詞使用。
explanation_english: The character "蜂" refers to bees (typically honeybees) and appears in compounds related to bees, such as beehive and swarm. It is commonly used as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚畀蜂蜇到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng1 bei2 fung1 zat6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他害怕被蜜蜂叮到。
examples.english_sentence: He's afraid of being stung by a bee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面成群嘅蜂圍住啲花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 sing4 kwan4 ge3 fung1 wai4 zyu6 di1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里成群的蜜蜂围着花。
examples.english_sentence: Swarms of bees were surrounding the flowers in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企後園有個蜂巢，要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 hau6 jyun4 jau5 go3 fung1 caau4, jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家后院有一个蜂巢，要小心。
examples.english_sentence: There's a beehive in the backyard; be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 蜂后（雌性蜂群的産卵個體，亦可比喻群體中的主導女性）
english_meaning: queen bee (the reproductive female in a bee colony; also used metaphorically for a dominant or central woman in a group)
explanation_mandarin: 指蜂群中負責產卵和維持群體的雌性成員（即蜂後），在口語中亦可用作比喻，形容群體中受人矚目或主導地位的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to the female bee in a colony responsible for laying eggs and sustaining the hive. Figuratively, it can describe a woman who is the center of attention or holds a dominant/social leadership role in a group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 養蜂場入面，每個蜂箱都有一隻蜂后，負責產卵同繁殖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joeng5 fung1 coeng4 jap6 min6, mui5 go3 fung1 soeng1 dou1 jau5 jat1 zek3 fung1 hau6, fu6 zaak3 caan2 laan6 tung4 faan4 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 养蜂场里面，每个蜂箱都有一只蜂后，负责产卵和繁殖。
examples.english_sentence: In the apiary, each hive has a queen bee, responsible for laying eggs and reproduction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺班女同學入面，佢好似班裡嘅蜂后，人人圍住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 baan1 neoi5 tung4 hok6 jap6 min6, keoi5 hou2 ci5 baan1 leoi5 ge3 fung1 hau6, jan4 jan4 wai4 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在班上的女生里面，她像班里的“蜂后”，人人围着她。
examples.english_sentence: Among the girls in class, she is like the group's 'queen bee', with everyone gathered around her.

mandarin_meaning: 蜂巢（蜜蜂築的巢穴）
english_meaning: honeycomb; beehive
explanation_mandarin: 指蜜蜂所築的巢穴，由許多六邊形的蜂房組成。也可比喻為一個繁忙、熱鬧或人來人往的場所。
explanation_english: Refers to the nest built by bees—made up of many hexagonal cells. Can also be used metaphorically to describe a busy, bustling place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園裏面有個蜂巢，小朋友唔好近嗰度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 leoi5 min6 jau5 go3 fung1 caau4, siu2 pang4 jau5 m4 hou2 gan6 go2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一个蜂巢，小朋友不要靠近那里。
examples.english_sentence: There's a beehive in the park; children shouldn't go near it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聖誕市集熱鬧得好似一個蜂巢，人人都忙緊買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 daan3 si5 zaap6 jit6 naau6 dak1 hou2 ci5 jat1 go3 fung1 caau4, jan4 jan4 dou1 mong4 gan2 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圣诞市集热闹得像一个蜂巢，人人都忙着买东西。
examples.english_sentence: The Christmas market was buzzing like a hive; everyone was busy buying things.

mandarin_meaning: 蜂窝板（蜂窝芯复合板）
english_meaning: honeycomb panel / honeycomb board (a lightweight composite panel with a honeycomb core)
explanation_mandarin: 一种以蜂窝状芯材夹在两层表面板之间的轻质复合板材，常用于家具、隔断、展览以及工业领域，具有重量轻、强度高和易运输等特点。
explanation_english: A lightweight composite panel that has a honeycomb core sandwiched between two face sheets. Commonly used in furniture, partitions, exhibitions and industrial applications; it is light, strong and easy to transport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房啲櫃門係用蜂巢板做嘅，夠輕身又唔易變形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong4 di1 gwai6 mun4 hai6 jung6 fung1 cau4 baan2 zou6 ge3, gau3 hing1 san1 jau6 m4 ji6 bin3 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房間的櫃門是用蜂巢板做的，夠輕又不容易變形。
examples.english_sentence: The cabinet doors in the room are made of honeycomb panels; they're light and not easily deformed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 展覽會啲隔板多數係用蜂巢板，方便搬運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin2 laam5 wui6 di1 gaak3 baan2 do1 sou3 hai6 jung6 fung1 cau4 baan2, fong1 bin6 bun1 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 展览会的隔板多数使用蜂巢板，方便搬运。
examples.english_sentence: The partitions at the exhibition are usually made of honeycomb panels, which makes them easy to transport.

mandarin_meaning: 蜂拥而上（形容大量人或事物像蜜蜂一樣湧上或衝向某處）
english_meaning: to swarm; to rush forward in large numbers; to flock to something all at once
explanation_mandarin: 形容很多人或事物像蜜蜂一樣聚集或同時湧向某處，強調數量多且行動迅速，常用於描述群眾、顧客等爭相前往的情況。
explanation_english: Describes a large number of people or things swarming or rushing toward a place like bees; emphasizes a rapid, mass surge and is often used for crowds, customers, etc., flocking to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新產品一推出，顧客就蜂擁而上，貨架好快就清空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 caan2 ban2 jat1 ceot1, gu3 haak3 zau6 fung1 jung1 ji4 soeng5, fo3 gaa3 hou2 faai3 zau6 cing1 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新產品一推出，顧客就蜂拥而上，貨架很快就被搶購一空。
examples.english_sentence: When the new product was released, customers rushed in droves and the shelves were quickly emptied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會門一開，粉絲們蜂擁而上衝進會場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui6 mun4 jat1 hoi1, fan2 si1 mun4 fung1 jung1 ji4 soeng5 cung1 zeon3 wui6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱會一開門，粉絲們蜂拥而上衝進會場。
examples.english_sentence: When the concert doors opened, fans swarmed in and rushed into the venue.

mandarin_meaning: 蜂拥而至（大量的人或事物像蜜蜂一样涌来）
english_meaning: to flock to; to swarm in; to arrive in large numbers
explanation_mandarin: 形容大量人或事物像蜜蜂一样涌来，纷纷到达某处，常用来描述人群或顾客大量涌入某地的情形。
explanation_english: Describes a large number of people or things arriving like a swarm of bees; commonly used to describe crowds or customers pouring into a place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新款手機一出，市民都蜂擁而至去排隊買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 fun2 sau2 gei1 jat1 ceot1, si5 man4 dou1 fung1 jung2 ji4 zi3 heoi3 paai4 deoi6 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新款手机一上市，市民都蜂拥而至去排队购买。
examples.english_sentence: When the new model phone was released, people flocked to line up to buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 蜂蜜
english_meaning: honey (natural sweet substance produced by bees)
explanation_mandarin: 由蜜蜂採集花蜜並經酵素處理儲存在蜂巢中的天然甜物質，常用作甜味劑或調味，也用於保健和護膚。嬰兒一歲以下不宜食用蜂蜜。
explanation_english: A natural sweet substance produced by bees from flower nectar and stored in honeycombs. Commonly used as a sweetener, flavoring, and in health and skincare. Not recommended for infants under one year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早鍾意喺多士搽蜂蜜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1zou2 zung1ji3 hai2 do1si6 caat3 fung1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早上喜歡在吐司上抹蜂蜜。
examples.english_sentence: I like to spread honey on toast in the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢杯茶加少少蜂蜜幾好飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bui1 caa4 gaa1 siu2siu2 fung1 mat6 gei2 hou2 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这杯茶加一点蜂蜜很好喝。
examples.english_sentence: This tea tastes good with a bit of honey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話一歲以下嘅細路唔好食蜂蜜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1sang1 waa6 jat1 seoi3 ji5haa6 ge3 sai3lou6 m4 hou2 sik6 fung1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说一岁以下的孩子不要吃蜂蜜。
examples.english_sentence: Doctors say children under one year shouldn't eat honey.

mandarin_meaning: 蜃（蜃景）；傳說中的吐霧成景的大蛤蜊
english_meaning: mirage; (in legend) a large clam that creates mirages
explanation_mandarin: 指由光的折射或大氣層溫度差等引起的蜃景（海市蜃樓）現象；在傳說裡也指一種能吐霧成景的大蛤蜊。
explanation_english: Refers to a mirage (the optical phenomenon often called a fata morgana); in folklore it also denotes a legendary clam said to produce mirages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 沿海有時會見到蜃景，睇落好似有樓喺海上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin4 hoi2 jau5 si4 wui5 gin3 dou2 san4 ging2, tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 jau5 lau4 hai2 hoi2 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沿海有时会看到蜃景，看起来好像有建筑物在海上。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes you can see a mirage along the coast; it looks like there are buildings on the sea.

mandarin_meaning: 蚬 / 蛤蜊（淡水或近海的雙殼軟體動物）
english_meaning: clam (a bivalve mollusk, often used for food)
explanation_mandarin: 指一種常見的雙殼軟體動物，可食用，常用於煮湯或炒菜，在沿海或潮間帶常見。
explanation_english: Refers to a common bivalve mollusk eaten as food; often found in coastal or intertidal areas and used in soups or stir-fries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚煮蜆湯啦，好鮮甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 zyu2 hin2 tong1 laa1, hou2 sin1 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚煮蜆湯吧，很鮮甜。
examples.english_sentence: Let's make clam soup tonight — it's very fresh and sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海邊有好多蜆可以挖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 bin1 jau5 hou2 do1 hin2 ho2 ji5 waat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海邊有很多蜆可以挖。
examples.english_sentence: There are lots of clams on the beach you can dig up.

mandarin_meaning: 蛤蜊/蜆的外殼；貝殼（字面義）
english_meaning: clamshell; the hard outer shell of a clam (literal meaning)
explanation_mandarin: 指蜆（蛤蜊）或類似軟體動物的硬外殼。通常用於描述自然環境、烹飪材料或手工藝用的貝殼等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the hard outer shell of a clam (or similar shellfish). Used literally in contexts such as nature, cooking, or crafts involving shells.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 沙灘上有好多蜆殼，記得唔好踩爛佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saa1 taan1 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 hin3 hok3, gei3 dak1 m4 hou2 caai2 laan6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沙灘上有很多蜆殼，記得不要踩碎它們。
examples.english_sentence: There are many clamshells on the beach; remember not to step on them.

mandarin_meaning: 殼牌（Shell，石油/加油站品牌）的戲稱
english_meaning: A colloquial (often jocular) name for the Shell petrol/gas brand or Shell gas station
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語中對殼牌（Shell）這個石油/加油站品牌的戲稱或俗稱，字面是「蜆殼牌」，帶有調侃或親切口吻。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial term for the Shell oil/gas brand or a Shell petrol station. Literally 'clam-shell brand', used jokingly or informally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺蜆殼牌加滿晒油，宜家出發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 hai2 hin2 hok3 paai4 gaa1 mun5 saai3 jau4, ji4 gaa1 ceot1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛在蜆殼牌把油加滿了，現在出發。
examples.english_sentence: I just filled up at Shell, I'm leaving now.

mandarin_meaning: 俚語，形容人吝嗇、小氣（字面為「蜆」與「芥」組合，使用頻率較低且具地域性）
english_meaning: Colloquial slang for someone stingy or petty (literally 'clam + mustard'; rare and regionally used)
explanation_mandarin: 「蜆芥」為粵語口語或俚語用法，通常用來形容一個人吝嗇、愛計較或小氣。字面由「蜆」（小貝類）和「芥」（芥菜或芥末）組成，但實際含義為比喻性的性格評價，使用較少且具地域性。
explanation_english: "蜆芥" is Cantonese colloquial/slang typically used to describe someone stingy, petty, or niggardly. Literally composed of "蜆" (clam) and "芥" (mustard/mustard greens), the meaning is figurative. The term is relatively rare and regionally used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係幾蜆芥，連支筆都唔肯借。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 gei2 hin3 gaai3, lin4 zi1 bat1 dou1 m4 hang2 ze3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真有點小氣，連支笔都不肯借。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a bit stingy — he won't even lend a pen.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：蜆和鴨（蛤蜊與鴨子）；口語：可指將蜆與鴨搭配成的一道菜或比喻兩者搭配不協調的組合
english_meaning: Literal: clams and duck; colloquially: a dish pairing clams with duck or a metaphor for an incongruous/odd combination
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（字面）；口語中可做名詞或比喻短語
explanation_mandarin: 「蜆鴨」由「蜆」（蛤蜊）與「鴨」組成，字面上是指以蜆和鴨為主料的菜餚。在廣東話口語中，有時亦用來形容兩樣事物的搭配奇怪或不協調。
explanation_english: Composed of the characters for clam and duck, literally referring to a clam-and-duck dish. In Cantonese colloquial use it can also metaphorically describe a strange or mismatched pairing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚屋企煲咗蜆鴨，好特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 uk1 kei2 bou1 zo2 hin2 aap3, hou2 dak6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚在家煲了蜆鴨，很特別。
examples.english_sentence: I made clam-and-duck at home tonight — quite unusual.

mandarin_meaning: （被昆虫用刺）蜇、刺；（文言）蛰伏、冬眠
english_meaning: to sting (by an insect); (literary) to go into torpor/hibernate
explanation_mandarin: 表示被昆蟲用刺刺傷（例如被蜂蜇）；在書面或文言中也可指動物蛰伏、冬眠。
explanation_english: Refers to being stung or pierced by an insect (e.g. being stung by a bee); in literary usage it can mean an animal going into torpor or hibernation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我畀馬蜂蜇咗，好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 maa5 fung1 zit3 zo2, hou2 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被馬蜂蜇了，很痛。
examples.english_sentence: I was stung by a hornet; it really hurts.

mandarin_meaning: （通常見於「蜈蚣」）蜈蚣，指多足節肢動物
english_meaning: centipede (usually seen in the compound 蜈蚣)
explanation_mandarin: 字義指蜈蚣，單獨使用較少，常出現在合成詞如「蜈蚣」。用於指多足的節肢動物。
explanation_english: The character denotes a centipede. It is rarely used alone and commonly appears in the compound 蜈蚣 to refer to the many-legged arthropod.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺廁所見到一隻大蜈蚣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 hai2 ci3 so2 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 daai6 ng4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛在廁所看到一隻大蜈蚣。
examples.english_sentence: I just saw a big centipede in the bathroom.

mandarin_meaning: 蜈蚣 (wúgōng)
english_meaning: centipede
explanation_mandarin: 蜈蚣是一種多足的節肢動物，身體長而扁，具有多對足，常見於潮濕或陰暗的環境。某些種類會咬人，導致疼痛或局部腫脹。
explanation_english: A centipede — an elongated, many-legged arthropod with numerous paired legs. Often found in damp, dark places; some species can bite and cause pain or localized swelling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺屋企花園見到一隻大蜈蚣，嚇死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2 faa1 jyun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 daai6 ng4 gung1, haak3 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在家裡的花園看到一只大蜈蚣，把我嚇壞了。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a big centipede in my garden and it scared me.

mandarin_meaning: 散彈；霰彈
english_meaning: buckshot; shotgun shell that fires many small pellets; used metaphorically for a scattershot or salvo
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，指會發射多顆小彈丸的彈藥（即散彈／霰彈），有時亦用作比喻，形容掃射式或一次性發出大量、分散的攻擊或訊息。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term for ammunition that fires many small pellets (i.e., buckshot/shotgun shell). Also used figuratively to describe a scattershot approach or a salvo that spreads many hits or messages at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方用咗蜈蚣彈去驅散人群。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 jung6 zo2 ng4 gung1 daan6 heoi3 keoi1 saan3 jan4 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方用了霰弹来驱散人群。
examples.english_sentence: The police used buckshot to disperse the crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影裡，壞人用蜈蚣彈掃射街道，場面好驚嚇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 leoi5 waai6 jan4 jung6 ng4 gung1 daan6 sou2 se6 gaai1 dou6 coeng4 min6 hou2 ging1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影里，坏人用霰弹扫射街道，场面很可怕。
examples.english_sentence: In the movie, the villains swept the street with buckshot; the scene was terrifying.

mandarin_meaning: 蜉（如蜉蝣 fúyóu），指蜉蝣這種壽命很短的昆蟲；引申為短暫、瞬間。
english_meaning: Mayfly (a very short-lived insect); figuratively, something ephemeral or fleeting.
explanation_mandarin: 「蜉」本義指昆蟲，常見於合成詞「蜉蝣」，在文學語境中常用來比喻生命或事物的短暫與轉瞬即逝。單字口語使用較少，主要見於書面或詩詞中。
explanation_english: The character 蜉 originally refers to an insect, commonly seen in the compound 蜉蝣 (mayfly). In literary contexts it is often used metaphorically to denote brevity or transience. The single character is uncommon in everyday speech and appears mainly in written or poetic usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古詩裡用「蜉」嚟形容人生嘅短暫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si1 leoi5 jung6 "fu4" lai4 jing4 jung4 jan4 sang1 ge3 dyun2zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古詩裡用「蜉」來形容人生的短暫。
examples.english_sentence: Classical poems use '蜉' to describe the brevity of life.

mandarin_meaning: 蛤蜊；一種雙殼貝類（常用於烹飪）
english_meaning: clam (a type of bivalve shellfish)
explanation_mandarin: 「蜊」指一類雙殼貝，常見於沿海，常用於煮湯或其他料理（如蛤蜊湯）。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of bivalve shellfish (clams) commonly found in coastal areas and used in cooking, e.g., clam soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個市場啲蜊好新鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si5 coeng4 di1 lei4 hou2 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個市場的蜊很新鮮。
examples.english_sentence: The clams at this market are very fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 蟾蜍（青蛙類的一種，俗稱蟾蜍）
english_meaning: toad
explanation_mandarin: 蜍指一種兩棲類動物，常與「蟾」合用為「蟾蜍」，體型較短胖，皮膚多有疣狀突起，俗稱癩蛤蟆。
explanation_english: Refers to a toad — an amphibian, typically short and stout with warty skin; often used in the compound 蟾蜍 and commonly called a toad or 'laigaama' in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺河邊見到一隻蜍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ho4 bin1 gin3 dou3 jat1 zek3 co4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在河邊看到一只蟾蜍。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a toad by the river.

mandarin_meaning: 蜑（人）：指傳統居住在船上的群體，俗稱蜑家或舟民，尤指中國南方沿海及珠江三角洲的水上居民。
english_meaning: Tanka; boat‑dwelling people — traditional communities living on boats, especially in southern China (Pearl River Delta and coastal areas).
explanation_mandarin: “蜑”多見於“蜑家”“蜑人”等詞，指以船為主要居所、以漁業等為生的水上居民群體。歷史上蜑家在生活習俗和社會地位上與陸地居民有所區別。
explanation_english: The character '蜑' appears in terms like '蜑家' or '蜑人' and denotes boat‑dwelling communities (Tanka) who traditionally lived on boats and often earned a living from fishing. They were particularly common in southern Chinese coastal and delta regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係蜑家人，世代住喺船上，靠打魚為生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 daan6 gaa1 jan4, sai3 doi6 zyu6 hai2 syun4 seong6, kaau3 daa2 jyu4 wai4 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是蜑家人，世代住在船上，以打魚為生。
examples.english_sentence: He is a Tanka (boat‑dweller); his family has lived on boats for generations and makes a living fishing.

mandarin_meaning: 蜑家（或稱蜑民）：在水上生活的漁民或船民，歷史上指在南方沿海以船為家的族群（即“丁卡”/舟居漁民）。
english_meaning: Tanka / boat-dwelling fisherfolk: people who traditionally lived on boats and worked as fishermen in southern China; historically a marginalized boat-people community.
explanation_mandarin: 「蜑家」常用來指稱以船為家、以漁業為生的群體（亦稱蜑民或船民），在華南沿海地區有悠久歷史，社會地位過去常較邊緣化。
explanation_english: Refers to the Tanka or boat people — communities who traditionally lived on boats and made a living from fishing. Common in southern China, historically viewed as a distinct and often marginalized social group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係蜑家出身，一直住喺船上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 daan6 gaa1 ceot1 san1, jat1 zik6 zyu6 hai2 syun4 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是蜑家出身，一直住在船上。
examples.english_sentence: He is from the Tanka (boat people) and has always lived on boats.

mandarin_meaning: 趁機得利；見到有利可圖就馬上行動（帶有機會主義或貪小利的含義）
english_meaning: To seize opportunistic gains; to grab any profitable opportunity (often implying opportunism or grabbing small benefits whenever possible).
explanation_mandarin: 這是廣東話俗語，字面是指蜑家（舢舨/舢舨人的家庭）婦女去摸蜆，實際用來形容人見到有利就立刻行動、撿便宜或趁機得利，帶有機會主義或貪小利的語感。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'a Tanka woman picking clams.' It is used to describe someone who jumps on any profitable opportunity—picking up small gains or acting opportunistically when a chance appears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意就係蜑家婆摸蜆，見到有利就落手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 zau6 hai6 daan6 gaa1 po4 mo2 hin2, gin3 dou3 jau5 lei6 zau6 lok6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意就是蜑家婆摸蜆，看到有利就下手。
examples.english_sentence: His business style is like 'Tanka woman picking clams'—he jumps on any profitable opportunity.

mandarin_meaning: 蜑家话（蜑家人的语言/方言）
english_meaning: Tanka language / the dialect spoken by the Tanka (boat people)
explanation_mandarin: 指蜑家（即傳統以船為生的水上人群）所使用的語言或方言，主要分佈於中國南方沿海地區，如廣東、香港一帶。在某些語境下也可泛指與漁民、水上社群有關的土語或方言用語。
explanation_english: Refers to the language or dialect used by the Tanka (boat people), a traditional water-dwelling community mainly along the southern Chinese coast (e.g., Guangdong and Hong Kong). In some contexts it can be used more generally for vernacular speech associated with fishing or boat communities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲老朋友有啲係蜑家人，會講蜑家話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 lou5 pang4 jau5 jau5 di1 hai6 daan6 gaa1 jan4, wui5 gong2 daan6 gaa1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的老朋友中有一些是蜑家人，會說蜑家話。
examples.english_sentence: Some of his longtime friends are Tanka people and can speak the Tanka dialect.

cantonese: 蜑家雞 - 見水唔得飲
jyutping: daan6 gaa1 gai1 — gin3 seoi2 m4 dak1 jam2
mandarin_meaning: 可望而不可及；近在咫尺卻得不到
english_meaning: So close yet so far; within sight but cannot obtain; tantalizingly out of reach
explanation_mandarin: 比喻明明接近某種資源或機會，卻因條件或身份等原因無法享用或取得，帶有無奈和惋惜的意味。
explanation_english: A proverb used to describe being close to something (a resource, opportunity, or desire) but unable to attain or enjoy it, conveying frustration or regret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明住喺碼頭，日日見到海但唔可以游水，真係蜑家雞——見水唔得飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 zyu6 hai2 maa5 tau4, jat6 jat6 gin3 dou3 hoi2 daan6 m4 ho2 ji5 jau4 seoi2, zan1 hai6 daan6 gaa1 gai1 — gin3 seoi2 m4 dak1 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明住在碼頭，每天看到大海卻不能游泳，真是可望而不可及。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming lives on the pier; he sees the sea every day but can't swim — truly so close yet so far.

mandarin_meaning: 如魚得水／在熟悉的環境中表現得很自在或得心應手
english_meaning: to be in one's element; to feel comfortable and perform well in a familiar environment
explanation_mandarin: 「蜑家」指以海上生活為業的船民，整句用來比喻人一到熟悉或擅長的環境就變得很自在、精力充沛或做事得心應手。出處不甚確定，多為口語慣用說法。
explanation_english: Literally referencing the Tanka (boat people), the phrase metaphorically describes someone who becomes very comfortable, energetic, or adept when they are in a familiar or suitable environment. It is a colloquial idiom and its exact origin is uncertain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明一去海邊就蜑家雞見水，做嘢特別有精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 jat1 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 zau6 daan6 gaa1 gai1 gin3 seoi2, zou6 je5 dak6 bit6 jau5 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明一到海边就如鱼得水，做事特别有精神。
examples.english_sentence: Whenever Ah Ming goes to the seaside he is in his element and much more energetic.

mandarin_meaning: （俗語/方言）如魚得水；在熟悉或擅長的環境中表現得很自在、出色
english_meaning: an idiom meaning to be in one's element; to perform well and feel at ease in a familiar or suitable environment
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語/慣用語（比喻性短語，可作謂語或定語）
explanation_mandarin: 字面上是指蜑家（以船為生的漁民）家的雞見到水，借喻人在熟悉或合適的環境中變得活躍、得心應手。此語屬口語或地區性用法，常用於形容人在某種情境下表現突出。
explanation_english: Literally 'a Tanka family's chicken sees water' — a regional/colloquial metaphor meaning someone becomes lively, confident, or does very well when placed in a familiar or suitable environment. Used to describe being 'in one's element.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一返去做海上嘅生意即刻舒服，真係蜑家鷄見水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 faan1 heoi3 zou6 hoi2 soeng6 ge3 saang1 ji3 zik1 haak1 syu1 fuk6, zan1 hai6 daan6 gaa1 gai1 gin3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一回到做海上的生意就立刻得心應手，真是蜑家雞見水。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he returns to maritime business he’s immediately comfortable — truly in his element.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽係水上項目，佢就好掂，簡直蜑家鷄見水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 hai6 seoi2 soeng6 hong6 muk6, keoi5 zau6 hou2 dim6, gaan2zik6 daan6 gaa1 gai1 gin3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽是水上項目，他很拿手，簡直是蜑家雞見水。
examples.english_sentence: The competition is a water event — he’s excellent at it, practically in his element.

mandarin_meaning: 多用于“蜿蜒”，表示延伸且曲折
english_meaning: used mainly in the compound '蜿蜒', meaning winding or meandering
explanation_mandarin: 漢字“蜒”本身較少單獨使用，常見於詞語“蜿蜒”，用來描述事物延伸且彎曲、曲折的狀態，如山路或河流。
explanation_english: The character 蜒 is rarely used alone and commonly appears in the compound 蜿蜒, describing something that extends in a winding or meandering manner (e.g., a road or river).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條山路蜿蜒，行落去要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 saan1 lou6 waan4 jin4, hang4 lok6 heoi3 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山路蜿蜒，走下去要小心一些。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain path winds on; be careful when walking down.

mandarin_meaning: 蜻蜓（昆虫），通常作为'蜻蜓'一词的字形成分
english_meaning: dragonfly (insect); commonly appears as part of the compound '蜻蜓'
explanation_mandarin: 單獨的'蜓'字較少單獨使用，常見於複合詞'蜻蜓'，指一種翅膀較長、善飛行的昆蟲。
explanation_english: '蜓' by itself is rarely used alone in speech, and is most commonly seen in the compound '蜻蜓' referring to the insect dragonfly, which has long wings and agile flight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園度有好多蜻蜓飛嚟飛去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 cing1 ting4 fei1 lai4 fei1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里有很多蜻蜓飞来飞去。
examples.english_sentence: There are many dragonflies flying around in the park.

mandarin_meaning: 蜕（蛻）：脫落、蜕皮；引申為轉變、蛻變
english_meaning: to shed (skin); to molt; to cast off; to transform or undergo a change
explanation_mandarin: 通常指動物脫去皮或外殼（如蛇蜕皮），也可用作比喻，表示轉變、蛻變或擺脫舊有狀態。
explanation_english: Usually refers to an animal shedding its skin or shell (e.g., a snake molting). It can also be used figuratively to mean transforming, changing, or shedding an old state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條蛇啱啱蜕咗皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 se4 aam1 aam1 teoi3 zo2 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條蛇剛剛蜕皮了。
examples.english_sentence: The snake just shed its skin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想要蜕變，重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jiu3 teoi3 bin3, cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想要蜕變，重新開始。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to transform and start anew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過呢段時間，我慢慢蜕變，唔同以前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 ni1 dyun6 si4 gaan3, ngo5 maan6 maan6 teoi3 bin3, m4 tung4 ji5 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過這段時間，我慢慢蜕變，不同以前。
examples.english_sentence: After this period, I've slowly changed and am different from before.

mandarin_meaning: 蛻變（拼音：tuìbiàn）；指形態或性質的重大改變或轉變。
english_meaning: metamorphosis; transformation — a profound change in form, nature, or character; to undergo a major change.
explanation_mandarin: 指生物或事物形態、性質發生根本性的改變；也常用作比喻，表示經歷重大轉折或改變。
explanation_english: Refers to a fundamental change in form or nature (e.g., biological metamorphosis); often used metaphorically to describe a major personal, organizational, or societal transformation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市喺過去十年有好大嘅蜕變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 hai2 gwo3 heoi3 sap6 nin4 jau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 teoi3 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個城市在過去十年經歷了巨大的蛻變。
examples.english_sentence: This city has undergone a major transformation over the past ten years.

mandarin_meaning: 蜘蛛（常與「蛛」組成），一種節肢動物。
english_meaning: Spider (character usually appears in the compound 蜘蛛).
explanation_mandarin: 「蜘」字本身較少單獨使用，通常與「蛛」組成「蜘蛛」，指會吐絲捕食昆蟲的節肢動物。
explanation_english: The character 蜘 is seldom used alone. It commonly appears in the compound 蜘蛛, meaning spider — an arachnid that often uses silk to catch prey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱底有隻小蜘蛛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 dai2 jau5 zek3 siu2 zi1 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子底下有一只小蜘蛛。
examples.english_sentence: There's a small spider under the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「蜘」通常唔會單獨用，會同「蛛」一齊組成「蜘蛛」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 tung1 soeng4 m4 wui5 daan1 duk6 jung6, wui5 tung4 zyu1 jat1 cai4 zou2 sing4 zi1 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「蜘」通常不會單獨使用，會和「蛛」一起組成「蜘蛛」。
examples.english_sentence: '蜘' is usually not used alone; it combines with '蛛' to form '蜘蛛' (spider).

mandarin_meaning: 蜘蛛 (zhīzhū)
english_meaning: spider
explanation_mandarin: 指一類節肢動物，通常有八條腿，能吐絲結網捕捉昆蟲，也常用於比喻狡猾或布下圈套的人或組織。
explanation_english: Refers to arachnids that typically have eight legs and spin silk to make webs for catching insects; also used metaphorically for someone or an organization that sets traps or schemes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 房間個角落有隻蜘蛛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong4 gaan1 go3 gok3 lok6 jau5 zek3 zi1 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房間的角落有一隻蜘蛛。
examples.english_sentence: There's a spider in the corner of the room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好驚蜘蛛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 geng1 zi1 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很怕蜘蛛。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very afraid of spiders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 窗邊有隻蜘蛛結咗個網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng1 bin1 jau5 zek3 zi1 zyu1 git3 zo2 go3 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 窗邊有一隻蜘蛛結了一張網。
examples.english_sentence: There is a spider that has spun a web by the window.

mandarin_meaning: 飞；飞行；常用于合成词，如“蜚声”、“蜚短流长”，引申为传播、流言或声名
english_meaning: to fly; (literary/component in compounds) to spread, gossip, or fame (as in 'to become famous')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 名词（多见于合成词中）
partOfSpeech_english: verb / noun (mainly used as part of compounds)
explanation_mandarin: “蜚”本义为飞翔，也用作词素出现在诸如“蜚声”“蜚短流长”等词语中，表示传播、流言或声名。
explanation_english: Originally means to fly. Commonly appears as a morpheme in compounds (e.g., '蜚声', '蜚短流长') to convey spreading, gossip, or renown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺人背後蜚短流長，講啲冇根據嘅嘢好傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 jan4 bui3 hau6 fei1 dyun2 lau4 coeng4, gong2 di1 mou5 gan1 geoi3 ge3 je5 hou2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在人背后蜚短流长，說些沒有根據的話會很傷人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spread gossip about people behind their backs; saying baseless things can really hurt them.

mandarin_meaning: 声名远扬；出名
english_meaning: to become famous; to gain a wide reputation
explanation_mandarin: 表示聲名傳播很廣、廣為人知，常用於書面或正式語境，形容人在某領域或在更大範圍內出名。
explanation_english: Indicates gaining wide renown or becoming well known; often used in formal or written contexts to describe someone becoming famous in a field or on a larger scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢憑呢套電影喺國際上蜚聲，變成家喻戶曉嘅導演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 hai2 gwok3 zai3 soeng6 fei1 sing1, bin3 sing4 gaa1 jyu6 wu6 hiu2 ge3 dou6 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他凭这部电影在国际上声名鹊起，成为家喻户晓的导演。
examples.english_sentence: He gained international fame with this film and became a household-name director.

mandarin_meaning: 蜚聲國際 / 在國際上聞名
english_meaning: to become internationally renowned; to gain fame worldwide
explanation_mandarin: 表示名聲傳到國際上，被國際社會所知曉、讚譽或重視。
explanation_english: A phrase meaning that someone's or something's reputation has spread internationally and is known or acclaimed across countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個品牌好快就蜚聲國際，喺好多國家都有分店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 paai4 paan2 hou2 faai3 zau6 fei1 sing1 gwok3 zai3, hai2 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 jau5 fan1 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個品牌很快就蜚聲國際，在很多國家都有分店。
examples.english_sentence: This brand quickly became known internationally and now has branches in many countries.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜；蜂蜜；糖漿
english_meaning: honey; sweet syrup
explanation_mandarin: 指蜜蜂採集並製成的甜物質（蜂蜜），亦可泛指甜的糖漿或用於構成複合詞（如蜂蜜、蜜糖）。
explanation_english: Refers to the sweet substance produced by bees (honey); can also refer more generally to sweet syrups or be used in compound words (e.g., honey, syrup).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢樽蜂蜜好甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zeon1 fung1 mat6 hou2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這瓶蜂蜜很甜。
examples.english_sentence: This jar of honey is very sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜月 (mìyuè)：新婚夫妻結婚後的旅行；比喻事物初期的和諧、融洽時期
english_meaning: honeymoon; honeymoon period (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 指新婚夫婦結婚後為慶祝婚姻而進行的旅行或度假；也常用來比喻事物開始階段的和諧、順利時期（蜜月期）。
explanation_english: Refers to a trip or vacation taken by newlyweds to celebrate their marriage; also used figuratively to describe an initial period of harmony or goodwill (the 'honeymoon period').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋下個禮拜去日本度蜜月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 dou6 mat6 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们下个礼拜去日本度蜜月。
examples.english_sentence: They're going to Japan for their honeymoon next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家仲處於蜜月期，大家合作愉快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 zung6 cyu5 jyu1 mat6 jyut6 kei4, daai6 gaa1 hap6 zok3 jyu4 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司目前还处于蜜月期，大家合作得很愉快。
examples.english_sentence: The company is still in its honeymoon period; everyone is cooperating happily.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜月期 (mìyuèqī)
english_meaning: honeymoon period; an initial phase after a change (relationship, new job, policy, etc.) when things are especially positive or tolerant
explanation_mandarin: 指開始階段的一段時間，常用來形容婚後或剛開始的關係／職位／政策等，大家態度較寬容或氣氛較熱絡、和諧的時期。
explanation_english: Refers to an initial period after a beginning (e.g., marriage, a new job, a new policy) during which people are especially positive, tolerant, or affectionate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新公司入職嗰陣，通常會有一段蜜月期，大家對你會比較包容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 gung1 si1 jap6 zik1 go2 zan6, tung1 soeng4 wui5 jau5 jat1 dyun6 mat6 jyut6 kei4, daai6 gaa1 deoi3 nei5 wui5 bei2 gou3 baau1 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在新公司入職時，通常會有一段蜜月期，大家對你會比較包容。
examples.english_sentence: When starting at a new company there's usually a honeymoon period where colleagues are more tolerant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋而家仲係蜜月期，成日好甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 mat6 jyut6 kei4, sing4 jat6 hou2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們現在還處於蜜月期，經常很甜蜜。
examples.english_sentence: They're still in their honeymoon period and are often very affectionate.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜柑（柑橘類水果，類似橘子／蜜橘）
english_meaning: mandarin orange / tangerine (Japanese 'mikan')
explanation_mandarin: 一種小型、果肉多汁且偏甜的柑橘類水果。日語稱為「みかん」，在冬季常見並常被食用。
explanation_english: A small, sweet, juicy citrus fruit (a mandarin/tangerine). Known as 'mikan' in Japanese and commonly eaten in winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲蜜柑，放喺雪櫃入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 mat6 gam1, fong3 hai2 syut3 gwai6 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了些蜜柑，放在冰箱裡面。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some mikan (mandarin oranges) and put them in the fridge.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜枣（用糖或蜂蜜蜜渍的枣）
english_meaning: candied jujube; honeyed jujube
explanation_mandarin: 蜜棗是將棗以糖、蜂蜜等蜜漬處理後的甜果，常用於糖水、藥膳、甜點或作零食，也可入藥潤喉補氣。
explanation_english: Jujubes preserved in sugar or honey — a sweet preserved fruit commonly used in sweet soups, medicinal dishes, desserts, or as a snack; also used in traditional remedies to soothe the throat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗蜜棗糖水可以幫助潤喉，冬天飲最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 mat6 zou2 tong4 seoi2 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 jeon6 hau4, dung1 tin1 jam2 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這碗蜜棗糖水可以幫助潤喉，冬天喝最好。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of candied jujube sweet soup can soothe the throat; it's best to drink it in winter.

mandarin_meaning: （网络用语）令人费解、莫名其妙
english_meaning: Internet slang meaning inexplicable/odd/strangely amusing
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 网络用语，副词/形容词性用法
explanation_mandarin: “蜜汁”字面是“蜂蜜汁”，在网络和口语中用作形容词或副词，表示某事或某人令人费解、莫名其妙、诡异或有点奇怪，常带调侃或无奈的语气。
explanation_english: Literally ‘honey sauce’. In internet/colloquial use it’s a slang adjective/adverb meaning something is inexplicable, oddly strange, or amusingly weird. Often used sarcastically or to express bafflement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日講嘢好蜜汁，大家都唔知佢想講咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 gong2 je5 hou2 mat6 zap1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 gong2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天说话很蜜汁，大家都不明白他想说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He was being kind of weird in what he said today; nobody could tell what he meant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件新衫嘅設計有啲蜜汁，但又幾有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 san1 saam1 ge3 cit3 gai3 jau5 di1 mat6 zap1, daan6 jau6 gei2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件新衫的设计有点蜜汁，但又挺有型。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this new shirt is kind of strange, but actually pretty cool.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜瓜（mìguā）— 一种甜的瓜类水果，果肉多汁，常见于超市和水果摊
english_meaning: honeydew melon (a sweet, juicy type of melon)
explanation_mandarin: 蜜瓜是一種甜的瓜類水果，果肉多汁。廣東話裡的「蜜瓜」通常指可直接食用的甜瓜類，如蜜瓜或一般甜瓜品種。
explanation_english: A sweet, juicy melon commonly eaten fresh. In Cantonese, '蜜瓜' refers to the edible sweet melon (honeydew or similar varieties).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一個蜜瓜，今晚切嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 mat6 gwaa1, gam1 maan5 cit3 lei4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个蜜瓜，今晚切来吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a honeydew melon; I'll cut it up to eat tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蜜瓜好甜，好多汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mat6 gwaa1 hou2 tim4, hou2 do1 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蜜瓜很甜，很多汁。
examples.english_sentence: This honeydew is very sweet and juicy.

mandarin_meaning: 蜂蜜；也可比喻為甜美或討好人的話/手段
english_meaning: honey (literal); metaphorically, sweetness or flattery/coaxing
explanation_mandarin: 指蜜蜂採集花蜜後製成的甜物質；在口語或比喻中也可用來形容甜美或用來討好、哄人的方式。
explanation_english: Refers to the sweet substance produced by bees from nectar. Colloquially or metaphorically, it can describe sweetness or methods of flattering/coaxing someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢樽蜜糖係本地出產，好純正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zun1 mat6 tong4 hai6 bun2 dei6 ceot1 caan2, hou2 seon4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這瓶蜜糖是本地出產，非常純正。
examples.english_sentence: This jar of honey is locally produced and very pure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意喺多士上抹蜜糖，當早餐食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 do1 si6 soeng6 mut6 mat6 tong4, dong3 zou2 caan1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡把蜜糖抹在吐司上當作早餐吃。
examples.english_sentence: I like to spread honey on toast for breakfast.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜糖罐；比喻甜蜜的處境或關係（如蜜月期）；有時亦可諷刺指表面甜美但可能隱藏限制或陷阱
english_meaning: honeypot / 'honey-jar' — a sweet, pleasant situation or the honeymoon stage of a relationship; sometimes used ironically for something that appears attractive but may hide conditions or a trap
explanation_mandarin: 「蜜糖埕」是廣東話口語或俚語，字面是蜜糖的罐子，常用來形容一段關係或環境非常甜蜜、令人舒服（類似「蜜月期」）。在某些語境下帶有諷刺意味，指表面看來很吸引但實際可能有條件限制或陷阱。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term literally meaning 'honey jar.' It describes a very sweet, pleasant situation or the honeymoon stage of a relationship. In some contexts it is used ironically to warn that something attractive on the surface may hide conditions or a trap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段新戀情令佢好似喺蜜糖埕咁，日日都好甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 san1 lyun2 cing4 ling6 keoi5 hou2 ci5 hai6 mat6 tong4 cang4 gam2, jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這段新戀情讓他好像處於蜜糖罐裡一樣，每天都很甜蜜。
examples.english_sentence: This new relationship has him in the honeymoon stage — every day is sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工啲福利睇落好吸引，但小心可能係蜜糖埕，簽咗先知有好多限制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 di1 fuk1 lei6 tai2 lok6 hou2 kap1 jan5, daan6 siu2 sam1 ho2 nang4 hai6 mat6 tong4 cang4, cim1 zo2 sin1 zi1 jau5 hou2 do1 haan6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份工作的福利看起來很吸引，但要小心可能是個蜜糖埕，簽約後才會發現有很多限制。
examples.english_sentence: The job's perks look attractive, but beware — it might be a honeypot; you'll only find the many conditions after signing.

mandarin_meaning: 蜂蜜水；（香港粤语）比喻接受好处、特权或贿赂
english_meaning: honey water (water sweetened with honey); (Hong Kong Cantonese slang) metaphorically, receiving favors, perks, or bribes
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指用蜂蜜兑水的饮料。口语中，尤指香港粤语里，“饮/收/食蜜糖水”可引申为享受甜头、得到好處或受賄。
explanation_english: Literally a beverage made by dissolving honey in water. Colloquially in Hong Kong Cantonese, expressions like 'drink/receive honey water' can figuratively mean enjoying benefits, perks, or taking bribes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家好口渴，想飲杯蜜糖水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 hau2 hot3, soeng2 jam2 bui1 mat6 tong4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在很口渴，想喝一杯蜂蜜水。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really thirsty right now; I'd like a cup of honey water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有傳媒話幾位官員被揭發收受蜜糖水，件事引起公眾憤怒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 cyun4 mei6 waa6 gei2 wai2 gun1 jyun4 bei6 gik6 faat3 sau1 sau6 mat6 tong4 seoi2, gin6 si6 jan5 hei2 gung1 zung3 fan5 nou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有媒体报道几位官员被揭发收受“蜜糖水”，此事引起公众愤怒。
examples.english_sentence: Media reported that several officials were exposed for accepting 'honey water' (bribes), and the incident sparked public outrage.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜糖豆（指蜜糖或糖衣包裹的小豆狀糖果或蜜餞；在口語中有時作愛稱，用來稱呼甜美可愛的人）
english_meaning: honey-coated beans / sugar-coated bean-shaped candy; (colloquially) a sweet/sweetheart (affectionate nickname)
explanation_mandarin: 原指一種以蜜糖或糖衣包裹的小豆狀糖果或蜜餞，屬於食品名稱。在口語或情感表達中，有時會把「蜜糖豆」當作愛稱，用來形容某人甜美、可愛或討人喜歡。
explanation_english: Primarily a food term referring to small bean-shaped candies or preserved beans coated with honey or sugar. Colloquially it can be used as a term of endearment to describe someone sweet or cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一包蜜糖豆，放喺屋企當零食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 baau1 mat6 tong4 dau6, fong3 hai2 uk1 kei5 dong1 ling4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一包蜜糖豆，放在家裡當零食。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bag of honey-coated beans and keep them at home as a snack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係我嘅蜜糖豆，成日都令我開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 mat6 tong4 dau6, sing4 jat6 dou1 ling6 ngo5 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真的是我的蜜糖豆，總是讓我很開心。
examples.english_sentence: You're really my honey bean — you always make me happy.

mandarin_meaning: （英語）Miss 的音譯，常用作品牌名或非正式稱呼
english_meaning: A transliteration of the English title 'Miss'; often used in brand names or informal address
explanation_mandarin: 「蜜絲」源自英語 Miss 的音譯，在粵語或書面用法中多見於化妝品、服飾等品牌名稱，或作非正式稱呼。寫法上有時亦見作「密斯」。
explanation_english: Derived from the English title 'Miss' as a phonetic borrowing. In Cantonese it is commonly seen in brand names (especially cosmetics/fashion) or as an informal form of address. It is sometimes written as "密斯".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個牌子叫蜜絲，佢哋嘅護膚品幾受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 paai4 zi2 giu3 mat6 si1, keoi5 dei6 ge3 wu6 fu1 ban2 gei2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个牌子叫“蜜丝”，他们的护肤品很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: This brand is called 'Miss'; their skincare products are quite popular.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜蜂 (mìfēng)
english_meaning: bee; honeybee
explanation_mandarin: 一种会采蜜并有螫针的昆虫，常作为授粉者并能产蜜。通常指会群居、采集花蜜的蜂类。
explanation_english: An insect that collects nectar and produces honey; typically has a sting and lives in colonies. Bees are important pollinators and include honeybees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 花園入面有好多蜜蜂，記住唔好打擾佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 mat6 fung1, gei3 zyu6 m4 hou2 daa2 jiu2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 花园里有很多蜜蜂，记住不要打扰它们。
examples.english_sentence: There are many bees in the garden; remember not to disturb them.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜蜂築巢的地方（蜂窩）；口語或俚語用法可引申為人多、熱鬧的地方或像蜂窩般的痘、膿腫群
english_meaning: beehive (literally); colloquially/slang: a place buzzing with activity/crowds, or a cluster of pimples/boils resembling a hive
explanation_mandarin: 直譯為蜜蜂的巢穴。香港粵語中此詞屬較口語或罕見用法，除字面意思外，常被比喻用來形容熱鬧擁擠的場所，或形容臉上/皮膚上成簇的痘痘、膿包像蜂窩一樣。
explanation_english: Literally the place where bees build a nest. In Hong Kong Cantonese this is a more colloquial/rare term; besides the literal meaning it can be used metaphorically to describe a crowded, bustling place or a cluster of pimples/boils that looks like a hive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個市集成日咁多人，好似一個蜜蜂竇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 si5 zaap6 sing4 jat6 gam2 do1 jan4, hou2 ci5 jat1 go3 mat6 fung1 dau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个集市常常这么多人，像一个蜜蜂巢。
examples.english_sentence: That market is always so crowded, like a beehive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面上起咗幾個痘，成個樣似蜜蜂竇，幾難睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 soeng6 hei2 zo2 gei2 go3 dau3, sing4 go3 joeng6 ci5 mat6 fung1 dau6, gei2 naan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他脸上长了好几个痘，整张脸像蜜蜂窝，有点难看。
examples.english_sentence: He has several pimples on his face; the whole thing looks like a beehive and it's pretty ugly.

mandarin_meaning: 蜂蜡；（珠宝行话）指色泽像蜜色的琥珀
english_meaning: beeswax; (in jewelry trade) amber with a honey-like color
explanation_mandarin: 指蜜蜂分泌的天然蠟，用於製作蠟燭、拋光劑、皮革護理等；在珠寶行話中，顏色像蜂蜜的琥珀有時也被稱為蜜蠟或蜜色琥珀。
explanation_english: Refers to beeswax, a natural wax produced by honeybees used for making candles, polishes, leather care, etc.; in the jewelry trade, amber with a honey-like color is sometimes referred to as '蜜蠟' or 'honey amber'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢串蜜蠟手串係佢喺緬甸買返嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 cyun4 mat6laap6 sau2 cyun4 hai6 keoi5 hai2 min5 din1 maai5 faan1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这串蜜蜡手串是她在缅甸买回来的。
examples.english_sentence: This amber bracelet was bought by her in Myanmar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用蜜蠟整咗支蠟燭，燃燒得好穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 mat6laap6 zing2 zo2 zi1 laap6 zuk1, jin4 siu1 dak1 hou2 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用蜂蜡做了根蜡烛，燃烧得很稳定。
examples.english_sentence: I used beeswax to make a candle; it burns very steadily.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜運 / 蜜月期、戀愛運勢好
english_meaning: honeymoon period; a streak of good luck in love; being in a sweet phase of a relationship
explanation_mandarin: 指戀愛或婚姻中甜蜜幸福的階段，或指感情運勢好、容易遇到好感情的時期。有時亦用作口語俗稱。
explanation_english: Refers to the sweet, happy phase in a romantic relationship (the honeymoon period) or a period of good luck in love. Often used colloquially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啱啱結婚，家陣仲喺蜜運期，日日都好甜蜜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 git3 fan1, gaa1 zan6 zung6 hai2 mat6 wan6 kei4, jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 tim4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们刚结婚，现在还处于蜜月期，每天都很甜蜜。
examples.english_sentence: They just got married and are still in their honeymoon period; every day is very sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 蜜饯（用糖、鹽或其他方法醃製或糖漬的果品）
english_meaning: preserved/candied fruit; sugared or salted preserved fruit
explanation_mandarin: 蜜餞是將水果用糖、鹽或其他方式醃漬或熬製而成的甜或鹹的保存食品，常作零食或佐料。
explanation_english: Preserved fruit made by curing or candying fruit with sugar, honey, salt, or other methods; a traditional snack or condiment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食蜜餞，尤其係梅味嗰啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 mat6 zin3, jau4 kei4 hai6 mui4 mei6 go2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡吃蜜餞，尤其是梅子味的那些。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating preserved (candied) fruit, especially the plum-flavored ones.

mandarin_meaning: 小虫；幼虫（罕用字）
english_meaning: a small insect; larva (rare/archaic character)
explanation_mandarin: 「蜞」為罕見字，常見於古籍或方言記錄，通常指小昆蟲或幼蟲，現代口語中不常使用。
explanation_english: Rare character used to refer to a small insect or larva; mainly found in archaic texts or dialect records and not common in modern speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺花盆見到一隻細蜞，應該係幼蟲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 faa1 pun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 sai3 kei4, jing1 goi1 hai6 jau6 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在花盆里看到一只小虫，应该是幼虫。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a small worm in the flower pot; it was probably a larva.

mandarin_meaning: 惡毒/刻薄的女人（貶義，俚語）
english_meaning: a nasty/vicious woman (derogatory, slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「蜞乸」是粵語俚語，帶有貶義，用來形容性格惡毒、刻薄或讓人討厭的女性。通常用作罵人的稱呼，語氣粗俗，不禮貌。
explanation_english: “蜞乸” is Cantonese slang, derogatory, used to describe a woman who is nasty, mean, or malicious. It is an insulting colloquial term and considered rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係個蜞乸，成日鬧人，冇好脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 kei4 naa5, seng4 jat6 naau6 jan4, mou5 hou2 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真是個惡毒的女人，整天罵人，脾氣很差。
examples.english_sentence: She's such a nasty woman, always yelling at people and has a terrible temper.

mandarin_meaning: 蚱蜢（昆蟲）
english_meaning: grasshopper
explanation_mandarin: 指蚱蜢這類會跳躍的昆蟲，常見於田野和草地，也常在粵語口語中作蚱蜢的簡稱。
explanation_english: Refers to a grasshopper (an insect that jumps), commonly found in fields and grasslands; in Cantonese it is often used as a short form for 蚱蜢.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候我成日喺田度捉蜢玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 ngo5 sing4 jat6 hai2 tin4 dou6 zuk1 mang2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我经常在田里抓蚱蜢玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child I often caught grasshoppers in the fields to play with.

mandarin_meaning: 蜥蜴（爬行動物）
english_meaning: lizard
explanation_mandarin: 指一類爬行動物，常見於複合詞如「蜥蜴」。單字「蜥」通常與「蜴」合用表示蜥蜴。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of reptile — a lizard. The character '蜥' is commonly used in the compound '蜥蜴' (lizard).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺公園見到一隻蜥蜴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 sik1 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在公園看到一隻蜥蜴。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a lizard in the park.

mandarin_meaning: 蜥蜴 (xīyì)
english_meaning: lizard
explanation_mandarin: 一種爬行動物，屬於有鱗目的動物，通常有尾巴並喜歡在溫暖環境中活動。
explanation_english: A reptile (lizard), typically scaly with a tail, belonging to the order Squamata and often found in warm environments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺屋企嘅後園見到一隻蜥蜴，佢好快就溜走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2 ge3 hau6 jyun4 gin3 dou6 jat1 zek3 sik1 jik6, keoi5 hou2 faai3 zau6 lau1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在家後院看到一只蜥蜴，它很快就跑走了。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a lizard in my backyard; it ran away quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 蜥蜴（爬行動物）
english_meaning: lizard (a reptile)
explanation_mandarin: 指一種爬行動物——蜥蜴。常與「蜥」字合用成「蜥蜴」。
explanation_english: Refers to a lizard, a type of reptile. Frequently appears together with the character 蜥 to form 蜥蜴.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺窗台見到一隻蜴，嚇親我一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 coeng1toi4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 jik6, haak3 can1 ngo5 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在窗台看到一只蜥蜴，嚇了我一跳。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a lizard on the windowsill and it startled me.

mandarin_meaning: 蜷缩；弯曲或收缩身体（如蜷成一团）
english_meaning: to curl up; to crouch or hunch the body into a curled position
