examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲街客經過，見到我哋表演就停低睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 gaai1 haak3 ging1 gwo3, gin3 dou2 ngo5 dei6 biu2 jin2 zau6 ting4 dai1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些路人在经过时看到我们表演就停下来观看。
examples.english_sentence: Some passers-by stopped to watch our performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係我朋友，就係街客一個，唔好理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 ngo5 pang4 jau5, zau6 hai6 gaai1 haak3 jat1 go3, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是我的朋友，只是个路人，别理他。
examples.english_sentence: He's not my friend, just a passer-by — don't pay attention to him.

mandarin_meaning: 菜市场 / 市场
english_meaning: wet market; public market (for fresh produce, meat, seafood, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指出售蔬菜、肉类、海鲜等生鲜食品的传统有顶或露天市场，香港常用称呼。
explanation_english: A traditional market where fresh produce, meat, and seafood are sold; commonly used in Hong Kong to refer to the public/wet market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我星期日會去街市買菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 kei4 jat6 wui5 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期日會去菜市場買菜。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to the wet market on Sunday to buy groceries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間街市好乾淨，好多人都鍾意去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gaai1 si5 hou2 gon1 zang6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家菜市場很乾淨，很多人都喜歡去。
examples.english_sentence: This market is very clean; many people like to go there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街市嘅魚檔今日特價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 si5 ge3 jyu4 dong3 gam1 jat6 dak6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菜市場的魚檔今天特價。
examples.english_sentence: The fish stall at the market has a special price today.

mandarin_meaning: 菜市場出身的人；小販；市井小民
english_meaning: Literally 'market boy' — a person from the wet market; a hawker/vendor or an ordinary, streetwise/common person
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，原指在街市工作或在街市長大的人；也可泛指市井、樸實、街頭機靈的人。視語境可帶親暱或輕微貶義。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial term originally for someone who works at or grew up around the wet market; can mean a hawker/vendor or an ordinary, streetwise person. Depending on context it can be affectionate or mildly derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個喺街市度幫手賣嘢，係個街市仔嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 hai2 gaai1 si5 dou6 bong1 sau2 maai6 je5, hai6 go3 gaai1 si5 zai2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候在菜市場幫忙賣東西，是個「街市仔」（即菜市場出身的人）。
examples.english_sentence: He used to help sell goods at the wet market as a kid — he's a 'gaai si zai' (someone from the market).

mandarin_meaning: 街拍（街头摄影）
english_meaning: street photography / street-style (fashion) photography; street snaps
explanation_mandarin: 指在街上拍攝的照片，常指以展示潮流穿搭為主的街頭時尚照片，也可泛指紀實性的街頭攝影作品。
explanation_english: Refers to photos taken on the street; commonly denotes street-style fashion photos showing people’s outfits, but can also refer more generally to documentary street photography.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意睇街拍，學下啲潮人點樣配搭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai2 gaai1 paak3, hok6 haa5 di1 ciu4 jan4 dim2 joeng6 pui3 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢看街拍，学学潮人怎么搭配。
examples.english_sentence: I like looking at street-style photos to learn how trendy people match their outfits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時裝雜誌成日有好多街拍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 zong1 zaap6 zi3 sing4 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 gaai1 paak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时装杂志经常有很多街拍。
examples.english_sentence: Fashion magazines often have lots of street-style shots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做攝影師，成日喺街頭做街拍，拍到好多生動嘅人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 sip3 jing2 si1, sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 tau4 zou6 gaai1 paak3, paak3 dou3 hou2 do1 saang1 dung6 ge3 jan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是摄影师，经常在街头做街拍，拍到很多生动的人物。
examples.english_sentence: He's a photographer who often does street shoots, capturing many lively people.

mandarin_meaning: 街頭招攬／街頭拉客（在街上招徠客人、派傳單或招募人員）
english_meaning: street solicitation / street recruitment (soliciting customers or recruits on the street)
explanation_mandarin: 「街招」是粵語俗語，指在街上招攬客人、派傳單、拉客或招募人手的行為，常見於推銷、直銷或傳銷等活動。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, "街招" refers to solicitation on the street — attracting customers, handing out flyers, or recruiting people in public spaces, commonly seen in sales, direct selling, or pyramid-scheme activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近街上好多人街招，賣緊啲保健品同美容療程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gaai1 soeng6 hou2 do1 jan4 gaai1 ziu1, maai6 gan2 di1 bou2 gin6 ban2 tung4 mei5 jung4 liu4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近街上很多人在街頭拉客，賣保健品和美容療程。
examples.english_sentence: Lately there are many people soliciting on the streets, selling health products and beauty treatments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人街招，結果畀佢拉入一個傳銷組織。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 gaai1 ziu1, git3 gwo2 bei2 keoi5 laai1 jap6 jat1 go3 cyun4 siu1 zou2 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街上被人拉攏，結果被拉進了一個傳銷組織。
examples.english_sentence: He was solicited on the street and ended up being drawn into a pyramid-selling organization.

mandarin_meaning: （粤语口语）人情账、欠款或未结清的往来；也可指算旧账、算账
english_meaning: Cantonese slang for informal accounts between people (debts/favors owed) or to settle a score/repay what is owed
explanation_mandarin: 「街數」是廣東話的俗語，通常指朋友或熟人之間未結清的人情、欠款或帳目；作動詞時可表示要跟人算舊帳、清算債務或討回欠款，語境上有時帶威脅或強硬意味。
explanation_english: “街數” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang term referring to informal accounts between people — favors, debts, or obligations that haven't been settled. As a verb it can mean to settle a score or demand repayment, and in some contexts it carries an aggressive or confrontational tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲有我嘅街數未還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 jau5 ngo5 ge3 gaai1 sou3 mei6 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你還沒還我欠的帳。
examples.english_sentence: You still haven't paid back what you owe me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔還街數，可能會惹麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 waan4 gaai1 sou3, ho2 nang4 wui5 je5 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不還帳，可能會惹來麻煩。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't settle your debts, you might get into trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要算街數，大家要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 syun3 gaai1 sou3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說要跟人算舊帳，大家要小心。
examples.english_sentence: He says he wants to settle old scores; everyone should be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 街头斗殴
english_meaning: street fight; brawl
explanation_mandarin: 指在街上或公共場所發生的打鬥或鬥毆，通常為多人或公開的衝突。
explanation_english: Refers to a fight or brawl that happens on the street or in public places, often involving multiple people and public confrontation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚喺街度發生咗一場街斗，好多人受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 maan5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 faat3 sang1 zo2 jat1 coeng4 gaai1 dau3, hou2 do1 jan4 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚街上发生了一场街头斗殴，很多人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: A street fight broke out last night and many people were injured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺酒吧門口街斗，警察即刻嚟到制止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 zau2 baa1 mun4 hau2 gaai1 dau3, ging2 caat3 zik1 hak1 lai4 dou3 zai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在酒吧门口街头打斗，警察立刻赶到制止。
examples.english_sentence: They were fighting outside the bar; the police arrived immediately to stop it.

mandarin_meaning: 街景（jiējǐng）
english_meaning: street scene; street view
explanation_mandarin: 指街道的景色或街道呈現的視覺景象；也可指街道的實景影像（如 Google 街景）。
explanation_english: Refers to the visual scenery of a street or street-level imagery; can also mean street-view images such as those on Google Street View.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街嘅街景好靚，啲舊樓同霓虹燈好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 ge3 gaai1 ging2 hou2 leng3, di1 gau6 lau4 tung4 nei4 hung4 dang1 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街的街景很漂亮，旧楼和霓虹灯很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: The street scene on this street is beautiful; the old buildings and neon lights are very distinctive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺 Google 街景度睇過呢度，知道點行會方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 Google gaai1 ging2 dou6 tai2 gwo3 ni1 dou6, zi1 dou3 dim2 haang4 wui5 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在 Google 街景上看过这里，知道怎么走会更方便。
examples.english_sentence: I saw this place on Google Street View and know how to get there more conveniently.

mandarin_meaning: 街機（街機遊戲／街機機台）
english_meaning: arcade machine; arcade game
explanation_mandarin: 指放在遊戲廳或商場內供多人投幣遊玩的電子遊戲機或機台；在廣東話中也常用來指街機遊戲本身或街機廳。
explanation_english: Refers to an arcade machine or cabinet — electronic games found in arcades or game halls. In Cantonese it can also refer to arcade games in general or the arcade venue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日去街機廳打街機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 heoi3 gaai1 gei1 teng1 daa2 gaai1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候經常去遊戲廳打街機。
examples.english_sentence: I used to go to arcades to play arcade games when I was a kid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家街機唔似以前咁多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gaai1 gei1 m4 ci5 ji5 cin4 gam3 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在街機不像以前那麼多人了。
examples.english_sentence: Arcades aren't as crowded as they used to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部街機係90年代嘅經典。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gaai1 gei1 hai6 gau2 ling4 nin4 doi6 ge3 ging1 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這台街機是90年代的經典。
examples.english_sentence: This arcade machine is a classic from the 1990s.

mandarin_meaning: 路段；街道的一段
english_meaning: a stretch/section of street; a segment of a road or neighborhood area
explanation_mandarin: 指街道的一段或某一段路，有時用來描述該段的環境或狀況（例如繁忙、安靜等）。
explanation_english: Refers to a section or stretch of a street/road; often used to describe the characteristics or condition of that stretch (e.g., busy, quiet).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街段成日好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 dyun6 sing4 jat6 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段街经常有很多人。
examples.english_sentence: This stretch of street is always crowded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺邊條街段見到佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 bin1 tiu4 gaai1 dyun6 gin3 dou2 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在哪一段街看到他？
examples.english_sentence: Which part of the street did you see him?

mandarin_meaning: 短程擺渡、小型渡船（通常載行人往返短距離水道）
english_meaning: a short-distance ferry or shuttle boat (usually carries pedestrians across a short water crossing)
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語中常指在河灣或岸邊之間提供短程運輸的小型擺渡或渡船，也可泛指短距離往返的擺渡服務。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, refers to a short-distance ferry or shuttle boat that carries people across a stretch of water; can also mean the shuttle service itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搭街渡去對岸，幾分鐘就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daap3 gaai1 dou6 heoi3 deoi3 ngon6, gei2 fan1 zung1 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們搭街渡去對岸，幾分鐘就到。
examples.english_sentence: We took the street ferry to the opposite shore; it only took a few minutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝大風，啲街渡都停咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 daai6 fung1, di1 gaai1 dou6 dou1 ting4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上下大風，街渡都停了。
examples.english_sentence: There was strong wind this morning, and the ferries were all suspended.

mandarin_meaning: 街灯 / 路灯
english_meaning: street lamp; streetlight
explanation_mandarin: 指設置在街道上的照明裝置，用於夜間照明並保障行人與車輛的安全。
explanation_english: Refers to lamps installed along streets to provide lighting at night and help ensure pedestrian and traffic safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚街燈一開，條街就光晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 gaai1 dang1 jat1 hoi1, tiu4 gaai1 zau6 gwong1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜里街灯一亮，整条街就亮了。
examples.english_sentence: When the streetlights turn on at night, the whole street lights up.

mandarin_meaning: 路牌／街道标牌
english_meaning: street sign; road sign; street name plate
explanation_mandarin: 指安裝在街道上用以顯示街名、方向或其他路況資訊的牌子，即路牌或街名牌。
explanation_english: A sign installed on streets that displays the street name, directions, or other road information (i.e., a street/road sign).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下嗰個街牌寫住邊條街？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 go2 go3 gaai1 paai4 se2 zyu6 bin1 tiu4 gaai1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看那个街牌写着哪条街？
examples.english_sentence: Check that street sign to see which street it is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會換新嘅街牌，因為舊咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 wun6 san1 ge3 gaai1 paai4, jan1 wai6 gau6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府会更换新的街牌，因为旧了。
examples.english_sentence: The government will replace the street signs because they're old.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲街牌冇清楚標示，司機好容易行錯路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gaai1 paai4 mou5 cing1 co2 biu1 si6, si1 gei1 hou2 jung4 ji6 hang4 co3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些街牌没有清楚标示，司机很容易走错路。
examples.english_sentence: The street signs are not clearly marked, so drivers can easily take the wrong turn.

mandarin_meaning: 一種俚語，指喜歡出街、在公共場合出風頭或渴望外出社交的習性／傾向
english_meaning: A slang term describing a tendency to go out frequently and seek attention in public; the restless urge to go out and socialize (literally 'street syndrome').
explanation_mandarin: 「街症」多用於粵語口語，形容一個人特別喜歡出街、愛在街上出風頭或在外面社交，尤其在長時間不能外出後常出現的渴望或習慣性行為。
explanation_english: Used in Cantonese slang to describe someone who loves going out, showing off in public, or craving social outings—often used when people feel restless after being unable to go out for a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日好有街症，好鍾意去街上出風頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hou2 jau5 gaai1 zing3, hou2 zung1 ji3 heoi3 gaai1 soeng5 ceot1 fung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常有「街症」，很喜歡在街上出風頭。
examples.english_sentence: He often has 'street syndrome'—he likes to show off in public/on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 停咗一段時間無得出街，大家而家開始發街症，成日想出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting4 zo2 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 mou5 dak1 ceot1 gaai1, daai6 gaa1 ji4 gaa1 hoi1 ci2 faat3 gaai1 zing3, seng4 jat6 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 停了一段時間不能外出，大家現在開始發街症，總是想出門。
examples.english_sentence: After being unable to go out for a while, everyone is starting to get 'street syndrome'—constantly wanting to go out.

mandarin_meaning: 街知巷闻（广为人知）
english_meaning: widely known; the talk of the town
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某事或某人的名聲或消息在街坊巷弄間廣為流傳，人人皆知。
explanation_english: Used to describe something or someone whose reputation or news is widely circulated among the public and known by everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事已經街知巷聞，冇必要再講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 gaai1 zi1 hong6 man4, mou5 bit1 jiu3 zoi3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事已经街知巷闻，没必要再说了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is already widely known; there's no need to say more.

mandarin_meaning: 街頭臨時攤位或宣傳站（常用於派傳單、宣傳或競選活動）
english_meaning: street booth / street stall / campaigning booth (a temporary booth on the street used for promotion, handing out flyers, or political campaigning)
explanation_mandarin: 指在街道上設立的臨時攤位或站點，用來派發宣傳資料、與路人接觸或進行籌款、競選等活動。在香港語境中常見於政黨或團體的宣傳活動。
explanation_english: Refers to a temporary booth or stall set up on the street used to distribute promotional materials, contact passersby, fundraise, or carry out campaigning. In the Hong Kong context it is often used by political parties or groups for outreach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺地鐵站外面擺咗個街站，派宣傳單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 ngoi6 min6 baai2 zo2 go3 gaai1zaam6, paai3 syun3cyun4 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在地鐵站外面擺了個街站，派宣傳單。
examples.english_sentence: We set up a street booth outside the MTR station to hand out flyers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選舉嗰陣，街站係黨派接觸選民嘅重要渠道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 geoi2 go2 zan6, gaai1zaam6 hai6 dong2 paai3 zip3 zuk1 syun2 man4 ge3 zung6 jiu3 keoi4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 選舉期間，街站是政黨接觸選民的重要渠道。
examples.english_sentence: During elections, street booths are an important channel for parties to reach voters.

mandarin_meaning: 街童（街头小孩、在街上游荡或以街头为主要活动场所的儿童）
english_meaning: street child; street urchin (a child who lives on or spends much time on the streets)
explanation_mandarin: 指無家可歸或長時間在街上遊蕩、以街頭為主要活動或生活場所的兒童。在香港口語中也可泛指成天在街上閒逛或打混的年輕小孩或少年。
explanation_english: Refers to a child who has no stable home or who spends much of their time on the streets; a street child or street urchin. In Hong Kong colloquial usage it can also broadly refer to youngsters who hang around on the streets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從細就係街童，日日喺街度流連，無固定寓所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 sai3 zau6 hai6 gaai1 tung4, jat6 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 lau4 lin4, mou5 guk6 ding6 jyu6 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他從小就是街童，天天在街上遊蕩，沒有固定住處。
examples.english_sentence: He has been a street child since he was young, wandering the streets every day with no fixed place to live.

mandarin_meaning: 街頭賣淫者；街頭性工作者（俚語）
english_meaning: streetwalker; a prostitute who solicits on the street (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「街簿」為粵語俚語，指在街頭招攬生意或從事性交易的人，含貶義或口語色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term referring to a person who solicits sexual services on the street (a streetwalker). It is colloquial and can be derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚嗰條街有幾個街簿喺度搵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 go2 tiu4 gaai1 jau5 gei2 go3 gaai1 bou2 hai2 dou6 wan2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上那條街有幾個街頭賣淫者在那裡賺錢。
examples.english_sentence: There are a few streetwalkers making money on that street at night.

mandarin_meaning: 街头传闻；街头消息（俚语）
english_meaning: word on the street; street rumor; street-level connections (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港廣東話口語中，「街綫」常用作俚語，指在街頭流傳的消息或小道消息，有時也泛指街頭圈子或人際關係網絡。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "街綫" is a slang noun meaning rumors or word-on-the-street; it can also refer more broadly to street-level social contacts or networks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事係街綫傳開㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 gaai1 sin3 cyun4 hoi1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事是街头传闻，已经传开了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is word on the street; it's already spread around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信街綫，最好問當事人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 gaai1 sin3, zeoi3 hou2 man6 dong1 si6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信街头传闻，最好问当事人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust the word on the street; better ask the person involved.

mandarin_meaning: 露宿街頭；流落街頭（俚語）
english_meaning: to become homeless; to end up living on the streets (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「街線」是香港粵語俚語，用來形容一個人失去住所或經濟來源，可能要露宿街頭或流落街頭的情況。可作動詞（變得街線）或名詞（過著街線生活）。
explanation_english: “街線” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang describing someone who has lost housing or income and may end up sleeping on the streets. It can be used as a verb (to become homeless) or as a noun (a street-living situation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢舖頭收鋪，差啲就要街線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pou3 tau2 sau1 pou3, caa1 di1 zau6 jiu3 gaai1 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的店鋪倒閉，差點就要露宿街頭。
examples.english_sentence: His shop closed; he almost became homeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家街線住，好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 gaai1 sin3 zyu6, hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在露宿街頭，很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He's living on the streets now and it's very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果再搵唔到工，佢好快會街線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 wan2 m4 dou2 gung1, keoi5 hou2 faai3 wui5 gaai1 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果再找不到工作，他很快會變得流落街頭。
examples.english_sentence: If he doesn't find a job soon, he'll end up on the streets.

mandarin_meaning: 不詳（罕見字，可能是寫錯或方言變體；可能指「街舖」「行街」等）
english_meaning: Unknown / rare term (likely a misspelling or dialectal variant; possibly intended to mean 'street stall/shop' or 'hanging out on the street')
partOfSpeech_english: unknown (rare/nonstandard; likely noun or verb depending on intended word)
explanation_mandarin: 「街艔」並非標準或常見的粵語詞彙，現存資料極少。很可能是寫錯字或地方口語用字，常見的替代詞包括「街舖」（街上的小店/檔口）或「行街/逛街」（到街上逛、閒蕩）。
explanation_english: “街艔” is not a standard or commonly attested Cantonese term and appears to be extremely rare. It is likely a misspelling or a dialectal/archaic variant. Possible intended meanings include 'street stall/shop' (街舖) or the action 'to go hang out/shop on the street' (行街 / 逛街).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇聽過「街艔」？我喺字典都搵唔到，估計係寫錯「街舖」或者係方言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 teng1 gwo3 'gaai1[?]'? ngo5 hai2 zi6 din2 dou1 wan2 m4 dou3, gu2 gai3 hai6 se2 co3 'gaai1 pou3' waa6 ze2 hai6 fong1 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有聽過「街艔」？我在字典也找不到，估計是寫錯「街舖」或者是方言。
examples.english_sentence: Have you heard of '街艔'? I can't find it in dictionaries — I suspect it's a misspelling of '街舖' (street stall) or a dialectal term.

mandarin_meaning: 街头采访 / 街头访问
english_meaning: street interview; vox pop; man-on-the-street interview
explanation_mandarin: 指在街头对路人进行简短采访或询问，常见于新闻报道或街头节目，用来收集公众意见或反应。
explanation_english: An interview conducted on the street with passersby (vox pop). Common in news reports and programs to gather public opinions or reactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台喺街頭做街訪，問市民對交通擠塞嘅睇法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 hai2 gaai1 tau4 zou6 gaai1 fong2, man6 si5 man4 deoi3 gaau1 tung1 zai1 sak1 ge3 tai2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視台在街頭做了街訪，詢問市民對交通擁擠的看法。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station did a street interview, asking citizens their views on traffic congestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋想做個街訪，會去問下唔同嘅人對新政策有冇意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 zou6 go3 gaai1 fong2, wui5 heoi3 man6 haa5 m4 tung4 ge3 jan4 deoi3 san1 zing3 caak3 jau5 mou5 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們想做一個街訪，會去問不同的人對新政策是否有意見。
examples.english_sentence: We want to do a street interview; we'll ask different people whether they have opinions on the new policy.

mandarin_meaning: 街谈巷议（街头巷尾的议论、闲谈，常指流言蜚语）
english_meaning: public gossip; widespread talk or speculation in the streets; rumors circulated among people
explanation_mandarin: 指街头巷尾流传的议论或闲谈，通常含有流言蜚语、议论纷纷之意，常用于形容舆论或民间非正式的讨论。
explanation_english: Refers to talk and discussion heard in the streets and alleys; public gossip or widespread speculation, often implying rumors and idle talk. Used to describe informal public opinion or chatter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近公司有好多變動，街談巷議唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gung1 si1 jau5 hou2 do1 bin3 dung6, gaai1 taam4 hong6 ji5 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近公司有很多變動，街谈巷议不断。
examples.english_sentence: There have been many changes at the company recently, and gossip is nonstop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府一公布新政策，街談巷議即刻多咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jat1 gung1 bou3 san1 zing3 caak3, gaai1 taam4 hong6 ji5 zik1 hak1 do1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府一公布新政策，街谈巷议立刻增多。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the government announced the new policy, gossip spread immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 街頭妓女；（貶義）指性工作者或被視為輕浮的女子
english_meaning: streetwalker; prostitute; derogatory term for a woman perceived as promiscuous or a sex worker
explanation_mandarin: 「街貨」是香港粵語俚語，字面為「街上的貨品」。通常作貶義，指在街上拉客的性工作者或被視為放蕩、不檢點的女性，屬侮辱性用語。
explanation_english: 'Gai fo' is Hong Kong Cantonese slang literally meaning 'street goods'. It is usually derogatory and refers to street prostitutes or women considered promiscuous; it is an insulting term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用街貨嚟罵人，太冇禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 gaai1 fo3 lai4 maa6 jan4, taai3 mou5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用「街貨」來罵人，太沒禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call people 'gai fo' (street trash); it's very rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲街貨喺街口拉客，差人都知道佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 gaai1 fo3 hai2 gaai1 hau2 laai1 haak3, caa1 jan4 dou1 zi1 dou3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些街貨在街口拉客，警察也知道她們。
examples.english_sentence: Those 'streetwalkers' are soliciting at the street corner; the cops know about them.

mandarin_meaning: 街头车辆；（口语）街头小推车、流动摊车
english_meaning: street vehicle; (colloquial) street cart / vendor's pushcart
explanation_mandarin: “街車”字面上指在街上的車輛；在口語中常用來指街頭的小推車或流動攤車，也可泛指路邊活動的車輛。用法較口語化，視語境可指販賣用的手推車或其他街頭移動車輛。
explanation_english: Literally a vehicle on the street. Colloquially it often refers to a street cart or vendor's pushcart, and can more generally mean any street-side/mobile vehicle. Usage is informal and context-dependent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲街車喺市集擺緊嘢賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gaai1 ce1 hai2 si5 zaap6 baai2 gan2 je5 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些街头的小推车在市集摆东西卖。
examples.english_sentence: Those street carts are selling items at the market.

mandarin_meaning: 街道（街/道路；亦可指行政上的街道或街道办事处）
english_meaning: street; road; (administratively) subdistrict or street office jurisdiction
explanation_mandarin: 指城市中的道路或街区范围；在行政语境下也可指街道办事处及其管辖范围。
explanation_english: Refers to a street or road in a city, or the area around a street; in administrative contexts it can mean a subdistrict or the jurisdiction of a street office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街道好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街道很多人。
examples.english_sentence: This street has a lot of people.

mandarin_meaning: 街边 / 路边
english_meaning: street side; roadside; curb
explanation_mandarin: 表示街道的一侧或路旁的地方，常用作名词，指人或摊档所在的路边位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the side of a street or the roadside; a noun indicating a location beside a road where people, stalls, or vehicles may be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺街邊食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在街边吃东西。
examples.english_sentence: We are eating on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街邊有檔小食車，賣魚蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 bin1 jau5 dong3 siu2 sik6 ce1, maai6 jyu4 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街边有一辆小吃车，卖鱼蛋。
examples.english_sentence: There is a food cart on the street selling fish balls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車輛就嚟駛過，唔好企喺街邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1 loeng6 zau6 lai4 sai2 gwo3, m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 gaai1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车辆就要驶过，不要站在街边。
examples.english_sentence: Vehicles are coming, don't stand at the roadside.

mandarin_meaning: 街边小贩；在街上闲逛或游荡的人（口语）
english_meaning: street vendor; street kid/loiterer (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語詞，通常指在街邊擺攤賣東西的小販；也可泛指經常在街上閒逛、聚集的人，語氣可中性或帶有輕微貶義。
explanation_english: A colloquial term generally referring to a person who sells goods on the street (a street vendor). It can also refer more broadly to people who hang out or loiter on the streets; the term is informal and can carry a mildly derogatory tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個街邊仔喺地鐵站出口擺賣小食，生意幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gaai1 bin1 zai2 hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 ceot1 hau2 baai2 maai6 siu2 sik6, saang1 ji3 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個街邊小販在地鐵站出口擺攤賣小吃，生意不錯。
examples.english_sentence: That street vendor sets up a stall at the MTR exit selling snacks; business is quite good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 附近有幾個街邊仔，成晚喺行人路度坐低傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 gan6 jau5 gei2 go3 gaai1 bin1 zai2, sing4 maan5 hai2 hang4 jan4 lou6 dou6 co5 dai1 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 附近有幾個經常在街上閒逛的人，整晚坐在行人路上聊天。
examples.english_sentence: There are some street kids nearby who hang out on the sidewalk all night chatting.

mandarin_meaning: 街邊小吃 / 街頭小吃
english_meaning: street food; street snacks; roadside snacks
explanation_mandarin: 指在街頭或路邊販售、可即時食用的小吃，常見於夜市或路邊攤檔，如魚蛋、雞蛋仔、燒賣等，是香港及華人地區常見的街頭飲食文化。
explanation_english: Refers to snacks or small ready-to-eat foods sold on the street or roadside, commonly found at night markets and stalls (e.g., fish balls, egg waffles, siu mai). It is a common part of Hong Kong and Chinese street food culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意喺夜市試唔同嘅街邊小食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 hai2 je6 si5 si3 m4 tung4 ge3 gaai1 bin1 siu2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜歡在夜市嘗試不同的街邊小吃。
examples.english_sentence: I really like trying different street foods at the night market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅街邊小食好有特色，例如雞蛋仔同魚蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gaai1 bin1 siu2 sik6 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1, lai6 jyu4 gai1 daan6 zai2 tung4 jyu4 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的街邊小吃很有特色，例如雞蛋仔和魚蛋。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's street food is very distinctive, for example egg waffles and fish balls.

mandarin_meaning: 街边货；（俚语、贬义）指廉价、质量低劣的东西，或贬称某人（常指女性）廉价、放荡
english_meaning: street-stall goods; (slang, derogatory) cheap or low-quality goods; pejoratively used to call someone ('cheap' person, often implying a promiscuous/cheap woman)
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指街边小贩卖的廉价货物；引申为俚语，用来贬低事物品質或侮辱人（常指对女性的贬称）。
explanation_english: Literally goods sold at street stalls; figuratively a slang, derogatory term for cheap/low-quality items or a person (often used to insult, implying someone is promiscuous or 'cheap').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪賣嘅衫好多野都係街邊貨，質素唔好，唔好買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 maai6 ge3 saam1 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 gaai1 bin1 fo3, zat1 sou3 m4 hou2, m4 hou2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖的衣服很多都是街边货，质量不好，不要买。
examples.english_sentence: Many of the clothes sold in this shop are street-stall goods; the quality is poor—don't buy them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話人係街邊貨，講法好傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 jan4 hai6 gaai1 bin1 fo3, gong2 faat3 hou2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说别人是街边货，说法很伤人。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps calling people 'street trash'—that's very hurtful.

mandarin_meaning: 街上的時鐘；公共場所的時鐘
english_meaning: street clock; public clock
explanation_mandarin: 指安裝在街道或公共場所供路人看時間的時鐘。
explanation_english: A clock installed on a street or in public places for passersby to check the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個街鐘壞咗，唔知而家幾點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gaai1 zung1 waai6 zo2, m4 zi1 ji4 gaa1 gei2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個街上的時鐘壞了，不知道現在幾點。
examples.english_sentence: The street clock is broken; I don't know what time it is now.

mandarin_meaning: 店舖面向街道的卷閘或鐵閘（用來關上或保護店面的門閘）
english_meaning: shopfront metal/roller shutter (the gate used to close or secure a storefront facing the street)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語常用詞，指商店或舖位面向街道的卷閘或鐵閘，通常在開舖前或收舖後升降以保護或封閉店舖。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term for the metal or roller shutter installed at a shopfront facing the street; commonly raised or lowered before opening or after closing to secure the premises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間舖已經落咗街閘，唔好再去敲門啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 pou3 ji5 ging1 lok6 zo2 gaai1 zaap6, m4 hou2 zoi3 heoi3 haau1 mun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店已經把街閘拉上了，不要再去敲門了。
examples.english_sentence: That shop has already pulled down its street shutter; don't go knocking on the door again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺舖頭門口裝咗新嘅街閘，提高咗安全性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 pou3 tau4 mun4 hau2 zong1 zo2 san1 ge3 gaai1 zaap6, tai4 gou1 zo2 on1 cyun4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在店門口安裝了新的街閘，提高了安全性。
examples.english_sentence: They installed a new street shutter at the shop entrance, increasing security.

mandarin_meaning: 街头；街道；街上
english_meaning: street; the street; on the street; street scene
explanation_mandarin: 指城市或城镇中的街道、街头位置，或表示在街上发生的场景或活动。
explanation_english: Refers to a street or the area of a street; can denote the street itself or activities/scenes happening on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺街頭見到一個歌手唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 tau4 gin3 dou2 jat1 go3 go1 sau2 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在街头看到一个歌手在唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: We saw a singer singing on the street.

mandarin_meaning: 街頭小吃
english_meaning: street snacks; street food
explanation_mandarin: 指在街頭、夜市或攤檔販售的各種小吃，通常價格便宜、份量較小，適合邊走邊吃，是香港等地常見的街頭美食文化。
explanation_english: Refers to various snacks sold on the street, at night markets, or food stalls. They are typically inexpensive, served in small portions, and often eaten while walking. A common element of Hong Kong street food culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食街頭小食，尤其係魚蛋同車仔麵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 gaai1 tau4 siu2 sik6, jau4 kei4 hai6 jyu4 daan2 tung4 ce1 zai2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜歡吃街頭小吃，特別是魚蛋和車仔麵。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating street snacks, especially fish balls and cart noodles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜市裏有好多街頭小食，可以邊行邊食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 si5 leoi5 jau5 hou2 do1 gaai1 tau4 siu2 sik6, ho2 ji5 bin1 haang4 bin1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜市裡有很多街頭小吃，可以邊走邊吃。
examples.english_sentence: The night market has a lot of street snacks; you can eat while walking around.

mandarin_meaning: 街头巷尾（大街小巷，到处）
english_meaning: everywhere; all over town; in every street and alley
explanation_mandarin: 表示在大街小巷、處處；用來形容某事被廣泛談論或普遍存在。
explanation_english: Literally ‘streets and alleys’; used to mean ‘everywhere’ or ‘all over town’, often to say something is widely known or talked about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事而家喺街頭巷尾都講緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ji4 gaa1 hai6 gaai1 tau4 hong6 mei5 dou1 gong2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事现在街头巷尾都在谈论。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is now being talked about all over town.

mandarin_meaning: 衙门；官署，指古代官员办公或执法的地方
english_meaning: yamen; government office; magistrate's office (place where officials worked or administered law)
explanation_mandarin: 「衙」多見於合成詞，如衙門、衙署，指官員辦公或執法的場所，常用於描述古代或傳統的官署體制。
explanation_english: Used mainly in compounds (e.g., yamen 衙門, yashu 衙署) to denote a government office or magistrate's office where officials worked or enforced laws, especially in historical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代官員喺衙門度辦公，處理民間事務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 gun1 jyun4 hai2 ngaa4 mun4 dou6 baan6 gung1, cyu5 lei5 man4 gaan1 si6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代官员在衙门处理民间事务。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, officials handled civilian affairs at the yamen (government office).

mandarin_meaning: 衙门（官府、官署；亦可指官僚機構或政府部門）
english_meaning: yamen; government office or the office of a local official; (by extension) government agency or bureaucracy
explanation_mandarin: 指古代或近代地方官員辦公的衙署或官署，現代可泛指政府機構或官僚體制。
explanation_english: Refers to the office or administrative headquarters of a government official (historically in imperial China). In modern usage it can broadly mean a government office, agency, or the bureaucracy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊衙門而家改建成博物館，成日有人去參觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 aa4 mun4 ji4 gaa1 goi2 gin3 sing4 bok3 mat6 gun2, sing4 jat6 jau5 jan4 heoi3 caam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 舊衙門現在改建成博物館，經常有人去參觀。
examples.english_sentence: The old yamen has been converted into a museum, and people visit it all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民向衙門投訴噪音，但官衙拖延處理，大家好唔滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 hoeng3 aa4 mun4 tau4 sou3 zou6 jam1, daan6 gun1 aa4 to1 jin4 cyu3 lei5, daai6 gaa1 hou2 m4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民向衙門投訴噪音，但官衙拖延處理，大家很不滿意。
examples.english_sentence: Citizens complained to the authorities about the noise, but the officials delayed handling it, and everyone was very dissatisfied.

mandarin_meaning: （為「胡」的異體字）表示胡亂、無稽之談；亦見於地名詞“衚衕”（北京巷弄）
english_meaning: A variant of 胡 (hu); conveys ideas of 'nonsense' or 'random/irrational'; appears in compounds such as 衚說 (talk nonsense) and 衚衕 (hutong)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 詞素/構詞成分（在合成詞中可表示動詞或形容詞意義）
partOfSpeech_english: morpheme / element (used in compounds; functions like a verb/adjective in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 衚為「胡」的異體字，讀音與「胡」相近，單字在口語中罕用，多見於合成詞或書面、方言詞彙，如「衚說」（胡說，講廢話）或「衚衕」（北京的巷弄、胡同）。
explanation_english: 衚 is a variant form of 胡 and carries similar meanings. It is uncommon as a standalone word in everyday Cantonese and mainly appears in compounds or literary/dialectal terms, such as 衚說 (to speak nonsense) and 衚衕 (hutong, a narrow lane).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日衚說，唔好理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 wu4 syut3, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是胡說，別理他。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks nonsense; don't pay attention to him.

mandarin_meaning: 胡同
english_meaning: narrow alley or lane (especially traditional Beijing alley)
explanation_mandarin: 指狹窄的巷弄，尤指北京傳統的街巷，也可泛指小巷或弄堂。
explanation_english: A narrow alley or lane, commonly referring to traditional Beijing alleys (hutongs); can also refer generally to small lanes or alleys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日喺呢條衚衕度玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 hai2 ni1 tiu4 wu4-tung3 dou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候常在這條胡同裡玩。
examples.english_sentence: I used to play in this alley when I was a child.

mandarin_meaning: 卫 (wèi) — 守卫、保护；也用于复合词如“卫生”“卫星”，亦为姓氏
english_meaning: wèi / guard, defend, protect; used in compounds like '衛生' (hygiene) and '衛星' (satellite); also a surname
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「衛」表示守衛、保護的意思，常見於複合詞如「衛生」（衛護健康、清潔）、「衛星」，也可作為姓氏或指守衛的人。
explanation_english: The character '衛' denotes guarding or protecting. It commonly appears in compounds such as '衛生' (hygiene) and '衛星' (satellite), and can be a surname or refer to a guard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要注意衛生，經常洗手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 wai6 saang1, ging1 soeng4 sai2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要注意卫生，经常洗手。
examples.english_sentence: We should pay attention to hygiene and wash our hands frequently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰日城門有衛兵把守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 jat6 sing4 mun4 jau5 wai6 bing1 baa2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那天城门有卫兵把守。
examples.english_sentence: That day the city gate was guarded by soldiers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晚上可以見到衛星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan5 soeng6 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 wai6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上可以看到卫星。
examples.english_sentence: You can see satellites at night.

mandarin_meaning: 衛（卫）：保衛、守護；與衛生、有關保潔或防護的意思；也用於合成詞如「衛星」、「衛生」。
english_meaning: The character 衛 (wai6): to guard or defend; relates to hygiene/cleanliness or protection; appears in compounds like 'satellite' and 'hygiene'.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞/動詞/前綴（用於合成詞）
explanation_mandarin: 字義包含保衛、守護，另在現代漢語中常見於表示清潔、防護或守護概念的詞語（如「衛生」、「衛星」）。可做名詞、動詞，或作合成詞的構件。
explanation_english: The character denotes guarding or protecting. In modern usage it commonly appears in words related to hygiene or protection (e.g. '衛生' hygiene, '衛星' satellite). It can function as a noun, verb, or as part of compound words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間廁所好衛生，成日有人清潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ci3 so2 hou2 wai6 saang1, sing4 jat6 jau5 jan4 cing1 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个厕所很卫生，经常有人清洁。
examples.english_sentence: This toilet is very hygienic; it's cleaned regularly.

mandarin_meaning: 卫冕（在比赛中保住或再次夺得冠军、头衔）
english_meaning: to defend (a title); to retain a championship
explanation_mandarin: 指在比賽或競賽中保住或再次獲得某個頭銜或冠軍，特別是成功防守上一屆所獲得的冠軍。
explanation_english: To defend or retain a title or championship in a competition — especially by successfully holding onto a title won previously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上次贏咗冠軍，今次成功衛冕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 ci3 jing4 zo2 gun1 gwan1, gam1 ci3 sing4 gung1 wai6 min5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上次贏得冠軍，這次成功衛冕。
examples.english_sentence: He won the championship last time and successfully defended his title this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊要努力先可以衛冕聯賽冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi6 jiu3 nou5 lik6 sin1 ho2 ji5 wai6 min5 lyun4 coi3 gun1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球隊要努力才能衛冕聯賽冠軍。
examples.english_sentence: The team must work hard if they want to defend the league championship.

mandarin_meaning: 衛冕（保持冠軍或頭銜）
english_meaning: to defend (one's) title; to retain a championship/position
explanation_mandarin: 指在競賽、比賽或選舉等情況中，擊敗挑戰者以保持原有的頭銜或冠軍位置。
explanation_english: Refers to retaining a title or championship by defeating challengers in a competition, election, or similar contest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊成功衛冕，下年繼續挑戰新對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi6 sing4 gung1 wai6 min5, haa6 nin4 gai3 zuk6 tiu1 zin3 san1 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球隊成功衛冕，明年繼續挑戰新的對手。
examples.english_sentence: The team successfully defended their title and will continue to face new opponents next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位選手有望衛冕，但壓力好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai6 syun2 sau2 jau5 mong6 wai6 min5, daan6 ngaat3 lik6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位選手有望衛冕，但壓力很大。
examples.english_sentence: This athlete is expected to defend their title, but the pressure is intense.

mandarin_meaning: 衛星
english_meaning: satellite
explanation_mandarin: 繞行行星或行星繞行恆星的天體，包括天然衛星（如月球）或人造衛星（人為發射到軌道上的設備）。
explanation_english: A body that orbits a planet or that is placed into orbit around a planet; can refer to natural satellites (e.g., the Moon) or artificial satellites launched into orbit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 月球係地球嘅天然衛星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyut6 kau4 hai6 dei6 kau4 ge3 tin1 jin4 wai6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 月球是地球的天然衛星。
examples.english_sentence: The Moon is Earth's natural satellite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人造衛星已經進入軌道，準備開始傳送數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 zou6 wai6 sing1 ji5 ging1 zeon3 jap6 gwai2 dou6, zeon2 bei6 hoi1 ci2 cyun4 sung3 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這顆人造衛星已經進入軌道，準備開始傳送數據。
examples.english_sentence: This artificial satellite has entered orbit and is preparing to start transmitting data.

mandarin_meaning: 衛星（環繞行星或其他天體運行的天然或人造天體）
english_meaning: satellite (a natural or artificial body orbiting a planet or other body)
explanation_mandarin: 指環繞行星或其他天體運行的天然或人造天體，常用於通訊、導航、氣象觀測和科學研究等用途。
explanation_english: Refers to a natural or artificial body that orbits a planet or other body; commonly used for communications, navigation, weather observation, and scientific research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個國家發射咗一個衛星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 faat3 se3 zo2 jat1 go3 wai6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個國家發射了一顆衛星。
examples.english_sentence: This country launched a satellite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企用衛星電視睇外國台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 jung6 wai6 sing1 din6 si6 tai2 ngoi6 gwok3 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們家用衛星電視看外國的頻道。
examples.english_sentence: My family uses satellite TV to watch foreign channels.

mandarin_meaning: 卫生 (指清洁、无污染、利于健康的状态或习惯)
english_meaning: hygiene; sanitation; sanitary; cleanliness
explanation_mandarin: 表示清潔或衛生狀況，指個人、場所或習慣是否無污染、利於健康。可作名詞或形容詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to cleanliness or sanitary conditions—whether a person, place, or practice is free from dirt/germs and conducive to health. Can be used as a noun or an adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳好乾淨，衛生做得唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 gon1 zeng6, wai6 saang1 zou6 dak1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间餐厅很干净，卫生做得不错。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is very clean; its hygiene is handled well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完記得洗手，保持個人衛生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 gei3 dak1 sai2 sau2, bou2 ci4 go3 jan4 wai6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完记得洗手，保持个人卫生。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to wash your hands after eating and maintain personal hygiene.

mandarin_meaning: 衛生（指清潔、衛生條件及與健康相關的習慣）
english_meaning: hygiene; sanitation; cleanliness; sanitary
explanation_mandarin: 指保持乾淨、避免疾病傳播的措施或狀態，如個人衛生、公共衛生和環境衛生等。
explanation_english: Refers to cleanliness and measures to prevent disease transmission or maintain health, including personal hygiene, public sanitation, and environmental cleanliness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間廁所好衛生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ci3 so2 hou2 wai6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個廁所很衛生。
examples.english_sentence: This toilet is very hygienic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街返嚟記得洗手，注意個人衛生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 faan1 lai4 gei3 dak1 sai2 sau2, zyu3 ji3 go3 jan4 wai6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出去回來記得洗手，注意個人衛生。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to wash your hands when you come back; pay attention to personal hygiene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間工廠嘅衛生條件唔夠好，可能要改善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong4 ge3 wai6 saang1 tiu4 gin6 m4 gau3 hou2, ho2 nang4 jiu3 goi2 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間工廠的衛生條件不夠好，可能需要改善。
examples.english_sentence: The factory's sanitary conditions are not good and may need improvement.

mandarin_meaning: 卫生局（政府负责公共卫生、防疫与疾病控制的机构）
english_meaning: Department of Health; public health bureau (government agency responsible for public health, disease control, and related services)
explanation_mandarin: 指政府中負責公共衛生、疫苗接種、疾病防控和相關監管事務的機構，處理市民的衛生政策與公共健康事宜。
explanation_english: Refers to a government agency responsible for public health matters such as vaccination programs, disease control, health regulations, and other public-health services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以打電話去衛生局問下疫苗接種安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 daa2 din6 waa2 heoi3 wai6 saang1 guk6 man6 haa5 jik6 miu4 zip3 zung3 ngon1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以打電話去衛生局問一下疫苗接種安排。
examples.english_sentence: You can call the Department of Health to ask about vaccination arrangements.

mandarin_meaning: 卫生巾（女性在生理期用來吸收經血的一次性衛生用品）
english_meaning: sanitary napkin; menstrual pad (a disposable hygiene product used by women to absorb menstrual blood)
explanation_mandarin: 衛生巾是女性在月經期間使用的拋棄式衛生用品，用於吸收和保護衣物免受經血污染，市面上有不同吸收力、長短和款式（如夜用、日用、護翼等）。
explanation_english: A sanitary napkin (menstrual pad) is a disposable hygiene product used by people who menstruate to absorb menstrual blood and protect clothing. They come in different lengths, absorption levels, and styles (e.g., daytime, overnight, with wings).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱嚟經，冇帶衛生巾，好唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 lai4 ging1, mou5 daai3 wai6 saang1 gan1, hou2 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛開始來月經，沒帶衛生巾，很不方便。
examples.english_sentence: I just started my period and didn't bring a sanitary pad; it's really inconvenient.

mandarin_meaning: 卫生巾 / 月经巾 (wèishēngjīn / yuèjīngjīn)
english_meaning: sanitary napkin; sanitary pad
explanation_mandarin: 女性在生理期使用的吸收經血的衛生用品，通常為一次性或可換式墊片。
explanation_english: A feminine hygiene product used to absorb menstrual blood, typically a disposable or replaceable pad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇帶衛生巾？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 daai3 wai6 sang1 gan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有带卫生巾？
examples.english_sentence: Did you bring a sanitary pad?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市入面有衛生巾賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jap6 min6 jau5 wai6 sang1 gan1 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市里面有卫生巾卖。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket sells sanitary pads.

mandarin_meaning: 自慰 / 手淫
english_meaning: masturbation; to masturbate (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語粗俗俚語，指個人單獨以手或其他方式進行性刺激以達到性快感，即普通話的「自慰／手淫」。屬非正式、不雅用語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese vulgar slang term meaning to masturbate — self-stimulation to achieve sexual pleasure. It's informal and considered crude, not appropriate for formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺屋企打緊衛生麻雀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 uk1 kei5 daa2 gan2 wai6 saang1 maa4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她現在在家自慰／手淫。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is masturbating at home right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「衛生麻雀」係廣東話嘅粗俗俚語，唔適合喺正式場合用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 saang1 maa4 zoek3 hai6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 cou1 suk6 lei5 jyu5, m4 sik1 hap6 hai2 zing3 sik1 coeng4 hap6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「衛生麻雀」是廣東話的粗俗俚語，不適合在正式場合使用。
examples.english_sentence: "衛生麻雀" is a vulgar Cantonese slang term and is not appropriate for formal situations.

mandarin_meaning: 不賭錢的麻將（純為娛樂或社交）
english_meaning: mahjong played without gambling; casual/social mahjong (no money involved)
explanation_mandarin: 「衛生麻雀」是香港粵語俚語，字面上「衛生」指「乾淨、無問題」，實際用法指打麻將但不賭錢、只是為了娛樂或社交。常用以區別有賭注的麻將。*號有時用作標示俚語或俗語。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "衛生麻雀" (literally "hygiene mahjong") refers to playing mahjong without betting money — a casual, social game for fun rather than gambling. The term contrasts with games that involve stakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去我屋企打衛生麻雀得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 ngo5 uk1 kei5 daa2 wai6 sang1 maa4 zoek3 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去我家打衛生麻將可以嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can we go to my place tonight to play 'hygiene mahjong' (no-money mahjong)?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋只打衛生麻雀，唔准攞錢出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi2 daa2 wai6 sang1 maa4 zoek3, m4 zeon2 lo2 cin2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們只是打衛生麻將，不准拿錢出來。
examples.english_sentence: We're only playing casual mahjong—no money allowed.

mandarin_meaning: 卫衣（休闲上衣，通常指套头衫或连帽衫）
english_meaning: sweatshirt; hoodie (a casual pullover, often with a hood)
explanation_mandarin: 一种休闲上衣，通常由棉或抓绒等面料制成，有时带帽（称为连帽卫衣）。在粤语口语中，“衛衣”常用来指卫衣或连帽衫。
explanation_english: A casual pullover typically made from cotton or fleece; can refer to a sweatshirt or a hoodie if it has a hood. In Cantonese speech, '衛衣' commonly denotes a sweatshirt/hoodie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗件新衛衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gin6 san1 wai6 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一件新卫衣。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new sweatshirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣凍，記得著件衛衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 gin6 wai6 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气冷，记得穿件卫衣。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold today; remember to wear a sweatshirt.

mandarin_meaning: 冲 / 衝（冲、冲击、冲动）
english_meaning: to rush; to charge; to dash; (can mean) impulsive
explanation_mandarin: 表示快速向前或向外移動、衝刺或猛衝；在某些語境下也可表示衝動、魯莽行事。
explanation_english: Indicates moving or rushing forward/outward, charging or dashing; in some contexts it also conveys being impulsive or acting recklessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家要衝出去搭巴士，等陣再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 cung1 ceot1 heoi3 daap3 baa1 si2, dang2 zan6 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在要衝出去趕公車，等一下再談。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to rush out to catch the bus now; we'll talk later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一聽到火警，大家即刻衝出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 teng1 dou3 fo2 ging2, daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 cung1 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一聽到火警，大家立刻衝出來。
examples.english_sentence: When they heard the fire alarm, everyone rushed out immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁衝動，諗清楚先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6, nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要這麼衝動，先想清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive; think it through first.

mandarin_meaning: 冲刺（在最後階段集中力量努力達成目標；短距離快速衝刺）
english_meaning: to sprint; to make a final push or exert intense effort toward a goal (also a short fast dash in sports)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在最後階段集中力量、加緊努力以達到目標；在體育比賽中也指短距離的快速衝刺。
explanation_english: Indicates concentrating effort in a final stage to achieve a goal; in sports, it also refers to a short, fast sprint to the finish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試快到，呢幾日要衝刺溫習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 faai3 dou3, ni1 gei2 jat6 jiu3 cung1 ci3 wan1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试快到了，这几天要冲刺复习。
examples.english_sentence: Exams are coming soon; we need to make a final push in studying these few days.

mandarin_meaning: 冲力（推动力、冲击力、势头）
english_meaning: impetus; momentum; thrust; driving force; impact force
explanation_mandarin: 衝力可以指物理上的推动力或冲击力（如火箭的推力），也可用于比喻，表示推动事情前进或带来改变的动力或势头。
explanation_english: "Cung lik" refers to a physical force or thrust (e.g., the thrust of a rocket) and is also used metaphorically to mean an impetus, momentum, or driving force that pushes something forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃畀咗我好大嘅衝力，令我有動力繼續落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 bei2 zo2 ngo5 hou2 daai6 ge3 cung1 lik6, ling6 ngo5 jau5 dung6 lik6 gai3 zuk6 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划给了我很大的冲力，让我有动力继续下去。
examples.english_sentence: This project gave me great impetus, making me motivated to continue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火箭發射嘅時候會產生好大嘅衝力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 zin3 faat3 seot3 ge3 si4 hau6 wui5 caan2 sang1 hou2 daai6 ge3 cung1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火箭发射时会产生很大的冲力。
examples.english_sentence: Rockets generate huge thrust when launched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場勝利畀咗球隊一個好大嘅衝力，大家士氣上升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 sing3 lei6 bei2 zo2 kau4 deoi6 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 cung1 lik6, daai6 gaa1 si6 hei3 soeng5 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场胜利给球队带来了很大的冲力，大家士气上升。
examples.english_sentence: This victory gave the team a big boost; morale rose.

mandarin_meaning: 冲劲 / 干劲 / 劲头
english_meaning: momentum; drive; vigor; enthusiasm
explanation_mandarin: 表示做事或行动时的劲头、干劲和冲劲，常用于形容积极、有动力的状态，也可指一时的冲劲或气势。
explanation_english: Refers to the drive, momentum, or vigor someone has when doing something. It describes an energetic, motivated state and can also mean a burst of boldness or momentum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好有衝勁，成日都想試新嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 cung1 ging6, sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 si3 san1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很有冲劲，总想尝试新东西。
examples.english_sentence: He works with a lot of drive and is always eager to try new things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽入球之後，全隊有晒衝勁，士氣高昂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 jap6 kau4 zi1 hau6, cyun4 deoi6 jau5 saai3 cung1 ging6, si6 hei3 gou1 ong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛进球之后，全队都充满了冲劲，士气高昂。
examples.english_sentence: After the goal, the whole team was full of momentum and their morale soared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有衝勁係好，但冇計劃可能會走偏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 cung1 ging6 hai6 hou2, daan6 mou5 gai3 waak6 ho2 nang4 wui5 zau2 pin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有冲劲是好事，但没有计划可能会偏离方向。
examples.english_sentence: Having drive is good, but without a plan you might go off course.

mandarin_meaning: 冲动（chōngdòng）
english_meaning: impulse; impulsive; to act on impulse
explanation_mandarin: 指情緒或慾望突然強烈產生，導致不經深思就採取行動或做出反應。
explanation_english: Refers to a sudden strong urge or emotion that leads someone to act without careful thought.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好衝動，一時衝動就買咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 cung1 dung6, jat1 si4 cung1 dung6 zau6 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很冲动，一时冲动就买了很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's very impulsive; he bought a lot of things on a whim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好一時衝動做決定，諗清楚先好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jat1 si4 cung1 dung6 zou6 kyut3 ding6, lam2 cing1 co2 sin1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要一时冲动做决定，先想清楚再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make decisions on impulse; think it through first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為氣頭上衝動講咗啲嘢，事後好後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 hei3 tau4 soeng6 cung1 dung6 gong2 zo2 di1 je5, si6 hau6 hou2 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为气头上一时冲动说了些话，事后很后悔。
examples.english_sentence: He said things in the heat of the moment and regretted it afterward.

mandarin_meaning: 脱口而出；不经过思考就说出来
english_meaning: to blurt out; to say something impulsively without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 表示在没有经过深思熟虑的情况下把话说出来，常用于形容情绪激动时说出不该说或冒犯人的话。
explanation_english: Describes saying something without careful thought—often uttering inappropriate or offensive words when emotionally charged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時激動，衝口而出講咗啲唔應該講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1si4 gik1dung6, cung1 hau2 ji4 ceot1 gong2 zo2 di1 m4 jing1goi1 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时激动，脱口而出说了不该说的话。
examples.english_sentence: He got carried away and blurted out something he shouldn't have.

mandarin_meaning: 冲撞；碰撞；得罪、冒犯
english_meaning: to collide; to crash into; (figuratively) to offend or clash with someone/ something
explanation_mandarin: 「衝撞」可指物理上的碰撞、撞擊（如車輛或人相撞），也可引申為言行冒犯、觸怒或與…衝突、違背（如衝撞規則或感情）。
explanation_english: “衝撞” can mean a physical collision or crash (e.g., vehicles or people bumping), and figuratively it means to offend or provoke someone, or to clash with/rub against rules, opinions, or feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心同架車衝撞，車頭凹咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 tung4 gaa3 ce1 cung1 zong6, ce1 tau4 ngaau1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心撞到了一輛車，車頭凹了。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally collided with a car, and the front got dented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁直率講法會衝撞到佢，應該婉轉啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zik6 seot6 gong2 faat3 wui5 cung1 zong6 dou3 keoi5, jing1 goi1 jyun2 zyun2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣直接的說法會得罪他，應該委婉一點。
examples.english_sentence: Saying that so bluntly will offend him; you should be more tactful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個做法衝撞公司政策，唔可以咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 cung1 zong6 gung1 si1 zaak3 caak3, m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個做法衝突公司政策，不可以這樣做。
examples.english_sentence: This approach clashes with company policy; you can't do it this way.

mandarin_meaning: 冲击
english_meaning: impact; shock; to strike/attack
explanation_mandarin: 表示强烈的打击、冲撞或对心理、组织、系统等产生明显影响的作用；可作动词（冲击某物/某人）或名词（造成冲击）。
explanation_english: Refers to a strong strike, collision, or an event that produces a significant effect or shock on people, organizations, or systems; can be used as a verb (to impact/strike) or a noun (an impact).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個消息對公司嚟講係一個好大嘅衝擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 siu1si3 deoi3 gung1si1 lai4 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 cung1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个消息对公司来说是一个很大的冲击。
examples.english_sentence: This news is a big impact on the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震造成咗嚴重嘅衝擊，成千上萬嘅建築受損。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 zou6 coeng4 zo2 jim4 zung6 ge3 cung1 gik1, seng4 cin1 soeng6 maan6 ge3 gin3 zuk1 sau6 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震造成了严重的冲击，成千上万的建筑受损。
examples.english_sentence: The earthquake caused severe impact; thousands of buildings were damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方衝擊咗示威現場，雙方爆發推擠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 cung1 gik1 zo2 si6 wai1 jin6 coeng4, soeng1 fong1 baau3 faat3 teoi1 zai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方冲击了示威现场，双方爆发推挤。
examples.english_sentence: The police stormed the protest site, and both sides broke into pushing and shoving.

mandarin_meaning: 冲浪
english_meaning: surfing (riding waves); colloquially, surfing the internet / browsing online
explanation_mandarin: 冲浪指在海上乘浪进行的运动（使用冲浪板在海浪上滑行）。在口语中也可指在互联网上浏览信息、随意浏览网页（即“上网”）的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the sport of riding ocean waves on a surfboard. Colloquially it can also mean browsing the internet or casually surfing websites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我暑假去衝浪，學咗點樣保持平衡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 syu1 gaa3 heoi3 chung1 long6, hok6 zo2 dim2 joeng6 bou2 ci4 ping4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我暑假去冲浪，学会了如何保持平衡。
examples.english_sentence: I went surfing during summer vacation and learned how to maintain my balance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺社交媒體度衝浪，成晚都唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 dou6 chung1 long6, sing4 maan5 dou1 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在社交媒体上冲浪，整晚都停不下来。
examples.english_sentence: He often surfs social media and can't stop all evening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個星期六我哋去石澳衝浪，你有冇興趣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 luk6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sek6 ou3 chung1 long6, nei5 jau5 mou5 hing3 ceoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个星期六我们去石澳冲浪，你有兴趣吗？
examples.english_sentence: We're going surfing at Shek O next Saturday. Are you interested?

mandarin_meaning: 闯红灯
english_meaning: run a red light
explanation_mandarin: 指駕車、騎車或行人不遵守交通號誌，在紅燈時繼續通過路口的違規行為。也可引申為魯莽衝過某個障礙或規矩。
explanation_english: To pass through an intersection while the traffic light is red (disobeying traffic signals). It denotes an illegal traffic action and can be used figuratively for recklessly rushing past rules or obstacles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都衝燈，終於被警察截停咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 cung1 dang1, zung1 jyu1 bei2 ging2 caat3 zit3 ting4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常闖紅燈，終於被警察攔下了。
examples.english_sentence: He frequently runs red lights and was finally stopped by the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細心啲，唔好衝燈啦，前面有個行人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Sai3 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 cung1 dang1 laa1, cin4 min6 jau5 go3 haang4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心點，不要闖紅燈，前面有行人。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't run the red light — there's a pedestrian ahead.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）趕在紅燈變紅/變燈時衝過路口、闖紅燈；（引申）在最後一刻匆忙完成或衝刺
english_meaning: (literal) to dash through a traffic light at the tail end (risking running a red light); (figurative) to make a last-minute rush or sprint to finish something
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，原指駕駛時趕在燈變前衝過路口（有闖燈風險）；引申為在最後一刻急忙完成某事或最後衝刺。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term. Literally refers to dashing through an intersection at the tail end of the traffic light (risking running a red light). Figuratively it means doing a last-minute rush to finish something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好衝燈尾，會畀交警罰錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 cung1 dang1 mei5, wui5 bei2 gaau1 ging2 fat6 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要衝燈尾，會被交警罰款的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to dash through the light at the last moment; you'll get fined by the traffic police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日衝燈尾先交功課，搞到自己好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 cung1 dang1 mei5 sin1 gaau1 gung1 fo3, gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常最後一刻才交作業，把自己弄得很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: He always hands in assignments at the last minute, making himself very stressed.

mandarin_meaning: 冲破；突破
english_meaning: to break through; to burst through; to overcome (an obstacle or limit)
explanation_mandarin: 表示突破阻碍、界限或封锁，既可指物理上衝破，也可指抽象的突破（例如紀錄、限制、傳統等）。
explanation_english: Indicates breaking through an obstacle, boundary, or blockade. Can be used for physical breaking through or metaphorical breakthroughs (e.g., records, limits, traditions).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢衝破警方嘅封鎖逃走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1po3 ging2fong1 ge3 fung1so2 tou4zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他冲破了警方的封锁逃走。
examples.english_sentence: He broke through the police cordon and escaped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要衝破傳統嘅框框，先至可以創新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 jiu3 cung1po3 cyun4tung2 ge3 kwaang1kwaang1 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 cong3san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要冲破传统的框架，才能创新。
examples.english_sentence: The company must break through traditional frameworks in order to innovate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次銷售額衝破咗去年嘅紀錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1ci3 siu1sau6 ngok6 cung1po3 zo2 heoi3nin4 ge3 gei2luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次销售额冲破了去年的纪录。
examples.english_sentence: This time the sales figures broke through last year's record.

mandarin_meaning: 冲突 (chōngtú)
english_meaning: conflict; clash; collision
explanation_mandarin: 表示雙方在意見、利益或行動上的對立或不一致；也可指物理上的碰撞。
explanation_english: Indicates opposition or disagreement between parties in opinions, interests, or actions; can also refer to a physical collision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個部門喺會議入面發生衝突，搞到大家都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 bou6 mun4 hai2 wui6 ji5 jap6 min6 faat3 sang1 cung1 dat6, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩個部門在會議中發生了衝突，讓大家都不高興。
examples.english_sentence: The two departments had a conflict during the meeting, making everyone unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為利益嘅衝突而爭執。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 lei6 jik6 ge3 cung1 dat6 ji4 zang1 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們因為利益衝突而爭執。
examples.english_sentence: They argued because of a conflict of interests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車同單車喺十字路口發生衝突，警察到場調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1 tung4 daan1 ce1 hai2 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2 faat3 sang1 cung1 dat6, ging2 caat3 dou3 coeng4 tiu4 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 車和自行車在十字路口發生了碰撞，警方到場調查。
examples.english_sentence: A car and a bicycle collided at the intersection; police arrived to investigate.

mandarin_meaning: 闯红灯
english_meaning: to run a red light
explanation_mandarin: 表示駕駛者或行人無視紅燈信號，直接通過路口，通常是違法且危險的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to a driver or pedestrian passing through an intersection when the traffic light is red; generally illegal and dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好衝紅燈，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 cung1 hung4 dang1, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別闖紅燈，很危險的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't run the red light, it's very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為衝紅燈被罰咗五百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 cung1 hung4 dang1 bei6 fat6 zo2 ng5 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為闖紅燈被罰了五百塊。
examples.english_sentence: He got fined $500 for running a red light.

mandarin_meaning: 冲线（冲过终点线）；（比喻）在最后关头完成或达成目标
english_meaning: to cross the finish line; (figurative) to make a final push to finish or achieve a goal
explanation_mandarin: 原指在比赛中冲过终点线，常用于体育比赛；引申为在最后关头冲刺、赶工或通过最后努力达到目标或完成任务。
explanation_english: Originally refers to crossing the finish line in a race; figuratively used to mean making a final push, rushing to complete something, or achieving a goal at the last moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最後一刻衝線，贏咗比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 hak1 cung1 sin3, jing4 zo2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在最后一刻冲线，赢了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He crossed the finish line at the last moment and won the race.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月業績唔夠，要衝線先至可以達標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 jip6 zik1 m4 gau3, jiu3 cung1 sin3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 daat6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月业绩不够，要冲线才能达标。
examples.english_sentence: This month's results are short; we need a final push to meet the target.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕工衝線，通宵做到早上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 gung1 cung1 sin3, tung1 siu1 zou6 dou3 zou2 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶工冲线，通宵做到早上。
examples.english_sentence: I rushed to finish the work, working through the night until morning.

mandarin_meaning: 冲量（指通过促销、刷流量等手段快速提高曝光、点击量或销量）
english_meaning: to boost traffic/metrics or ramp up sales (often by promotion or artificial means)
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，指為了短期內提高曝光、點擊或銷量而採取的行動，如做促銷、投放廣告或刷流量，有時帶有短期或非自然增長的含義。
explanation_english: A colloquial term meaning to rapidly increase exposure, clicks, or sales—by promotions, advertising, or inflating metrics (e.g., via click farms). It often implies short-term or artificial growth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月要衝量，做多啲廣告同限時優惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 jiu3 cung1 loeng6, zou6 do1 di1 gwong2 gao3 tung4 haan6 si4 jau6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月要冲量，多做广告和限时优惠。
examples.english_sentence: This month we need to boost our numbers—run more ads and limited-time offers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係用水軍衝量，質量同口碑都好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 jung6 seoi2 gwan1 cung1 loeng6, zat1 loeng6 tung4 hau2 bei1 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是用水军冲量，质量和口碑都很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just use click farms to boost metrics; quality and reputation are important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲主播會喺夜晚時間衝量，試下吸引多啲觀眾睇直播。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zyu2 bo3 wui5 hai2 je6 maan5 si4 gaan1 cung1 loeng6, si3 haa5 kap1 jan5 do1 di1 gun1 zung3 tai2 zik6 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 主播会在夜间冲量，试着吸引更多观众看直播。
examples.english_sentence: Streamers might try to boost numbers at night to attract more viewers to their live streams.

mandarin_meaning: 冲锋（向前進攻；發起攻勢；比喻率先衝在前面）
english_meaning: to charge (forward); to launch an assault; to rush forward; to take the lead in an attack or effort
explanation_mandarin: 指軍隊或人群向前猛攻、發動攻勢；也可作比喻，表示勇往直前、率先行動。
explanation_english: Refers to troops or people rushing forward to attack; figuratively, it means to boldly push ahead or to take the lead in action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班士兵衝鋒上前，攻佔咗個陣地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 si6 bing1 cung1 fung1 soeng5 cin4, gung1 zim6 zo2 go3 zan6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些士兵冲锋上前，占领了阵地。
examples.english_sentence: The soldiers charged forward and captured the position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最後一分鐘，球隊衝鋒陷陣，追返一個入球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi6 hau6 jat1 fan1 zung1, kau4 deoi6 cung1 fung1 ham6 zan3, zeoi1 faan1 jat1 go3 jap6 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最后一分钟，球队发起冲锋，追回一个进球。
examples.english_sentence: In the final minute, the team launched an attack and scored to equalize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要衝鋒陷陣，先至可以完成呢個企劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung1 fung1 ham6 zan3, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 kei5 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要冲锋陷阵，才能完成这个企划。
examples.english_sentence: We need to push forward and take the lead to complete this project.

mandarin_meaning: 衝鋒車（指警察在維持治安或鎮壓示威時使用的防暴或裝甲車輛）
english_meaning: riot vehicle; police armored/riot van used for crowd control
explanation_mandarin: 指警方在處理大型示威或騷亂時使用的重型或裝甲車輛，例如防暴車、裝甲運兵車等，用於押送警員、戒備或驅散群眾。
explanation_english: Refers to heavy or armored vehicles used by police during large demonstrations or public disorder—e.g. riot vans or armored personnel carriers—employed to transport officers, secure areas, or disperse crowds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察駕住衝鋒車到場戒備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 gaa3 zyu6 cung1 fung1 ce1 dou3 coeng4 gaai3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察駕著衝鋒車到場戒備。
examples.english_sentence: The police drove the riot van to the scene to stand guard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 示威者見到衝鋒車駛近就即刻散開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 wai1 ze2 gin3 dou3 cung1 fung1 ce1 sai2 gan6 zau6 zik1 haak1 saan3 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威者看到衝鋒車駛近就立刻散開。
examples.english_sentence: Protesters immediately dispersed when they saw the riot vans approaching.

mandarin_meaning: 冲锋陷阵；在危险或困难的情况下带头进攻或承担重任（成语）
english_meaning: To charge into battle; to spearhead an attack; to take the lead in a dangerous or difficult task
explanation_mandarin: 原指军队冲向敌阵，后引申为在危险或艰难的情况下冲在前面，勇于承担任务或责任。
explanation_english: Originally referred to troops charging the enemy lines; figuratively used for taking the lead in dangerous or difficult situations, showing bravery and responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢次項目入面，阿明一直喺前線衝鋒陷陣，幫團隊解決好多難題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 ci3 hong6 muk6 jap6 min6, aa3 ming4 jat1 zik6 hai2 cin4 sin3 cung1 fung1 ham6 zan3, bong1 tyun4 deoi2 gaai2 kyut3 hou2 do1 naan4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这次项目中，阿明一直在前线冲锋陷阵，帮助团队解决很多难题。
examples.english_sentence: In this project, Ah Ming has been at the forefront, charging into the fray and helping the team solve many difficult problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部隊衝鋒陷陣，最終奪返陣地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 deoi6 cung1 fung1 ham6 zan3, zeoi3 zung1 dyut6 faan1 zan6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 部队冲锋陷阵，最终夺回阵地。
examples.english_sentence: The troops charged into battle and ultimately retook the position.

mandarin_meaning: 冲门；破门而入；冲出门（猛力推开或闯出门）
english_meaning: to force or rush through a door; to storm out
explanation_mandarin: 「衝門」在粵語中指用力推開門或猛衝出/衝入門內，常用於描述破門而入或氣急衝出門的情況。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "衝門" means to forcefully push open a door or to rush through a door — either storming out or forcing one's way in. It describes breaking/forcing entry or suddenly charging out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察衝門入去救人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 cung1 mun4 jap6 heoi3 gau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察破门而入救人。
examples.english_sentence: The police forced the door open and went in to rescue someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嬲就衝門出街，唔理我講咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 nau1 zau6 cung1 mun4 ceot1 gaai1, m4 lei5 ngo5 gong2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生气就冲出门去，不管我说什么。
examples.english_sentence: Whenever he gets angry he storms out the door and ignores whatever I say.

mandarin_meaning: 衝閘／闖閘（在地鐵或閘機處不付款或非法通過閘機，屬於逃票或違規行為）
english_meaning: to jump/run through a fare gate; fare-dodging at a turnstile (to pass a gate without paying)
explanation_mandarin: 「衝閘」是香港口語，指在地鐵／車站的閘機處不付款或不經正規程序而強行通過閘機，屬於逃票或違規行為，也可泛指強行衝開或闖過閘門。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial phrase meaning to run through or jump a fare gate/turnstile without paying (fare evasion). It can also more generally mean forcing or rushing past a gate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺港鐵站衝閘畀職員捉到，最後要畀罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gong2 tit3 zaam6 cung1 zaap6 bei2 zik1 jyun4 zuk1 dou3, zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 bei2 fat6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在港鐵站衝閘被職員抓到，最後要被罰款。
examples.english_sentence: He ran through the MTR fare gate and was caught by staff; in the end he had to pay a fine.

mandarin_meaning: 冲关；突破关卡/关口
english_meaning: to break through a checkpoint or gate; to clear or overcome a level/stage (literal or figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 原指強行突破檢查站或關口，也可引申為通過或突破障礙、關卡（如遊戲關卡、考試或面試等）。為口語用法，常見於香港粵語。
explanation_english: Originally refers to forcefully breaking through a checkpoint or gate. Figuratively, it means to pass or overcome an obstacle or stage (e.g., game levels, exams, interviews). Common colloquial Cantonese usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋凌晨偷偷衝關，想過境去大陸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ling4 san4 tau1 tau1 cung1 gwaan1, soeng2 gwo3 ging2 heoi3 daai6 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们凌晨偷偷冲关，想过境去大陆。
examples.english_sentence: They secretly rushed through the checkpoint at dawn, trying to cross into the mainland.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要熬夜打機衝關到最後一關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 ngou4 je6 daa2 gei1 cung1 gwaan1 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要熬夜打游戏冲关到最后一关。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to stay up late tonight to play and clear the final level of the game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺面試度衝關，希望可以入職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 min6 si3 dou6 cung1 gwaan1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jap6 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在面试中冲关，希望能入职。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently going through the interview stages, hoping to get the job.

mandarin_meaning: 闯黄灯（在黄灯时继续通过；引申为在警告或危险信号下贸然行动）
english_meaning: to run a yellow light (to go through an intersection when the traffic light is yellow); figuratively, to take a risky action despite a warning
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指在交通信号灯为黄色时仍然冲过去。引申义指在已有警告或可能有风险的情况下仍然冒险采取行动。
explanation_english: Literally means driving through an intersection when the traffic light is yellow. Figuratively, it means proceeding despite a warning or taking a risky/premature action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢衝黃燈畀交警截停咗，俾咗張罰單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 wong4 dang1 bei2 gaau1 ging2 zit3 ting4 zo2, bei2 zo2 zoeng1 faat3 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他闯黄灯被交警拦下了，开了张罚单。
examples.english_sentence: He ran a yellow light and was stopped by the traffic police; he got a ticket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁做等於係衝黃燈，好易出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 zou6 dang2 jyu1 hai6 cung1 wong4 dang1, hou2 ji6 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做等于闯黄灯，很容易出事。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that is like running a yellow light; it's likely to cause trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 卫（保卫、守护）；也用于表示卫生（如衞生）
english_meaning: to guard; to defend; hygiene (in compounds such as 衞生)
explanation_mandarin: 漢字衞，表示保護、守衛等意思，常見於衞生、衞兵、守衞等詞，也可作姓氏。
explanation_english: The character 衞 means to guard or defend. It appears in compounds related to protection (e.g., 衞兵) and hygiene (e.g., 衞生). It can also be a surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院好注重衞生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 hou2 zyu3 zung6 wai6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院很注重卫生。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital places a lot of emphasis on hygiene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做衞兵，責任係守衞總統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 wai6 bing1, zaak3 jam6 hai6 sau2 wai6 zung2 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当卫兵，职责是守卫总统。
examples.english_sentence: He serves as a guard; his duty is to protect the president.

mandarin_meaning: 卫冕
english_meaning: to defend (a title); to retain a championship
explanation_mandarin: 指保住自己已獲得的冠軍或頭銜，繼續保持第一名的地位。
explanation_english: To retain a previously won title or championship; to successfully defend one's title.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次喺世界盃成功衞冕，連續兩屆做冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 hai2 sai3 gaai3 bui3 sing4 gung1 wai6 min5, lin4 zuk6 loeng5 gaai3 zou6 gun1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次在世界杯成功卫冕，连续两届当冠军。
examples.english_sentence: He successfully defended his title at the World Cup this time, becoming champion for two consecutive editions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔贏最後嗰場比賽，球隊就無辦法衞冕聯賽冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 jing4 zeoi6 hau6 go2 coeng4 bei2 coi3, kau4 deoi6 zau6 mou5 baan6 faat3 wai6 min5 lyun4 coi3 gun1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果輸掉最後一场比赛，球队就没办法卫冕联赛冠军。
examples.english_sentence: If they don't win the last match, the team won't be able to defend the league title.

mandarin_meaning: 卫星 (wèixīng)
english_meaning: satellite
explanation_mandarin: 指圍繞行星或其他天體運行的天然天體（如月亮）或人造物體（人造衛星）；在現代語境中也常特指人造衛星。
explanation_english: Refers to a body that orbits a planet or other body — either a natural object (e.g. the Moon) or an artificial object (an artificial satellite). In modern usage it often specifically denotes man-made satellites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個國家啱啱發射咗一個人造衞星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gwok3 gaa1 aam1 aam1 faat3 se6 zo2 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6 wai6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个国家刚刚发射了一个人造卫星。
examples.english_sentence: That country has just launched an artificial satellite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 月亮係地球唯一嘅天然衞星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyut6 loeng6 hai6 dei6 kau4 wai4 jat1 ge3 tin1 jin4 wai6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 月亮是地球唯一的天然卫星。
examples.english_sentence: The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite.

mandarin_meaning: 卫生 (wèishēng)
english_meaning: hygiene; sanitation; health (relating to cleanliness and disease prevention)
explanation_mandarin: 指與清潔、公共或個人健康有關的概念，可表示衛生狀況或形容某物／環境是否乾淨、衛生。
explanation_english: Refers to cleanliness, sanitation, or matters related to public or personal health; can denote the state of hygiene or describe something as hygienic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個廁所唔太衞生，我哋唔好喺度食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ci3 so2 m4 taai3 wai6 sang1, ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个厕所不太卫生，我们不要在这里吃东西。
examples.english_sentence: The restroom isn't very hygienic; let's not eat here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校每個星期都會檢查學生嘅衞生習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 wui5 gim2 caa4 hok6 saang1 ge3 wai6 sang1 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校每个星期都会检查学生的卫生习惯。
examples.english_sentence: The school checks students' hygiene habits every week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 衞生署話政府會加強衞生防疫工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 sang1 cyu5 waa6 zing3 fu2 wui5 gaa1 koeng4 wai6 sang1 fong4 jik6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 卫生署表示政府会加强卫生防疫工作。
examples.english_sentence: The Department of Health said the government will strengthen hygiene and epidemic-prevention efforts.

mandarin_meaning: 卫生局
english_meaning: Department of Health; Health Bureau
explanation_mandarin: 指负责公共卫生管理、疾病预防、检疫和相关卫生政策执行的政府机构或部门。
explanation_english: A government department responsible for public health administration, disease prevention, quarantine, and implementation of related health policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 衞生局話要加強入境檢疫措施，市民要配合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 sang1 guk6 waa6 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 jap6 ging2 gim2 jik6 co3 si1, si5 man4 jiu3 pui3 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 卫生局说要加强入境检疫措施，市民要配合。
examples.english_sentence: The Department of Health said it will strengthen inbound quarantine measures; citizens should cooperate.

mandarin_meaning: 卫生巾
english_meaning: sanitary napkin; sanitary pad
explanation_mandarin: 供女性在月经期间使用、用于吸收经血的一次性或可重复使用的卫生用品。
explanation_english: An absorbent pad worn by women during menstruation to absorb menstrual blood; a sanitary pad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要去買啲衞生巾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 heoi3 maai5 di1 wai6 saang1 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要去買一些衛生巾。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to buy some sanitary pads tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得帶衞生巾，唔知可唔可以借一片？
