examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 m4 bei2 gung1 zung3 faat3 jin6, keoi5 dei6 zau6 si3 tou4 bou2 jim2 go2 ci3 sou3 geoi3 sit3 lau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了不让公众发现，他们试图掩盖那次数据泄漏。
examples.english_sentence: To avoid public discovery, they tried to cover up that data leak.

mandarin_meaning: 补救 (bǔjiù)
english_meaning: to remedy; to make amends; to salvage
explanation_mandarin: 表示採取措施以挽回錯誤、缺陷或不良結果，使情況好轉或避免更壞的後果。
explanation_english: To take actions to fix or mitigate a mistake, defect, or adverse outcome in order to improve the situation or prevent further damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家要諗辦法補救佢哋嘅錯，唔可以再等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 nam2 baan6 faat3 bou2 gau3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 co3, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在要想办法补救他们的错误，不能再等。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a way to remedy their mistake now; we can't wait any longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事已經好難完全補救，要小心處理後續影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 hou2 naan4 jyun4 cyun4 bou2 gau3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5 hau6 zuk1 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事已经很难完全补救，要小心处理后续影响。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is already hard to fully rectify; be careful handling the follow-up effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家交多啲功課都未必可以補救分數，平時唔好拖到最後一刻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 gaau1 do1 di1 gung1 fo3 dou1 mei6 bat1 ho2 ji5 bou2 gau3 fan1 sou3, ping4 si4 m4 hou2 to1 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在交更多作业也未必能补救分数，平时不要拖到最后一刻。
examples.english_sentence: Turning in more homework now may not make up your grade; don't procrastinate until the last minute.

mandarin_meaning: 凑数/充数（表示为凑足人数或数量而存在）
english_meaning: to make up the numbers; to be there only to fill a required headcount or quota
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，用来形容某人或某物只是用来凑人数或填补数量，并非真正承担实质性作用或重要角色。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning someone or something is present only to make up the numbers — included merely to reach a required count, without a real role or importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚嚟只係補數，唔會幫手做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1maan5 lai4 zi2 hai6 bou2 sou3, m4 wui5 bong1 sau2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚来只是凑数，不会帮忙做事。
examples.english_sentence: He came tonight just to make up the numbers; he won't help with the work.

mandarin_meaning: 补时
english_meaning: stoppage time; added time (in sports)
explanation_mandarin: 在足球等比赛中，指因中途暂停（如伤停、换人、暂停处理等）由裁判在比赛结束前额外补上的时间；也可泛指补上的时间。
explanation_english: In sports (especially football/soccer), the extra time the referee adds at the end of a match to compensate for stoppages (injuries, substitutions, delays); more generally, 'make-up' or added time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球賽尾段，裁判加咗三分鐘補時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 coi3 mei5 dyun6, coi4 pun3 gaa1 zo2 saam1 fan1 zung1 bou2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球赛尾段，裁判加了三分钟补时。
examples.english_sentence: In the final part of the match, the referee added three minutes of stoppage time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺補時入波，最後贏咗比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bou2 si4 jap6 bo1, zeoi3 hau6 jing4 zo2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在补时进球，最终赢得了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He scored in stoppage time and ultimately won the match.

mandarin_meaning: 補充水分；（美容）給皮膚補水、保濕
english_meaning: to replenish water/hydrate (literally); to moisturize or rehydrate skin (skincare context)
explanation_mandarin: 「補水」可指補充身體或容器的水分，也常用於美容語境，指為皮膚補充水分、保濕。
explanation_english: “補水” can mean topping up water for the body or a container, and in skincare contexts it means to moisturize or replenish the skin's hydration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會講到口乾舌燥，要出去補吓水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 gong2 dou3 hau2 gon1 sit3 zou6, jiu3 ceot1 heoi3 bou2 haa5 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在開會時講得口乾舌燥，要出去補充水分。
examples.english_sentence: Talking so much in the meeting made my mouth dry; I need to go out and get some water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近皮膚好乾，我換咗一支好補水嘅面霜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 pei4 fu1 hou2 gon1, ngo5 wun6 zo2 jat1 zi1 hou2 bou2 seoi2 ge3 min6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近皮膚很乾，我換了一款很補水的面霜。
examples.english_sentence: My skin has been very dry lately; I switched to a very hydrating face cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 水缸嘅水唔夠，要補水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi2 gong1 ge3 seoi2 m4 gau3, jiu3 bou2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水缸的水不夠，需要補水。
examples.english_sentence: The water tank doesn't have enough water; it needs to be refilled.

cantonese: 補漏趁天晴，讀書趁年輕
jyutping: bou2 lau6 can3 tin1 cing4, duk6 syu1 can3 nin4 heng1
mandarin_meaning: 趁天氣好修補漏洞，趁年輕努力讀書；比喻要把握有利時機，及早處理事情與學習，不要拖延。
english_meaning: Fix problems while conditions are favorable and study while you're young; a proverb urging people to seize good opportunities and act early instead of procrastinating.
explanation_mandarin: 用生活化的比喻提醒人們在有利的時候做該做的事：天氣好時修補屋漏，年輕時努力讀書，以免日後後悔。
explanation_english: A colloquial proverb advising people to take advantage of favorable moments to fix problems and to study while young — emphasizing timely action and avoiding procrastination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好等到有事先做，補漏趁天晴，讀書趁年輕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dang2 dou3 jau5 si6 sin1 zou6, bou2 lau6 can3 tin1 cing4, duk6 syu1 can3 nin4 heng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別等到出事才做，趁天晴補漏，趁年輕讀書。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wait until something goes wrong to act; fix leaks while the weather's good and study while you're young.

mandarin_meaning: 补牙
english_meaning: to get a tooth filled; dental filling
explanation_mandarin: 在牙科將蛀牙或受損的牙齒部分清除，然後用填充物修復，使牙齒恢復形狀和功能。
explanation_english: A dental procedure to remove decayed or damaged tooth material and restore it with filling material; to have a cavity filled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去補牙，依家好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 bou2 nga4, ji1 gaa1 hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去补牙，现在很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to get a filling tomorrow; I'm really scared right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為有蛀牙，所以要去補牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 jau5 zyu3 nga4, so2 ji5 jiu3 heoi3 bou2 nga4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为有蛀牙，所以要去补牙。
examples.english_sentence: He has a cavity, so he needs to get a filling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁遲先去補牙，會越嚟越嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 ci4 sin1 heoi3 bou2 nga4, wui5 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要等到太晚才去补牙，会越来越严重。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wait so long to get a filling; it will only get worse.

mandarin_meaning: 补发；重新签发或再次发放（证件、卡片、票据等）
english_meaning: to reissue; to issue a replacement (documents, cards, tickets, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指對已遺失、損毀或未收到的證件、卡片、票據等進行重新發放或補發；在口語中亦可用於補接頭髮（接髮、補髮）。
explanation_english: Refers to issuing something again as a replacement when the original is lost, damaged, or not received (e.g. ID cards, transit cards, tickets). Informally it can also refer to adding hair (extensions/repairs).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我張身份證唔見咗，要去入境處補發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 san1 fan6 zing3 m4 gin3 zo2, jiu3 heoi3 jap6 ging2 cyu3 bou2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的身份證不見了，要去入境處補發。
examples.english_sentence: My ID card is missing; I need to go to the Immigration Department to have it reissued.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果八達通卡壞咗，可以去補發一張新嘅，裏面嘅餘額會轉去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 baat3 daat6 tung1 kaat1 waa6 zo2, ho2 ji5 heoi3 bou2 faat3 jat1 zoeng1 san1 ge3, leoi5 min6 ge3 jyu4 ngok6 wui5 zyun2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果八達通卡壞了，可以補發一張新的，裡面的餘額會轉過去。
examples.english_sentence: If the Octopus card is damaged, you can get a replacement issued; the remaining balance will be transferred over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去髮廊補發接髮，睇落精神好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 faat3 long4 bou2 faat3 zip3 faat3, tai2 lok6 zing1 san4 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她去髮廊補接頭髮，看起來精神好多。
examples.english_sentence: She went to the salon to add hair extensions and looked much more lively.

mandarin_meaning: 補上祝賀；補辦慶祝（如補祝生日、補祝婚禮等）
english_meaning: to make up a celebration; to offer belated congratulations; to hold a belated celebration
explanation_mandarin: 指在錯過原定時間後，補上祝賀或補辦慶祝活動。例如沒能在當天慶祝生日，之後再補祝。
explanation_english: Refers to making up missed congratulations or celebrations after the original date. For example, having a belated birthday celebration when you missed the actual day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇喺佢生日果日見到佢，所以下星期補祝佢生日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 hai2 keoi5 saang1 jat6 go2 jat6 gin3 dou3 keoi5, so2 ji5 haa6 sing1 kei4 bou2 zuk1 keoi5 saang1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒在他生日那天看到他，所以下星期補祝他的生日。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't see him on his birthday, so I'll celebrate his birthday belatedly next week.

mandarin_meaning: 补票
english_meaning: to make up/pay for a missing/invalid ticket; (slang) to buy extra tickets to inflate attendance or to add/forge votes
explanation_mandarin: 「補票」可指在乘搭交通工具時補交票款或補辦票務，也可作俗稱，指主辦方購買額外門票以填滿場面，或在選舉等情況下非法增加票數（補票、作票）。
explanation_english: “補票” literally means to make up or pay for a missing/invalid ticket (e.g. on public transport). Colloquially it can also mean buying extra tickets to boost attendance, or (in a political context) adding/forging votes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上車冇拍八達通，落車先發現，結果要補票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng5 ce1 mou5 paak3 baat3 daat6 tung1, lok6 ce1 sin1 faat3 jin6, git3 gwo2 jiu3 bou2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上车没刷八达通，下车才发现，结果要补票。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't tap my Octopus card when I boarded; I only realized after getting off, so I had to pay/make up the fare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗令場面熱鬧，主辦方補票填滿座位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 ling6 coeng4 min6 jit6 naau6, zyu2 baan6 fong1 bou2 piu3 tin4 mun5 zo6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了让场面热闹，主办方补票填满座位。
examples.english_sentence: To make the venue look full, the organizers bought extra tickets to fill the seats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人話嗰次選舉有人補票，警方調查中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 waa6 go2 ci3 syun2 geoi2 jau5 jan4 bou2 piu3, ging2 fong1 diu6 caa4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人说那次选举有人补票，警方正在调查。
examples.english_sentence: There are claims that votes were added in that election; the police are investigating.

mandarin_meaning: 补妆；补粉底
english_meaning: to touch up one's makeup (especially powder/foundation)
explanation_mandarin: 指在外出或化妆后重新涂抹粉底、散粉等以修整妆容，属于日常口语用法。
explanation_english: Refers to reapplying powder/foundation or otherwise touching up one's makeup after initial application; a common colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街之前記得補粉喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 bou2 fan2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门之前记得补妆。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to touch up your makeup before going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去到party都不停補粉，妝好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 dou3 party dou1 bat1 ting4 bou2 fan2, zong1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她到派对不停地补妆，妆化得很好看。
examples.english_sentence: She kept touching up her makeup at the party; her makeup looked great.

mandarin_meaning: 补妆 (bǔ zhuāng)
english_meaning: to touch up one's makeup; to reapply or fix makeup
explanation_mandarin: 指在外出或化妆后，重新整理或修补妆容，例如补口红、补粉或修正眼妆等。
explanation_english: To retouch or refresh makeup during the day—reapplying lipstick, powder, foundation, or fixing eye makeup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去廁所補粧先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 ci3 so2 bou2 zong1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要去洗手间补妆一下。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the restroom to touch up my makeup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街前我要補粧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 cin4 ngo5 jiu3 bou2 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门前我要补妆。
examples.english_sentence: I need to touch up my makeup before going out.

mandarin_meaning: 补给 (bǔjǐ) — 补充物资、供应所需的东西
english_meaning: to supply; to resupply; provision (of goods or resources)
explanation_mandarin: 表示提供或补充物资、用品或必需品，常用于军事、远足、旅行、物流等需要补充物资的情境，也可作名词指补给的物资。
explanation_english: Refers to providing or replenishing supplies, goods, or necessities. Commonly used in contexts like military operations, hiking, travel, and logistics. Can also be used as a noun for the supplies themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要補給食物同水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 bou2 kap1 sik6 mat6 tung4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要补给食物和水。
examples.english_sentence: We need to resupply food and water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍隊去前線補給彈藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 deoi2 heoi3 cin4 sin3 bou2 kap1 daan6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军队去前线补给弹药。
examples.english_sentence: The troops go to the front to resupply ammunition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 登山隊在山腰補給物資再上山頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang1 saan1 deoi6 zoi6 saan1 jiu1 bou2 kap1 mat6 zi1 zoi3 soeng5 saan1 deng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 登山队在山腰补给物资再上山顶。
examples.english_sentence: The climbing team resupplied at the midpoint before heading to the summit.

mandarin_meaning: 補給線 (bǔjǐ xiàn)
english_meaning: supply line; logistics line
explanation_mandarin: 指軍隊或組織用來運送補給物資、人員或裝備到前線或需要地點的路線或通道。
explanation_english: The route or channel through which supplies, personnel, or equipment are transported to a front line or an area in need; a logistics line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前線嘅補給線畀對方切斷，士兵冇晒彈藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 sin3 ge3 bou2 kap1 sin3 bei2 deoi3 fong1 cit3 dyun6, si6 bing1 mou5 saai3 daan6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前線的補給線被對方切斷，士兵沒有彈藥。
examples.english_sentence: The front's supply line was cut off by the enemy, and the soldiers have no ammunition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗應付暴風，政府加強咗救援嘅補給線，送水同食物俾受影響嘅居民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jing3 fu6 bou6 fung1, zing3 fu2 gaa1 koeng4 zo2 gau3 jyun4 ge3 bou2 kap1 sin3, sung3 seoi2 tung4 sik6 mat6 bei2 sau6 jing2 hoeng2 ge3 geoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了應付暴風，政府加強了救援的補給線，送水和食物給受影響的居民。
examples.english_sentence: To cope with the storm, the government strengthened the relief supply lines, sending water and food to affected residents.

mandarin_meaning: 补习
english_meaning: to attend tutoring / take supplementary lessons
explanation_mandarin: 指在正规课堂之外接受额外的学习或补课，通常为了复习、赶进度或提升成绩，常见形式有补习班或请家教。
explanation_english: Refers to receiving extra lessons outside regular classes, usually to review material, catch up, or improve grades; common forms include cram schools or private tutors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家放學之後要去補習，唔可以同你食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 fong3 hok6 zi1 hau6 jiu3 heoi3 bou2 zaap6, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在放学之后要去补习，不能跟你吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to tutoring after school now, I can't have dinner with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母成日叫我去補習，真係幾辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 sing4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 heoi3 bou2 zaap6, zan1 hai6 gei2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母经常让我去补习，确实挺辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: My parents often make me go to tutoring; it's quite exhausting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔明就去補習問老師會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 ming4 zau6 heoi3 bou2 zaap6 man6 lou5 si1 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不懂就去补习问老师会比较好。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't understand something, going to tutoring and asking the teacher is better.

mandarin_meaning: 補習老師 / 家教
english_meaning: tutor (private tutor / supplementary teacher)
explanation_mandarin: 指以私人或小班形式為學生補習課業的老師，常用於香港語境，可指到門教或補習社的老師。
explanation_english: Refers to a tutor who gives private or small-group supplementary lessons; commonly used in Hong Kong to mean a private tutor or a teacher at a tuition centre.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我請咗個補習先生幫我補數學，佢教得好細心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceng2 zo2 go3 bou2 zaap6 sin1 saang1 bong1 ngo5 bou2 sou3 hok6, keoi5 gaau3 dak1 hou2 sai3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我请了一个补习老师帮我补数学，他教得很细心。
examples.english_sentence: I hired a tutor to help me with math; he teaches very carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 補習界的名師／補習班名師（意指在補習界非常有名且招生旺盛的老師）
english_meaning: tutoring king; a top/celebrity private tutor (a very popular and successful cram-school teacher)
explanation_mandarin: 俗稱，指在補習界非常有名、教學成效高且學生眾多的補習老師。可用作稱讚或半開玩笑的稱呼。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for a very famous and successful private tutor in the cram-school sector, typically with many students. Used as praise or sometimes jokingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係補習天王，成日課堂都爆滿，學生要排隊先至有位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 bou2 zaap6 tin1 wong4, sing4 jat6 fo3 tong4 dou1 baau3 mun5, hok6 saang1 jiu3 paai4 deoi3 sin1 zi3 jau5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被稱為補習天王，經常課堂爆滿，學生要排隊才有名額。
examples.english_sentence: He's known as the 'tutoring king'; his classes are always full and students have to queue to get a spot.

mandarin_meaning: 补习班（為學生提供課後或應試補習的機構或課程）
english_meaning: cram school; tutoring class; tutoring center (after-school or exam-focused classes)
explanation_mandarin: 指專門提供課後補習或應試訓練的機構或課程，常見於中小學生或應試需要的補習安排。
explanation_english: Refers to institutions or classes that provide after-school tutoring or exam-focused instruction (cram schools), commonly attended by students preparing for exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日返補習班，為咗考大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 faan1 bou2 zaap6 baan1, wai6 zo2 haau2 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小的時候常常去補習班，為了考大學。
examples.english_sentence: When I was young I often went to tutoring classes to prepare for university entrance exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲英文唔掂，要俾佢去補習班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 di1 jing1 man4 m4 dim6, jiu3 bei2 keoi5 heoi3 bou2 zaap6 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的英語不好，要讓他去補習班。
examples.english_sentence: Their English isn't good; they should send them to a tutoring center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期六補習班會有模擬試，記得報名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 luk6 bou2 zaap6 baan1 wui5 jau5 mou4 ji5 si3, gei3 dak1 bou3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 補習班在星期六會有模擬考試，記得報名。
examples.english_sentence: The cram school will have a mock test on Saturday; remember to sign up.

mandarin_meaning: 補習班／補習社（提供課外補習或應試輔導的機構）
english_meaning: tutoring center; cram school (an institution offering extra lessons or exam-focused tutoring)
explanation_mandarin: 指提供課外補習、加強練習或應試輔導的機構，學生常在課後或假期到補習社補習或溫習。
explanation_english: Refers to an institution that provides extra lessons, reinforcement practice, or exam-focused tutoring. Students often attend after school or during holidays to review or catch up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日去補習社溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 heoi3 bou2 zaap6 se5 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候經常去補習社念書。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little I often went to a tutoring center to study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多家長會送仔女去補習社補底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gaa1 zoeng2 wui5 sung3 zai2 neoi5 heoi3 bou2 zaap6 se5 bou2 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多家長會送子女去補習社補底。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many parents send their children to tutoring centers to catch up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗準備公開試，我報咗間補習社嘅密集班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 zeon2 bei6 gung1 hoi1 si3, ngo5 bou3 zo2 gaan1 bou2 zaap6 se5 ge3 mat6 zaap6 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了準備公開考試，我報名了補習社的密集班。
examples.english_sentence: To prepare for the public exam, I enrolled in the tutoring center's intensive class.

mandarin_meaning: 補習老師 / 家教（指在課外對學生進行補習的老師）
english_meaning: tutor; private tutor; cram-school teacher
explanation_mandarin: 指在正規學校課程之外，為學生提供補課、功課輔導或升學準備的教師，可為私人家教或補習班的老師。
explanation_english: A teacher who provides lessons outside regular school hours to help students with homework, exam preparation, or extra practice — can be a private tutor or a cram-school instructor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋請咗個補習老師幫阿仔補數學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 bou2 zaap6 lou5 si1 bong1 aa3 zai2 bou2 sou3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們請了一位補習老師幫我兒子補數學。
examples.english_sentence: We hired a tutor to help my son with math.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 補習老師通常會提供功課輔導同額外練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 zaap6 lou5 si1 tung1 soeng4 wui5 tai4 gung1 gung1 fo3 fu6 dou6 tung4 ngaak6 ngoi6 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 補習老師通常會提供功課輔導和額外練習。
examples.english_sentence: Tutors usually provide homework help and extra practice.

mandarin_meaning: 补考
english_meaning: to retake an exam; make-up exam
explanation_mandarin: 指因缺考或未通过原考试而重新参加的考试；也可作动词，表示参加补考或安排别人补考。
explanation_english: An exam taken after missing or failing the original test (make-up exam); can also be used as a verb meaning to retake an exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜要補考數學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lei5 baai3 jiu3 bou2 haau2 sou3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个礼拜要补考数学。
examples.english_sentence: I have to retake a math exam next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為遲到錯過咗考試，依家要補考。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ci4 dou6 co3 gwo3 zo2 haau2 si3, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 bou2 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为迟到错过了考试，现在要补考。
examples.english_sentence: He missed the exam because he was late, so now he has to take the make-up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校安排咗下星期嘅補考，大家要溫習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 on1 paai4 zo2 haa6 sing1 kei4 ge3 bou2 haau2, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 wan1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校安排了下星期的补考，大家要复习。
examples.english_sentence: The school scheduled make-up exams next week; everyone needs to study.

mandarin_meaning: 补花（打麻将时指把摸到的花牌补出并补摸牌）
english_meaning: To replace a flower tile in mahjong by setting aside the flower and drawing a replacement tile; (by extension) to make up or compensate (rare/colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，補花主要指打麻將時摸到花牌，將花牌放出並補摸一張牌的動作。也可引申為彌補或補償（口語、罕見用法）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 補花 primarily refers to the mahjong action of setting aside a drawn flower tile and drawing a replacement tile. It can also be used figuratively to mean 'to make up' or 'to compensate' (colloquial, less common).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱補咗花，攞到一張好牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 bou2 zo2 faa1, lo2 dou3 jat1 zoeng1 hou2 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛補了花，摸到一張好牌。
examples.english_sentence: I just drew a replacement for a flower and got a good tile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺麻雀入面，當你攞到花牌，就要補花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 maa4 zoek3 jap6 min6, dong1 nei5 lo2 dou3 faa1 paai4, zau6 jiu3 bou2 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在麻將裡，當你摸到花牌，就要補花。
examples.english_sentence: In mahjong, when you draw a flower tile you have to draw a replacement (補花).

mandarin_meaning: 補藥 / 補身的藥物或滋補品
english_meaning: tonic; restorative medicine; nourishing supplement
explanation_mandarin: 指用來補身、強身或滋補的藥物或補品，常見於中醫調理或產後調養等情況；亦可泛指有補益作用的食補或保健品。
explanation_english: Refers to medicines or supplements taken to restore strength, nourish the body, or improve health—commonly used in traditional Chinese medicine, postpartum recovery, or as nourishing supplements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近身體虛，要開始食補葯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 san1 tai2 heoi1, jiu3 hoi1 ci2 sik6 bou2 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近身体虚，需要开始吃补药。
examples.english_sentence: I've been feeling weak lately and need to start taking tonics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢產後食咗一段時間嘅補葯，身體好返啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caan2 hau6 sik6 zo2 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 ge3 bou2 joek6, san1 tai2 hou2 faan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她产后吃了一段时间的补药，身体好了一些。
examples.english_sentence: She took tonics for a while after giving birth and her health improved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂買藥，買補葯最好問中醫師意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 maai5 joek6, maai5 bou2 joek6 zeoi3 hou2 maan6 zung1 ji1 si1 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便买药，购买补药最好咨询中医师意见。
examples.english_sentence: Don't buy medicine recklessly; it's best to consult a Chinese medicine practitioner before buying tonics.

mandarin_meaning: 补药 (bǔyào)，用于补身体或补充营养的药物
english_meaning: tonic; medicinal supplement (medicine used to strengthen or restore the body)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來補身或補充營養的藥物，常指中醫的滋補藥品或營養補充類藥物，用於調理體質或恢復健康。
explanation_english: Refers to medicines used to tonify the body or replenish nutrients. Often denotes Chinese tonic medicines or nourishing supplements used to strengthen constitution or restore health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我病咗幾日，阿媽買咗啲補藥俾我食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 beng6 zo2 gei2 jat6, aa3 maa1 maai5 zo2 di1 bou2 joek6 bei2 ngo5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我病了幾天，媽媽買了些補藥給我吃。
examples.english_sentence: I've been sick for a few days; my mom bought me some tonics to take.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話佢太虛弱，要食補藥調理身體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 keoi5 taai3 heoi1 joek6, jiu3 sik6 bou2 joek6 tiu4 lei5 san1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中醫說他太虛弱，要吃補藥調理身體。
examples.english_sentence: The Chinese medicine doctor said he's too weak and needs to take tonics to restore his health.

mandarin_meaning: 補償；彌補
english_meaning: to compensate; to make up for; to make amends
explanation_mandarin: 表示對損失或錯誤採取補償或彌補的行為，常用於口語中指承擔責任或作出補救。
explanation_english: Indicates taking action to compensate for a loss or mistake; commonly used colloquially to mean bearing responsibility or making amends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心打爛咗我杯碗，老細話要補處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 laan6 zo2 ngo5 bui1 wun2, lou5 sai3 waa6 jiu3 bou2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心打破了我的杯碗，老闆說要補償。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally broke my cup and bowl; the boss said he should compensate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做錯事要補處，唔好再唔承認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 co3 si6 jiu3 bou2 cyu3, m4 hou2 zoi3 m4 sing4 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做錯事要彌補，不要再不承認。
examples.english_sentence: If you did something wrong you should make amends; don't keep denying it.

mandarin_meaning: 补血（bǔ xuè）：滋养血液、恢复体力；中医上指养血、调理气血。
english_meaning: to replenish blood; to restore vitality or energy (often used in traditional Chinese medicine to mean 'tonify the blood').
explanation_mandarin: “补血”既可指通过食补或药物改善血液和气色（如吃红枣、阿胶），也可引申为恢复体力、补充精力。在中医语境中常指养血或调理气血。
explanation_english: “補血” literally means to replenish blood; it commonly refers to using food or medicine (e.g. red dates, ejiao) to improve blood and complexion, or more generally to restore strength and energy. In TCM it specifically means to tonify the blood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話我氣色唔好，要去食啲補血嘅藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Aa3 maa1 waa6 ngo5 hei3 sik1 m4 hou2, jiu3 heoi3 sik6 di1 bou2 hyut3 ge3 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说我气色不好，要去吃些补血的药。
examples.english_sentence: My mom said I look pale and should take some blood-tonifying medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經期完咗之後，佢去飲紅棗同阿膠補血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ging1 kei4 jyun4 zo2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 heoi3 jam2 hung4 zou2 tung4 aa3 gaau1 bou2 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经期结束后，她会吃红枣和阿胶来补血。
examples.english_sentence: After her period, she takes red dates and ejiao to replenish her blood.

mandarin_meaning: 补衣服；缝补衣物
english_meaning: to mend or darn clothes; to repair garments
explanation_mandarin: 指把破损或有洞的衣服用针线缝好、修补使能继续穿用。
explanation_english: Refers to sewing or repairing torn/damaged clothing so the garment can be worn again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫爛咗，要去補衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 laan6 zo2, jiu3 heoi3 bou2 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服破了，要去补衣服。
examples.english_sentence: The garment is torn; I need to get it mended.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔使買新衫，媽媽幫我補衫就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sai2 maai5 san1 saam1, maa4 maa1 bong1 ngo5 bou2 saam1 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不用买新衣，妈妈帮我补衣服就行。
examples.english_sentence: I don't need to buy new clothes; my mom can just mend them.

mandarin_meaning: 補衣服的人；縫補或修改衣物的婦女（常指年長或鄰居中的補衣者）
english_meaning: a woman who mends or alters clothes; a seamstress/clothes mender (often an older neighbor or informal tailor)
explanation_mandarin: 「補衫婆」是粵語俗稱，通常指替人補衣、縫補破洞或改衣服的婦女，常帶有口語或鄉土色彩，有時也泛指修補衣物的裁縫。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to a woman who mends, patches, or alters clothes (often an older neighbor or informal seamstress). It is a casual/local expression for someone who does clothing repairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日帶件衫去畀隔籬嗰位補衫婆補破洞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 daai3 gin6 saam1 heoi3 bei2 gaak3 lei4 go2 wai2 bou2 saam1 po4 bou2 po3 dung6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候常常把衣服拿去給隔壁那位補衣服的阿姨補破洞。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child I often took my clothes to the neighbor who mends clothes to have the holes patched.

mandarin_meaning: 补语
english_meaning: complement (grammar)
explanation_mandarin: 在語法中，補語是跟在動詞、形容詞或句子其他成分之後，用以補充或完成謂語的資訊（如結果、程度、方向等）的成分。
explanation_english: In grammar, a complement is a constituent that follows a verb, adjective, or other predicate element to complete or add information about the action or state (e.g. result, degree, direction).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 補語可以講明動作嘅結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 jyu5 ho2 ji5 gong2 ming4 dung6 zok3 ge3 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 补语可以说明动作的结果。
examples.english_sentence: A complement can indicate the result of an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢句子入面有兩個補語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi3 zi6 jap6 min6 jau5 loeng5 go3 bou2 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他（她）的句子里有两个补语。
examples.english_sentence: There are two complements in his/her sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學語法時要識得用補語，咁先可以講得清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jyu5 faat3 si4 jiu3 sik1 dak1 jung6 bou2 jyu5, gam2 sin1 ho2 ji5 gong2 dak1 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学语法时要懂得使用补语，这样才能说得清楚。
examples.english_sentence: When studying grammar you need to know how to use complements; that way you can speak more clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 补课
english_meaning: to make up a class; to take extra lessons/tutoring
explanation_mandarin: 指把因故缺席或取消的課程補上，或指額外的輔導課程（例如補習）。
explanation_english: Refers to attending makeup classes for lessons missed or canceled, or taking extra tutoring sessions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為病咗，我今日唔能夠返學，要喺禮拜六補課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 beng6 zo2, ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 nang4 gau3 faan1 hok6, jiu3 hai6 lai5 baai3 luk6 bou2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為生病，我今天不能去上學，要在星期六補課。
examples.english_sentence: Because I was sick, I can't go to school today; I need to make up the class on Saturday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校因為暴雨停課，所以要安排補課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 jan1 wai6 bou6 jyu5 ting4 fo3, so2 ji5 jiu3 on1 paai4 bou2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校因為暴雨停課，所以要安排補課。
examples.english_sentence: The school canceled classes because of the storm, so they need to arrange makeup classes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你錯過一堂，你就要補課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 co3 gwo3 jat1 tong4, nei5 zau6 jiu3 bou2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你錯過一節課，你就要補課。
examples.english_sentence: If you miss a class, you have to make it up.

mandarin_meaning: 补贴
english_meaning: subsidize; subsidy
explanation_mandarin: 表示政府或機構在經濟上給予補助或補償的行為或金額，也可指所得到的補助款。
explanation_english: To provide financial assistance or a subsidy; can also refer to the subsidy amount given by a government or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會補貼低收入家庭嘅生活開支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 bou2 tit3 dai1 sau1 jap6 gaa1 ting4 ge3 sang1 wut6 hoi1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府會補貼低收入家庭的生活開支。
examples.english_sentence: The government will subsidize the living expenses of low-income families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司申請到政府補貼，先至可以開展新項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 san1 cing2 dou3 zing3 fu2 bou2 tit3, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 hoi1 zin2 san1 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司申請到政府補貼，才可以開展新項目。
examples.english_sentence: The company obtained government subsidies, so it can start a new project.

mandarin_meaning: 补足；补充不足的部分，使达到所需数量或程度
english_meaning: to supplement; to make up for a deficiency; to replenish so that something is sufficient
explanation_mandarin: 表示對不足的部分進行補充或彌補，使達到所需的數量或程度，常用於工作、學習、申請等場景。
explanation_english: Indicates supplying or filling in what is lacking so that a required amount or standard is reached; commonly used in contexts like work, study, or applications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要補足人手先可以完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bou2 zuk1 jan4 sau2 sin1 ho2 ji5 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要補足人手才能完成這個項目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to supplement our manpower before we can complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要補足缺少嘅資料先可以遞交申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 bou2 zuk1 kyut3 siu2 ge3 zi1 liu2 sin1 ho2 ji5 dai6 gaau1 san1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要補足缺少的資料才能遞交申請。
examples.english_sentence: You need to provide the missing documents before you can submit the application.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想達到要求，就要補足練習時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 daat6 dou3 jiu1 kau4, zau6 jiu3 bou2 zuk1 lin6 zaap6 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想達到要求，就要補足練習時間。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to meet the requirements, you need to make up sufficient practice time.

mandarin_meaning: 補身 / 補養身體（利用食補、藥材等增強體力或恢復健康）
english_meaning: to tonify or nourish the body (usually by taking tonic foods, herbal remedies, or rest to strengthen health)
explanation_mandarin: 「補身」指透過食補、煲湯、中藥或休養等方法滋補身體，以增強體力、改善虛弱或加速康復。常用於日常口語，尤其在華人社會談論養生時使用。
explanation_english: “補身” means to nourish or tonify the body through tonic foods, soups, herbal medicine, or rest to boost strength, recover from weakness, or aid convalescence. It is commonly used in everyday speech, especially in Chinese-speaking contexts about health and wellness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽整咗人參雞湯畀我補身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 zing2 zo2 jan4 sam1 gai1 tong1 bei2 ngo5 bou2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈煲了参鸡汤给我补身。
examples.english_sentence: My mom made ginseng chicken soup for me to help tonify my body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天容易着涼，要補身，多飲啲暖湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 jung6 ji6 zoek3 loeng4, jiu3 bou2 san1, do1 jam2 di1 nyun5 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天容易着凉，要补身，多喝些热汤。
examples.english_sentence: In winter it's easy to catch a cold; you should nourish your body and drink more hot soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使日日補身，均衡飲食先重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 jat6 jat6 bou2 san1, gwan1 hang4 jam2 sik6 sin1 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不需要每天补身，均衡饮食更重要。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to take tonics every day; a balanced diet is more important.

mandarin_meaning: 补胎 / 修補輪胎
english_meaning: to patch/repair a punctured tire (tyre)
explanation_mandarin: 指把汽車、自行車等的輪胎修補或補胎，通常用於輪胎被刺破或洩氣後的處理。
explanation_english: To repair or patch a punctured tire (for a car, bicycle, etc.), typically used when a tire is punctured or has gone flat and needs fixing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車爆咗軚，要去補軚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 baau3 zo2 dit3, jiu3 heoi3 bou2 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车胎爆了，要去补胎。
examples.english_sentence: The car got a flat tyre; we need to get it patched.

mandarin_meaning: 补选 (bǔxuǎn)，为填补公职空缺而举行的选举
english_meaning: by-election; special election held to fill a vacant public office
explanation_mandarin: 因公職出缺（如辭職、死亡或取消資格）而在定期選舉之外舉行，用以選出新的任職者。
explanation_english: An election held outside the regular schedule to fill a vacant public office (for example due to resignation, death, or disqualification).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為議員辭職，政府要喺下個月搞一場補選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 ji5 jyun4 ci4 zik1, zing3 fu2 jiu3 hai2 haa6 go3 jyut6 gaau2 jat1 coeng4 bou2 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为议员辞职，政府要在下个月举行一次补选。
examples.english_sentence: Because the councillor resigned, the government will hold a by-election next month.

mandarin_meaning: 补针；打加强针（也可指缝补衣物）
english_meaning: to get a booster shot; (also) to darn/mend by sewing
explanation_mandarin: 在香港廣東話中，『補針』常用來指接種疫苗的加強針（即再次注射疫苗以增強免疫力）。在更傳統或字面上，也可指用針線縫補衣物的動作。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '補針' commonly refers to receiving a vaccine booster shot (an additional vaccination to strengthen immunity). Literally, it can also mean to darn or mend clothing with a needle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日去打補針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 daa2 bou2 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天去打加强针。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to get a booster shot tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫有窿，要去補針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 jau5 lung4, jiu3 heoi3 bou2 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服有个洞，要去补针（缝补）。
examples.english_sentence: The shirt has a hole; it needs to be mended.

mandarin_meaning: 代班／補班；補課（視語境而定）
english_meaning: to cover a shift; to work an extra/make-up shift; to take a make-up class (context-dependent)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語口語用法，指代替別人上班或補上缺失的班次；在教育情境下亦可指補上缺課或補習的課堂。常見於輪班工作或補課情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese expression meaning to cover someone else's work shift or to do an extra/makeup shift; in educational contexts it can mean attending a make-up class. Common in shift-work and schooling contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要補鐘，幫阿珍頂朝早嗰個班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 bou2 zung1, bong1 aa3 zan1 deng2 ziu1 zou2 go2 go3 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去代班，幫阿珍頂早上的班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to cover a shift tomorrow — I'm covering Ah Zhen's morning shift.

mandarin_meaning: 收拾爛攤子；善後；彌補（別人）的錯誤或掩飾失誤
english_meaning: to clean up someone else's mess; to fix or cover up mistakes; to bail someone out
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，字面是「補鍋/補鑊」，引申為幫人收拾爛攤子、彌補錯誤或替人善後、掩飾失誤。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally 'patch the wok'; it means to clean up someone else's mess, remedy or cover up mistakes, or handle the aftermath on someone else's behalf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫佢補鑊，唔想佢被辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 keoi5 bou2 wok6, m4 soeng2 keoi5 bei6 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我幫他善後，不想他被解雇。
examples.english_sentence: I'll clean up for him; I don't want him to get fired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗唔畀客鬧，我哋要即刻去補鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 m4 bei2 haak3 naau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 heoi3 bou2 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了不被客人責罵，我們要立刻去收拾殘局。
examples.english_sentence: To avoid being scolded by the customer, we need to go fix things right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想畀人發現錯漏，於是搵人嚟幫佢補鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 faat3 jin6 co3 lau6, jyu1 si6 wan2 jan4 lai4 bong1 keoi5 bou2 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想讓人發現他的錯漏，於是找人來幫他收拾爛攤子。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't want people to find out his mistake, so he hired someone to cover it up.

mandarin_meaning: 補救反而讓情況更糟 / 越補越壞
english_meaning: to make matters worse when trying to fix something; an attempt to remedy a problem that causes further loss or deterioration
explanation_mandarin: 形容為了彌補錯誤或掩飾問題而採取的補救措施，結果不但沒解決問題，反而造成更大的損失或使事情惡化。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where attempts to remedy or cover up a mistake end up making things worse or creating additional losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢補鑊唔見枳，越補越糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou2 wok6 m4 gin3 zi2, jyut6 bou2 jyut6 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他補救時反而越補越糟。
examples.english_sentence: His attempt to fix it only made things worse.

mandarin_meaning: 补鞋；修理鞋子
english_meaning: to mend/repair shoes; to work as a cobbler; (figuratively) to patch up something
explanation_mandarin: 指修补、縫補或更換鞋子損壞部分的動作，也可引申為修補或彌補某種損壞或缺失（例如關係、問題等）。
explanation_english: Refers to repairing or mending shoes (stitching, replacing soles, etc.). Can also be used figuratively to mean patching up or fixing something damaged, such as a relationship or problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿伯喺街市幫人補鞋，做咗幾十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baak3 hai2 gaai1 si5 bong1 jan4 bou2 haai4, zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他伯父在街市帮人补鞋，做了几十年。
examples.english_sentence: His uncle mends shoes at the market; he's been doing it for decades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鞋底甩咗，我要趁今晚去補鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haai4 dai2 laat3 zo2, ngo5 jiu3 can3 gam1 maan5 heoi3 bou2 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鞋底掉了，我要趁今晚去补鞋。
examples.english_sentence: The sole came off; I need to get my shoes repaired tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 補票（補交車費或補票罰款）
english_meaning: to buy/pay for a replacement ticket or pay the fare/penalty for travelling without a valid ticket
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語口語中，「補飛」通常指在乘坐公共交通工具時，沒有有效車票而補交票款或支付補票罰款的行為，也可指補買遺失或忘帶的票證。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "補飛" commonly means to pay for a missing or invalid ticket—i.e., buy a replacement ticket or pay the fare/penalty when caught without a valid ticket. It can also mean purchasing a ticket you forgot or lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上車冇帶飛，被查票嘅人發現要補飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 ce1 mou5 daai3 fei1, bei6 caa4 piu3 ge3 jan4 faat3 jin6 jiu3 bou2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上車沒帶票，被查票的人發現要補票。
examples.english_sentence: He boarded without a ticket; when the inspector found out, he had to pay for a ticket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下次出門記得帶八達通，唔好再要補飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 ci3 ceot1 mun4 gei3 dak1 daai3 baat3 daat6 tung1, m4 hou2 zoi3 jiu3 bou2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下次出門記得帶八達通，不要再補票了。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your Octopus card next time so you won't have to buy a replacement ticket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搭的士比司機查到冇票，司機要佢補飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daap3 dik1 si6 bei2 si1 gei1 caa4 dou3 mou5 piu3, si1 gei1 jiu3 keoi5 bou2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搭計程車被司機查到沒票，司機要他補票。
examples.english_sentence: He took a taxi and the driver found he had no ticket, so the driver asked him to pay for one.

mandarin_meaning: 收拾爛攤子；補救錯誤，做善後
english_meaning: to clean up a mess; to fix someone else's mistakes or do damage control
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指在事情出錯或出現混亂時，替人或替一件事收拾善後、補救局面。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to tidy up a mess or fix problems after something goes wrong — often implies taking responsibility for repairing damage or covering up mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰單project搞到一鑊粥，依家要我去補𤶸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 daan1 project gaau2 dou3 jat1 wok6 zuk1, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 ngo5 heoi3 bou2 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個項目弄得一團糟，現在要我去收拾爛攤子。
examples.english_sentence: That project turned into a mess; now I'm the one who has to fix it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔做嘢，出事就叫我去補𤶸，我都頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 m4 zou6 je5, ceot1 si6 zau6 giu3 ngo5 heoi3 bou2 wok6, ngo5 dou1 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常不做事，出事就叫我去收拾爛攤子，我也受不了。
examples.english_sentence: He often shirks work; when things go wrong he expects me to clean up the mess — I can't stand it.

mandarin_meaning: 装（zhuāng）：假装；打扮；安装；包装
english_meaning: to pretend; to dress/dress up; to install; to pack
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語中，「裝」(zong1) 常作動詞使用，可以表示假扮（如裝可憐）、打扮（如裝靚啲）、安裝（如裝軟件）或包裝等意思，具體含義視上下文而定。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '裝' (zong1) is commonly used as a verb meaning to pretend (e.g. pretend to be), to dress or dress up, to install (software/equipment), or to pack — the exact sense depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鍾意裝可憐，連自己嘅錯都唔承認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zung1 ji3 zong1 ho2 lin4, lin4 zi6 gei2 ge3 co3 dou1 m4 sing4 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是喜歡裝可憐，連自己的錯都不承認。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to play the victim and won't admit his mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱裝咗個新應用程式，依家試吓先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 zong1 zo2 go3 san1 jing3 jung6 cing4 sik1, ji4 gaa1 si3 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛安裝了一個新應用程序，現在試一下。
examples.english_sentence: I just installed a new app; I'll try it now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚佢打算裝靚啲去派對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 keoi5 daa2 syun3 zong1 leng3 di1 heoi3 paai3 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚他打算打扮漂亮一點去派對。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight he's going to dress up a bit to go to the party.

mandarin_meaning: 裝逼 / 裝腔作勢
english_meaning: to show off; to act pretentiously; to put on airs
explanation_mandarin: 俚語，指故意誇耀自己或裝作很厲害、很有型以吸引別人注意或提升自己面子。
explanation_english: Colloquial slang meaning to pretend to be impressive or cool, to show off or act pretentiously to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日裝b，好討厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zong1 bi1, hou2 tou2 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是裝逼，真討厭。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is always showing off — so annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺我面前裝b，我都知你有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 zong1 bi1, ngo5 dou1 zi1 nei5 jau5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在我面前裝逼，我知道你有錢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off in front of me — I know you're rich.

mandarin_meaning: 裝作；假裝
english_meaning: to pretend; to feign
explanation_mandarin: 表示假裝成某種樣子、狀態或舉動，但實際並非如此。
explanation_english: To act as if something is the case when it is not; to feign a state, behavior, or feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢裝作冇睇到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong1 zok3 mou5 tai2 dou3 ngo5。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他裝作沒看到我。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended not to see me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好裝作唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zong1 zok3 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別裝作不知道發生了什麼事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend you don't know what's happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢裝作好忙，但其實冇嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong1 zok3 hou2 mong4, daan6 kei4 sat6 mou5 je5 zou6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他裝作很忙，但其實沒事做。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended to be busy, but actually had nothing to do.

mandarin_meaning: 装修（对房屋或室内进行装饰、翻新或修缮）
english_meaning: to renovate; to decorate; renovation (of a house or interior)
explanation_mandarin: 指對房屋或室內空間進行裝飾、翻新或修繕，以改善外觀或功能。
explanation_english: Refers to decorating, refurbishing, or repairing a house or interior space to improve appearance or functionality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算下個月開始裝修間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 zong1 sau1 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算下个月开始装修房子。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to start renovating the house next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裝修要幾耐先完成？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong1 sau1 jiu3 gei2 noi6 sin1 jyun4 sing4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 装修要多久才能完成？
examples.english_sentence: How long will the renovation take?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗一隊人嚟裝修廚房同浴室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cing2 zo2 jat1 deoi6 jan4 lai4 zong1 sau1 cyu4 fong2 tung4 juk6 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们请了一个团队来装修厨房和浴室。
examples.english_sentence: They hired a team to renovate the kitchen and bathroom.

mandarin_meaning: 裝可憐／裝無辜（故意裝出可憐或無辜以獲取同情或利益）
english_meaning: to pretend to be pitiful/innocent or ingratiate oneself; to act fake to gain sympathy or advantage
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指故意擺出可憐、無辜或卑微討好的樣子，以獲得同情、寬恕或其他利益，帶有貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning to deliberately act pitiful, innocent, or submissive in a fake way to obtain sympathy, forgiveness, or advantage. It is pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前裝假狗，求升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 zong1 gaa2 gau2, kau4 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在老闆面前裝可憐，求升職。
examples.english_sentence: He always pretends to be pitiful in front of the boss to ask for a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再裝假狗喇，做錯嘢就承認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi6 zong1 gaa2 gau2 laa3, zou6 co3 je5 zau6 sing4 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別再裝可憐了，做錯事就承認。
examples.english_sentence: Stop pretending to be pitiful; admit your mistake.

mandarin_meaning: 装备（器材、配备）；也可作动词，表示配备、装备
english_meaning: equipment; gear; to equip
explanation_mandarin: 指為完成某項任務或活動所需的器材、裝置或配套，也可指把這些器材配置到位（作動詞）。
explanation_english: Refers to the tools, gear, or devices needed for a task or activity; can also be used as a verb meaning to provide or outfit with such gear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要先買齊所有嘅裝備先出發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 maai5 cai4 so2 jau5 ge3 zong1 bei6 sin1 ceot1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要先把所有装备都买齐才能出发。
examples.english_sentence: We need to buy all the equipment before we can set off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢裝備得好，就可以應付任何情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong1 bei6 dak1 hou2, zau6 ho2 ji5 jing3 fu6 jam6 ho4 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他装备得好，就可以应付任何情况。
examples.english_sentence: If he's well-equipped, he can handle any situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部相機嘅裝備好齊，連三腳架都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 soeng2 gei1 ge3 zong1 bei6 hou2 cai4, lin4 saam1 goek3 gaa3 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台相机的配备很齐全，连三脚架都有。
examples.english_sentence: This camera comes well-equipped; it even includes a tripod.

mandarin_meaning: 装傻 / 装糊涂（佯装不知情或不懂）
english_meaning: to pretend to be stupid / to feign ignorance / act clueless
explanation_mandarin: 表示故意裝作不懂或不知情，以迴避責任或避免麻煩、責備。
explanation_english: Means deliberately acting as if one doesn't understand or know something, usually to avoid responsibility, blame, or trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老闆面前裝傻扮懵，想避責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 zong1 so4 baan6 mung4, soeng2 bei6 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在老板面前装傻装糊涂，想推卸责任。
examples.english_sentence: He often plays dumb in front of the boss to shirk responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師問佢問題，佢就裝傻扮懵，結果畀同學笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 man6 keoi5 man6 tai4, keoi5 zau6 zong1 so4 baan6 mung4, git3 gwo2 bei2 tung4 hok6 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师问他问题，他就装傻装糊涂，结果被同学嘲笑。
examples.english_sentence: When the teacher asked him a question, he pretended not to know and ended up being laughed at by classmates.

mandarin_meaning: 裝（上）冷氣；裝作冷漠／冷淡
english_meaning: to install air-conditioning; (slang) to act aloof or play cool
explanation_mandarin: 「裝冷氣」字面上可指安裝冷氣機；在香港粵語口語中常作俚語，表示故意表現得冷淡或裝作高冷、與人保持距離。
explanation_english: Literally means to install an air conditioner. In Hong Kong Cantonese slang it often means to act cold or aloof—putting on a cool/indifferent attitude to keep distance from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺我面前裝冷氣，唔想同我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 zong1 laang5 hei3, m4 soeng2 tung4 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在我面前裝作冷漠，不想和我說話。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts aloof in front of me; he doesn't want to talk to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算喺間屋裝冷氣，因為夏天太熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 hai2 gaan1 uk1 zong1 laang5 hei3, jan1 wai6 haa6 tin1 taai3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們打算在房子裡安裝冷氣，因為夏天太熱。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to install air conditioning in the apartment because it's too hot in summer.

mandarin_meaning: 装卸
english_meaning: to load and unload (goods); loading/unloading
explanation_mandarin: 指将货物装上或从运输工具、仓库等处卸下，进行装载与搬运的动作或工作。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of loading goods onto, or unloading goods from, vehicles, containers, or storage — the handling of cargo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班工人負責裝卸貨物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 gung1 jan4 fu6 zaak3 zong1 se6 fo3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这班工人负责装卸货物。
examples.english_sentence: These workers are responsible for loading and unloading the cargo.

mandarin_meaning: 装嵌（安装、嵌装零件或组件）
english_meaning: to assemble and fit; to install or mount parts/components
explanation_mandarin: 指把零件或元件裝配、嵌入或安裝到機器、設備或其他器材中的動作，常用於技術或維修場合。
explanation_english: Refers to the action of assembling, fitting, or installing parts or components into a machine, device, or equipment; commonly used in technical or repair contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲零件要裝嵌好先至可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ling4 gin6 jiu3 zong1ham3 hou2 sin1 zi1 ho2 ji5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些零件要先装嵌好才能使用。
examples.english_sentence: These parts need to be assembled/installed properly before they can be used.

mandarin_meaning: 裝幀 / 裝訂（書籍的封面、裝訂和版式設計）
english_meaning: book binding; book design/cover design (the design and production of a book's cover, binding and layout)
explanation_mandarin: 指圖書的封面設計、裝訂方式與版式等外觀與結構的設計與製作，常用於出版與印刷領域。
explanation_english: Refers to the design and production of a book's exterior and structure — cover design, binding method, and layout. Commonly used in publishing and printing contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅裝幀好靚，好有設計感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 zong1 zang1 hou2 leng3, hou2 jau5 cit3 gai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的装帧很漂亮，很有设计感。
examples.english_sentence: The book's binding/cover design is beautiful and very stylish.

mandarin_meaning: 裝（填）彈弓；（俚語）裝腔作勢、虛張聲勢
english_meaning: to load a slingshot; (slang) to put on an act, bluff, or show off
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指把彈丸裝入彈弓；在口語或俚語中可指做出威風或虛張聲勢的動作，表現得好像有實力或準備還擊。
explanation_english: Literally, to load a slingshot with a projectile. Colloquially (slang), it can mean to put on a show, bluff, or act tough as if prepared to fight or retaliate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔喺公園度裝彈弓，想射樹上嘅小鳥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 hai2 gung1 jyun4 dou6 zong1 daan6 gung1, soeng2 se6 syu6 seong6 ge3 siu2 niu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩在公園裡裝彈弓，想射樹上的小鳥。
examples.english_sentence: The kid is loading a slingshot in the park, trying to shoot the small birds in the tree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺朋友面前裝彈弓，其實冇真材實料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 pang4 jau5 min6 cin4 zong1 daan6 gung1, kei4 sat6 mou5 zan1 coi4 sat6 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在朋友面前裝彈弓，其實沒有真材實料。
examples.english_sentence: He always shows off in front of friends, but actually he lacks real ability.

mandarin_meaning: 装扮；打扮；伪装
english_meaning: to dress up; to dress/put on a disguise; to decorate one's appearance
explanation_mandarin: 指改變穿著或外表，打扮成某種樣子或偽裝以達到特定形象或目的。
explanation_english: To change one's clothing or appearance to achieve a certain look, to dress up, or to disguise oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日裝扮得好靚，好有氣質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zong1 baan6 dak1 hou2 leng3, hou2 jau5 hei3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天打扮得很漂亮，很有气质。
examples.english_sentence: She dressed up nicely today; she looks very elegant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 萬聖節我哋要裝扮成超級英雄去派糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man6 sing3 zit3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zong1 baan6 sing4 ciu1 kap1 jing1 hung4 heoi3 paai3 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 万圣节我们要装扮成超级英雄去发糖。
examples.english_sentence: For Halloween we'll dress up as superheroes to hand out candy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想露面，所以裝扮成另一個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 lou6 min6, so2 ji5 zong1 baan6 sing4 ling6 jat1 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想露面，所以装扮成另一个人。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't want to be recognized, so he disguised himself as someone else.

mandarin_meaning: 装束；服饰；打扮
english_meaning: attire; outfit; costume; one's dress or overall appearance
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人的穿著、服飾或整體打扮，可指日常服裝或表演用的戲服與造型。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's clothing, garments, or overall dressing/appearance; can mean everyday outfits or costumes used for performances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日嘅裝束好有型，吸引咗唔少人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1jat6 ge3 zong1 zuk1 hou2 jau5 jing4, kap1 jan5 zo2 m4 siu2 jan4 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天的装束很有型，吸引了不少人的注意。
examples.english_sentence: His outfit today is very stylish and attracted a lot of attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演出嘅裝束係專門為咗重現古代服飾而設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 ceot1 ge3 zong1 zuk1 hai6 zyun1 mun4 wai4 zo2 cung4 jin6 gu2 doi6 fuk6 sik1 ji4 cit3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演出的装束是专门为了重现古代服饰而设计的。
examples.english_sentence: The performance's costumes were specially designed to recreate ancient clothing.

mandarin_meaning: 装模作样 (假装、做作)
english_meaning: to put on an act; to be pretentious; to put on airs
explanation_mandarin: 指故意擺出某種姿態或樣子，做作以博取注意或讓人留下印象，帶有貶義。
explanation_english: To deliberately adopt a showy or pretentious manner to impress others or deceive; usually derogatory, meaning to put on an act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺人面前裝模作樣，好似好叻，其實乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 zong1 mou4 zok3 joeng6, hou2 ci5 hou2 lek3, kei4 sat6 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在別人面前裝模作樣，好像很了不起，其實什麼都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on an act in front of others, acting like he's great, but actually he doesn't know anything.

mandarin_meaning: 装配/安装机器；设置（电脑/设备）
english_meaning: to install or assemble a machine/device; to set up a computer (hardware/software)
explanation_mandarin: 指為機器或電子設備安裝硬件或軟件、配置系統，常用於電腦或其他電子設備的安裝與調試。
explanation_english: Refers to installing hardware or software for a machine or electronic device, configuring the system; commonly used for computer/device setup and assembly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去幫佢裝機，裝返啲必需嘅軟件同驅動程式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 bong1 keoi5 zong1 gei1, zong1 faan1 di1 bit1 seoi1 ge3 jyun5 gin6 tung4 keoi1 dung6 cing4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去帮他装机，安装必要的软件和驱动程序。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to install his computer today, installing the necessary software and drivers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舖講明裝機服務會另外收費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 gong2 ming4 zong1 gei1 fuk6 mou6 wui5 ling6 ngoi6 sau1 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 店家说明装机服务会另外收费。
examples.english_sentence: The shop stated that installation service will be charged separately.

mandarin_meaning: 装柜；把货物装进集装箱或货柜
english_meaning: to load goods into a (shipping) container; to containerize
explanation_mandarin: 指在物流或運輸作業中，將貨物裝入貨櫃或集裝箱以便運輸或存放。
explanation_english: Refers to the logistics operation of loading goods into a shipping container or containerizing cargo for transport or storage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢批貨今晚要裝櫃，記得準備好單據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pat1 fo3 gam1 maan5 jiu3 zong1 gwai6, gei3 dak1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 daan1 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這批貨今晚要裝櫃，記得準備好單據。
examples.english_sentence: This shipment needs to be loaded into the container tonight; remember to prepare the documents.

mandarin_meaning: 装潢 (zhuānghuáng) — 装修、室内装饰
english_meaning: interior decoration; to decorate/renovate (interior)
explanation_mandarin: 指对房屋或店铺进行内部装修、布置，也可指装饰的风格或效果（尤指室内装饰）。
explanation_english: Refers to decorating or renovating the interior of a house, shop, etc.; can also mean the decorative style or finish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月會裝潢間屋，依家要開始諗設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 zong1 wong4 gaan1 uk1, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 hoi1 ci2 nam2 cit3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月会装修房子，现在要开始考虑设计。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to renovate the apartment next month; we need to start thinking about the design now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間店啲裝潢好有心思，客人多咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 dim3 di1 zong1 wong4 hou2 jau5 sam1 si1, haak3 jan4 do1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店的装潢很有心思，顾客多了。
examples.english_sentence: The shop's decoration is very thoughtful; it's attracting more customers.

mandarin_meaning: 装甲；甲胄；有装甲的（如装甲车、装甲部队）
english_meaning: armor; armored (as in armored vehicle or units); armor plating
explanation_mandarin: 指用來保護身體或機械的甲冑、裝甲板，或表示具有裝甲防護的狀態（例如裝甲車、裝甲部隊）。
explanation_english: Refers to armor or armor plating used to protect a person or machine, or describes something that is armored (e.g., armored vehicle, armored unit).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個裝甲車停咗喺路口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zong1 gaap3 ce1 ting4 zo2 hai2 lou6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那辆装甲车停在路口。
examples.english_sentence: The armored vehicle stopped at the intersection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裝甲部隊向前推進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong1 gaap3 bou6 deoi6 hoeng3 cin4 teoi1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 装甲部队向前推进。
examples.english_sentence: The armored units advanced forward.

mandarin_meaning: 装甲车（zhuāngjiǎchē）
english_meaning: armored vehicle (armored car, armored personnel carrier, or tank)
explanation_mandarin: 指装有装甲防护的军用或特种车辆，用于保护乘员和装备，类型包括坦克、装甲运兵车、装甲巡逻车等。
explanation_english: A vehicle fitted with armor plating for protection, typically military or special-purpose; includes tanks, armored personnel carriers, and armored cars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 博物館入面展咗一架二戰時期嘅裝甲車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 zin2 zo2 jat1 ga3 ji6 zin3 si4 kei4 ge3 zong1 gaap3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 博物馆里展出了一辆二战时期的装甲车。
examples.english_sentence: The museum is displaying an armored vehicle from World War II.

mandarin_meaning: 裝瘋賣傻（裝作瘋癲或裝傻以逃避責任或欺騙他人）
english_meaning: to pretend to be crazy or play dumb (to avoid responsibility, deceive, or get away with something)
explanation_mandarin: 故意裝作瘋癲或傻樣，表現出不懂、不記得或無辜，以逃避責任、混淆他人或謀取利益。
explanation_english: To deliberately feign craziness or foolishness, acting as if unaware or innocent in order to avoid responsibility, confuse others, or gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯事之後竟然裝瘋賣傻，話自己唔記得發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 si6 zi1 hau6 ging2 jin4 zong1 fung1 maai6 so4, waa6 zi6 gei2 m4 gei3 dak1 faat3 saang1 gwo3 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯事後竟然裝瘋賣傻，說自己不記得發生了什麼事。
examples.english_sentence: After making a mistake, he actually pretended to be dumb, saying he didn't remember what happened.

mandarin_meaning: 裝神弄鬼 (裝腔作勢、耍花招以欺騙或博取注意)
english_meaning: to put on a show / act mysteriously or deceitfully to attract attention or play tricks
explanation_mandarin: 形容故意擺出神秘或誇張的樣子來欺騙、迷惑別人或吸引注意，常帶貶義。
explanation_english: Describes deliberately acting mysterious or putting on a show to deceive, confuse others, or attract attention; often derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺人面前裝神弄鬼，淨係想引人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 zong1 san4 nung6 gwai2, zing6 hai6 soeng2 jan5 jan4 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在別人面前裝神弄鬼，只是想吸引別人的注意。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is always putting on a show in front of others — just trying to attract attention.

mandarin_meaning: 装置 / 安装、设备
english_meaning: device; installation; to install or set up
explanation_mandarin: 「裝置」可作名詞，指各種設備或器具；亦可作動詞，表示安裝或設置某物。
explanation_english: “裝置” can be a noun meaning a device, piece of equipment, or installation; it can also be a verb meaning to install or set up something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺大廈入面裝置咗新嘅煙霧探測器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 daai6 haa6 jap6 min6 zong1 zi3 zo2 san1 ge3 jin1 mou6 taam3 cak1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在大厦里安装了新的烟雾探测器。
examples.english_sentence: They installed new smoke detectors in the building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺手機嘅設定入面改變裝置嘅語言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 sau2 gei1 ge3 sit3 ding6 jap6 min6 goi2 bin3 zong1 zi3 ge3 jyu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在手机的设置里更改装置的语言。
examples.english_sentence: You can change the device's language in the phone's settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個藝術裝置喺展覽廳入面好惹人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ngai6 seot6 zong1 zi3 hai2 zin2 laam5 teng1 jap6 min6 hou2 je5 jan4 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个艺术装置在展览厅里很引人注目。
examples.english_sentence: This art installation in the gallery is very eye-catching.

mandarin_meaning: 裝聋作哑（假裝聽不見或不回應）
english_meaning: to play deaf and dumb; to pretend not to hear or respond (feign ignorance/indifference)
explanation_mandarin: 故意假裝聽不見或不回應，以迴避責任、責備或參與某事。
explanation_english: To deliberately pretend not to hear or respond in order to avoid responsibility, blame, or involvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明知係佢錯，但喺上司面前就裝聾作啞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4ming4 zi1 hai6 keoi5 co3, daan6 hai6 soeng6si1 min6 cin4 zau6 zong1 lung4 zok3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明知道是他的錯，但在上司面前就裝聾作哑。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly knew it was his fault, but in front of his boss he just played deaf and dumb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府面對批評，一向都係裝聾作啞，冇乜回應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3fu2 min6 deoi3 pai1ping4, jat1hoeng3 dou1 hai6 zong1 lung4 zok3 aa3, mou5 mat1 wui4jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府面對批評，一向都裝聾作哑，沒有太多回應。
examples.english_sentence: The government, when faced with criticism, always plays deaf and dumb and gives little response.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到有人偷嘢，鄰居都裝聾作啞，唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 jau5 jan4 tau1 je5, leon4 geoi1 dou1 zong1 lung4 zok3 aa3, m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到有人偷東西，鄰居都裝聾作哑，不敢出聲。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing someone steal, the neighbors all pretended not to notice and didn't dare to speak up.

mandarin_meaning: 装腔作势：故意摆出某种姿态或做作的样子，装模作样。
english_meaning: to put on airs; to affect an attitude; to pose or act pretentiously
explanation_mandarin: 表示故意摆出一副重要或威严的样子，或做出虚假的态度以取悦或欺骗别人。
explanation_english: Describes deliberately adopting a showy or pretentious manner to impress others or affect an appearance of importance; to put on a pose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺人面前裝腔作勢，好令人反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 zong1 hong1 zok3 sai3, hou2 ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在别人面前装腔作势，令人反感。
examples.english_sentence: He is always putting on airs in front of others; it's off-putting.

mandarin_meaning: 安裝；設置
english_meaning: to install; to set up; installation
explanation_mandarin: 指把設備或系統安裝、設置好，使其能正常運作。常用於科技、工程或保安等領域。
explanation_english: To install or set up equipment or systems so they function properly. Commonly used in technical, engineering, or security contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企要裝設一部新冷氣機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jiu3 zong1 cit3 jat1 bou6 san1 laang5 hei3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡要安裝一部新的冷氣機。
examples.english_sentence: We need to install a new air conditioner at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經喺所有出入口裝設咗閉路電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 hai2 so2 jau5 ceot1 jap6 hau2 zong1 cit3 zo2 bai3 lou6 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經在所有出入口安裝了閉路電視。
examples.english_sentence: The company has installed CCTV at all entrances and exits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個系統需要由專業人士嚟裝設同測試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 seoi1 jiu3 jau4 zyun1 jip6 jan4 si6 lai4 zong1 cit3 tung4 cak1 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個系統需要由專業人士來安裝並測試。
examples.english_sentence: This system needs to be installed and tested by professionals.

mandarin_meaning: 穿衣、穿戴（自己把衣物或護具穿在身上）
english_meaning: to dress oneself; to put on clothes or gear (including protective equipment or costumes)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語詞語（口語），表示為自己穿上衣服或配戴裝備，也可指穿上特定服裝或護具（如戲服、防護衣等）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to put on clothes or equipment oneself. It can refer to everyday dressing or donning specific outfits or protective gear (e.g., costumes, PPE).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你出街記住裝身喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ceot1 gaai1 gei3 zyu6 zong1 san1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你出門記得穿好衣服喔。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to get dressed before you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫護人員入隔離區前要裝身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 jap6 gaak3 lei4 keoi1 cin4 jiu3 zong1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫護人員進入隔離區前要穿戴防護用品。
examples.english_sentence: Healthcare workers must put on protective gear before entering the isolation area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演戲或扮演角色前要先裝身，化妝同埋著戲服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 hei3 waak6 ze2 baan6 jin2 gok3 sik1 cin4 jiu3 sin1 zong1 san1, faa3 zong1 tung4 maai4 zoek3 hei3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演戲或扮演角色前要先穿上戲服並化妝。
examples.english_sentence: For acting or cosplay, you need to get dressed first — put on the costume and makeup.

mandarin_meaning: 装腔作势；卖弄；故意显摆自己（粗俗俚语）
english_meaning: to show off; to act pretentiously; to put on airs (vulgar/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 指故意擺出比別人優越或有本事的樣子，往往是虛張聲勢或愛現的行為，屬粗俗用語。
explanation_english: A vulgar slang verb meaning to put on airs or show off — pretending to be superior, impressive, or more capable than one really is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度裝逼，講自己有幾勁，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zong1 bik1, gong2 zi6 gei2 jau5 gei2 ging6, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那裡裝逼，說自己有多厲害，真煩人。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps showing off, bragging about how great he is — it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 用釘子固定；裝上釘子；（作為裝飾）鑲上鉚釘
english_meaning: to fasten or attach with nails; to nail on; to stud (decorate with metal studs)
explanation_mandarin: 指用釘子或鉚釘把物件固定或做為裝飾，例如在皮帶、鞋或木製品上釘上金屬釘或鉚釘。
explanation_english: To fix or attach something using nails or studs; often used for fastening or decorating items (e.g., adding metal studs to belts, shoes, or nailing objects in place).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺皮帶上面裝釘咗幾粒金屬釘，睇落型格好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 pei4 daai3 soeng6 min6 zong1 ding1 zo2 gei2 lap1 gam1 suk6 ding1, tai2 lok6 jing4 gaak3 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在皮帶上裝了幾顆金屬釘，看起來更有型。
examples.english_sentence: He put several metal studs on his belt; it looks much more stylish.

mandarin_meaning: 盛饭 / 装饭
english_meaning: to serve/scoop/pack rice
explanation_mandarin: 指把米饭盛入碗、盒或盤中（亦可指打包飯盒）。在餐飲或家居情境中常用。
explanation_english: To scoop or serve rice into a bowl, plate, or container (including packing rice for takeaway). Commonly used in dining and household contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽咪幫我裝飯落膠盒，帶去公司食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 mi1 bong1 ngo5 zong1 faan6 lok6 gaau1 hap6, daai3 heoi3 gung1 si1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈帮我把饭装到塑料盒，带去公司吃。
examples.english_sentence: My mom packed my rice into a plastic container for me to take to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食堂人手少，工人要快手裝飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 tong4 jan4 sau2 siu2, gung1 jan4 jiu3 faai3 sau2 zong1 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 食堂人手少，工作人员要快手装饭。
examples.english_sentence: The cafeteria is short-staffed, so the workers have to quickly serve the rice.

mandarin_meaning: 装饰 (zhuāngshì)
english_meaning: decorate; ornament; decoration
explanation_mandarin: 指用各種物品或元素美化、點綴空間、物件或服飾，也可指裝點外表以增加美觀。
explanation_english: To adorn or embellish a space, object, or clothing with decorative items; can also mean a decorative item or ornament.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要裝飾廳堂，準備擺花同掛畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zong1 sik1 teng1 tong4, zeon2 bei6 baai2 faa1 tung4 gwaa3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要裝飾廳堂，準備擺花和掛畫。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to decorate the living room, getting flowers and paintings ready.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件頸鏈係一件細細嘅裝飾品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 geng2 lin2 hai6 jat1 gin6 sai3 sai3 ge3 zong1 sik1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條項鍊是一件小巧的裝飾品。
examples.english_sentence: This necklace is a small decorative piece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司每年聖誕都會裝飾辦公室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mui5 nin4 sing3 daan3 dou1 wui5 zong1 sik1 baan6 gung1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司每年聖誕都會裝飾辦公室。
examples.english_sentence: The company decorates the office every Christmas.

mandarin_meaning: 装饰品
english_meaning: decoration; ornament; decorative item; accessory
explanation_mandarin: 指用來裝飾房間、衣物或其他物品的物件，如小擺設、飾品、掛飾等，用以美化或點綴。
explanation_english: Items used to decorate a room, clothing, or other objects—such as trinkets, ornaments, or hangings—intended to beautify or embellish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲新裝飾品擺喺廳度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 san1 zong1 sik1 ban2 baai2 hai2 teng1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一些新的装饰品摆在客厅里。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some new decorative items and put them in the living room.

mandarin_meaning: 裝作純潔/可愛、裝乖以博取關注或好感
english_meaning: to pretend to be innocent/cute or act coy to gain attention, sympathy, or favor
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，用來形容某人故意裝作純潔、可愛或乖巧，從而博取別人的關注、同情或好感。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang verb describing someone who deliberately acts innocent, cute, or well-behaved to attract attention, sympathy, or favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度裝香啦，大家都睇得出你唔係咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zong1 hoeng1 laa3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 tai2 dak1 ceot1 nei5 m4 hai6 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別在那裡裝香了，大家都看得出你不是那樣的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act coy/innocent here; everyone can tell you're not like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺男朋友面前裝香，想攞多啲關注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 naam4 pang4 jau5 min6 cin4 zong1 hoeng1, soeng2 lo2 do1 di1 gwaan1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她總是在男朋友面前裝香，想得到更多關注。
examples.english_sentence: She always acts cute/innocent in front of her boyfriend to get more attention.

mandarin_meaning: 袈裟（佛教僧人的外袍）
english_meaning: kasaya; Buddhist monk's robe (outer robe)
explanation_mandarin: 指佛教僧人所穿的外袍，常見於僧侶的儀式或日常服飾；此字常見於詞語「袈裟」。
explanation_english: Refers to the outer robe worn by Buddhist monastics (kasaya); commonly seen in rituals and the daily dress of monks and nuns. The character often appears in the compound "袈裟."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師父著住件裟喺廟入面誦經。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 saa1 hai2 miu6 jap6 min6 sung6 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 師父穿着袈裟在廟裡誦經。
examples.english_sentence: The master/monk, wearing a kasaya, is chanting sutras inside the temple.

mandarin_meaning: 裡／里面（lǐ），表示在某物的內部或範圍之內
english_meaning: inside; within
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某物的內部或範圍之內，常用於表示位置，如「書包裡」、「屋裡」。
explanation_english: Indicates the interior or within a certain area; commonly used to denote location, as in 'in the bag' or 'inside the room.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺屋裡開燈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 uk1 leoi5 hoi1 dang1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在屋裡開燈吧。
examples.english_sentence: Turn on the light inside the room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 書包裡有本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 baau1 leoi5 jau5 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 書包裡有一本書。
examples.english_sentence: There is a book in the backpack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你心裡諗緊啲乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sam1 leoi5 lam2 gan2 di1 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你心裡在想些什麼？
examples.english_sentence: What are you thinking (in your heart)?

mandarin_meaning: 裡 / 裡面 (lǐ / lǐmiàn)
english_meaning: inside; within; in
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物或某處的內部位置，相當於「裡面」、「內部」。常用於表示位置關係。
explanation_english: Indicates the interior or internal position of something (inside, within). Used to express location or spatial relation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個箱裡有啲衫，你要唔要我拎出嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 soeng1 leoi5 jau5 di1 saam1, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 ling1 ceot1 lai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 箱子裡有一些衣服，你要不要我拿出來？
examples.english_sentence: There are some clothes in the box. Do you want me to take them out?

mandarin_meaning: 裡面；在內（口語用法）
english_meaning: inside; within (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「裡便」為粵語口語或書面變體，用來表示位置上的「裡面」、「在內」，可作方位或副詞性短語使用，語感偏口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning 'inside' or 'within'. It functions as a locative term or adverbial phrase indicating something is in the interior; commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲杯擺咗喺箱裡便，唔使擔心會跌爛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bui1 baai2 zo2 hai2 soeng1 leoi5 bin6, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 wui5 dit3 laan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 杯子放在箱子裡面，不用擔心會掉碎。
examples.english_sentence: The cups are placed inside the box, no need to worry they'll fall and break.

jyutping: leoi5 bin1 / (常用寫法：裡面 leoi5 min6)
mandarin_meaning: （口語/錯寫）在裡面；裡邊
english_meaning: inside; within (colloquial/nonstandard spelling of 'inside')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 方位詞／名詞性短語（表示位置）
explanation_mandarin: 「裡便」並非常用標準字形，常見於口語或打字時把「裡邊」或「裡面」錯寫成「裡便」。在香港粵語中通常用來表示「在裡面、在內部」。建議書寫時使用「裡邊/裡面/入面」。
explanation_english: “裡便” is a nonstandard spelling often used in casual Cantonese writing or speech to mean “inside” (usually intended as 裡邊 or 裡面). It is colloquial/misspelled; the standard forms are 裡邊 (leoi5 bin1) or 裡面 (leoi5 min6).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲嘢放喺裡便度呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 je5 fong3 hai2 leoi5 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的東西放在裡面嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are your things placed inside?

mandarin_meaning: 裡面 / 里面 (lǐmiàn)
english_meaning: inside; within
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 方位詞（表示位置，可作名詞或副詞）
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，表示在某物或某處的內部，既可指具體空間，也可引申為心裡、內心等抽象位置。相當於普通話的「裡、裡面、裡邊」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese locative term meaning 'inside' or 'within'. It can refer to physical interior spaces or be used figuratively (e.g. 'in one's heart'). Equivalent to Mandarin '裡/裡面'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個箱裡底有啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 soeng1 leoi5 dai2 jau5 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 箱子裡面有一些東西。
examples.english_sentence: There are some things inside the box.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你屋裡底有冇人？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 uk1 leoi5 dai2 jau5 mou5 jan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你屋子裡面有沒有人？
examples.english_sentence: Is there anyone inside your house?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我心裡底諗咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 sam1 leoi5 dai2 nam2 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事我在心裡想了很久。
examples.english_sentence: I've been thinking about this in my heart for a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 内应外合 / 裡應外合（內外勾結，互相配合）
english_meaning: Collusion between insiders and outsiders; coordinated action from inside and outside (often secretive or conspiratorial)
explanation_mandarin: 指內部人員和外部勢力暗中互相配合或勾結，從內外共同達成某種目的，常含貶義或涉非法行為。
explanation_english: Refers to insiders and outsiders secretly coordinating or colluding to achieve a goal; an inside-outside cooperative scheme, often with negative or illegal connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑有人做裡應外合，幫外面嗰啲人滲透入去偷資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 jau5 jan4 zou6 leoi5 jing3 ngoi6 hap6, bong1 ngoi6 min6 go2 di1 jan4 sam3 tau3 jap6 heoi3 tau1 zi1 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方怀疑有人里应外合，帮外面的人渗透进去偷取资料。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect someone is colluding from inside and outside, helping outsiders infiltrate and steal data.

mandarin_meaning: 里应外合（裡應外合）：內外相互配合，通常指內部和外部勾結以達成陰謀或行動。
english_meaning: Coordination between insiders and outsiders (collusion); working together from the inside and outside to carry out a plan or attack.
explanation_mandarin: 指內部人員與外部勢力互相配合，暗中協助或勾結，使某個計劃或行動得以實施。
explanation_english: Refers to insiders and outsiders coordinating (often secretly) to help a plan or scheme succeed; implies collusion or covert cooperation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 原來佢哋係裡應外合，先可以偷走公司啲資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 loi4 keoi5 dei6 hai6 lei5 jing3 ngoi6 hap6, sin1 ho2 ji5 tau1 zau2 gung1 si1 di1 zi1 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 原来他们里应外合，才偷走了公司的资料。
examples.english_sentence: It turned out they were colluding from the inside and outside, which allowed them to steal the company's data.

mandarin_meaning: 里海（世界上最大的內陸鹹水湖，位於歐洲與亞洲之間）
english_meaning: Caspian Sea (the world's largest inland saltwater lake/sea, located between Europe and Asia)
explanation_mandarin: 里海（傳統字為「裡海」）是一個位於歐洲與亞洲交界的內陸鹹水湖/內海，為世界上面積最大的封閉海域，周邊國家包括俄羅斯、哈薩克斯坦、土庫曼斯坦、伊朗及阿塞拜疆等。
explanation_english: The Caspian Sea (written 裡海 in traditional characters) is an inland saltwater lake/sea located between Europe and Asia. It is the largest enclosed inland body of water by area, bordered by Russia, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Iran and Azerbaijan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裡海係世界上最大嘅內陸鹹水湖，位於歐亞之間，周邊有俄羅斯、哈薩克、土庫曼、伊朗同阿塞拜疆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi5 hoi2 hai6 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 noi6 luk6 haam4 seoi2 wu4, wai6 jyu1 au1 aa3 zi1 gaan1, zau1 bin1 jau5 ngo4 lo4 si1, haa1 saat3 hak1, tou2 fu3 maan6, ji1 long5 tung4 aa3 sak1 baai3 goeng1.
