explanation_mandarin: 指褲子套在腿上的部分或褲腳的管狀部分，也可以指褲子的下擺或褲腿寬窄。
explanation_english: Refers to the part of pants that covers the leg (the tubular section or hem). Can describe the width or style of the pant leg.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件褲嘅褲管好闊，著落好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 fu3 ge3 fu3 gun2 hou2 fut3, zoek3 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的裤管很宽，穿着很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The pant legs on his/her pants are wide and very comfortable to wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條牛仔褲褲管太窄，著唔到靴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 ngau4 zai2 fu3 fu3 gun2 taai3 zaak6, zoek3 m4 dou2 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条牛仔裤的裤管太窄，穿不了靴子。
examples.english_sentence: The pant legs of these jeans are too narrow to fit over boots.

mandarin_meaning: 裤脚（裤子的下端或裤腿部分）
english_meaning: pant leg; trouser leg; the hem/lower part of a pair of trousers
explanation_mandarin: 指褲子的下端或褲腿部位，常指靠近腳踝的部分，也可指褲子的邊口或褲腳口。
explanation_english: Refers to the lower part of trousers—the trouser leg or hem near the ankle; can also mean the opening/edge of the pant leg.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你褲腳有破，快啲補一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fu3 goek3 jau5 po3, faai3 di1 bou2 jat1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的褲腳破了，快點補一補。
examples.english_sentence: Your pant leg is torn — fix it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條褲褲腳太長，會拖到地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 fu3 fu3 goek3 taai3 coeng4, wui5 to1 dou3 dei6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條褲子的褲腳太長，會拖到地面。
examples.english_sentence: The pant leg on these trousers is too long and will drag on the ground.

mandarin_meaning: 裤袋 / 裤子上的口袋
english_meaning: pants pocket; trouser pocket
explanation_mandarin: 指褲子上用來放置物品的小口袋，例如放手機、錢包或鑰匙等。
explanation_english: The small pocket on a pair of pants used to hold items such as a phone, wallet, or keys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我把電話放咗喺褲袋度，依家搵唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ba2 din6 waa2 fong3 zo2 hai2 fu3 doi6 dou6, ji1 gaa1 wan2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把电话放在裤袋里，现在找不到。
examples.english_sentence: I put my phone in my pants pocket and now I can't find it.

mandarin_meaning: 裤裆
english_meaning: crotch (of trousers); crotch area
explanation_mandarin: 指褲子在胯下、中間的位置，即人腿之間與褲子接觸的那一部分，也可泛指該處的狀況（如濕、破等）。
explanation_english: Refers to the crotch area of trousers—the part where the legs meet and the pants join; can also refer to the condition of that area (e.g. wet, torn).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你褲襠濕咗未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fu3 dong1 sap1 zo2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的裤裆湿了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is your crotch wet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條褲個褲襠破咗，要補返先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 fu3 go3 fu3 dong1 po3 zo2, jiu3 bou2 faan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裤子的裤裆破了，需要补一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: The crotch of the pants is torn; it needs mending.

mandarin_meaning: 裤头；裤子的腰部；口语也可指内裤
english_meaning: waistband (of pants); the waist area of trousers; colloquially, underpants/underwear
explanation_mandarin: 指裤子围在腰部的部分（如弹性或布料形成的腰圈）。在口语中，有时也用来指内裤（尤其是儿童或非正式场合的用法）。
explanation_english: Refers to the waistband or waist area of pants (the elastic or fabric band around the waist). Informally, it can also be used to mean underwear/underpants in casual speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我褲頭太緊，唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fu3 tau4 taai3 gan2, m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的裤头太紧，不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: My waistband is too tight and uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得換褲頭未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 wun6 fu3 tau4 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得换内裤了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Did you remember to change your underwear?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我條褲嘅褲頭鬆咗，要繫返條腰帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tiu4 fu3 ge3 fu3 tau4 sung1 zo2, jiu3 hai3 faan1 tiu4 jiu1 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我那条裤子的裤头松了，要系回腰带。
examples.english_sentence: The waistband of my pants has become loose; I need to fasten my belt back on.

mandarin_meaning: 裤带 / 裤头的带子（用于固定裤子或装饰）
english_meaning: belt; the strap at the waistband of pants used to secure or decorate them
explanation_mandarin: 指系在褲頭上的帶子，用來固定褲子或作為裝飾。可指腰帶、褲腰上的繫帶或帶扣。
explanation_english: Refers to the strap attached to the waistband of pants used to hold the pants up or for decoration; can mean a belt, waistband strap, or buckle strap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你褲頭帶唔見咗，要買條新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fu3 tau4 daai3 m4 gin3 zo2, jiu3 maai5 tiu4 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的裤带不见了，要买一条新的。
examples.english_sentence: Your belt is missing; you need to buy a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 褲頭帶甩咗，褲會跌落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu3 tau4 daai3 lat1 zo2, fu3 wui5 dit3 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裤腰带脱落了，裤子会掉下来。
examples.english_sentence: The waistband's strap came off; the pants will fall down.

mandarin_meaning: 褲襠 / 褲檔
english_meaning: crotch (of pants); crotch seam/gusset
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，指褲子連接內側的檔位或襠部位，即褲子的『褲襠』處，常用於日常描述衣物破損或縫補位置。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for the crotch area of trousers — the crotch seam or gusset. Commonly used in everyday speech to describe the part of a garment that may be torn or need mending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲褲骨位有洞，要唔要我幫你補？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 fu3 gwat1 wai6 jau5 dung6, jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 nei5 bou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的褲襠有洞，要不要我幫你補？
examples.english_sentence: Your pants have a hole in the crotch. Do you want me to mend it?

mandarin_meaning: 褲子裂開（褲襠破裂）
english_meaning: pants split (usually at the crotch)
explanation_mandarin: 俗語/俚語，指褲子在襠部或某處被撕裂或破開，常用於形容尷尬的情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang term referring to a pair of pants splitting (often at the crotch); used to describe the embarrassing situation when one's trousers tear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，行到條褲𧟘咗，點算呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, haang4 dou3 tiu4 fu3 mak6 zo2, dim2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，走着走着我的褲子裂開了，怎麼辦？
examples.english_sentence: Wow, my pants split while I was walking — what should I do?

mandarin_meaning: 褶子（折痕、皺摺），如衣物上的褶。
english_meaning: a crease, fold, or pleat (e.g., on clothing); a wrinkle or folded pleat
explanation_mandarin: 指布料或表面上的折痕、皺摺；亦可指褶狀的樣式（如褶裙）。
explanation_english: Refers to a fold, crease, or pleat on fabric or a surface; can also denote a pleated style (for example, a pleated skirt).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫有褶，要熨一熨先好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 jau5 ze2, jiu3 wan3 jat1 wan3 sin1 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服有褶，要熨一熨才好看。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt has creases; it needs to be ironed to look presentable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著住條褶裙，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 tiu4 ze2 kwan4, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿着褶裙，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing a pleated skirt; it looks very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 外套；夾克；大衣
english_meaning: jacket; coat; overcoat (colloquial Cantonese for an outer garment)
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，『褸』是口語用法，指外穿的衣物，如外套、夾克或大衣。常與量詞「件」搭配（如一件褸），也可與「外」字組成「外褸」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '褸' is a colloquial noun referring to an outer garment such as a jacket, coat, or overcoat. It is commonly used with the classifier '件' (e.g., one jacket) and appears in compounds like '外褸'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你著咗件褸未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 lau4 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你已經穿上外套了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Have you put on your jacket yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁凍，記得拎多件褸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam2 dung3, gei3 dak1 ling1 do1 gin6 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣這麼冷，記得多帶一件外套。
examples.english_sentence: It's so cold; remember to bring an extra jacket.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗）笨蛋、無能或令人討厭的人
english_meaning: (slang, derogatory) an idiot / a useless person / a loser
explanation_mandarin: 「褸丘」為香港粵語粗俗俗語，用來罵人笨拙、無能或討厭。詞源和構成不正式，屬口語及帶貶義用法，常出現在非正式對話或罵人時。
explanation_english: "褸丘" is a colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese slang insult used to call someone an idiot, a useless person, or otherwise annoying. The term is informal, derogatory, and typically used in casual speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個褸丘又遲到，仲搞錯文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 lau4 jau1 jau6 ci4 dou3, zung6 gaau2 co3 man4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個笨蛋又遲到，還把文件弄錯了。
examples.english_sentence: That idiot was late again and even messed up the documents.

mandarin_meaning: 一種香港粵語的口語俚語，字面無明確意思，常用作表達不滿、嘲諷或稱為無聊、胡扯的話語（類似罵人或感嘆詞）。
english_meaning: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese slang/interjection with no clear literal meaning; used to express displeasure, mockery, or to label something as nonsense—essentially a playful or coarse expletive.
explanation_mandarin: 「褸丘僂斗」並非正式成語，字面上各字沒有連貫語義，常見於口語或俚語語境中用來替代粗口、嘲諷對方或表示事情荒謬。屬非正式、帶貶義或戲謔性的用法，在正式場合不宜使用。
explanation_english: “褸丘僂斗” is not a formal idiom; the characters do not form a coherent literal meaning. It appears in colloquial speech as a slang interjection used to substitute for stronger swear words, to mock someone, or to dismiss something as ridiculous. It is informal and potentially derogatory, and not appropriate in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講啲乜嘢褸丘僂斗呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 di1 mat1 je5 lou2 jau1 lau4 dau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在說些什麼褸丘僂斗（就是胡說八道）？
examples.english_sentence: What nonsense are you talking about?

mandarin_meaning: 被留下付帳的人；吃虧、落單受損失的人（口語）
english_meaning: the person left to pay the bill; to be left holding the short end; to get the raw deal (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，通常指在結帳或分擔責任時，結果最後被留下承擔費用或損失的人。也可用作動詞，表示成為這樣的人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term referring to the person who ends up bearing the cost or loss (for example, the one left paying the bill). It can be used as a noun or verb in informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚買單唔好做褸尾，大家記住分開俾錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 maai5 daan1 m4 hou2 zou6 lau4 mei5, daai6 gaa1 gei3 zyu6 fan1 hoi1 bei2 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚結帳不要做褸尾，大家記得分開付錢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be the one left paying the bill tonight; remember to split the payment.

jyutping: lou6 jau1 (不常見，讀音為推測)
mandarin_meaning: 非標準或罕見詞彙；可能由「褸」（外套、破爛）與「幽」（陰森、幽暗）組合而成，推測含義為衣衫破爛或樣子陰森（未有確實記錄）
english_meaning: Not an attested/standard Cantonese term; possibly a coinage from 褸 (coat, ragged clothes) + 幽 (ghostly, gloomy). Hypothetical meaning: scruffy/ragged or ghostly/eerie in appearance (unattested)
explanation_mandarin: 「褸幽」並非主流粵語詞條，在主要詞典與語料庫中難以找到確切用法。按字面分析，可理解為描述衣著破爛或外表陰森之意，但此解釋屬推測，使用時應小心，並確認說話者的具體含義或是否為拼寫/聽寫錯誤。
explanation_english: “褸幽” is not a standard or commonly recorded Cantonese entry. Based on the characters, it could be a nonce/colloquial coinage combining 褸 (coat, ragged clothes) and 幽 (ghostly, secluded), suggesting a meaning like scruffy/ragged or ghostly-looking. This is speculative; the term is unattested in major dictionaries and may be a misspelling or local slang. Verify context before using.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個詞「褸幽」好少見，可能係拼錯或者係某區域性講法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ci4 「lou6 jau1」 hou2 siu2 gin3, ho2 nang4 hai6 ping1 co3 wa6 ze2 hai6 mau5 keoi1 wik6 sing3 gong2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個詞「褸幽」很少見，可能是拼錯或是某個地區的說法。
examples.english_sentence: The term “褸幽” is rarely seen; it may be a misspelling or a regional expression.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語/口語）形容衣衫破舊、佝僂駝背、看起來很衰弱或邋遢
english_meaning: A colloquial/slang expression describing someone who is raggedly dressed, stooped/hunched and appearing feeble or shabby
explanation_mandarin: 「褸幽僂斗」並非標準書面語，而是粵語口語或地區性俚語的拼合詞。字面上可拆作「褸」（破舊的外衣）、「幽」（陰暗、隱蔽）、「僂」（佝僂、駝背）和「斗」（語氣上作強調），用來形容一個人穿得破爛、身體佝僂、顯得衰老或邋遢。此詞較少見，可能為俗語或戲謔性的造詞。
explanation_english: “褸幽僂斗” is not a standard written term but a colloquial/regionally slangy compound in Cantonese. Literally it combines characters suggesting 'ragged jacket', 'gloomy/hidden', 'stooped' and an emphatic particle, and is used to describe someone who is raggedly dressed, hunched/stooped and looking feeble or shabby. The expression is uncommon and may be playful or dialectal rather than widely attested in formal dictionaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺年紀大，成日著得褸幽僂斗，行路都慢慢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 nin4 gei2 daai6, sing4 jat6 zoek3 dak1 lou3 jau1 lau4 dau2, haang4 lou6 dou1 maan6 maan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷年纪大，經常穿得破舊且佝偻，走路也很慢。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa is old; he often dresses raggedly and is stooped, and walks very slowly.

mandarin_meaning: 破爛的衣物或席子；衣衫襤褸
english_meaning: ragged, tattered clothes or bedding; threadbare/rag-like
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，用來形容衣物或被褥等破舊、襤褸不堪，帶有貶義或自嘲意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe clothing or bedding that is worn-out, tattered, or threadbare; often carries a derogatory or self-mocking tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲衫舊到爛晒，成身褸蓆咁，行街都冇面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 saam1 gau6 dou3 laan6 saai3, seng4 san1 lou2 sik1 gam2, haang4 gaai1 dou1 mou5 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服破得像褸蓆一樣，出門都沒面子。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes were so tattered, like a ragmat, that he was embarrassed to go out.

mandarin_meaning: 外套和被褥；指僅有的衣物和臥具（常用以形容生活困窮或身無長物）
english_meaning: A coat and a quilt; basic clothing and bedding (often used to describe poverty or having very few possessions)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，字面是「外套（褸）和被褥（被）」，常用來表示一個人僅有的衣物、寢具，含有生活清貧、沒什麼家當的意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term literally meaning 'coat (褸) and quilt (被)'. It is used to refer to someone's minimal clothing and bedding, implying poverty or having very few belongings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家窮到淨係得件褸被。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 ji4 gaa1 kung4 dou3 zing6 hai6 dak1 gin6 lou2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在窮得只剩下一件外套和一床被子。
examples.english_sentence: He's so poor he only has a coat and a quilt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋嗰陣，佢哋淨係拎咗幾件褸被就走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Bun1 uk1 go2 zan6, keoi5 dei6 zing6 hai6 ling1 zo2 gei2 gin6 lou2 bei6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家的時候，他們只帶了幾件衣物和被褥就走了。
examples.english_sentence: When moving house, they only took a few garments and quilts and left.

mandarin_meaning: 外套式連衣裙或上衣與裙子配套的款式（相當於「coat‑dress」或套裝中的裙子）
english_meaning: a coat‑dress or a skirt paired with a coat/jacket; a garment styled like a coat combined with a skirt
explanation_mandarin: 「褸裙」是香港粵語用語，指外觀或剪裁像外套（褸）但與裙合為一體，或指外套配裙的款式，常用於描述服裝風格。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, 褸裙 refers to a coat‑dress (a dress styled like a coat) or an outfit consisting of a jacket/coating top paired with a skirt. It is used to describe a particular clothing style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着咗件褸裙，睇落好時尚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 lou4 kwan4, tai2 lok6 hou2 si4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了一件褸裙，看起來很時尚。
examples.english_sentence: She put on a coat‑dress; it looks very fashionable.

mandarin_meaning: 穿着寬鬆風褸、打扮中性或偏粗獷的女生（俗稱假小子、tomboy）
english_meaning: a tomboyish girl who wears a baggy/hooded jacket (a girl with a masculine or rough style)
explanation_mandarin: 「褸𩬎妹」為香港粵語俗語，用來描述那些常穿風褸或寬鬆外套、打扮較中性或帶有粗獷氣質的女生。語氣口語、帶地方色彩，可帶讚賞或中性描述意味。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to describe girls who often wear windbreakers or baggy jackets and present a more masculine/tomboyish or rough style. It is colloquial and can be neutral or complimentary depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個褸𩬎妹好型，唔似一般細妹咁嬌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 lou4 aam1 mui6 hou2 jing4, m4 ci5 jat1 bun1 sai3 mui6 gam2 giu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個穿風褸的女生很有型，不像一般女生那麼嬌柔。
examples.english_sentence: That girl in the jacket looks cool and tomboyish, not like the typical delicate girl.

mandarin_meaning: 猥褻、褻瀆；不莊重或下流
english_meaning: obscene; indecent; to profane or desecrate
explanation_mandarin: 「褻」字表示猥褻、下流或褻瀆（亵渎）的意思，可用作形容詞表示不莊重或猥褻，也可作動詞表示褻瀆、亵渎。常見於合成詞如「猥褻」「褻瀆」。
explanation_english: The character 褻 denotes something obscene, indecent, or the act of profaning/desecrating. It can function as an adjective (indecent/obscene) or as a verb (to profane/desecrate). Frequently appears in compounds like 猥褻 (obscene) and 褻瀆 (desecrate).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰啲嘢好褻，唔啱小朋友聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 je5 hou2 sit3, m4 aam1 siu2 pang4 jau5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的話很猥褻，不適合小孩子聽。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was obscene; not suitable for children to hear.

mandarin_meaning: 褻瀆（xiè dú）：對宗教、神聖事物、先人或莊重場所不敬或侮辱、褻瀆之行為或言論
english_meaning: to desecrate; to profane; to blaspheme — to show disrespect or insult toward sacred things, religion, ancestors, or solemn places
explanation_mandarin: 指對神聖或應受尊重的事物以不敬、辱罵或破壞的方式對待，帶有冒犯或褻瀆之意。
explanation_english: Refers to treating sacred or respected objects/places in a disrespectful, insulting, or destructive way; implies profaning or blaspheming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講係褻瀆宗教，唔可以咁樣講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 hai6 sit3 duk6 zung1 gaau3, m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說是在褻瀆宗教，不能這樣說。
examples.english_sentence: What you said is desecrating religion; you shouldn't say that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 亂畫墓碑係褻瀆先人嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lyun6 waa6 mu6 bei1 hai6 sit3 duk6 sin1 jan4 ge3 hang4 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 亂塗墓碑是在褻瀆先人的行為。
examples.english_sentence: Defacing graves is an act of desecrating one's ancestors.

mandarin_meaning: 襁（常見於「襁褓」），指包裹嬰兒的布或襁褓中的嬰兒
english_meaning: Used in the word '襁褓' (qiǎngbǎo): swaddling cloths for infants; an infant wrapped in swaddling
explanation_mandarin: 「襁」通常與「褓」組成詞語「襁褓」，指用來包裹嬰兒的布，也可借指襁褓中的嬰兒，常用於書面或成語中。
explanation_english: ‘襁’ appears chiefly in the compound ‘襁褓’ (swaddling cloths). It refers to the cloth used to wrap an infant, or to an infant in swaddling; found mainly in literary or idiomatic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣佢係襁褓入面畀媽咪包住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 keoi5 hai6 koeng4 bou2 jap6 min6 bei2 maa1 mi4 baau1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候被妈妈用襁褓包着。
examples.english_sentence: When he was a baby, his mother wrapped him in swaddling clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 襁褓（qiǎng bǎo）：指用來包裹嬰兒的布，亦可引申指嬰兒時期。
english_meaning: swaddling clothes; swaddling (cloths used to wrap an infant); by extension, infancy
explanation_mandarin: 襁褓原指用來包裹嬰兒的布或被，古文中常用來表示嬰兒時期或幼年階段。現代多見於書面或較文雅的表達。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the cloths or wrappings used to swaddle an infant. In literary usage it can also denote infancy or the earliest stage of life. It is mainly used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嬰兒啱啱出世，仲包緊襁褓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 ji4 aam1 aam1 ceot1 sai3, zung6 baau1 gan2 koeng2 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婴儿刚刚出生，还裹着襁褓。
examples.english_sentence: The infant had just been born and was still wrapped in swaddling clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 襄（xiāng）：帮助、协助；亦作地名或姓氏（如襄阳）
english_meaning: To assist; to aid; also used as a place name or surname (e.g. Xiangyang)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词；也可作地名或姓氏
explanation_mandarin: 「襄」常用於書面語，表示協助、幫助。也見於地名或作姓氏用。
explanation_english: Used mainly in formal or literary contexts to mean to assist or aid; also appears in place names and as a surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇你襄助，我哋就完成唔到呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 mou5 nei5 soeng1 zo6, ngo5 dei6 zau6 jyun4 sing4 m4 dou3 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有你襄助，我们就完成不了这件事。
examples.english_sentence: If it weren't for your assistance, we wouldn't have been able to finish this.

mandarin_meaning: 協助；幫助（書面語）
english_meaning: to assist; to help (formal/literary)
explanation_mandarin: 襄助為較書面或正式用語，表示協助、幫助他人或某項事務。
explanation_english: A formal/literary verb meaning to assist or help; commonly used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你襄助我完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 zoeng1 zo6 ngo5 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 感謝你協助我完成這個項目。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for assisting me in completing this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府請各界襄助救災工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ceng2 gok3 gaai3 zoeng1 zo6 gau3 zoi1 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府請各界協助救災工作。
examples.english_sentence: The government asks all sectors to assist the disaster relief efforts.

mandarin_meaning: 襟；衣襟、領口；胸襟、胸怀
english_meaning: lapel/collar; the front part of a garment; (figuratively) chest/bosom, one's disposition
explanation_mandarin: 指衣服前部的部分，如衣襟或領口；引申可指胸襟、胸怀或人的心胸。
explanation_english: Refers to the front part of clothing (lapel/collar); figuratively can mean the chest or one's disposition/heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你件衫嘅襟位有啲污漬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin6 saam1 ge3 gam1 wai6 jau5 di1 wu1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你衣服的襟位有些污渍。
examples.english_sentence: There are some stains on the lapel of your shirt.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）好用、方便
english_meaning: handy; convenient to use (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港廣東話的口語用法中，「襟使」用來形容某物好用或使用上很方便。此詞屬於口語/俚語，書面語少見或視情況使用。
explanation_english: In colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese, "襟使" (gam1 si2) describes something that is handy or convenient to use. It is informal/slang and rarely used in formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個旅行袋真係好襟使，放嘢好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 leoi5 hang4 doi2 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam1 si2, fong3 je5 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个旅行袋真的很好用，放东西很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This travel bag is really handy; it's easy to put things in.

mandarin_meaning: 裝做 / 假裝
english_meaning: to pretend; to feign; to put on an act
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語用法，表示裝作某種狀態或行為（如裝作沒事、裝作自信等）。多見於香港日常會話，等同於「裝做／扮做」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to pretend or put on an act (for example, to pretend nothing is wrong or to feign confidence). Common in Hong Kong Cantonese and similar in meaning to 裝做/扮做.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好襟做冇事，我知道你唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam1 zou6 mou5 si6, ngo5 zi1 dou3 nei5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別裝作沒事，我知道你不高興。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend nothing's wrong — I know you're upset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢襟做好似冇睇到我，其實係避開我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 zou6 hou2 ci5 mou5 tai2 dou2 ngo5, kei4 sat6 hai6 bei6 hoi1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他裝作好像沒看到我，其實是在避開我。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended not to see me, but actually he was avoiding me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺面試嗰陣，佢襟做好自信，但其實好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 min6 si3 go2 zan6, keoi5 gam1 zou6 hou2 zi6 seon3, daan6 kei4 sat6 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在面試的時候，他裝作很有自信，但其實很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview he pretended to be confident, but he was actually very nervous.

mandarin_meaning: 義兄弟；要好的男性朋友
english_meaning: sworn brother; very close male friend; close buddy
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指關係非常親密的男性朋友，類似「義兄弟」或「好兄弟」，帶有感情深厚、互相扶持的含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for a very close male friend—like a sworn brother or bosom buddy—implying deep mutual loyalty and support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅襟兄弟，無論發生咩事都會幫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gam1 hing1 dai6, mou4 leon6 fat3 sang1 me1 si6 dou1 wui5 bong1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我很要好的兄弟，無論發生什麼事都會幫我。
examples.english_sentence: He's my close buddy/sworn brother—he'll help me no matter what happens.

mandarin_meaning: 把（小東西）藏在衣襟裡；暗自佔有或私吞（俗語）
english_meaning: to hide small items in one's collar; to stash or secretly keep something for oneself (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，字面是把東西放在衣襟裡。常用來形容把小東西或應屬公有的東西暗自攞走或私吞，帶有貶義、非正式。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb literally meaning to put something into one's collar. Often used to describe secretly stashing small items or pocketing something that should not be kept, with a negative/informal connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢襟撈嗰啲糖，唔畀其他人食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 lo1 go2 di1 tong4, m4 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把那些糖藏在衣襟裡，不讓其他人吃。
examples.english_sentence: He hid those candies in his collar and didn't let others eat them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啲花紅畀佢襟撈咗，其他同事好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 di1 faa1 hung4 bei2 keoi5 gam1 lo1 zo2, kei4 taa1 tung4 si6 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的花紅被他私吞了，其他同事很生氣。
examples.english_sentence: He pocketed the company's bonus, and the other colleagues were very angry.

mandarin_meaning: （香港粵語俚語）炫耀新買的東西／顯擺新裝
english_meaning: (Hong Kong Cantonese slang) to show off something new; to flaunt a recent purchase (often clothes or gadgets)
explanation_mandarin: 「襟新」是香港口語中的俚語，字面為「襟（衣領）+ 新」，常用來形容有人因為買了新的衣物或物件而四處展示或炫耀。此詞屬口語、非正式用法，在不同社區可能較少見或用法有變化。
explanation_english: "襟新" is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang term (literally 'lapel/new') used to describe someone who shows off or flaunts a newly bought item (often clothing or gadgets). It is informal and colloquial; usage and frequency may vary by community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日襟新，買咗部新電話就日日拎出嚟晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gam1 san1, maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 zau6 jat6 jat6 ling1 ceot1 lai4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是「襟新」，買了新手機就每天拿出來炫耀。
examples.english_sentence: He always '襟新' — whenever he buys a new phone he takes it out to show off every day.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）尷尬死了／非常尷尬
english_meaning: extremely embarrassed; unbelievably awkward
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用法，用來形容事情或處境讓人覺得非常尷尬或難堪，相當於「尷尬死了」。通常作為感嘆或描述用語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to describe a situation that is extremely embarrassing or awkward. It functions as an emphatic adjective or interjection, similar to "so embarrassing" or "awkward as hell."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱講錯個名，真係襟死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 gong2 co3 go3 ming4, zan1 hai6 gam1 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛說錯了名字，真是尷尬死了。
examples.english_sentence: I just said the wrong name — so embarrassing.

mandarin_meaning: 好用 / 實用 / 方便
english_meaning: useful; handy; convenient
explanation_mandarin: 「襟用」是粵語口語（香港常用），用來形容某物或某事容易使用、實用或方便。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term (commonly used in Hong Kong) meaning something is easy to use, practical, or convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個袋好襟用，裝嘢好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 doi2 hou2 gam1 jung6, zong1 je5 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個包很實用，裝東西很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This bag is very handy; it's convenient for carrying things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機幾襟用，用嚟睇片同打機都順手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 gei2 gam1 jung6, jung6 lai4 tai2 pin3 tung4 daa2 gei1 dou1 seon6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機挺好用的，用來看影片和打遊戲都很順手。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is pretty handy; it's smooth to use for watching videos and gaming.

mandarin_meaning: 看怎麼看 / 視角不同而定
english_meaning: depending on how you look at it; a matter of perspective
explanation_mandarin: 「襟睇」為廣東話口語用語，表示某件事是否成立或好壞取決於觀察者的角度或看法，即“視乎怎麼看”。常用於日常對話中表達觀點具有主觀性。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning that something depends on one's point of view — a matter of perspective. It is used to indicate that whether something is right, good, or acceptable varies by how you look at it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢做得啱唔啱，其實襟睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 zou6 dak1 aam1 m4 aam1, kei4 sat6 gam1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說他做得對不對，其實是看怎麼看的。
examples.english_sentence: Whether you think what he did was right or wrong is actually a matter of perspective.

mandarin_meaning: 襟章 / 胸章（别在衣襟上的徽章）
english_meaning: lapel pin; badge; badge worn on the lapel
explanation_mandarin: 指别在衣襟上的小徽章或别针，常用于表示身份、支持某個團體或作為裝飾。
explanation_english: A small badge or pin worn on the lapel of clothing, commonly used to indicate affiliation, show support for a group, or serve as decoration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢襟度夾住一個襟章，係支持嗰個團體嘅標誌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 dou6 gaap3 zyu6 jat1 go3 gam1 zoeng1, hai6 zi1 ci4 go2 go3 tyun4 tai2 ge3 biu1 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他襟上别着一个襟章，是支持那个团体的标志。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lapel pin attached to his lapel; it's a symbol of support for that group.

mandarin_meaning: 坦率；直爽；直言不讳
english_meaning: frank; straightforward; candid (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容一個人說話直率、坦白，不會拐彎抹角。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term describing someone who is frank, straightforward, and speaks candidly without beating around the bush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好襟計，唔會拐彎抹角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gam1 gai3, m4 wui5 gwaai2 waan1 mut6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很直率，不會拐彎抹角。
examples.english_sentence: He's very straightforward and doesn't beat around the bush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細鍾意襟計嘅員工，因為佢哋容易溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 zung1 ji3 gam1 gai3 ge3 jyun4 gung1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 jung4 ji6 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆喜歡率直的員工，因為他們比較容易溝通。
examples.english_sentence: The boss likes frank employees because they're easier to communicate with.

mandarin_meaning: 覺得不好意思／尷尬
english_meaning: to feel embarrassed/awkward; to feel shy or uncomfortable
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，表示因某事而覺得尷尬、不好意思或難為情，常用於日常對話中描述短暫的羞澀或尷尬感。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing a brief feeling of embarrassment, awkwardness, or shyness about something; commonly used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢讚我，我有啲襟諗，唔知點答。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 zaan3 ngo5, ngo5 jau5 di1 gam1 nam2, m4 zi1 dim2 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到他誇我，我有點不好意思，不知道怎麼回答。
examples.english_sentence: When he praised me, I felt a bit embarrassed and didn't know how to reply.

mandarin_meaning: 蹭饭 / 白吃（占别人便宜吃东西）
english_meaning: to mooch food; to freeload (eat at others' expense)
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，常見於香港粵語，指不付出代價或不回報地吃別人提供的食物或佔別人便宜蹭飯。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang verb (common in Hong Kong) meaning to mooch food or freeload — eating others' food without paying or reciprocating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嚟我屋企襟食，連飯錢都唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 gam1 sik6, lin4 faan6 cin2 dou1 m4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常來我家蹭飯，連飯錢都不付。
examples.english_sentence: He often comes to my place to mooch food; he doesn't even pay for the meals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日襟食人嘅好意，偶然接受可以，但唔好成習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 gam1 sik6 jan4 ge3 hou2 ji3, ngau5 jin4 zip3 sau6 ho2 ji5, daan6 m4 hou2 seng4 zaap6 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要總是占別人便宜，偶爾接受可以，但不要養成習慣。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always take advantage of others' kindness by mooching meals; it's okay occasionally, but don't make it a habit.

mandarin_meaning: 褲襠；胯下（褲子兩腿之間的部位）
english_meaning: crotch; gusset (the area of trousers between the legs)
explanation_mandarin: 「襠」指衣物（尤其是褲子）在兩腿之間的部位，如褲襠或褲檔，常用於描述該處的破損或設計。
explanation_english: Refers to the part of clothing (especially trousers) between the legs — the crotch or gusset. Commonly used to describe that area in terms of wear, damage, or construction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我條褲襠裂咗，要補吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tiu4 fu3 dong1 lit6 zo2, jiu3 bou2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的褲襠裂了，需要補一下。
examples.english_sentence: The crotch of my pants ripped; I need to mend it.

mandarin_meaning: 破爛；衣衫破舊（常見於「襤褸」）
english_meaning: ragged, tattered; describing clothes or items that are worn out (often seen in the compound '襤褸')
explanation_mandarin: 表示衣服或物品破爛、破舊，常用於複合詞「襤褸」來形容衣衫破爛不堪，也可用於比喻事物殘破。
explanation_english: Indicates that clothing or objects are ragged, tattered, or worn out. Commonly appears in the compound '襤褸' to mean rags; can also be used metaphorically for something dilapidated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫襤褸到唔想出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 laam4 lou6 dou3 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服破烂到不想出门。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes are so tattered he doesn't want to go out.

mandarin_meaning: 破爛；破舊不堪
english_meaning: tattered; ragged; shabby; worn-out
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容衣物或物品破舊、破爛不堪，也可比喻狀況很糟或寒酸。
explanation_english: Describes clothing or items that are torn and shabby; can also be used metaphorically for something in a poor or dilapidated state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫已經襤褸到拆晒線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 ji5 ging1 laam4 lou6 dou3 caak3 saai3 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服已經破爛到掉線了。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes are so tattered that the seams are coming apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街市有人賣緊襤褸嘅舊衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 si5 jau5 jan4 maai6 gan2 laam4 lou6 ge3 gau6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市場有人在賣破舊的舊衣服。
examples.english_sentence: There are people selling ragged old clothes at the market.

mandarin_meaning: 襪；襪子 (wà)
english_meaning: sock; stocking
explanation_mandarin: 指穿在腳上用以保暖或吸汗的布製品，泛指襪子或長短不同的襪類。
explanation_english: Refers to a garment worn on the foot for warmth or to absorb sweat; generally denotes socks or stockings of varying lengths.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗隻襪，可能落咗洗衣機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 zek3 mat6, ho2 nang4 lok6 zo2 sai2 ji1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不見了一只襪子，可能掉進洗衣機裡。
examples.english_sentence: I lost one sock; it probably fell into the washing machine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗對新襪，行路舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 deoi3 san1 mat6, haang4 lou6 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了一雙新襪子，走路舒服一點。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new pair of socks; walking is a bit more comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請幫我拎一對襪出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 bong1 ngo5 ling1 jat1 deoi3 mat6 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請幫我拿出一雙襪子來。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me take out a pair of socks.

mandarin_meaning: 襪子 (wàzi)
english_meaning: socks
explanation_mandarin: 覆蓋腳部的布製或針織用品，通常用來保暖、吸汗或減少摩擦。
explanation_english: A garment worn on the feet, typically made of knitted or woven fabric, used for warmth, absorbing sweat, or reducing friction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗一隻襪子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 jat1 zek3 mat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我丟失了一隻襪子。
examples.english_sentence: I lost one sock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對襪好軟，好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 mat6 hou2 jyun5, hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這雙襪子很軟，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: These socks are very soft and comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣凍，記得著襪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣冷，記得穿襪子。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold; remember to wear socks.

mandarin_meaning: 襪帶（wàidài）：用來固定長襪的帶子或夾子
english_meaning: garter; a band or clip used to hold up stockings
explanation_mandarin: 用來固定或支撐長襪的配件，可以是帶子、夾子或吊襪帶的一部分，常見於絲襪、禮服或內衣造型中。
explanation_english: An accessory (a band, clip, or part of a garter belt) used to hold up or secure stockings. Commonly seen with hosiery, formal wear, or lingerie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗條新襪帶，用嚟夾住長襪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 tiu4 san1 mat6 daai3, jung6 lai4 gaap3 zyu6 coeng4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她買了一條新的襪帶，用來夾住長襪。
examples.english_sentence: She bought a new garter to hold up her long stockings.

mandarin_meaning: 襪帶；用來固定襪子或絲襪防止滑落的環或帶
english_meaning: garter; a band or ring used to hold socks or stockings in place
explanation_mandarin: 襪箍是套在襪子或腿上的環狀或帶狀配件，用來固定襪子或絲襪，防止滑落或下滑。有時也指小孩或老人用來防止襪子亂掉的彈性帶。
explanation_english: A sock garter — a ring or band accessory worn with socks or stockings to keep them from slipping down. It can be an elastic band or strap used for practical fastening or fashion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗條新嘅襪箍，著高筒襪唔會跌落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 tiu4 san1 ge3 mat6 gu1, zoek3 gou1 tung4 mat6 m4 wui5 dit3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一條新的襪箍，穿高筒襪不會掉落。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new sock garter; wearing knee-high socks won't slip down.

mandarin_meaning: 連褲襪 / 褲襪
english_meaning: tights; pantyhose; panty hose
explanation_mandarin: 指一種將褲子與襪子結合在一起的貼身衣物（如連褲襪、褲襪），常用於保暖或修飾腿部。
explanation_english: Refers to hosiery that combines underwear and stockings (tights/pantyhose); worn to keep the legs warm or for decorative/coverage purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗一條新襪褲，好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 jat1 tiu4 san1 mat6 fu3, hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天买了一条新连裤袜，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new pair of tights today; they're very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天着襪褲可以保暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 zoek3 mat6 fu3 ho2 ji5 bou2 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天穿连裤袜可以保暖。
examples.english_sentence: Wearing tights in winter can keep you warm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對唔住，呢條襪褲有個洞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 m4 zyu6, ni1 tiu4 mat6 fu3 jau5 go3 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对不起，这条连裤袜有个洞。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, this pair of tights has a hole.

mandarin_meaning: 襪子的前端（覆蓋腳趾的部分）
english_meaning: the toe part of a sock; the front part covering the toes
explanation_mandarin: 指襪子最前端，覆蓋腳趾的部位。也可用來特指那部分磨破或破洞的位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the front part of a sock that covers the toes. Can also refer specifically to that area when it is worn out or has a hole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對襪頭破咗，要換對新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 mat6 tau4 po3 zo2, jiu3 wun6 deoi3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的襪頭破了，要換一雙新的。
examples.english_sentence: The toe of your sock is torn; you should change to a new pair.

mandarin_meaning: （動詞）配襯、襯托；（用於服飾、顏色等）使相配
english_meaning: to match; to go with; to set off (used for clothes, colors, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 「襯」常用於廣東話，表示兩樣事物在顏色或款式上相配、襯托，比如衣服或顏色互相搭配。也可用於表示襯托、配合的意思。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 襯 (can3) is a verb meaning to match or set off (especially for clothing and colors). It denotes that two items complement or suit each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫襯你條褲好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 can3 nei5 tiu4 fu3 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衬衫和你的裤子很配。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt goes really well with your pants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個顏色好襯你，可以襯托你嘅膚色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 can3 nei5, ho2 ji5 can3 tok3 nei5 ge3 foo1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个颜色很适合你，可以衬托你的肤色。
examples.english_sentence: This color suits you well; it can set off your complexion.

mandarin_meaning: 襯字（用來襯托、填充或配合句子、名字等的字）
english_meaning: a character/word used to match, embellish, or fill out a phrase or name; a filler or decorative character
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，指用來襯托、配合或填補語句、名字或標題等的字詞，通常有裝飾性或調整平衡的作用。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a character or short word used to match, embellish, or fill out a phrase, name, or title. Often decorative or used to balance wording.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個名片嘅名字太短，可以加啲襯字令佢睇落平衡啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ming4 pin2 ge3 ming4 zi6 taai3 dyun2, ho2 ji5 gaa1 di1 can3 zi6 ling6 keoi5 tai2 lok6 ping4 hang4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个名片的名字太短，可以加些襯字让它看起来更平衡。
examples.english_sentence: The name on this business card is too short; you can add some matching characters to make it look more balanced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫廣告標題要揀啱襯字，先可以吸引目光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 gwong2 gou3 biu1 tai4 jiu3 gaan2 ngaam1 can3 zi6, sin1 ho2 ji5 kap1 jan5 muk6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写广告标题要选对襯字，才能吸引目光。
examples.english_sentence: When writing an ad headline you need to choose the right matching words to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起名嗰陣，師傅話要加個襯字配八字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 ming4 go2 zan6, si1 fu1 waa6 jiu3 gaa1 go3 can3 zi6 pui3 baat3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给孩子起名时，师傅说要加一个襯字来配八字。
examples.english_sentence: When naming the child, the master said to add a matching character to fit the birth-chart (Ba Zi).

mandarin_meaning: 陪襯；湊數（俚語）
english_meaning: to make up the numbers; a filler/plant who attends just for appearances (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 指被邀請來只是陪襯或湊數的人（多含貶義）；有時也可作動詞，表示為了場面而湊數。
explanation_english: Refers to a person invited only to make up the numbers or to accompany for appearances (often pejorative). Can also be used as a verb meaning to fill in or make up the numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次派對人唔夠，淨係搵咗幾個人嚟做襯家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 paai3 deoi6 jan4 m4 gou3, zing6 hai6 wan2 zo2 gei2 go3 jan4 lai4 zou6 can3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次派对人手不够，只找了几个人来凑数/陪衬。
examples.english_sentence: There weren't enough people for the party, so they only found a few people to make up the numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想淨係做個襯家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 zing6 hai6 zou6 go3 can3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她不想只是被当作陪衬。
examples.english_sentence: He/She doesn't want to just be a filler.

mandarin_meaning: 雙方都免除／兩邊都不用負擔（口語）
english_meaning: both parties are exempted / neither side has to pay or be held responsible (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，常用來表示雙方或多方在某種安排下都免除責任或費用（較口語、少見或地區性用法）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang phrase used to indicate that both parties (or all sides) are exempted from responsibility or payment under an arrangement. It is informal and regionally used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你哋合作，襯家兩免，大家都唔使出錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 dei6 hap6 zok3, can3 gaa1 loeng5 min5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 sai2 ceot1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你們合作，襯家兩免，大家都不用出錢。
examples.english_sentence: If you cooperate, both sides get off — nobody has to pay.

mandarin_meaning: 襯托（用來突顯或襯映某人或某物，使其更顯突出）
english_meaning: to set off; to highlight or show something/someone by contrast
explanation_mandarin: 表示用某物（如衣服、配色、燈光、配角等）來襯映或突出另一個對象，使其看起來更顯眼或更有特色。
explanation_english: Used to describe using something (e.g., clothing, color, lighting, a supporting role) to set off or highlight another object or person, making it appear more prominent or distinctive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰件紅衫好襯托佢嘅皮膚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 gin6 hung4 saam1 hou2 can3 tok3 keoi5 ge3 pei4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她那件紅色的衣服很襯托她的膚色。
examples.english_sentence: That red dress really sets off her complexion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 燈光襯托出晚會嘅氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang1 gwong1 can3 tok3 ceot1 maan5 wui6 ge3 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 燈光襯托出晚會的氣氛。
examples.english_sentence: The lighting sets off the atmosphere of the party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個配角嘅表現襯托咗主角嘅演技。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 pui3 gok3 ge3 biu2 jin6 can3 tok3 zo2 zyu2 gok3 ge3 jin2 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個配角的表現襯托了主角的演技。
examples.english_sentence: The supporting actor's performance set off the lead's acting.

mandarin_meaning: 配色／搭配顏色
english_meaning: color matching; to coordinate colors
explanation_mandarin: 表示選擇或搭配顏色，使多種顏色相互協調，常用於服裝、室內設計、平面設計等場合。
explanation_english: Refers to choosing or coordinating colors so they match or harmonize; commonly used in clothing, interior design, and graphic design contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買條新裙，你可唔可以幫我襯色？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 tiu4 san1 kwan4, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 can3 sik1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买条新裙，你可以帮我配色吗？
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a new skirt — can you help me pick/coordinate the colors?

mandarin_meaning: 衬衣；在廣東話中常指襯衫或作為內穿的上衣（視語境可指襯衫、背心等）
english_meaning: shirt; (in some contexts) an undershirt or vest worn under other clothes
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語中，襯衣通常指上衣類服飾，可指正式的襯衫，也可指作為內穿的背心或內衣，具體含義視語境而定。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, 襯衣 generally refers to an upper-body garment. It can mean a dress shirt or, depending on context, an undershirt/vest worn underneath. The exact sense depends on usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝我要著件襯衣去返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ngo5 jiu3 zoek3 gin6 can3 ji1 heoi3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上我要穿襯衣去上班。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I need to wear a shirt to go to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天我喺襯衣下面著背心會舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ngo5 hai2 can3 ji1 haa6 min6 zoek3 bui3 sam1 wui5 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天我在襯衣下面穿背心會舒服一些。
examples.english_sentence: In summer I wear a vest under my shirt; it's more comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 衬衫
english_meaning: shirt (collared shirt)
explanation_mandarin: 「襯衫」是粵語用詞，指有衣領並可有扣子的上身衣物，可用於正式或日常場合。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '襯衫' refers to a shirt — typically a collared upper garment (with buttons), worn for formal or everyday occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日著咗件新襯衫去返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 san1 can3 saam1 heoi3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天穿了件新的衬衫去上班。
examples.english_sentence: I wore a new shirt to work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖啲襯衫款式好多，揀唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 di1 can3 saam1 fun2 sik1 hou2 do1, gaan2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的衬衫款式很多，挑选不过来。
examples.english_sentence: This shop has many shirt styles; I can't decide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗件襯衫，襯埋條領呔，好正式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 can3 saam1, can3 maai4 tiu4 ling5 taai1, hou2 zing3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她穿了件衬衫，配上领带，很正式。
examples.english_sentence: He/She put on a shirt and paired it with a tie; very formal.

mandarin_meaning: 袭 / 襲（xí）
english_meaning: to attack; to raid; to strike; (in compounds) hereditary/pass down (as in 世襲)
explanation_mandarin: 表示发动攻击、侵袭；在某些词语中（如“世袭”）表示世代相传或继承。
explanation_english: Indicates attacking or raiding; in some compounds (e.g. 世襲) it means hereditary or to be passed down through generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風襲港，港鐵要暫停服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 zaap6 gong2, gong2 tit3 jiu3 zaam6 ting4 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风袭港，港铁要暂停服务。
examples.english_sentence: The typhoon hit Hong Kong, so the MTR needs to suspend service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 匪徒襲擊咗銀行，警方封鎖現場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei2 tou4 zaap6 gik1 zo2 ngan4 hong4, ging2 fong1 fung1 so2 jin6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 匪徒袭击了银行，警方封锁现场。
examples.english_sentence: Robbers attacked the bank; the police sealed off the scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係世襲貴族，爵位代代相傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 sai3 zaap6 gwai3 zuk6, zoek3 wai6 daai3 daai3 soeng1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是世袭贵族，爵位代代相传。
examples.english_sentence: They are hereditary nobles; the title is passed down through generations.

mandarin_meaning: 袭击 (xíjī)
english_meaning: attack; assault; raid; strike
explanation_mandarin: 指發動攻擊或突襲，通常以武力或突然的方式對目標進行打擊或侵襲。
explanation_english: To launch an attack or assault, often by force or via a sudden strike against a target.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 匪徒襲擊咗銀行，警方展開追捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei1 tou4 zaap6 gik1 zo2 ngan4 hong4, ging2 fong1 zin2 hoi1 zeoi1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 歹徒襲擊了銀行，警方展開追捕。
examples.english_sentence: The criminals attacked the bank; the police launched a manhunt.

mandarin_meaning: 袭警（袭击警察）
english_meaning: assaulting a police officer; attacking the police
explanation_mandarin: 指攻击或袭击警察的行为，属于刑事违法行为，通常会被逮捕和起诉。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of attacking or assaulting a police officer; a criminal offence that normally leads to arrest and prosecution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為襲警被捕咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 zaap6 ging2 bei6 bou6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因袭警被捕了。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested for assaulting a police officer.

mandarin_meaning: 戴 (dài)
english_meaning: to wear; to put on (accessories such as hats, glasses); to honor
explanation_mandarin: 襶為罕用或古字，常作「戴」的異體字，主要見於古籍、碑刻或人名中。意思與「戴」相同，指佩戴、戴上（如帽子、眼鏡）或表示尊敬。
explanation_english: 襶 is a rare/archaic variant form of 戴, mainly seen in classical texts, inscriptions, or personal names. It has the same meaning as 戴: to wear or put on items (e.g. hats, glasses) and, by extension, to honor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你襶咗頂帽未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daai3 zo2 ding2 mou6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你戴了帽子嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Did you put on your hat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日襶住副眼鏡，睇落好有學問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 daai3 zyu6 fu3 ngaan5 geng2, tai2 lok6 hou2 jau5 hok6 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常戴著一副眼鏡，看起來很有學問。
examples.english_sentence: He often wears glasses; he looks very scholarly.

mandarin_meaning: 西（xī）：西方、向西或与西方相关的事物
english_meaning: west; western; to the west; used as a prefix meaning 'Western' in compounds
explanation_mandarin: 表示方位“西”，指西方或朝西；也常作前綴，表示“西方的、洋的”，如“西瓜”、“西餐”。
explanation_english: Indicates the direction 'west' or relates to the west; also commonly used as a prefix meaning 'Western' in compound words (e.g. 西瓜, 西餐).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺西環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 sai1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在西环（香港的西区）。
examples.english_sentence: I live in Sai Wan (the Western District in Hong Kong).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係西面，唔好向嗰邊走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 sai1 min6, m4 hou2 hoeng3 go2 bin1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里是西边，不要往那边走。
examples.english_sentence: This is the west side; don't go that way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天我好鍾意食西瓜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 sai1 gwaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天我很喜欢吃西瓜。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating watermelon in summer.

mandarin_meaning: 西九龙（常指西九文化区或西九龙一带）
english_meaning: West Kowloon (commonly refers to the West Kowloon Cultural District or the West Kowloon area in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 「西九」是對香港九龍西部地區的簡稱，常用來指西九文化區，包含博物館、表演場地及公共空間，也是香港多個文化活動與展覽的集中地。
explanation_english: “西九” is an abbreviation for the western part of Kowloon in Hong Kong, commonly referring to the West Kowloon Cultural District. It includes museums, performance venues and public spaces, and is a hub for cultural events and exhibitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日去咗西九睇展覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2 sai1 gau2 tai2 zin2 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天去了西九龙看展览。
examples.english_sentence: I went to West Kowloon to see an exhibition yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 西九文化區有好多藝術場館，週末好適合去行下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai1 gau2 man4 faa3 keoi1 jau5 hou2 do1 ngai6 seot6 coeng4 gun2, zau1 mut6 hou2 sik1 hap6 heoi3 haang4 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 西九龙文化区有很多艺术场馆，周末很适合去逛逛。
examples.english_sentence: The West Kowloon Cultural District has many art venues; it's great to visit on the weekend.

mandarin_meaning: 西九龙（香港地名）
english_meaning: West Kowloon (a district/area in Kowloon, Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 指香港九龍西部的地區，通常包含西九文化區及其周邊的填海和市區，常用於指稱該地的交通、文化設施及發展項目。
explanation_english: Refers to the western part of Kowloon in Hong Kong, commonly including the West Kowloon Cultural District and surrounding reclaimed and urban areas; used to denote the area's transport links, cultural facilities, and development projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去西九龍行下，睇下新開嘅藝術公園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 sai1 gau2 lung4 haang4 haa5, tai2 haa5 san1 hoi1 ge3 ngai6 seot6 gung1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們明天去西九龍走走，看看新開的藝術公園。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to West Kowloon tomorrow to walk around and check out the newly opened arts park.

mandarin_meaning: 西亚
english_meaning: West Asia; the Middle East (geographic region)
explanation_mandarin: 指亞洲西部的地理區域，常與「中東」概念重疊，包含若干西亞國家與文化。
explanation_english: Refers to the geographic region of Western Asia, often overlapping with the term Middle East; denotes the countries and cultures in that area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去西亞出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 sai1 aa3 ceot1 caai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去西亚出差。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going on a business trip to West Asia next month.

mandarin_meaning: 西方人；洋人
english_meaning: Westerner; Western person (foreign person from Western countries)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語裡常用來指稱來自西方國家的人（如歐美人）。語氣較口語，可中性使用，但在某些語境下亦可能帶有距離感或刻板印象。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term commonly used to refer to people from Western countries (e.g., Europeans or North Americans). It is colloquial and generally neutral, but in some contexts can convey distance or stereotype.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲西人好鍾意飲咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai1 jan4 hou2 zung1 ji3 jam2 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 西方人很喜歡喝咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: Westerners really like drinking coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個西人，唔識廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 sai1 jan4, m4 sik1 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個洋人，不會說廣東話。
examples.english_sentence: He's a Westerner who doesn't speak Cantonese.

mandarin_meaning: 西伯利亚（俄罗斯的一个广袤地区）
english_meaning: Siberia (a vast region in Russia)
explanation_mandarin: 指俄罗斯亚欧大陆北部的广阔地区，气候寒冷，拥有大片针叶林（泰加林）、永久冻土和稀疏的人口分布，常用于表述极寒或偏远之地。
explanation_english: Refers to the vast region in northern Asia within Russia, known for its extremely cold climate, extensive taiga, permafrost, and sparse population; often used to denote a very cold or remote place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去西伯利亞睇北極光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 sai1 baak3 lei6 aa3 tai2 bak1 gik6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去西伯利亚看北极光。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to Siberia to see the aurora.

mandarin_meaning: 西方紀年（相當於公元）
english_meaning: Western calendar era (Anno Domini / Common Era)
explanation_mandarin: 指以西方紀年方式標示的年份（相當於「公元」），常用於年份前或與年份連用；搭配「西元前」表示公元前的年份。
explanation_english: Refers to the Western/Common Era way of numbering years (equivalent to Anno Domini). Commonly used with year numbers (e.g. 西元2023年); '西元前' denotes years before the Common Era (BC).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一般用西元紀年，唔係用農曆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 bun1 jung6 sai1 jyun4 gei2 nin4, m4 hai6 jung6 nung4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們一般使用西元紀年，不是使用農曆。
examples.english_sentence: We generally use the Western calendar era (CE), not the lunar calendar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係西元1984年出世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 sai1 jyun4 jat6 gau2 baat3 sei3 nin4 ceot1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她出生於西元1984年。
examples.english_sentence: He/She was born in 1984 AD.

mandarin_meaning: （牛排的一种）西冷牛排（sirloin）
english_meaning: sirloin (steak)
explanation_mandarin: 「西冷」為英語 sirloin 的音譯，常用於指牛排的一種部位或菜式，常見於餐廳菜單。與「沙朗（沙朗牛排）」常被視為同類或同義詞。
explanation_english: “西冷” is a Cantonese/Chinese transliteration of the English word “sirloin.” It refers to the sirloin cut of beef or a sirloin steak commonly found on restaurant menus. It is often used interchangeably with 沙朗 (salang).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食西冷牛扒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 sai1 laang5 ngau4 paa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃西冷牛排。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a sirloin steak tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 西冷牛排（牛里脊/腰部的牛排切块）
english_meaning: sirloin steak
explanation_mandarin: 指牛身上西冷部位切成的牛排，在粤语中常简称为“西冷扒”，是餐厅常见的主菜之一。
explanation_english: Refers to a steak cut from the sirloin area of beef. In Cantonese, '扒' denotes a steak; commonly served as a main dish in restaurants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去餐廳食西冷扒，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 caan1 teng1 sik6 sai1 ling4 paa4, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去餐厅吃西冷牛排，怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go to the restaurant to eat sirloin steak tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊西冷扒好嫩，仲有肉汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 sai1 ling4 paa4 hou2 nan6, zung6 jau5 juk6 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块西冷牛排很嫩，还有肉汁。
examples.english_sentence: This sirloin steak is very tender and juicy.

mandarin_meaning: 西冷牛排（牛里脊/西冷部位的牛排）
english_meaning: sirloin steak
explanation_mandarin: 「西冷牛扒」是粤语中对英式/美式牛排中“西冷”（sirloin）部位牛排的称呼，通常指将牛的西冷部位切成的牛排，常用煎、烤等方式烹调。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "西冷牛扒" refers to a sirloin steak — a cut from the sirloin section of beef. It is typically pan-seared or grilled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去食牛扒，我想食西冷牛扒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 sik6 ngau4 paa4, ngo5 soeng2 sik6 sai1 laang5 ngau4 paa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去吃牛排，我想吃西冷牛排。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to eat steak tonight; I want to have a sirloin steak.

mandarin_meaning: （香港口語）指冰的紅茶，常見於茶餐廳；有時也用作對「錫蘭紅茶」的俗稱。
english_meaning: A Hong Kong colloquial term for iced black tea (often Ceylon tea) commonly ordered in cha chaan tengs; a slangy way to refer to cold/iced black tea.
explanation_mandarin: 「西冷紅茶」在香港口語中多指加冰的紅茶，點飲時可表明希望飲凍或指常用的錫蘭紅茶。屬於飲食用語及俗稱。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong usage, "西冷紅茶" typically refers to iced black tea (sometimes specifically Ceylon tea). It's an informal/colloquial food-and-drink term used when ordering tea in local cafes (cha chaan teng).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺茶餐廳我通常會叫一杯西冷紅茶，唔加糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 wui5 giu3 jat1 bui1 sai1 laang5 hung4 caa4, m4 gaa1 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在茶餐廳我通常會叫一杯西冷紅茶，不加糖。
examples.english_sentence: At the cha chaan teng I usually order a cup of "西冷紅茶" (iced black tea), no sugar.

mandarin_meaning: 西化（xīhuà）——西方化、向西方文化或制度靠攏
english_meaning: westernization; to westernize; Westernized
explanation_mandarin: 指接受或采用西方的文化、制度、生活方式等；也可指某事物變得具有西方特色。
explanation_english: Refers to adopting Western culture, institutions, lifestyles, etc.; can describe the process (to westernize) or the result (westernization).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年嚟，呢個城市愈來愈西化，街上有好多嘢都好西式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 loi4, ni1 go3 sing4 si5 jyu6 loi4 jyu6 sai1 faa3, gaai1 soeng5 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 dou1 hou2 sai1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来，这个城市越来越西化，街上有很多东西都很西式。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years this city has become more and more westernized; many things on the streets are very Western-style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗配合國際市場，公司要西化佢哋嘅產品包裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 pui3 hap6 gwok3 zai3 si5 coeng4, gung1 si1 jiu3 sai1 faa3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 caan2 ban2 baau1 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了配合国际市场，公司要将他们的产品包装西化。
examples.english_sentence: To fit the international market, the company needs to westernize their product packaging.

mandarin_meaning: 西北（方向/地区）
english_meaning: northwest (direction); the northwest region
explanation_mandarin: 表示方向（指向西與北之間的方位）或指代西北地區（如中國西北地區）。
explanation_english: Refers to the northwest direction (between west and north) or to the northwest region (e.g., the northwest area of a country).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風由西北吹嚟，天氣會轉冷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 jau4 sai1 bak1 ceoi1 lai4, tin1 hei3 wui5 zyun2 laang5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风从西北吹来，天气会变冷。
examples.english_sentence: The wind is coming from the northwest; the weather will turn colder.

mandarin_meaning: 西区；（通常指城市的）西部地区；在香港语境下常指香港岛的西区（西环一带）
english_meaning: Western District; the western part of a city; in Hong Kong, the Western District on Hong Kong Island (Sai Wan/Western District)
explanation_mandarin: 指城市的西部地區。於香港語境下，常專指香港島的西區（俗稱西環），包括上環、石塘咀等地。
explanation_english: Refers to the western district or western part of a city. In the Hong Kong context it usually denotes the Western District on Hong Kong Island (commonly called Sai Wan/Western District), covering areas such as Sheung Wan and Shek Tong Tsui.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 週末我哋去西區行街，順便食海鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau1 mut6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sai1 keoi1 hang4 gaai1, seon6 bin6 sik6 hoi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 周末我們去西區逛街，順便吃海鮮。
examples.english_sentence: This weekend we're going to the Western District to go shopping and have some seafood.

mandarin_meaning: 西半球（指以本初子午线为界，位于地球西侧的半球）
english_meaning: the Western Hemisphere (the half of Earth west of the Prime Meridian)
explanation_mandarin: 地理学术语，指以本初子午线（经度0°）為界位於其西側的地球半球，通常包括北美洲、南美洲及相邻的大西洋和太平洋部分。
explanation_english: A geographical term for the half of the Earth west of the Prime Meridian (longitude 0°); commonly includes North and South America and adjacent parts of the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美國喺西半球，屬於北美洲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 gwok3 hai2 sai1 bun3 kau4, suk6 jyu1 bak1 mei5 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美国在西半球，位于北美洲。
examples.english_sentence: The United States is in the Western Hemisphere, located in North America.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由倫敦飛去紐約，航班會越過本初子午線，進入西半球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 leon4 deon1 fei1 heoi3 nau2 joek3, hong4 baan1 wui5 jyut6 gwo3 bun2 co2 zi2 ng5 sin3, zeon3 jap6 sai1 bun3 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从伦敦飞往纽约，航班会越过本初子午线，进入西半球。
examples.english_sentence: Flying from London to New York, the flight crosses the Prime Meridian into the Western Hemisphere.

mandarin_meaning: 西南 (xīnán)
english_meaning: southwest
explanation_mandarin: 表示方位，指西和南之間的方向或地區，也可指西南部或西南方位。
explanation_english: Indicates the direction or region between west and south; refers to the southwest direction or a southwestern area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月去西南旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 sai1 naam4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下個月去西南旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to travel to the southwest next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市位於西南部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 wai6 jyu1 sai1 naam4 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個城市位於西南部。
examples.english_sentence: This city is located in the southwest.

mandarin_meaning: 字面是「西南的二伯父」，為香港粵語俚語，用來指無關緊要、莫名其妙或荒謬的人或事，常帶貶義或戲謔成分。
english_meaning: Literally 'the second uncle from the southwest'; a Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to refer to something or someone irrelevant, nonsensical, or absurd — often a mild insult or dismissive remark.
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，來源不明，字面上並無特定親屬指涉。用於貶低或否定某人或某事的價值或合理性，相當於說『胡說』『無關痛癢的東西』。
explanation_english: A colloquial slang expression of uncertain origin; the literal words do not point to a real relative. It is used to belittle or dismiss a person or thing as irrelevant, nonsensical, or trivial — roughly equivalent to calling something 'nonsense' or someone 'a nobody'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰啲西南二伯父嘢有咩意思？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 di1 sai1 naam4 ji6 baak3 fu6 je5 jau5 me1 ji3 si1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說的那些莫名其妙的話是什麼意思？
examples.english_sentence: What do you mean by that nonsense?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢根本係一個西南二伯父，唔值得理會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan1 bun2 hai6 jat1 go3 sai1 naam4 ji6 baak3 fu6, m4 zik1 dak1 lei5 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他根本就是個無關緊要的人，不值得理會。
examples.english_sentence: He's basically a nobody; not worth paying attention to.

mandarin_meaning: 對不同人說不同話，表裡不一、兩面派
english_meaning: to say different things to different people; being two-faced or hypocritical
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，形容一個人對不同的人講不同的說話或表現，表裡不一、兩面派，常帶負面評價。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase describing someone who tells different things to different people — i.e., two-faced or hypocritical. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺你面前講支持你，背後又講你壞話，真係西口西面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 nei5 min6 cin4 gong2 zi1 ci4 nei5, bui3 hau6 jau6 gong2 nei5 waai6 waa6, zan1 hai6 sai1 hau2 sai1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在你面前說支持你，背後卻又說你的壞話，真是兩面三刀（西口西面）。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he supports you to your face, but talks badly about you behind your back — really two-faced.

mandarin_meaning: 台灣西部；（俚語）諷刺性或戲稱地稱中國大陸為「西台灣」
english_meaning: western Taiwan; (slang) sarcastic term referring to mainland China as 'West Taiwan'
explanation_mandarin: 「西台灣」字面上指台灣島的西部平原地區；在網路或口語中，有時被用作俚語、諷刺或揶揄地將中國大陸稱為「西台灣」，帶有政治或貶義色彩，需視語境使用。
explanation_english: Literally 'western Taiwan', referring to the western part of Taiwan. Colloquially or online, it is sometimes used as a slang or sarcastic label for mainland China as 'West Taiwan'. This usage can carry derogatory or political connotations and depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人戲稱內地係「西台灣」，但呢個講法帶有貶義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 hei3 cing1 noi6 dei6 hai6 「sai1 toi4 waan1」，daan6 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 daai3 jau5 bin2 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人戲稱（中國）內地是「西台灣」，但這種說法帶有貶義。
examples.english_sentence: Some people jokingly call mainland China 'West Taiwan', but this term is derogatory.

mandarin_meaning: 西方歷史；西洋史
english_meaning: Western history
explanation_mandarin: 「西史」在粵語中常用作「西方歷史」或「西洋史」的簡稱，指歐洲及其他西方國家的歷史或相關研究。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "西史" is often an abbreviated form meaning Western history (history of Europe and other Western countries) or the study of that history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對西史好有興趣，成日喺圖書館搵資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 sai1 si2 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3, sing4 jat6 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 wan2 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對西方歷史很有興趣，經常在圖書館查資料。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very interested in Western history and often look up materials in the library.

mandarin_meaning: 西域（xīyù）：古代指中國以西的地區，主要為中亞，常見於歷史文獻與絲綢之路的語境中。
english_meaning: Western Regions; historically the areas west of China (mainly Central Asia); often referenced in historical texts about the Silk Road; can also mean western territories.
explanation_mandarin: 「西域」為歷史用語，通常指漢代以來中國以西的廣袤地區，涵蓋今天的中亞及絲綢之路沿線，常出現在古代史料與地理記載中。
explanation_english: A historical term referring to the regions west of China—primarily Central Asia—frequently mentioned in accounts of the Silk Road and ancient Chinese historical records; can broadly mean western territories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本歷史書有一章講西域同絲綢之路嘅交流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 lik6 si2 syu1 jau5 jat1 zoeng1 gong2 sai1-wik6 tung4 si1-cau4 zi1 lou6 ge3 gaau1-lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本歷史書有一章講述西域與絲綢之路的交流。
examples.english_sentence: This history book has a chapter about the exchanges between the Western Regions and the Silk Road.

mandarin_meaning: 西夏（又稱西夏國），是由黨項族（唐古特）建立的王朝或國家，存在於1038年至1227年，主要分佈在今寧夏及中國西北地區。
english_meaning: Western Xia (Western Xia Kingdom), a Tangut-led dynasty/kingdom in northwest China that existed from 1038 to 1227.
explanation_mandarin: 中國歷史上的一個政權，由黨項族建立，首都曾在興慶（今寧夏銀川一帶），1227年被蒙古帝國滅亡。西夏有獨特的文字與文化遺存。
explanation_english: A historical polity in China founded by the Tangut (Dangxiang) people, centered around present-day Ningxia. It had its own script and culture and was conquered by the Mongol Empire in 1227.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺歷史課讀到西夏嘅興衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 lik6 si2 fo3 duk6 dou3 sai1 haa6 ge3 hing1 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛在歷史課上讀到西夏的興衰。
examples.english_sentence: I just read about the rise and fall of the Western Xia in history class.

mandarin_meaning: 西多士（法式吐司的口語縮稱）
english_meaning: Colloquial abbreviation for '西多士' (French toast)
explanation_mandarin: 「西多」是廣東話（香港口語）常把「西多士」縮短後的說法，指的是西式的法式吐司，常見於茶餐廳的早餐或甜品選項。
explanation_english: “Sai do” is a colloquial Cantonese abbreviation of "西多士" (xī duō shì), referring to French toast. It is commonly used in Hong Kong, especially in cha chaan tengs as a breakfast or snack item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝喺茶餐廳食咗西多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 sik6 zo2 sai1 do1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上在茶餐廳吃了西多（即西多士/法式吐司）。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I ate "sai do" (i.e. French toast) at the cha chaan teng.

mandarin_meaning: 西多士（港式法式吐司）
english_meaning: Hong Kong-style French toast (deep-fried sandwich-style toast often served with butter and condensed milk or syrup)
explanation_mandarin: 一種香港茶餐廳常見的西式吐司做法：兩片吐司夾入牛油或花生醬，沾蛋液後煎或炸，再淋上煉乳或糖漿，口感香脆且甜味明顯。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong-style variant of French toast: two slices of bread (often with butter or peanut butter between), dipped in beaten egg, pan-fried or deep-fried, and served with condensed milk or syrup—crispy, buttery, and sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝喺茶餐廳食咗份西多士，真係好抵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 sik6 zo2 fan6 sai1 do1 si6, zan1 hai6 hou2 dai2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上在茶餐廳吃了份西多士，真的很划算／很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I had a Hong Kong-style French toast at a cha chaan teng; it was really delicious and good value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅西多士會加花生醬或者牛油，好多人都鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 sai1 do1 si6 wui5 gaa1 faa1 sang1 zoeng3 waak6 ze2 ngau4 jau4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的西多士會加花生醬或者牛油，很多人都喜歡。
examples.english_sentence: Their French toast comes with peanut butter or butter; many people like it.

mandarin_meaning: 過度西化／擺出過於「洋」的樣子（口語）
english_meaning: slang for being overly westernized or trying too hard to appear Western
explanation_mandarin: 「西多過like」是香港口語混合用法，帶有調侃意味，用來形容某人或某事看起來過份西化、刻意模仿西方風格或裝扮，給人不自然或做作的感覺。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong slang phrase mixing Cantonese and English. It jokingly describes a person or thing that is excessively westernized or trying too hard to look Western — often implying it looks forced or inauthentic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日咁着，真係西多過like喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 gam2 zoek3, zan1 hai6 sai1 do1 gwo3 laik6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天這樣打扮，真的太西化了。
examples.english_sentence: The way you're dressed today is really over-the-top Western.

mandarin_meaning: （佛教）西方极乐世界；口语中指去世
english_meaning: the Western Pure Land (Buddhist paradise); colloquially, to die/go to heaven
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词；口语中作动词短语
explanation_mandarin: 原指佛教中的西方极乐世界（阿弥陀佛的净土）。在口语或俚语中常用来婉转或粗俗地表示死亡、去世。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the Buddhist Western Pure Land (Sukhāvatī). Informally used to mean 'to die' or 'to go to heaven', sometimes used euphemistically or crudely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸上個禮拜去咗西天，成間屋都好沉默。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa1 soeng6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 zo2 sai1 tin1, sing4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 hou2 cam4 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸上个礼拜去世了，整个屋子都很沉默。
examples.english_sentence: His father passed away last week; the whole house was very quiet.

mandarin_meaning: 西安（陕西省省会，中国城市）
english_meaning: Xi'an (capital city of Shaanxi Province, China)
explanation_mandarin: 中国陕西省的省会，历史悠久，古称长安，曾为多朝代的都城，著名景点有兵马俑和古城墙，是丝绸之路的起点之一。
explanation_english: The capital of Shaanxi Province in China. Historically known as Chang'an, it served as the capital for several dynasties. Famous for the Terracotta Army, the ancient city wall, and as a starting point of the Silk Road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜會去西安旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 sai1 on1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个礼拜会去西安旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Xi'an for a trip next week.

mandarin_meaning: 指來自西方的遊客或外國人（口語用法）
english_meaning: A colloquial term for Western visitors / Westerners (often tourists)
explanation_mandarin: 「西客」是廣東話的口語用法，字面為「西方的客人」，通常指來自西方的遊客或外國人。語氣可中性，但在某些語境下可能帶有刻板或冒犯意味。
explanation_english: “西客” is a Cantonese colloquial term literally meaning “Western guest.” It typically refers to Western visitors or foreigners (often tourists). It can be neutral, but in some contexts may carry mild stereotypical or offensive overtones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班西客成日喺中環影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 sai1 haak3 sing4 jat6 hai2 zung1 waan4 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些西方遊客經常在中環拍照。
examples.english_sentence: Those Western tourists are always taking photos in Central.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識同啲西客講嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 tung4 di1 sai1 haak3 gong2 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你會不會跟那些西方遊客講話？
examples.english_sentence: Can you talk to the Western tourists?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人覺得用「西客」呢個詞會有啲冒犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 gok3 dak1 jung6 「sai1 haak3」ni1 go3 ci4 wui5 jau5 di1 mou6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有的人覺得用「西客」這個詞會有點冒犯。
examples.english_sentence: Some people feel that using '西客' can be a bit offensive.

mandarin_meaning: 西宁（青海省省会）
english_meaning: Xining (capital city of Qinghai Province, China)
explanation_mandarin: 西宁是中国青海省的省会，位于青藏高原东北缘，海拔较高，是通往青藏高原和青海湖等地的重要交通枢纽。
explanation_english: Xining is the capital of Qinghai Province in China, located on the northeastern edge of the Tibetan Plateau. It sits at high elevation and serves as a key transport hub to the Tibetan Plateau and Qinghai Lake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 西寧係青海省嘅省會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai1 ning4 hai6 cing1 hoi2 saang2 ge3 saang2 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 西宁是青海省的省会。
examples.english_sentence: Xining is the capital of Qinghai Province.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下年會去西寧旅行，想睇青海湖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 nin4 wui5 heoi3 sai1 ning4 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 tai2 cing1 hoi2 wu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明年会去西宁旅行，想看青海湖。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Xining next year for a trip; I want to see Qinghai Lake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 青藏鐵路由西寧出發，前往拉薩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 zong6 tit3 lou6 jau4 sai1 ning4 ceot1 faat3, cin4 wong5 laai1 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 青藏铁路从西宁出发，前往拉萨。
examples.english_sentence: The Qinghai–Tibet Railway departs from Xining and goes to Lhasa.

mandarin_meaning: 西厨（指從事或擅長西式料理的廚師；亦可指西式廚房）
english_meaning: Western chef; a chef who specializes in Western cuisine (or the Western-style kitchen)
explanation_mandarin: 指專門烹調西式料理的廚師，常用於餐飲業內區分中廚與西廚；有時也可指西式的廚房或西餐部門。
explanation_english: Refers to a chef who specializes in Western-style cooking, commonly used in the restaurant industry to distinguish between Chinese and Western cooks; can also mean the Western-style kitchen or Western cuisine section.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋餐廳新請咗個西廚，佢整嘅牛扒好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 caan1 teng1 san1 ceng2 zo2 go3 sai1 cyu4, keoi5 zing2 ge3 ngau4 paa4 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們餐廳新請了一位西廚，他做的牛排很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Our restaurant hired a new Western chef; the steak he makes is delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 酒店啲西廚主要負責西餐嘅部分，同中廚分工唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau2 dim3 di1 sai1 cyu4 zyu2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 sai1 caan1 ge3 bou6 fan6, tung4 zung1 cyu4 fan1 gung1 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 酒店裡的西廚主要負責西餐的部分，與中廚分工不同。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel's Western chefs mainly handle the Western cuisine section, which is organized differently from the Chinese kitchen.

mandarin_meaning: 西式（来自或受西方影响的样式、风格）
english_meaning: Western-style; in the style of the West
explanation_mandarin: 表示屬於或受西方文化、設計或習慣影響的樣式或風格，例如西式服飾、西式餐飲等。
explanation_english: Indicates something that is of or influenced by Western culture, design, or customs — for example Western-style clothing, food, or practices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋食西式餐，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 sik6 sai1 sik1 caan1, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们吃西式餐，好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we have a Western-style meal tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著咗件西式西裝去面試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 sai1 sik1 sai1 zong1 heoi3 min6 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿了西式西装去面试。
examples.english_sentence: He wore a Western-style suit to the interview today.

mandarin_meaning: 西德（指1949年至1990年的德國西部，即德意志聯邦共和國）
english_meaning: West Germany (the Federal Republic of Germany, referring to western Germany from 1949–1990)
explanation_mandarin: 指二戰後德國分裂期間的西部政權，正式稱為德意志聯邦共和國，常與東德（德意志民主共和國）相對。
explanation_english: Refers to the western part of Germany during the postwar division (1949–1990), officially the Federal Republic of Germany, often contrasted with East Germany.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢嘅祖父係西德人，喺戰後移民嚟香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ge3 zou2 fu6 hai6 sai1 dak1 jan4, hai2 zin3 hau6 ji4 man4 lai4 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他的祖父是西德人，战后移民来香港。
examples.english_sentence: He said his grandfather was from West Germany and immigrated to Hong Kong after the war.

mandarin_meaning: 西撒哈拉（Xī Sāhālā）——位於北非的一個地區，主要為撒哈拉沙漠的一部分，政治地位有爭議（摩洛哥與波利薩里奧等之間存在主權爭議）。
english_meaning: Western Sahara — a disputed territory in North Africa, largely desert and the subject of political dispute between Morocco and the Polisario Front.
explanation_mandarin: 西撒哈拉是北非西北部的一片沙漠地區，曾為西班牙殖民地，現時其主權存在爭議，國際間有不同認定與和平談判進展。
explanation_english: Western Sahara is a region in northwest Africa, mostly desert, formerly a Spanish colony; its sovereignty is disputed and the territory has been the subject of international negotiation and conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺地理課學到關於西撒哈拉嘅歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dei6 lei5 fo3 hok6 dou3 gwaan1 jyu1 sai1 saat3 haa1 laa1 ge3 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在地理课学到关于西撒哈拉的历史。
examples.english_sentence: We learned about the history of Western Sahara in geography class.

mandarin_meaning: 指西方的文字或語言，通常特指英語或以拉丁字母書寫的外文
english_meaning: Western writing/language (commonly refers to English or other Latin‑script foreign languages)
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語口語中，『西文』常用來指西方的書面文字或語言，尤其指英語；有時也泛指所有以拉丁字母書寫的外文。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '西文' is used to refer to Western written language, commonly English, or more generally any foreign language written in the Latin alphabet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份表格要填西文定中文？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 biu2 gok3 jiu3 tim4 sai1 man4 ding6 zung1 man4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份表格要用西文还是中文填写？
examples.english_sentence: Does this form need to be filled in Western language (English) or Chinese?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識打西文？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 daa2 sai1 man4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会不会打西文？
examples.english_sentence: Can you type in English?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅官方語言有中文同西文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gung1 fong1 jyu5 jin4 jau5 zung1 man4 tung4 sai1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的官方语言有中文和西文。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's official languages include Chinese and Western languages (English).

mandarin_meaning: 歪斜；不正
english_meaning: tilted; crooked; off (not right)
explanation_mandarin: 通常用來形容物件傾斜、歪斜；在口語中也可用來表示事情不太正常、不對勁或有問題。
explanation_english: Usually describes something that is tilted or crooked; colloquially can also mean that something is off, not right, or suspicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張相西斜咗，幫我調正啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 soeng2 sai1 ce4 zo2, bong1 ngo5 tiu4 zing3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照片歪了，幫我調正一下。
examples.english_sentence: The photo is crooked; please straighten it for me.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見或可能為錯誤拼寫的粵語俚語；字面可解作「西邊斜熱」，但沒有固定通用含義或廣泛承認的解釋。
english_meaning: A rare or possibly misspelled Cantonese slang phrase; literally "west-slant hot" — there is no established or widely recognized meaning.
explanation_mandarin: 「西斜熱」並非廣泛使用的標準粵語詞彙，可能是地區性俚語、誤寫或聽寫錯誤。若逐字解釋，為「西邊斜／傾斜」與「熱」，但缺乏公認語義或用法。
explanation_english: “西斜熱” is not a widely used standard Cantonese term; it may be a regional slang, a misspelling, or a misheard phrase. Taken literally it combines “west/tilt” and “hot”, but there is no agreed-upon meaning or common usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近聽到有人講「西斜熱」，但真係唔知佢想表達咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 teng1 dou3 jau5 jan4 gong2 "sai1 ce4 jit6", daan6 zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 biu2 daat6 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近聽到有人說「西斜熱」，但真的不知道他想表達什麼。
examples.english_sentence: I recently heard someone say "西斜熱", but I really don't know what they mean.

mandarin_meaning: 西方（指地理方位或西方國家／西方文化）
english_meaning: the West; western (the West as a geographical direction or Western countries/culture)
explanation_mandarin: 可指方位上的「西邊」，也常用來指西方國家或西方的文化、思想與社會制度。
explanation_english: Can mean the western direction (the west) or refer to Western countries, Western culture, values, and society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽從西方落山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 cung4 sai1 fong1 lok6 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳从西方落山。
examples.english_sentence: The sun sets in the west.
