explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面意思是试穿鞋子（在鞋店等地方试试看是否合脚）。2) 口语用法上也指让某人接受试用或试训，以考察其能力（如球隊試腳球員）。
explanation_english: 1) Literally means to try on shoes (e.g., at a shoe shop to check fit). 2) Colloquially it can mean to give someone a trial (e.g., a trial period or trial training) to test their ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺間鞋舖試腳，嗰對啱我啲尺碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaan1 haai4 pou3 si3 goek3, go2 deoi3 aam1 ngo5 di1 cek3maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在鞋店试穿，那双合适我的尺码。
examples.english_sentence: I tried on shoes at the shoe store; that pair fits my size.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊上個星期試腳咗一個新前鋒，佢表現唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi2 seong6 go3 sing1 kei4 si3 goek3 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 cin4 fung1, keoi5 biu2 jin6 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队上星期试训了一个新前锋，他表现不错。
examples.english_sentence: The team trialled a new striker last week; he performed well.

mandarin_meaning: 试行 (shìxíng)：先以试验性或临时性的方式施行某项措施、制度或系统，评估可行性与成效。
english_meaning: to trial; to implement on a trial or pilot basis; to run a pilot scheme or test implementation
explanation_mandarin: 表示在小范围或限定时间内先行实施某项政策、制度或系统，以便观察效果并作调整。
explanation_english: To put a measure, policy, or system into effect temporarily or on a limited basis in order to observe results, evaluate feasibility, and make adjustments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司打算下個月試行新系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 si3-hang4 san1 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司打算下个月试行新系统。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to trial the new system next month.

mandarin_meaning: 试穿（衣服）
english_meaning: to try on (clothes); to fit clothing
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示在購買或決定前穿上衣物以確認尺寸或款式是否合適。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to put on clothing to check fit or appearance before buying or deciding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去試身件新衫先，睇下啱唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 si3 san1 gin6 san1 saam1 sin1, tai2 haa5 aap3 m4 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去試穿那件新衣服，看看合不合適。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to try on the new shirt to see if it fits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺試身室裡面用手機影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai6 si3 san1 sat1 leoi5 min6 jung6 sau2 gei1 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在試衣間裡面用手機拍照。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take photos with your phone inside the fitting room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件褲好似唔啱，要再試身另一條先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 fu3 hou2 ci5 m4 aap3, jiu3 zoi3 si3 san1 ling6 jat1 tiu4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條褲子好像不合適，要再試穿另一條。
examples.english_sentence: These pants don't seem right; I need to try on another pair first.

mandarin_meaning: 試衣間 / 試衣室
english_meaning: fitting room; changing room
explanation_mandarin: 指商店或服裝店內供顧客試穿衣物的房間或隔間，通常設有鏡子和試衣鉤/座位。
explanation_english: A room or booth in a store where customers try on clothes, usually equipped with mirrors and hooks or seating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去試身室試件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 si3 san1 sat1 si3 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要去試衣間試衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the fitting room to try on a shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 試身室入面有人，我要等等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si3 san1 sat1 jap6 min6 jau5 jan4, ngo5 jiu3 dang2 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 試衣間裡有人，我要等一會兒。
examples.english_sentence: There's someone in the fitting room; I have to wait.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 試身室入面唔可以影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si3 san1 sat1 jap6 min6 m4 ho2 ji5 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 試衣間裡不能拍照。
examples.english_sentence: You can't take photos inside the fitting room.

mandarin_meaning: 试过 (shìguo) / 曾经尝试过
english_meaning: have tried; tried before; have had the experience of
explanation_mandarin: 由動詞「試」和經驗助詞「過」組成，用來表示曾經做過某事、嘗試過某事或有過某種經驗。
explanation_english: Formed from the verb '試' plus the experiential particle '過'. It indicates that someone has tried or experienced something in the past ('have tried', 'tried before').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試過食呢間餐廳未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 gwo3 sik6 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你試過吃這間餐廳嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Have you tried eating at this restaurant?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以前試過去英國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 cin4 si3 gwo3 heoi3 jing1 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以前試過去英國讀書。
examples.english_sentence: I have studied in the UK before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔試過，你唔會知啲嘢係點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 si3 gwo3, nei5 m4 wui5 zi1 di1 je5 hai6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不試過，你不會知道事情是怎樣的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't try, you won't know what it's like.

mandarin_meaning: 试金石
english_meaning: touchstone; decisive test
explanation_mandarin: 原指用來檢驗金屬真偽的石頭，現常比喻用以檢驗事物真偽、能力或誠意的標準或試驗。
explanation_english: Originally a stone used to test the purity of gold; figuratively, a criterion or test used to determine the quality, authenticity, ability, or sincerity of something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅面試係佢事業嘅試金石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 min6 si3 hai6 keoi5 si6 jip6 ge3 si3 gam1 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的面试是他事业的试金石。
examples.english_sentence: This interview is a touchstone for his career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新政策會成為檢驗政府誠意嘅試金石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 zing3 caak3 wui5 sing4 wai4 gim2 jim6 zing3 fu2 sing4 ji3 ge3 si3 gam1 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新政策将成为检验政府诚意的试金石。
examples.english_sentence: The new policy will become a touchstone for testing the government's sincerity.

mandarin_meaning: 试镜（为演出或上镜进行的试演或镜头测试）
english_meaning: audition; screen test
explanation_mandarin: 指演員、藝人為爭取角色或檢查鏡頭效果而進行的試演或鏡頭測試；可作動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: To audition or perform a screen test — trying out for a role or testing how someone looks on camera. Used as a verb or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日有個試鏡，要準備一段獨白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 jau5 go3 si3 geng3, jiu3 zeon2 bei6 jat1 dyun6 duk6 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她明天有個試鏡，要準備一段獨白。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has an audition tomorrow and needs to prepare a monologue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 導演叫我去試鏡，話有機會爭取一個角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou6 jin2 giu3 ngo5 heoi3 si3 geng3, wa6 jau5 gei1 wui6 zang1 ceoi2 jat1 go3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 導演叫我去試鏡，說有機會爭取一個角色。
examples.english_sentence: The director asked me to audition; he said there's a chance to get a role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拍戲之前通常要做試鏡頭，確保鏡頭效果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paak3 hei3 zi1 cin4 tung1 soeng4 jiu3 zou6 si3 geng3 tau4, kok3 bou2 geng3 tau4 haau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍电影之前通常要做试镜头，以确保镜头效果。
examples.english_sentence: A screen test is often done before filming to ensure the camera shots look right.

mandarin_meaning: 试戴（手表）/ 试戴手錶
english_meaning: to try on a watch
explanation_mandarin: 指在鐘錶店或購買手錶時，將手錶戴在手腕上試戴，查看款式、尺寸或外觀是否合適。
explanation_english: Refers to putting a watch on your wrist at a watch store or when buying a watch to check the style, fit, or appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔想試鐘嗰隻錶？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 si3 zung1 go2 zek3 biu1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想不想试戴那只手表？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to try on that watch?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 試鐘之前要先量吓手圍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si3 zung1 zi1 cin4 jiu3 sin1 loeng4 haa5 sau2 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 试戴之前要先量一下手围。
examples.english_sentence: Before trying the watch on, measure your wrist first.

mandarin_meaning: 试音；声检；（试唱/试音）
english_meaning: soundcheck; audio test; (also used for audition/voice test)
explanation_mandarin: 指在演出、錄音或廣播前檢查和調整麥克風、音響等設備的聲音狀況；在唱片或聲音行業也可指試唱或試音試鏡的動作。
explanation_english: Refers to checking and adjusting microphones, speakers, and audio equipment before a performance, recording, or broadcast; can also mean an audition or voice test in the music/recording industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會之前要做試音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 zi1 cin4 jiu3 zou6 si3 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会之前要做试音。
examples.english_sentence: We need to do a soundcheck before the concert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日去唱片公司試音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 coeng3 pin2 gung1 si1 si3 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天去唱片公司试音。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the record company today for an audition/voice test.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪有雜音，工程師話要再試音一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 jau5 zaap6 jam1, gung1 cing4 si1 waa6 jiu3 zoi3 si3 jam1 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麦克风有杂音，工程师说要再试音一次。
examples.english_sentence: The mic has interference; the technician said we need to do the soundcheck again.

mandarin_meaning: 试题
english_meaning: test question; exam question
explanation_mandarin: 指考試或測驗中要回答的題目。
explanation_english: Refers to questions that appear on a test or exam and need to be answered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份考試嘅試題好難，我答唔晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 haau2 si3 ge3 si3 tai4 hou2 naan4, ngo5 daap3 m4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次考試的試題很難，我做不完。
examples.english_sentence: The exam questions are difficult; I couldn't finish them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師已經發晒全部試題出嚟，學生要返屋企複習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 ji5 ging1 faat3 saai3 cyun4 bou6 si3 tai4 ceot1 lai4, hok6 saang1 jiu3 faan1 uk1 kei5 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師已經把全部試題發出來了，學生要回家複習。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher has already released all the test questions; students should go home and review.

mandarin_meaning: 試驗；測試；實驗（檢驗某事物或方法的效果）
english_meaning: test; experiment; trial (to examine or evaluate something under controlled conditions)
explanation_mandarin: 指為了檢驗、評估或驗證某物、方法或理論而進行的試驗或測試，可用作動詞或名詞。
explanation_english: Refers to conducting a test, experiment, or trial to evaluate, verify, or examine something; usable as a verb or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院而家做緊一個新疫苗嘅臨床試驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 jat1 go3 san1 jik6 miu4 ge3 lam4 coeng4 si3 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫院現在正在做一個新疫苗的臨床試驗。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital is currently conducting a clinical trial of a new vaccine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程師會試驗新嘅軟件功能，確保冇漏洞先至推出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 si1 wui5 si3 jim6 san1 ge3 jyun5 gin6 gung1 nang4, kok3 bou2 mou5 lau6 dung6 sin1 zi3 teoi1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程師會試驗新的軟件功能，確保沒有漏洞才推出。
examples.english_sentence: The engineers will test the new software features to ensure there are no vulnerabilities before release.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺實驗室做緊試驗，測試呢個新產品嘅效能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 sat6 jim6 sat1 zou6 gan2 si3 jim6, caak1 si3 ni1 go3 san1 caan2 ban2 ge3 haau6 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在實驗室做試驗，測試這個新產品的效能。
examples.english_sentence: We're running experiments in the lab to test the performance of this new product.

mandarin_meaning: 试点（shìdiǎn）；先行试验或试行某项政策、计划或系统
english_meaning: pilot (pilot project); to pilot or trial-run something on a small scale
explanation_mandarin: 指在有限範圍內先進行嘗試性的實施，目的是評估效果和可行性，然後再決定是否全面推行。
explanation_english: Refers to carrying out a small-scale trial implementation of a policy, plan, or system to evaluate its effectiveness and feasibility before wider rollout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會喺下個月做一個試點計劃，先試下新系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 hai2 haa6 go3 jyut6 zou6 jat1 go3 si3 dim2 gai3 waak6 , sin1 si3 haa5 san1 hai6 tung2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會在下個月做一個試點計劃，先試用新系統。
examples.english_sentence: The company will run a pilot program next month to try out the new system first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府打算喺幾個社區試點垃圾分類，睇下成效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 daa2 syun3 hai2 gei2 go3 se5 keoi1 si3 dim2 laap6 saap3 fan1 leoi6 , tai2 haa5 sing4 haau6 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府打算在幾個社區試點垃圾分類，看看成效。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to pilot waste sorting in several communities to see the results.

mandarin_meaning: 詩；詩歌
english_meaning: poem; poetry
explanation_mandarin: 指以節奏、韻律或意象為特徵的文學作品，常用來抒發情感或表達思想。
explanation_english: A literary composition (poem) characterized by rhythm, imagery, and concentrated language, used to express feelings or ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗一首詩畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 jat1 sau2 si1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他寫了一首詩給我。
examples.english_sentence: He/she wrote a poem for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意讀唐詩同宋詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 duk6 tong4 si1 tung4 sung4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡讀唐詩和宋詞。
examples.english_sentence: I like reading Tang poetry and Song lyrics.

mandarin_meaning: 詩人；創作詩歌的人
english_meaning: poet
explanation_mandarin: 以詩歌創作為職業或興趣的人，擅長用凝練的語言表達情感與意象。
explanation_english: A person who writes poetry (a poet); someone who composes poems, often expressing emotions and images through condensed language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個詩人，成日喺咖啡店寫詩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 si1 jan4, seng4 jat6 hai2 kaa1 fe1 dim3 se2 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個詩人，經常在咖啡店寫詩。
examples.english_sentence: He's a poet who often writes poems in cafes.

mandarin_meaning: 詩作 (shīzuò)
english_meaning: poem; poetic composition
explanation_mandarin: 指詩歌的作品，用來稱呼個人或他人創作的詩，語氣較書面或正式。
explanation_english: A work of poetry; a poem or poetic composition. The term is relatively formal and is used to refer to a written poem by someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最新嘅詩作好有感染力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 san1 ge3 si1 zok3 hou2 jau5 gam2 jim5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最新的詩作很有感染力。
examples.english_sentence: His latest poem is very moving.

mandarin_meaning: 诗句（詩歌中的一句）
english_meaning: a line or verse of poetry
explanation_mandarin: 指詩歌中的一句或一行，通常是表達完整意思、畫面或情感的語言單位。
explanation_english: Refers to a line or verse in a poem, usually a unit that expresses a complete idea, image, or emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺詩入面寫咗一句好靚嘅詩句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 si1 jap6 min6 se2 zo2 jat1 geoi3 hou2 leng3 ge3 si1 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在詩裡寫了一句很漂亮的詩句。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a beautiful line of poetry in the poem.

mandarin_meaning: 诗情画意（充满诗意、如画的意境）
english_meaning: poetic and picturesque; full of poetic charm and pictorial beauty
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容景色、情境或氛圍具有詩一般的意境和如畫的美，常用於讚美風景或浪漫的氛圍。
explanation_english: Describes a scene or mood that is poetic and picturesque, evoking poetic imagery and artistic beauty; commonly used to praise scenery or a romantic atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅山水好詩情畫意，好啱嚟度寫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 saan1 seoi2 hou2 si1 cing4 waa6 ji3, hou2 ngaam1 lai4 dou6 se2 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的山水很诗情画意，很适合来这里写生。
examples.english_sentence: The landscape here is very poetic and picturesque — perfect for coming here to sketch.

mandarin_meaning: 诗意 (shīyì)
english_meaning: poetic; having the mood or imagery of poetry
explanation_mandarin: 形容富有詩歌的意境、情趣或美感，常用來描述景物、語言或氛圍具有畫面感與情調。
explanation_english: Describes something that evokes the mood, imagery, or aesthetic of poetry; often used for scenes, language, or atmospheres that feel picturesque or lyrical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫好有詩意，睇落好寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 hou2 jau5 si1 ji3, tai2 lok6 hou2 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画很有诗意，看起来很宁静。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is very poetic; it looks very tranquil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條小巷入面好有詩意，夜晚行過有種浪漫嘅感覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 siu2 hong6 jap6 min6 hou2 jau5 si1 ji3, je6 maan5 hang4 gwo3 jau5 zung2 long6 maan6 ge3 gam2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条小巷很有诗意，晚上经过有一种浪漫的感觉。
examples.english_sentence: This little alley is very poetic; walking past at night gives a romantic feeling.

mandarin_meaning: 詩歌（詩與歌的總稱）／詩歌
english_meaning: poetry; poems and songs
explanation_mandarin: 指詩與歌的文學或藝術形式，泛指詩作或歌謠，常用於文學、表演或宗教等場合。
explanation_english: Refers to poetry and songs as literary or artistic forms; broadly denotes poems or ballads, often used in literary, performance, or religious contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校今個禮拜會舉行一場詩歌朗誦會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 geoi2 hang4 jat1 coeng4 si1 go1 long5 sung3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校這個星期會舉行一場詩歌朗誦會。
examples.english_sentence: The school will hold a poetry recitation event this week.

mandarin_meaning: 诗白（詩式念白）
english_meaning: poetic recitative (poem-like spoken lines)
explanation_mandarin: 詩白指在戲曲、表演或文學中以詩歌形式寫成，但以念白或口語方式朗誦或表演的段落。它介乎唱腔與純粹口白之間，保留詩歌的韻律與修辭特徵，常見於粵劇、戲曲及某些文學作品中。
explanation_english: Poetic recitative: lines written in verse but spoken or recited rather than sung. Common in Cantonese opera and other theatrical or literary contexts, it sits between sung passages and plain spoken dialogue and preserves poetic rhythm and rhetorical features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺粵劇入面有段詩白，好有感染力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jyut6 kek6 jap6 min6 jau5 dyun6 si1 baak6, hou2 jau5 gam2 cin2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在粤剧里面有段诗白，很有感染力。
examples.english_sentence: He has a poetic recitative passage in the Cantonese opera that is very moving.

mandarin_meaning: 诗篇（指诗歌、诗的篇章；亦常指《圣经》中的〈诗篇〉）
english_meaning: psalm; a poem or a collection/passage of poetry (often refers to the Book of Psalms in the Bible)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指一首詩或詩的篇章；在宗教語境中常特指聖經裡的《詩篇》卷，包含多首詩歌與讚美文。
explanation_english: Refers to a poem or a passage of poetry; in religious contexts it commonly denotes the Book of Psalms in the Bible, which contains many hymns and poems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺教會讀咗一段詩篇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaau3 wui6 duk6 zo2 jat1 dyun6 si1 pin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在教会读了一段诗篇。
examples.english_sentence: He read a passage from the Psalms at church.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 《詩篇》係聖經入面嘅一卷書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 pin1 hai6 sing3 ging1 jap6 min6 ge3 jat1 gyun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 《诗篇》是圣经里面的一卷书。
examples.english_sentence: The Book of Psalms is a book in the Bible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢昨晚朗讀咗一段詩篇，令大家好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok6 maan5 long5 duk6 zo2 jat1 dyun6 si1 pin1, ling6 daai6 gaa1 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚朗读了一段诗篇，让大家很感动。
examples.english_sentence: He read a passage from the Psalms last night, which moved everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 詩興大發（突發性地產生強烈的作詩興致或靈感）
english_meaning: suddenly struck by a poetic mood; a burst of inspiration to compose poetry
explanation_mandarin: 形容突然興起作詩的興致或靈感，常用來說某人在某個時刻特別有詩意或想寫詩。
explanation_english: Describes a sudden strong urge or inspiration to write poetry; used when someone becomes particularly poetic or inspired at a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝行山嗰陣，佢詩興大發，寫咗首短詩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 haang4 saan1 go2 zan6, keoi5 si1 hing3 daai6 faat3, se2 zo2 sau2 dyun2 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上爬山時，他詩興大發，寫了一首短詩。
examples.english_sentence: This morning while hiking, he was suddenly struck by a poetic mood and wrote a short poem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲完幾杯酒之後，大家都詩興大發，輪流即興作詩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam2 jyun4 gei2 bui1 zau2 zi1 hau6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 si1 hing3 daai6 faat3, leon4 lau4 zik1 hing3 zok3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝了幾杯酒後，大家詩興大發，輪流即興作詩。
examples.english_sentence: After a few drinks, everyone felt poetic and took turns improvising poems.

mandarin_meaning: 诗词（詩和詞，中文的詩歌體裁）
english_meaning: poetry; poems and lyrics (classical Chinese poetic forms, shi and ci)
explanation_mandarin: 指詩和詞兩種文學體裁，常用來泛指傳統中文的詩歌或詞章，包含格律、押韻等形式特色。
explanation_english: Refers to the literary forms shi (poems) and ci (lyrics); broadly denotes traditional Chinese poetry and lyrical verse, often with specific metrical and rhyming patterns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意寫詩詞，經常都有新作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 se2 si1 ci4, ging1 soeng4 dou1 jau5 san1 zok3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜歡寫詩詞，經常有新作品。
examples.english_sentence: He likes writing poetry and often has new works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校舉辦咗一場詩詞朗誦比賽，吸引咗好多學生參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 geoi2 baan6 zo2 jat1 coeng4 si1 ci4 long5 sung3 bei2 coi3, kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 hok6 saang1 caam1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校舉辦了一場詩詞朗誦比賽，吸引了很多學生參加。
examples.english_sentence: The school held a poetry recital competition that attracted many students to participate.

mandarin_meaning: 诗词歌赋（指诗、词、歌、赋等文学体裁，泛指诗歌及文学作品）
english_meaning: Poetry and other literary forms (refers to poems, lyrics, songs, rhapsodies; collectively denotes poetic and literary works)
explanation_mandarin: 「詩詞歌賦」為四字成語，指詩、詞、歌、賦等各種傳統文學體裁，常用以泛指詩歌與文學創作或文學藝術方面的內容。
explanation_english: A four-character idiom referring to classical Chinese literary forms—poems, ci (lyrics), songs and fu (rhapsodies). It is commonly used to refer broadly to poetry and literary works or the art of literature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對詩詞歌賦有好深嘅研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 si1 ci4 go1 fu3 jau5 hou2 sam1 ge3 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她對詩詞歌賦有很深的研究。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has conducted in-depth research into poetry and literary forms.

mandarin_meaning: 詫（读作 chà），表示惊讶、诧异
english_meaning: to be surprised; astonished; startled
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 動詞（書面語）
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事感到驚訝或不解，多見於書面語或與「詫異」等詞組合使用。
explanation_english: Expresses surprise or astonishment; mostly used in written/formal contexts and commonly appears in compounds such as '詫異'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅說法感到非常詫異。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 syut3 faat3 gam2 dou3 fei1 soeng4 caa3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對他的說法感到非常詫異。
examples.english_sentence: I was very surprised by what he said.

mandarin_meaning: 诧异（感到惊讶、惊异）
english_meaning: astonished; surprised; taken aback
explanation_mandarin: 表示對出乎意料或不同尋常的事物感到驚訝、不解或訝異。
explanation_english: Indicates feeling surprised, astonished, or taken aback by something unexpected or unusual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢突然辭職感到詫異。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 dat6 jin4 ci4 zik1 gam2 dou3 caa3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對他突然辭職感到詫異。
examples.english_sentence: I was astonished by his sudden resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見到嗰幅畫嘅風格咁特別，都有啲詫異。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 dou2 go2 fuk1 waa6 ge3 fung1 gaak3 gam3 dak6 bit6, dou1 jau5 di1 caa3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到那幅畫的風格如此特別，我也有些詫異。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that painting's style was so unusual, I felt somewhat surprised.

mandarin_meaning: 詬罵；責罵、指責（多用於書面語或與其他字合用，如「詬罵」「詬病」）
english_meaning: to scold; to berate; to criticize (often literary or used in compounds like 詬罵, 詬病)
explanation_mandarin: 「詬」字常見於書面語或與其他字連用，表示責備、辱罵或批評。例如「詬罵」「詬病」。單獨使用較少，口語中常以「罵」「斥責」替代。
explanation_english: The character 詬 is often used in literary or written contexts and in compounds to mean to berate, criticize, or insult (e.g. 詬罵, 詬病). It is rarely used alone in everyday speech; colloquial alternatives include 罵 or 斥責.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不停詬罵我，真係好無禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 ting4 gau3 maa6 ngo5, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou4 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不停詬罵我，真是很沒禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: He kept berating me; it's really rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅做法畀人詬病，社會上有好多批評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 zou6faat3 bei2 jan4 gau3 beng6, se5wui6 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 pai1ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的做法被人詬病，社會上有很多批評。
examples.english_sentence: Their approach was criticized; there are many criticisms in society.

mandarin_meaning: 挑剔、指责别人的缺点；批评（多带贬义）
english_meaning: to criticize; to censure; to find fault with
explanation_mandarin: 表示挑剔或指責事物或人的缺點，常用於書面或正式語境，帶有負面評價的意思。
explanation_english: Used to indicate criticizing or finding fault with a person or thing, often in a somewhat formal or literary register and generally carrying negative judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲評論家詬病政府處理疫情嘅方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 ping4 leon6 gaa1 gou3 beng6 zing3 fu2 cyu2 lei5 jik6 cing4 ge3 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些評論家詬病政府處理疫情的方式。
examples.english_sentence: Some commentators criticized the government's way of handling the epidemic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日詬病同事嘅缺點，唔肯幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gou3 beng6 tung4 si6 ge3 kyut3 dim2, m4 hang2 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是挑剔同事的缺點，不肯幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He constantly finds fault with his colleagues' shortcomings and refuses to help.

mandarin_meaning: 诡（guǐ）：表示诡异、诡计，含有奇怪或奸诈的意思
english_meaning: strange; uncanny; deceitful; crafty
explanation_mandarin: 「詭」常用於合成詞（如「詭異」「詭計」），表示不尋常、怪異或帶有欺騙、奸詐的性質。
explanation_english: The character 詭 is used in compounds (e.g. 詭異, 詭計) to indicate something strange/uncanny or deceitful and crafty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事睇落好詭異，唔似正常嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 tai2 lok6 hou2 gwai2 ji6, m4 ci5 zing3 soeng4 ge3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事看起来很诡异，不像正常的情况。
examples.english_sentence: This matter looks very strange; it doesn't seem like a normal situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢整咗個詭計想呃人，結果畀人識破。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing2 zo2 go3 gwai2 gei3 soeng2 aak1 jan4, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 sik1 po3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他弄了个诡计想骗别人，结果被人识破。
examples.english_sentence: He hatched a trick to deceive people, but it was seen through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚條街有種詭異嘅氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 tiu4 gaai1 jau5 zung2 gwai2 ji6 ge3 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜晚街道有种诡异的气氛。
examples.english_sentence: There's a strange/uncanny atmosphere on the street at night.

mandarin_meaning: 诡异 (guǐyì)
english_meaning: strange; weird; eerie; uncanny
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事情、氣氛、行為或人等奇怪、怪異、令人不安或不可思議的情況。
explanation_english: Describes something (an event, atmosphere, behavior, or person) that is strange, uncanny, eerie, or unsettling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好詭異，我唔知點解會咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 gwai2 ji6, ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事很詭異，我不知道為什麼會這樣。
examples.english_sentence: This is so weird; I don't know why it happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚經過間舊屋覺得好詭異，燈光不停閃爍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 ging1 gwo3 gaan1 gau6 uk1 gok3 dak1 hou2 gwai2 ji6, dang1 gwong1 bat1 ting4 sim2 seok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上經過那間舊房子覺得很詭異，燈光一直在閃爍。
examples.english_sentence: Passing that old house at night felt very eerie; the lights kept flickering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個解釋有啲詭異，我唔太信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 gaai2 sik1 jau5 di1 gwai2 ji6, ngo5 m4 taai3 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的解釋有點詭異，我不太相信。
examples.english_sentence: Your explanation is a bit strange — I'm not sure I believe it.

mandarin_meaning: 诡秘（奇怪、神秘且带有隐秘或不安的意味）
english_meaning: eerie; mysterious; strange and secretive
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物或氣氛帶有奇怪、神秘或隱秘的特質，常令人感到不安或好奇。
explanation_english: Describes something or an atmosphere that is strange, mysterious, or secretive, often causing unease or curiosity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間房入面有啲好詭祕嘅感覺，唔知係咪有人住過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei1 gaan1 fong2 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 hou2 gwai2 bei3 ge3 gam2 gok3, m4 zi1 hai6 mai6 jau5 jan4 zyu6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房里有点很诡秘的感觉，不知道是不是有人住过。
examples.english_sentence: This room feels rather eerie; I wonder if someone has lived here before.

mandarin_meaning: 诡秘 (guǐmì) — 指神秘、怪异，给人难以捉摸或不安的感觉。
english_meaning: mysterious; enigmatic; secretive — having an uncanny, hard-to-understand, or unsettling quality.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物或举止带有神秘、不可捉摸或令人不安的特质，常用于形容环境、氣氛或人的行為。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone's behavior as mysterious, enigmatic, or eerie — implying secrecy or an unsettling, hard-to-understand quality. Commonly used to describe situations, atmospheres, or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方好詭秘，夜晚唔好一個人去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 hou2 gwai2 bei3, je6 maan5 m4 hou2 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方很诡秘，晚上不要一个人去。
examples.english_sentence: This place is very mysterious; don't go there alone at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為好詭秘，唔知有咩打算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 haang4 wai4 hou2 gwai2 bei3, m4 zi1 jau5 me1 daa2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为很诡秘，不知道有什么打算。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is very secretive/mysterious; I don't know what he's planning.

mandarin_meaning: 诡计（陰險的計謀或騙術）
english_meaning: trick; ruse; deceitful scheme
explanation_mandarin: 指為了欺騙或達到不正當目的而使用的陰險手段或計謀，範圍可從小伎倆到複雜騙局。
explanation_english: Refers to deceitful schemes or maneuvers used to trick or manipulate others; can range from small tricks to elaborate plots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日用啲詭計騙人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jung6 di1 gwai2 gai3 pin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常用詭計騙人。
examples.english_sentence: He often uses tricks to deceive people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個投資案有啲詭計，小心唔好上當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tau4 zi1 on3 jau5 di1 gwai2 gai3, siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 soeng5 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個投資案有些詭計，小心不要上當。
examples.english_sentence: This investment deal has some tricks; be careful not to be duped.

mandarin_meaning: 诡辩
english_meaning: sophistry; specious argument; to argue deceptively
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can describe the act of arguing deceptively)
explanation_mandarin: 指用貌似合理但實際上不成立或誤導人的論點來辯解或說服別人，帶有狡辯、牽強附會的含義。
explanation_english: Using seemingly plausible but actually fallacious or misleading arguments to defend a position or persuade others; implies sophistry or quibbling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日用啲詭辯嚟護短，聽到好令人反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jung6 di1 gwai2bin6 lai4 wu6 dyun2, teng1 dou3 hou2 ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常用詭辯為自己護短，聽起來令人反感。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses sophistry to defend himself; it sounds really off-putting.

mandarin_meaning: 解釋、詮釋
english_meaning: to interpret; to explain; interpretation (in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示對事物的意義或內涵進行說明或詮釋，常見於「詮釋」一詞中。
explanation_english: Means to explain or interpret the meaning of something; commonly seen in compounds such as '詮釋' (interpretation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好用自己個角度去詮釋佢嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jung6 zi6 gei2 go3 gok3 dou6 heoi3 cyun4 sik1 keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要用自己的角度去詮釋他的行為。
examples.english_sentence: Don't interpret his actions from your own perspective.

mandarin_meaning: 詮釋、解釋（對語言、文本或現象進行解釋或翻譯）
english_meaning: to interpret; to render the meaning of speech/text/data; to translate or explain
explanation_mandarin: 指對語言、文字、數據或現象進行解釋或翻譯，賦予意義或說明脈絡，常見於學術、文學或翻譯語境。
explanation_english: To interpret or explain the meaning of speech, text, data, or phenomena; to translate or render meaning, often used in academic, literary, or translation contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣詮譯佢嘅說話，可能會誤會佢嘅本意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 cyun4 jik6 keoi5 ge3 syut3 waa6, ho2 nang4 wui5 ng6 wui6 keoi5 ge3 bun2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那樣詮釋他的話，可能會誤會他的本意。
examples.english_sentence: Don't interpret his words that way; you might misunderstand his original intention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 研究員需要仔細詮譯呢啲數據先至可以得出結論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin4 gau3 jyun4 seoi1 jiu3 zai2 sai3 cyun4 jik6 ni1 di1 sou3 geoi3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 dak1 ceot1 git3 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 研究人員需要仔細詮釋這些數據才能得出結論。
examples.english_sentence: Researchers need to carefully interpret these data before drawing conclusions.

mandarin_meaning: 诠释；解释，说明
english_meaning: to interpret; to explain; interpretation
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also be used as a noun: 'interpretation')
explanation_mandarin: 指出或阐明某段文字、事实或行为的含义或内涵，用以说明、解释或赋予意义。
explanation_english: To explain or interpret the meaning of a text, fact, action, or data; to provide an interpretation or explanation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章有唔同嘅詮釋方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 cyun4 sik1 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章有不同的诠释方式。
examples.english_sentence: There are different ways to interpret this article.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官對證據嘅詮釋會影響判決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 deoi3 zing3 geoi3 ge3 cyun4 sik1 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 pun3 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官对证据的诠释会影响判决。
examples.english_sentence: The judge's interpretation of the evidence can affect the verdict.

mandarin_meaning: 责问；追问；盘问；责备
english_meaning: to question/press/inquire sharply; to reproach or rebuke
explanation_mandarin: 表示严厉地追问或责备，常见于“詰問”、“詰責”等词语，带有追究或责难的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates sharply questioning or reproaching someone; used in compounds like 詰問 (to interrogate) or 詰責 (to reprimand), carrying a sense of pressing for answers or blame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者喺記者會上詰問政府官員有關呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 hai2 gei3 ze2 wui2 soeng6 git3 man6 zing3 fu2 gun1 jyun4 jau5 gwaan1 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者在记者会上詰问政府官员有关此事。
examples.english_sentence: Reporters questioned the government officials about the matter at the press conference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上司詰責下屬唔盡責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 si1 git3 zaak3 haa6 suk6 m4 zeon6 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上司詰责下属不尽责任。
examples.english_sentence: The boss reproached the subordinate for not fulfilling their responsibilities.

mandarin_meaning: 说；话
english_meaning: to say; speech; words
explanation_mandarin: 「話」在廣東話中通常讀作 waa6。作動詞表示「說、講」，用於轉述或陳述；作名詞表示「話語、言語、事情」。亦出現在口語慣用語，如「話時話」（順帶一提）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '話' (waa6) commonly means 'to say' (verb) or 'words/speech' (noun). It is used for reported speech and remarks, and appears in colloquial expressions such as '話時話' (by the way).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他不来。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wouldn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅話真係幾傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 waa6 zan1 hai6 gei2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的话真的很伤人。
examples.english_sentence: What you said is really hurtful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話時話，你今朝嗰件衫真係幾靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 si4 waa6, nei5 gam1 ziu1 go2 gin6 saam1 zan1 hai6 gei2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說起來，你今天早上的那件衣服真的挺漂亮的。
examples.english_sentence: By the way, that shirt you wore this morning is really pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 一說……就……／說了就……
english_meaning: as soon as... then...; say... and (immediately) do...
explanation_mandarin: 「話⋯就⋯」是廣東話常用的口語句式，表示一旦前項發生或一說到某事，後項就立即發生或被採取，強調動作的迅速或果斷。有時也用於評論某人做事率性或反應快。
explanation_english: The Cantonese pattern 'wa6 ... zau6' is a colloquial construction meaning 'as soon as... then...' or 'say... and (immediately) do...'. It indicates that once the first part happens or is said, the second part occurs immediately, emphasizing immediacy or decisiveness. Often used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話走就走，唔再理人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wa6 zau2 zau6, m4 zoi3 lei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說走就走，沒有人能勸他。
examples.english_sentence: He says he'll leave and then leaves; no one can persuade him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你話做就做，大家都好佩服你嘅決斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 wa6 zou6 zau6 zou6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 pui3 fuk6 nei5 ge3 kyut3 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你說做就做，大家都很佩服你的決斷。
examples.english_sentence: If you say you'll do it and then do it, everyone admires your decisiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話唔去就唔去，點解要理佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wa6 m4 heoi3 zau6 m4 heoi3, dim2 gaai2 jiu3 lei5 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說不去就不去，為什麼要理他？
examples.english_sentence: You say you won't go and you don't; why bother with him?

jyutping: waa6 bat1 tau4 gei1 bun3 geoi3 do1
mandarin_meaning: 話不投機，半句多
english_meaning: When people don't hit it off in conversation, even half a sentence is too much; it's better to stay silent than to continue talking.
explanation_mandarin: 形容彼此談話不合拍，說再多也無益，寧可保持沉默或各走各路。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people don't get along in conversation; talking more is pointless, so it's better to remain silent or separate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣，佢同張經理話不投機半句多，索性唔再發表意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 go2 zan6, keoi5 tung4 zoeng1 ging1 lei5 waa6 bat1 tau4 gei1 bun3 geoi3 do1, sok3 sing3 m4 zoi3 fat3 biu2 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，他和张经理話不投機，半句话都觉得多，干脆不再发表意见。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, he and Manager Cheung didn't hit it off — even half a sentence was too much — so he simply stopped expressing his opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 告诉；说到（用于引出或转接话题）
english_meaning: to tell; to say; (discourse marker) speaking of / by the way
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 連詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「話之」在廣東話中可用作動詞，表示「告訴（某人）」，亦可作話頭或連接語，用來引出或轉換話題。口語中常用的替代說法有「同…講」「講畀…聽」或「話畀…知」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '話之' can function as a verb meaning 'to tell (someone)', or as a discourse marker meaning 'speaking of' or 'by the way' to introduce or shift a topic. More colloquial alternatives include '同…講' or '講畀…聽' (tell someone).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我早幾日已經話之佢，佢仲係唔記得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou2 gei2 jat6 ji5 ging1 waa6 zi1 keoi5, keoi5 zung6 hai6 m4 gei3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我前幾天已經告訴他了，他還是忘了。
examples.english_sentence: I already told him a few days ago, but he still forgot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話之，你仲記唔記得嗰次旅行？
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 zi1, nei5 zung6 gei3 m4 gei3 dak1 go2 ci3 leoi5 hang4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說到這個，你還記不記得那次旅行？
examples.english_sentence: Speaking of which, do you still remember that trip?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得話之爸爸聽，佢可能可以幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 waa6 zi1 baa4 baa1 teng1, keoi5 ho2 nang4 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你記得告訴爸爸，他可能可以幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to tell Dad; he might be able to help.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）告訴你 / 讓你知道
english_meaning: Let me tell you; I'll tell you (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 「話之你」是廣東話的口語表達，用來引出或強調接下來要說的內容，類似「話畀你知／告訴你」。比正式用法更隨意，有時在書寫的廣東話或網絡語境中出現。
explanation_english: "話之你" is an informal Cantonese expression used to introduce or emphasize what follows, similar to Mandarin "告訴你" or English "let me tell you." It is colloquial and less formal than alternatives like "話畀你知."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話之你，佢今日唔會返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 zi1 nei5, keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 告訴你，他今天不會回來。
examples.english_sentence: Let me tell you, he won't come back today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係要話之你，千祈唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 jiu3 waa6 zi1 nei5, cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的要告訴你，千萬不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really telling you, don't ever trust him.

synonyms: 話畀你知 (waa6 bei2 nei5 zi1)
講俾你聽 (gong2 bei2 nei5 teng1)

mandarin_meaning: 告訴他/她；跟他/她說
english_meaning: to tell him/her; to inform him/her
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，表示把某事告訴某人（即『跟他/她說』）。常用於非正式語境，與「話畀佢」意思相近。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning 'to tell/inform him or her'. Used in informal contexts and similar in meaning to 'waa6 bei2 keoi5' (tell him/her).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你見到佢，就話之佢我會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gin3 dou2 keoi5, zau6 waa6 zi1 keoi5 ngo5 wui5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你見到他，就告訴他我會遲到。
examples.english_sentence: If you see him, tell him I'll be late.

mandarin_meaning: 說了算；有決定權
english_meaning: to have the final say; to be in charge of making decisions
explanation_mandarin: 在某個場合或群體中擁有決定權或最後發言權，能決定事情的走向或結果。
explanation_english: To hold the authority to decide or have the final say in a matter; to be the person who determines what happens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司，大方向由經理話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1, daai6 fong1 hoeng3 jau4 ging1 lei5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司，大方向由經理說了算。
examples.english_sentence: In the company, the overall direction is decided by the manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔可以你一個人話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 ho2 ji5 nei5 jat1 go3 jan4 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事不可以由你一個人說了算。
examples.english_sentence: This matter can't be decided by you alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企通常係阿媽話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 tung1 soeng4 hai6 aa3 maa1 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們家通常是媽媽說了算。
examples.english_sentence: At our home, mom usually has the final say.

mandarin_meaning: 说了算的人；决策者；负责人
english_meaning: decision-maker; the person who calls the shots; the person in charge
explanation_mandarin: 指在某個情況或團體中擁有最終決定權、負責作主的人。常用於口語或非正式場合。
explanation_english: Refers to the person who has the final say or authority to make decisions in a situation or group. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次項目嘅話事人係邊個？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 hong6 muk6 ge3 waa6 si6 jan4 hai6 bin1 go3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次项目的负责人是谁？
examples.english_sentence: Who is the person in charge of this project?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講笑吓都好，但最後要由老細做話事人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 siu3 haa5 dou1 hou2, daan6 zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 jau4 lou5 sai3 zou6 waa6 si6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开玩笑可以，但最后要由老板来决定。
examples.english_sentence: Joking aside, in the end the boss has to make the decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家庭入面通常爸爸係話事人，但現代家庭愈來愈講求平等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 ting4 jap6 min6 tung1 soeng4 baa4 baa1 hai6 waa6 si6 jan4, daan6 jin6 doi6 gaa1 ting4 jyu3 lai4 jyu3 gong2 kau4 ping4 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在家庭裡通常爸爸是主事者，但现代家庭越来越讲求平等。
examples.english_sentence: In families the father is usually the decision-maker, but modern families increasingly emphasize equality.

mandarin_meaning: 有決定權的人；說了算的人
english_meaning: the person who has the final say; decision-maker; the one who calls the shots
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，指在某個場合或群體中有最終決定權、說了算的人或角色。常用於非正式語境。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to the person who has the final decision-making power in a situation or group. Commonly used in informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入面邊個係話事偈？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 jap6min6 bin1go3 hai6 waa6si6gai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司裡面誰是有決定權的人？
examples.english_sentence: Who in the company is the decision-maker?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽老細講，最後要唔要加人工都係佢話事偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 lou5sai3 gong2, zeoi3hau6 jiu3 m4jiu3 gaa1 jan4gung1 dou1 hai6 keoi5 waa6si6gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽老闆說，最後要不要加薪都是他說了算。
examples.english_sentence: According to the boss, whether to give a raise in the end is up to him.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/俚語）說了算的人；掌權/做主的人
english_meaning: a person who calls the shots; the one who has the final say
explanation_mandarin: 「話事啤」是廣東話的口語或俚語，用來形容有權決定或最終說話權的人，常帶有非正式或略帶戲謔的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term for someone who has the authority to decide or the final say. Often informal and can be used jokingly or sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投票係佢話事啤，大家唔好爭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 piu3 hai6 keoi5 waa6 si6 be1, daai6 gaa1 m4 hou2 zeng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投票由他来决定，大家别争了。
examples.english_sentence: He's the one who calls the shots in this vote, so everyone stop arguing.

mandarin_meaning: 话事权 / 决定权
english_meaning: decision-making power; authority to make decisions
explanation_mandarin: 指在團體、組織或某個情況中有權決定事情或主導方向的權力或權限。
explanation_english: Refers to the power or authority within a group, organization, or situation to make decisions or determine the course of action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔係我有話事權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 hai6 ngo5 jau5 waa6 si6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不是由我来决定。
examples.english_sentence: This matter isn't for me to decide.

mandarin_meaning: 決定權；說了算
english_meaning: to have the final say; decision-making power; to call the shots
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示具有決定權、能夠說了算的人或行為，也可指誰來作主。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to have the authority to decide or to be the one who calls the shots; can refer to the decision-maker or the act of deciding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個項目由阿強話事計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 hong6 muk6 jau4 aa3 koeng4 waa6 si6 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次項目由阿強說了算。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Keung will call the shots on this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日淨係想話事計，大家一齊傾下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zing6 hai6 soeng2 waa6 si6 gai3, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 king1 haa5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別總是想獨斷，大家一起商量吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always try to be the one who calls the shots; let's discuss it together.

mandarin_meaning: 有決定權的人；說了算的人
english_meaning: a person who calls the shots; the decision-maker
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，用來形容在某範圍內擁有最終決定權或常常說了算的人，有時帶貶義，暗示專斷或好當權。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who has the final say or makes the decisions in a group or organization. It can be neutral or slightly pejorative, implying bossiness or authoritarian behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司入面，老細先係話事齋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 jap6min6, lou5sai3 sin1 hai6 waa6 si6 zaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這家公司裡，老闆才是說了算的人。
examples.english_sentence: In this company, the boss is the one who calls the shots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日想做話事齋，大家都覺得好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 soeng2 zou6 waa6 si6 zaai1, daai6gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是想當說了算的人，大家都覺得很煩。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to be the one in charge; everyone finds it annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 議會入面冇一個明確嘅話事齋，決策好分散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 wui6 jap6min6 mou5 jat1 go3 ming4kok3 ge3 waa6 si6 zaai1, kyut3 caak3 hou2 fan1 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 會議中沒有一個明確的決策人，決策很分散。
examples.english_sentence: There's no clear decision-maker in the council; decision-making is very dispersed.

mandarin_meaning: 小聲說／低聲說
english_meaning: to speak quietly; to lower one's voice
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示用較低的聲音說話或叫別人小聲一點。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to speak in a lower voice or to ask someone to speak more quietly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大聲，話低啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1, waa6 dai1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么大声，声音小一点儿吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so loud; speak more quietly.

mandarin_meaning: 別那麼快 / 還沒那麼快（別急）
english_meaning: Not so fast; hold on; don't be so quick to decide or act.
explanation_mandarin: 「話冇咁快」是廣東話的口語表達，用來阻止或勸阻對方過快下結論或行動，相當於普通話的「別那麼快」或「別急」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to stop or warn someone from making a hasty conclusion or action — equivalent to "not so fast" or "hold on" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢會輸？話冇咁快啦，佢仲有機會追返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 wui5 syu1? waa6 mou5 gam2 faai3 laa1, keoi5 zung6 jau5 gei1 wui6 zeoi1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說他會輸？還沒那麼快，他還有機會追回來。
examples.english_sentence: You say he'll lose? Not so fast — he still has a chance to come back.

mandarin_meaning: 沒那麼容易
english_meaning: it's not that easy / easier said than done
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某件事不像說得那麼簡單，常用於提醒或警告他人不要低估困難。
explanation_english: Used to say that something is not as easy as it sounds; often used to warn or remind someone not to underestimate the difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住唔用功就考到高分，話冇咁易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 m4 jung6 gung1 zau6 haau2 dou3 gou1 fan1, waa6 mou5 gam2 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別以為不努力就能考到高分，沒那麼容易。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can get high marks without studying — it's not that easy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 討論到計劃好似好簡單，但真正去做嘅時候話冇咁易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou2 leon6 dou3 gai3 waak6 hou2 ci5 hou2 gaan2 daan1, daan6 zan1 zang3 heoi3 zou6 ge3 si4 hau6 waa6 mou5 gam2 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 討論計劃時好像很簡單，但真正去做時沒那麼容易。
examples.english_sentence: When discussing the plan it sounded simple, but when actually doing it, it wasn't that easy.

mandarin_meaning: 兩面討好
english_meaning: to tell different people different things; to be noncommittal / try to please both sides
explanation_mandarin: 粵語習語，指對不同的人說不同的話或採取模糊立場，兩面討好或不願明確表態。
explanation_english: A Cantonese idiom meaning to speak differently to different people or to take an ambiguous stance — i.e., try to please both sides or avoid taking a clear position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話分兩頭，喺大家面前講嘢總係唔肯表態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 fan1 loeng5 tau4, hai6 daai6 gaa1 min6 cin4 gong2 je5 zung2 hai6 m4 hang2 biu2 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是兩面討好，在大家面前說話總是不肯表態。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to please both sides; when speaking in front of everyone he never dares to take a clear stand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政治人物唔可以成日話分兩頭，選民會唔信任佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 zi6 jan4 mat6 m4 ho2 ji5 sing4 jat6 waa6 fan1 loeng5 tau4, syun2 man4 wui5 m4 seon3 jam6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政治人物不能總是兩面討好，選民會不信任他。
examples.english_sentence: Politicians can't keep trying to please both sides; voters will lose trust in them.

mandarin_meaning: 說到底；最後
english_meaning: in the end; after all is said and done; ultimately
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話表達，常用來引出結論或強調最後的結果，相當於普通話的「說到底」或「最後」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to introduce a conclusion or emphasize the final outcome; equivalent to Mandarin '說到底' or English 'in the end/after all is said and done.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話到尾，佢都係唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 dou3 mei5, keoi5 dou1 hai6 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說到底，他還是沒有來。
examples.english_sentence: In the end, he still didn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以講得再多，但話到尾都係你要負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 gong2 dak1 zoi3 do1, daan6 waa6 dou3 mei5 dou1 hai6 nei5 jiu3 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以再多說，但說到底還是你要負責。
examples.english_sentence: You can talk as much as you want, but in the end you have to take responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 话剧（以口语对白为主的现代戏剧）
english_meaning: spoken drama; modern stage play (drama with spoken dialogue)
explanation_mandarin: 一种以口语对白为主、在舞台上演出的现代戏剧形式，区别于传统戏曲和歌舞类表演。
explanation_english: A form of drama performed on stage that emphasizes spoken dialogue, typically referring to modern plays as opposed to traditional operatic or musical theatre.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日去睇一齣話劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 jat6 heoi3 tai2 jat1 ceot1 waa6 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去看一出话剧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to see a play tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 话匣子（huà xiázi）：指一旦开始说话就停不下来的谈话状态或喜欢说话的人
english_meaning: chatterbox; someone who starts talking and can't stop; to open up and start chatting a lot
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（口语，亦可指动作或状态）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (informal; can describe the act of opening up and talking a lot)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语词，字面上是“话”的匣子，比喻一旦开启就说个不停。可用来形容喜欢讲话的人或某人一开口就滔滔不绝。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning a 'talking box' — a metaphor for someone who, once they start, won't stop talking. Used for a talkative person or the act of opening up and chatting non-stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿敏一開口就打開咗話匣子，講個不停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 man5 jat1 hoi1 hau2 zau6 daa2 hoi1 zo2 waa6 hap6 zi2, gong2 go3 bat1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿敏一开口就打开了话匣子，讲个不停。
examples.english_sentence: Once Ah-man starts talking, she opens up and can't stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個話匣子，成日同人傾到夜晚先走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 waa6 hap6 zi2, sing4 jat6 tung4 jan4 king1 dou3 je6 maan5 sin1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个话匣子，经常和人聊到很晚才走。
examples.english_sentence: He's a real chatterbox — he often chats with people until late before leaving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次議會，某啲議員一開咗話匣子就講好多例子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ji5 wui6, mau2 di1 ji5 jyun4 jat1 hoi1 zo2 waa6 hap6 zi2 zau6 gong2 hou2 do1 lai6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次议会，某些议员一开话匣子就讲了很多例子。
examples.english_sentence: At this council meeting, some councilors opened up and gave lots of examples.

mandarin_meaning: 說漏嘴 / 忍不住說出（本應保密或不該說的事）
english_meaning: can't keep one's mouth shut; blurt out; spill the beans
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，形容一個人忍不住把原本應該保密或不該說的事說出來，或說話沒收斂、說個不停。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who can't keep a secret or can't stop talking — they blurt something out or reveal information they shouldn't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢講咗個驚喜，點知佢話口唔埋，第二日成個學校都知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 zo2 go3 ging1 hei2, dim2 zi1 keoi5 waa6 hau2 m4 maai4, dai6 ji6 jat6 sing4 go3 hok6 haau6 dou1 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我跟他說了一個驚喜，沒想到他忍不住說出來，第二天整個學校都知道了。
examples.english_sentence: I told him about a surprise; unexpectedly he couldn't keep it to himself, and the whole school knew by the next day.

mandarin_meaning: 话还没说完 / 话未说完
english_meaning: haven't finished speaking / I wasn't finished (yet)
explanation_mandarin: 常用于被打断时，表示自己还没把话说完，或用来引出后续的事情，属于口语表达。
explanation_english: A colloquial expression used when someone is interrupted to insist they haven't finished speaking; can also introduce that something happened before the speaker finished. Common in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好打岔，我話口未完呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daa2 caat3, ngo5 waa6 hau2 mei6 jyun4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要打岔，我的话还没说完呀！
examples.english_sentence: Don't interrupt me — I haven't finished speaking!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我話口未完，佢已經走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 waa6 hau2 mei6 jyun4, keoi5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我话还没说完，他已经走了。
examples.english_sentence: I hadn't finished speaking when he had already left.

mandarin_meaning: 據說；被稱為；號稱
english_meaning: to be said to be; to be reputed as; so‑called
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語（表示傳聞/稱呼）
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，用來表示傳聞或稱某人或某物有某個名聲或稱號，相當於普通話的「號稱」「據說」「所謂」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to indicate hearsay or reputation — that someone or something is said to be or is reputed as. It corresponds to Mandarin "號稱/據說" and English "said to be/so‑called."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間餐廳話名係全城最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 waa6 ming4 hai6 cyun4 sing4 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間餐廳據說是全城最好的。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant is said to be the best in the city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話名係個好人，但其實做事唔靠得住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ming4 hai6 go3 hou2 jan4, daan6 kei4 sat6 zou6 si6 m4 kaau3 dak1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被說是個好人，但其實做事不可靠。
examples.english_sentence: He's said to be a good person, but actually unreliable.

mandarin_meaning: （表示）這麼快 / 說來就……
english_meaning: so fast; that quickly; (expressing surprise that something happened so soon)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 感嘆詞 / 副詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示對事情發生得很快的驚訝或感嘆，常與「就」或動詞連用，例如「話咁快就……」。口語常用於廣東話語境。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to show surprise that something happened very quickly. Often appears as an exclamation or adverbial phrase (e.g. "waa6 gam2 faai3 zau6 ..." = "that quickly ...").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上個月先見到佢，話咁快佢就結婚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 sin1 gin3 dou3 keoi5, waa6 gam2 faai3 keoi5 zau6 git3 fan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上個月才見到他，這麼快他就要結婚了。
examples.english_sentence: I only saw him last month — so soon he's getting married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱先放工，話咁快又要返工喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aam1 aam1 sin1 fong3 gung1, waa6 gam2 faai3 jau6 jiu3 faan1 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 剛下班，這麼快又要回去上班了。
examples.english_sentence: I just got off work, and so soon I have to go back to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話咁快就走？點解唔同我講？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 gam2 faai3 zau6 zau2? dim2 gaai2 m4 tung4 ngo5 gong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼快就走？為什麼不跟我說？
examples.english_sentence: You're leaving so soon? Why didn't you tell me?

mandarin_meaning: 說得容易 / 沒那麼簡單
english_meaning: easier said than done; it's not that simple (said sarcastically or dismissively)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，帶有諷刺或反駁意味，多用來表示某事並不像說得那麼簡單，或對別人輕率的說法表示懷疑。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used sarcastically or to dispute someone's claim that something is easy. It conveys that the matter is not as simple as suggested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好話咁易啦，真係有好多困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 waa6 gam2 ji6 laa3, zan1 hai6 jau5 hou2 do1 kwan3 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別說那麼簡單，真的有很多困難。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say it's that easy; there are actually many difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話咁易就開公司？唔係咁簡單㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 gam2 ji6 zau6 hoi1 gung1 si1? m4 hai6 gam2 gaan2 daan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說開公司那麼容易？沒那麼簡單啊。
examples.english_sentence: You think starting a company is that easy? It's not that simple.

mandarin_meaning: 你說什麼？（表示疑問或驚訝、不相信）
english_meaning: What did you say? / What? (expressing question, surprise, or disbelief)
explanation_mandarin: 「話咩」是廣東話的口語用法，常用來詢問剛才說了甚麼，或表示不相信、驚訝或挑釁的語氣，等同於「你說什麼？」
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to ask what was said or to show surprise, disbelief, or challenge. Equivalent to "What did you say?" or simply "What?"

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話咩？再講一次啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 me1? zoi3 gong2 jat1 ci3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說什麼？再說一次吧。
examples.english_sentence: What did you say? Say it again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話咩呀？邊有可能？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 me1 aa3? bin1 jau5 ho2 nang4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說什麼？哪有可能？
examples.english_sentence: What are you saying? How is that possible?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話咩意思？我唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 me1 ji3 si1? ngo5 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說什麼意思？我不明白。
examples.english_sentence: What do you mean? I don't understand.

mandarin_meaning: 說不完；說不盡
english_meaning: cannot be fully said; can't finish saying/expressing (in a few words)
explanation_mandarin: 「話唔埋」是粵語口語，表示用幾句話或一次講法不能把事情說清楚或說完，常用於事情複雜或內容太多的情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning that something cannot be fully said or finished expressing (often because it's complicated or there is too much to cover in a few words).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事太複雜，幾句話話唔埋，要慢慢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 taai3 fuk1 zaap6, gei2 geoi3 waa6 waa6 m4 maai4, jiu3 maan6 maan6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事太複雜，幾句話說不完，要慢慢講。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is too complicated; it can't be explained in a few words — we need to talk it over slowly.

mandarin_meaning: 说不定
english_meaning: maybe; perhaps; it's not certain; could be
explanation_mandarin: 表示不确定的可能性，意思是某件事可能会发生，也可能不会发生，常用来推测或提醒不确定性。
explanation_english: Expresses uncertainty or possibility; indicates that something might happen or might not. Used to speculate or warn that the outcome is not certain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話唔定今晚會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 m4 ding6 gam1 maan5 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她说不定今晚会来。
examples.english_sentence: He/she might come tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家落大雨，話唔定要等陣先出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 lok6 daai6 jyu5, waa6 m4 ding6 jiu3 dang2 zan6 sin1 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在下大雨，说不定要等一会儿才能出门。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining heavily now; we might have to wait a while before going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話唔定佢已經收到信，但未回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 m4 ding6 keoi5 ji5 ging1 sau1 dou3 seon3, daan6 mei6 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说不定他/她已经收到信，但还没回复。
examples.english_sentence: He/she might have already received the letter, but hasn't replied yet.

mandarin_meaning: 只是/罢了（口语，表示弱化或淡化前述内容）
english_meaning: just (saying); merely; only — a colloquial particle used to downplay or soften a statement
explanation_mandarin: “話啫”是粤语口语中的语气词，用来弱化或淡化前面的话，相当于普通话的“只是/罢了”，常用于缓和语气或表示不必当真。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial discourse particle used to downplay or soften a prior remark. Equivalent to 'just (saying)' or 'it's nothing/just that' — often used to indicate one isn't being serious or to reduce the force of a statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我話啫，你唔好咁認真啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 waa6 ze3, nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 jing6 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是说而已，你不要那么认真。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just saying, don't take it so seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話啫，冇咩大不了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ze3, mou5 me1 daai6 bat1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是说说，没什么大不了的。
examples.english_sentence: He was just saying it — it's no big deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係提醒你啫，唔使太擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 tai4 sing2 nei5 ze3, m4 sai2 taai3 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是提醒你，不用太担心。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just reminding you, so don't worry too much.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）把要說的話全部說完／已經說過了
english_meaning: (colloquial) to have said everything; to have said it all; to have already said (something)
explanation_mandarin: 「話嗮」為廣東話口語用法，嗮（或寫作晒）表示完成，合起來表示把要說的話全部說完或已經說出來。常用於非正式語境。
explanation_english: "話嗮" is a Cantonese colloquial expression. 嗮 (same sound as 晒, saai3) marks completion, so together it means to have said everything or to have already said something. Used in informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經話嗮唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 waa6 saai3 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經說了他不會來。
examples.english_sentence: He has already said he won't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好將佢啲秘密話嗮出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoeng1 keoi5 di1 bei3 mat6 waa6 saai3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別把他的秘密全部說出來。
examples.english_sentence: Don't reveal all of his secrets.

mandarin_meaning: （口）說了／說過（用於轉述或帶有不耐煩、強調語氣）
english_meaning: colloquial 'said' / 'said already' (used to report speech or add an emphatic/impatient tone)
explanation_mandarin: 「話嗻」是廣東話口語用法，常用於轉述別人的話或作為語氣詞，帶有強調、已經說過或略帶不耐煩的語氣，相當於普通話的「（已）說了／說過」或口語的「說啦」。
explanation_english: “話嗻” is a colloquial Cantonese expression used to report what someone said or as a discourse particle. It often carries an emphatic or slightly impatient tone, roughly equivalent to Mandarin '（已）說了' or English 'said (already)' or 'I told you'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話嗻佢唔會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ze3 keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說他不會來。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wouldn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂話嗻人呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 waa6 ze3 jan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要隨便說別人的壞話／亂說別人的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't randomly say things about people.

mandarin_meaning: 说定；约定；确定
english_meaning: to agree on; to settle; to make a firm arrangement (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示已經說好或決定（通常指事先約定或確認某個時間、安排或承諾）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to have agreed on something or to have decided/settled an arrangement (often used for appointments or confirmations).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚八點已經話定喺咖啡店見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 baat3 dim2 ji5 ging1 waa6 ding6 hai2 gaa3 fe1 dim3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚八点已经说定在咖啡店见面。
examples.english_sentence: We've agreed to meet at the coffee shop at 8 tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出發前記住話定好時間，唔好遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 faat3 cin4 gei3 zyu6 waa6 ding6 hou2 si4 gaan3, m4 hou2 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出发前记得把时间说定好，不要迟到。
examples.english_sentence: Before leaving, remember to firm up the time; don't be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好話定咗就唔做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 waa6 ding6 zo2 zau6 m4 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要说好了就不做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't agree to something and then not follow through.

mandarin_meaning: 說實話／老實說
english_meaning: to be honest; frankly speaking
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，用來引出誠實或坦白的意見，相當於普通話的「說實話」或「老實說」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used as a discourse marker to introduce an honest or frank statement; equivalent to Mandarin '說實話' or English 'to be honest' / 'frankly speaking'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話實，我真係唔想去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wa6 sat6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說實話，我真的不想去。
examples.english_sentence: To be honest, I really don't want to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話實，你咁做唔係好掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wa6 sat6, nei5 gam2 zou6 m4 hai6 hou2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老實說，你這樣做不太好。
examples.english_sentence: Frankly, what you're doing isn't very good.

mandarin_meaning: 可以說是 / 算得上
english_meaning: can be said to be; could be considered; arguably
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語（情態/評價表達）
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事或某人可以這樣說或算作，帶有評價或推測的語氣，屬於口語用法。
explanation_english: Indicates that something or someone can be described or regarded as... Used to express evaluation or conjecture; a colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司做咗十年，話得埋係個老鳥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1si1 zou6 zo2 sap6 nin4, waa6 dak1 maai4 hai6 go3 lou5 niu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司做了十年，可以說是個老手/資深員工。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked at the company for ten years; you could say he's a veteran.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影雖然票房一般，但從藝術性嚟講，話得埋係一部有深度嘅作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 jing2 seoi1 jin4 piu3 fong4 jat1 baan1, daan6 cung4 ngai6 seot6 sing3 lai4 gong2, waa6 dak1 maai4 hai6 jat1 bou6 jau5 sam1 dou6 ge3 zok3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影雖然票房一般，但從藝術性來說，可以說是部有深度的作品。
examples.english_sentence: Although the film's box office was mediocre, artistically speaking, you could say it's a work with depth.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）已經說明、明明是…／既然…
english_meaning: colloquial marker meaning 'it's been made clear', 'obviously', or 'since it's been said'
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，用來強調某事已經說清楚或理所當然，常帶有不耐煩或責備的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to emphasize that something has already been made clear or is obvious; often carries a tone of impatience or reproach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話明唔會嚟，點解你仲喺度等？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ming4 m4 wui5 lai4, dim2 gaai2 nei5 zung6 hai2 dou6 dang2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經說明不會來，為什麼你還在等？
examples.english_sentence: He already said he wouldn't come; why are you still waiting?

mandarin_meaning: 只是說說而已 / 只是隨口一說
english_meaning: just saying; merely a remark; don't take it seriously
explanation_mandarin: 「話是偈」是廣東話的口語用法，用來表示剛剛說的話只是隨口說說、無須太當真或當作指示。類似「只是說說而已」、「僅僅是一句話」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to indicate that what was just said is merely a remark and should not be taken seriously or treated as an instruction—similar to "just saying".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同你講啫，話是偈，唔好當真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 nei5 gong2 ze1, waa6 si6 gai3, m4 hou2 dong1 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是說說而已，別當真。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just saying; don't take it seriously.

mandarin_meaning: 被說成是預謀/圈套（有人說這件事是故意安排的）
english_meaning: to be said to be a deliberate plan or setup; to be accused of being a scheme
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示有人說某件事是有預謀或是別人設下的圈套，通常帶有懷疑或指責的意味。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that people claim an event was deliberate or a setup; it usually carries a tone of suspicion or accusation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事畀人話是計，我都唔知道可唔可以信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 bei2 jan4 waa6 hai6 gai3, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 dou3 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人說這件事是有預謀的，我也不知道能不能相信他。
examples.english_sentence: People are saying this was planned — I don't know if we can trust him.

mandarin_meaning: 只是說說而已；隨口一說
english_meaning: just saying; merely saying it (not to be taken seriously)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，用來緩和語氣或表示所說的話只是隨便說說，不必當真，也可用來減輕責備或提醒對方不要介意。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to soften a remark or indicate that something was said casually and should not be taken seriously. Often used to reduce tension or to signal no ill intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好當真，我只係話是齋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dong3 zan1, ngo5 zi2 hai6 waa6 si6 zaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別當真，我只是說說而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take it seriously — I'm just saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁講其實係話是齋，唔係真心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 gong2 kei4 sat6 hai6 waa6 si6 zaai1, m4 hai6 zan1 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那樣說其實只是隨口一說，不是認真的。
examples.english_sentence: When he said that, he was just saying it — not serious.

mandarin_meaning: 說起來 / 話說回來 / 順便一提
english_meaning: by the way; speaking of which; incidentally
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，用來轉換話題或插入與前述內容有關的補充說明，語氣隨意、非正式，類似普通話的「說起來」「話說回來」或「順便一提」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese discourse marker used to change the subject or add a related remark. Informal and conversational, similar to Mandarin '說起來' or English 'by the way'/'speaking of which'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話時話，你上次借我嗰本書還唔還呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 si4 waa6, nei5 soeng6 ci3 ze3 ngo5 go2 bun2 syu1 waan4 m4 waan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說起來，你上次借我的那本書還沒還嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Speaking of which, have you returned the book you borrowed from me last time?

synonyms: 順帶一提 (seon6 daai3 jat1 tai4)

mandarin_meaning: 毕竟；反正；说到底（口语用法，用来强调理由或结论）
english_meaning: after all; since; (used to emphasize a reason or conclusion; colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「話晒」是廣東話的口語用法，常放在句首或子句前用來強調原因、理由或結論，類似普通話的「畢竟」、「反正」或「說到底」。語氣上可帶出理所當然、無可奈何或輕微不滿的意味。
explanation_english: “話晒” is a colloquial Cantonese expression placed before a clause to emphasize a reason or conclusion, similar to Mandarin "毕竟/反正" or English "after all/since." It often conveys a sense of obviousness, resignation, or slight reproach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話晒佢係老細，唔好同佢講咁大聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 saai3 keoi5 hai6 lou5 sai3, m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 gam2 daai6 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毕竟他是老板，别对他那么大声说话。
examples.english_sentence: After all, he's the boss; don't speak so loudly to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話晒自己識做，點解仲錯咗？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 saai3 zi6 gei2 sik1 zou6, dim2 gaai2 zung6 co3 zo2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都说自己会做，为什么还错了？
examples.english_sentence: You said you could do it, so why did you still get it wrong?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話晒係免費，點解要俾錢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 saai3 hai6 min5 fai3, dim2 gaai2 jiu3 bei2 cin2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 反正是免费的，为什么要付钱？
examples.english_sentence: Since it's free, why pay?

mandarin_meaning: 话柄 / 把柄（可用来指责、攻击或嘲笑别人的把柄或谈资）
english_meaning: a handle/foil for criticism; something that can be used against someone; fodder for gossip or ridicule
explanation_mandarin: 指可以用來攻擊、嘲諷或討論某人缺點或醜聞的事情，常被當作抨擊或談資。
explanation_english: Refers to information or material that can be used to criticize, reproach, or ridicule someone—something one can hold against a person or use as gossip/ammunition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲私生活畀咗對手好多話柄，依家好難反駁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 si1 saang1 wut6 bei2 zo2 deoi3 sau2 hou2 do1 waa6 beng2, ji1 gaa1 hou2 naan4 faan2 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的私生活给了对手很多话柄，现在很难反驳。
examples.english_sentence: His private life has given his opponents a lot of ammunition; now it's hard to refute him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀呢件小事變成佢哋嘅笑柄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 ni1 gin6 siu2 si6 bin3 seng4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 siu3 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让这件小事变成他们的笑柄。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let this minor matter become their laughingstock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者不停追問，令市長連番道歉，成為新聞界嘅話柄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 bat1 ting4 zeoi1 man6, ling6 si5 zoeng2 lin4 faan1 dou6 hip3, sing4 wai4 san1 man4 gaai3 ge3 waa6 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者不断追问，令市长连番道歉，成为媒体的话柄。
examples.english_sentence: Reporters kept pressing, causing the mayor to apologize repeatedly and become fodder for the media.

mandarin_meaning: 话梅 (huàméi) — 腌制或糖渍的梅子，常作小吃或调味料
english_meaning: preserved plum (sweet-sour-salty plum snack), also used as seasoning
explanation_mandarin: 話梅是一種經過鹽漬或糖漬的梅子，味道通常酸甜帶鹹，可直接當零食吃或用作調味。
explanation_english: A type of preserved plum treated with salt or sugar, typically sweet-sour-salty in taste; eaten as a snack or used as a seasoning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食話梅，酸酸甜甜，好開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 waa6 mui4, syun1 syun1 tim4 tim4, hou2 hoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢吃话梅，酸酸甜甜，很开胃。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating preserved plums; they're sour and sweet and appetizing.

mandarin_meaning: 告诉、让……知道
english_meaning: to tell; to let someone know
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用法，表示把某事告訴別人或讓別人知道某信息，常用於請求或陳述已經告知的情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to tell or let someone know something; commonly used to ask someone to inform another person or to state that someone has already been informed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你早啲話知我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou2 di1 waa6 zi1 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你早点告诉我。
examples.english_sentence: Let me know earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經話知咗我佢唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 waa6 zi1 zo2 ngo5 keoi5 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经告诉我他不会来。
examples.english_sentence: He already told me he won't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得話知我你去邊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 waa6 zi1 ngo5 nei5 heoi3 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得告诉我你去哪儿。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to tell me where you're going.

mandarin_meaning: 告诉你／让你知道
english_meaning: to tell you; to let you know (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示把某事告訴對方或讓對方知道。可用於陳述已經告知（「我早話知你」）或作為警告、強調語氣（「我而家話知你」）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to tell someone or let them know. It can indicate that something has already been told ("I told you earlier") or be used to warn/emphasize ("I'm telling you now").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我早話知你啦，唔好遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou2 waa6 zi1 nei5 laa3, m4 hou2 ci4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早就告诉你了，别迟到。
examples.english_sentence: I told you earlier, don't be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家話知你，唔好再咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 waa6 zi1 nei5, m4 hou2 zoi3 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在告诉你，不要再这样做。
examples.english_sentence: I'm telling you now, don't do that again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩改動記得話知我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 goi2 dung6 gei3 dak1 waa6 zi1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有任何更改记得告诉我。
examples.english_sentence: If there are any changes, remember to let me know.

mandarin_meaning: 告诉他/她；让他/她知道
english_meaning: to let him/her know; to tell him/her
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示把某事告訴對方或讓對方知道某個資訊。比正式的“告诉他/她”更口語、常用於日常對話中。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to indicate informing someone or letting them know something. More casual than the formal 'tell him/her', commonly used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遲啲話知佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci4 di1 waa6 zi1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等一下會告诉他/她。
examples.english_sentence: I'll let him/her know later.

mandarin_meaning: 接著說 / 繼續說
english_meaning: to continue saying; to go on to say
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話口語中用作接續說話，表示接著要講下一部分或繼續講下去，常見於口語敘述或對話中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to continue speech or introduce what is said next; commonly used in spoken narrative or conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話落話：『唔係我嘅錯。』
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 lok6 waa6: "m4 hai6 ngo5 ge3 co3."
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他接著說：「不是我的錯。」
examples.english_sentence: He went on to say, "It's not my fault."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我話落再講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 waa6 lok6 zoi3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等我接著再說。
examples.english_sentence: Wait, I'll say more later.

mandarin_meaning: 话语权 (在某个讨论、决策或舆论场域中拥有发言或影响力的权力)
english_meaning: the power or right to speak; the influence or authority to shape discourse or decisions (having a 'say')
explanation_mandarin: 指在討論、決策或公眾輿論等場域中，擁有發表意見、影響決定或主導話題的權力與影響力。
explanation_english: Refers to the authority or influence someone or a group has to speak, shape discussion, or influence decisions within a particular forum or context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司內部嘅會議上，市場部想爭取多啲話語權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 ge3 wui6 ji5 soeng6, si5 coeng4 bou6 soeng2 zang1 ceoi2 do1 di1 waa6 jyu5 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司內部的會議上，市場部想爭取更多話語權。
examples.english_sentence: At the company's internal meeting, the marketing department wants to gain more influence/ say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為家長，你要有一定嘅話語權，先可以影響孩子嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai6 gaa1 zoeng2, nei5 jiu3 jau5 jat1 ding6 ge3 waa6 jyu5 kyun4, sin1 ho2 ji5 jing2 hoeng2 haai4 zi2 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作為家長，你要有一定的話語權，才能影響孩子的決定。
examples.english_sentence: As a parent, you need to have a certain amount of say in order to influence your child's decisions.

mandarin_meaning: （用作轉換或引出話題）話說/說起來；（有時）據說
english_meaning: Speaking of which; by the way; (sometimes) it is said that
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 插入語/語氣詞（可作連詞用）
explanation_mandarin: 「話說」常用作口語的插入語，用來引入新話題或把話題轉回，例如相當於「說起來」、「順帶一提」。有時也用作講述傳聞，相當於「據說」。
explanation_english: A spoken Cantonese discourse marker used to introduce or shift topics (equivalent to "speaking of which" or "by the way"). It can also be used to introduce a reported saying or rumor ("it is said that").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話說，你聽日有冇空？
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 syut3, nei5 ting1 jat6 jau5 mou5 hung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 話說，你明天有空嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Speaking of which, are you free tomorrow?

mandarin_meaning: （語篇標記）“說起／話說”，用來引入話題或開始敘述（例如：話說當年…）
english_meaning: A discourse marker meaning "speaking of..." or "it is said that", used to introduce a topic or begin a story/narrative.
explanation_mandarin: 「話說」常用作口語或書面敘述的開頭，用來引出一段敘述、故事或轉換話題。根據語境可近似於「說起」、「話說當年」或「據說」。
explanation_english: "話說" is commonly used as an introductory phrase in Cantonese to start a narrative, anecdote, or to shift the topic. Depending on context it corresponds to "speaking of", "it is said that", or "once upon a time" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話說嗰日我喺荃灣見到佢，佢變咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 syut3 go2 jat6 ngo5 hai2 cyun4 waan1 gin3 dou2 keoi5, keoi5 bin3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說起那天我在荃灣看到他，他變化了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Speaking of that day, I saw him in Tsuen Wan — he had changed a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 話說當年阿明喺學校好出名，成日係籃球隊入面最叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 syut3 dong1 nin4 aa3 ming4 hai2 hok6 haau6 hou2 ceot1 ming4, sing4 jat6 hai6 laam4 kau4 deoi6 jap6 min6 zeoi3 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說起當年阿明在學校很出名，他常是籃球隊裡最厲害的。
examples.english_sentence: Speaking of back then, Ah Ming was famous at school — he was always the best on the basketball team.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）說起來／話說，常用作轉換話題或引出補充說明
english_meaning: speaking of which; that reminds me; by the way; it is said that (depending on context)
explanation_mandarin: 用作轉換話題或插話的插入語，相當於「說起來」、「話說回來」或「順帶一提」。在不同語境下也可表示「有人說、據說」。
explanation_english: A discourse marker used to shift or introduce a topic, equivalent to "speaking of which", "that reminds me", or "by the way". In some contexts it can mean "it is said/rumored".
