examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gun2 lei5 cang4 wo4 gung1 wui6 sai6 bat1 loeng5 laap6, baa6 gung1 jat1 zuk1 zik1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司管理層和工會誓不兩立，罷工一觸即發。
examples.english_sentence: Management and the union are sworn enemies; a strike is imminent.

mandarin_meaning: 誓死（誓言宁愿牺牲生命也要做到；表示极强的决心或承诺）
english_meaning: swear to the death; vow to do something even at the cost of one's life; express extreme determination
explanation_mandarin: 表示下决心、发誓愿意为某事付出生命代价，常用于强调坚定的承诺或决心，例如「誓死保護」。
explanation_english: A phrase used to express a vow or determination so strong one would 'swear to die' for it; used to emphasize firm commitment or resolve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我誓死都要保護你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 sei2 dou1 jiu3 bou2 wu6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我誓死也要保护你。
examples.english_sentence: I swear I'll protect you even if it costs my life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話誓死都唔會放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 sai3 sei2 dou1 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说誓死也不会放弃。
examples.english_sentence: He says he will never give up, even to the death.

mandarin_meaning: 向神明（或以莊重方式）發誓、立下誓願
english_meaning: To swear a solemn oath (often invoking gods) or make a solemn vow
explanation_mandarin: 表示以非常莊重的方式向神明或他人發誓，強調誓言的嚴肅性和決心，常見於口語或誇張的表達。
explanation_english: To make a very solemn vow, often invoking deities; used to emphasise the seriousness and determination behind a promise. Common in colloquial or emphatic speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢誓神劈願話會照顧屋企人一世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 san4 pik1 jyun6 waa6 wui5 ziu3 gu3 uk1 kei5 jan4 jat1 sai3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向神明發誓說會照顧家人一輩子。
examples.english_sentence: He swore to the gods that he would take care of his family for life.

mandarin_meaning: 誓约；誓言、承诺或契约
english_meaning: an oath, vow, pledge, or formal promise/agreement
explanation_mandarin: 表示以言語或書面作出承諾或約定的內容或行為，常用於婚禮、法律或正式協議中。
explanation_english: A formal promise or pledge—spoken or written—committing someone to a course of action or an agreement; used in contexts like weddings, legal documents, or formal commitments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺婚禮上互相宣讀誓約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 fan1 lai5 soeng6 wu6 soeng1 syun1 duk6 seoi6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在婚礼上互相宣读誓约。
examples.english_sentence: They read their vows to each other at the wedding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要求新員工簽署保密誓約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau1 kau4 san1 jyun4 gung1 cim1 syu1 bou2 mat6 seoi6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要求新员工签署保密誓约。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires new employees to sign a confidentiality agreement.

mandarin_meaning: 誓言（庄严的承诺或宣誓）
english_meaning: vow; oath; pledge
explanation_mandarin: 誓言指正式且莊嚴的承諾或宣誓，常見於婚禮、就職或個人立志的場合，也可用作比喻性的堅定承諾。
explanation_english: A solemn promise or pledge, typically formal (such as wedding vows or oaths) or a personal commitment; can also be used figuratively to mean a firm promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺婚禮上，佢哋交換誓言，講好要一齊到老。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 fan1 lai5 soeng6, keoi5 dei6 gaau1 wun6 sai6 jin4, gong2 hou2 jiu3 jat1 cai4 dou3 lou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在婚禮上，他們交換了誓言，承諾要一起到老。
examples.english_sentence: At the wedding, they exchanged vows, promising to grow old together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向自己立下誓言，唔會再犯同樣嘅錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 zi6 gei2 laap6 haa6 sai6 jin4, m4 wui5 zoi3 faan6 tung4 joeng6 ge3 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向自己立下誓言，不會再犯同樣的錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: He made a vow to himself not to repeat the same mistake.

mandarin_meaning: 誓言、宣誓時所說的話
english_meaning: oath; vow; words of a pledge (the formal words spoken when making an oath)
explanation_mandarin: 指在宣誓、立誓或婚禮等正式場合中所說的誓言文字或內容，常用來表明承諾或責任。
explanation_english: Refers to the formal words spoken as an oath or vow (e.g., at a wedding or during a swearing-in), used to express a pledge or commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 結婚嗰陣，佢哋互相宣讀誓詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: git3 fan1 go2 zan6, keoi5 dei6 wu6 soeng1 syun1 duk6 sai3 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 結婚時他們互相宣讀誓詞。
examples.english_sentence: At the wedding they read their vows to each other.

mandarin_meaning: 誓言；承諾
english_meaning: vow; pledge; solemn promise
explanation_mandarin: 指以莊嚴或堅定的語氣所作出的承諾或願望，常用於婚禮、儀式或表達決心的場合。
explanation_english: A solemn promise or pledge expressed with firm determination; often used in weddings, ceremonies, or contexts expressing a strong commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺婚禮上講出咗佢對伴侶嘅誓願。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fan1lai5 soeng6 gong2 ceot1 zo2 keoi5 deoi3 bun6leoi5 ge3 sai3 jyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在婚禮上說出了對伴侶的誓言。
examples.english_sentence: He voiced his vow to his partner at the wedding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我誓願會照顧你一世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 jyun6 wui5 ziu3 gu3 nei5 jat1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我誓願會照顧你一輩子。
examples.english_sentence: I vow to take care of you for a lifetime.

jyutping: sai6 jyun6 dong1 sik6 saang1 coi3
mandarin_meaning: 誓言只是空話／不會兌現的承諾
english_meaning: a vow or promise that's empty — mere lip service that won't be fulfilled
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話的俗語，用來形容某人的誓言或承諾只是空談，不會實際兌現，語氣通常帶有懷疑或不屑。屬非正式用語，常見於口語中。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial expression used to describe a vow or promise that is merely empty talk and unlikely to be kept. It is informal and often used with a skeptical or dismissive tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話會還我錢，但我覺得嗰啲誓願當食生菜，唔會兌現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wui5 waan4 ngo5 cin2, daan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 go2 di1 sai6 jyun6 dong1 sik6 saang1 coi3, m4 wui5 deoi3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說會還我錢，但我覺得那些誓言只是空話，不會兌現。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd pay me back, but I think those vows are just empty words and won't be fulfilled.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見或古字，現代漢語中極少使用，無通行的普通話讀音或固定詞義（多見於古籍或字書）
english_meaning: Rare/obsolete Chinese character; not commonly used in modern Mandarin or Cantonese; typically appears only in classical texts or character dictionaries
explanation_mandarin: 「誔」是一個罕見或古字，現代口語與書面語中很少使用。此字多出現在古籍、字典或碑刻中，現代漢語通常沒有統一的讀音與固定詞義，故在普通話與粵語中都屬於冷僻字。
explanation_english: “誔” is a rare or archaic Chinese character seldom used in modern speech or writing. It mainly appears in classical texts or character compilations; there is no widely established modern Mandarin or Cantonese reading or fixed meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「誔」係一個罕見嘅漢字，日常唔會用到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: (罕用字) hai6 jat1 go3 ham2 gin3 ge3 hon3 zi6, jat6 soeng4 m4 wui5 jung6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “誔”是一个罕见的汉字，日常不会使用。
examples.english_sentence: “誔” is a rare Chinese character and is not used in everyday language.

mandarin_meaning: （表詞素）出生、誕生；亦可表示荒誕、不真實（見於合成詞如：誕生、聖誕、荒誕）
english_meaning: a bound morpheme meaning 'birth' or 'to be born'; also appears in words meaning 'absurd' or 'unreal' (e.g., '聖誕' Christmas, '誕生' birth, '荒誕' absurd)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 語素/詞素（多用作合成詞的成分，可構成名詞或動詞等）
partOfSpeech_english: morpheme / bound root (used in compound nouns or verbs)
explanation_mandarin: 「誕」字本身常作詞素使用，意指出生或與誕生有關；在某些合成詞中也表示荒誕、不真實的意思，例如「誕生」、「聖誕」、「荒誕」。
explanation_english: The character '誕' functions mainly as a bound morpheme in Cantonese and Mandarin compounds, typically relating to birth (e.g., '誕生') or, in other compounds, to absurdity (e.g., '荒誕'). It is not often used alone as a free-standing word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聖誕嗰陣我哋會交換禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 daan3 go2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 wui5 gaau1 wun6 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圣诞的时候我们会交换礼物。
examples.english_sentence: At Christmas we exchange gifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻小貓昨晚誕生咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 siu2 maau1 zok6 maan5 daan3 saang1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只小猫昨晚诞生了。
examples.english_sentence: The kitten was born last night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅說話好荒誕，信都唔信得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 syut3 waa6 hou2 wong4 daan3, seon3 dou1 m4 seon3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她说的话很荒诞，根本不可信。
examples.english_sentence: What they said is absurd and not believable.

mandarin_meaning: 诞生
english_meaning: to be born; birth; to come into existence
explanation_mandarin: 表示出生、产生或开始存在；既可指生物的出生，也可比喻事物或观念的出现。
explanation_english: Denotes being born or coming into existence; can refer to biological birth or the emergence/creation of things, ideas, or movements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個嬰兒喺凌晨三點誕生，媽媽而家安好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 jing1ji4 hai2 ling4san4 saam1 dim2 daan3 sang1, maa4maa1 ji4gaa1 on1hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个婴儿在凌晨三点诞生，妈妈现在安好。
examples.english_sentence: The baby was born at 3 a.m.; the mother is fine now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅新品牌喺上個月正式誕生，反應幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 ge3 san1 ban2paai4 hai2 soeng6 go3 jyut6 zing3sik1 daan3 sang1, faan2jing3 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的新品牌在上个月正式诞生，反应挺好。
examples.english_sentence: The company's new brand was officially launched last month and the response has been quite good.

mandarin_meaning: 誕辰（書面語）指生日、出生紀念日
english_meaning: birthday; birth anniversary (formal/literary)
explanation_mandarin: 「誕辰」偏書面或正式用法，用來指個人的生日或名人、聖賢的生辰紀念。
explanation_english: A somewhat formal or literary term meaning someone's birthday or a birth anniversary (often used for notable figures or deities).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係佢嘅誕辰，我哋要慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 daan3 san4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是他的誕辰，我們要慶祝。
examples.english_sentence: Today is his birthday; we should celebrate.

mandarin_meaning: 诱 (yòu)：引诱、诱惑、引发
english_meaning: to entice, to lure, to tempt, to seduce; to induce
explanation_mandarin: 「誘」常用作動詞，表示用某些手段吸引、引誘他人做某事或相信某事，經常出現在合成詞如「引誘」「誘惑」中。
explanation_english: Commonly a verb meaning to entice or lure someone into doing or believing something; frequently appears in compounds like "引誘" (to entice) or "誘惑" (to tempt).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用甜言蜜語誘我信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 tim4 jin4 mat6 jyu5 jau6 ngo5 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用甜言蜜语诱我相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He used sweet words to lure me into believing him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司用高薪誘人加入團隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jung6 gou1 san1 jau6 jan4 gaa1 jap6 tyun4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司用高薪诱人加入团队。
examples.english_sentence: The company entices people to join the team with high salaries.

mandarin_meaning: 诱人（有吸引力，令人心动）
english_meaning: tempting; attractive; enticing
explanation_mandarin: 「誘人」表示某事物具有吸引力或诱惑力，让人产生兴趣或想要去尝试。
explanation_english: “誘人” describes something that is attractive or enticing, provoking interest or desire to try or take it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢道菜賣相好靚，好誘人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 coi3 maai6 soeng2 hou2 leng3, hou2 jau6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜卖相很好，很诱人。
examples.english_sentence: This dish looks great and is very tempting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家有半價優惠，好誘人，我想買一件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 jau5 bun3 gaa3 jau1 wai6, hou2 jau6 jan4, ngo5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在有半价优惠，很诱人，我想买一件。
examples.english_sentence: There's a half-price offer now — very tempting, I want to buy one.

mandarin_meaning: 诱使（yòushǐ）：引诱或驱使某人去做某事
english_meaning: to induce; to entice or lure someone into doing something
explanation_mandarin: 以引诱、劝说或其他手段使某人去做某事，常含使人做出不利或不正当行为的意味。
explanation_english: To cause, tempt, or persuade someone to do something, often by enticing or coaxing; frequently implies leading someone into wrongdoing or an undesirable action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人誘使去偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 jau6 si2 heoi3 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人诱使去偷东西。
examples.english_sentence: He was lured by someone into stealing.

mandarin_meaning: 诱因（yòuyīn）：导致某种结果的原因或诱发因素
english_meaning: inducement; cause; triggering factor — a factor that induces or leads to a particular result
explanation_mandarin: 指引發或導致某種結果的原因或刺激因素，常用於分析行為、事件或疾病等的誘發原因。
explanation_english: Refers to a cause or factor that induces or triggers a particular outcome; commonly used when discussing reasons, incentives, or triggers for behaviors, events, or conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟壓力係佢辭職嘅主要誘因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 aat3 lik6 hai6 keoi5 ci4 zik1 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 jau6 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济压力是他辞职的主要诱因。
examples.english_sentence: Economic pressure was the main reason that led to his resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廣告提供嘅優惠係吸引消費者嘅一個誘因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong2 gou3 tai4 gung1 ge3 jau1 wai6 hai6 kap1 jan5 siu1 fai3 ze2 ge3 jat1 go3 jau6 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 广告提供的优惠是吸引消费者的一个诱因。
examples.english_sentence: The discounts offered in the advertisement are one incentive that attracts consumers.

mandarin_meaning: 诱奸（引诱他人发生性关系，常用于法律语境，指通过诱骗或引诱实施强奸或与未成年人发生性关系）
english_meaning: to entrap or entice someone into sexual intercourse; to sexually entrap (often used in legal contexts, e.g., enticement to rape or to have sex with a minor)
explanation_mandarin: 「誘姦」指以引誘、誘騙等方式使他人發生性行為，常用於法律或新聞報導中，尤其涉及未成年人或強制性情況時，屬於犯罪行為。
explanation_english: “誘姦” refers to inducing or luring someone into sexual intercourse by deception or entrapment. It is commonly used in legal and news contexts and denotes a criminal act, especially when victims are minors or when coercion is involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被指控誘姦一名未成年女童。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 zi2 hung3 jau6-gaan1 jat1 ming4 mei6 sing4 nin4 neoi5 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被指控诱奸一名未成年的女童。
examples.english_sentence: He was accused of luring and raping a minor girl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種行為喺法律上屬於誘姦罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 hang4 wai6 hai2 faat3 leot6 soeng6 suk6 jyu1 jau6-gaan1 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種行為在法律上屬於誘姦罪。
examples.english_sentence: This behavior legally constitutes the crime of enticement to rape.

mandarin_meaning: 诱导 (yòudǎo)：引导、诱使
english_meaning: to induce; to lead or guide someone to do something; to entice or manipulate
explanation_mandarin: 表示以某種方式引導或促使他人做某事。語義可中性（引導、導引、指導），亦可用於負面語境（誘使、操控、誤導）。
explanation_english: Refers to leading or guiding someone to do something. Can be neutral (to guide/instruct) or negative (to entice, manipulate, or mislead).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢試圖誘導我支持佢嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si3 tou4 jau5 dou6 ngo5 zi1 ci4 keoi5 ge3 ji3 gin3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他试图诱导我支持他的意见。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to induce me to support his opinion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用問題誘導我講出真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 man6 tai4 jau5 dou6 ngo5 gong2 ceot1 zan1 soeng6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用问题诱导我说出真相。
examples.english_sentence: He used questions to lead me to reveal the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 诱惑 (yòuhuò)
english_meaning: tempt; temptation; to entice
explanation_mandarin: 表示引誘或吸引某人做某事，也可指能使人產生慾望或難以抗拒的事物或狀態。
explanation_english: Refers to enticing or attracting someone to do something; can also mean something that arouses desire or is hard to resist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅笑容對我嚟講係一種誘惑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu3 jung4 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 jat1 zung2 jau5 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的笑容對我來說是一種誘惑。
examples.english_sentence: His/Her smile is a kind of temptation to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀廣告誘惑你買唔需要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 gwong2 gou3 jau5 waak6 nei5 maai5 m4 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被廣告誘惑去買不需要的東西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be tempted by advertisements to buy things you don't need.

mandarin_meaning: 诱捕 (yòubǔ)
english_meaning: to lure and capture; to entrap (often used for sting operations)
explanation_mandarin: 以引誘、設陷阱或佈局等手段把嫌疑人、動物等引出或引入圈套，然後加以抓捕。
explanation_english: To lure someone or an animal into a trap or sting operation so they can be captured or arrested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方用誘捕行動捉住嗰班走私犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geng2 fong1 jung6 jau6 bou6 hang4 dung6 zuk1 zyu6 go2 baan1 zau2 si1 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方用诱捕行动抓住那批走私犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police used a sting operation to catch that group of smugglers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 動物管制員用誘捕籠引誘隻受傷嘅流浪狗入籠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 mat6 gun2 zai3 jyun4 jung6 jau6 bou6 lung4 jan5 jau6 zek3 sau6 soeng1 ge3 lau4 long6 gau2 jap6 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 動物管制員用诱捕笼引诱受傷的流浪狗進籠。
examples.english_sentence: The animal control officer used a humane trap to lure the injured stray dog into the cage.

mandarin_meaning: 誘發 (yòufā)：引起、導致（某種反應、情況或事件）
english_meaning: to induce; to trigger; to provoke (a reaction, event, or condition)
explanation_mandarin: 表示引起或導致某種反應、症狀、情況或事件，常用於醫學、心理或描述因果關係的語境中。
explanation_english: Indicates causing or bringing about a reaction, symptom, situation, or event; commonly used in medical, psychological, or causal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥可能會誘發過敏反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 faat3 gwo3 man5 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種藥可能會誘發過敏反應。
examples.english_sentence: This medication may induce an allergic reaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲評論好容易誘發爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 ping4 leon6 hou2 ji6 ji6 jau5 faat3 zang1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的評論很容易誘發爭議。
examples.english_sentence: His comments are likely to provoke controversy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌誘發咗我嘅回憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 jau5 faat3 zo2 ngo5 ge3 wui4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這首歌喚起了我的回憶（或：誘發了我的回憶）。
examples.english_sentence: This song triggered my memories.

mandarin_meaning: 誘蚊器 / 诱蚊器 (用來吸引並捕捉或消滅蚊子的裝置)
english_meaning: mosquito trap; mosquito-attracting device
explanation_mandarin: 一種裝置，用來吸引並捕捉或殺死蚊子，通常利用紫外線光、二氧化碳、熱、氣味誘餌或黏性表面等原理，有時也稱為誘蚊燈或捕蚊器。
explanation_english: A device designed to lure and trap or kill mosquitoes, typically using UV light, CO2, heat, scent attractants, or sticky surfaces. Also called a mosquito lamp or mosquito catcher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企買咗部誘蚊器，晚上好少俾蚊叮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 maai5 zo2 bou6 jau6 man1 hei3，maan5 soeng6 hou2 siu2 bei2 man1 ding2。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡買了一台誘蚊器，晚上很少被蚊子叮。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a mosquito trap for the house, so I rarely get bitten at night.

mandarin_meaning: 诱饵 (吸引動物或人的食物或物品；也比喻用來引誘、誘騙的手段)
english_meaning: bait; lure; decoy (something used to attract animals or people; figuratively, a tactic to entice or deceive)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來吸引動物或人靠近的食物或物件；在比喻用法上，指用以引誘或誘騙他人的手段或誘因。
explanation_english: An item or tactic used to attract animals or people. Literally food or an object used to lure (e.g., for fishing); figuratively, a scheme or inducement used to entice or deceive someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方用誘餌引出犯罪集團嘅成員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 jung6 jau6 ji5 jan5 ceot1 faan6 zeoi6 zaap6 tyun4 ge3 sing4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方用诱饵引出犯罪集团的成员。
examples.english_sentence: The police used bait to lure out members of the criminal gang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用麵包做誘餌去捉老鼠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 min6 baau1 zou6 jau6 ji5 heoi3 zuk1 lou5 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用面包做诱饵去抓老鼠。
examples.english_sentence: He used bread as bait to catch mice.

mandarin_meaning: 诱骗 (yòupiàn)
english_meaning: to lure and deceive; to entice someone into a trap or trick them
explanation_mandarin: 用诱导、利诱或欺骗的手法使人上当或做出某事。
explanation_english: To use enticement, bribery, or deception to make someone fall for a trick or do something against their interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用禮物誘騙我簽咗嗰份合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 lai5 mat6 jau5 pin3 ngo5 cim1 zo2 go2 fan6 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用礼物诱骗我签了那份合同。
examples.english_sentence: He used gifts to lure me into signing that contract.

mandarin_meaning: 語（yǔ）— 語言、言語、話語等
english_meaning: 語 (jyu5) — language; speech; words (often a morpheme meaning 'language' or 'speech')
partOfSpeech_english: noun (often a bound morpheme in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 「語」常用作詞素，表示語言、言語或說話的意思，如「語言」「外語」「語音」。在粵語中讀作 jyu5，常見於複合詞中。
explanation_english: The character 語 (Jyutping: jyu5) is used as a morpheme meaning 'language', 'speech', or 'words' (e.g., '語言' = language, '外語' = foreign language). In Cantonese it is pronounced jyu5 and is commonly found in compound words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識講幾種語言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 gong2 gei2 zung2 jyu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會說幾種語言。
examples.english_sentence: I can speak several languages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廣東語同廣東話有啲唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong2 dung1 jyu5 tung4 gwong2 dung1 waa2 jau5 di1 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 粵語和廣東話有些不同。
examples.english_sentence: Yue (廣東語) and the term Cantonese (廣東話) have some differences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺語言學方面好有研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jyu5 jin4 hok6 fong1 min6 hou2 jau5 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在語言學方面有很多研究。
examples.english_sentence: He has done a lot of research in linguistics.

mandarin_meaning: 说话惊人；言语出人意料、令人震惊
english_meaning: to say something startling; a remark that shocks or surprises listeners
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一句話或言論出人意料、令人震驚或感到驚訝，常用於描述某人說話內容令人吃驚。
explanation_english: Used to describe a remark that is unexpected and startling; often applied when someone's words surprise or shock the audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱講嗰句真係語出驚人，冇人估到佢會咁講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aam1 aam1 gong2 go2 geoi3 zan1 hai6 jyu5 ceot1 ging1 jan4, mou5 jan4 gu2 dou3 keoi5 wui5 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛才說的那句話真是語出驚人，沒有人想到他會這麼說。
examples.english_sentence: What he just said was truly startling; no one expected him to say that.

mandarin_meaning: 語句 (yǔjù) — 句子或短語；表達的措辭
english_meaning: sentence; phrase; wording
explanation_mandarin: 指語言中完整的表達單位，如句子或短語；也可指表達方式或措辭。
explanation_english: Refers to a unit of expression in language, such as a sentence or phrase; can also mean wording or phrasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫嘅語句好唔通順，需改一改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 ge3 jyu5 geoi3 hou2 m4 tung1 seon3, seoi1 goi2 jat1 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他寫的語句很不通順，需要修改一下。
examples.english_sentence: The sentences he wrote are very awkward; they need to be revised.

mandarin_meaning: 语境
english_meaning: context (linguistic context)
explanation_mandarin: 指一句话、词语或交流行为所处的语言环境或情境，影响该话语的含义与解读。
explanation_english: Refers to the linguistic situation or environment in which an utterance occurs; it affects the meaning and interpretation of the utterance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺唔同嘅語境入面，一句話可以有唔同意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 jyu5 ging2 jap6 min6, jat1 ge3 waa6 ho2 ji5 jau5 m4 tung4 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在不同的语境中，同一句话可能有不同的意思。
examples.english_sentence: In different contexts, the same sentence can have different meanings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫作時要留意讀者嘅語境，同埋適當調整用詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 zok3 si4 jiu3 lau4 ji3 duk6 ze2 ge3 jyu5 ging2, tung4 maai4 sik1 dong3 tiu4 zing2 jung6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写作时要注意读者的语境，并适当调整用词。
examples.english_sentence: When writing, pay attention to the readers' context and adjust wording accordingly.

mandarin_meaning: 语序（指词语在句子中的排列顺序）
english_meaning: word order (the order of words in a sentence)
explanation_mandarin: 指語言中詞語在句子裡出現的先後排列，會影響句子的意思和語法關係。
explanation_english: The order in which words appear in a sentence; it affects meaning and grammatical relations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 英文同中文嘅語序唔一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 man4 tung4 zung1 man4 ge3 jyu5 zeoi6 m4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 英文和中文的语序不一样。
examples.english_sentence: English and Chinese have different word order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學習語序可以幫助你寫出正確嘅句子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 zaap6 jyu5 zeoi6 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 nei5 se2 ceot1 zing3 kok3 ge3 geoi3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习语序可以帮助你写出正确的句子。
examples.english_sentence: Learning word order can help you write correct sentences.

mandarin_meaning: 語感（yǔgǎn）：對語言、句子、發音或用法的直覺性敏感度，能判斷是否自然或恰當。
english_meaning: linguistic intuition; a feel for language — the intuitive sense of whether words, sentences, pronunciation or usage sound natural or appropriate.
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人對語言的直覺判斷能力，例如聽到一句話是否自然、語序或用詞是否恰當。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's intuitive ability regarding language — for example judging whether a sentence sounds natural, or whether word choice or word order is appropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好強嘅語感，寫英文信都冇乜問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 koeng4 ge3 jyu5 gam2, se2 jing1man4 seon3 dou1 mou5 mat1 man6tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有很強的語感，寫英文信也沒什麼問題。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong sense of language; writing English letters is not much of a problem for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學語言嘅時候，多聽多講可以提升語感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jyu5jin4 ge3 si4hau6, do1 teng1 do1 gong2 ho2 ji5 tai1sing1 jyu5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學語言的時候，多聽多說可以提升語感。
examples.english_sentence: When learning a language, listening and speaking more can improve your linguistic intuition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嗰句講法聽落語感唔太自然，可能要改一改語序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go2 geoi3 gong2 faat3 teng1 lok6 jyu5 gam2 m4 taai3 zi6jin4, ho2 nang4 jiu3 goi2 jat1 go3 jyu5 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你那句講法聽起來語感不太自然，可能要稍微改一下語序。
examples.english_sentence: That phrasing doesn't sound quite natural — you might need to tweak the word order a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 語文（yǔwén）：指語言與文字，常指學校的語文科目（例如中文、語文課）。
english_meaning: language and literature; language (as a school subject)
explanation_mandarin: 「語文」一般指語言與文字的總稱，亦常用來指學校中的語文科（例如中文科），涵蓋閱讀、寫作、語法等內容。
explanation_english: “語文” refers to language and written characters, often used to denote the school subject covering reading, writing, grammar, and literature (e.g., Chinese language class).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日有語文考試，要溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 jyu5 man4 haau2 si3, jiu3 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天有語文考試，要溫習。
examples.english_sentence: I have a language exam today; I need to study.

mandarin_meaning: 語料（語言資料、語料庫中的資料）
english_meaning: language data; corpus (textual or speech materials used for analysis or training)
explanation_mandarin: 指在語言學、自然語言處理或相關研究中，用於分析、訓練或參考的語言資料，通常來自文本或語音資料庫。
explanation_english: Refers to language data used in linguistics, NLP, or related research — textual or speech materials used for analysis, training, or reference (i.e., corpus data).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家要整理語料，俾機器學習用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 zing2 lei5 jyu5 liu6, bei2 gei1 hei3 hok6 zaap6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們現在要整理語料，給機器學習用。
examples.english_sentence: We need to compile the corpus now for machine learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份研究用咗大量真實語料做分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 jin4 gau3 jung6 zo2 daai6 loeng6 zan1 sat6 jyu5 liu6 zou6 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份研究用了大量真實語料來做分析。
examples.english_sentence: This study used a large amount of real-world language data for analysis.

mandarin_meaning: 语料库
english_meaning: corpus (a database of texts or speech used for linguistic research or NLP)
explanation_mandarin: 用於保存文本、語音或其他語言資料，供語言研究、語言學分析或自然語言處理等用途的資料庫。
explanation_english: A database of texts, transcripts, or recorded speech used for linguistic research, language analysis, or natural language processing (NLP) tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要擴充語料庫，先至可以改善語音辨識系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kwaang3 cung1 jyu5 liu6 fu3, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 goi2 sin6 jyu5 jam1 bin6 sik1 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要扩充语料库，才能改善语音识别系统。
examples.english_sentence: We need to expand the corpus in order to improve the speech recognition system.

mandarin_meaning: 語族（語言學）
english_meaning: language family
explanation_mandarin: 指一組具有共同祖先語或相似語言特徵的語言，例如印歐語系、漢藏語系下的各個語族。
explanation_english: A group of languages that share a common ancestral language or similar linguistic features; e.g., branches within language families like Indo-European or Sino-Tibetan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語族係指一班有共同語源或者相似語言特徵嘅語言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 zuk6 hai6 zi2 jat1 baan1 jau5 gung6 tung4 jyu5 jyun4 waak6 ze2 soeng1 ci5 jyu5 jin4 dak6 zing1 ge3 jyu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 語族是指一組有共同語源或者相似語言特徵的語言。
examples.english_sentence: A language family refers to a group of languages that share a common origin or similar linguistic features.

mandarin_meaning: 語氣（說話的語調或態度）
english_meaning: tone (of voice); manner of speaking; intonation
explanation_mandarin: 指說話時表現出的語調、態度或情感，例如客氣、嚴厲或不耐煩等，能反映說話者的情緒和立場。
explanation_english: Refers to the speaker's tone, intonation, or manner of speaking—such as polite, stern, or impatient—which conveys the speaker's emotion or stance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢嘅語氣聽落好唔尊重人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 ge3 jyu5 hei3 teng1 lok6 hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說話的語氣聽起來很不尊重人。
examples.english_sentence: The tone of your speech sounds very disrespectful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢回覆電郵嘅語氣好客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wui4 fuk1 din6 jau4 ge3 jyu5 hei3 hou2 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他回覆郵件的語氣很客氣。
examples.english_sentence: His tone in replying to the email is very polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師教學生要注意語氣同態度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 gaau3 hok6 saang1 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 jyu5 hei3 tung4 taai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師教學生要注意語氣和態度。
examples.english_sentence: Teachers should pay attention to their tone and attitude when teaching students.

mandarin_meaning: 语法 (yǔfǎ)
english_meaning: grammar; syntax
explanation_mandarin: 指构成语句和词语的规则和结构，也可以指程序语言中的语法（syntax）。
explanation_english: Refers to the rules and structures that govern how words and sentences are formed; can also mean syntax in programming languages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅語法有啲錯，要改一改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 jyu5 faat3 jau5 di1 co3, jiu3 goi2 jat1 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的语法有一些错误，需要改一下。
examples.english_sentence: Your grammar has some mistakes; you should correct them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學好語法可以寫出更正確嘅句子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 hou2 jyu5 faat3 ho2 ji5 se2 ceot1 gang3 zing3 kok3 ge3 geoi3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学好语法可以写出更正确的句子。
examples.english_sentence: Learning grammar well helps you write more accurate sentences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種編程語法唔同於其他語言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 bin1 cing4 jyu5 faat3 m4 tung4 jyu1 kei4 taa1 jyu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种编程语法不同于其他语言。
examples.english_sentence: This programming syntax differs from other languages.

mandarin_meaning: 词源；词汇的来源（即词语的起源或演变）
english_meaning: etymology; the origin and historical development of a word or phrase
explanation_mandarin: 指詞語或字的來源與演變過程，也可指研究這類現象的學問（詞源學）。
explanation_english: Refers to the origin and historical development of words or morphemes; also denotes the field of study (etymology) that investigates these origins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書講咗好多詞語嘅語源，幫我了解佢哋點樣演變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci4 jyu5 ge3 jyu5 jyun4, bong1 ngo5 liu5 gaai2 keoi5 dei6 dim2 joeng6 jin2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书讲了很多词语的语源，帮助我了解它们是如何演变的。
examples.english_sentence: This book discusses the etymology of many words, helping me understand how they evolved.

mandarin_meaning: 說得含糊、不具體，沒有交代清楚細節（成語）
english_meaning: vague; unclear; lacking specific details
explanation_mandarin: 指語言或文字表達得含糊、不詳盡，沒有把事情講清楚或交代清楚細節。
explanation_english: Describes speech or writing that is vague or not detailed, failing to make the facts or specifics clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰份報告寫得語焉不詳，老闆問咗好多次都唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 jyu5 jin1 bat1 coeng4, lou5 baan2 man6 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那份報告寫得語焉不詳，老闆問了很多次還是不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The report is written vaguely; even after the boss asked many times, it's still unclear.

mandarin_meaning: 语无伦次 (yǔ wú lún cì) — 说话混乱、不连贯
english_meaning: to speak incoherently; to be unable to express oneself clearly; to ramble
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话混乱、前后不连贯、缺乏条理，常因紧张、情绪激动或醉酒等原因导致。
explanation_english: Describes speech that is confused, disorganized, or rambling—often caused by strong emotions, nervousness, intoxication, or shock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚到語無倫次，講唔出完整句子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 dou3 jyu5 mou4 leon4 ci3, gong2 m4 ceot1 jyun4 zing2 geoi3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他惊得语无伦次，说不出完整的句子。
examples.english_sentence: He was so frightened that he spoke incoherently and couldn't form complete sentences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當你太緊張時，可能會語無倫次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 nei5 taai3 gan2 zoeng1 si4, ho2 nang4 wui5 jyu5 mou4 leon4 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当你太紧张时，可能会语无伦次。
examples.english_sentence: When you're too nervous, you might speak incoherently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢醉到語無倫次，大家都扶佢返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 dou3 jyu5 mou4 leon4 ci3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 fu4 keoi5 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他醉到语无伦次，大家都扶他回家。
examples.english_sentence: He was so drunk that he was speaking incoherently, so everyone helped him home.

mandarin_meaning: 語用；（語言）在語境中的使用（即語用學）
english_meaning: pragmatics; the use of language in context
explanation_mandarin: 「語用」一般指語言在具體語境或社會互動中如何被使用與理解，常作為語用學（pragmatics）的簡稱，關注語境、會話含義與言外之意。
explanation_english: “語用” (pragmatics) refers to how language is used and interpreted in specific contexts and social interactions. It focuses on context-dependent meaning, conversational implicature, and how speakers convey and infer intentions beyond literal words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要分析呢句嘅真正意思，就要睇佢喺語境入面嘅語用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 fan1 sik1 ni1 geoi3 ge3 zan1 zing3 ji3 si1, zau6 jiu3 tai2 keoi5 hai2 jyu5 ging2 jap6 min6 ge3 jyu5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要分析這句話的真正含義，就要看它在語境中的語用。
examples.english_sentence: To analyze the true meaning of this sentence, you need to look at its pragmatic use in context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語用學係研究語言喺特定情境或交際中點樣使用嘅學科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 jung6 hok6 hai6 jin4 gau3 jyu5 jin4 hai2 dak6 ding6 cing4 ging2 waak6 gaau1 zai3 zung1 dim2 joeng6 si6 jung6 ge3 hok6 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 語用學是研究語言在特定情境或交際中如何使用的學科。
examples.english_sentence: Pragmatics is the field that studies how language is used in particular situations or interactions.

mandarin_meaning: 语病 (yǔbìng)：語言或文字表述中的錯誤或不當之處
english_meaning: error in wording; awkward phrasing; a mistake in expression or grammar
explanation_mandarin: 指說話或寫作中出現的表達問題，例如語法錯誤、病句或措辭不當，會影響意思的清晰與準確。
explanation_english: Refers to problems in spoken or written expression, such as grammatical mistakes, awkward phrasing, or inappropriate wording, which affect clarity and accuracy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你篇文章入面有幾處語病，要改一改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 pin1 man4 zoeng1 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 cyu3 jyu5 beng6, jiu3 goi2 jat1 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你文章里面有几处语病，要改一改。
examples.english_sentence: There are several wording problems in your article; you should revise it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句有語病，聽落意思有啲含糊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 jau5 jyu5 beng6, teng1 lok6 ji3 si1 jau5 di1 ham4 wu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句有语病，听起来意思有点含糊。
examples.english_sentence: This sentence has awkward phrasing; the meaning sounds a bit unclear.

mandarin_meaning: （网络俚语）形容某人的说话方式让人难以忍受、尴尬或充满口头禅与语病，带有贬义。
english_meaning: Internet slang describing someone's way of speaking as painfully bad, cringeworthy, or riddled with verbal tics/grammatical errors; pejorative.
explanation_mandarin: 「語癌」为粤语网络用语，字面为「语言的癌症」，比喻说话方式非常刺耳、别扭或常犯语病／使用过多口头禅，通常用于嘲讽或批评。
explanation_english: “語癌” is Cantonese internet slang literally meaning “speech cancer.” It metaphorically criticizes speech that is extremely unpleasant, awkward, full of verbal tics or grammar mishaps. It is typically used mockingly or pejoratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲講法真係語癌，聽到我頭都痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gong2 faat3 zan1 hai6 jyu5 ngaam4, teng1 dou3 ngo5 tau4 dou1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她的说法真是語癌，听了我头都疼。
examples.english_sentence: His/her way of speaking is really '語癌' — listening to it gives me a headache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲網上留言成日有語癌，通常係啲口頭禪同錯誤用語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 mong5 seong6 lau4 jim4 seng4 jat6 jau5 jyu5 ngaam4, tung1 soeng4 hai6 di1 hau2 tau4 sin4 tung4 co3 ng6 jung6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上留言经常出现語癌，通常是口头禅和错误的用语。
examples.english_sentence: Online comments often contain '語癌', usually catchphrases and incorrect expressions.

mandarin_meaning: 語系（語族）
english_meaning: language family; language system
explanation_mandarin: 指具有共同語源或相似語言特徵的一組語言，也可泛指語言的分類系統。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of languages that share a common origin or similar linguistic features; can also refer to a system/classification of languages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語系係指一組有共同來源同語言特徵嘅語言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 hai6 hai6 zi2 jat1 zou2 jau5 gung6 tung4 loi4 jyun4 tung4 jyu5 jin4 dak6 zing1 ge3 jyu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 語系是指一組具有共同來源和語言特徵的語言。
examples.english_sentence: A language family refers to a group of languages that have a common origin and similar linguistic features.

mandarin_meaning: 語素（语素）
english_meaning: morpheme
explanation_mandarin: 語素是語言中最小的意義單位，不能再切分而保有獨立語義。語素可分為自立語素（能單獨成詞）和黏著語素（需附著於其他語素）。
explanation_english: A morpheme is the smallest meaningful unit in a language that cannot be further divided while preserving meaning. Morphemes can be free (standalone) or bound (attach to other morphemes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語素係語言入面最細嘅意義單位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 sou3 hai6 jyu5 jin4 jap6 min6 zeoi3 sai3 ge3 ji3 ji6 daan1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 語素是語言中最小的意義單位。
examples.english_sentence: A morpheme is the smallest meaningful unit in a language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 分析一個詞嘅語素可以幫助理解詞義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 sik1 jat1 go3 ci4 ge3 jyu5 sou3 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 lei5 gaai2 ci4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 分析一個詞的語素可以幫助理解詞義。
examples.english_sentence: Analyzing the morphemes of a word can help understand its meaning.

mandarin_meaning: 语义（词语或句子的含义）
english_meaning: semantics; the meaning of a word, phrase, or sentence
explanation_mandarin: 語義指詞語或句子所表達的意義或概念，是語言學中研究含義與解釋的範疇。
explanation_english: The meaning or semantic content of a word, phrase, or sentence; a field in linguistics that studies meanings and their interpretation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺語言學入面，語義係好重要嘅研究範疇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jyu5 jin4 hok6 jap6 min6, jyu5 ji6 hai6 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jin4 gau3 faan6 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在语言学中，语义是很重要的研究范畴。
examples.english_sentence: In linguistics, semantics is a very important area of study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個詞有多重語義，要靠上下文先可以理解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ci4 jau5 do1 cung4 jyu5 ji6, jiu3 kaau3 soeng6 haa6 man4 sin1 ho2 ji5 lei5 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个词有多重语义，要靠上下文才能理解。
examples.english_sentence: This word has multiple meanings; you need to rely on context to understand it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 翻譯嗰陣要注意原文嘅語義，唔好只睇字面意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan1 jik6 go2 zan6 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 jyun4 man4 ge3 jyu5 ji6, m4 hou2 zi2 tai2 zi6 min6 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 翻译的时候要注意原文的语义，不要只看字面意思。
examples.english_sentence: When translating, pay attention to the original text's semantics; don't rely only on the literal meaning.

mandarin_meaning: 語言
english_meaning: language; speech
explanation_mandarin: 指人類用來溝通的語音、文字或符號系統。
explanation_english: Refers to a system of spoken, written, or signed symbols used by people to communicate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多種語言同文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 zung2 jyu5 jin4 tung4 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多種語言和文化。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many languages and cultures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語言係文化嘅一部分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 jin4 hai6 man4 faa3 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 語言是文化的一部分。
examples.english_sentence: Language is a part of culture.

mandarin_meaning: 语言不通（无法用相同语言交流）
english_meaning: Unable to communicate due to different languages; language barrier
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词性短语/动词短语（表状态）
explanation_mandarin: 表示双方或多方因使用不同語言而無法順暢溝通，通常用來說明交流上的障礙。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people cannot communicate smoothly because they do not share a common language; indicates a language barrier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢語言不通，所以要搵翻譯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 jyu5 jin4 bat1 tung1, so2 ji5 jiu3 wan2 faan1 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他语言不通，所以要找翻译。
examples.english_sentence: He and I don't speak the same language, so we need to find a translator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去旅行嗰時，如果語言不通就會好麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 go2 si4, jyu4 gwo2 jyu5 jin4 bat1 tung1 zau6 wui5 hou2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去旅行时，如果语言不通就会很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: When traveling, language barriers can cause a lot of trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 語言偽術（指利用語言技巧或修辭手段進行欺騙或誤導）
english_meaning: linguistic deception; rhetorical trickery — using language and rhetoric to mislead or manipulate
explanation_mandarin: 指透過刻意使用模糊、誇大、歪曲或轉移焦點的措辭與修辭技巧，來誤導、操控或欺騙聽眾或讀者的言語手法，帶有貶義，常見於政治宣傳、辯論或廣告中。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberate use of ambiguous, exaggerated, distorted, or attention-shifting wording and rhetorical techniques to mislead, manipulate, or deceive listeners or readers. It is pejorative and often appears in politics, debates, or advertising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲政客成日玩語言偽術，想轉移市民嘅注意力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zing3 haak3 sing4 jat6 waan2 jyu5 jin4 ngai6 seot6, soeng2 zyun2 ji4 si5 man4 ge3 zyu3 ji3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些政客經常玩語言偽術，想轉移市民的注意力。
examples.english_sentence: Those politicians often use linguistic deception to divert the public's attention.

mandarin_meaning: 語言伪术（指用语言上的技巧或诡计来欺骗、误导或操控他人）
english_meaning: linguistic deceit; rhetorical trickery — using language-based techniques or fallacies to deceive, mislead, or manipulate others
explanation_mandarin: 指利用語言的修辭、措辭或語序等技巧，達到誤導、操控或欺騙他人的目的，常帶負面含義。
explanation_english: Refers to using rhetorical techniques, wording choices, or verbal tactics to mislead, manipulate, or deceive others; typically has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日用啲語言僞術嚟操控人哋嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jung6 di1 jyu5 jin4 wai6 seot6 lai4 cou1 hung3 jan4 dei6 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常用語言伪术來操控別人的想法。
examples.english_sentence: He often uses linguistic trickery to manipulate other people's thinking.

mandarin_meaning: 語言學 (yǔyánxué)
english_meaning: linguistics; the scientific study of language
explanation_mandarin: 研究語言的本質、結構、功能與演變的一門學科。
explanation_english: The scientific study of language, including its structure, use, and historical development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大學讀語言學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 jyu5 jin4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大學念語言學。
examples.english_sentence: I study linguistics at university.

mandarin_meaning: 語調（說話的聲音高低、強弱和節奏）
english_meaning: intonation; the pitch, stress, and rhythm of spoken language
explanation_mandarin: 說話時語音的升降、強弱與節奏特徵，用以表達語氣、情感或強調。
explanation_english: The pitch, stress, and rhythm patterns in speech used to convey attitude, emotion, emphasis, or meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢個語調聽落唔同咗，係咪唔開心呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 go3 jyu5 diu6 teng1 lok6 m4 tung4 zo2, hai6 mai6 m4 hoi1 sam1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說話的語調聽起來不一樣了，是不是不開心？
examples.english_sentence: The way you speak sounds different — are you upset?

mandarin_meaning: 語重心長（說話誠懇、語氣沉重，通常用於勸告或叮囑）
english_meaning: Speak earnestly and sincerely; to give heartfelt, weighty advice or admonition
explanation_mandarin: 表示說話言詞誠懇、有分量且出於關切，語氣較沉重，常用來形容對別人的忠告或囑咐。
explanation_english: Describes speech that is earnest and heartfelt, often weighty and given out of concern; commonly used to characterize sincere admonition or advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸對我語重心長，勸我要珍惜呢個機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa4 deoi3 ngo5 jyu5 zung6 sam1 coeng4, hyun3 jiu3 ngo5 zi1 sik1 ni1 go3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸對我語重心長，勸我要珍惜這個機會。
examples.english_sentence: My father spoke to me earnestly, urging me to cherish this opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師對學生語重心長，提醒佢哋要準時交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 deoi3 hok6 saang1 jyu5 zung6 sam1 coeng4, tai4 sing2 keoi5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師對學生語重心長，提醒他們要準時交作業。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher spoke earnestly to the students, reminding them to hand in their assignments on time.

mandarin_meaning: 語錄；摘錄的言論或名言
english_meaning: quotations; a collection/excerpt of spoken lines or notable sayings
explanation_mandarin: 指某人說過的話或名言的摘錄、彙編，也可以指記錄下來的句子或語言素材，常用於引用、分享或整理重要言論。
explanation_english: Refers to a collection or excerpt of spoken lines, quotations, or notable sayings; often used for quoting, sharing, or compiling memorable remarks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺社交網站度收集名人語錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mong5 zaam6 dou6 sau1 zaap6 ming4 jan4 jyu5 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在社交網站上收集名人的語錄。
examples.english_sentence: He often collects famous people's quotes on social media.

mandarin_meaning: 语音（指語言的聲音、發音；亦可指音頻/將文字轉為聲音）
english_meaning: speech sound; phonetics; pronunciation; (also) audio / text-to-speech
explanation_mandarin: 指語言的聲音或發音特徵；在科技語境亦常指音頻資料或將文字轉換成聲音的技術（語音合成/語音檔）。
explanation_english: Refers to the sounds of spoken language or pronunciation features; in tech contexts it often means audio data or the technology that converts text to speech (TTS).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個應用可以將文字轉做語音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jing3 jung6 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 man4 zi6 zyun2 zou6 jyu5 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个应用可以把文字转换为语音。
examples.english_sentence: This app can convert text into speech (audio).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅普通話語音好標準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 pou2 tung1 waa2 jyu5 jam1 hou2 biu1 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的普通话语音很标准。
examples.english_sentence: His Mandarin pronunciation is very standard.

mandarin_meaning: 語音學（研究語言聲音的學科）
english_meaning: phonetics (the study of speech sounds)
explanation_mandarin: 研究語言聲音特徵、發音機制與聲學特性的語言學分支，涵蓋元音、子音、聲調、語音分析等。
explanation_english: The branch of linguistics that studies the physical properties, production, and perception of speech sounds, including vowels, consonants, tones, and phonetic analysis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大學修讀語音學，學緊元音、子音同聲調嘅分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 daai6 hok6 sau1 duk6 jyu5 jam1 hok6, hok6 gan2 jyun4 jam1, zi2 jam1 tung4 seng1 diu6 ge3 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大學修讀語音學，正在學習元音、子音和聲調的分析。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying phonetics at university, currently learning analysis of vowels, consonants and tones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語音學對學習外語嘅發音好有幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 jam1 hok6 deoi3 hok6 zaap6 ngoi6 jyu5 ge3 faat3 jam1 hou2 jau5 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 語音學對學習外語的發音很有幫助。
examples.english_sentence: Phonetics is very helpful for learning pronunciation in foreign languages.

mandarin_meaning: 語音輸入 (yǔyīn shūrù)
english_meaning: voice input; speech-to-text input
explanation_mandarin: 利用語音辨識技術將說話轉換成文字，作為輸入的一種方式，常見於手機或電腦的輸入法中。
explanation_english: An input method that uses speech recognition technology to convert spoken words into text, commonly available on phones and computers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家手機有語音輸入，好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sau2 gei1 jau5 jyu5 jam1 syu1 jap6, hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在手機有語音輸入，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: Phones now have voice input; it's very convenient.

mandarin_meaning: 語體（指語言的表達風格或體裁，如書面語、口語、正式或非正式等）
english_meaning: language register/style (the style or mode of expression, e.g. written vs. spoken, formal vs. informal)
explanation_mandarin: 語體指語言在不同語境下的表現方式或風格，例如書面語體、口語體、正式語體或非正式語體，常用於語言學和寫作評析中。
explanation_english: Refers to the style or register of language used in a given context (e.g. written vs. spoken, formal vs. informal). Commonly used in linguistics and writing analysis to describe modes of expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章嘅語體比較正式，唔太適合喺社交媒體發佈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ge3 jyu5 tai2 bei2 gaau3 zing3 sik1, m4 taai3 sik1 hap6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 faat3 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章的语体比较正式，不太适合在社交媒体发布。
examples.english_sentence: The register of this article is relatively formal, so it's not very suitable to post on social media.

mandarin_meaning: 誠（诚）——真誠、誠實、誠懇
english_meaning: sincerity; honesty; earnestness
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 詞素（常用於合成詞）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / morpheme (commonly used in compounds); can function adverbially in fixed expressions
explanation_mandarin: 表示真誠、誠實或誠懇，常見於誠實、誠意、誠心等合成詞或成語中，表達真摯或認真的態度。
explanation_english: Indicates sincerity, honesty, or earnestness. Frequently appears in compounds (e.g. 誠實, 誠意) and idiomatic expressions to express a genuine or earnest attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好誠實，唔會講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sing4-sat6, m4 wui5 gong2 daai6-waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很誠實，不會說謊。
examples.english_sentence: He is very honest; he wouldn't tell lies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇誠意？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 sing4-ji3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有誠意？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any sincerity? / Are you sincere?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我誠心誠意向你道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4-sam1 sing4-ji3 hoeng3 nei5 dou6-hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我誠心誠意向你道歉。
examples.english_sentence: I sincerely apologize to you.

mandarin_meaning: 诚信 (chéngxìn)
english_meaning: honesty; integrity; trustworthiness
explanation_mandarin: 表示為人誠實、守信用，既可作為名詞（誠信）也可作為形容詞（有誠信）。常用於描述個人或機構的品行或商業信用。
explanation_english: Refers to being honest and keeping one's promises; can be used as a noun (integrity/honesty) or an adjective (trustworthy). Often used to describe a person's or organization's character or business credibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人好有誠信，大家都好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 jau5 sing4 seon3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人很有誠信，大家都很信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He is very trustworthy; everyone trusts him.

mandarin_meaning: 诚信破产；完全失去信誉或诚信
english_meaning: to be bankrupt in integrity; to have completely lost credibility or trustworthiness
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或組織因說謊、違約、不守承諾等行為，導致信譽或誠信完全喪失。語氣偏口語，常用來批評或指責。
explanation_english: Indicates that a person or organization has lost all credibility or integrity due to lying, breaking promises, or other untrustworthy behavior. Colloquial and often used critically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講大話，誠信已經破產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, sing4 seon3 ji5 ging1 po3 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是說謊，誠信已經破產了。
examples.english_sentence: He lies all the time; his credibility is already gone.

mandarin_meaning: 誠實 (chéngshí)，指為人真誠、不說謊、不虛偽。
english_meaning: honest; honesty; sincere — being truthful, not deceitful or deceptive.
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人說話和行為真實、不欺騙、不虛偽，值得信賴。
explanation_english: Describes a person or behavior that is truthful, sincere, and not deceitful; trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好誠實，從來唔講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sing4 sat6, cung4 loi4 m4 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很誠實，從來不說謊。
examples.english_sentence: He is very honest; he never tells lies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得誠實比一時的利益更重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 sing4 sat6 bei2 jat1 si4 dik1 lei6 jik1 gang3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我覺得誠實比一時的利益更重要。
examples.english_sentence: I think honesty is more important than short-term gains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然講真話有時會傷人，但我仍然想保持誠實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gong2 zan1 waa2 jau5 si4 wui5 soeng1 jan4, daan6 ngo5 jing4 jin4 soeng2 bou2 ci4 sing4 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然說真話有時會傷人，但我仍然想保持誠實。
examples.english_sentence: Although telling the truth can sometimes hurt people, I still want to remain honest.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：誠實的豆沙包；引申：指性格老實、直率、會把話或秘密說出來的人（帶有調侃或半開玩笑的語氣）
english_meaning: Literally 'honest red-bean bun'; slang for a person who is naively honest or blunt — someone who tends to blurt things out or tells the truth without filtering (often used jokingly).
explanation_mandarin: 網絡/口語俚語，用來形容一個人老實、直率或太過坦白，會不經意地說出真相或別人的秘密，語氣通常帶有調侃成分。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression used to describe someone who is honest, blunt, or naive — prone to saying whatever is on their mind or revealing secrets unintentionally. Often used teasingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個誠實豆沙包，見到咩就會講出嚟，唔會扮嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 sing4 sat6 dau6 saa1 baau1, gin3 dou3 me1 zau6 wui5 gong2 ceot1 lai4, m4 wui5 baan6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個誠實豆沙包，看到什麼就會說出來，不會做作。
examples.english_sentence: He's an 'honest red-bean bun' — he says whatever he sees; he doesn't pretend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做誠實豆沙包，啲秘密唔好亂講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 sing4 sat6 dau6 saa1 baau1, di1 bei3 mat6 m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當誠實豆沙包，秘密不要亂說。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be an 'honest red-bean bun' — don't blurt out secrets.

mandarin_meaning: 誠意徵求／誠摯招聘
english_meaning: sincerely seeking; genuinely recruiting (used in ads or listings to indicate earnest intent)
explanation_mandarin: 常見於招聘或求物、求租類廣告，表示誠懇地徵求或招聘某人或某物，讓其他人知道此為真誠需求。
explanation_english: Commonly used in classifieds (jobs, roommates, items wanted) to indicate a sincere or genuine request/recruitment; signals that the poster is earnest about finding someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司誠徵一位有經驗嘅前台，歡迎投遞履歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 sing4 zing1 jat1 wai2 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 cin4 toi4, fun1 jing4 tau4 dai6 leoi5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司誠徵一名有經驗的前台，歡迎投遞履歷。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is sincerely recruiting an experienced receptionist; resumes are welcome.

mandarin_meaning: 诚心；真诚的心意
english_meaning: sincerity; heartfelt; sincerely
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 副词（视用法而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示真诚、诚恳的心意或态度，可作名词表示“诚意”，亦可用作副词/短语表示“真诚地”。
explanation_english: Expresses sincerity or a heartfelt attitude. Can function as a noun meaning 'sincerity' or as an adverbial phrase meaning 'sincerely'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我誠心希望你快啲好返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 sam1 hei1 mong6 nei5 faai3 di1 hou2 faan1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真诚地希望你快点好起来。
examples.english_sentence: I sincerely hope you get well soon.

mandarin_meaning: （成語）形容非常惶恐不安，帶有畢恭畢敬或謙恭的態度；常用於書信或正式場合表示懇請、敬畏或歉疚。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning to be extremely apprehensive and uneasy; to feel deeply fearful or full of trepidation, often used humbly or respectfully in formal contexts to express deference or contrition.
explanation_mandarin: 誠惶誠恐為四字成語，原多用於正式或書面語中，表示心懷畏懼、戰戰兢兢，或謙恭地請示、道歉。
explanation_english: A four-character idiom (classical) typically used in formal or written contexts to express fear, trepidation, or humble deference — often used when apologizing or respectfully addressing a superior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為負責人，我對今次事件誠惶誠恐，深感歉意並願承擔一切責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai6 fu6 zaak3 jan4, ngo5 deoi3 gam1 ci3 si6 gin3 seng4 wong4 seng4 hung2, sam1 gam2 hip3 ji3 bing6 jyun6 sing4 daam1 jat1 cai3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为负责人，我对这次事件诚惶诚恐，深感歉意并愿承担一切责任。
examples.english_sentence: As the person in charge, I am deeply apprehensive about this incident, sincerely apologize, and am willing to take full responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 诚意
english_meaning: sincerity; genuine intent; earnestness
explanation_mandarin: 表示真心、誠摯的意願或態度，常用來形容一個人或行為具有誠懇和善意。
explanation_english: Indicates a sincere, earnest intention or attitude; used to describe genuine, heartfelt intentions or gestures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係有誠意想幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 jau5 sing4 ji3 soeng2 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的有诚意想帮你。
examples.english_sentence: I really do mean to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送咗份禮物表示誠意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 zo2 fan6 lai5 mat6 biu2 si6 sing4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送了一份礼物表示诚意。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a gift to show his sincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你有誠意，就直接講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jau5 sing4 ji3, zau6 zik6 zit3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有诚意，就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you're sincere, just say it directly.

mandarin_meaning: 誠懇 (chéngkěn) — 表示誠摯、真誠
english_meaning: sincere; earnest; genuine and frank
explanation_mandarin: 表示態度真誠、誠懇，不虛偽或矯飾，常用來形容說話或行為的真摯。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude that is sincere and earnest, without pretense; often used to describe someone's words or behavior as genuine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好誠懇，令人好信服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 sing4 han2, ling6 jan4 hou2 seon3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話很誠懇，讓人很信服。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very sincerely, which makes people convinced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣，你要用誠懇嘅態度去回答問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 go2 zan6, nei5 jiu3 jung6 sing4 han2 ge3 taai3 dou6 heoi3 wui6 daap3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試的時候，你要用誠懇的態度去回答問題。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview, you should answer questions with a sincere attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望佢誠懇道歉，咁件事先可以過去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 keoi5 sing4 han2 dou6 hip3, gam2 gin6 si6 sin1 ho2 ji5 gwo3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望他誠懇道歉，這件事才能過去。
examples.english_sentence: I hope he apologizes sincerely so the matter can be put behind us.

mandarin_meaning: 诚然（确实如此；的确）
english_meaning: indeed; admittedly; it is true that
explanation_mandarin: 表示承認前述事實或情況，常用於書面或正式語境，通常用來引出轉折或提出不同意見。
explanation_english: Used to concede a point—acknowledges a preceding fact or situation. Common in written or formal contexts and often introduces a contrast or reservation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 誠然，佢嘅經驗豐富，但係未必適合呢個職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 jin4, keoi5 ge3 ging1 jim6 fung1 fu3, daan6 hai6 mei6 bat1 sik1 hap6 ni1 go3 zik1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 诚然，他的经验丰富，但未必适合这个职位。
examples.english_sentence: Indeed, he has rich experience, but may not necessarily be suitable for this position.

mandarin_meaning: 誠摯聘請（常用於招聘廣告，表示誠意招聘）
english_meaning: to sincerely hire; used in job advertisements to indicate that an organization is recruiting
explanation_mandarin: 「誠聘」常見於招聘啟事或廣告，表示公司或機構誠意聘請人才，語氣正式且禮貌。
explanation_english: Commonly used in job postings and advertisements, "誠聘" indicates that a company or organization is sincerely hiring; the term is formal and polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本公司誠聘市場經理，有相關經驗者優先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 gung1 si1 sing4 ping3 si5 coeng4 ging1 lei5, jau5 soeng1 gwan1 ging1 jim6 ze2 jau1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本公司誠聘市場經理，有相關經驗者優先。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is sincerely hiring a marketing manager; candidates with relevant experience will be given priority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校誠聘數學老師，歡迎合資格申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 sing4 ping3 sou3 hok6 lou5 si1, fun1 jing4 hap6 zi1 gaak3 san1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校誠聘數學老師，歡迎合資格者申請。
examples.english_sentence: The school is hiring a math teacher; qualified applicants are welcome to apply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 招聘啟事上寫住：誠聘全職前台職員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 pin3 kai2 si6 soeng6 se2 zyu6: sing4 ping3 cyun4 zik1 cin4 toi4 zik1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 招聘啟事上寫著：誠聘全職前台職員。
examples.english_sentence: The job notice reads: sincerely hiring a full-time receptionist.

mandarin_meaning: 诚邀（诚恳地邀请）
english_meaning: to sincerely invite; to cordially invite
explanation_mandarin: 表示以诚恳、正式的态度邀请对方参加活动或出席场合，通常用于书面或正式场合。
explanation_english: Expresses a sincere and formal invitation for someone to attend an event or occasion; commonly used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋誠邀您出席晚宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 jiu1 nei5 ceot1 zik6 maan5 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们诚邀您出席晚宴。
examples.english_sentence: We sincerely invite you to attend the banquet.

mandarin_meaning: 告诫；警告；戒律
english_meaning: to admonish; to warn; admonition; precept
explanation_mandarin: 表示警告或教誨，提醒對方注意或改正錯誤，有時也指戒律或規範。
explanation_english: Means to warn or admonish someone, reminding them to take care or correct mistakes; can also refer to a precept or injunction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我告誡你，唔好再犯同樣嘅錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gou3 gai3 nei5, m4 hou2 zoi3 faan6 tung4 joeng6 ge3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我告诫你，不要再犯同样的错误。
examples.english_sentence: I warn you not to make the same mistake again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母成日告誡佢哋唔好夜瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 sing4 jat6 gou3 gai3 keoi5 dei6 m4 hou2 je6 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母经常告诫他们不要晚睡。
examples.english_sentence: Parents often warn them not to stay up late.

mandarin_meaning: 戒律；戒條（宗教或倫理上的規範）
english_meaning: precepts; rules or commandments (especially religious or ethical rules)
explanation_mandarin: 指宗教或倫理上的規範、戒條，常見於佛教、道教等宗教語境，用以約束行為或修持。
explanation_english: Refers to rules or precepts, especially in a religious or ethical context (e.g., Buddhist precepts); guidelines that prescribe or forbid certain behaviors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 修行者應該遵守誡律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 hang4 ze2 jing1 goi1 zeon1 sau2 gaai3 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 修行者應該遵守戒律。
examples.english_sentence: Practitioners should observe the precepts.

mandarin_meaning: 诬（捏造事实诽谤、陷害他人）
english_meaning: to falsely accuse; to frame; to slander
explanation_mandarin: 指捏造事实、诬蔑或陷害他人，使其受到指责或法律追究，通常用作动词。
explanation_english: Refers to fabricating facts to slander, falsely accuse, or frame someone, causing them to face blame or legal consequences. Usually used as a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人誣告偷嘢，佢根本冇做過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 mou1 gou3 tau1 je5, keoi5 gan1 bun2 mou5 zou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人诬告偷窃，他根本没做过。
examples.english_sentence: He was falsely accused of theft; he didn't do it at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂誣人，冇證據就唔好講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 mou1 jan4, mou5 zing3 geoi3 zau6 m4 hou2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便诬陷别人，没有证据就不要说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't falsely accuse others; don't speak without evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 诬告
english_meaning: to falsely accuse; to frame (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 指捏造事實，對他人提出不實指控或控告，讓對方遭受譴責或法律追訴。
explanation_english: To fabricate facts and make false accusations against someone, causing them to be blamed or potentially pursued legally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢誣告我偷嘢，完全冇根據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wu1 gou3 ngo5 tau1 je5, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 gan1 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他诬告我偷东西，完全没有依据。
examples.english_sentence: He falsely accused me of stealing; there's no evidence at all.

mandarin_meaning: 誣告（wūgào）：虛假指控他人犯罪或不當行為，故意捏造事實使人受害。
english_meaning: to falsely accuse; to make a false accusation or frame someone
explanation_mandarin: 指故意編造、捏造事實，向警方或公眾指控他人犯罪或不當行為，導致他人名譽或權益受損。
explanation_english: Deliberately fabricating facts or evidence to accuse someone of a crime or wrongdoing, causing harm to that person's reputation or rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人誣告偷嘢，其實根本冇做過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 wu1 gou3 tau1 je5, kei4 sat6 gan1 bun2 mou5 zou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人誣告偷東西，事實上根本沒有做過。
examples.english_sentence: He was falsely accused of stealing; in fact, he didn't do it.

mandarin_meaning: 诬捏（捏造事实、诬陷）
english_meaning: to fabricate/slander; to frame someone by making up lies or false evidence
explanation_mandarin: 指捏造事实、污蔑或诬陷他人，通常含有故意造假或栽赃的意思。
explanation_english: To invent false facts or evidence in order to slander or frame someone; implies deliberate fabrication or malicious accusation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人誣捏話佢做賊，實際上冇任何證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 wu1 nip6 waa6 keoi5 zou6 caak3, sat6 zai3 soeng6 mou5 jat1 ho4 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人诬捏说他是贼，实际上没有任何证据。
examples.english_sentence: He was framed/slandered as a thief, but in reality there is no evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 诬蔑（捏造或歪曲事实，损害他人名誉）
english_meaning: to slander; to smear; to defame (falsely accuse or distort facts to damage someone's reputation)
explanation_mandarin: 指捏造或歪曲事实，公开或私下诋毁、贬低他人的名誉，属于损害名誉的行为。
explanation_english: To fabricate or distort facts to harm someone's reputation; to falsely accuse, slander, or defame someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被人誣蔑偷嘢，最後要上庭澄清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jan4 wu1 mit6 tau1 je5, zeoi6 hau6 jiu3 soeng5 ting4 cing4 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人诬蔑偷东西，最后不得不上法庭澄清。
examples.english_sentence: He was slandered as a thief and ultimately had to go to court to clear his name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳媒誣蔑嗰位政治人物，結果不得不道歉並賠償。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 mui4 wu1 mit6 go2 wai6 zing3 zi6 jan4 mat6, git3 gwo2 bat1 dak1 bou3 dou6 hip3 bing6 pui4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒体诬蔑那位政治人物，结果不得不道歉并赔偿。
examples.english_sentence: The media slandered that politician and ended up having to apologize and pay compensation.

mandarin_meaning: 诬蔑；诽谤
english_meaning: to slander; to smear; to defame
explanation_mandarin: 誣衊指捏造事實或扭曲真相，故意中傷或損害他人的名譽。
explanation_english: To falsely accuse or fabricate facts to damage someone's reputation; to slander or defame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人誣衊話佢偷咗錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 wu1 mit6 waa6 keoi5 tau1 zo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人诬蔑说他偷了钱。
examples.english_sentence: He was slandered—people accused him of stealing money.

mandarin_meaning: 诬陷（用谎言或伪证陷害他人）
english_meaning: to frame; to falsely accuse someone
explanation_mandarin: 指用捏造的事实、谎言或伪证等手段陷害别人，使其受责备或承担罪名。
explanation_english: To falsely accuse or set someone up by fabricating facts, lies, or false evidence so that they are blamed or held responsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被人誣陷偷嘢，其實佢冇做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jan4 wu1 ham6 tau1 je5, kei4 sat6 keoi5 mou5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人诬陷偷东西，其实他没有做。
examples.english_sentence: He was framed for stealing, but he didn't do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂誣陷人，冇證據就唔好講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 wu1 ham6 jan4, mou5 zing3 geoi3 zau6 m4 hou2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便诬陷别人，没有证据就不要说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't falsely accuse people without evidence; don't say it unless you have proof.

mandarin_meaning: 误 (wù) — 错误；弄错；误解
english_meaning: mistake; error; to make a mistake; to misunderstand
explanation_mandarin: 表示错误或弄错，常用于合成词如“误会”、“误解”、“错误”等，在口語中也可表示“误以为”。
explanation_english: Indicates an error or mistake; commonly used in compounds such as '误会' (misunderstand) and '错误' (error). Can also mean 'to mistakenly think/assume'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好誤會，我唔係針對你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ng6 wui6, ngo5 m4 hai6 zam1 deoi3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別誤會，我不是針對你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't misunderstand me; I'm not targeting you.

mandarin_meaning: 無意中被牽連 / 誤被牽連
english_meaning: to be inadvertently implicated; to be unintentionally dragged into someone else's trouble
explanation_mandarin: 指無意間被捲入他人的麻煩或事件，成為牽連或需分擔責任或後果。
explanation_english: Refers to unintentionally getting drawn into someone else's trouble or situation, becoming implicated or forced to share responsibility or consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係唔想管佢啲事，點知誤中副車而家要一齊負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 gun2 keoi5 di1 si6, dim2 zi1 ng6 zung1 fuk1 ce1 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 jat1 cai4 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的不想管他的事，沒想到誤被牽連現在要一起負責。
examples.english_sentence: I really didn't want to get involved in his affairs; I didn't expect to be inadvertently implicated and now have to take responsibility together.

mandarin_meaning: 误事（耽误事情；妨碍事情顺利进行；把事情弄糟）
english_meaning: to cause trouble or delay; to mess things up; to hinder the smooth progress of something
explanation_mandarin: 表示耽误事情或妨碍事情顺利进行，常用於口语，含有把事情弄坏或拖延的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates causing delay or trouble, hindering the smooth progress of an affair, or messing things up; commonly used in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你遲到會誤事，努力啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ci4 dou3 wui5 ng6 si6, nou5 lik6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你迟到会误事，要努力一点。
examples.english_sentence: If you're late you'll mess things up, try harder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣亂搞，最後只會誤事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng6 lyun6 gaau2, zeoi3 hau6 zi2 wui5 ng6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样胡乱弄，最后只会误事。
examples.english_sentence: If he messes around like that, he'll only make things worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家齊心協力先唔會誤事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 cai4 sam1 hip3 lik6 sin1 m4 wui5 ng6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家同心协力才不会误事。
examples.english_sentence: Only if everyone works together will things not be messed up.

mandarin_meaning: 误导后辈；把年轻人带坏
english_meaning: to mislead or corrupt the younger generation; to lead young people astray
explanation_mandarin: 指以不良言行或教導使年輕人受到誤導，走上錯誤或不良的道路。
explanation_english: Refers to misleading or corrupting young people through bad behavior or instruction, causing them to adopt wrong or harmful ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲壞榜樣會誤人子弟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 waai6 bong2 joeng6 wui5 ngo5 jan4 zi2 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的壞榜樣會誤人子弟。
examples.english_sentence: His bad example will lead young people astray.

mandarin_meaning: 误入歧途 (wù rù qí tú) — 走上错误或不正当的道路/方向
english_meaning: to go astray; to take a wrong or immoral path; to be led into wrongdoing
explanation_mandarin: 形容因為選擇錯誤或受壞影響，走上錯誤、違法或不道德的道路。常用來指人生方向或行為偏離正道。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, through wrong choices or bad influences, has taken a wrong, illegal, or immoral path in life or behavior. Often used about moral/life direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識咗啲壞朋友，結果誤入歧途，開始做違法嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 zo2 di1 waai6 pang4 jau5, git3 gwo2 ngo5 jap6 kei4 tou4, hoi1 ci2 zou6 wai4 faat3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他结交了坏朋友，结果误入歧途，开始做违法的事。
examples.english_sentence: He made friends with the wrong people and ended up going astray, starting to do illegal things.

mandarin_meaning: 誤判 / 錯判
english_meaning: misjudge; make an erroneous judgment; wrongful conviction (as noun)
explanation_mandarin: 表示錯誤地判斷或裁定（如對案件、證據或情況的判斷），可作動詞（誤判某事）或名詞（一次誤判）使用。
explanation_english: Refers to making an incorrect judgment or ruling (e.g., about a case, evidence, or situation). Can be used as a verb (to misjudge) or as a noun (a misjudgment/wrongful conviction).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法院誤判，令無辜嘅人被判有罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 jyun6 ngo6 pun3, ling6 mou4 gu1 ge3 jan4 bei6 pun3 jau5 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法院誤判，導致無辜的人被判有罪。
examples.english_sentence: The court's misjudgment led to innocent people being convicted.

mandarin_meaning: 误导 (wùdǎo)
english_meaning: to mislead; to misguide; misleading
explanation_mandarin: 使他人产生错误的认识或判断，导向错误的方向。可以是故意也可以是无意的。
explanation_english: To cause someone to form a wrong understanding or make an incorrect judgement; to lead someone in the wrong direction. Can be intentional or accidental.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰啲講法有誤導性，唔可以完全相信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 di1 gong2 faat3 jau5 ngo5 dou6 sing3, m4 ho2 ji5 jyun4 cyun4 soeng1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那些说法具有误导性，不能完全相信。
examples.english_sentence: His statements are misleading and shouldn't be fully trusted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 錯誤嘅標題可能會誤導讀者，記者要更加小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co3 ngo5 ge3 biu1 tai4 ho2 nang4 wui5 ngo5 dou6 duk6 ze2, gei3 ze2 jiu3 gang1 gaa1 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 错误的标题可能会误导读者，记者要更加小心。
examples.english_sentence: An incorrect headline can mislead readers; reporters should be more careful.

mandarin_meaning: 誤差 (wùchā)：指測量、計算或預測結果與真實值之間的差距或偏差。
english_meaning: Error; the difference or deviation between a measured, calculated, or predicted value and the true value.
explanation_mandarin: 在科學、工程或統計中，表示觀測值或計算值與真實值或標準值之間的偏離程度，可能來自系統性或隨機性因素。
explanation_english: In science, engineering, or statistics, it denotes the amount by which an observed or calculated value deviates from the true or standard value; it can arise from systematic or random factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部秤有啲誤差，要校準先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 cang3 jau5 di1 ng6 caa1, jiu3 gaau3 zeon2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這台秤有些誤差，要先校準。
examples.english_sentence: This scale has some error; it needs to be calibrated first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 計算結果出現咗誤差，要檢查程式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gai3 syun3 git3 gwo2 ceot1 jin2 zo2 ng6 caa1, jiu3 gim2 caa4 cing4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 計算結果出現了誤差，要檢查程式。
examples.english_sentence: The calculation results showed an error; we need to check the program.

mandarin_meaning: 误打误撞；碰巧、无意中
english_meaning: by chance; accidentally; stumble upon; serendipitously
explanation_mandarin: 表示无意中或偶然发生某事，常用作副词或状语，形容碰巧做到或遇到某事。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happened accidentally or by chance. Commonly used adverbially to describe stumbling into or unexpectedly achieving/encountering something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋誤打誤撞搵到間好正嘅小店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ng6 daa2 ng6 zong6 waan2 dou3 gaan1 hou2 zeng3 ge3 siu2 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们无意中找到了一间很棒的小店。
examples.english_sentence: We accidentally found a great little shop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢誤打誤撞入咗呢行，宜家做得幾成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ng6 daa2 ng6 zong6 jap6 zo2 ni1 hong4, ji4 gaa1 zou6 dak1 gei2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他误打误撞进入了这个行业，现在做得挺成功的。
examples.english_sentence: He stumbled into this industry and is now quite successful.

mandarin_meaning: 误会 (wùhuì)
english_meaning: misunderstand / misunderstanding
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事或某人的意思、情況理解錯誤，可作動詞（誤會某人/某事）或名詞（有一個誤會）使用。
explanation_english: Indicates an incorrect understanding of something or someone. Can be used as a verb ('to misunderstand') or a noun ('a misunderstanding').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好誤會我，我唔係咁意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ng6 wui6 ngo5, ngo5 m4 hai6 gam2 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別誤會我，我不是那個意思。
examples.english_sentence: Don't misunderstand me; that's not what I meant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之間有啲誤會，需要解釋清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 di1 ng6 wui6, seoi1 jiu3 gaai2 sik1 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們之間有些誤會，需要解釋清楚。
examples.english_sentence: There are some misunderstandings between us that need to be clarified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢誤會咗對方嘅意思，事情先鬧大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ng6 wui6 zo2 deoi3 fong1 ge3 ji3 si1, si6 cing4 sin1 naau6 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他誤會了對方的意思，事情才鬧大。
examples.english_sentence: He misunderstood the other's meaning, and the matter then escalated.

mandarin_meaning: 误杀（无意间或因疏忽导致的致人死亡）
english_meaning: accidental killing; killing by mistake
explanation_mandarin: 指因疏忽、誤判或意外而造成他人死亡，並非預謀或蓄意殺人的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to causing someone's death unintentionally due to negligence, mistake, or accident — not a premeditated or intentional homicide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話係誤殺，警方正調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 hai6 ng6 saat3, ging2 fong1 zing3 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說是誤殺，警方正在調查。
examples.english_sentence: He says it was an accidental killing; the police are investigating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打獵時佢唔小心誤殺咗一隻鹿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 lip6 si4 keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 ng6 saat3 zo2 jat1 zek3 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打獵時他不小心誤殺了一隻鹿。
examples.english_sentence: While hunting, he accidentally killed a deer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官要判定係誤殺定蓄意殺人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 jiu3 pun3 ding6 hai6 ng6 saat3 ding6 cuk3 ji3 saat3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官要判定是誤殺還是蓄意殺人。
examples.english_sentence: The judge must determine whether it was an accidental killing or intentional murder.

mandarin_meaning: 误解
english_meaning: misunderstanding; to misunderstand
explanation_mandarin: 对某事或某人的意思、动机或情况理解错误，产生误会或错误判断。
explanation_english: A mistaken understanding of something or someone; to misunderstand, leading to a misconception or wrong judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可能係語言問題造成咗誤解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 nang4 hai6 jyu5 jin4 man6 tai4 zou6 sing4 zo2 ng6 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可能是语言问题造成了误解。
examples.english_sentence: Maybe a language issue caused the misunderstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好誤解我，我真係想幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ng6 gaai2 ngo5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别误解我，我真的想帮你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't misunderstand me; I really want to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可能誤解咗佢講嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 nang4 ng6 gaai2 zo2 keoi5 gong2 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可能误解了他/她的话意。
examples.english_sentence: You may have misunderstood what he/she meant.

mandarin_meaning: 诵；念诵、朗读（常指经文、诗词等）
english_meaning: to recite; to chant; to read aloud (often scriptures, poems, or passages)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用語音朗讀或念誦文本，常用於誦經、誦詩等宗教或文學場景。
explanation_english: To read or chant aloud a text. Commonly used for chanting sutras, reciting poems, or verbally practicing passages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺佛堂入面誦經。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fat6 tong4 jap6 min6 sung6 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在佛堂裡面誦經。
examples.english_sentence: He is chanting sutras in the temple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個已經識得誦短文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 sik1 dak1 sung6 dyun2 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候已經會背誦短文。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little I could already recite short passages.

mandarin_meaning: 誦經 / 念经（誦讀宗教經文，尤指佛經）
english_meaning: to chant or recite scriptures (especially Buddhist sutras); to read religious texts aloud
explanation_mandarin: 指朗誦或念誦宗教經文（多指佛經、經典），作為宗教儀式或修行的一部分。也可引申為機械式或重複性地朗讀、背誦。
explanation_english: Refers to chanting or reciting religious scriptures (commonly Buddhist sutras) as part of ritual or practice. It can also be used figuratively for rote or repetitive recitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寺廟入面有啲和尚喺誦經，聲音好寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 miu6 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 wo4 soeng6 hai2 sung3 ging1, sing1 jam1 hou2 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寺庙里面有和尚在念经，声音很宁静。
examples.english_sentence: There are monks in the temple chanting sutras; the sound is very peaceful.

mandarin_meaning: 教誨；教導、勸誡（書面語）
english_meaning: to instruct; to admonish; teaching; admonition
explanation_mandarin: 「誨」本義為教導、勸誡，常見於複合詞如「教誨」「訓誨」，屬較書面或文言色彩的用法。
explanation_english: The character means to instruct or admonish. It commonly appears in compounds such as "教誨" and "訓誨" and is typically formal or literary in usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一直記住師父嘅教誨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zik6 gei3 zyu6 si1 fu2 ge3 gaau3 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一直記住師父的教誨。
examples.english_sentence: I have always remembered my master's teachings.

mandarin_meaning: 教導別人有耐心，從不厭倦（誨人不倦）
english_meaning: to teach others tirelessly; to be indefatigable and patient in instructing others
explanation_mandarin: 形容教導別人時十分有耐心，從不覺得厭倦，常用來稱讚老師或指導者的教學態度。
