explanation_english: Historically used to refer to the Korean script (Hangul, also called Hunminjeongeum); more generally it can mean a vernacular or colloquial writing style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 韓文本來叫做諺文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hon4 man4 bun2 loi4 giu3 zou6 jin6 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 韩文原本叫做諺文。
examples.english_sentence: Korean script was originally called '諺文'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係用諺文寫嘅，好容易明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 jung6 jin6 man4 se2 ge3, hou2 jung4 ji6 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是用白话文写的，很容易理解。
examples.english_sentence: This book is written in the vernacular, so it's easy to understand.

mandarin_meaning: 谚语
english_meaning: proverb; saying; adage
explanation_mandarin: 諺語是流傳於民間的簡短語句，常用來表達生活經驗、智慧或勸誡，具有比喻性和概括性。
explanation_english: A proverb or saying handed down among people, typically short and expressing practical wisdom, experience, or moral advice; often metaphorical and generalizing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句諺語講得好有道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 jin6 jyu5 gong2 dak1 hou2 jau5 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這句諺語說得很有道理。
examples.english_sentence: This proverb makes a lot of sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽成日用諺語教我做人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 jung6 jin6 jyu5 gaau3 ngo5 zou6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我媽媽常用諺語教我做人。
examples.english_sentence: My mother often uses proverbs to teach me how to behave.

mandarin_meaning: 諾 (nuò)：允诺、答应、同意
english_meaning: to promise; to consent; assent; a pledge or promise
explanation_mandarin: 表示答应或承诺，多見於書面語或與其他字構成詞（如「允諾」「承諾」「諾言」）。
explanation_english: Denotes to promise or give assent. Commonly appears in written language and in compounds (e.g., 'allow/consent', 'commitment', 'promise').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經允諾會幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 wan2 nok6 wui5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經允諾會幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He has already promised to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講嘢要負責，唔好隨便許下諾言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 je5 jiu3 fu6 zaak3, m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin6 heoi2 haa6 nok6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說話要負責，不要隨便許下諾言。
examples.english_sentence: Be responsible with your words; don't make promises lightly.

mandarin_meaning: 诺言；承诺
english_meaning: promise; pledge; vow
explanation_mandarin: 表示答應要做某事的話語或承諾，通常指口頭或書面的保證。
explanation_english: A statement or assurance that one will do something; a verbal or written pledge or promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要記住你嘅諾言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 nei5 ge3 nok6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要記住你的诺言。
examples.english_sentence: You must remember your promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔守諾言，令我好失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sau2 nok6 jin4, ling6 ngo5 hou2 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不守诺言，让我很失望。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't keep his promise; it made me very disappointed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 簽咗嘅諾言就唔好隨便改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cim1 zo2 ge3 nok6 jin4 zau6 m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin6 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 签了的诺言就不要随便改变。
examples.english_sentence: Don't casually change a promise you've signed.

mandarin_meaning: 诺贝尔（如诺贝尔奖）
english_meaning: Nobel (as in the Nobel Prize)
explanation_mandarin: 指瑞典化學家阿爾弗雷德·諾貝爾及其命名的諾貝爾獎，常用以指諾貝爾獎項或諾貝爾這個名稱。
explanation_english: Refers to Alfred Nobel and the Nobel Prize named after him; commonly used to refer to the Nobel Prize or the name 'Nobel'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為做出重大發現而攞咗諾貝爾獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 zou6 ceot1 zung6daai6 faat3jin4 ji4 lo2 zo2 nok6 bui3 ji5 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為做出重大發現而獲得了諾貝爾獎。
examples.english_sentence: He won the Nobel Prize for making a major discovery.

mandarin_meaning: 谋 (móu)：计划、策划、图谋；亦可指谋求生计（如“谋生”）
english_meaning: to plan; to scheme; to seek; (in compounds) to make a living
explanation_mandarin: 表示策劃、計劃或圖謀某事，常見於合成詞如「謀生」「密謀」「圖謀」等，用於表示尋求、安排或策劃的意思。
explanation_english: Denotes planning, scheming, or seeking something. Frequently appears in compounds such as "謀生" (to make a living) and "密謀" (to conspire), indicating arranging, seeking, or plotting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗謀生，佢去咗外國打工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 mau4 saang1, keoi5 heoi3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 daa2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了谋生，他去了外国打工。
examples.english_sentence: To make a living, he went abroad to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋密謀改變公司政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mat6 mau4 goi2 bin3 gung1 si1 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们密谋改变公司政策。
examples.english_sentence: They conspired to change the company's policy.

mandarin_meaning: （可能為「謀人事」的誤寫/變體）暗中設計、陷害或算計別人
english_meaning: (likely a misspelling/variant of "謀人事") to secretly scheme against, set up, or plot against someone
explanation_mandarin: 「謀人寺」在香港口語中常見，但多數情況下是「謀人事」的誤寫或口語變體。意思是暗地裡計劃、設計或陷害別人，使對方受害或被誣陷，屬於貶義的俗語用法。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese this form is often seen but is generally a misspelling/variant of "謀人事". It refers to secretly plotting against, framing, or scheming to harm someone. It's colloquial and derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺背後謀人寺（即係謀人事），搞到大家唔信任佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 bui3 hau6 mou4 jan4 ji6 (zik1 hai6 mou4 jan4 si6), gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 m4 seon3 jam6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在背後謀人事（即是暗中算計別人），結果大家不再信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He is always scheming against people behind their backs (i.e. plotting to harm or frame others), so nobody trusts him anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 谋划（筹划、策划）
english_meaning: to plan; to scheme; to plot
explanation_mandarin: 表示筹划、策划某件事，常指周密或有策略地制定计划，有时带有暗中或谋略的含义。
explanation_english: To devise or arrange a plan or scheme; often implies deliberate, strategic planning and can sometimes carry a sense of plotting or secrecy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司正謀劃一個新嘅市場推廣計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zing3 mau4 waak6 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 si5 coeng4 teoi1 gwong2 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司正在谋划一个新的市场推广计划。
examples.english_sentence: The company is planning a new marketing campaign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺背後謀劃推翻董事會嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 bui3 hau6 mau4 waak6 teoi1 faan1 dung2 si6 wui2 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在背后谋划推翻董事会的决定。
examples.english_sentence: They are scheming behind the scenes to overturn the board's decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府謀劃經濟振興方案，並徵求公眾意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 mau4 waak6 ging1 zai3 zan3 hing1 fong1 on3, bing6 zing1 kau4 gung1 zung3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府谋划经济振兴方案，并征求公众意见。
examples.english_sentence: The government is devising an economic revitalization plan and seeking public input.

mandarin_meaning: 謀反（策劃、圖謀推翻統治者或政府）
english_meaning: to plot rebellion; to revolt; treasonous plotting against a ruler or government
explanation_mandarin: 指策劃或圖謀推翻統治者、朝廷或政府的行為，常用於指控叛亂或叛國的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to planning or plotting to overthrow a ruler, court, or government; commonly used to describe acts of rebellion or treason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代一旦有人謀反，通常會被嚴懲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 jat1 daan6 jau5 jan4 mau4 faan2, tung1 soeng4 wui5 bei6 jim4 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代一旦有人謀反，通常會被嚴懲。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, if someone plotted rebellion, they were usually punished severely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人控告謀反，依家等緊審判結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 hung3 gou3 mau4 faan2, ji4 gaa1 dang2 gan2 sam2 pun3 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人控告謀反，現在在等待審判結果。
examples.english_sentence: He was accused of plotting rebellion and is now awaiting the trial's verdict.

mandarin_meaning: 謀取（谋取，móu qǔ）— 設法獲得、謀求（利益、權力等）
english_meaning: to seek to obtain; to attempt to acquire (often benefits, power, etc.), sometimes by scheming
explanation_mandarin: 表示經過計畫、安排或用不當手段去獲取某種利益或權力，語氣常帶有謀劃或不正當的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates trying to obtain something (benefits, power, etc.) through planning or schemes; often implies plotting or using improper means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗謀取利益，做咗好多不光彩嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 mau4 ceoi2 lei6 jik6, zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 bat1 gwong1 caai2 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了謀取利益，做了很多不光彩的事。
examples.english_sentence: He did many dishonorable things to obtain benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府有人被揭發謀取私利，要接受調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jau5 jan4 bei6 git3 faat3 mau4 ceoi2 si1 lei6, jiu3 zip3 sau6 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府有人被揭發謀取私利，需要接受調查。
examples.english_sentence: Someone in the government was exposed for seeking private gain and must be investigated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗謀取好成績而作弊係錯嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 mau4 ceoi2 hou2 sing4 zik1 ji4 zou6 baak3 hai6 co3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了謀取好成績而作弊是錯誤的。
examples.english_sentence: Cheating to obtain good grades is wrong.

mandarin_meaning: 謀害（謀劃傷害或殺害某人）
english_meaning: to plot to harm or kill someone; to conspire to injure or assassinate
explanation_mandarin: 指有預謀地計畫傷害或殺害某人，帶有蓄意和計畫性的意思，常出現在法律或新聞語境。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately planning to harm or kill someone; implies premeditated and intentional action. Commonly used in legal or news contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑有人謀害嗰個證人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 jau5 jan4 mau4 hoi6 go2 go3 zing3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方懷疑有人謀害那位證人。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect someone plotted to harm that witness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被人謀害，差啲喪命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jan4 mau4 hoi6, caa1 di1 song3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人謀害，差點喪命。
examples.english_sentence: He was targeted in a plot and almost lost his life.

mandarin_meaning: 谋杀 (móushā)
english_meaning: murder; to murder
explanation_mandarin: 故意且非法剝奪他人生命的行為，常見於法律、新聞等語境。
explanation_english: The deliberate and unlawful act of causing another person's death; commonly used in legal and news contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑有人謀殺咗受害者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 jau5 jan4 mou4 saat3 zo2 sau6 hoi6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方怀疑有人谋杀了受害者。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect someone murdered the victim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被控謀殺罪，案件仲喺調查中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 hung3 mou4 saat3 zeoi6, on3 gin2 zung6 hai6 tiu4 caa4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被控谋杀罪，案件还在调查中。
examples.english_sentence: He is charged with murder; the case is still under investigation.

mandarin_meaning: 谋求；寻求，设法获得或争取（某种利益、地位、结果）
english_meaning: to seek; to strive for; to try to obtain or achieve something
explanation_mandarin: “謀求”用于表示通过计划或努力去争取、获得某种利益、地位或结果，语气较正式，多见于书面或正式场合。
explanation_english: “謀求” indicates making plans or efforts to obtain or secure something (e.g., benefits, position, results). It is relatively formal and often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司謀求擴展海外市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mau4 kau4 kwaang3 zin2 hoi2 ngoi6 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司谋求扩展海外市场。
examples.english_sentence: The company seeks to expand into overseas markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋謀求同政府協商補貼方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mau4 kau4 tung4 zing3 fu2 hip3 soeng1 bou2 tip3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谋求与政府协商补贴方案。
examples.english_sentence: They are seeking to negotiate subsidy plans with the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢謀求晉升到經理職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mau4 kau4 zeon3 sing1 dou3 ging1 lei5 zik1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他谋求晋升到经理职位。
examples.english_sentence: He is seeking a promotion to a managerial position.

mandarin_meaning: 谋生；为维持生计而工作或谋取生计。
english_meaning: to make a living; to work or seek work in order to support oneself.
explanation_mandarin: 指为了维持生活而从事工作或寻找能维持生计的途径。
explanation_english: Refers to working or finding ways to earn money in order to support oneself or one's family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗外國謀生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 mau4 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去国外谋生。
examples.english_sentence: He went abroad to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗謀生，佢做咗幾份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 mau4 saang1, keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了谋生，他做了好几份工作。
examples.english_sentence: To make a living, he took several jobs.

mandarin_meaning: 谋略；计谋、策略
english_meaning: strategy; tactic; scheming
explanation_mandarin: 指用來達成目的的計畫或策略，常用於形容在政治、商業、軍事等場合的智略與計策。
explanation_english: Refers to plans or strategies devised to achieve objectives; often used to describe tactical thinking or scheming in politics, business, military, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有謀略，喺談判度成日諗到辦法爭取最大利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 mau4 loek6, hai2 taam4 pun3 dou6 sing4 jat6 lam2 dou3 baan6 faat3 zang1 ceoi2 zeoi3 daai6 lei6 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有谋略，在谈判中经常想出办法争取最大利益。
examples.english_sentence: He is very strategic; during negotiations he often comes up with ways to secure the greatest benefit.

mandarin_meaning: 谋私；谋取私利
english_meaning: to seek personal gain; to act for private/self-serving interests
explanation_mandarin: 指以權力或機會為自己謀取不正當或私人的利益，帶有貪婪或自私的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to using power or opportunities to obtain improper private benefits for oneself; implies selfish or corrupt behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔應該喺公司入面謀私，咁樣好唔公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 jing1 goi1 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 mau4 si1, gam2 joeng6 hou2 m4 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不應該在公司裡謀私，這樣很不公平。
examples.english_sentence: He shouldn't seek personal gain within the company; that's very unfair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有報道話啲官員利用職權謀私，要調查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 bou3 dou6 waa6 di1 gun1 jyun4 lei6 jung6 zik1 kyun4 mau4 si1, jiu3 tiu4 caa4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有報道說官員利用職權謀私，需要徹查。
examples.english_sentence: Reports say officials used their power to seek personal gain and need to be thoroughly investigated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司規定要防止員工謀私利，違規者會受罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kwai1 ding6 jiu3 fong4 zi2 jyun4 gung1 mau4 si1 lei6, wai4 kwai1 ze2 wui5 sau6 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司規定要防止員工謀私利，違規者會受罰。
examples.english_sentence: The company rules aim to prevent employees from seeking private gain; violators will be punished.

mandarin_meaning: 谋财害命（指为了钱财而杀害他人）
english_meaning: To kill or harm someone in order to obtain their money or property; to murder for gain.
explanation_mandarin: 指為了獲取財物而設計或實施殺害他人的行為，常用以形容極端貪婪和殘忍的犯罪。
explanation_english: Refers to plotting or committing killing in order to obtain money or property; used to describe extremely greedy and cruel criminal behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲罪行真係惡劣，簡直係謀財害命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zeoi6 hang4 zan1 hai6 ok3 lit6, gan2 zik6 hai6 mau4 coi4 hoi6 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些罪行真惡劣，簡直是謀財害命。
examples.english_sentence: Those crimes are truly heinous — basically killing for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方話有人疑似因為繼承問題而謀財害命，已經展開調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waa6 jau5 jan4 ji4 si6 jan1 wai6 gai3 sing4 man6 tai4 ji4 mau4 coi4 hoi6 ming6, ji5 ging1 zin2 hoi1 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方表示有人因為繼承糾紛疑似謀財害命，已經展開調查。
examples.english_sentence: The police said someone is suspected of plotting to kill over an inheritance dispute; an investigation has begun.

mandarin_meaning: 謁見；拜見（拜訪以表示敬意）
english_meaning: to pay respects; to have an audience with; to visit (to show respect)
explanation_mandarin: 表示前往拜見或拜訪重要或尊貴的人，以表示敬意。用法偏正式或書面語，常見於「謁見」「拜謁」等詞組中。
explanation_english: Indicates going to visit or pay respects to an important or higher-status person. The term is formal or literary and often appears in compounds like '謁見' (to have an audience) or '拜謁' (to pay respects).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝我去先人牌位前謁，獻咗鮮花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ngo5 heoi3 sin1 jan4 paai4 wai6 cin4 jit6, hin2 zo2 sin1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我到先人的牌位前謁，獻了鮮花。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I went to the ancestral tablet to pay respects and offered fresh flowers.

mandarin_meaning: 稱為；叫做；說
english_meaning: to call; to say; to mean
explanation_mandarin: 表示稱為、叫做或說的動作，常見於書面語或構成詞語（如「所謂」、「可謂」、「自謂」）。
explanation_english: Indicates calling something by a name, saying, or meaning; commonly used in formal/written contexts and in compounds such as '所謂' (so-called) and '可謂' (can be said).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 所謂成功唔單止係有錢，仲要有滿足感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: so2 wai6 sing4 gung1 m4 daan1 zi2 hai6 jau5 cin2, zung6 jiu3 jau5 mun5 zuk1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 所謂的成功不單只是有錢，還要有滿足感。
examples.english_sentence: The so-called success is not just about having money; it also requires a sense of fulfillment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自謂好有才華，但其實未必。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 wai6 hou2 jau5 coi4 waa4, daan6 kei4 sat6 mei6 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自謂很有才華，但其實未必。
examples.english_sentence: He considers himself very talented, but not necessarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程可謂係一次重大的嘗試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 ho2 wai6 hai6 jat1 ci3 zung6 daai6 ge3 soeng4 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個工程可謂是一次重大的嘗試。
examples.english_sentence: This project can be said to be a significant attempt.

mandarin_meaning: 谓语（句子成分，表示主语的动作、状态或性质）
english_meaning: predicate (the part of a sentence that expresses the action, state, or property of the subject)
explanation_mandarin: 在語法中，謂語是句子的一部分，通常由動詞、動詞短語或形容詞承擔，用來表達主語的動作、狀態或性質。
explanation_english: In grammar, the predicate is the part of a sentence that expresses the subject's action, state, or property; it is typically realized by a verb, verb phrase, or adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學語法時要分清主語同謂語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jyu5 faat3 si4 jiu3 fan1 cing1 zyu2 jyu5 tung4 wai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学语法时要分清主语和谓语。
examples.english_sentence: When studying grammar, you should distinguish the subject and the predicate.

mandarin_meaning: 抄寫；謄錄（抄本、謄本）
english_meaning: to transcribe; to copy out; a transcript/copy
explanation_mandarin: 表示將書面文字抄錄下來或複製出一份書面文件，常見於「謄寫」「謄本」等用法。
explanation_english: Means to copy or transcribe written text, or to produce a transcript/copy of a document. Common in compounds like '謄寫' (to transcribe) and '謄本' (transcript).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我謄低呢份合約？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 tang4 dai1 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能不能幫我抄下這份合約？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me copy down this contract?

mandarin_meaning: 謄寫下來的文件副本；誊本、抄本
english_meaning: a transcript or duplicate copy of a document; a transcribed/duplicated text
explanation_mandarin: 指經過謄寫或誊錄而成的文件副本，常用於法律、登記或其他正式場合作為證明或備案之用。
explanation_english: Refers to a copy or transcript of an original document produced by transcription or duplication; often used in legal, registration, or other formal contexts as evidence or for filing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文件係正本，呢份係謄文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 hai6 zing3 bun2, ni1 fan6 hai6 tang4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份文件是正本，這份是謄文（抄本）。
examples.english_sentence: This document is the original; this one is the transcript/copy.

mandarin_meaning: 胡說、亂說或編造（話）
english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to make things up; to spout lies
explanation_mandarin: 「謅」（常見於「胡謅」）表示說沒有根據的話、亂編或瞎扯，多用於口語，含有貶義或戲謔成分。
explanation_english: The verb 謅 (often seen in the compound 胡謅) means to talk nonsense, fabricate stories, or spout untrue things. It is colloquial and can carry a mildly pejorative or teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡謅，講真啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 zau1, gong2 zan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別胡說，說認真一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense; be a bit more serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日謅嘢，冇人信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zau1 je5, mou5 jan4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是胡說，沒人相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks nonsense; no one believes him.

mandarin_meaning: 謊（huǎng）：謊言；說謊
english_meaning: lie; falsehood; to tell a lie
explanation_mandarin: 表示不真實的言語或陳述；作動詞時指說不真實的話或欺騙他人。
explanation_english: Refers to an untrue statement or falsehood; as a verb, to tell an untrue statement or deceive someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講謊，我已經唔信佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 fong2, ngo5 ji5 ging1 m4 seon3 keoi5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常說謊，我已經不再相信他了。
examples.english_sentence: He often lies; I no longer trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用謊話嚟遮掩真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 fong2 waa6 lai4 ze1 jim2 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用謊言來掩蓋真相。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use lies to cover up the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 谎言（huǎngyán）：不真实的陈述或说法，用来欺骗或掩盖事实
english_meaning: lie; falsehood; an untrue statement made to deceive or conceal the truth
explanation_mandarin: 指為了欺騙或掩蓋真相而說的不真實的話或陳述，常與說謊、假話相關。
explanation_english: A false statement or assertion made to deceive or hide the truth; commonly associated with lying or false statements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅全部都係謊言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 wong4 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的全都是謊言。
examples.english_sentence: Everything he said is a lie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用謊言去解釋你做錯嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 wong4 jin4 heoi3 gaai2 sik1 nei5 zou6 co3 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用謊言去解释你做错的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use lies to explain your mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 謊話 / 謊言 (huǎng huà / huǎng yán)
english_meaning: lie; falsehood; untrue statement
explanation_mandarin: 指不真實、為了欺騙或誤導而說的話。
explanation_english: A statement that is not true, often told to deceive or mislead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講謊話，冇人再信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 fong2 waa6, mou5 jan4 zoi3 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常說謊話，沒有人再相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He often tells lies; no one believes him anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同小朋友講謊話，佢哋會學返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 siu2 pang4 jau5 gong2 fong2 waa6, keoi5 dei6 wui5 hok6 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要對小朋友說謊話，他們會學起來。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tell lies to children; they'll pick it up.

mandarin_meaning: 謊話連篇 (huǎng huà lián piān) — 連續不斷地說謊，充滿謊言。
english_meaning: Full of lies; telling lie after lie; a tissue/pack of lies.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事充滿謊言，一再講假話，難以讓人信服或相信。
explanation_english: Describes a person, statement, or text that is full of lies — continuously telling untruths; used to accuse someone or something of being extremely dishonest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅全部都係謊話連篇，唔好再信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 fong2 waa6 lin4 pin1, m4 hou2 zoi3 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的全部都是謊話連篇，不要再相信他。
examples.english_sentence: Everything he says is a pack of lies — don't believe him anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰份報告謊話連篇，連基本數據都唔可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fan6 bou3 gou3 fong2 waa6 lin4 pin1, lin4 gei1 bun2 sou3 geoi3 dou1 m4 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那份報告謊話連篇，連基本數據都不可信。
examples.english_sentence: That report is full of lies; even the basic data aren't reliable.

mandarin_meaning: 谜（mí）：谜语、谜团、难以理解的事物或现象
english_meaning: riddle; mystery; something puzzling
explanation_mandarin: 表示谜语或难以理解、难以解释的事物或现象。常見於組合詞如「謎語」、「謎團」、「謎底」。
explanation_english: Refers to a riddle or something mysterious/difficult to understand. Often appears in compounds like '謎語' (riddle), '謎團' (mystery), and '謎底' (answer to a riddle).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個謎好難猜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mai4 hou2 naan4 caai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个谜很难猜。
examples.english_sentence: This riddle is hard to guess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢留低咗一個謎，無人知道答案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lau4 dai1 zo2 jat1 go3 mai4, mou5 jan4 zi1 dou3 daan6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他留下了一个谜，没人知道答案。
examples.english_sentence: He left behind a riddle/mystery, and no one knows the answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到最後先揭曉謎底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 zeoi3 hau6 sin1 kit3 hiu2 mai4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到最后才揭晓谜底。
examples.english_sentence: The riddle's answer was revealed only at the end.

mandarin_meaning: 谜团；难解之谜
english_meaning: mystery; enigma; puzzling matter
explanation_mandarin: 指難以理解或解釋的事情、現象或案件，通常帶有神秘或尚未解決的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to something difficult to understand or explain—an enigma or unresolved matter, often implying mystery or puzzlement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事到而家仲係一個謎團。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 jat1 go3 mai4 tyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事到現在仍然是一個謎團。
examples.english_sentence: This matter remains a mystery to this day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 案件背後有好多謎團，需要進一步調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: on3 gin6 bui3 hau6 jau5 hou2 do1 mai4 tyun4, seoi1 jiu3 zeon3 jat1 bou6 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 案件背後有很多謎團，需要進一步調查。
examples.english_sentence: There are many mysteries behind the case that require further investigation.

mandarin_meaning: 谜底；谜语的答案
english_meaning: answer to a riddle; solution to a puzzle
explanation_mandarin: 指谜语、謎題或疑问的答案，也可比喻为事情的真相或关键所在。
explanation_english: The answer to a riddle or puzzle. Can also be used metaphorically to mean the truth or key behind a mystery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好快就搵到謎底，原來係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 faai3 zau6 wan2 dou3 mai4 dai2, jyun4 loi4 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很快就找到了谜底，原来是这样。
examples.english_sentence: He found the riddle's answer quickly — it turned out to be like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊戲入面要解開謎題，同搵出謎底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 jiu3 gaai2 hoi1 mai4 tai4, tung4 wan2 ceot1 mai4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 游戏里面要解开谜题，并找出谜底。
examples.english_sentence: In the game you need to solve the riddles and find the answers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師叫我哋寫低謎語同埋謎底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 se2 dai1 mai4 jyu5 tung4 maai4 mai4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师让我们写下谜语和谜底。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked us to write down the riddles and their answers.

mandarin_meaning: 谜语
english_meaning: riddle
explanation_mandarin: 用描述、比喻或暗示等方式提出讓人猜測答案的語句或問題，常用於娛樂或猜謎活動。
explanation_english: A question or statement phrased to puzzle or trick someone into guessing an answer, often using metaphor, wordplay, or hints; commonly used for entertainment or guessing games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小時候我最鍾意聽長輩講謎語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 si4 hau6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 teng1 coeng4 bui3 gong2 mai4 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我最喜欢听长辈讲谜语。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I loved listening to elders tell riddles.

mandarin_meaning: 神秘的表情／莫測的面容
english_meaning: an enigmatic/mysterious facial expression; an inscrutable face
explanation_mandarin: 「謎面」是廣東話口語，指看起來神秘、難以猜透或表情讓人摸不着頭腦的面容或表情。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial use, '謎面' describes a mysterious or inscrutable facial expression — a look that makes it hard to tell what someone is thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擺住一副謎面，唔知諗緊啲乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baai2 zyu6 jat1 fu2 mai4 min6, m4 zi1 lam2 gan2 di1 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她总是擺出一副神秘的表情，不知道在想什麼。
examples.english_sentence: He/she always has an enigmatic expression — you can't tell what they're thinking.

mandarin_meaning: （方言/俗用）笑、嘲笑
english_meaning: to laugh; (colloquial) to laugh at / to mock
explanation_mandarin: 「謏」為較少見或口語化用法的字，常在廣東話書寫或網路用語中當作「笑」或帶有嘲笑語氣的「嘲笑」使用。用法偏口語、俗用或古今異義兼具的情況。
explanation_english: A less common / colloquial character used in Cantonese writing or online to mean 'to laugh' or (with a mocking tone) 'to laugh at, to mock'. Usage is chiefly colloquial and may carry a playful or sarcastic tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰個嘢真係謏死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 go3 je5 zan1 hai6 siu3 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的那件事真把我笑死了。
examples.english_sentence: What he said really made me laugh (so hard).

mandarin_meaning: （戲）谑 / 戏谑；开玩笑、调侃
english_meaning: to jest; to joke or tease playfully; playful mockery
explanation_mandarin: 表示开玩笑、以幽默或讥讽的方式调侃别人，常见于‘戲謔’、‘戲謑’等词语中。
explanation_english: Denotes joking or teasing in a playful or teasing way; often used in compounds such as '戲謔' to indicate jesting or playful mockery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日咁戲謔，唔係真心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 gam2 hei3 ngok6, m4 hai6 zan1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話總是這麼戲謔，不是真心的。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks so jokingly; he's not sincere.

mandarin_meaning: 戲稱；開玩笑地稱呼
english_meaning: to jokingly call; to refer to someone/something in jest
explanation_mandarin: 表示以開玩笑或不太嚴肅的方式稱呼或給予某人、某物一個外號或名稱。
explanation_english: Used to indicate calling someone or something by a nickname or label in a joking or unserious manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都謔稱佢做「問答王」，其實佢好低調。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 hok6 cing1 keoi5 zou6 "man6 daap3 wong4", kei4 sat6 keoi5 hou2 dai1 diu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都戲稱他為「問答王」，其實他很低調。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone jokingly calls him 'the Quiz King', but he's actually very low-profile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳媒謔稱呢項新政策會帶來一場災難，講法有啲誇張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 mui4 hok6 cing1 ni1 hong6 san1 zing3 caak3 wui5 daai3 loi4 jat1 coeng4 zoi1 naam6, gong2 faat3 jau5 di1 kwaa1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒體戲稱這項新政策會帶來一場災難，說法有點誇張。
examples.english_sentence: The media jokingly called the new policy a recipe for disaster — the wording is a bit exaggerated.

mandarin_meaning: 诽谤；中伤
english_meaning: to slander; to defame; to speak ill of someone
explanation_mandarin: 謗（简体：谤，读音 bàng），指用言语或文字散布不实或恶意的信息，以损害他人的名誉，即诽谤、诋毁。
explanation_english: To make false or malicious statements about someone to damage their reputation; to slander or defame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺背後謗我，講啲唔實嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 bui3 hau6 bong6 ngo5, gong2 di1 m4 sat6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在背后诽谤我，说一些不实的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He often slanders me behind my back, saying untrue things.

mandarin_meaning: 謙（qian1），表示謙虛、謙遜
english_meaning: modest; humble; unassuming
explanation_mandarin: 表示性格謙遜、不自滿，常見於「謙虛」「謙遜」「謙讓」等複合詞，表示對自己收斂或讓步。
explanation_english: Indicates modesty or humility. Commonly appears in compounds such as '謙虛' (modest), '謙遜' (humble), and '謙讓' (yielding).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好謙虛，俾人讚賞時會輕描淡寫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 him1 heoi1, bei2 jan4 zaan3 soeng2 si4 wui5 hing1 miu4 daam6 se2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很謙虛，受到讚賞時會輕描淡寫。
examples.english_sentence: He is very modest; when praised he tends to downplay it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺會議中，大家互相謙讓以避免衝突。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 wui6 ji5 zung1, daai6 gaa1 wu6 soeng1 him1 joeng6 ji5 bei6 min5 cung1 dat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在會議中，大家互相謙讓以避免衝突。
examples.english_sentence: In the meeting, everyone yielded to one another to avoid conflict.

mandarin_meaning: 谦卑 (qiānbēi)，谦虚、低调
english_meaning: humble; humility; modest
explanation_mandarin: 表示謙虛、不驕傲自滿的態度或性格，也可指謙遜的品質（名詞用法）。
explanation_english: Describes a modest, unpretentious attitude or character; can also refer to the quality of humility (noun usage).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好謙卑，唔會誇耀自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 him1 bei1, m4 wui5 kwaa1 jiu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很谦卑，不会夸耀自己。
examples.english_sentence: He is very humble and doesn't brag about himself.

mandarin_meaning: 谦厚（谦逊而厚道、为人诚恳）
english_meaning: modest and sincere / unassuming and kind-hearted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人謙虛、不張揚，同時待人誠懇、厚道。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is modest and unpretentious, while being sincere and kind in their dealings with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格謙厚，大家都好鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gaak3 him1 hau5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他性格谦厚，大家都很喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He is modest and kind-hearted; everyone likes him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試時佢表現得好謙厚，面試官對佢印象深刻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 si4 keoi5 biu2 jin2 dak1 hou2 him1 hau5, min6 si5 gun1 deoi3 keoi5 jan3 zoeng6 sam1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试时他表现得很谦厚，面试官对他印象深刻。
examples.english_sentence: He came across as modest and sincere during the interview; the interviewer was impressed.

mandarin_meaning: 谦称（用谦虚的称呼或自称）
english_meaning: humble form of address; to refer modestly to oneself or others
explanation_mandarin: 指以謙虛的方式稱呼自己或他人，常用於自謙或禮貌表達，例如「謙稱自己為……」。
explanation_english: Refers to using a modest or humble form of address for oneself or others, often for self-deprecation or polite expression (e.g. 'to modestly call oneself ...').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢謙稱自己只係一個普通員工，唔想講太多功勞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 him1 cing1 zi6 gei2 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 pou2 tung1 jyun4 gung1, m4 soeng2 gong2 taai3 do1 gung1 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他谦称自己只是一个普通员工，不想多说功劳。
examples.english_sentence: He modestly referred to himself as just an ordinary employee and didn't want to mention his contributions.

mandarin_meaning: 谦虚（qiānxū）
english_meaning: modest; humble
explanation_mandarin: 表示不自滿、不誇耀自己、對自己的優點或成就保持低調和謙遜的態度。
explanation_english: Indicates modesty; describing someone who does not boast about their abilities or achievements and remains humble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好謙虛，成日話自己仲未夠好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 him1 heoi1, sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 zung6 mei6 gau3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很謙虛，常常說自己還不夠好。
examples.english_sentence: He is very modest; he often says he's not good enough.

mandarin_meaning: 謙謙君子 (qiānqiān jūnzǐ)：形容為人謙虛、有禮且品行端正的男子。
english_meaning: A modest and virtuous gentleman; a man of humility, courtesy, and high moral character.
explanation_mandarin: 「謙謙君子」常用於書面語或正式語境，用以稱讚一個人謙遜、有禮、品行端正，帶有文雅與道德讚譽的意味。
explanation_english: Used chiefly in literary or formal contexts to praise someone—typically a man—as humble, courteous, and morally upright. It conveys respect and admiration for the person's character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個謙謙君子，為人謙遜、有禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 him1 him1 gwan1 zi2, wai6 jan4 him1 seon3, jau5 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個謙謙君子，為人謙遜、有禮。
examples.english_sentence: He is a modest gentleman—humble and polite in his manners.

mandarin_meaning: 谦逊（qiānxùn），谦虚
english_meaning: modest; humble
explanation_mandarin: 表示不自滿、不驕傲，對自己的成就或能力保持低調和謙虛的態度。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not proud or boastful, showing humility and a low-key attitude about their achievements or abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一向好謙遜，從來唔會話自己做得最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 hou2 him1 seon3, cung4 loi4 m4 wui5 waa6 zi6 gei2 zou6 dak1 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一向很谦逊，从来不会说自己做得最好。
examples.english_sentence: He is always very modest and never says he does the best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好謙遜，唔鍾意喺人面前誇耀自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 him1 seon3, m4 zung1 ji3 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 kwaa1 jiu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很谦逊，不喜欢在别人面前夸耀自己。
examples.english_sentence: He is very humble and doesn't like to boast about himself in front of others.

mandarin_meaning: 諡；追贈或賜予死者的稱號（亦可作動詞，表示賜諡號）
english_meaning: posthumous name; to confer a posthumous title/name
explanation_mandarin: 指對已故人物追封的稱號（諡號），或作動詞指賜予這種稱號，常見於歷史、官方祭祀或記載中。
explanation_english: Refers to a posthumous name bestowed on a deceased person, or the act of conferring such a name; commonly used in historical and official contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢死後獲得一個光榮嘅謚號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sei2 hau6 wok6 dak1 jat1 go3 gwong1 wing4 ge3 si6 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他死後獲得一個光榮的諡號。
examples.english_sentence: He received an honorable posthumous name after his death.

mandarin_meaning: 諡號 (shìhào)：對死者（尤指皇帝、官員）追封或評定的稱號，用以概括其品德或功過。
english_meaning: posthumous name/title — an honorary name given to a deceased person (especially rulers or officials) reflecting their character or deeds.
explanation_mandarin: 謚號是古代對逝者依其生前事跡或品德所賦予的稱號，常見於皇帝、諸侯、官員等，用以評定或紀念其功過與品行。
explanation_english: A posthumous name or title assigned to a deceased person (commonly emperors or officials) that summarizes or evaluates their virtues, achievements, or failings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位皇帝有個好有名嘅謚號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 wong4 dai3 jau5 go3 hou2 jau5 ming4 ge3 si6 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位皇帝有一個很有名的諡號。
examples.english_sentence: That emperor has a very famous posthumous name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代官員死咗之後可能會被賜謚號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 gun1 jyun4 sei2 zo2 zi1 hau6 ho2 nang4 wui5 bei6 ci3 si6 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代官員死後可能會被賜諡號。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, officials might be granted a posthumous title after death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識佢嘅謚號係乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 keoi5 ge3 si6 hou6 hai6 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道他的諡號是什麼嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know what his posthumous name was?

mandarin_meaning: 说；讲（shuō/jiǎng）
english_meaning: to speak; to say; to tell
explanation_mandarin: 表示發出語言、表達意思或告訴別人某事。
explanation_english: Indicates producing speech, expressing something, or telling someone about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說什麼？
examples.english_sentence: What are you saying?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想講呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gong2 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想談這件事。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to talk about this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He/She speaks very clearly.

jyutping: gong2 jat1 tou3 zou6 jat1 tou3
mandarin_meaning: 说一套做一套 / 言行不一
english_meaning: Say one thing and do another; hypocritical; not practicing what one preaches.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人說的和做的不一致，表裡不一或言行不符，常帶批評或不信任的語氣。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose words and actions do not match — saying one thing but doing another. Often used critically to indicate hypocrisy or inconsistency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己好節儉，實際上就係講一套做一套，成日亂花錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 zit3 gim2, sat6 zai3 soeng6 zau6 hai6 gong2 jat1 tou3 zou6 jat1 tou3, seng4 jat6 lyun6 faa1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是说自己很节省，实际上是说一套做一套，经常乱花钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's frugal, but in reality he says one thing and does another — he frequently splurges.

mandarin_meaning: 說三道四
english_meaning: to gossip; to talk ill of others; to make petty or critical remarks
explanation_mandarin: 表示對別人議論、閒話或多嘴指指點點，常帶負面意味，也可指對事情過分挑剔或批評。
explanation_english: Indicates gossiping, making petty comments or criticizing others (often behind their backs); generally negative connotation and can also mean nitpicking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺人背後講三講四。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 jan4 bui3 hau6 gong2 saam1 gong2 sei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在別人背後說三道四。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about others behind their backs.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）說一下；談一談
english_meaning: talk a bit; say briefly; have a word
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示請對方說一下或談一談，也可用作語氣助詞以軟化命令或表示短暫的動作。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning 'say a bit' or 'talk briefly'. Often used to ask someone to speak, to soften a request/command, or to indicate a short/brief action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講下呀，我想聽下你嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 haa5 aa3, ngo5 soeng2 teng1 haa5 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說一下吧，我想聽聽你的意見。
examples.english_sentence: Say something, I'd like to hear your opinion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我講下先，呢件事唔係咁簡單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 gong2 haa5 sin1, ni1 gin6 si6 m4 hai6 gam2 gaan2 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等我先說一下，這件事不是那麼簡單。
examples.english_sentence: Let me say something first; this matter isn't that simple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚出嚟傾下，講下啲計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 ceot1 lai4 king1 haa5, gong2 haa5 di1 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚出來聊聊，談談一些計劃。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go out tonight to chat and discuss some plans.

mandarin_meaning: 談論別人的私事/閒話；干涉別人的事
english_meaning: to gossip about others; to discuss others' private affairs; to meddle in others' business
explanation_mandarin: 指談論或散播有關他人的私事或是非，常帶有八卦或干涉意味，通常含貶義。
explanation_english: Refers to talking about or spreading others' private matters or rumors; carries a sense of gossiping or meddling and is usually negative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講人事，唔關你事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 jan4 si6, m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別說別人的事，這不關你的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about other people's affairs; it's none of your business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鍾意講人事，成日八卦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zung1 ji3 gong2 jan4 si6, seng4 jat6 baat3 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是喜歡說別人的閒話，總是八卦。
examples.english_sentence: He/she always likes to gossip about others; always being nosy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔鼓勵員工喺辦公室講人事，因為會影響團隊氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 gu2 lai6 jyun4 gung1 hai2 baan6 gung1 sat1 gong2 jan4 si6, jan1 wai6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 tyun4 deoi2 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不鼓勵員工在辦公室談論別人的私事，因為會影響團隊氛圍。
examples.english_sentence: The company doesn't encourage employees to discuss others' private matters in the office because it can affect team morale.

mandarin_meaning: 貶低；說別人的壞話；看不起人
english_meaning: to belittle; to disparage; to speak ill of someone; to look down on someone
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示貶低別人、說別人的壞話或看不起別人。常用於「講低人」等搭配。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to belittle or disparage someone, i.e., to speak ill of or look down on another person. Often used in phrases like "講低人" (to put someone down).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講低我哋嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 dai1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常貶低我們的努力。
examples.english_sentence: He often belittles our efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺人面前講低佢，好唔禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 gong2 dai1 keoi5, hou2 m4 lei5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在人面前貶低他，很不禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't belittle him in front of others; it's very rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講低人，冇人想同佢做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 dai1 jan4, mou5 jan4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是貶低別人，沒有人想和他做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He always belittles others; no one wants to be friends with him.

cantonese: 講來講去三幅被，量來量去二丈四
jyutping: gong2 loi4 gong2 heoi3 saam1 fuk1 bei3, loeng4 loi4 loeng4 heoi3 ji6 zoeng6 sei3
mandarin_meaning: 說來說去沒有結論、反覆衡量卻沒有結果；形容拖延或猶豫不決
english_meaning: To talk/measure over and over with no conclusion; to go round in circles — describes indecision, dithering, or endless discussion without result
explanation_mandarin: 這句粵語俗語用來形容談論或衡量同一件事反覆不定、沒有實際結果，常用來責備拖延或猶豫不決的人。
explanation_english: This Cantonese saying describes repeatedly talking or measuring the same thing without reaching a decision. It's used to criticize dithering, procrastination, or talking in circles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講來講去三幅被，量來量去二丈四，唔好淨係講，做個決定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 loi4 gong2 heoi3 saam1 fuk1 bei3, loeng4 loi4 loeng4 heoi3 ji6 zoeng6 sei3, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 gong2, zou6 go3 kyut3 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說來說去沒有結果、反反覆覆，別光說不做，做個決定吧。
examples.english_sentence: You keep talking in circles and going over it again and again; don't just talk—make a decision.

mandarin_meaning: 說謊；（有時）開玩笑、鬧着玩
english_meaning: to lie; to tell a lie; (sometimes) to joke or kid
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，通常指說不真實的話以欺騙或誤導他人；在某些語境下亦可表示「只是開玩笑、鬧著玩」。可用來質問別人不誠實（如「你講假？」）或輕鬆地表示不必當真（如「我哋喺度講假啫」）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to speak falsely (to lie) or, in some contexts, to joke/kid. It can be used to accuse someone of being untruthful (e.g. "You lying?") or more lightly to indicate you're not serious (e.g. "We're just joking").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講假呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 gaa2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在說謊嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you lying?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講假，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 gaa2, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常說謊，別相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He lies all the time; don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺度講假啫，唔使認真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dou6 gong2 gaa2 ze1, m4 sai2 jing6 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們只是在開玩笑，不用認真。
examples.english_sentence: We're just kidding; don't take it seriously.

mandarin_meaning: 讲价 / 讨价还价 (与卖方就价格进行协商)
english_meaning: to haggle; to bargain (negotiate the price)
explanation_mandarin: 與賣方就商品或服務的價格進行協商，通常為了壓低售價或取得更優惠的價格。
explanation_english: To negotiate the price of goods or services with a seller, usually with the aim of lowering the asking price or obtaining a better deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺市集買衫，要記得講價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 si5 zaap6 maai5 saam1, jiu3 gei3 dak1 gong2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在市集买衣服，要记得讲价。
examples.english_sentence: We're buying clothes at the market; remember to haggle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張伯係個好叻講價嘅人，買嘢通常可以慳唔少錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 baak3 hai6 go3 hou2 lek1 gong2 gaa3 ge3 jan4, maai5 je5 tung1 soeng4 ho2 ji5 haan1 m4 siu2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 张伯很会讲价，买东西通常能省不少钱。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle Cheung is good at bargaining; he usually saves a lot when buying things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁快講價，先睇清楚啲貨先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 gong2 gaa3, sin1 tai2 cing1 co2 di1 fo3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么快讲价，先把货看清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't haggle so quickly; inspect the goods first.

mandarin_meaning: 说两句 / 说几句话
english_meaning: to say a few words; to speak briefly; (colloquially) to give someone a brief remark, comment, or mild scolding
explanation_mandarin: 口语用法，表示说几句话、发表意见或简短交谈。有时用于提醒、批评或把事情讲清楚，语气可正式也可随意，视语境而定。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to say a few words or speak briefly. It can be used to make a short comment, give advice or mild criticism, or to ask to clarify something — tone and force depend on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想講兩句，你可唔可以等我講完？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 gong2 loeng5 geoi3, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 dang2 ngo5 gong2 jyun4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想说两句话，你能不能等我说完？
examples.english_sentence: I want to say a few words; can you wait until I finish?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，我要講兩句同佢講清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, ngo5 jiu3 gong2 loeng5 geoi3 tung4 keoi5 gong2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，我要和他说两句话把事情讲清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late — I need to say a few words to him to make things clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係喺度講兩句，做實際啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hai2 dou6 gong2 loeng5 geoi3, zou6 sat6 zai3 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别只在那儿说两句，做点实际的事吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just stand there and say a few words — do something practical.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）說到口乾舌燥／把話題說到沒完沒了或談論得很疲倦
english_meaning: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to talk about something until exhausted or ad nauseam; to discuss something over and over until there's nothing left to say.
explanation_mandarin: 口語說法，形容對某事反覆不停地談論，或把話題說到沒什麼可再說／使人感到厭煩或疲累。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to describe discussing something repeatedly or nonstop until one is exhausted or fed up; literally ‘talk until the mouth is dry’.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我哋都已經講到口水乾，仲要再傾咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 ji5 ging1 gong2 dou3 hau2 seoi2 gon1, zung6 jiu3 zoi3 king1 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事我們已經說到口乾舌燥了，還要再談什麼？
examples.english_sentence: We've already talked this to death — what more is there to discuss?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每次都講同一樣嘢，講到口水乾都唔肯收聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 ci3 dou1 gong2 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5, gong2 dou3 hau2 seoi2 gon1 dou1 m4 hang2 sau1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都說同樣的話，說到口乾舌燥也不肯閉嘴。
examples.english_sentence: He repeats the same thing every time and talks nonstop until he's hoarse and still won't shut up.

mandarin_meaning: （話）說到嘴邊；快要說出口
english_meaning: on the tip of one's tongue; about to say something; nearly uttered
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容差一點就把話說出來，或快要說出口但又忍住沒說。常用於口語表達有人即將透露或說明某事卻收住不說的情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning someone is about to say something (almost blurted it out) but stops or holds back. It describes the state of being on the verge of speaking or revealing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱想爆料，講到咀唇邊就收咗口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aam1 aam1 soeng2 baau3 liu6, gong2 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1 zau6 sau1 zo2 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛才想爆料，說到嘴邊又閉嘴了。
examples.english_sentence: He was about to expose it, but stopped at the last moment.

mandarin_meaning: 話到嘴邊 / 差點就說出來
english_meaning: on the tip of one's tongue; almost said it (brought up but stopped)
explanation_mandarin: 表示話快要說出口或提起某件事，但最後又收回沒說出來。常用以形容猶豫、尷尬或不敢說的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates that something was about to be said or brought up but was stopped before being spoken. Often used to describe hesitation, embarrassment, or reluctance to speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講到咀脣邊，最後又收返口，唔敢講出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, zeoi3 hau6 jau6 sau1 faan1 hau2, m4 gam2 gong2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他差點就說出口，最後又收回，不敢說出來。
examples.english_sentence: He was about to say it, but in the end held back and didn't dare to say it out loud.

mandarin_meaning: 話到嘴邊／差點說出來（但最後沒說）
english_meaning: on the tip of one's tongue; almost said something but stopped
explanation_mandarin: 表示話已經快要說出口了，但最終沒有說出來，常用於描述差點透露某事或猶豫不說的情況。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that someone was about to say something but stopped short; commonly describes nearly revealing information or hesitating to speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我已經講到嘴唇邊，但最後又收返口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 ji5 ging1 gong2 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, daan6 zeoi6 zung1 jau6 sau1 faan1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事我已經說到嘴邊了，但最後又收回去了。
examples.english_sentence: I had almost said it, but in the end I held it back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰樣嘢嘅時候，我都聽到你講到嘴唇邊，但你冇講落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 joeng6 je5 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dou1 teng1 dou3 nei5 gong2 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, daan6 nei5 mou5 gong2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說那件事的時候，我聽到你已經說到嘴邊了，但你沒有繼續說下去。
examples.english_sentence: When you mentioned that thing, I heard you nearly say it, but you didn't continue.

mandarin_meaning: （話）到嘴邊／快說出口
english_meaning: On the tip of one's tongue; about to say something but stopping or being interrupted
explanation_mandarin: 指一句話快要說出來了，但因為猶豫、被打斷或收回而沒有說出來。
explanation_english: Refers to a remark that is about to be spoken but is hesitated, interrupted, or swallowed back — literally 'spoken up to the edge of the lips.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我本來想講嘅嘢已經講到嘴脣邊，但最後又吞返落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun2 loi4 soeng2 gong2 ge3 je5 ji5 ging1 gong2 dou3 zeoi2 ceon4 bin1, daan6 zeoi6 hau6 jau6 tan1 faan1 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本來想說的話已經快說到嘴邊了，但最後又吞回去了。
examples.english_sentence: What I was going to say was on the tip of my tongue, but in the end I swallowed it.

mandarin_meaning: 說到底；歸根結底
english_meaning: in the end; when all is said and done; ultimately
explanation_mandarin: 「講到尾」是廣東話口語，表示「說到底、最後、歸根結底」，常用來引出總結、結論或強調最終情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning 'in the end' or 'when all is said and done'. It is used to introduce a summary, conclusion, or the ultimate point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講到尾，佢都唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dou3 mei5, keoi5 dou1 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說到底，他還是沒來。
examples.english_sentence: In the end, he still didn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講到尾，目的就係要賺錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dou3 mei5, muk6 dik1 zau6 hai6 jiu3 zaan6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說到底，目的就是要賺錢。
examples.english_sentence: When it comes down to it, the goal is to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋講咗咁耐，講到尾都冇結論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gong2 zo2 gam2 noi6, gong2 dou3 mei5 dou1 mou5 git3 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們說了這麼久，說到底還是沒有結論。
examples.english_sentence: We talked for so long, and in the end there was still no conclusion.

mandarin_meaning: 說得清楚；講明白
english_meaning: to make something clear; to state explicitly
explanation_mandarin: 表示把事情說得很清楚、講明白，常用於強調已經說清楚或要求對方說得清楚。
explanation_english: Used to indicate stating something very clearly or explicitly; often used to emphasize that something has been made clear or to demand clarity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經講到明，唔好再問我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gong2 dou3 ming4, m4 hou2 zoi6 man6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經說清楚了，不要再問我。
examples.english_sentence: I've already made it clear; don't ask me again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆講到明話加班有額外補償。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gong2 dou3 ming4 waa6 gaa1 baan1 jau5 ngok6 ngoi6 bou2 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆講明了加班有額外補償。
examples.english_sentence: The boss made it clear that overtime comes with extra compensation.

mandarin_meaning: 說到這個／說起來
english_meaning: speaking of which; now that you mention it
explanation_mandarin: 用作語 discourse 標記，用來引出與剛才話題相關的補充、反應或轉折，類似「說到這個」「說起來」。
explanation_english: A discourse marker used to introduce a related point, reaction, or turn in the conversation—similar to "speaking of which" or "now that you mention it."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講到話，你上次講嗰本書我都睇完喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dou3 waa6, nei5 soeng5 ci3 gong2 go2 bun2 syu1 ngo5 dou1 tai2 jyun4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說到這個，你上次說的那本書我也看完了。
examples.english_sentence: Speaking of which, I also finished the book you mentioned last time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講到話，佢好似冇再返工喇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dou3 waa6, keoi5 hou2 ci5 mou5 zoi3 faan1 gung1 laa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說起來，他好像沒有再去上班了？
examples.english_sentence: Speaking of which, hasn't he stopped going to work?

mandarin_meaning: 光說不做
english_meaning: All talk and no action; talks but doesn't act
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容只會說話、不會付諸行動的人或情況，與「光說不做」意思相近。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who only talks but doesn't take action; similar to 'all talk and no action.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講口唔講手，話會幫我搬屋，但係最後一件都冇做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 hau2 m4 gong2 sau2, waa6 wui5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 gin6 dou1 mou5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是光說不做，說會幫我搬家，但最後一件事也沒做。
examples.english_sentence: He's always all talk and no action — he said he'd help me move, but didn't do a single thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細唔可以淨係講口唔講手，要睇到實際行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 gong2 hau2 m4 gong2 sau2, jiu3 tai2 dou3 sat6 zai3 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆不能只是說說而已，要看到實際的行動。
examples.english_sentence: The boss can't just talk — we need to see concrete actions.

mandarin_meaning: （談論）口齒、口齒清晰與否；評論說話的方式或發音
english_meaning: to talk about someone's diction/articulation; to comment on how clearly someone speaks
explanation_mandarin: 粵語用語，通常指評論或談論一個人的口齒（說話是否清晰、發音如何），有時也泛指對說話方式的批評或討論。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression typically used to comment on someone's diction or articulation (whether their speech is clear, how they pronounce words). It can also broadly refer to criticizing or discussing someone's manner of speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講口齒好清楚，大家都聽得明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hau2 ci2 hou2 cing1 co2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 teng1 dak1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他口齒很清楚，大家都聽得懂。
examples.english_sentence: His diction is very clear; everyone could understand him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係講口齒，講下內容或者其他重點啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 gong2 hau2 ci2, gong2 haa5 noi6 jung4 waak6 ze2 kei4 taa1 zung6 dim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只談論口齒，說一下內容或者其他重點吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just focus on diction; talk about the content or other key points.

mandarin_meaning: 讲故事、闲聊或八卦
english_meaning: to tell stories; to chat/gossip; to spin a yarn
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，原指讲故事或说古老传说；现代也常用于指闲聊、聊天或八卦，有时含夸张添油加醋的意思。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb originally meaning to tell stories or folk tales; modern usage often means to chat informally or gossip, sometimes implying exaggerated or colorful storytelling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去茶餐廳，大家坐低講古啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 caa4 caan1 teng1, daai6 gaa1 co5 dai1 gong2 gu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去茶餐厅，大家坐下聊天吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the cha chaan teng tonight and sit down to chat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺街度同人講古，成日誇大啲事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 tung4 jan4 gong2 gu2, sing4 jat6 kwaa1 daai6 di1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在街上和人聊天，总是把事情说得夸张。
examples.english_sentence: He often chats with people on the street, always exaggerating things.

mandarin_meaning: 讲故事 / 聊天（常指讲鬼故事或闲聊、八卦）
english_meaning: to tell stories (often ghost stories) / to chat or gossip
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，表示讲故事或讲鬼故事，也可指闲聊、聊八卦、讲笑话等，常见于香港日常用语。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to tell stories — often ghost stories — or to chat/gossip. Commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚喺屋企講古仔，講到半夜先散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 haai2 uk1 kei2 gong2 gu2 zai2, gong2 dou3 bun3 je6 sin1 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚在家讲故事（/讲鬼故事），一直讲到半夜才散。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight we told stories at home, chatting until past midnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺茶餐廳同朋友講古仔，講到大家笑死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 tung4 pang4 jau5 gong2 gu2 zai2, gong2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 siu3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在茶餐厅和朋友讲故事/聊天，讲得大家笑趴。
examples.english_sentence: He often tells stories/chats with friends at the cha chaan teng, making everyone laugh.

mandarin_meaning: 互相顶嘴/回嘴；你来我往地争辩或打趣
english_meaning: to argue back; to retort; to exchange barbs or banter
explanation_mandarin: 指雙方互相回嘴、顶撞或争辩，常见于口语，语气可带有争执或打趣成分。
explanation_english: A colloquial phrase meaning to trade retorts or argue back-and-forth; can be used for light teasing or minor disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日講句駁句，大家講清楚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gong2 geoi3 bok3 geoi3, daai6 gaa1 gong2 cing1 co2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別總是互相顶嘴了，大家把話說清楚吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop snapping at each other all the time; let's make things clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日講句駁句，其實都係玩嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 jat6 gong2 geoi3 bok3 geoi3, kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 waan2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两個总是互相顶嘴，其实都是在开玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: Those two keep exchanging barbs, but they're actually just joking.

mandarin_meaning: 讲台；发言平台
english_meaning: podium, lectern; (figurative) a platform to speak or express opinions
explanation_mandarin: 指老师或演講者站立發言的台子；引申指公開發表意見或獲得曝光的機會或平台。
explanation_english: Refers to the physical podium or lectern where a teacher or speaker stands; figuratively, it means a platform or opportunity to speak or be heard publicly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師企喺講台上面教書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 kei5 hai2 gong2 toi4 soeng6 min6 gaau3 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师站在讲台上教书。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher stands on the podium to teach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媒體唔應該畀極端分子太多講台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui4 tai2 m4 jing1 goi1 bei2 gik6 dyun1 fan6 zi2 taai3 do1 gong2 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒体不应该给极端分子太多发言平台。
examples.english_sentence: The media shouldn't give extremists too much of a platform.

mandarin_meaning: 說這些／談論這些（事情）
english_meaning: to talk about these things; to mention this stuff (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，指談論某些事情或提到某類話題。根據語境可中性描述談論，亦常用作帶有不耐或要求停止討論的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to talk about these things or mention this stuff. Depending on context it can neutrally describe discussing topics or be used dismissively to tell someone to stop bringing something up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講呢啲啦，我哋講正經嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 ni1 di1 laa1, ngo5 dei6 gong2 zing3 ging1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別說這些了，我們講正經的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about these things; let's talk about serious matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講呢啲八卦，真係煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 ni1 di1 baat3 gwaa3, zan1 hai6 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說這些八卦，真煩人。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks about this gossip; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講呢啲無謂，快啲做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 ni1 di1 mou4 wai6, faai3 di1 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說這些沒意義，快點做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Talking about this is pointless — hurry up and do it.

mandarin_meaning: 说得容易（通常暗含做起来不容易）
english_meaning: Easier said than done; (used to scold or remind someone that something is easy to say but hard to do)
explanation_mandarin: 用来表示某件事说起来容易，但实际去做并不容易，常用来回击或提醒对方别只空谈。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something is easy to talk about but hard to accomplish; often used to rebuke or remind someone not to only talk but to act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講咁易？你試過做到先至講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 gam2 ji6? nei5 si3 gwo3 zou6 dou3 sin1 zi3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说得容易？你先试着做到再说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Easier said than done? Try doing it yourself before you say that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係講咁易，做嘢要實際啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 gong2 gam2 ji6, zou6 je5 jiu3 sat6 zai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是说得容易，做事要实际一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just say it's easy; be more practical when doing things.

mandarin_meaning: 和解；和好；停戰
english_meaning: to make peace; to reconcile; to call a truce
explanation_mandarin: 表示雙方停止爭執或敵對，達成和解或重歸於好。
explanation_english: To stop a dispute or hostilities between parties and reach reconciliation or make up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔好再爭，講和啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 zoi6 zang1, gong2 wo4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們不要再爭了，和好吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's stop arguing and make peace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司同供應商終於講和，簽咗合作協議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tung4 gung1 jing3 soeng1 zung1 jyu1 gong2 wo4, cim1 zo2 hap6 zok3 hip3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司和供應商終於和解，簽了合作協議。
examples.english_sentence: The company and the supplier finally reconciled and signed a cooperation agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個吵到冇朋友，依家終於講和。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 cau3 dou3 mou5 pang4 jau5, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 gong2 wo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們兩個吵到沒朋友，現在終於和好了。
examples.english_sentence: They fought so badly they had no friends; now they've finally made up.

mandarin_meaning: 你在說什麼？/說什麼？（表示不相信、驚訝或要求解釋）
english_meaning: What are you talking about? / What do you mean? (expressing disbelief, surprise, or asking for clarification)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用語，通常用來質疑對方說法、表示不相信、驚訝或要求對方解釋。語氣可帶挑戰或驚訝成分。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to question what someone said, expressing disbelief, surprise, or asking for clarification. It can carry a challenging or incredulous tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講咩呀？點解會係我做嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 me1 aa3? dim2 gaai2 wui5 hai6 ngo5 zou6 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在說什麼？為什麼會是我做的？
examples.english_sentence: What are you talking about? Why would it be me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話我遲到係我嘅錯，我就話："講咩！我明明提前咗！"
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ngo5 ci4 dou3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 co3, ngo5 zau6 waa6: "gong2 me1! ngo5 ming4 ming4 tai4 cin4 zo2!"
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說我遲到是我的錯，我就說：『你在說什麼！我明明提前了！』
examples.english_sentence: He said I'm late and it's my fault, and I said, 'What are you talking about? I was clearly early!'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日有考試喎。講咩？我完全唔知！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jau5 haau2 si3 wo3. gong2 me1? ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有考試喔。你在說什麼？我完全不知道！
examples.english_sentence: There's an exam tomorrow. What are you talking about? I had no idea!

mandarin_meaning: （口語）說不完／說不完就被打斷或無法收尾
english_meaning: (colloquial) unable to finish speaking; can't bring the topic to a close (often because of interruptions or because it goes on and on)
explanation_mandarin: 表示講話講唔到尾、講不完，常因被打斷或話題延伸而無法收場，也可形容話題冗長講不完。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning one cannot finish speaking or cannot bring the conversation to an end—often because one is interrupted or the topic keeps going on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺會議入面講唔埋欄，成日畀人打斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 wui6 ji5 jap6 min6 gong2 m4 maai4 laan4, sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 daa2 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在會議裡說不完話，總是被打斷。
examples.english_sentence: I couldn't finish speaking in the meeting; I kept getting interrupted.

mandarin_meaning: 说话；聊天
english_meaning: to speak; to talk; to chat
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用語，表示發表言語、交談或閒聊，有時也可指說廢話或胡扯。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to speak, talk, or chat. It can also sometimes imply talking nonsense or chatting idly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺我面前講嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 gong2 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在我面前说话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk in front of me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋出去講嘢啦，坐低飲杯嘢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ceot1 heoi3 gong2 je5 laa1, co5 dai1 jam2 bui1 je5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们出去聊聊，先坐下喝杯东西。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go out and talk; let's sit down and have a drink first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度講嘢唔停，真係好吵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gong2 je5 m4 ting4, zan1 hai6 hou2 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在那里说个不停，真的很吵。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps talking all the time; it's really noisy.

mandarin_meaning: 說話啊；（表示驚訝或不相信時）你在開玩笑吧？
english_meaning: Say something / Speak up; (as an exclamation) Are you kidding me?
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法。一方面可用作催促或邀請某人說話（「說點話吧」）；另一方面作感嘆或表不相信的反應（相當於「你在開玩笑吧？」）。
explanation_english: Colloquial usage. Can be used to prompt or urge someone to speak ("say something / speak up"); it can also be an exclamation expressing disbelief or surprise ("are you kidding?").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁沉默，講嘢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 cam4 mak6, gong2 je5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別這麼沉默，說點話啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so quiet, say something!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話可以一個鐘跑完？講嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ho2 ji5 jat1 go3 zung1 paau2 jyun4? gong2 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說可以一個鐘跑完？你在開玩笑吧？
examples.english_sentence: He said he can finish running in an hour? Are you kidding?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師問：'邊個想講嘢呀？'
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 man6: 'bin1 go3 soeng2 gong2 je5 aa3?'
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師問：'誰想說話？'
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked, 'Who wants to speak?'

mandarin_meaning: 說話有分量／說話有底氣（說話有理、有說服力）
english_meaning: to speak with substance, authority, or conviction; to have credibility/backbone when speaking
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，形容一個人說話有分量、有理有據或有骨氣，不是空泛的話語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone who speaks with weight, credibility, or conviction — not just empty talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢有骨，大家都信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 jau5 gwat1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話有分量，大家都相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks with authority; everyone trusts him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇評論講嘢有骨，指出咗啲深層問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 ping4 leon6 gong2 je5 jau5 gwat1, zik1 ceot1 zo2 di1 sam1 cang4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇評論有深度，指出了一些深層問題。
examples.english_sentence: This review is substantial; it points out some deeper issues.

mandarin_meaning: 讲堂；讲学或授课的场所/讲座
english_meaning: lecture hall; lecture room; a place or event for giving talks or lessons
explanation_mandarin: 指学校、机构或团体用于讲课、演讲或集会的厅堂，也可以泛指讲学或讲座的场合。
explanation_english: Refers to a hall or room used by schools, institutions, or groups for lectures, talks, or assemblies; can also refer broadly to a lecture or talk event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日喺講堂度上課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 gong2 tong4 dou6 soeng5 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常在讲堂上课。
examples.english_sentence: We often have classes in the lecture hall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚講堂會有一個公開講座，大家都可以去聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gong2 tong4 wui5 jau5 jat1 go3 gung1 hoi1 gong2 zo6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 ho2 ji5 heoi3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚讲堂会有一个公开讲座，大家都可以去听。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a public lecture in the lecture hall tonight; everyone can go and listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 校長喺講堂發表咗一段講話，提到學校未來嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau6 zoeng2 hai2 gong2 tong4 faat3 biu2 zo2 jat1 dyun6 gong2 waa6, tai4 dou3 hok6 haau6 mei6 loi4 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 校长在讲堂发表了一段讲话，提到学校未来的计划。
examples.english_sentence: The principal gave a speech in the lecture hall, mentioning the school's future plans.

mandarin_meaning: 講壇（講演、發表或討論的舞台或論壇）
english_meaning: a platform or forum for giving speeches, lectures, or public discussions; podium/lectern
explanation_mandarin: 指用來發表演講、舉辦講座或公開討論的場所或平台，既可指實體的講台，也可指論壇或節目中的討論環節。
explanation_english: Refers to a venue or platform used for delivering speeches, lectures, or public discussions. It can mean a physical lectern/podium or a forum/program segment where talks occur.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學嘅講壇上發表咗研究成果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 ge3 gong2 taan4 soeng6 faat3 biu2 zo2 jin4 gau3 sing4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大學的講壇上發表了研究成果。
examples.english_sentence: He presented his research findings at the university podium.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社區講壇每個月都有講座，歡迎大家參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 keoi1 gong2 taan4 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jau5 gong2 zo6, fun1 jing4 daai6 gaa1 caam1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社區的講壇每個月都有講座，歡迎大家參加。
examples.english_sentence: The community forum holds lectures every month; everyone is welcome to join.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個星期日有一個公開講壇，幾位嘉賓會討論社會議題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 jau5 jat1 go3 gung1 hoi1 gong2 taan4, gei2 wai2 gaa1 ban1 wui5 tou2 leon6 se5 wui6 ji5 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個星期日有一個公開的講壇，幾位嘉賓會討論社會議題。
examples.english_sentence: This Sunday there's a public forum where several guests will discuss social issues.

mandarin_meaning: 多說無益／說再多也沒用
english_meaning: There's no point in talking more; further discussion is pointless
explanation_mandarin: 表示再多說也沒有意義或用處，常用來結束話題或表達不想繼續討論。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that further discussion is pointless or won't change anything; often used to end a topic or dismiss further debate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事已經決定咗，講多無謂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 kyut3 ding6 zo2, gong2 do1 mou4 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事已經決定了，說再多也沒用。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has already been decided; there's no point in saying more.

jyutping: gong2 do1 mou4 wai6, sik6 do1 wui5 zai3
mandarin_meaning: 多說無益，吃多了會撐／會脹
english_meaning: There's no point talking too much; eating too much will make you feel bloated (i.e. too much of something is bad)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東俗語，字面意思是多說沒有用，吃太多會感到脹。常用來提醒別人不要多言或不要過量，含有適可而止的意思。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb literally meaning 'no point talking too much; eating too much will make you bloated.' It is used to warn against excessive talking or excess in general — advising moderation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲點心咁多，講多無謂，食多會滯，我哋每人夾兩件就好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dim2 sam1 gam2 do1, gong2 do1 mou4 wai6, sik6 do1 wui5 zai3, ngo5 dei6 mui5 jan4 gaap3 loeng5 gin6 zau6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些點心這麼多，沒必要說太多，吃多了會撐，我們每人夾兩件就好。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many dim sum — no point talking about it; eating too much will make you feel bloated. Let's each take two pieces.

mandarin_meaning: 多說多錯 / 說得越多越容易出錯
english_meaning: The more you talk, the more mistakes you make; speaking more often leads to more errors.
explanation_mandarin: 一句俗語，意思是說話越多越容易說錯或出錯，常用來提醒人少說為妙或說話要謹慎。
explanation_english: A proverb meaning that the more one speaks, the more likely one is to make mistakes. It is used to advise people to speak less or be careful with their words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你面試嘅時候唔好講太多，講多錯多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 min6 si3 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 hou2 gong2 taai3 do1, gong2 do1 co3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你面试的时候不要说太多，话多容易出错。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk too much during the interview; the more you speak, the more mistakes you'll make.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺會議度亂講，真係講多錯多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 wui6 ji5 dou6 lyun6 gong2, zan1 hai6 gong2 do1 co3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在会议上乱说话，真是多说多错。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks carelessly in meetings — truly, the more he talks, the more mistakes he makes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好即刻答佢，諗清楚先，講多錯多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zik1 hak1 daap3 keoi5, lam2 cing1 co2 sin1, gong2 do1 co3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要立刻回答他，先想清楚，說得太多容易出錯。
examples.english_sentence: Don't answer him immediately; think it through first — speaking more often leads to more mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 說謊；撒謊
english_meaning: to tell a lie; to lie
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示說不真實的話、欺騙別人或不說實話的行為。
explanation_english: Used to indicate saying something untrue or deceiving others; the act of not telling the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再講大話啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 daai6 waa6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再說謊了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tell lies anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講大話，冇人信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, mou5 jan4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說謊，沒有人相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always tells lies; no one trusts him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友唔好講大話，要誠實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 m4 hou2 gong2 daai6 waa6, jiu3 sing4 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友不要說謊，要誠實。
examples.english_sentence: Children shouldn't lie; be honest.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）说好 / 事先约定 / 达成一致
english_meaning: to agree on something; to have arranged or promised beforehand
explanation_mandarin: 表示事先约定或达成共识，常用於口語，例如约定见面、分工或时间等。也可表示已经承诺某事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese verb phrase meaning to have agreed on or promised something in advance; commonly used in spoken language for arrangements (e.g., meetings, plans, responsibilities).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋講好今晚七點喺咖啡店見面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gong2 hou2 gam1 maan5 cat1 dim2 hai2 gaa3 fe1 dim3 gin3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们说好今晚七点在咖啡店见面。
examples.english_sentence: We agreed to meet at the café at 7 tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 說好話/甜言蜜語（恭維、討好）
english_meaning: to say nice things; to flatter or sweet-talk
explanation_mandarin: 指對別人說好聽的話，包含恭維、安撫或討好，有時帶有不真誠或為達目的而拍馬屁的意味。
explanation_english: To tell someone pleasant things—praising, flattering, or placating them—often to curry favor or achieve a purpose; can imply insincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就識得講好說話，想騙你買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 sik1 dak1 gong2 hou2 syut3 waa6, soeng2 pin3 nei5 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很會說好話，想騙你買東西。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to sweet-talk you and wants to trick you into buying something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好畀人用講好說話騙咗你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 jung6 gong2 hou2 syut3 waa6 pin3 zo2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別讓別人用甜言蜜語騙了你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let others sweet-talk you into being deceived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日對員工講好說話，想提高士氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 sing4 jat6 deoi3 jyun4 gung1 gong2 hou2 syut3 waa6, soeng2 tai4 gou1 si6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆經常對員工說好聽的話，想提高士氣。
examples.english_sentence: The boss often says nice things to the staff to try to boost morale.

mandarin_meaning: 說好聽的話；甜言蜜語；奉承
english_meaning: to say flattering or agreeable things; to sweet-talk; to speak conciliatorily or persuasively with nice words
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，指說討好或好聽的話以取得別人好感或達到某種目的，語氣可中性或帶貶義（視語境而定）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to say pleasing or flattering things to gain someone's favor or achieve a goal. Can be neutral or carry a negative connotation (i.e., sweet-talking or flattering), depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係識講好說話，做嘢要實際啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 gong2 hou2 syut3 waa6, zou6 je5 jiu3 sat6 zai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只會說好聽的話，做事要實際一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just say nice things; be more practical in your actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對老闆講好說話，其實係想拎獎金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 lou5 baan2 gong2 hou2 syut3 waa6, kei4 sat6 hai6 soeng2 ling1 zoeng2 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常對老闆說好聽的話，其實是想拿獎金。
examples.english_sentence: He often flatters the boss; actually he wants to get the bonus.

mandarin_meaning: 說好話；奉承，討好以圖利
english_meaning: to flatter; to sweet-talk; to say pleasant things to ingratiate oneself or gain advantage
explanation_mandarin: 指說好聽或討好對方的話，通常為了取得好處或討好對方，常含諂媚或不夠誠懇的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to saying pleasant or flattering things to please someone, often to gain advantage or favor; usually implies flattery or insincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對老闆講好説話，希望加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 lou5 baan2 gong2 hou2 syut3 waa6, hei1 mong6 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常對老闆說好話，希望加薪。
examples.english_sentence: He always sweet-talks the boss, hoping to get a raise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只會對客人講好説話，背後又講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 wui5 deoi3 haak3 jan4 gong2 hou2 syut3 waa6, bui3 hau6 jau6 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只會對客人說好話，背後又說假話。
examples.english_sentence: He only sweet-talks customers but tells lies behind their backs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用講好説話嘅方法想騙我投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 gong2 hou2 syut3 waa6 ge3 fong1 faat3 seong2 pin3 ngo5 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用說好話的方法想騙我投資。
examples.english_sentence: He used flattery to try to trick me into investing.

mandarin_meaning: 讲学；授课
english_meaning: to give a lecture; to teach or give a talk
explanation_mandarin: 表示到某處講課或授課，常用於指專家、教授或講者到其他學校或場合講授知識或分享經驗。
