explanation_english: Refers to protecting or treating the hair to make it healthier and smoother; commonly involves using hair-care products or receiving salon treatments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱做完護髮，頭髮好柔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 zou6 jyun4 wu6 faat3, tau4 faat3 hou2 jau4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚做完护发，头发很柔顺。
examples.english_sentence: I just had a hair treatment; my hair is very smooth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近啲頭髮好乾，我諗住去髮型屋做護髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 di1 tau4 faat3 hou2 gon1, ngo5 lam2 zyu6 heoi3 faat3 jing4 uk1 zou6 wu6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近头发很干，我打算去发廊护发。
examples.english_sentence: My hair has been very dry lately; I'm planning to go to the salon for a hair treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 护发素 (hùfàsù)
english_meaning: hair conditioner
explanation_mandarin: 用於洗髮後的護理產品，能滋潤、柔順、修復並防止打結，使頭髮更易梳理，通常為乳液或霜狀。
explanation_english: A hair-care product used after shampooing to moisturize, smooth, repair, and detangle hair, making it easier to comb; usually in a lotion or cream form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗新嘅護髮素，用咗之後頭髮順滑好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 san1 ge3 wu6faat3sou3, jung6 zo2 zi1hau6 tau4faat3 seon6waat6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了新的护发素，用了之后头发顺滑很多。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new hair conditioner; after using it, my hair became much smoother.

mandarin_meaning: 讚揚；名聲（如：聲譽、享譽）
english_meaning: praise; reputation; honour
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「譽」表示稱讚或名聲，常見於「聲譽」、「享譽」、「讚譽」等詞語，表示受到讚揚或享有良好名聲。
explanation_english: ‘譽’ denotes praise or reputation. It commonly appears in compounds such as '聲譽' (reputation), '享譽' (be renowned), and '讚譽' (praise), indicating being praised or having a good name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位享譽國際嘅畫家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 hoeng2 jyu6 gwok3 zai3 ge3 waa6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位享譽國際的畫家。
examples.english_sentence: He is a painter renowned internationally.

mandarin_meaning: 被誉为；被称为
english_meaning: to be acclaimed as; to be reputed as; to be regarded as
explanation_mandarin: 表示被讚揚或被認為具有某種身份、地位或特質，常用於書面語或正式場合。
explanation_english: Indicates being praised or regarded as having a certain role, status, or quality; often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被譽為本地最出色嘅年輕導演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jyu6 wai4 bun2 dei6 zeoi3 ceot1 sik1 ge3 nin4 hing1 dou6 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被誉为本地最出色的年轻导演。
examples.english_sentence: He is acclaimed as the most outstanding young director locally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司一直被譽為業界嘅標杆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jat1 zik6 bei6 jyu6 wai4 jip6 gaai3 ge3 biu1 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司一直被誉为业界的标杆。
examples.english_sentence: This company has long been regarded as an industry benchmark.

mandarin_meaning: 譽為 / 被譽為 (yùwéi)：稱讚為、被認為是
english_meaning: to be praised as; to be regarded as; to be acclaimed as
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某物被稱讚或被認為具有某種身份、地位或特質，常用於較正式或書面語境。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something is praised or regarded as having a certain identity, status, or quality. Commonly used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被譽為本地最有影響力嘅藝術家之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jyu6 wai4 bun2 dei6 zeoi3 jau5 jing2 hoeng2 lik6 ge3 ngai6 seot6 gaa1 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被譽為本地最有影響力的藝術家之一。
examples.english_sentence: He is regarded as one of the most influential local artists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書被譽為現代文學嘅經典。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 bei6 jyu6 wai4 jin6 doi6 man4 hok6 ge3 ging1 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書被譽為現代文學的經典。
examples.english_sentence: This book is acclaimed as a classic of modern literature.

mandarin_meaning: 读（dú）
english_meaning: to read; to study; to attend school; to read aloud
explanation_mandarin: 表示用眼睛或聲音閱讀文字、唸書、就學或念誦等行為，亦可指唸出來讓人聽。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of reading text (silently or aloud), studying/attending school, or reciting something aloud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大學讀中文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 zung1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大學讀中文。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying Chinese at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我讀呢段畀我聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 duk6 ni1 dyun6 bei2 ngo5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我把这一段读给我听。
examples.english_sentence: Read this paragraph to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家仲喺讀緊書，唔好打擾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai2 duk6 gan2 syu1, m4 hou2 daa2 jiu2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在還在讀書，不要打擾他。
examples.english_sentence: He's studying right now; don't disturb him.

mandarin_meaning: 為了勝過別人而讀書（刻意讀書以超越他人、考高分）
english_meaning: to study hard in order to outperform others; to study (with the aim) to win/beat others
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語/口語用法，字面上為「讀（書）以勝」，常用來形容為了在考試或競爭中超越他人而刻意努力讀書，語氣可中性亦可帶點競爭或炫耀意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression literally meaning "read (study) to win." It describes studying with the explicit goal of outperforming others in exams or competitions; the tone can be neutral or carry a competitive/show-off nuance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試快到，佢喺圖書館日日讀勝，希望考到第一名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 faai3 dou3, keoi5 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 jat6 jat6 duk6 sing3, hei1 mong6 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試快到了，他最近每天在圖書館刻意讀書，希望考到第一名。
examples.english_sentence: Exams are coming; he's been studying in the library every day to beat others, hoping to get first place.

mandarin_meaning: 讀書的朋友、同學或讀書夥伴
english_meaning: a fellow student or study buddy; someone you read/study with
explanation_mandarin: “讀友”指一起讀書或互相切磋功課的朋友或同學，常用於口語，強調共同讀書或交換筆記的關係。
explanation_english: “讀友” refers to friends or classmates who study together or help each other with schoolwork. It is commonly used in spoken Cantonese to mean classmate or study partner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅讀友，成日一齊溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 duk6 jau5, sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 wun1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的讀友，經常一起溫習。
examples.english_sentence: He's my study buddy; we often study together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校搞咗個讀友聚會，大家互相交換筆記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 gaau2 zo2 go3 duk6 jau5 zeoi6 wui2, daai6 gaa1 wu6 soeng1 gaau1 wun6 bat1 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校舉辦了讀友聚會，大家互相交換筆記。
examples.english_sentence: The school organized a gathering for study buddies; everyone exchanged notes.

mandarin_meaning: 读取 (dúqǔ)
english_meaning: to read or retrieve data (from storage, memory, or a device); to load/read in
explanation_mandarin: 指從儲存裝置、檔案、記憶體或裝置中讀取或擷取資料，常用於電腦與電子設備相關情境。
explanation_english: Refers to reading or retrieving data from storage, files, memory, or devices; commonly used in computing and electronic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 系統而家讀取緊啲資料，請等一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 tung2 ji4 gaa1 duk6 ceoi2 gan2 di1 zi1 liu2, ceng2 dang2 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 系统正在读取数据，请稍等。
examples.english_sentence: The system is reading the data now; please wait a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部相機讀取唔到記憶卡，可能係卡壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 soeng1 gei1 duk6 ceoi2 m4 dou2 gei3 jik6 kaa1, ho2 nang4 hai6 kaa1 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 相机读取不到记忆卡，可能是卡坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The camera can't read the memory card; the card might be broken.

mandarin_meaning: 說黃色笑話或說露骨、猥褻的話（俚語）
english_meaning: to say dirty or explicit (sexual) remarks; to tell/offhandly read out erotic/dirty jokes (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「讀口黃」是香港廣東話口語俚語，指說黃色笑話或露骨、猥褻的話，通常帶有不雅或令人尷尬的語氣。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase meaning to utter or recite dirty/explicit (often sexual) remarks or jokes. It usually implies indecent or embarrassing speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日讀口黃，大家都覺得好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 duk6 hau2 wong4, daai6gaa1 dou1 gok3dek1 hou2 gaam1go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常說黃色笑話，大家都覺得很尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: He often tells dirty jokes; everyone finds it very awkward.

mandarin_meaning: 唇讀（通過觀察他人唇形來理解所說的話）
english_meaning: lip-reading; to read lips (understanding speech by watching mouth movements)
explanation_mandarin: 利用觀察說話者的唇形、口型和面部動作來推測或理解其語言內容，常用於聽力受損者或噪音環境下輔助手段。
explanation_english: The practice of understanding spoken words by observing a speaker's lip movements, mouth shapes, and facial cues; often used by people with hearing loss or as an aid in noisy situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽唔到，只可以靠讀唇嚟明白我講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 m4 dou2, zi2 ho2 ji5 kaau3 duk6 seon4 lai4 ming4 baak6 ngo5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽不到，只能靠讀唇來理解我說什麼。
examples.english_sentence: He can't hear; he can only rely on lip-reading to understand what I'm saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個學過讀唇，幫到啲聽障朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 hok6 gwo3 duk6 seon4, bong1 dou3 di1 teng1 zoeng3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候學過唇讀，可以幫助有聽力障礙的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I learned lip-reading when I was young; it can help friends with hearing impairments.

mandarin_meaning: 讀壞書 / 受壞影響；學壞
english_meaning: to be led astray by bad influences; to pick up bad habits or be corrupted
explanation_mandarin: 「讀壞書」原字面為「讀壞的書」，引申為受到不良影響或跟壞人學壞。常用於批評某人受壞影響或有不良行為傾向。
explanation_english: Literally 'read bad books', used idiomatically to mean being corrupted by bad influences or picking up bad habits (often from bad company or harmful content).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好畀啲細路讀壞書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bei2 di1 sai3 lou6 duk6 waai6 syu1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要讓那些小孩受到壞影響。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let the kids be influenced badly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日同啲壞朋友埋堆，真係讀壞書喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tung4 di1 waai6 pang4 jau5 maai4 deoi1, zan1 hai6 duk6 waai6 syu1 laa3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是和壞朋友混在一起，真是被帶壞了。
examples.english_sentence: He always hangs out with bad friends; he's really being led astray.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲網上內容好容易令年青人讀壞書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 mong5 soeng6 noi6 jung6 hou2 jung6 ji6 ling6 nin4 cing1 jan4 duk6 waai6 syu1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一些網上的內容很容易讓年輕人學壞。
examples.english_sentence: Some online content can easily lead young people astray.

mandarin_meaning: 读写障碍（指在阅读和/或书写方面存在持续且显著的神经性困难，常与学习障碍相关）
english_meaning: reading and writing disability; difficulty with reading and/or writing (a learning disorder, e.g., dyslexia/dysgraphia)
explanation_mandarin: 讀寫障礙是指個體在識字、閱讀理解或書寫表達方面持續存在顯著困難，通常不是由智力低下或感覺缺陷直接引起，常需專業評估與特別教育支持。
explanation_english: A persistent difficulty in reading, understanding written text, or written expression that is not primarily due to low intelligence or sensory impairments. It often requires professional assessment and specialized educational support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個時被診斷有讀寫障礙，需要特別教育支援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 si4 bei6 zan3 dyun6 jau5 duk6 se2 zoeng3 ngoi6, seoi1 jiu3 dak6 bit6 gaau3 juk6 zi1 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候被診斷有讀寫障礙，需要特殊教育支援。
examples.english_sentence: He was diagnosed with a reading and writing disability when he was young and needs special educational support.

mandarin_meaning: 念爛台詞 / 照稿念（俚語）
english_meaning: to read out canned or poorly written lines; to recite scripted nonsense (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 俚語，用來形容某人照本宣科、機械或無感情地念稿、念台詞或說出毫無內容的話，常用來批評主持人、演員或公眾人物的表現不自然或空洞。
explanation_english: A slang verb describing someone who mechanically or insincerely reads from a script or utters canned, meaningless lines. Often used to criticize anchors, actors, or public figures for delivering lines without feeling or originality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做主播好似淨係識讀屎片，冇感情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zyu2 bo3 hou2 ci5 zing6 hai6 sik1 duk6 si2 pin3, mou5 gam2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做主播好像只會照稿念，沒有感情。
examples.english_sentence: He seems like a news anchor who only reads canned scripts, with no emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺記者會度讀屎片，講真啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai6 gei3 ze2 wui2 dou6 duk6 si2 pin3, gong2 zan1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別在記者會上照稿念，講真一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't read canned lines at the press conference — be more genuine.

mandarin_meaning: 讀心術 / 讀心能力（看穿別人內心想法或推測他人心理的能力或技巧）
english_meaning: mind-reading; the ability or technique of discerning or predicting another person's thoughts or intentions (can be supernatural telepathy or practical psychological skill)
explanation_mandarin: 指能夠看穿或推測別人內心想法的能力或技巧。既可指超自然的心靈感應，也可指透過觀察與心理學推斷他人意圖的本領。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability or technique of perceiving or inferring someone else's thoughts. It can mean supernatural telepathy or practical skills based on observation and psychological inference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似有讀心術，成日都知道我諗緊乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 jau5 duk6 sam1 seot6, sing4 jat6 dou1 zi1 dou3 ngo5 lam2 gan2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像有讀心術，總是知道我在想什麼。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have mind-reading abilities; he always knows what I'm thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 魔術師話佢識讀心術，其實係用心理學同推理技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mo1 seot6 si1 gong2 keoi5 sik1 duk6 sam1 seot6, kei4 sat6 hai6 jung6 sam1 lei5 hok6 tung4 teoi1 lei5 gei6 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 魔術師說他會讀心術，其實是用心理學和推理技巧。
examples.english_sentence: The magician says he can read minds, but actually it's based on psychology and deduction skills.

mandarin_meaning: 朗讀或報出數字、報表數據；也可指計算、核對帳目
english_meaning: to read out numbers or figures; to report/count statistics; to calculate or check accounts
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指把數字或數據朗讀、報出或核對，也可指計算、整理帳目或匯報數字資訊。
explanation_english: Spoken Cantonese term meaning to read out or report numbers/figures; it can also mean to count, calculate, verify accounts, or present numeric data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會計要讀數，確保帳目冇錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 gai3 jiu3 duk6 sou3, kok3 bou2 zoeng3 muk6 mou5 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会计要把数字核对清楚，确保账目没有错误。
examples.english_sentence: The accountant needs to read/check the numbers to ensure the accounts are correct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫手讀數，講下本月銷售數字？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 duk6 sou3, gong2 haa6 bun2 jyut6 siu1 sau6 sou3 zi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以帮忙读数，讲一下本月的销售数字？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help read the numbers and tell me this month's sales figures?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 智能電表會自動讀數，方便電力公司計費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 nang4 din6 biu1 wui5 zi6 dung6 duk6 sou3, fong1 bin6 din6 lik6 gung1 si1 gai3 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 智能电表会自动读数，方便电力公司计费。
examples.english_sentence: Smart meters automatically read the usage, making it easy for the power company to bill.

mandarin_meaning: 读书 (dú shū)
english_meaning: to study; to read books; to attend school
explanation_mandarin: 表示閱讀書籍或接受學習、上學的行為。可指念書、學習或在學校就讀。
explanation_english: Refers to reading books or studying; can mean studying in general, reading, or attending school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家喺屋企讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 uk1 kei5 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在在家讀書。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying/reading at home right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你讀書讀到幾點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 duk6 syu1 duk6 dou3 gei2 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你讀書讀到幾點呀？
examples.english_sentence: Until what time will you study?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大學讀書。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is studying at university.

mandarin_meaning: 讀書人（dúshūrén）— 讀書的人；泛指學生、學者或有文化知識的人
english_meaning: scholar; learned person; someone who studies or is well-educated; a bookish person
explanation_mandarin: 指以讀書為主、接受過教育或有學問的人。可以指學生、學者或書生，有時帶有書卷氣或書生氣，語氣可中性或略帶褒義／描述性。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who reads and studies—someone educated, a student or scholar. It can imply a bookish or literary temperament; generally a neutral noun but can carry a mildly positive or descriptive tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個讀書人，成日對歷史好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 duk6 syu1 jan4, seng4 jat6 deoi3 lik6 si2 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一個讀書人，平時對歷史很有興趣。
examples.english_sentence: He is a scholarly person and is always very interested in history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係當佢係讀書人，佢其實都好擅長做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 dong3 keoi5 hai6 duk6 syu1 jan4, keoi5 kei4 sat6 dou1 hou2 sin6 coeng4 zou6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只把他當作讀書人，其實他也很會做生意。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just regard him as a bookish person—he's actually good at doing business.

jyutping: duk6 syu1 m4 sing4 saam1 daai6 hoi6
mandarin_meaning: 不讀書有三大害
english_meaning: Not studying brings three great harms
explanation_mandarin: 一句粵語俗語，用來提醒或警告年輕人不讀書會帶來三方面或三種主要的壞處（如前途受限、品行或社會適應受影響等），常用以催促孩子讀書。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb used to warn or remind young people that failing to study leads to three major harms (for example limited prospects, poor conduct, or difficulty adapting socially). Often used to urge children to study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日話：「讀書唔成三大害，快啲溫書啦！」
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 waa6: "duk6 syu1 m4 sing4 saam1 daai6 hoi6, faai3 di1 wan1 syu1 laa1!"
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽常說：「不讀書有三大害，快點複習吧！」
examples.english_sentence: My mom always says, "Not studying brings three great harms—hurry up and study!"

mandarin_meaning: 讀書會 (讀書會/讀書小組)
english_meaning: book club; study group
explanation_mandarin: 由一群人定期聚會，共同閱讀、討論書籍或進行學習交流的活動或組織。
explanation_english: A group of people who meet regularly to read, discuss books, or study together; a book club or study group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我逢星期三都去讀書會，今次喺度討論《小王子》。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fung4 sing1 kei4 saam1 dou1 heoi3 duk6 syu1 wui6, gam1 ci3 hai2 dou6 tou2 leon6 siu2 wong4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每星期三都去讀書會，這次在這裡討論《小王子》。
examples.english_sentence: I go to the book club every Wednesday; this time we're discussing "The Little Prince."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋讀書會每個月聚一次，一齊帶住自己鍾意嘅書去討論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 duk6 syu1 wui6 mui5 go3 jyut6 zeoi6 jat1 ci3, jat1 cai4 daai3 zyu6 zi6 gei2 zung1 ji3 ge3 syu1 heoi3 tou2 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們的讀書會每個月聚一次，大家一起帶著自己喜歡的書來討論。
examples.english_sentence: Our book club meets once a month; we each bring a book we like to discuss.

mandarin_meaning: 读本；教材；课本
english_meaning: reader; textbook; primer (a school book containing reading passages and exercises)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於教學或閱讀練習的書籍，常用於小學或語文課程，包含短文與練習題。
explanation_english: A book used for teaching reading or for classroom instruction—often a school reader or primer containing passages and exercises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師叫我哋買新嘅讀本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 maai5 san1 ge3 duk6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师叫我们买新的读本。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher told us to buy the new reader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢冊讀本收錄咗好多短文同練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 caak3 duk6 bun2 sau1 luk6 zo2 hou2 do1 dyun2 man4 tung4 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本读本收录了很多短文和练习。
examples.english_sentence: This reader contains many short passages and exercises.

mandarin_meaning: 死讀書（死记硬背，机械式学习）
english_meaning: to study mechanically/by rote; to cram; to be overly bookish and unable to apply knowledge
explanation_mandarin: 指按照書本機械地記憶或背誦知識而不理解或不會應用，含貶義。
explanation_english: Refers to learning mechanically from books—memorizing or cramming without understanding or applying knowledge; carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識讀死書，唔識應用知識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 duk6 sei2 syu1, m4 sik1 jing3 jung6 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只會死讀書，不會應用知識。
examples.english_sentence: He only crams from books and can't apply the knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前好多人都讀死書，希望考到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 duk6 sei2 syu1, hei1 mong6 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试前很多人都死读书，希望考到好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: Many people cram before exams hoping to get good grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係讀死書，要多做實踐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 duk6 sei2 syu1, jiu3 do1 zou6 sat6 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只死读书，要多做实践。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just memorize—do more practical work.

mandarin_meaning: 读熟；把内容读到熟悉或记牢
english_meaning: to read/study until familiar; to memorize or master by repeated reading
explanation_mandarin: 表示通过反复阅读或练习，把某些文字、内容弄得熟悉或记牢，常用于学习或准备考试、背诵等情境。
explanation_english: Indicates reading or practicing something repeatedly until it becomes familiar or memorized; commonly used in study, exam preparation, or memorization contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我未將呢篇文章讀熟，仲要再讀多幾次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mei6 zoeng1 ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 duk6 suk6, zung6 jiu3 zoi3 duk6 do1 gei2 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我還沒有把這篇文章讀熟，還要再讀多幾次。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't read this article thoroughly yet; I need to read it a few more times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前你要將筆記全部讀熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 nei5 jiu3 zoeng1 bat1 gei3 cyun4 bou6 duk6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試前你要把筆記全部讀熟。
examples.english_sentence: Before the exam you should memorize all your notes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經將歌詞讀熟，唱得好流暢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 go1 ci4 duk6 suk6, coeng3 dak1 hou2 lau4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經把歌詞讀熟，唱得很流暢。
examples.english_sentence: He has already memorized the lyrics and sings very smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 读物
english_meaning: reading material(s); literature; material for reading
explanation_mandarin: 指供閱讀的各類書籍或材料，如小說、教科書、雜誌、參考書等。
explanation_english: Materials intended for reading, such as books, magazines, textbooks, and other literature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校圖書館有好多適合學生嘅讀物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 tou4 syu1 gun2 jau5 hou2 do1 sik1 hap6 hok6 saang1 ge3 duk6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校图书馆有很多适合学生的读物。
examples.english_sentence: The school library has many reading materials suitable for students.

mandarin_meaning: 博覽群書、讀得很多並且很熟悉文字
english_meaning: to be very well-read; to have read extensively and be very familiar with texts/characters
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面上指把字都讀破了，意指讀書很多、學問淵博或對文字典籍非常熟悉。通常用來稱讚某人博學或閱歷豐富。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'read until the characters are worn out.' It describes someone who has read extensively and is very knowledgeable or well-versed in literature and texts. Often used to praise someone's broad learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀破字膽，喺文史方面好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 po3 zi6 daam2, hai2 man4 si2 fong1 min6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他博覽群書，在文史方面很厲害。
examples.english_sentence: He is well-read; he's very good in literature and history.

mandarin_meaning: 读者 (dúzhě)
english_meaning: reader; readership
explanation_mandarin: 指阅读书籍、报刊等的人；也可以指某一出版物的读者群体。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who reads books, newspapers, articles, etc.; can also mean the readership or audience of a publication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本雜誌嘅讀者越嚟越多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 zaap6 zi3 ge3 duk6 ze2 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本杂志的读者越来越多。
examples.english_sentence: The readers of this magazine are increasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作家喺書展同讀者見面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 gaa1 hai2 syu1 zin2 tung4 duk6 ze2 gin3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作家在书展与读者见面。
examples.english_sentence: The author met with readers at the book fair.

mandarin_meaning: 读唇（用看唇形和口型理解對方語言）
english_meaning: lip-reading; to read lips (understand speech by watching lip movements)
explanation_mandarin: 通過觀察對方的唇形、口型和面部表情來推測或理解其所說的話，常用於聽力受損者或需要在靜默環境下溝通時。
explanation_english: The act of understanding spoken language by watching a speaker's lip movements, mouth shapes, and facial expressions; commonly used by people with hearing loss or when verbal speech cannot be heard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽聽唔到，佢靠讀脣同人溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 teng1 m4 dou3, keoi5 kaau3 duk6 seon4 tung4 jan4 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈听不到，她靠读唇跟人沟通。
examples.english_sentence: My mother is deaf; she relies on lip-reading to communicate with people.

mandarin_meaning: 以讀書／學識勝過別人；在學業或論戰上勝出
english_meaning: to outstudy someone; to beat others academically or win by having more knowledge
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法（常見於粵語）：指透過讀書、溫習或憑學識在考試、比賽或爭論中勝過別人。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to surpass others by studying or by having greater knowledge, e.g. winning in exams, competitions, or arguments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想淨係打機，仲想讀贏班同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zing6 hai6 daa2 gei1, zung6 soeng2 duk6 jing4 baan1 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想只玩遊戲，還想在讀書上超過同學。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to just play games; I also want to outstudy my classmates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想喺考試入面有好成績，就要早啲開始溫書，爭取讀贏其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 hai2 haau2 si3 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 sing4 zik1, zau6 jiu3 zou2 di1 hoi1 ci2 wan1 syu1, zang1 ceoi2 duk6 jing4 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想在考試中有好成績，就要早點開始複習，努力讀書以超過其他人。
examples.english_sentence: If you want good exam results, start revising early and work hard to outstudy others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講佢係學霸，話自己可以讀贏晒成班人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 keoi5 hai6 hok6 baa1, waa6 zi6 gei2 ho2 ji5 duk6 jing4 saai3 sing4 baan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常說自己是學霸，能讀贏整個班的人。
examples.english_sentence: He often says he's a top student and can outstudy the whole class.

mandarin_meaning: 读音（dúyīn）
english_meaning: pronunciation; the way a character or word is pronounced
explanation_mandarin: 指字或詞的發音方式，通常用來描述漢字或詞語在某種方言或語言中的讀法。
explanation_english: Refers to the pronunciation of a character or word, describing how a character or term is read in a particular dialect or language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字嘅讀音係點？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 ge3 duk6 jam1 hai6 dim2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字的读音是什么？
examples.english_sentence: What's the pronunciation of this character?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個讀音同普通話唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 duk6 jam1 tung4 pou2 tung1 waa2 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 它的读音和普通话不同。
examples.english_sentence: Its pronunciation is different from Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本字典有每個字嘅讀音同例句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 zi6 din2 jau5 mui5 go3 zi6 ge3 duk6 jam1 tung4 lai6 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本字典有每个字的读音和例句。
examples.english_sentence: This dictionary provides pronunciations and example sentences for each character.

mandarin_meaning: 默读；默默地阅读或默念以便记忆
english_meaning: to read silently; to silently recite or study to memorize
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，指不出聲地閱讀或默念以便記住內容，常用於溫習或準備考試時。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to read or recite silently to commit material to memory, commonly used when studying or preparing for exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家要讀默，唔好吵我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 duk6 mak6, m4 hou2 caau2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在要默读，不要吵我。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to read/study silently now — please don't disturb me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前最好多啲讀默，加強記憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 zeoi3 hou2 do1 di1 duk6 mak6, gaa1 koeng4 gei3 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试前最好多做默读，增强记忆。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to do more silent reading before the exam to strengthen memory.

mandarin_meaning: 變 / 變化 / 變得 (biàn)
english_meaning: to change; to become; to turn into
explanation_mandarin: 表示改變、轉變或成為某種狀態，可作動詞，亦常與其他字構成詞語（如變成、變得、變化）。
explanation_english: Indicates change, transformation, or becoming a different state. Used as a verb and commonly appears in compounds (e.g., become, change, transform).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣變咗，好快就落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 bin3 zo2, hou2 faai3 zau6 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣變了，很快就要下雨。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has changed; it will rain soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢變得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bin3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他變得很開心。
examples.english_sentence: He has become very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂變主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 bin3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要隨便改變主意。
examples.english_sentence: Don't change your mind randomly.

mandarin_meaning: 变成；成为
english_meaning: to become; to change into
explanation_mandarin: 表示由一种状态、身份或形态改变为另一种，常用于描述变化或转变。
explanation_english: Indicates a change of state, identity, or form into something else; used to describe transformation or becoming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢變做醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bin3 zou6 ji1 sang1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他变成医生。
examples.english_sentence: He became a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間餐廳變做書店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 bin3 zou6 syu1 dim3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅变成了书店。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant turned into a bookstore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為失戀，心情變做灰暗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sat1 lyun2, sam1 cing4 bin3 zou6 fui1 aam3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为失恋，心情变得灰暗。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the breakup, his mood became gloomy.

mandarin_meaning: 变动（变化、变更）
english_meaning: change; fluctuation; alteration
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物發生變化或改動，可作動詞或名詞，常用於描述政策、市場、數量等的變化或波動，語氣較正式。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has changed or been altered; can function as a verb or a noun. Commonly used in formal or written contexts to describe changes or fluctuations in policies, markets, numbers, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司政策有變動，員工要注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zing3 caak3 jau5 bin3 dung6, jyun4 gung1 jiu3 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司政策有变动，员工要注意。
examples.english_sentence: There are changes in company policy; employees should pay attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近市場變動好大，投資者要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 si5 coeng4 bin3 dung6 hou2 daai6, tau4 zi1 ze2 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近市场变动很大，投资者要小心。
examples.english_sentence: The market has been fluctuating a lot recently; investors should be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 变化；变更
english_meaning: change; variation; to change
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物的改变或变动，也可作动词，表示使发生变化或变化的过程。
explanation_english: Refers to a change or variation; can also be used as a verb meaning to change or undergo change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近天氣變化好大，記得帶埋件外套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 bin3 faa3 hou2 daai6, gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 gin6 ngoi6 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气变化很大，记得带上外套。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been changing a lot recently; remember to bring a jacket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工作上嘅變化令佢有啲緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 zok3 soeng6 ge3 bin3 faa3 ling6 keoi5 jau5 di1 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作上的变化让他有点紧张。
examples.english_sentence: Changes at work made him a bit nervous.

mandarin_meaning: 变化多端；多变且难以预测
english_meaning: very changeable; full of twists and turns; unpredictable
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或情况经常发生变化，变化多且难以捉摸。
explanation_english: Describes something that changes frequently and unpredictably; full of variations and hard to anticipate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣最近變化多端，出門記得帶埋雨傘同外套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 zeoi3 gan6 bin3 faa3 do1 dyun1, ceot1 mun4 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 jyu5 saan3 tung4 ngoi6 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气变化多端，出门记得带伞和外套。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been very changeable lately — remember to take an umbrella and a jacket when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 变卦（改变主意、食言、反悔）
english_meaning: to back out; to renege; to change one's mind or go back on a promise
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，原指卜筮時卦象變化，引申為改變原先承諾或決定、反悔或食言。
explanation_english: Colloquial term originally from divination (changing hexagrams); now used to mean changing one's decision or going back on a promise/reneging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次又變卦，唔肯出手買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 jau6 bin3 gwaa3, m4 hang2 ceot1 sau2 maai5 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次又变卦，不肯出手买房。
examples.english_sentence: He backed out again this time and won't go through with buying the flat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好變卦，答應咗要幫手就做埋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bin3 gwaa3, daap3 jing6 zo2 jiu3 bong1 sau2 zau6 zou6 maai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要变卦，答应了要帮忙就把事情做完。
examples.english_sentence: Don't go back on your word; if you agreed to help, finish the task.

mandarin_meaning: 变压；（常作「变压器」的简称）变压器；改变电压
english_meaning: voltage conversion; transformer (power adapter); to change/convert voltage
explanation_mandarin: 可作名詞，指變壓器（電源轉換器、電源適配器）的簡稱；也可作動詞，指改變電壓的行為或過程。
explanation_english: As a noun, it is often an abbreviation of 變壓器 (transformer / power adapter / voltage converter). As a verb, it means to change or convert voltage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個變壓唔掂，成部機都冇電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bin3 aat3 m4 dim6, seng4 bou6 gei1 dou1 mou5 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 變壓器出了問題，整台機器都沒有電。
examples.english_sentence: The transformer is faulty; the whole machine has no power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂變壓，會燒壞啲電器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 bin3 aat3, wui5 siu1 waai6 di1 din6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要隨便改變電壓，會把電器燒壞。
examples.english_sentence: Don't change the voltage randomly; it can fry the appliances.

mandarin_meaning: 变压器 (biànyāqì)
english_meaning: transformer (electrical device that changes voltage)
explanation_mandarin: 用來改變交流電壓的電氣設備，常見於電力系統、配電箱及電子裝置中，用以升高或降低電壓。
explanation_english: An electrical device that transfers electrical energy between circuits and changes voltage levels, commonly used in power distribution and electronic equipment to step voltage up or down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部變壓器壞咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 bin3 aat3 hei3 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 變壓器壞了，要換一個。
examples.english_sentence: The transformer is broken and needs to be replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座大廈嘅變壓器容量唔夠，要升級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 daai6 haa6 ge3 bin3 aat3 hei3 jung4 loeng6 m4 gau3, jiu3 sing1 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這棟大廈的變壓器容量不夠，要升級。
examples.english_sentence: The building's transformer capacity is insufficient and needs to be upgraded.

mandarin_meaning: 變壓站 / 變電站（變壓器或變電設備的場所）
english_meaning: transformer station; electrical substation
explanation_mandarin: 指用來調整或變換電壓的設施或場所，通常為電力系統中的變壓器或變電設備所在之處，用以配電或升降電壓。
explanation_english: Refers to a facility or site where voltage is transformed or adjusted—typically where transformers or substation equipment are located for distributing or stepping voltage up/down in the power grid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企隔離有個變壓站，間唔中會聽到維修嘅聲音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 gaak3 lei4 jau5 go3 bin3 aat3 zaam6, gaan1 m4 zung1 wui5 teng1 dou3 wai4 sau1 ge3 sing1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家隔壁有一個變壓站，偶爾會聽到維修的聲音。
examples.english_sentence: There is a transformer station next to my home; occasionally you can hear maintenance noises.

mandarin_meaning: （1）天氣發生變化；（2）比喻局勢、政權或情況出現重大轉變
english_meaning: 1) a change in the weather; 2) metaphorically, a major change in situation, regime, or circumstances
explanation_mandarin: 口語常用詞，既可指實際的天氣變化，也常用作比喻，指政治或局勢等出現重大轉變。
explanation_english: A colloquial expression used literally for changes in the weather and figuratively to indicate a major shift in politics, power, or general situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚開始會變天，記得帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hoi1 ci2 wui5 bin3 tin1, gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚開始會變天，記得帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: The weather will change starting tonight — remember to bring an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果選舉結果出乎意料，政局可能會變天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 syun2 geoi2 git3 gwo2 ceot1 fu1 ji3 liu6, zing3 guk6 ho2 nang4 wui5 bin3 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果選舉結果出乎意料，政局可能會變天。
examples.english_sentence: If the election result is unexpected, the political situation could change drastically.

mandarin_meaning: 变奏
english_meaning: variation (musical) / variation
explanation_mandarin: 在音樂中指在主題基礎上對旋律、和聲、節奏等進行變化的手法或作品；也可泛指對事物的變體或變通。
explanation_english: In music, a variation on a theme — altering melody, harmony, rhythm, or other elements; can also be used more generally for a variant or alteration of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次音樂會有一段鋼琴嘅變奏，聽落好有趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jam1 ngok6 wui2 jau5 jat1 dyun6 gong3 kam4 ge3 bin3 zau3, teng1 lok6 hou2 jau5 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次音乐会有一段钢琴的变奏，听起来很有趣。
examples.english_sentence: There was a piano variation in this concert; it sounded very interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將首歌做咗幾個變奏版，逐個版本風格都唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 sau2 go1 zou6 zo2 gei2 go3 bin3 zau3 baan2, zuk6 go3 baan2 bun2 fung1 gaak3 dou1 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把这首歌做了好几个变奏版本，每个版本的风格都不同。
examples.english_sentence: He made several variations of the song; each version had a different style.

mandarin_meaning: 变幻 (biànhuàn)：变化、变换，常指事物无常或多变
english_meaning: changeable; ever-changing; to change or transform, often unpredictably
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物經常變化或變化無常，也可指把一種形態改變成另一種形態。
explanation_english: Indicates that something changes frequently or unpredictably; can also mean transforming one form into another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣成日變幻，出門記得帶把遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 sing4 jat6 bin3 wun6, ceot1 mun4 gei3 dak1 daai3 baa2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气经常变幻，出门记得带把伞。
examples.english_sentence: The weather keeps changing; remember to bring an umbrella when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個心情變幻不定，大家都唔知點安慰佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sam1 cing4 bin3 wun6 bat1 ding6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 on1 wai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的心情变幻不定，大家都不知道怎么安慰他。
examples.english_sentence: His mood is changeable and unpredictable; everyone doesn't know how to comfort him.

mandarin_meaning: 變化無常，難以預測或捉摸
english_meaning: ever-changing and unpredictable; hard to fathom or predict
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物、情況或人的行為變化多端，難以預料或捉摸。
explanation_english: Describes a situation, thing, or person's behavior that changes constantly and is difficult to predict or grasp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅性格變幻莫測，大家都唔知佢下一步會點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing3gok3 bin3 waan6 mok6 cak1, daai6gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 haa6 jat1 bou6 wui5 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格變化莫測，大家都不知道他下一步會怎麼做。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is unpredictable; nobody knows what he'll do next.

mandarin_meaning: 变形（指形狀改變或從一種形態轉換為另一種形態）
english_meaning: to change shape; to deform; to transform (change from one form to another)
explanation_mandarin: 指物體的形狀發生改變或扭曲；也可指事物從一種型態轉換成另一種型態（例如玩具或機械的變形）。
explanation_english: Refers to a change or distortion of shape, or a transformation from one form to another (e.g., a toy transforming into a robot).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張紙濕咗之後變形咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 zi2 sap1 zo2 zi1 hau6 bin3 jing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那張紙濕了之後變形了。
examples.english_sentence: The paper got wet and became deformed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻玩具可以變形做機械人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 waan2 geoi6 ho2 ji5 bin3 jing4 zou6 gei1 haai6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個玩具可以變成機器人。
examples.english_sentence: This toy can transform into a robot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔好好保養，車身會變形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 hou2 hou2 bou2 joeng5, ce1 san1 wui5 bin3 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不保養，車身會變形。
examples.english_sentence: If not properly maintained, the car body will deform.

mandarin_meaning: 变心 (biàn xīn)
english_meaning: to change one's mind or feelings; to fall out of love; to become unfaithful
explanation_mandarin: 表示改變心意或感情，常用於情感關係中，意指對某人失去愛意或變得不忠。
explanation_english: Means to change one's mind or feelings, often used in romantic contexts to indicate falling out of love or becoming unfaithful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢變心唔鍾意我喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bin3 sam1 m4 zung1 ji3 ngo5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她变心，不再喜欢我了。
examples.english_sentence: He/she has changed their mind and doesn't like me anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出咗軌，變心咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 zo2 gwai2, bin3 sam1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出轨，变心了。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated and changed his feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講真，如果對方變心，就唔好再拖住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 zan1, jyu4 gwo2 deoi3 fong1 bin3 sam1, zau6 m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说真的，如果对方变心，就不要再拖着他/她。
examples.english_sentence: Honestly, if the other person changes their feelings, don't keep holding onto them.

mandarin_meaning: 变性（改变生理性别或进行性别重置）
english_meaning: to change sex; sex reassignment (the process or act of changing one's biological sex)
explanation_mandarin: 指改變生理性別或透過手術、荷爾蒙療法等方式進行性別重置的行為或過程；在語境中可作動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to changing one's biological sex or undergoing gender reassignment procedures (such as surgery or hormone therapy). Can be used as a verb or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗變性手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 bin3sing3 sau2seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她做了变性手术。
examples.english_sentence: They had sex reassignment surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 变态（對行為或性傾向異常的人或行為的貶義稱呼）
english_meaning: pervert; abnormal; perverted (used as a noun or adjective, often derogatory or slang)
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語口語或俚語中，「變態」用來形容行為或想法非常怪異、異常，或有性方面的變態傾向；可作形容詞或名詞，語氣通常帶貶義或戲謔成分。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial/slang usage, '變態' describes behavior or thoughts that are abnormal or sexually perverted. It can be used as an adjective or noun and is typically derogatory or used jokingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好變態，成日喺地鐵度偷睇人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 bin3 taai3, seng4 jat6 hai2 dei6 tit3 dou6 tau1 tai2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很变态，经常在地铁上偷看别人。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a pervert, always peeking at people on the subway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講好似有啲變態喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 bin3 taai3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样说好像有点变态哦。
examples.english_sentence: Saying that sounds kind of perverted/weird.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個變態，唔好單獨同佢一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 bin3 taai3, m4 hou2 daan1 duk6 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个变态，别单独和他在一起。
examples.english_sentence: He's a pervert; don't be alone with him.

mandarin_meaning: （粤语）对男性变态或好色男子的贬称，相当于“变态”或“色狼”。
english_meaning: A pejorative slang term for a male pervert or creepy, lecherous man; 'pervert' or 'creep'.
explanation_mandarin: 用於廣東話的口語侮辱詞，指行為或舉止有性騷擾傾向、令人不舒服的男子。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial insult used to describe a man who behaves in a sexually inappropriate, creepy, or harassing way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日喺港鐵見到啲變態佬，令人好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 jat6 hai2 gong2 tit3 gin3 dou2 di1 bin3 taai3 lou2, ling6 jan4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总是在地铁看到一些变态佬，让人很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I keep seeing perverts on the MTR; it's really unsettling.

mandarin_meaning: 變態的女人／怪異、猥褻的女人（貶義、口語）
english_meaning: a perverted/creepy woman (derogatory slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語粗俗用語，用來形容行為或舉止有性騷擾、古怪或令人不舒服的女人。屬於口語、貶義用法，不禮貌，常用作辱罵或批評。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang insult for a woman who behaves in a perverted, creepy, or otherwise unsettling way. Informal and derogatory — offensive and typically used to criticize or insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺樓下偷望啲女住客，真係變態婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 lau4 haa6 tau1 mong6 di1 neoi5 zyu6 haak3, zan1 hai6 bin3 taai3 po4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她老是在樓下偷看女住戶，真是個變態女人。
examples.english_sentence: She always sneaks looks at the female tenants downstairs; she's really a perverted woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝喺巴士上有個變態婆用手機偷拍，大家都好反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 hai2 baa1 si2 soeng6 jau5 go3 bin3 taai3 po4 jung6 sau2 gei1 tau1 paak3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上在公車上有個變態女人用手機偷拍，大家都很反感。
examples.english_sentence: This morning on the bus there was a perverted woman secretly filming with her phone; everyone felt disgusted.

mandarin_meaning: 变成 (biànchéng)：变为；成为
english_meaning: to become; to turn into; to change into
explanation_mandarin: 表示由一種狀態或事物轉變為另一種狀態或事物。
explanation_english: Indicates that something changes into a different state or becomes something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊冰變成水喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 bing1 bin3 sing4 seoi2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊冰變成水了。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of ice has turned into water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一夜之間變成咗一個名人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 je6 zi1 gaan1 bin3 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 ming4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一夜之間變成了一個名人。
examples.english_sentence: He became a celebrity overnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細小嘅錯誤如果唔即刻處理，可能會變成大問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 siu2 ge3 co3 ng6 jyu4 gwo2 m4 zik1 hak1 cyu3 lei5, ho2 nang4 wui5 bin3 sing4 daai6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小錯誤如果不及時處理，可能會變成大問題。
examples.english_sentence: Small mistakes, if not handled promptly, can become big problems.

mandarin_meaning: 变换 (表示改变、转换)
english_meaning: change; transform; convert; variation
explanation_mandarin: 表示使某種狀態、形式或性質發生改變或轉換，既可指外在形態的變更，也可指功能或數值的轉換。
explanation_english: Indicates causing a state, form, or property to change or be transformed; can refer to changes in appearance, function, or values.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣經常變換，要帶埋雨具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 ging1 soeng4 bin3 wun6, jiu3 daai3 maai4 jyu5 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣經常變化，要帶雨具。
examples.english_sentence: The weather changes frequently; bring rain gear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程式可以變換顏色同大小，方便自訂界面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ho2 ji5 bin3 wun6 ngaan4 sik1 tung4 daai6 siu2, fong1 bin6 zi6 deng6 gaai3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序可以变换颜色和大小，方便自定界面。
examples.english_sentence: This program can change colors and sizes, making it easy to customize the interface.

mandarin_meaning: 變故（指突發的意外或不幸事件）
english_meaning: an unexpected incident or mishap; a sudden misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 指突發的、不幸或意外的事件，常用來形容家庭、工作或生活中發生的變化或事故，帶有不利或令人擔憂的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to a sudden, often unfortunate or unexpected event; commonly used to describe accidents or abrupt misfortunes affecting family, work, or life situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然遇到咗一啲家庭變故，所以要請假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 jyu6 dou3 zo2 jat1 di1 gaa1 ting4 bin3 gu3, so2 ji5 jiu3 cing2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然遇到了家庭變故，所以要請假。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly experienced a family mishap, so he needs to take leave.

mandarin_meaning: 變數（變量）
english_meaning: variable (a quantity that can change or take different values)
explanation_mandarin: 在數學、統計、科學或程式設計中，表示可以改變或取不同數值或類型的量，常用於表示會影響結果或被研究的量。
explanation_english: In mathematics, statistics, science, or programming, a quantity that can change or take different values or types; used to represent values that affect outcomes or are studied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺程式設計入面，變數用嚟儲存數值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 cing4 sik1 cit3 gai3 jap6 min6, bin3 sou3 jung6 lai4 cyu5 cyun4 sou3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在程式設計中，變數用來儲存數值。
examples.english_sentence: In programming, variables are used to store values.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺統計學上，我哋會研究自變數同應變數之間嘅關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 tung2 gai3 hok6 seong6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 jin4 gau3 zi6 bin3 sou3 tung4 jing3 bin3 sou3 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在統計學上，我們會研究自變數和應變數之間的關係。
examples.english_sentence: In statistics, we study the relationship between independent variables and dependent variables.

mandarin_meaning: 变更（更改、修改）
english_meaning: to change; to alter; a change or modification
explanation_mandarin: 表示改變、調整或修改，常用於指文件、合約、安排或制度等方面的變動。
explanation_english: Indicates changing or modifying something; commonly used for alterations to documents, contracts, arrangements, or systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要變更合約條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 bin3 geng1 hap6 joek3 tiu4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要變更合約條款。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to change the contract terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次變更會喺下個月生效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 bin3 geng1 wui5 hai2 haa6 go3 jyut6 saang1 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次變更會在下個月生效。
examples.english_sentence: This change will take effect next month.

mandarin_meaning: 變本加厲（biànběn jiālì）：事情或行為比原來更嚴重、更過分
english_meaning: To become increasingly severe, intense, or excessive; to escalate or worsen compared with before.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容情況或行為比之前更惡化、更加嚴重或過分，常帶有負面含義。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or behavior that worsens or escalates beyond what it was before, usually with a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從投訴冇人理之後，對方反而變本加厲，不斷發短訊騷擾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 tau4 sou3 mou5 jan4 lei5 zi1 hau6, deoi3 fong1 faan2 ji4 bin3 bun2 gaa1 lai6, bat1 dyun6 faat3 dyun2 seon3 sou1 jiu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從投訴沒人理之後，對方反而變本加厲，不斷發短信騷擾我。
examples.english_sentence: Since nobody responded to the complaint, the other party escalated their behavior and kept sending harassing text messages to me.

mandarin_meaning: 把資產或價值轉換成現金（或將某種價值貨幣化）
english_meaning: to realize (an asset) into cash; to cash out; to monetize
explanation_mandarin: 指把有價值的東西（如資產、股票、無形資產或興趣）轉換成現金，或以貨幣形式實現其價值。
explanation_english: Refers to converting an asset or value into cash, or otherwise monetizing something (turning its value into money).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將股票變現，趁市勢好賣出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 gu2 piu3 bin3 jin6, can3 si5 sai3 hou2 maai6 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把股票變現，趁市勢好賣出。
examples.english_sentence: I want to cash out my stocks while the market is strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司需要變現資產嚟支付營運資金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 bin3 jin6 zi1 caan2 lai4 zi1 fu6 jing4 wan6 zi1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司需要變現資產來支付營運資金。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to realize assets to pay for operating funds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢透過網店將興趣變現，賺埋外快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau3 gwo3 mong5 dim3 zoeng1 hing3 ceoi3 bin3 jin6, zaan6 maai4 ngoi6 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他透過網店把興趣變現，賺點外快。
examples.english_sentence: He monetized his hobby through an online shop and earned some extra money.

mandarin_meaning: 变异（指形态、性质或基因等发生改变）
english_meaning: variation; mutation (a change in form, nature, or genetic information)
explanation_mandarin: 指事物或生物在形态、性质或基因等方面发生改变，常用于遗传学、流行病学或一般变化的描述。
explanation_english: Refers to a change or alteration in form, nature, or genetic material; commonly used in genetics, epidemiology, or to describe general variations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近個病毒出現咗新嘅變異株，傳染力好似提高咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 go3 beng6 duk6 ceot1 jin2 zo2 san1 ge3 bin3 ji6 zuk1, cyun4 jim6 lik6 hou2 ci5 tai4 gou1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近这个病毒出现了新的变异株，传染力似乎提高了。
examples.english_sentence: Recently the virus has developed a new variant that appears to be more transmissible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個變異可能係因為基因突變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bin3 ji6 ho2 nang4 hai6 jan1 wai6 gei1 jan1 dat6 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个变异可能是因为基因突变。
examples.english_sentence: This variation may be caused by a genetic mutation.

mandarin_meaning: 变相（以另一种形式或间接的方式）
english_meaning: in a disguised form; indirectly; 'in effect' (done in an indirect or disguised way)
explanation_mandarin: 表示以另一種形式或間接的方式做某事，常含有實際上是某種行為但表面上掩飾的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something in an indirect or disguised way; often means 'in effect' or 'in practice' when the real action is masked by another form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府變相加稅，市民好唔滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 bin3 soeng1 gaa1 seoi3, si5 man4 hou2 m4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府变相加税，市民很不满。
examples.english_sentence: The government has effectively raised taxes, and the citizens are very dissatisfied.

mandarin_meaning: （設備）變磚 / 變成磚頭（指電子設備因刷機、升級或故障而無法使用）
english_meaning: to brick (a device) — to render an electronic device unusable, usually after a failed flash/update or severe software error
explanation_mandarin: 「變磚」是香港粵語俗語，指電子設備（如手機、路由器、平板等）因刷機、更新或系統錯誤而變得無法開機或無法使用，形同一塊磚頭。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning an electronic device has become unusable (like a brick), typically after a failed firmware flash, update, or catastrophic software error.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱刷機失敗，部電話變磚咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 caat3 gei1 sat1 baai6, bou6 din6 waa2 bin3 zyun1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛刷機失敗，手機變磚了。
examples.english_sentence: I just failed flashing my phone; it got bricked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂升級手機，驚會變磚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 sing1 kap1 sau2 gei1, geng1 wui5 bin3 zyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要隨便升級手機，怕會變磚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't randomly upgrade your phone; it might get bricked.

mandarin_meaning: 变种（指由原有類型變化出來的新類型，亦可貶義指怪異的人）
english_meaning: variant; mutation; a mutated form (also used derogatorily to call someone a freak/weirdo)
explanation_mandarin: 指經過變化產生的新類型，可用於病毒、物種或作貶義形容怪異的人或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to a new type produced by change (a variant or mutation). Used for viruses, species, or figuratively as a derogatory term for someone unusual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新冠病毒出現咗好多變種，要小心防疫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 gwan1 beng6 duk6 ceot1 jin2 zo2 hou2 do1 bin3 zung2, jiu3 siu2 sam1 fong4 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新冠病毒出现了很多变种，要小心防疫。
examples.english_sentence: Many variants of the coronavirus have appeared; be careful with prevention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成個人好怪，好似變種咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 go3 jan4 hou2 gwaai3, hou2 ci5 bin3 zung2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整個人很怪，好像變種一樣。
examples.english_sentence: He's really strange, like a freak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲科學家發現咗一個植物嘅變種，外形同顏色都有所不同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo1 hok6 gaa1 faat3 jin6 zo2 jat1 go3 zik6 mat6 ge3 bin3 zung2, ngoi6 jing4 tung4 ngaan4 sik1 dou1 jau5 so2 bat1 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学家发现了一个植物的变种，外形和颜色都有所不同。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists discovered a variant of a plant; its appearance and color are different.

mandarin_meaning: 變節（背叛、叛變，投向對立一方）
english_meaning: to betray one's cause or allies; to defect; to turn traitor
explanation_mandarin: 指背棄原有的立場、信念、承諾或組織，轉而投向對立或敵對的一方，多含強烈的道德或政治指責意味。
explanation_english: Refers to abandoning one's original position, beliefs, promises, or organization and turning to the opposing side; often carries strong moral or political condemnation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當年為咗利益變節，加入咗敵對陣營。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1 nin4 wai6 zo2 lei6 jik6 bin3 zit3, gaa1 jap6 zo2 dik6 deoi3 zan6 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當年為了利益變節，加入了敵對陣營。
examples.english_sentence: He betrayed his side back then for personal gain and joined the opposing camp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果被人話你變節，通常係指你背棄咗以前嘅承諾或信念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 bei6 jan4 waa6 nei5 bin3 zit3, tung1 soeng4 hai6 zi2 nei5 bui3 hei3 zo2 ji5 cin4 ge3 sing4 nok6 waak6 seon3 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有人說你變節，通常是指你背棄了以前的承諾或信念。
examples.english_sentence: If someone calls you a traitor, it usually means you've abandoned previous promises or beliefs.

mandarin_meaning: 变声；声音变化（如青春期或人为改变声音）
english_meaning: voice change; to change one's voice; voice break (puberty); to disguise or modify the voice
explanation_mandarin: 指聲音的變化或改變，可指青春期的聲音變化（變聲期），亦可指透過工具或技巧改變聲音以偽裝或搞笑。
explanation_english: Refers to a change or alteration of the voice. It can mean the natural voice change during puberty (voice breaking), or intentionally modifying the voice using devices or techniques to disguise or create effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候變聲，好唔習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 bin3 seng1, hou2 m4 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小的時候變聲，很不習慣。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child I went through a voice change and wasn't used to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打電話用變聲器嚟搞笑？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 din6 waa2 jung6 bin3 seng1 hei3 lai4 gaau2 siu3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打電話用變聲器來搞笑？
examples.english_sentence: Are you using a voice changer on the phone to make a joke?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家喺青春期，變聲好明顯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 cing1 ceon1 kei4, bin3 seng1 hou2 ming4 hin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在正值青春期，變聲很明顯。
examples.english_sentence: He's now in puberty and the voice change is very obvious.

mandarin_meaning: 变脸（原指川剧中快速更换脸谱，后引申为人的表情或态度突然改变）
english_meaning: to change one's facial expression quickly; to suddenly change one's mood, attitude, or stance (originally the Sichuan opera 'face-changing' technique)
explanation_mandarin: “變臉”原指川劇演員快速更換臉譜的表演技巧，後來引申為人面部表情或態度瞬間改變，有時帶有翻臉或態度突然冷淡的意思。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the Sichuan opera technique of rapidly changing painted masks. Figuratively, it means someone's facial expression or attitude changes suddenly, often implying a sudden turn cold or hostile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到嗰個消息就變臉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 go2 siu1 sik1 zau6 bin3 lim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到那个消息就变脸。
examples.english_sentence: He changed his expression as soon as he heard the news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 川劇嘅變臉技巧好神奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun1 kek6 ge3 bin3 lim5 gei6 haau6 hou2 san4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 川剧的变脸技巧很神奇。
examples.english_sentence: The face-changing technique in Sichuan opera is amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對我變臉，唔知佢發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 ngo5 bin3 lim5, m4 zi1 keoi5 faat3 saang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常对我变脸，不知道他发生什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He often changes his attitude toward me; I don't know what's wrong with him.

mandarin_meaning: 变色（指顏色改變或臉色/表情突然改變）
english_meaning: to change color; to change (one's) facial expression — e.g. turn pale, flush, or show sudden shock/anger
explanation_mandarin: 可以指物體顏色發生變化，也常用來描述人的臉色或表情因驚訝、害怕、生氣等而突然改變。
explanation_english: Can mean a physical change in color (of an object) or, more commonly, a sudden change in a person's facial expression or complexion due to shock, fear, anger, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到呢個消息，臉色即刻變色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1, lim5 sik1 zik1 haak1 bin3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到這個消息，臉色立刻變了。
examples.english_sentence: He heard the news and his face immediately changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲顏料遇熱會變色，要小心保存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 ngaan4 liu6 jyu6 jit6 wui5 bin3 sik1, jiu3 siu2 sam1 bou2 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些顏料遇熱會變色，要小心保存。
examples.english_sentence: Some pigments change color when heated; they should be stored carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到人哋咁鬧，面都變色晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 jan4 dei6 gam2 naau6, min6 dou1 bin3 sik1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一聽到別人這麼罵，臉色都變了。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard people scolding him like that, his face visibly changed.

mandarin_meaning: 变色龙（字面：会变色的蜥蜴；引申：比喻立场或态度随情势变化、见风转舵的人）
english_meaning: Chameleon (literal); figuratively, a person who frequently changes opinions or behavior to suit circumstances — an opportunist or someone unprincipled/inconsistent.
explanation_mandarin: 原指一種可以改變體色的爬行動物；在口語中常用來比喻那些立場、態度或說法隨情勢改變、缺乏定性的人，語氣常帶貶義。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the reptile that changes color; colloquially used to describe a person whose stance or behavior shifts with circumstances — someone fickle or opportunistic. Often carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個政客講嘅嘢日日轉，真係一個變色龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 zing3 haak3 gong2 ge3 je5 jat6 jat6 zyun2, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 bin3 sik1 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個政客每天說的話都在變，真是一個變色龍。
examples.english_sentence: That politician changes what he says every day; he's really a chameleon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢嘅承諾，佢係變色龍，冇定性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 ge3 sing4 nok6, keoi5 hai6 bin3 sik1 lung4, mou5 ding6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別相信他的承諾，他是個變色龍，沒有定性。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust his promises; he's a chameleon and lacks consistency.

mandarin_meaning: 變調 / 聲調變化；（口語）改變態度或說話的腔調
english_meaning: tone sandhi; change of tone; (figuratively) change one's tune; go off-key
explanation_mandarin: 在語言學中指聲調在特定語境下的變化（如變調、聲調同化）；口語中亦可表示改變態度或說話方式；在音樂語境可指走音或音高改變。
explanation_english: In linguistics, refers to tone sandhi — changes in tone pronunciation in certain contexts. Figuratively, it can mean someone 'changes their tune' or alters their attitude; in musical contexts it can mean going off-key or changing pitch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種方言嘅變調好複雜，唔容易學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 fong1 jin4 ge3 bin3 diu6 hou2 fuk6 zaap6, m4 jung4 ji6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種方言的變調很複雜，不容易學。
examples.english_sentence: The tone sandhi in this dialect is very complicated and not easy to learn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到消息之後即刻變調，態度完全唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6 zik1 hak1 bin3 diu6, taai3 dou6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到消息後立刻變了態，態度完全不同。
examples.english_sentence: He immediately changed his tune after hearing the news; his attitude was completely different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺唱歌嗰陣有啲變調，音準唔穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 coeng3 go1 go2 zan6 jau5 di1 bin3 diu6, jam1 zeon2 m4 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你唱歌的時候有點走音，音準不穩。
examples.english_sentence: When you sang, you went off-key a bit; your pitch was unstable.

mandarin_meaning: 變賣 / 出售（財產、物品以換取現金）
english_meaning: to sell off (property or goods), to dispose of assets by sale, often to raise cash
explanation_mandarin: 把財產或物品出售以換取現金，常用於為償債或籌資等情況。
explanation_english: To sell property or goods to obtain cash; often used when selling assets to pay debts or raise funds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為欠咗好多債，只好將間舊屋變賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 him3 zo2 hou2 do1 zaai3, zi2 hou2 zoeng1 gaan1 gau6 uk1 bin3 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為欠了很多債，只好把舊房子變賣。
examples.english_sentence: He had to sell off his old house because he was heavily in debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗籌學費，變賣咗啲首飾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 cau4 hok6 fai3, bin3 maai6 zo2 di1 sau2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了籌學費，她把一些首飾變賣了。
examples.english_sentence: She sold some jewelry to raise tuition.

mandarin_meaning: 变质；指品质改变、腐坏，或比喻性质、道德的堕落
english_meaning: to change in quality; to deteriorate or go bad; (figuratively) to degenerate or become corrupt
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物在品质上发生变化（如食物腐坏）或性格、性质上恶化、堕落。
explanation_english: Indicates a change in quality (e.g., food spoiling) or a deterioration/degeneration of character, nature, or principles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢瓶牛奶變質咗，唔好飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ping4 ngau4 naai5 bin3 zat1 zo2, m4 hou2 jam2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这瓶牛奶变质了，不能喝。
examples.english_sentence: This bottle of milk has gone bad; don't drink it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗利益佢哋變質咗，唔再為公眾著想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 lei6 jik6 keoi5 dei6 bin3 zat1 zo2, m4 zoi6 wai6 gung1 zung3 zoek3 soeng2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了利益他们变质了，不再为公众着想。
examples.english_sentence: They compromised their principles for profit and became corrupt; they no longer consider the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲水果放耐咗就會變質，最好趁新鮮食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 seoi2 gwo2 fong3 noi6 zo2 zau6 wui5 bin3 zat1, zeoi3 hou2 can3 san1 sin1 sik6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些水果放久了就会变质，最好趁新鲜吃。
examples.english_sentence: If these fruits are left too long they will go bad; it's best to eat them while fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 变身 (biàn shēn) — 变成另一种形态或外貌；在动漫、影视作品中常指由普通形态转为特殊/超能形态，也可比喻改变身份或风格。
english_meaning: to transform; transformation — to change into another form or appearance (often used in animation/film for a character 'morphing'); can also be used figuratively for changing style, role, or identity.
explanation_mandarin: 表示（尤指在漫畫、動畫或電影中）由一種形態轉變為另一種形態或外貌；口語中亦可指改變身份、風格或形象。
explanation_english: Denotes changing into another form or appearance (especially in comics/animation/film); colloquially it can mean changing one's identity, style, or image.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺舞台上變身做另一個人，觀眾尖叫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mou5 toi4 soeng6 bin3 san1 zou6 ling6 jat1 go3 jan4, gun1 zung3 zim1 giu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在舞台上变身成另一个人，观众尖叫。
examples.english_sentence: He transformed into another person on stage, and the audience screamed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路最鍾意睇啲變身卡通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 di1 bin3 san1 kaa1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子最喜欢看变身的卡通。
examples.english_sentence: Kids love watching transformation cartoons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近變身做潮人，成日著得好有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 bin3 san1 zou6 ciu4 jan4, sing4 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近变身为潮人，整天穿得很有型。
examples.english_sentence: He recently transformed into a trendy person and always dresses stylishly.

mandarin_meaning: 变通（灵活处理、调整方法）
english_meaning: to be flexible; flexibility; to adapt or make adjustments according to circumstances
explanation_mandarin: 指在不同情況下能夠靈活處理、調整方法或做法，以達到目的或解決問題。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability to handle situations flexibly by adjusting methods or approaches to achieve goals or solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺工作上要識得變通，唔好成日死守規矩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 zok3 soeng6 jiu3 sik1 dak1 bin3 tung1, m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 sei2 sau2 kwai1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在工作上要学会变通，不要总是死守规矩。
examples.english_sentence: At work you should learn to be flexible; don't always rigidly stick to the rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到突發事件，大家要有變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 dat6 faat3 si6 gin2, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 jau5 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到突发事件，大家要有变通。
examples.english_sentence: When unexpected incidents occur, everyone needs to be flexible.

mandarin_meaning: 变速
english_meaning: change speed; variable speed; gear shifting
explanation_mandarin: 指改變速度或調整速率，常用於車輛的變速箱/變速器、單車換檔或播放速度等功能。
explanation_english: Refers to changing speed or adjusting the rate; commonly used for vehicle gearboxes/gear shifting, bicycle gears, or variable playback speed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部車要去保養，變速箱好似有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 ce1 jiu3 heoi3 bou2 joeng5, bin3 cuk1 soeng1 hou2 ci5 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的車要去保養，變速箱好像有問題。
examples.english_sentence: My car needs servicing; the gearbox seems to have a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果單車冇變速，好難爬山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 daan1 ce1 mou5 bin3 cuk1, hou2 naan4 paa4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果單車沒有變速（裝置），很難爬山。
examples.english_sentence: If the bicycle doesn't have gears, it's hard to climb hills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部播放器可以變速播放影片，方便重播。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 bo1 fong3 hei3 ho2 ji5 bin3 cuk1 bok3 fong3 jing2 pin2, fong1 bin6 zou6 cung4 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個播放器可以變速播放影片，方便重播。
examples.english_sentence: This player can play videos at variable speeds, which is convenient for replaying.

mandarin_meaning: 變速器（车辆或机械上用于改变传动比的装置，如汽車的變速箱或自行車的變速系統）
english_meaning: transmission; gearbox; speed changer (a device that changes gear ratios in a vehicle or machine)
explanation_mandarin: 指安裝在車輛或機械上，用以改變齒輪比或傳動速比的裝置。汽車常稱為變速箱，單車則為變速系統或變速器（含撥鏈、飛輪等部件）。
explanation_english: A device installed in vehicles or machinery that changes gear ratios or transmission speed. In cars it's commonly called a gearbox or transmission; in bicycles it refers to the gear/derailleur system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部車個變速器壞咗，要拎去維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 ce1 go3 bin3 cuk1 hei3 waai6 zo2, jiu3 ling1 heoi3 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的車的變速器壞了，要拿去維修。
examples.english_sentence: The transmission in my car broke; I need to take it in for repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單車個變速器如果唔保養，好容易甩鏈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 ce1 go3 bin3 cuk1 hei3 jyu4 gwo2 m4 bou2 joeng5, hou2 jung4 ji6 lat1 lin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不保養單車的變速器，很容易脫鏈。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't maintain a bicycle's gears, the chain can easily slip.

mandarin_meaning: 變速箱（汽車的傳動裝置/變速器）
english_meaning: gearbox; transmission (the vehicle component that changes gear ratios to control speed and torque)
explanation_mandarin: 汽車或其他機械使用的裝置，用來改變輸出轉速和扭力以配合不同行駛狀況，亦稱為變速器或傳動箱。
explanation_english: A mechanical device in a vehicle or machinery that changes output speed and torque by selecting different gear ratios; also called a gearbox or transmission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部車個變速箱壞咗，要拎去整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 ce1 go3 bin3-cuk1-soeng1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 ling1 heoi3 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的車的變速箱壞了，要拿去修理。
examples.english_sentence: The gearbox in my car is broken; I need to take it for repairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 換檔之前記住熄火，避免整壞變速箱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun6-dong3 zi1-cin4 gei3-zyu6 sik1-fo2, bei6-min5 zing2-waai6 bin3-cuk1-soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 換檔之前記得熄火，以免弄壞變速箱。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to turn off the engine before changing gears to avoid damaging the gearbox.

mandarin_meaning: 变迁（指事物随时间发生的变化，尤指社会、历史、环境等方面的变动）
english_meaning: change; transformation; vicissitudes (usually referring to changes over time, especially in society, history, or environment)
explanation_mandarin: 表示隨著時間推移而發生的變化、演變，多用於社會、歷史、環境等範疇，帶有長期或階段性變動的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to changes or transformations that occur over time, often used for social, historical, or environmental shifts; implies long-term or phased change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會嘅變遷真係好快，年輕人嘅想法同以前唔同晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 ge3 bin3 cin1 zan1 hai6 hou2 faai3, nin4 hing1 jan4 ge3 soeng2 faat3 tung4 ji5 cin4 m4 tung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会的变迁真的很快，年轻人的想法跟以前完全不同了。
examples.english_sentence: Social change is happening so quickly; young people's ideas are completely different from before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市嘅面貌經歷咗幾十年嘅變遷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 si5 ge3 min6 maau6 ging1 lik6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 ge3 bin3 cin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 城市的面貌经历了几十年的变迁。
examples.english_sentence: The city's appearance has undergone decades of change.

mandarin_meaning: 变量
english_meaning: variable (a quantity that can change; in math, programming, or science)
explanation_mandarin: 在數學、程式設計或科學中，指可以改變或取不同值的量或符號（如變數）。
explanation_english: A quantity that can change. In mathematics, programming, and science, a symbol or storage location whose value can vary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個程式入面，呢個變量會隨住用戶輸入改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 jap6 min6, ni1 go3 bin3 loeng6 wui5 seoi4 zyu6 jung6 wu6 syu1 jap6 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个程序里面，这个变量会随着用户输入改变。
examples.english_sentence: In this program, this variable will change according to the user's input.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺方程式中，x 同 y 都係變量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 fong1 cing4 sik1 zung1, x tung4 y dou1 hai6 bin3 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在方程式中，x 和 y 都是变量。
examples.english_sentence: In the equation, x and y are both variables.

mandarin_meaning: 变阵（改变阵型/战术、调整策略）
english_meaning: change formation/lineup; switch tactics or strategy
explanation_mandarin: 表示改变阵型或战术安排，常用于体育（如足球换阵）、政治或工作场景，指为应对形势而调整部署或策略。
explanation_english: Refers to changing a formation or lineup, or adjusting tactics/strategy. Commonly used in sports (e.g., switching football formations), politics, or organizational contexts when adapting to changing circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練喺下半場變陣，由四四二轉做三五二。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 hai2 haa6 bun3 coeng4 bin3 zan6, jau4 sei3 sei3 ji6 zyun2 zou6 saam1 ng5 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练在下半场变阵，由4-4-2改成3-5-2。
examples.english_sentence: The coach changed the formation in the second half, switching from a 4-4-2 to a 3-5-2.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 議會入面有人要求政府變陣，改變施政方向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 wui2 jap6 min6 jau5 jan4 jiu1 kau4 zing3 fu2 bin3 zan6, goi2 bin3 si1 zing3 fong1 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 议会里有人要求政府变阵，改变施政方向。
examples.english_sentence: Some people in the council are calling for the government to change its approach and alter its policy direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司個項目唔順，要變陣先至趕得到最後期限。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 go3 hong6 muk6 m4 seon6, jiu3 bin3 zan6 sin1 zi3 gon2 dak1 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 kei4 haan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的项目进展不顺，需要变阵才能赶上最后期限。
examples.english_sentence: The company's project progress isn't smooth; we need to change our approach to meet the deadline.

mandarin_meaning: 变电站 (biàn diàn zhàn)
english_meaning: electrical substation; transformer station
explanation_mandarin: 用於變換和分配電壓、轉換輸電到配電的設施，通常設有變壓器、開關設備與保護裝置，負責穩定與分配電力。
explanation_english: A facility that transforms voltage levels and distributes electrical power; typically contains transformers, switchgear, and protective devices to stabilize and route electricity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 附近嘅變電站今日要檢修，所以屋企可能會短暫停電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 gan6 ge3 bin3 din6 zaam6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 gim2 sau1, so2 ji5 uk1 kei5 ho2 nang4 wui5 dyun2 zaam6 ting4 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 附近的变电站今天要检修，所以家里可能会短暂停电。
examples.english_sentence: The nearby substation is undergoing maintenance today, so there may be a brief power outage at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新建嘅變電站可以提升整個地區嘅供電穩定性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 gin3 ge3 bin3 din6 zaam6 ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 zing2 go3 dei6 keoi1 ge3 gung1 din6 wan5 ding6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新建的变电站可以提升整个地区的供电稳定性。
examples.english_sentence: The newly built substation can improve the power supply stability of the entire area.

mandarin_meaning: 变脸（指川剧的变脸表演；口语中指态度或表情迅速改变）
english_meaning: face-changing (Sichuan opera art); to suddenly change one's facial expression or attitude
explanation_mandarin: 一方面是指川剧中的一种表演技艺——演员迅速更换面具或脸谱以变换表情；另一方面在口语中指人突然改变态度或表情，常含不稳定或虚伪的意味。
explanation_english: 1) The Sichuan-opera art of face-changing, where performers rapidly change masks/facial makeup. 2) Colloquially, to suddenly change one's expression or attitude, often implying inconsistency or hypocrisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日變面，唔可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bin3 min6, m4 ho2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是变脸，不可靠。
examples.english_sentence: He constantly changes his attitude; not reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 川劇演員嘅變面好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun1 kek6 jin2 jyun4 ge3 bin3 min6 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 川剧演员的变脸很出名。
examples.english_sentence: Sichuan opera performers' face-changing is very famous.

mandarin_meaning: 变革（对制度、结构或方式进行根本性的改变或改革）
english_meaning: reform; transformation; a fundamental change in systems, structures, or methods
explanation_mandarin: 指對制度、組織、結構或做法進行根本性或深刻的改變，常用於政治、社會或企業等領域。
explanation_english: Refers to a fundamental or profound change in systems, organizations, structures, or practices; commonly used in political, social, or corporate contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司需要變革先可以跟上市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 bin3 gaak3 sin1 ho2 ji5 gan1 soeng5 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司需要变革才能跟上市场。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs reform to keep up with the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會變革通常會帶來陣痛，但亦有助長遠發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 bin3 gaak3 tung1 soeng4 wui5 daai3 loi4 zan6 tung3, daan6 jik6 jau5 zo6 coeng4 jyun5 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会变革通常会带来阵痛，但也有助于长远发展。
examples.english_sentence: Social transformations often bring growing pains, but they can aid long-term development.

mandarin_meaning: 變體；變異形式（如病毒變體或字形變體）
english_meaning: variant; variant form (e.g., a viral variant or a variant form of a character)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物由原有形式演變出去的不同形式，常用於病毒、字形或其他類型的變異。
explanation_english: Refers to a different form that has evolved from an original form; commonly used for virus variants, character variants, or other types of variations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新冠病毒出現咗好多變體，疫苗要跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 gun1 beng6 duk6 ceot1 jin2 zo2 hou2 do1 bin3 tai2, jik6 miu4 jiu3 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新冠病毒出現了很多變體，疫苗需要跟進。
examples.english_sentence: Many variants of the coronavirus have emerged; vaccines need to be updated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本字典記錄咗漢字嘅不同變體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 zi6 din2 gei3 luk6 zo2 hon3 zi6 ge3 bat1 tung4 bin3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本字典記錄了漢字的不同變體。
examples.english_sentence: This dictionary records different variants of Chinese characters.

mandarin_meaning: 变魔术 / 耍魔术
english_meaning: to perform magic tricks; to work magic; (figuratively) to manipulate or cover up using trickery
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指表演魔術；引申用法指用手法、技巧或花招去操弄、掩飾或巧妙處理事情（如操縱數字、掩蓋問題等）。
explanation_english: Literally means to perform magic tricks. Figuratively, it refers to using sleight-of-hand, tricks, or clever manipulations to hide, disguise, or manage a situation (e.g., manipulating numbers or covering up problems).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺舞台上變魔術，好吸引觀眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mou5 toi4 soeng6 bin3 mo1 seot6, hou2 kap1 jan5 gun1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在舞台上变魔术，很吸引观众。
examples.english_sentence: He performed magic on stage and it really attracted the audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司用數字變魔術，想掩飾虧損。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jung6 sou3 zi6 bin3 mo1 seot6, soeng2 jim2 sik1 kwai1 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司用数字变魔术，想掩饰亏损。
examples.english_sentence: The company manipulated the numbers to try to hide the losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔鍾意睇變魔術表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 zung1 ji3 tai2 bin3 mo1 seot6 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子喜欢看变魔术表演。
examples.english_sentence: Children like watching magic shows.

mandarin_meaning: 宴会；筵席
english_meaning: banquet; feast
explanation_mandarin: 指宴會、筵席，常用於書面或古體語境，表示聚餐祝賀等正式宴席。
explanation_english: Refers to a banquet or feast; a formal or literary term for a meal gathering or ceremonial feast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚公司有個讌，唔好遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gung1 si1 jau5 go3 jin6, m4 hou2 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚公司有個宴會，不要遲到。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a banquet tonight; don't be late.

mandarin_meaning: 仇、怨恨或報仇（古字用法）
english_meaning: enmity, hatred, foe; vengeance (classical/archaic usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「讎」為「仇」的異體字，表示仇敵或怨恨，也可作動詞表示復仇，常見於古文或成語中。
