explanation_english: A Cantonese vulgar colloquial expression meaning that something isn't worth the trouble or time to discuss or deal with; conveys dismissiveness or impatience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事真係費撚事傾，等佢自己處理啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 fai3 lan2 si6 king1, dang2 keoi5 zi6 gei2 cyu2 lei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事真的没必要多谈，让他自己处理吧。
examples.english_sentence: This matter really isn't worth discussing; let him handle it himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好費撚事傾佢啲缺點，佢都唔會改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 fai3 lan2 si6 king1 keoi5 di1 kyut3 dim2, keoi5 dou1 m4 wui5 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别去跟他罗嗦他的缺点了，他也不会改变。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother talking about his flaws; he won't change anyway.

mandarin_meaning: 费用
english_meaning: cost; expense; fee
explanation_mandarin: 表示为某项活动、服务或物品所需支付的金钱或开支。
explanation_english: Refers to the money required to pay for an activity, service, or item; costs or expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅費用係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 fei3 jung6 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的费用是多少？
examples.english_sentence: How much will this project cost?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會承擔部分費用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 sing4 daam1 bou6 fan6 fei3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司会承担部分费用。
examples.english_sentence: The company will cover part of the expenses.

mandarin_meaning: 费尽唇舌（fèi jìn chún shé）：用尽口舌去劝说、解释或辩论，常含徒劳或无效的意味。
english_meaning: To use every argument or word to persuade someone; to exhaust one's words/efforts in pleading or arguing (often implying it is in vain).
explanation_mandarin: 用盡口舌去勸說、解釋或辯論，通常帶有努力卻無法改變對方想法或徒勞無功的含義。
explanation_english: A phrase meaning to expend all one's words/arguments trying to persuade or reason with someone, often suggesting the attempt is futile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經費盡唇舌，佢都唔肯改變主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 fei3 zeon6 seon4 sit3, keoi5 dou1 m4 hang2 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经费尽唇舌，他还是不肯改变主意。
examples.english_sentence: I had exhausted all arguments, but he still refused to change his mind.

mandarin_meaning: 费尽心思（費盡心思）
english_meaning: to rack one's brains; to go to great lengths; to spare no effort
explanation_mandarin: 表示為了達到某個目的而耗費大量心思，絞盡腦汁、費盡心機去籌劃或處理事情。
explanation_english: Indicates using up a lot of mental effort to achieve something; to plan or work at something with great care and effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗呢個活動費盡心思，結果活動好成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 ni1 go3 wut6 dung6 fai3 zeon6 sam1 si1, git3 gwo2 wut6 dung6 hou2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了這個活動費盡心思，結果活動非常成功。
examples.english_sentence: He/She spared no effort for this event, and as a result the event was very successful.

mandarin_meaning: 費心 / 費神（花費心力、操心、麻煩）
english_meaning: to take trouble; to bother oneself; to expend effort; to be bothersome/tedious
explanation_mandarin: 「費神」是廣東話常用詞，表示花費心力、操心或覺得某事很麻煩，需要耗費精神或勞力。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression meaning to take trouble, spend effort or bother (oneself/others). It indicates something is bothersome, requires care, attention, or mental/physical effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好費神，我可以自己整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fei3 san4, ngo5 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別費神，我可以自己做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother (yourself), I can do it myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫手，唔使費神啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 sau2, m4 sai2 fei3 san4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝你幫忙，不用費心了。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks for helping, you don't need to bother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整理舊相簿好費神，但好值得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 lei5 gau6 soeng2 bou2 hou2 fei3 san4, daan6 hou2 zik1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整理舊相簿很費神，但很值得。
examples.english_sentence: Sorting through old photo albums is quite tedious, but it's worth it.

mandarin_meaning: 费解；难以理解
english_meaning: difficult to understand; puzzling; hard to comprehend
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事很难理解或不容易弄清楚，觉得费力才能明白。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is hard to understand or puzzling; not easy to make sense of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅內容好費解，我睇咗好耐都唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 noi6 jung4 hou2 fai3 gaai2, ngo5 tai2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的内容很费解，我看了很久都不明白。
examples.english_sentence: The content of this book is very hard to understand; I've read it for a long time and still don't get it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅原因聽落費解，要佢再講一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 jyun4 jan1 teng1 lok6 fai3 gaai2, jiu3 keoi5 zoi3 gong2 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲的原因听起来很费解，要他再解释一次。
examples.english_sentence: The reason he gave sounds puzzling; ask him to explain it again.

mandarin_meaning: 贴 (tiē) - 粘、贴上；在网络上发布；掏钱补贴
english_meaning: to stick/paste; to post (online); to subsidize/cover part of a cost; close-fitting
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物黏在另一物上（如把海報貼在牆上）；在網絡語境可指發帖、張貼；口語中也可指補貼錢或貼錢。
explanation_english: Used to indicate attaching or pasting something to another surface (e.g., putting a poster on a wall); in online contexts it can mean to post; colloquially it can also mean to chip in or subsidize money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我貼張海報喺牆上？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 tip3 zoeng1 hoi2bou3 hai2 coeng4 soeng6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我把海報貼在牆上嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me put this poster on the wall?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺Facebook貼咗張相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 Facebook tip3 zo2 zoeng1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛在Facebook貼了一張相片。
examples.english_sentence: I just posted a photo on Facebook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔夠錢，我可以幫你貼一筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 gau3 cin2, ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 tip3 jat1 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不夠錢，我可以幫你補貼一筆。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't have enough money, I can chip in and cover part of it for you.

mandarin_meaning: 贴上 / 粘贴（将某物粘到另一物上；在电子文档中粘贴内容）
english_meaning: to stick on; to paste; to attach (e.g., paste text or attach an item)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物粘到另一個物體表面（例如貼紙貼上），或在電子環境中將剪貼板內容粘貼到文件中（例如 Ctrl+V 貼上）。
explanation_english: Means to stick something onto a surface (e.g., affix a sticker) or, in a digital context, to paste clipboard content into a document (e.g., Ctrl+V).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將貼紙貼上封面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 tip3 zi2 tip3 soeng5 fung1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把贴纸贴在封面上。
examples.english_sentence: I stuck the sticker onto the cover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺文件入面用 Ctrl+V 將文字貼上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 man4 gin2 jap6 min6 jung6 Ctrl+V zoeng1 man4 zi6 tip3 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在文件中用 Ctrl+V 将文字粘贴上去。
examples.english_sentence: You can paste the text into the document using Ctrl+V.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經把相片貼上咗，你睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 baa2 soeng2 pin3 tip3 soeng5 zo2, nei5 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经把照片贴上了，你看一下。
examples.english_sentence: I've already attached/pasted the photo — take a look.

mandarin_meaning: 說中；擊中要害；命中目標
english_meaning: to be spot on; to hit the mark; to hit the target; to accurately match
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示說話、評論或行為非常準確，正中要點或命中目標。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to be exactly right or to hit the core/target; used when a remark or observation accurately captures the main point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰句真係好貼中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 ge3 zan1 hai6 hou2 tip3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說的那句話真是說中了。
examples.english_sentence: That thing you said was really spot on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇評論貼中咗問題嘅核心，分析好到位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 ping4 leon6 tip3 zung1 zo2 man6 tai4 ge3 hat6 sam1, fan1 sik1 hou2 dou3 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇評論擊中了問題的核心，分析很到位。
examples.english_sentence: This comment hit the core of the problem; the analysis is very on point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲評論好貼中我而家嘅處境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 ping4 leon6 hou2 tip3 zung1 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ge3 cyu3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的評論很切合我現在的處境。
examples.english_sentence: Your comment really matches my current situation.

mandarin_meaning: 黏人；形容經常黏著別人的人（跟屁蟲、跟班）
english_meaning: a clingy person; someone who sticks close to or constantly follows someone (a tagalong/hanger-on)
explanation_mandarin: 「貼仔」為香港廣東話俗語，通常指在情感或工作關係中過度黏著別人、經常跟隨或纏著他人的人，有時帶輕微貶義，也可戲稱。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "貼仔" refers to someone who is overly clingy or constantly sticks to another person, whether in relationships or at work. It can be mildly derogatory or used jokingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁貼仔啦，俾佢啲私人空間啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 tip3 zai2 laa1, bei2 keoi5 di1 si1 jan4 hung1 gaan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那麼黏人了，給他一些私人空間。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clingy; give him/her some personal space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面係老闆嘅貼仔，咩都聽老闆講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 hai6 lou5 baan2 ge3 tip3 zai2, me1 dou1 teng1 lou5 baan2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡是老闆的跟班，什麼都聽老闆的。
examples.english_sentence: He's the boss's hanger-on at the company; he listens to whatever the boss says.

mandarin_meaning: 黏人、黏著別人的（俚語）
english_meaning: clingy; someone who clings to or is overly attached (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，用來形容在感情或相處上對伴侶或他人過度依賴、黏著、常常貼近對方，常帶有抱怨或不耐煩的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang term describing someone who is overly clingy or attached to another person (often a romantic partner), implying annoyance or frustration from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都好貼佬，成日黐住男朋友，令對方覺得好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 tip3 lou2, sing4 jat6 ci1 zyu6 naam4 pang4 jau5, ling6 deoi3 fong1 gok3 dak1 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很黏人，總是緊黏著男朋友，讓對方覺得很煩。
examples.english_sentence: She's very clingy — always clinging to her boyfriend, which annoys him.

mandarin_meaning: 張貼；發布（把告示、照片、訊息等貼到牆上或發佈在網上）
english_meaning: to post; to put up; to paste up (a notice, photo, message, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把紙張、照片、告示等貼到牆上或在網路平台上發佈相關內容。
explanation_english: Used to indicate putting a physical item (notice, photo) on a surface or publishing/posting content on an online platform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺Facebook貼出咗好多旅行相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 Facebook tip3 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 leoi5 hang4 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在Facebook上貼出了很多旅行照片。
examples.english_sentence: He posted many travel photos on Facebook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校已經喺告示板貼出新時間表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 ji5 ging1 hai2 gou3 si3 baan2 tip3 ceot1 san1 si4 gaan3 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校已經在公告欄貼出新的時間表。
examples.english_sentence: The school has posted the new timetable on the bulletin board.

mandarin_meaning: 貼切
english_meaning: apt; fitting; appropriate; accurate
explanation_mandarin: 表示描述、比喻或用語非常恰當，貼合事實或內心想表達的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates that a description, metaphor, or wording is very apt or fitting — accurately matching the fact or the intended meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得好貼切，正正表達到我嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 hou2 tip3 cit3, zing3 zing3 biu2 daat6 dou3 ngo5 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說得很貼切，正好表達了我的意思。
examples.english_sentence: You put it very aptly; you exactly expressed what I meant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個比喻好貼切，大家一聽就明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bei2 jyu6 hou2 tip3 cit3, daai6 gaa1 jat1 teng1 zau6 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個比喻很貼切，大家一聽就明白。
examples.english_sentence: This metaphor is very apt; everyone understands it as soon as they hear it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅評論貼切而且中肯，你值得參考。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ping4 leon6 tip3 cit3 ji4 ce2 zung1 hang2, nei5 zik1 dak1 caam1 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的評論貼切而且中肯，你值得參考。
examples.english_sentence: His critique is apt and pertinent; it's worth considering.

mandarin_meaning: 接地氣（貼近民眾、接地氣、親民）
english_meaning: down-to-earth; unpretentious; relatable; authentic/local-flavored
explanation_mandarin: 表示人或事物貼近生活、平易近人、不做作，也可指具有本地特色或接地氣的風格。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is down-to-earth, unpretentious and relatable; can also mean having a local, authentic quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套劇好貼地，描寫市民生活好真實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 kek6 hou2 tip3 dei6, miu4 se2 si5 man4 sang1 wut6 hou2 zan1 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部剧很接地气，描写市民生活很真实。
examples.english_sentence: That drama is very down-to-earth; its portrayal of ordinary people's lives is very realistic.

mandarin_meaning: 上床 / 同床（与某人发生性关系或一起睡在一张床上）
english_meaning: to sleep in the same bed with someone; (colloquially) to have sex with someone
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，指與某人同床或發生性關係，通常用來形容情侶之間的親密或性關係。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang Cantonese expression meaning to share a bed with someone or to have sex; typically used to describe intimacy between romantic partners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啱啱拍拖，已經貼埋大床。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 paak3 to1, ji5 ging1 tip3 maai4 daai6 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们刚开始谈恋爱，就已经上床了。
examples.english_sentence: They just started dating and are already sleeping together (i.e., having sex).

mandarin_meaning: 和父母同住；依賴父母（常指成年後仍與父母同住）
english_meaning: to live with one's parents; to remain dependent on one's parents (often referring to an adult who still lives at home)
explanation_mandarin: 「貼堂」是廣東話俗語，字面上可理解為「黏在家裡的堂屋」，通常用來形容成年後仍與父母或家庭同住、較依賴父母的人。語氣上帶有一點評價或輕微貶義（如不獨立）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, "貼堂" literally suggests 'sticking to the family hall' and is used to describe an adult who still lives with and depends on their parents. It often carries a mildly judgmental or pejorative sense (not being independent).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢三十歲仲貼堂，成日要父母照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saam1 sap6 seoi3 zung6 tit3 tong4, sing4 jat6 jiu3 fu6 mou5 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他三十歲還和父母同住，經常要父母照顧。
examples.english_sentence: He's 30 and still lives with his parents, always needing their care.

mandarin_meaning: （小）貼士；提示；建議
english_meaning: tip; hint; helpful advice
explanation_mandarin: 「貼士」是粵語從英語“tip(s)”借來的詞，常用來指實用的小建議或提醒，比如旅遊、生活或工作上的小技巧。
explanation_english: A Cantonese borrowing from English “tip(s)”, used to refer to small pieces of practical advice, hints, or reminders (e.g., travel tips, life hacks, or helpful pointers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有啲旅行貼士可以幫到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 di1 leoi5 hang4 tip3 si6 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡有一些旅遊貼士可以幫到你。
examples.english_sentence: Here are some travel tips that can help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀咗我幾個實用嘅貼士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 ngo5 gei2 go3 sat6 jung6 ge3 tip3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他給了我幾個實用的貼士。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me several useful tips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網站有啲安全貼士，記得睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 zaam6 jau5 di1 ngon1 cyun4 tip3 si6, gei3 dak1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 網站上有一些安全貼士，記得看。
examples.english_sentence: The website has some safety tips; remember to read them.

mandarin_meaning: 和某人上床；發生性關係（俗語）
english_meaning: To sleep with someone; to have sexual intercourse with someone (colloquial/slang).
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面是「貼在大床上」，用來指與某人發生性關係或同床，通常在口語中使用，視語境可帶粗俗或輕佻的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression literally meaning "stick to the big bed." It refers to sleeping with someone or having sex with them. Common in informal speech and can be coarse depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢上星期同公司同事貼大床㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 keoi5 soeng6 sing1 kei4 tung4 gung1 si1 tung4 si6 tip3 daai6 cong4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說他/她上星期和公司同事上床了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he/she slept with a coworker last week.

mandarin_meaning: 臥床／賴床（長時間待在床上，可能因病臥床或懶得起身）
english_meaning: to stay in bed / to laze in bed (either bedridden due to illness or lazily staying in bed)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指長時間臥床或賴在床上不願起身做事；也可用於因病而臥床不起的情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to stay in bed for a long time — either lazily (to laze in bed) or because of illness (to be bedridden).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗兩個禮拜，貼大牀冇返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 loeng5 go3 lai5 baai3, tip3 daai6 cong4 mou5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了兩個禮拜，一直臥床沒去上班。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for two weeks and stayed in bed, not going to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個周末我唔想郁，淨係想貼大牀睇劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 zau1 mut6 ngo5 m4 soeng2 juk6, zing6 hai6 soeng2 tip3 daai6 cong4 tai2 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個週末我不想動，只想躺在床上看劇。
examples.english_sentence: This weekend I don't want to move — I just want to stay in bed and watch shows.

mandarin_meaning: 貼心
english_meaning: considerate; thoughtful; intimate/close
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人很體貼、關心周到，或形容某事物貼近內心、讓人覺得溫暖和被理解。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is considerate and thoughtful, or something that feels intimate/heartwarming and shows care or attention to detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好貼心，成日都記得我鍾意嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tip3 sam1, sing4 jat6 dou1 gei3 dak1 ngo5 zung1 ji3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的是很貼心，總是記得我喜歡的東西。
examples.english_sentence: He's really considerate; he always remembers the things I like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁貼心，我好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 tip3 sam1, ngo5 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼貼心，我很感動。
examples.english_sentence: You're so thoughtful — I'm touched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計好貼心，有位可以放埋張信用卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sit3 gai3 hou2 tip3 sam1, jau5 wai6 ho2 ji5 fong3 maai4 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個設計很貼心，有地方可以放信用卡。
examples.english_sentence: This design is very thoughtful; there's a slot to put a credit card.

mandarin_meaning: 貼文 / 帖子（在社交媒體或論壇上發布的內容）
english_meaning: post (on social media or forums)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（口語中亦可作動詞使用）
explanation_mandarin: 指在社交媒體、論壇或博客上發布的文字、圖片、影片等內容。口語中有時也用作動詞，表示發布貼文。
explanation_english: Refers to content (text, images, videos) published on social media, forums, or blogs. Informally it can also be used as a verb meaning to post.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇睇過我昨日嘅貼文？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 tai2 gwo3 ngo5 zok6 jat6 ge3 tip3 man4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有看過我昨天的貼文？
examples.english_sentence: Did you see my post yesterday?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲貼文成日好有心機，張相修得靚晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 tip3 man4 sing4 jat6 hou2 jau5 sam1 gei1, zoeng1 soeng2 sau1 dak1 leng3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的貼文總是很用心，照片修得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: His posts are always well-made; the photos are edited nicely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺 Facebook 貼咗個貼文，大家可以去睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 hai2 Facebook tip3 zo2 go3 tip3 man4, daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 heoi3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛在 Facebook 貼了一則貼文，大家可以去看。
examples.english_sentence: I just posted a post on Facebook; everyone can go check it out.

mandarin_meaning: 信服；貼合（合身）
english_meaning: to be convinced; convincing; to fit closely/snugly
explanation_mandarin: 「貼服」在廣東話中常見有兩種意思：一是形容某人對說法或解釋感到信服、被說服；二是形容物件或衣服緊貼、合身、貼合。視語境可作動詞或形容詞使用。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '貼服' commonly has two senses: (1) to be convinced or persuaded by an argument/explanation; (2) to fit closely or snugly (e.g. clothing). It can function as either a verb or an adjective depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽完佢嘅解釋之後，好貼服佢嘅講法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 jyun4 keoi5 ge3 gaai2 sik1 zi1 hau6, hou2 tip3 fuk6 keoi5 ge3 gong2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我聽完他的解釋之後，很信服他的說法。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing his explanation, I was convinced by what he said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好貼服你個身形，睇落好合身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 tip3 fuk6 nei5 go3 san1 jing4, tai2 lok6 hou2 hap6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服很貼合你的身形，看起來很合身。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing fits your body well; it looks very flattering.

mandarin_meaning: 把票據在到期前以折扣方式換取現金；對票據進行折價兌現（貼現）
english_meaning: to discount a bill or draft (i.e., to cash a bill before its maturity by accepting a discount)
explanation_mandarin: 貼現是一種金融操作，指持票人在票據到期前，將票據以低於面值的價格賣給銀行或金融機構，以提前取得現金，常用於解決短期資金需求。
explanation_english: Discounting is a financial operation where a bill or draft is sold to a bank or financial institution before maturity at a price below its face value, allowing the holder to obtain cash earlier — commonly used to meet short-term funding needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司把張票貼現咗，解決短期資金問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 baa2 zoeng1 piu3 tip3 jin6 zo2, gaai2 kyut3 dyun2 kei4 zi1 gam1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司把票貼現了，解決了短期資金問題。
examples.english_sentence: The company discounted the bill to solve its short-term cash flow problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以將支票提前貼現，唔駛擔心收唔到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 zi1 piu3 tai4 cin4 tip3 jin6, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 sau1 m4 dou3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們可以把支票提前貼現，不用擔心收不到錢。
examples.english_sentence: We can discount the cheque early, so we don't have to worry about not receiving the money.

mandarin_meaning: 贴现率 (tiēxiànlǜ)：将未来现金流或票据折算为现值时使用的利率；银行贴现票据时收取的利率，或指中央银行的贴现政策利率。
english_meaning: Discount rate: the interest rate used to discount future cash flows to their present value; the rate charged by banks when discounting bills; can also refer to a central bank's discount rate.
explanation_mandarin: 貼現率是用來把未來的款項或票據折算為現值的利率。金融機構在對票據進行貼現時會根據貼現率計算應收取的費用；中央銀行調整貼現率會影響市場利率與借貸成本。
explanation_english: The discount rate used to convert future payments or bills into present value. Financial institutions use it to calculate charges when discounting bills; changes in a central bank's discount rate affect market interest rates and borrowing costs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中央銀行決定提高貼現率，會令借貸成本上升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 joeng1 ngan4 hong4 kyut3 ding6 tai4 gou1 tip3 jin6 leot6, wui5 ling6 ze3 daai3 sing4 bun2 soeng5 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中央银行决定提高贴现率，会使借贷成本上升。
examples.english_sentence: The central bank decided to raise the discount rate, which will increase borrowing costs.

mandarin_meaning: 貼紙 (tiēzhǐ)
english_meaning: sticker; adhesive label
explanation_mandarin: 黏貼在物品表面以作裝飾或標示的紙張或塑膠片，通常有背膠，可直接貼上。
explanation_english: A paper or plastic piece with adhesive on the back used for decoration or labeling; commonly known as a sticker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想喺電話後面貼張貼紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hai2 din6 waa2 hau6 min6 tip3 zoeng1 tip3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想在手機後面貼一張貼紙。
examples.english_sentence: I want to stick a sticker on the back of my phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友鍾意收集貼紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 zung1 ji3 sau1 zaap6 tip3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子喜歡收集貼紙。
examples.english_sentence: Kids like to collect stickers.

mandarin_meaning: 貼紙照片 / 可貼的照片
english_meaning: sticker photo; photo sticker
explanation_mandarin: 指以貼紙形式列印出來的小型照片，可以撕下來貼在手帳、手機或筆記本等物品上，通常由拍貼機或相館即時列印。
explanation_english: Small photos printed on sticker paper that can be peeled and stuck onto surfaces (planners, phones, notebooks, etc.), typically produced by photo booths or instant printing services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺相館整咗啲貼紙相，依家全部都貼咗喺我嘅手帳度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 soeng2 gun2 zing2 zo2 di1 tip3 zi2 soeng2, ji1 gaa1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 tip3 zo2 hai2 ngo5 ge3 sau2 zoeng3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛在照相館做了幾張貼紙照片，現在全部都貼在我的手帳裡。
examples.english_sentence: I just had some sticker photos made at the photo studio, and now they're all stuck in my planner.

mandarin_meaning: 在街上張貼廣告/傳單（通常指隨意或違規張貼）
english_meaning: to post flyers/posters on the street (often flyposting or unauthorised street advertising)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，指在街道或公共場所的牆壁、路燈柱等處張貼廣告、傳單或宣傳物，常含隨意或違規張貼的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to paste posters or flyers in public street locations (on walls, lampposts, etc.), often implying unauthorised or flyposting-style advertising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺呢度貼街招，政府會罰款㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai6 ni1 dou6 tip3 gaai1 ziu1, zing3 fu2 wui5 fat6 fun2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在這裡貼街招，政府會罰款的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't post flyers here; the government will fine you.

mandarin_meaning: 貼身 / 親近 / 緊貼（視語境，可指緊貼身體的、私人貼身的或關係親近）
english_meaning: close-fitting; close to the body; personal; intimate; (as noun/compound) close personal bodyguard
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（也可作動詞或複合名詞成分）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (can function attributively); also used in compounds as noun modifier
explanation_mandarin: 「貼身」可指衣物緊貼身體（合身、緊身），亦可指與某人關係親近或有專人緊密保護（如貼身保鏢）。用法視語境而定。
explanation_english: “貼身” describes something that fits closely to the body (form-fitting), denotes close/personal/intimate relationship, or indicates close protection (e.g., personal bodyguard). Usage depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好貼身，唔太透氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 tip3 san1, m4 taai3 tau3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服很貼身，不太透氣。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is very form-fitting and not very breathable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢帶咗個貼身保鏢去見客戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zo2 go3 tip3 san1 bou2 biu1 heoi3 gin3 haak3 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帶了個貼身保鏢去見客戶。
examples.english_sentence: He brought a personal bodyguard to meet the client.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個相處得好貼身，成日一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 soeng1 cyu3 dak1 hou2 tip3 san1, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們兩個相處得很親近，常常在一起。
examples.english_sentence: They are very close and are often together.

mandarin_meaning: 貼身膏藥（形容緊貼不離、難以擺脫的人或物；常用來指黏人的伴侶或跟班）
english_meaning: Someone or something that sticks closely and is hard to get rid of; a clingy person or constant hanger-on
explanation_mandarin: 用來比喻總是緊貼在某人身邊、難以擺脫的人或物，通常帶有貶義或調侃意味，例如形容黏人的伴侶或跟班。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a person or thing that clings closely to someone and is hard to shake off. Often derogatory or teasing, used for clingy partners, followers, or hangers-on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢同阿明一齊後，佢變成阿明嘅貼身膏藥，成日黐住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 tung4 aa3 ming4 jat1 cai4 hau6, keoi5 bin3 sing4 aa3 ming4 ge3 tip3 san1 gou1 joek6, sing4 jat6 ci1 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從她和阿明在一起後，她成了阿明的貼身膏藥，總是黏著他。
examples.english_sentence: Since she got together with Ah Ming, she became his clingy companion and is always sticking to him.

mandarin_meaning: 贴身裤（贴身穿着的内裤或紧身下装）
english_meaning: close-fitting underwear / underpants; tight-fitting pants worn close to the body
explanation_mandarin: 指緊貼身體穿着的褲子或內褲，通常指內層貼身的下裝，例如三角褲、緊身內褲或貼身打底褲。
explanation_english: Refers to pants or undergarments worn close to the body, typically innerwear such as briefs, boxer-briefs, or tight-fitting undershorts/leggings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天我鍾意着貼身褲，涼快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ngo5 zung1 ji3 zoek3 tip3 san1 fu3, loeng4 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天我喜欢穿贴身裤，会比较凉快。
examples.english_sentence: In summer I like wearing close-fitting underwear; it's cooler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條貼身褲太緊，我唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 tip3 san1 fu3 taai3 gan2, ngo5 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条贴身裤太紧，我不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This close-fitting pair of pants is too tight; I'm uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 贴近
english_meaning: to be close to; to approach; to be near (physically or metaphorically)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在空間上靠近某物或在情感、觀念上與某事物接近、貼合。例如：貼近生活、貼近需要。
explanation_english: Indicates physical proximity to something or figurative closeness/approximation (emotionally, conceptually, or in relevance). Examples: close to life, close to needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好貼近火爐，會好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tip3 gan6 fo2 lou4, wui5 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要靠近火爐，會很危險。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get close to the stove; it's very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本小說好貼近香港人嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 siu2 seot3 hou2 tip3 gan6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本小說很貼近香港人的生活。
examples.english_sentence: This novel closely reflects the lives of Hong Kong people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師試下用例子，令課堂內容更貼近學生嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 si3 haa5 jung6 lai6 zi2, ling6 fo3 tong4 noi6 jung4 gang3 tip3 gan6 hok6 saang1 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師試著用例子，讓課堂內容更貼近學生的需要。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher tried using examples to make the lesson content more closely match students' needs.

mandarin_meaning: 贴钱（付出额外钱款/补贴；在交易中亏钱）
english_meaning: to pay extra money (to subsidize); to lose money on a deal
explanation_mandarin: 表示出钱补贴某事或在买卖/交易中必须额外付钱，或因此亏损。
explanation_english: To put up money to subsidize something or to have to add money (thereby taking a loss) in a transaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次飯錢我貼錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 faan6 cin2 ngo5 tip3 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次饭钱我来贴钱吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll pay/chip in for the meal this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車賣唔出，賣家要貼錢先有人買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 maai6 m4 ceot1, maai6 gaa1 jiu3 tip3 cin2 sin1 jau5 jan4 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车卖不出去，卖家要贴钱才有人买。
examples.english_sentence: The car won't sell; the seller has to subsidize it for someone to buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 自討苦吃／自找麻煩（做出令自己難受或傷心的事）
english_meaning: literally 'pay money to buy discomfort' — to bring suffering on oneself; to do something that unnecessarily makes oneself unhappy or suffer
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，字面是「付錢買難受」，用來形容自己做出會令自己難過、受傷或麻煩的事情，相當於「自找麻煩／自討苦吃」。常用於責備或勸阻別人不要重複會傷害自己的行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression literally meaning 'pay money to buy discomfort.' It describes doing something that needlessly makes oneself unhappy or causes suffering — akin to 'bringing it on yourself' or 'asking for trouble.' Often used to warn or criticize someone for repeating hurtful behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日返去同佢傾偈，淨係令自己傷心，真係貼錢買難受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 faan1 heoi3 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2, zing6 hai6 ling6 zi6 gei2 soeng1 sam1, zan1 hai6 tip3 cin2 maai5 naan4 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是回去跟他聊，结果只会让自己难过，真是自讨苦吃。
examples.english_sentence: You keep going back to talk to him and it only makes you sad — you're just asking for it.
